tEn: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX) — Form 424B4 Final Prospectus (IPO)
tZh: 太空探索技术公司（SpaceX）——424B4 最终招股说明书（IPO）
sEn: SpaceX's IPO prospectus pitches a vertically integrated space, connectivity, and AI company with $18,674 million in 2025 revenue and a $(2,589) million operating loss.
sZh: SpaceX 招股书展示了一家垂直整合的太空、连接与 AI 公司，2025 年营收 186.74 亿美元、经营亏损 25.89 亿美元。
absEn: This prospectus summary describes SpaceX, a vertically integrated company founded in 2002 that designs, manufactures, launches, and operates rockets, spacecraft, and satellite networks, and that acquired xAI in early 2026. The company states its mission as making life multiplanetary, understanding the universe, and extending consciousness to the stars, pursued through three segments: Space, Connectivity (Starlink), and AI (Grok and X). Core to its argument is that first-principles engineering and extreme vertical integration have driven down launch costs, enabled a global broadband constellation serving roughly 10.3 million subscribers across 164 markets as of March 31, 2026, and supported development of a truth-seeking frontier AI model. Management presents financial results showing consolidated revenue of $18,674 million and a loss from operations of $(2,589) million in 2025, with Connectivity profitable and AI still investment-heavy. The company concludes that converging space, connectivity, and AI capabilities position it to build orbital AI compute infrastructure and capture what it calls the largest economic frontier in history, while cautioning that the summary is incomplete and that investors should review the risk factors and financial statements before investing.
absZh: 本招股说明书摘要介绍 SpaceX——一家成立于 2002 年的垂直整合公司，业务涵盖火箭、航天器和卫星网络的设计、制造、发射与运营，并于 2026 年初收购了 xAI。公司称其使命是让生命多行星化、理解宇宙并将意识延伸至星辰，通过太空、连接（Starlink）和 AI（Grok 与 X）三大板块推进。其核心论点是：第一性原理工程与极致的垂直整合压低了发射成本，支撑起一个全球宽带星座——截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，该星座在 164 个市场拥有约 1030 万用户——并支持了一款追求真相的前沿 AI 模型的开发。管理层列示的财务数据显示，2025 年合并营收为 186.74 亿美元，经营亏损为 25.89 亿美元，其中连接业务已实现盈利，AI 业务仍处于重投入阶段。公司总结称，太空、连接与 AI 能力的融合使其能够构建轨道 AI 算力基础设施，并把握其所谓历史上最大的经济前沿；同时提醒本摘要并不完整，投资者在投资前应审阅风险因素和财务报表。

contrib.zh: 2025 年营收 186.74 亿美元，经营亏损 25.89 亿美元，调整后 EBITDA 为 65.84 亿美元。

contrib.en: Starlink: ~10.3M subscribers, 164 markets, ~9,600 satellites as of March 31, 2026.
contrib.zh: 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，星链约 1030 万用户、覆盖 164 个市场、约 9600 颗卫星。

contrib.en: Connectivity 2025 revenue $11,387M, up 49.8%; operating income $4,423M, up 120.4%.
contrib.zh: 连接业务 2025 年营收 113.87 亿美元，增长 49.8%；经营利润 44.23 亿美元，增长 120.4%。

contrib.en: Falcon rockets: >80% of world mass to orbit yearly since 2023, >99% success.
contrib.zh: 自 2023 年起，猎鹰火箭每年承担全球超 80%入轨质量，任务成功率超 99%。

contrib.en: AI segment 2025 revenue $3,201M, operating loss $(6,355)M; capex $12,727M.
contrib.zh: AI 业务 2025 年营收 32.01 亿美元，经营亏损 63.55 亿美元，资本开支 127.27 亿美元。

contrib.en: Grok/X: ~550M MAUs, ~117M Grok users; ~1.3B supported accounts as of March 31, 2026.
contrib.zh: 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，Grok 与 X 约 5.5 亿月活、1.17 亿 Grok 用户、13 亿支持账户。

limits.en: Growth hinges on Starship scaling; payload delivery to orbit only expected in H2 2026.
limits.zh: 增长高度依赖星舰规模化，预计 2026 年下半年才开始向轨道运送载荷。

limits.en: Orbital AI compute, lunar economy and Mars plans use unproven tech; deployment as early as 2028.
limits.zh: 轨道 AI 算力、月球经济与火星计划依赖未经验证的技术，最早 2028 年部署。

limits.en: AI segment deeply loss-making with $12.7B 2025 capex; profitability uncertain.
limits.zh: AI 业务严重亏损，2025 年资本开支 127 亿美元，盈利前景不确定。

limits.en: Company reports consolidated operating losses in 2025 and Q1 2026 despite Adjusted EBITDA gains.
limits.zh: 尽管调整后 EBITDA 为正，公司 2025 年及 2026 年一季度合并口径仍经营亏损。

limits.en: $28.5T TAM excludes China and Russia; many target markets are still emerging.
limits.zh: 28.5 万亿美元 TAM 剔除中国和俄罗斯，且诸多目标市场仍处新兴阶段。

paras.en: The terms and abbreviations defined in this section are used throughout this prospectus:
paras.zh: 本节所定义的术语和缩写贯穿本招股说明书全文：

paras.en: - “AI” or “artificial intelligence” refers to advanced computational technologies and systems enabling machines to learn, comprehend reality, solve complex problems, exhibit creativity, make critical decisions, and function with growing autonomy.
paras.zh: - “AI”或“人工智能”指使机器能够学习、理解现实、解决复杂问题、展现创造力、做出关键决策并以日益增强的自主性运行的高级计算技术和系统。

paras.en: - “AI compute” or “compute” refers to the computing infrastructure required to train and operate artificial intelligence models, including, without limitation, specialized processors, networking, storage, and power systems deployed in data centers or other computing environments.
paras.zh: - “AI 算力”或“算力”指训练和运行人工智能模型所需的计算基础设施，包括但不限于部署在数据中心或其他计算环境中的专用处理器、网络、存储和电力系统。

paras.en: - “AI compute satellite” refers to a satellite equipped with onboard artificial intelligence processing capabilities designed to perform data analysis, inference, or other machine learning, automated decision-making and artificial intelligence algorithms, models and technologies workloads in orbit.
paras.zh: - “AI 算力卫星”指搭载星载人工智能处理能力、设计用于在轨执行数据分析、推理或其他机器学习、自动化决策及人工智能算法、模型和技术工作负载的卫星。

paras.en: - “AI ecosystem” refers to a complex, multi-layered network of technologies, products, systems, and infrastructure that develop, leverage, and deploy intelligent systems.
paras.zh: - “AI 生态系统”指由开发、利用和部署智能系统的技术、产品、系统和基础设施构成的复杂、多层次的网络。

paras.en: - “AI segment” refers to our AI business, which we acquired in connection with our acquisition of xAI in February 2026, and includes our AI compute, Grok, and X.
paras.zh: - “AI 分部”指我们的 AI 业务，该业务系随我们于 2026 年 2 月收购 xAI 一并取得，包括我们的 AI 算力、Grok 和 X。

paras.en: - “AI training cluster” refers to an integrated system that provides computational power required for training and running advanced AI models.
paras.zh: - “AI 训练集群”指提供训练和运行先进 AI 模型所需算力的集成系统。

paras.en: - “The Algorithm” refers to our five-step iterative process that we use to rapidly innovate and optimize, emphasizing making the requirements less dumb, deleting unnecessary processes or parts, optimizing the necessary processes or parts, accelerating cycle timesteps, and automating only proven processes after the first four steps are completed.
paras.zh: - “算法”指我们用于快速创新和优化的五步迭代流程，强调让需求不那么愚蠢、删除不必要的流程或部件、优化必要的流程或部件、加快循环时间步，以及仅在前四步完成后对已验证的流程进行自动化。

paras.en: - “Application Programming Interface” or “API” refers to a defined set of rules and protocols that allows different software systems to communicate with and interact with each other programmatically.
paras.zh: - “应用程序编程接口”或“API”指一组已定义的规则和协议，使不同软件系统能够以编程方式相互通信和交互。

paras.en: - “ARPU” refers to service revenue generated from Starlink Subscribers during a period divided by (i) the average number of Starlink Subscribers during the period and by (ii) the number of months in the period.
paras.zh: - “ARPU”指某一期间内 Starlink 用户产生的服务收入除以 (i) 该期间内 Starlink 用户的平均数量，再除以 (ii) 该期间的月份数。

paras.en: - “Artemis program” refers to a NASA program aimed at landing humans on the Moon by the late 2020s.
paras.zh: - “Artemis 计划”指 NASA 旨在到 2020 年代末将人类送上月球的一项计划。

paras.en: - “booster” refers to the first-stage rocket that provides the primary thrust during launch.
paras.zh: - “助推器”指在发射期间提供主要推力的第一级火箭。

paras.en: - “booster catch” refers to a recovery method in which a returning first-stage rocket booster is captured mid-air by mechanical arms on the launch tower rather than on legs at a landing zone or at sea.
paras.zh: - “助推器捕获”指一种回收方式，即返回的一级火箭助推器由发射塔上的机械臂在半空中捕获，而非在着陆区或海上通过着陆腿着陆。

paras.en: - “booster launch” refers to a rocket launch in which a booster stage provides the primary thrust during liftoff and the initial phase of ascent before separating from the vehicle.
paras.zh: - “助推器发射”指一种火箭发射方式，其中助推级在升空及上升初始阶段提供主要推力，随后与飞行器分离。

paras.en: - “bps” refers to bits per second.
paras.zh: - “bps”指比特每秒。

paras.en: - “COLOSSUS” refers to our flagship data center, located on Paul R. Lowry Road in Memphis, Tennessee.
paras.zh: - “COLOSSUS”指我们的旗舰数据中心，位于田纳西州孟菲斯的 Paul R. Lowry Road。

paras.en: - “COLOSSUS II” refers to our data centers in Memphis, Tennessee and in Southaven, Mississippi. These data centers are part of our coherent gigawatt-scale AI training cluster.
paras.zh: - “COLOSSUS II”指我们位于田纳西州孟菲斯和密西西比州 Southaven 的数据中心。这些数据中心是我们连贯的吉瓦级 AI 训练集群的一部分。

paras.en: - “Connectivity segment” refers to our Connectivity segment, which includes Starlink and associated offerings.
paras.zh: - “Connectivity 分部”指我们的 Connectivity 分部，包括 Starlink 及相关产品。

paras.en: - “Credit Agreements” refers to our SpaceX Credit Facility and SpaceX Bridge Loan.
paras.zh: - “信贷协议”指我们的 SpaceX 信贷融资和 SpaceX 过桥贷款。

paras.en: - “crewmember” refers to a person who has traveled on our spacecraft, measuring by each mission.
paras.zh: - “乘员”指曾乘坐我们航天器的人员，按每次任务计算。

paras.en: - “daily posts” on X and Grok refers to the aggregate volume of original posts, replies, reposts, quotes and media shared daily by users on the X platform, and the real-time interactions, analysis and generative capabilities provided to a user by Grok. This may include posts generated by AI or accounts managed by AI.
paras.zh: - X 和 Grok 上的“每日帖子”指用户在 X 平台上每日分享的原创帖子、回复、转发、引用和媒体的总数量，以及 Grok 向用户提供的实时交互、分析和生成能力。这可能包括由 AI 生成的帖子或由 AI 管理的账户。

paras.en: - “downlink capacity” refers to the maximum rate at which data can be transmitted from a satellite to users over a network or communication link in a given period of time.
paras.zh: - “下行容量”指在给定时间段内，数据通过网络或通信链路从卫星传输至用户的最大速率。

paras.en: - “Draco thrusters” refers to thrusters used in Dragon spacecraft for precise orbital maneuvering and adjustments.
paras.zh: - “Draco 推进器”指 Dragon 航天器上用于精确轨道机动和调整的推进器。

paras.en: - “Dragon” refers to our Dragon spacecraft.
paras.zh: - “Dragon”指我们的 Dragon 航天器。

paras.en: - “Falcon 1” refers to our two-stage, liquid-fueled small-lift launch vehicle that operated from 2006 to 2009.
paras.zh: - “Falcon 1”指我们于 2006 年至 2009 年运营的两级液体燃料小型运载火箭。

paras.en: - “Falcon 9” refers to our orbital-class rocket with reusable boosters, first launched in 2010, which has a payload capacity to LEO of approximately 23 metric tons.
paras.zh: - “Falcon 9”指我们具备可重复使用助推器的轨道级火箭，于 2010 年首飞，其近地轨道（LEO）运载能力约为 23 公吨。

paras.en: - “Falcon Heavy” refers to our partially reusable super heavy-lift launch vehicle, first launched in 2018, which has a payload capacity to LEO of approximately 64 metric tons.
paras.zh: - “Falcon Heavy”指我们部分可重复使用的超重型运载火箭，于 2018 年首飞，其近地轨道（LEO）运载能力约为 64 公吨。

paras.en: - “flight-proven booster launches” refers to a mission utilizing a booster that has previously completed at least one successful launch and recovery.
paras.zh: - “flight-proven booster launches”指使用此前已至少完成一次成功发射与回收的助推器执行的任务。

paras.en: - “frontier model” refers to a leading-edge, sophisticated large language model, such as Grok, designed for rigorous reasoning and real-time information synthesis.
paras.zh: - “frontier model”指领先的、复杂的大型语言模型，例如 Grok，专为严谨推理与实时信息综合而设计。

paras.en: - “Gbps” refers to gigabits per second.
paras.zh: - “Gbps”指吉比特每秒。

paras.en: - “geostationary orbit” refers to a high Earth orbit that allows satellites to match Earth’s rotation, appearing stationary from the ground, often used for communication satellites.
paras.zh: - “geostationary orbit”指一种高地球轨道，可使卫星与地球自转同步、从地面看呈静止状态，常用于通信卫星。

paras.en: - “geosynchronous transfer orbit” refers to an elliptical orbit used to transfer a spacecraft from a lower orbit to a geostationary orbit.
paras.zh: - “geosynchronous transfer orbit”指用于将航天器从较低轨道转移至地球静止轨道的椭圆轨道。

paras.en: - “gigawatt” refers to one billion watts.
paras.zh: - “gigawatt”指十亿瓦。

paras.en: - “gigawatt-scale” refers to infrastructure, systems, or facilities that are designed to generate, transmit, or consume approximately one gigawatt or more of electrical power capacity.
paras.zh: - “gigawatt-scale”指设计用于产生、传输或消耗约一吉瓦或以上电力容量的基础设施、系统或设施。

paras.en: - “GPU” refers to a graphics processing unit.
paras.zh: - “GPU”指图形处理器。

paras.en: - “Grok” refers to our family of frontier models, which represents a core pillar of our mission to advance humanity’s understanding of the universe through the development of truth-seeking artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: - “Grok”指我们的前沿模型系列，它代表我们使命的核心支柱，即通过开发追求真理的人工智能，推进人类对宇宙的理解。

paras.en: - “Grok API” refers to our application programming interface that enables developers to access and integrate Grok models into external software applications and workflows.
paras.zh: - “Grok API”指我们的应用程序编程接口，使开发者能够访问 Grok 模型并将其集成到外部软件应用程序和工作流程中。

paras.en: - “Grok Business” refers to our subscription-based offering that provides organizations with access to Grok models and related tools for use in internal business applications and workflows, designed for deployment by small-to-medium teams.
paras.zh: - “Grok Business”指我们基于订阅的服务，为组织提供 Grok 模型及相关工具的访问权限，用于内部业务应用程序和工作流程，专为中小型团队部署而设计。

paras.en: - “Grok Enterprise” refers to our subscription-based offering that provides organizations with access to Grok models and related tools for use in internal business applications and workflows, designed for deployment by enterprise organizations.
paras.zh: - “Grok Enterprise”指我们基于订阅的服务，为组织提供 Grok 模型及相关工具的访问权限，用于内部业务应用程序和工作流程，专为企业组织部署而设计。

paras.en: - “Grok Voice” refers to the Grok real-time speech engine.
paras.zh: - “Grok Voice”指 Grok 实时语音引擎。

paras.en: - “high-density compute” refers to compute infrastructure designed to deliver a large amount of processing power within a limited physical footprint, typically characterized by high processor concentration and elevated power usage per unit of space.
paras.zh: - “高密度算力”指旨在在有限物理空间内提供大量处理能力的算力基础设施，通常以高处理器密度和单位空间较高功耗为特征。

paras.en: - “Imagine” refers to our image and video generation system.
paras.zh: - “Imagine”指我们的图像和视频生成系统。

paras.en: - “inference” refers to the process by which a trained artificial intelligence model generates outputs (such as text, images, or predictions) from new input data.
paras.zh: - “推理”指经过训练的人工智能模型根据新输入数据生成输出（如文本、图像或预测）的过程。

paras.en: - “International Docking System Standard” refers to a standard for autonomous docking capabilities used by spacecraft like Dragon.
paras.zh: - “国际对接系统标准”指龙飞船等航天器所使用的自主对接能力标准。

paras.en: - “IoT” refers to the network of physical objects embedded with sensors, software, and other technologies for the purpose of connecting and exchanging data with other devices and systems over the internet.
paras.zh: - “IoT”指嵌入传感器、软件和其他技术的物理对象网络，目的是通过互联网与其他设备和系统连接并交换数据。

paras.en: - “Kardashev Type II” refers to a civilization that harnesses the full energy output of its local star, like our Sun, to power unprecedented growth and sustain the civilization’s existence.
paras.zh: - “卡尔达舍夫 II 型”指能够利用其所在恒星（如我们的太阳）的全部能量输出，以驱动前所未有的增长并维持文明存续的文明。

paras.en: - “large language model” or “LLM” refers to a sophisticated artificial intelligence model designed for advanced reasoning and natural language processing.
paras.zh: - “大语言模型”或“LLM”指专为高级推理和自然语言处理而设计的复杂人工智能模型。

paras.en: - “large-scale LEO broadband satellite constellation” refers to a satellite constellation network of over 1,000 satellites.
paras.zh: - “大规模低轨宽带卫星星座”指由超过 1,000 颗卫星组成的卫星星座网络。

paras.en: - “latency” refers to the time delay between the transmission of data from a source and its receipt at a destination, typically measured in milliseconds.
paras.zh: - “延迟”是指数据从源端传输到目的端接收之间的时间延迟，通常以毫秒为单位计量。

paras.en: - “launch payload mass” refers to the theoretical payload mass that a particular spacecraft is capable of delivering to a specified orbit under specific conditions, which is derived from advanced computer simulations and performance modeling that apply to particular mission scenarios and trajectory assumptions. Actual payload that can be delivered for a given mission may be different and will vary depending on numerous mission parameters and operational factors, including mission-specific trajectory requirements, atmospheric conditions, vehicle and payload configuration, risk profile, and applicable regulatory or range-safety limitations.
paras.zh: - “发射载荷质量”是指在特定条件下某一航天器能够将理论载荷质量投送至指定轨道的数值，该数值源自适用于特定任务场景和轨迹假设的先进计算机模拟与性能建模。特定任务实际可投送的载荷可能不同，并将因众多任务参数和运行因素而异，包括任务特定的轨迹要求、大气条件、运载器与载荷构型、风险状况以及适用的监管或靶场安全限制。

paras.en: - “launch system” refers to a comprehensive system comprising rockets and associated ground infrastructure used to launch spacecraft and payloads into space.
paras.zh: - “发射系统”是指由火箭及相关地面基础设施组成的综合系统，用于将航天器和载荷发射至太空。

paras.en: - “launch vehicle” refers to a rocket designed to transport payloads from terrestrial bodies (e.g., Earth, Moon, or Mars) to space or to a designated orbital trajectory.
paras.zh: - “运载火箭”是指设计用于将载荷从地球等陆地天体（例如地球、月球或火星）运送至太空或指定轨道轨迹的火箭。

paras.en: - “LEO satellite constellation” refers to a network of numerous satellites operating in Low-Earth Orbit, typically deployed to provide services such as broadband connectivity, including Starlink.
paras.zh: - “低地球轨道卫星星座”是指在低地球轨道运行的由众多卫星组成的网络，通常用于提供宽带连接等服务，包括 Starlink。

paras.en: - “Low-Earth Orbit” or “LEO” refers to an orbit relatively close to Earth’s surface, typically used by satellites for applications like broadband internet due to its lower latency compared to higher orbits.
paras.zh: - “低地球轨道”或“LEO”是指相对接近地球表面的轨道，由于其延迟低于更高轨道，通常被卫星用于宽带互联网等应用。

paras.en: - “low-latency network” refers to a network with latency below 70 milliseconds.
paras.zh: - “低延迟网络”是指延迟低于 70 毫秒的网络。

paras.en: - “lunar mass driver” refers to a launch system that we intend to build on the Moon’s surface that will be designed to use electromagnetic acceleration to propel payloads into space without the use of rockets.
paras.zh: - “月球质量驱动器”是指我们拟在月球表面建造的发射系统，其设计将利用电磁加速将载荷推入太空，而无需使用火箭。

paras.en: - “Macrohard” refers to a platform we are currently developing that is designed to emulate digital workflows, augment human operation of computers, and create a fully AI-operated software company.
paras.zh: - “Macrohard”是指我们目前正在开发的一个平台，旨在模拟数字工作流程、增强人类对计算机的操作，并创建一家完全由 AI 运营的软件公司。

paras.en: - “mass to orbit” refers to the total kilograms of payload deployed to orbit in a given period, and is a key indicator of our capacity and scalability that supports Space revenue and drives expansion across our Connectivity and AI segments.
paras.zh: - “入轨质量”是指在给定期间内投送至轨道的载荷总千克数，是衡量我们能力和可扩展性的关键指标，可支撑太空业务收入并推动我们连接和 AI 板块的扩张。

paras.en: - “MAU” (or monthly active users) refers to the total number of users who have interacted with Grok or X through web browsers or mobile applications at least once during the 30-day period ending on the date of measurement (“active users”). In presenting combined MAUs across the two platforms, we seek to identify and account for users who access both Grok and X based on sign-in traffic so that such users are not double-counted when measuring MAU. Furthermore, only users who have registered for an X or Grok account are included. While we believe our methodologies provide a reasonable approximation of MAU based on the number of unique users, they may not fully capture all instances of duplication, and our reported MAU should be viewed as an estimate of unique users across our Grok and X platforms for the applicable period. We track the subset of users who used Grok’s AI features and those who have not based on the source of their server requests.
paras.zh: - “MAU”（即月活跃用户）指在截至计量日期的 30 天期间内，通过网页浏览器或移动应用程序至少与 Grok 或 X 互动过一次的用户总数（“活跃用户”）。在列示两个平台的合并 MAU 时，我们力求根据登录流量识别并计入同时访问 Grok 和 X 的用户，以免在计量 MAU 时对此类用户重复计算。此外，仅统计已注册 X 或 Grok 账户的用户。尽管我们认为我们的方法能够基于独立用户数对 MAU 作出合理近似，但这些方法可能无法完全涵盖所有重复情形，我们报告的 MAU 应被视为适用期间内 Grok 和 X 平台独立用户数的估计值。我们根据服务器请求来源，分别追踪使用 Grok AI 功能的用户子集与未使用该功能的用户子集。

paras.en: - “Mbps” refers to megabits per second.
paras.zh: - “Mbps”指兆比特每秒。

paras.en: - “Megapack” refers to a containerized, utility-scale lithium-ion battery energy storage system produced by Tesla and designed to stabilize power grids, store renewable energy, and replace fossil fuel peaker plants.
paras.zh: - “Megapack”指由 Tesla 生产的一种集装箱式公用事业规模锂离子电池储能系统，旨在稳定电网、储存可再生能源并替代化石燃料调峰电厂。

paras.en: - “megawatt” refers to one million watts.
paras.zh: - “megawatt”指一百万瓦。

paras.en: - “Merlin” refers to the Merlin family of engines, which include vacuum and sea level variants and are fully developed and produced by the Company.
paras.zh: - “Merlin”指 Merlin 系列发动机，包括真空型和海平面型，均由本公司完全开发并生产。

paras.en: - “microgravity” refers to very weak gravity, such as that experienced in orbiting spacecraft, which allows for unique manufacturing processes like creating ultra-pure materials.
paras.zh: - “microgravity”指极微弱的引力，例如在轨道航天器中所经历的引力环境，可实现制造超纯材料等独特制造工艺。

paras.en: - “Mid-Earth Orbit” or “MEO” refers to an orbital region between approximately 2,000 km and 35,786 km above Earth’s surface.
paras.zh: - “Mid-Earth Orbit”或“MEO”指距地球表面约 2,000 km 至 35,786 km 之间的轨道区域。

paras.en: - “mission success rate” refers to the proportion of Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy missions that achieve their primary objectives. This term does not include Starship flight tests.
paras.zh: - “mission success rate”指 Falcon 9 和 Falcon Heavy 任务实现其主要目标的比例。该术语不包括 Starship 飞行测试。

paras.en: - “mobile network operators” or “MNOs” refers to the local entities of the companies that provide mobile phone services to customers, with whom SpaceX partners to offer satellite-to-mobile connectivity. The term may also include mobile virtual network operators, where applicable.
paras.zh: - “mobile network operators”或“MNOs”指向客户提供移动电话服务的公司的当地实体，SpaceX 与其合作提供卫星到移动设备的连接服务。在适用情况下，该术语也可包括移动虚拟网络运营商。

paras.en: - “Mobile Satellite Service” refers to providing wireless voice, messaging, and data connectivity to, from, or between mobile devices by using orbiting satellites rather than terrestrial cell towers.
paras.zh: - “Mobile Satellite Service”指通过使用轨道卫星而非地面蜂窝基站，向移动设备、从移动设备或在移动设备之间提供无线语音、消息和数据连接。

paras.en: - “Moore’s Law” refers to an observation, not a physical law, that the number of transistors on a microchip doubles roughly every two years, leading to exponentially faster, smaller, and cheaper electronics.
paras.zh: - “Moore’s Law”指一种观察结论（而非物理定律），即微芯片上的晶体管数量大约每两年翻一番，从而使电子产品速度呈指数级提升、体积更小且成本更低。

paras.en: - “orbital AI compute” refers to artificial intelligence computing infrastructure contemplated to be deployed in space, consisting of satellite constellations that act as orbital data centers, harnessing solar energy for power and leveraging the space environment for cooling. We expect to begin deploying our orbital AI compute satellites as early as 2028.
paras.zh: - “orbital AI compute”指拟部署在太空的人工智能算力基础设施，由充当轨道数据中心的卫星星座组成，利用太阳能供电并借助太空环境进行冷却。我们预计最早于 2028 年开始部署我们的轨道 AI 算力卫星。

paras.en: - “payload” refers to the portion of a vehicle’s total mass that consists of the cargo, passengers, satellites, or other mission-specific items being transported and that reaches the target orbit or destination. Payload is distinct from total mass (also referred to as gross mass or initial mass) which is the entire weight of the vehicle, including the payload, fuel / propellant, structure, engines, and any other items, at the start of a journey.
paras.zh: - “有效载荷”指飞行器总质量中由所运输的货物、乘客、卫星或其他特定任务物品构成、并抵达目标轨道或目的地的部分。有效载荷不同于总质量（也称毛质量或初始质量），后者指飞行器在旅程开始时的全部重量，包括有效载荷、燃料/推进剂、结构、发动机及任何其他物品。

paras.en: - “payload capacity to orbit” refers to a theoretical payload capacity that a particular launch vehicle is capable of delivering to a specified orbit (e.g., LEO or GEO) or celestial body (e.g., Mars) under specific conditions, which orbit is derived from advanced computer simulations and performance modelling that apply to particular mission scenarios and trajectory assumptions. Actual payload capacity for a given mission may be different and will vary depending on numerous mission parameters and operational factors, including mission-specific trajectory requirements, atmospheric conditions, vehicle and payload configuration, risk profile, and applicable regulatory or range-safety limitations.
paras.zh: - “入轨有效载荷能力”指某一特定运载火箭在特定条件下能够将有效载荷送达指定轨道（如 LEO 或 GEO）或天体（如火星）的理论有效载荷能力，该轨道系通过适用于特定任务场景和轨迹假设的先进计算机模拟与性能建模得出。特定任务的实际有效载荷能力可能不同，并将因众多任务参数和运行因素而异，包括任务特定轨迹要求、大气条件、飞行器与有效载荷配置、风险状况以及适用的监管或靶场安全限制。

paras.en: - “Power Usage Effectiveness” refers to the global standard metric for data center efficiency, calculated as the ratio of total facility power to IT equipment power.
paras.zh: - “电能使用效率”指数据中心效率的全球标准指标，按设施总用电量与 IT 设备用电量之比计算。

paras.en: - “propellant” refers to the chemical substance or combination of substances consumed by a rocket engine to produce thrust by generating high-velocity exhaust gases.
paras.zh: - “推进剂”指火箭发动机通过产生高速废气以产生推力所消耗的化学物质或多种物质的组合。

paras.en: - “propulsive landing” refers to the process of landing a rocket or spacecraft using its engines to control descent and achieve a soft, vertical touchdown.
paras.zh: - “动力着陆”指火箭或航天器利用其发动机控制下降并实现柔和垂直触地的着陆过程。

paras.en: - “radiative cooling” refers to a cooling method that dissipates heat by radiating it into space, often passively, and is expected to be used in orbital AI compute infrastructure.
paras.zh: - “辐射冷却”指通过将热量辐射至太空来散热的冷却方式，通常为被动方式，预计将用于轨道 AI 算力基础设施。

paras.en: - “Raptor engines” refers to high-performance family of engines developed and produced by the Company, such as those powering the Super Heavy booster and Starship upper stage, designed for efficiency and reusability.
paras.zh: - “Raptor 发动机”指本公司研发和生产的高性能发动机系列，例如为 Super Heavy 助推器和 Starship 上级提供动力的发动机，其设计注重效率与可重复使用性。

paras.en: - “reflight” refers to the reuse of a flight-proven rocket booster or upper stage that has successfully completed a prior space mission, and has been recovered, refurbished, and certified for subsequent launches.
paras.zh: - “复飞”指对已完成先前太空任务并已成功回收、翻新并获认证用于后续发射的经飞行验证的火箭助推器或上级进行重复使用。

paras.en: - “return payload mass” refers to the theoretical payload mass that a particular spacecraft is capable of bringing back to Earth from a specified orbit under specific conditions, which is derived from advanced computer simulations and performance modelling that apply to particular mission scenarios and trajectory assumptions. Actual payload that can be returned for a given mission may be different and will vary depending on numerous mission parameters and operational factors, including mission-specific trajectory requirements, atmospheric conditions, vehicle and payload configuration, risk profile, and applicable regulatory or range-safety limitations.
paras.zh: - “返回有效载荷质量”指某一特定航天器在特定条件下能够从指定轨道带回地球的理论有效载荷质量，该质量系通过适用于特定任务场景和轨迹假设的先进计算机模拟与性能建模得出。特定任务实际可返回的有效载荷可能不同，并将因众多任务参数和运行因素而异，包括任务特定轨迹要求、大气条件、飞行器与有效载荷配置、风险状况以及适用的监管或靶场安全限制。

paras.en: - “rideshare” refers to a type of space mission where multiple satellites or payloads from different customers are launched together on a single rocket, sharing the cost.
paras.zh: - “拼车发射”指一种太空任务类型，即来自不同客户的多个卫星或有效载荷搭载同一枚火箭一起发射，共担成本。

paras.en: - “satellite-to-mobile” refers to a service that provides global cellular connectivity directly to everyday smartphones via satellites, supplementing terrestrial networks and eliminating mobile dead zones.
paras.zh: - “卫星直连手机”是指通过卫星直接为日常智能手机提供全球蜂窝连接的服务，作为地面网络的补充，消除移动信号盲区。

paras.en: - “Service Line” refers to an individual instance of Starlink broadband internet service provisioned under a subscription plan, generally associated with a specific Starlink User Terminal or group of terminals, and billed according to Starlink’s service plans and terms of service. The number of Service Lines is distinct from the number of unique devices, account holders, end users, or physical persons.
paras.zh: - “服务线路”是指在订阅计划下开通的单个 Starlink 宽带互联网服务实例，通常与特定的 Starlink 用户终端或一组终端相关联，并按照 Starlink 的服务计划和条款计费。服务线路数量不同于唯一设备数、账户持有人数、最终用户数或自然人数。

paras.en: - “space economy” refers to economic activities related to the development, production, and operation of goods and services that utilize or support space-based infrastructure and capabilities, including launch services, satellite systems, and space-enabled technologies.
paras.zh: - “太空经济”是指与利用或支持天基基础设施和能力的商品和服务的开发、生产和运营相关的经济活动，包括发射服务、卫星系统和太空赋能技术。

paras.en: - “Space segment” refers to our Space segment, which includes our customer launch operations and offerings such as Falcon, Dragon, and Starship.
paras.zh: - “太空板块”是指我们的太空板块，包括我们的客户发射业务以及 Falcon、Dragon 和 Starship 等产品。

paras.en: - “SpaceX Bridge Loan” refers to the Bridge Loan Credit Agreement, dated as of March 2, 2026, by and among the Company, as borrower, the guarantors from time to time party thereto, the lenders from time to time party thereto and Goldman Sachs Bank USA, as administrative agent and a lender.
paras.zh: - “SpaceX 过桥贷款”是指日期为 2026 年 3 月 2 日的《过桥贷款信贷协议》，其订约方包括作为借款人的本公司、不时作为订约方的担保人、不时作为订约方的贷款人以及作为行政代理人和贷款人的 Goldman Sachs Bank USA。

paras.en: - “SpaceX Credit Facility” refers to our Credit Agreement, dated as of February 7, 2025, by and among the Company, as borrower, the guarantors from time to time party thereto, the lenders from time to time party thereto and Bank of America, N.A., as administrative agent, as amended by the First Amendment to Credit Agreement and Waiver, dated as of March 2, 2026, by and among the Company, the lenders party thereto, and the other L/C Issuers party thereto. In May 2026, the SpaceX Credit Facility was amended to increase the borrowing capacity and extends the maturity date.
paras.zh: - “SpaceX 信贷融资”是指我们日期为 2025 年 2 月 7 日的《信贷协议》，其订约方包括作为借款人的本公司、不时作为订约方的担保人、不时作为订约方的贷款人以及作为行政代理人的 Bank of America, N.A.，并经日期为 2026 年 3 月 2 日的《信贷协议第一修正案及豁免》修订，该修正案的订约方包括本公司、其订约方贷款人及其他订约方信用证开证人。2026 年 5 月，SpaceX 信贷融资经修订以增加借款额度并延长到期日。

paras.en: - “spectrum” refers to the range of electromagnetic frequencies used for wireless communication, with licensed spectrum granting use for specific services.
paras.zh: - “频谱”是指用于无线通信的电磁频率范围，其中授权频谱授予特定服务的使用权。

paras.en: - “Starlink” refers to our global Low-Earth Orbit satellite constellation and broadband network designed to deliver high-speed, low-latency internet connectivity worldwide.
paras.zh: - “Starlink”是指我们旨在全球范围内提供高速、低延迟互联网连接的全球低地球轨道卫星星座和宽带网络。

paras.en: - “Starlink Consumer Broadband” refers to a category of Starlink active users encompassing both individual residential users (households and personal use) and small-to-medium-sized businesses.
paras.zh: - “Starlink 消费者宽带”是指涵盖个人住宅用户（家庭和个人使用）及中小型企业的 Starlink 活跃用户类别。

paras.en: - “Starlink Fixed Site” refers to a category of Starlink active users encompassing exclusively enterprise businesses.
paras.zh: - “Starlink 固定站点”是指仅涵盖企业客户的 Starlink 活跃用户类别。

paras.en: - “Starlink Kit” refers to a set of products needed to connect to the Starlink network, typically including a Starlink User Terminal and accessories.
paras.zh: - “Starlink 套件”是指连接 Starlink 网络所需的一组产品，通常包括一个 Starlink 用户终端及配件。

paras.en: - “Starlink Mobile” refers to a service that provides cellular connectivity directly to everyday smartphones via satellites, supplementing terrestrial networks and substantially reducing mobile dead zones.
paras.zh: - “Starlink 移动”是指通过卫星直接为日常智能手机提供蜂窝连接的服务，作为地面网络的补充，并大幅减少移动信号盲区。

paras.en: - “Starlink Subscriber” refers to a unique Service Line that is directly assigned to a Starlink.com account registered to a person or entity that does not have a direct, negotiated agreement with the Starlink sales team.
paras.zh: - “Starlink 订户”指直接分配给在 Starlink.com 注册的账户的唯一下一代服务线路，该账户注册于未与 Starlink 销售团队签订直接协商协议的个人或实体。

paras.en: - “Starlink User Terminal” refers to a device developed by the Company that connects to the Starlink satellite constellation to deliver high-speed, low-latency internet.
paras.zh: - “Starlink 用户终端”指公司开发的、连接 Starlink 卫星星座以提供高速、低延迟互联网的设备。

paras.en: - “Starshield” refers to a secure satellite network designed specifically for government customers and national security applications.
paras.zh: - “Starshield”指专为政府客户和国家安全应用设计的安全卫星网络。

paras.en: - “Starship” refers to a fully reusable, super heavy-lift launch vehicle. Starship can be used to describe the stacked vehicle (booster and upper stage) or upper stage only. We expect Starship to commence payload delivery to orbit in the second half of 2026.
paras.zh: - “Starship”指完全可重复使用的超重型运载火箭。Starship 可指堆叠式运载器（助推器和上面级）或仅指上面级。我们预计 Starship 将于 2026 年下半年开始向轨道运送有效载荷。

paras.en: - “Sun-synchronous orbit” refers to a type of polar orbit around a planet in which a satellite passes over any given point of the planet’s surface at the same local mean solar time, allowing for consistent solar energy capture.
paras.zh: - “太阳同步轨道”指一种绕行星的极地轨道，卫星在任意给定地表点上空以相同的当地平太阳时经过，从而实现一致的太阳能捕获。

paras.en: - “Super Heavy” refers to the reusable first-stage booster for the Starship launch vehicle, powered by 33 Raptor engines.
paras.zh: - “Super Heavy”指 Starship 运载火箭的可重复使用第一级助推器，由 33 台 Raptor 发动机提供动力。

paras.en: - “SuperGrok” refers to our subscription-based Grok service that provides users with expanded access to Grok models and related tools.
paras.zh: - “SuperGrok”指我们基于订阅的 Grok 服务，为用户提供对 Grok 模型及相关工具的扩展访问权限。

paras.en: - “SuperGrok Heavy” refers to our subscription-based Grok service tier that provides users with expanded access to Grok models and related tools, including higher usage limits relative to SuperGrok.
paras.zh: - “SuperGrok Heavy”指我们基于订阅的 Grok 服务层级，为用户提供对 Grok 模型及相关工具的扩展访问权限，包括相对于 SuperGrok 更高的使用限额。

paras.en: - “SuperGrok Lite” refers to our subscription-based Grok service tier that provides users with basic access to Grok models and related tools.
paras.zh: - “SuperGrok Lite”指我们基于订阅的 Grok 服务层级，为用户提供对 Grok 模型及相关工具的基本访问权限。

paras.en: - “supported accounts” refers to, when used in the context of our X platform and Grok, a human, bot or similar account that logged into the X platform or Grok. The total number of supported accounts may include fake, spam or bot accounts if they are active.
paras.zh: - “supported accounts”（受支持账户）在我们的 X 平台和 Grok 语境下使用时，指登录 X 平台或 Grok 的人类、机器人或类似账户。受支持账户总数可能包括虚假、垃圾邮件或机器人账户（若其处于活跃状态）。

paras.en: - “Tbps” refers to terabits per second.
paras.zh: - “Tbps”指太比特每秒。

paras.en: - “Terafab” refers to a chip manufacturing initiative with a long-term goal of producing one terawatt of compute hardware each year.
paras.zh: - “Terafab”指一项芯片制造计划，其长期目标是每年生产一太瓦的算力硬件。

paras.en: - “terawatt” refers to one trillion watts.
paras.zh: - “太瓦”指一万亿瓦特。

paras.en: - “terawatt-scale” refers to infrastructure, systems, or facilities that are designed to generate, transmit, or consume approximately one terawatt or more of electrical power capacity.
paras.zh: - “太瓦级”指设计用于产生、传输或消耗约一太瓦或以上电力容量的基础设施、系统或设施。

paras.en: - “terrestrial AI compute” refers to artificial intelligence computing infrastructure located on Earth, such as data centers and supercomputers, used for training and running AI models.
paras.zh: - “地面 AI 算力”指位于地球上的、用于训练和运行 AI 模型的人工智能计算基础设施，例如数据中心和超级计算机。

paras.en: - “throughput” refers to the rate at which data or material can be processed or transferred, often referring to network capacity or production output.
paras.zh: - “吞吐量”指数据或材料可被处理或传输的速率，通常指网络容量或生产产出。

paras.en: - “tokens” refers to the basic units of text or images processed and generated by an AI model, used to measure AI workload, throughput, and computational output.
paras.zh: - “token”指由 AI 模型处理和生成的基本文本或图像单元，用于衡量 AI 工作负载、吞吐量和计算输出。

paras.en: - “watt” is the International System of Units (SI) unit for measuring power, representing the rate of which energy is transferred, used or generated.
paras.zh: - “瓦特”是国际单位制（SI）中用于衡量功率的单位，表示能量被传输、使用或产生的速率。

paras.en: - “X” refers to our real-time information, entertainment, and free speech platform that serves as a foundational distribution and data engine for the AI ecosystem.
paras.zh: - “X”指我们的实时信息、娱乐和言论自由平台，其作为 AI 生态系统的基础分发和数据引擎。

paras.en: - “xAI” refers to X.AI Holdings LLC or, prior to the xAI Merger, X.AI Holdings Corp., together with its subsidiaries, as applicable.
paras.zh: - “xAI”指 X.AI Holdings LLC，或在 xAI 合并之前指 X.AI Holdings Corp.，连同其子公司（视情况而定）。

paras.en: - “xAI Gov” refers to our offering that provides government customers with access to Grok models and related tools for use in governmental applications, workflows, and services.
paras.zh: - “xAI Gov”指我们提供的产品，使政府客户能够访问 Grok 模型及相关工具，用于政府应用、工作流程和服务。

paras.en: - “X Premium+” refers to our highest subscription tier for X.
paras.zh: - “X Premium+”指我们面向 X 的最高订阅层级。

paras.en: #### Our Satellite Names
paras.zh: #### 我们的卫星名称

paras.en: We use a “V” naming convention for our Starlink satellites (such as V1, V2 Mini, and V3). Although we use a similar “V” naming convention for both our broadband and mobile satellite constellations, these are distinct systems. Our broadband satellites are designed to deliver high-speed internet services to homes, businesses, and vehicles, while our mobile satellites are designed to connect directly to cell phones from space. These constellations have different performance requirements and technical specifications. Please see below the terms used for our satellites throughout this prospectus:
paras.zh: 我们对 Starlink 卫星采用“V”命名惯例（例如 V1、V2 Mini 和 V3）。尽管我们对宽带和移动卫星星座均采用类似的“V”命名惯例，但它们是不同的系统。我们的宽带卫星旨在向家庭、企业和车辆提供高速互联网服务，而我们的移动卫星旨在从太空直接连接手机。这些星座具有不同的性能要求和技术规格。请见下文我们在本招股说明书中使用的卫星相关术语：

paras.en: - “V1 Broadband satellites” refers to our first-generation satellites in the Starlink constellation for delivering high-speed, low-latency broadband internet from LEO to Earth.
paras.zh: - “V1 宽带卫星”指我们在 Starlink 星座中的第一代卫星，用于从近地轨道（LEO）向地球提供高速、低延迟的宽带互联网服务。

paras.en: - “V1 Mobile satellites” refers to our mobile satellites that provide light data, text messaging (SMS), and over-the-top voice services (e.g., WhatsApp and FaceTime) to mobile devices. V1 Mobile satellites are currently in orbit and are launched on our Falcon rockets.
paras.zh: - “V1 移动卫星”指我们的移动卫星，为移动设备提供轻量数据、文本消息（SMS）和 OTT 语音服务（例如 WhatsApp 和 FaceTime）。V1 移动卫星目前已在轨，并通过我们的 Falcon 火箭发射。

paras.en: - “V2 Mini satellites” refers to our current broadband satellites that provide high-speed internet to homes, businesses, and vehicles. V2 Mini satellites are currently in orbit and are launched on our Falcon rockets.
paras.zh: - “V2 Mini 卫星”指我们当前的宽带卫星，为家庭、企业和车辆提供高速互联网服务。V2 Mini 卫星目前已在轨，并通过我们的 Falcon 火箭发射。

paras.en: - “V2 Mobile satellites” refers to our next-generation mobile satellites, which are designed to provide more comprehensive satellite-to-mobile services, including broadband data and IoT connectivity and which we expect to begin deploying on Starship in 2027.
paras.zh: - “V2 移动卫星”指我们的下一代移动卫星，旨在提供更全面的卫星到移动设备服务，包括宽带数据和 IoT 连接，我们预计将于 2027 年开始在 Starship 上部署。

paras.en: - “V3 satellites” refers to our next-generation Starlink broadband satellites, which are designed to offer one Tbps of downlink capacity per satellite and which we expect to begin deploying on Starship in the second half of 2026.
paras.zh: - “V3 卫星”指我们的下一代 Starlink 宽带卫星，旨在为每颗卫星提供 1 Tbps 的下行容量，我们预计将于 2026 年下半年开始在 Starship 上部署。

paras.en: This summary highlights information contained elsewhere in this prospectus. This summary is not complete and does not contain all of the information you should consider before investing in our Class A common stock. You should read this entire prospectus carefully before making an investment decision. You should carefully consider, among other things, the sections titled “Risk Factors,” “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” and our consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this prospectus. Some of the statements in this summary constitute forward-looking statements. Please carefully consider “Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements.”
paras.zh: 本摘要重点介绍本招股说明书其他部分所载信息。本摘要并不完整，亦未包含您在投资我们的 A 类普通股之前应考虑的全部信息。在作出投资决策之前，您应仔细阅读本招股说明书全文。您应特别审慎考虑“风险因素”“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析”以及本招股说明书其他部分所载我们的合并财务报表及相关附注等章节。本摘要中的部分陈述构成前瞻性陈述。请审慎考虑“关于前瞻性陈述的警示性说明”。

paras.en: “You want to wake up in the morning and think the future is going to be great—and that’s what being a space-faring civilization is all about. It’s about believing in the future and thinking that the future will be better than the past. And I can’t think of anything more exciting than going out there and being among the stars.”
paras.zh: “你希望清晨醒来时认为未来将无比美好——而这正是成为太空文明的全部意义所在。它关乎对未来的信念，关乎相信未来将比过去更美好。我想不出还有什么比走向太空、置身群星之间更令人激动的事了。”

paras.en: — Elon Musk
paras.zh: — Elon Musk

paras.en: Our mission is to build the systems and technologies necessary to make life multiplanetary, to understand the true nature of the universe, and to extend the light of consciousness to the stars. To do this, we have formed the most ambitious, vertically integrated innovation engine on (and off) Earth with unmatched capabilities to rapidly manufacture and launch space-based communications that connect the world, to harness the Sun to power a truth-seeking artificial intelligence that advances scientific discovery, and ultimately to build a base on the Moon and cities on other planets.
paras.zh: 我们的使命是构建必要的系统与技术，使生命得以在多行星间延续，理解宇宙的真正本质，并将意识之光延伸至群星。为此，我们在地球上（以及地球之外）打造了最具雄心的垂直整合创新引擎，具备无可匹敌的能力，能够快速制造并发射连接世界的天基通信系统，驾驭太阳能为追求真理、推动科学发现的人工智能提供动力，并最终在月球建立基地、在其他行星上建设城市。

paras.en: Founded in 2002, SpaceX is the only company building the integrated hardware and software infrastructure of the future across space, connectivity, and AI. At our core, we are builders. We design, manufacture, launch, and operate products and services built on cutting-edge technologies, including the world’s most advanced rockets and spacecraft. We safely and reliably transport astronauts, satellites, and other payloads on missions that benefit life on Earth. Since 2023, we have launched more than 80% of mass to orbit for the world each year with an over 99% mission success rate with Falcon rockets. We also operate a high-speed, low-latency global broadband data and communications network powered by approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, delivering connectivity to million s of consumer, enterprise, and government customers across 164 countries, territories, and other markets, as of March 31, 2026. Using our dedicated satellite-to-mobile constellation, we offer connectivity services, supplementing terrestrial networks and substantially reducing mobile “dead zones” across approximately 30 countries.
paras.zh: SpaceX 成立于 2002 年，是唯一一家在太空、连接和 AI 领域构建未来软硬件一体化基础设施的公司。我们的核心是建设者。我们设计、制造、发射和运营基于前沿技术的产品与服务，包括全球最先进的火箭和航天器。我们安全可靠地运送宇航员、卫星及其他有效载荷，执行造福地球生命的任务。自 2023 年以来，我们每年以 Falcon 火箭为全球发射了超过 80% 的入轨质量，任务成功率超过 99%。我们还运营一个高速、低延迟的全球宽带数据与通信网络，由约 9,600 颗低地球轨道上的 Starlink 宽带和移动卫星提供支持，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，为 164 个国家、地区及其他市场的数百万消费者、企业和政府客户提供连接。利用我们专用的卫星直连移动星座，我们提供连接服务，补充地面网络，并大幅减少约 30 个国家的移动“盲区”。

paras.en: With the potential to improve both space exploration and life on Earth, AI accelerates SpaceX’s mission to make life multiplanetary, to understand the true nature of the universe, and to extend the light of consciousness to the stars. xAI, which was founded in 2023 and acquired by SpaceX in early 2026, is now an integral pillar of our vertically integrated company. We are rapidly constructing AI compute infrastructure—starting on Earth with the goal of extending to space—at industry-leading pace and cost efficiency. Our infrastructure supports training and inference for Grok, which has emerged as one of the world’s most advanced frontier models. Grok is designed as a truth-seeking AI model, built on our founder Elon Musk’s mission to enable humanity to understand the universe. We believe that accomplishing this mission requires a truth-seeking approach to AI. We define truth seeking as the active, relentless pursuit of what is objectively true about reality, and grounded in evidence, logic, empirical data, and first principles thinking. Our goal is to understand and explain what the universe appears to be doing, as accurately as current knowledge allows. Within two years of its initial model release, Grok achieved frontier-level performance in scientific reasoning, as measured by its GPQA Diamond score, an industry benchmark that evaluates AI models on a standardized set of questions written and validated by experts, on a faster timeline than reported by other leading model providers. Grok also benefits from integration with X, our real-time information, entertainment, and free speech platform, which serves as a foundational distribution and data engine for our AI ecosystem and further enhances Grok’s truth-seeking objective.
paras.zh: AI 具有改善太空探索和地球生命的潜力，加速了 SpaceX 的使命——让生命多行星化、理解宇宙的真正本质，并将意识之光延伸至星辰。xAI 成立于 2023 年，于 2026 年初被 SpaceX 收购，现已成为我们垂直整合公司不可或缺的支柱。我们正以行业领先的速度和成本效率快速构建 AI 算力基础设施——从地球起步，目标是延伸至太空。我们的基础设施支持 Grok 的训练和推理，Grok 已成为全球最先进的前沿模型之一。Grok 被设计为一个追求真相的 AI 模型，建立在我们的创始人 Elon Musk 的使命之上，即让人类理解宇宙。我们相信，实现这一使命需要对 AI 采取追求真相的方法。我们将追求真相定义为积极、不懈地追求关于现实的客观真实，并以证据、逻辑、经验数据和第一性原理思维为基础。我们的目标是，在现有知识允许的范围内，尽可能准确地理解和解释宇宙似乎正在做的事情。在其初始模型发布后的两年内，Grok 在科学推理方面达到了前沿水平，以 GPQA Diamond 分数衡量——这是一项行业基准，通过一组由专家编写和验证的标准化问题来评估 AI 模型——其时间线快于其他领先模型提供商所报告的。Grok 还得益于与 X 的整合，X 是我们的实时信息、娱乐和言论自由平台，作为我们 AI 生态系统的基础分发和数据引擎，并进一步增强 Grok 的追求真相目标。

paras.en: We believe that space represents the largest economic frontier in human history. Connectivity infrastructure in space is designed to help everyone on Earth have access to education, healthcare, entertainment, and communications, and to enable people to overcome many traditional limits, such as physical and political borders. We believe AI infrastructure in space can utilize the virtually limitless power of the Sun and thereby enable the use of AI as a transformative force for understanding the universe and improving the daily lives of all humans. We believe the convergence of these areas will enable an unprecedented expansion in the global economy, leading to an age of abundance. Our innovations and technological advancements are redefining industries on Earth, while we aim to create new ones on the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We are truly building the infrastructure of the future.
paras.zh: 我们相信，太空代表着人类历史上最大的经济前沿。太空中的连接基础设施旨在帮助地球上的每个人获得教育、医疗、娱乐和通信服务，并帮助人们克服诸多传统限制，例如物理边界和政治边界。我们相信，太空中的 AI 基础设施可以利用近乎无限的太阳能，从而使 AI 成为理解宇宙、改善全人类日常生活的变革性力量。我们相信，这些领域的融合将推动全球经济实现前所未有的扩张，引领一个丰裕时代的到来。我们的创新和技术进步正在重新定义地球上的各个行业，同时我们致力于在月球、火星及更远的地方创造新的行业。我们正在真正构建未来的基础设施。

paras.en: - Space. SpaceX is the only company that has cracked the code on accessing space at scale, revolutionizing an industry characterized by decades of stagnation, risk aversion, and economically perverse cost structures. SpaceX upended this paradigm through the application of first-principles thinking, which rejects industry assumptions and builds solutions based on the fundamental laws of physics. Our intense, mission-driven, engineering-first culture and focus on extreme vertical integration have propelled us to achieve what many deemed impossible. We pioneered high-cadence, reliable, and affordable access to space with our Falcon family of rockets. In 2015, we established at least a 10-year lead over the industry by successfully landing our first Falcon 9 booster back from space before anyone else. Space flight that historically cost billion s per launch now costs in the tens of million s, fundamentally reducing the cost of space access and providing the opportunity to build new enterprises in space.
paras.zh: - 太空。SpaceX 是唯一一家破解了大规模进入太空难题的公司，彻底改变了一个数十年来停滞不前、规避风险且成本结构在经济上不合理的行业。SpaceX 通过运用第一性原理思维颠覆了这一范式，该思维拒绝行业假设，并基于物理学基本定律构建解决方案。我们强烈的使命感、以工程为先的文化以及对极致垂直整合的专注，推动我们实现了许多人认为不可能的事情。我们凭借 Falcon 系列火箭开创了高频次、可靠且可负担的太空进入方式。2015 年，我们率先成功将首枚 Falcon 9 助推器从太空回收着陆，从而建立了对行业至少 10 年的领先优势。历史上每次发射耗资数十亿美元的太空飞行，如今成本已降至数千万美元，从根本上降低了太空进入成本，并为在太空建立新企业提供了机会。

paras.en: - Connectivity. Since activating service for customers in 2020, Starlink has rapidly expanded global access to high-speed internet, prioritizing underserved rural and remote communities worldwide. While building terrestrial networks in such communities can be prohibitively expensive, Starlink is capable of delivering broadband connectivity anywhere on Earth with just a Starlink Kit. As of March 31, 2026, we had approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, operating the world’s most advanced broadband constellation providing internet connectivity to approximately 10.3 million Starlink Subscribers across 164 countries, territories, and other markets. In January 2024, we also began deploying our Starlink Mobile constellation that utilizes separate Starlink satellites with satellite-to-mobile capabilities, substantially reducing mobile “dead zones” around the world. As of March 31, 2026, our dedicated satellite-to-mobile constellation of approximately 650 V1 Mobile satellites provides satellite-to-mobile data, over-the-top voice, and messaging services to approximately 7.4 million monthly unique devices across approximately 30 countries.
paras.zh: - 连接。自 2020 年开始为客户提供服务以来，Starlink 迅速扩大了全球高速互联网的接入范围，优先服务全球范围内服务不足的农村和偏远社区。在此类社区建设地面网络可能成本高昂得令人望而却步，而 Starlink 仅需一套 Starlink Kit 即可在地球上任何地方提供宽带连接。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们在低地球轨道拥有约 9,600 颗 Starlink 宽带和移动卫星，运营着全球最先进的宽带星座，为 164 个国家、地区和其他市场约 10.3 百万 Starlink 用户提供互联网连接。2024 年 1 月，我们还开始部署 Starlink Mobile 星座，该星座使用具备卫星直连手机能力的独立 Starlink 卫星，大幅减少全球移动“盲区”。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们约 650 颗 V1 Mobile 卫星组成的专用卫星直连手机星座，为约 30 个国家约 7.4 百万月度独立设备提供卫星直连手机数据、OTT 语音和消息服务。

paras.en: - AI. We were the first company to deploy a coherent gigawatt-scale AI training cluster. For complex reasoning and agentic workloads, compute is directly correlated with the quality of intelligence and task completion speed. In under two years, we have established a dual advantage in both cost efficiency and deployment speed at scale. By owning the compute infrastructure and vertically integrating across the full AI stack, we can train and iterate our frontier models at lower cost and higher velocity and accelerate development cycles. This eliminates external bottlenecks and drives rapid, continuous improvements in model performance. We believe this combination of our state-of-the-art AI compute infrastructure, our truth-seeking frontier model, and our access to real-time data on X creates a significant strategic advantage. Our integrated AI platforms across Grok and X had approximately 1.3 billion supported accounts active in the last twelve months ended March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, including approximately 550 million and 520 million MAUs as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively. Of our MAUs, we had approximately 117 million and 89 million MAUs that used Grok’s AI features as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively. Grok’s deep integration with X enables freshness, relevance, and contextual awareness that we believe is a competitive differentiator. This direct, real-time access to the information and human discourse on X enhances Grok’s truth-seeking capabilities by grounding outputs in up-to-date knowledge and diverse viewpoints. As a result, we believe Grok can deliver the most objective and relevant insights and best serve high-frequency, high-value use cases across consumer and enterprise AI applications.
paras.zh: - AI。我们是首家部署连贯的吉瓦级 AI 训练集群的公司。对于复杂推理和智能体工作负载而言，算力与智能质量及任务完成速度直接相关。在不到两年内，我们已在成本效率和规模化部署速度两方面建立起双重优势。通过自有算力基础设施并在整个 AI 技术栈上垂直整合，我们能够以更低的成本和更高的速度训练并迭代我们的前沿模型，并加速开发周期。这消除了外部瓶颈，推动模型性能快速、持续提升。我们相信，我们最先进的 AI 算力基础设施、追求真相的前沿模型以及对 X 实时数据的访问权限，这一组合构成了显著的战略优势。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日的过去十二个月内，我们横跨 Grok 和 X 的集成 AI 平台拥有约 13 亿个活跃支持账户，其中截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日的月活跃用户（MAU）分别约为 5.50 亿和 5.20 亿。在我们的 MAU 中，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日，分别约有 1.17 亿和 8,900 万 MAU 使用了 Grok 的 AI 功能。Grok 与 X 的深度集成带来了时效性、相关性和上下文感知能力，我们相信这是一项差异化竞争优势。这种对 X 上信息和人类话语的直接、实时访问，通过将输出建立在最新知识和多元观点之上，增强了 Grok 追求真相的能力。因此，我们相信 Grok 能够提供最客观、最相关的洞察，并最好地服务于消费级和企业级 AI 应用中的高频、高价值用例。

paras.en: We have created distinct new markets across the space, connectivity, and AI industries by building the integrated hardware and software infrastructure of the future and by combining our broad range of capabilities. For example, SpaceX’s recent acquisition of xAI unites SpaceX’s launch capabilities and global connectivity network with xAI’s AI development capabilities. Specifically, we believe SpaceX’s reusable rockets, scaled satellite manufacturing, and operational expertise can enable the cost-effective and rapid deployment of massive AI compute satellite constellations—with potentially million s of satellites—for orbital data centers. We believe these AI compute satellites in Sun-synchronous orbit will be able to handle energy-intensive AI workloads, such as inference demand, at far greater scale and efficiency than terrestrial alternatives, with Starlink providing low-latency, global connectivity linking these orbital AI systems to people around the world and delivering real-time intelligence. We expect to begin deploying our orbital AI compute satellites as early as 2028.
paras.zh: 我们通过构建面向未来的集成硬件和软件基础设施，并整合我们广泛的能力组合，在太空、连接和 AI 行业创造了独特的新市场。例如，SpaceX 近期对 xAI 的收购将 SpaceX 的发射能力和全球连接网络与 xAI 的 AI 开发能力结合在一起。具体而言，我们相信 SpaceX 的可重复使用火箭、规模化卫星制造和运营专长，能够实现大规模 AI 算力卫星星座——可能达到数百万颗卫星——的成本效益高且快速的部署，用于轨道数据中心。我们相信，这些位于太阳同步轨道的 AI 算力卫星将能够以远超地面替代方案的规模和效率处理能源密集型 AI 工作负载，例如推理需求，而 Starlink 提供低延迟的全球连接，将这些轨道 AI 系统与世界各地的人们连接起来，并交付实时智能。我们预计最早于 2028 年开始部署我们的轨道 AI 算力卫星。

paras.en: Our financial results reflect the strength of our operating model and our ability to create and scale multiple new businesses:
paras.zh: 我们的财务业绩反映了我们运营模式的实力，以及我们创建和规模化多项新业务的能力：

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, we generated revenue on a consolidated basis of $4,694 million, loss from operations of $(1,943) million and Adjusted EBITDA of $1,127 million. In 2025, we generated revenue on a consolidated basis of $18,674 million, loss from operations of $(2,589) million and Adjusted EBITDA of $6,584 million. Our Space and Connectivity segments contributed the substantial majority of our consolidated revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 and the year ended December 31, 2025, demonstrating the benefits of their scale and operating leverage in our vertically integrated business model;
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们按合并口径实现收入 $4,694 million，经营亏损 $(1,943) million，调整后 EBITDA 为 $1,127 million。2025 年，我们按合并口径实现收入 $18,674 million，经营亏损 $(2,589) million，调整后 EBITDA 为 $6,584 million。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，我们的太空与连接业务分部贡献了合并收入的绝大部分，体现了其规模优势以及在我们垂直一体化业务模式下的经营杠杆效益；

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, our Space segment generated revenue of $619 million, loss from operations of $(662) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $(351) million. In 2025, our Space segment generated revenue of $4,086 million, loss from operations of $(657) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $653 million. Additionally, our Space segment funded $930 million and $3,004 million in research and development expense during the three months ended March 31, 2026 and the year ended December 31, 2025, respectively, for our next-generation Starship launch vehicle program. Starship is designed to enable a step-function change in our launch capability across reusability, payload capacity, and launch cadence, and is the key enabler of our long-term growth strategy by unlocking entirely new categories of missions;
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们的太空业务分部实现收入 $619 million，经营亏损 $(662) million，分部调整后 EBITDA 为 $(351) million。2025 年，我们的太空业务分部实现收入 $4,086 million，经营亏损 $(657) million，分部调整后 EBITDA 为 $653 million。此外，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，我们的太空业务分部为下一代 Starship 运载火箭项目分别投入研发费用 $930 million 和 $3,004 million。Starship 旨在在可重复使用性、有效载荷能力和发射频次方面实现发射能力的阶跃式变革，并通过开辟全新的任务类别，成为我们长期增长战略的关键推动因素；

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, our Connectivity segment generated revenue of $3,257 million, income from operations of $1,188 million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $2,087 million. Our Connectivity segment, primarily driven by Starlink, generated revenue of $11,387 million, income from operations of $4,423 million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $7,168 million in 2025, representing year-over-year growth of 49.8%, 120.4%, and 86.2%, respectively, benefiting from subscriber growth, increasing enterprise adoption, and continued improvement in network efficiency;
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们的连接业务分部实现收入 $3,257 million，经营利润 $1,188 million，分部调整后 EBITDA 为 $2,087 million。我们的连接业务分部主要由 Starlink 驱动，2025 年实现收入 $11,387 million，经营利润 $4,423 million，分部调整后 EBITDA 为 $7,168 million，同比分别增长 49.8%、120.4% 和 86.2%，受益于用户增长、企业采用率提升以及网络效率的持续改善；

paras.en: - In our newly acquired AI segment, we plan to prioritize growth and investment to capture significant opportunities in AI applications and compute infrastructure. For the three months ended March 31, 2026, our AI segment generated revenue of $818 million, loss from operations of $(2,469) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $(609) million. In 2025, our AI segment generated revenue of $3,201 million, loss from operations of $(6,355) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $(1,237) million, reflecting its earlier stage of development and continued investments to support long-term growth opportunities in AI; and
paras.zh: - 在新收购的 AI 业务分部中，我们计划优先推动增长和投资，以把握 AI 应用和算力基础设施领域的重大机遇。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们的 AI 业务分部实现收入 $818 million，经营亏损 $(2,469) million，分部调整后 EBITDA 为 $(609) million。2025 年，我们的 AI 业务分部实现收入 $3,201 million，经营亏损 $(6,355) million，分部调整后 EBITDA 为 $(1,237) million，反映了其处于较早期的发展阶段以及为支持 AI 领域长期增长机遇而进行的持续投资；以及

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, capital expenditures for our Space segment was $1,052 million, for our Connectivity segment was $1,332 million and for our AI segment was $7,723 million. In 2025, capital expenditures for our Space segment was $3,832 million, for our Connectivity segment was $4,178 million and for our AI segment was $12,727 million.
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们太空业务分部的资本支出为 $1,052 million，连接业务分部的资本支出为 $1,332 million，AI 业务分部的资本支出为 $7,723 million。2025 年，我们太空业务分部的资本支出为 $3,832 million，连接业务分部的资本支出为 $4,178 million，AI 业务分部的资本支出为 $12,727 million。

paras.en: Segment Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP measure. Please refer to the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Non-GAAP Financial Measures” for additional information on our non-GAAP financial measures, including reconciliations of Segment Adjusted EBITDA to segment income (loss) from operations, the most directly comparable GAAP measure.
paras.zh: 分部调整后 EBITDA 是一项非 GAAP 指标。有关我们非 GAAP 财务指标的更多信息，包括分部调整后 EBITDA 与经营分部利润（亏损）（最直接可比的 GAAP 指标）的对账，请参阅标题为“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——非 GAAP 财务指标”的章节。

paras.en: For the entirety of its existence, human civilization has lived on a single celestial body: Earth. The current paradigm, in which human civilization is confined to one planet, exposes humanity to existential threats that are unpredictable and uncontrollable on a planetary scale. By moving beyond the only home we have ever known, we ensure species-level redundancy and that the light of consciousness will not be tied to a single planet subject to the inevitable hazards of a harsh and vast universe. We do not want humans to have the same fate as dinosaurs. We want to give them a reason to look ahead with excitement, with the prospect that we are entering an age of abundance with an endlessly prosperous and exciting future.
paras.zh: 在人类文明存在的整个历程中，我们始终生活在单一的天体之上：地球。当前这种将人类文明局限于一颗行星的范式，使人类暴露于行星尺度上不可预测且无法控制的存在性威胁之中。通过走出我们唯一已知的家园，我们确保物种层面的冗余，并确保意识之光不会系于一颗注定要承受严酷而浩瀚宇宙中不可避免之风险的行星。我们不希望人类重蹈恐龙的命运。我们希望给人类一个满怀激情展望未来的理由，一个我们正迈入富足时代、拥有无限繁荣与激动人心未来的前景。

paras.en: For decades, a reality where humanity travels between the planets and the stars has felt tantalizingly close but still locked in the pages and screens of science fiction. We are capable of better understanding the universe, exploring the universe, and ultimately making life multiplanetary across the universe. We are becoming a civilization with the ability to reach beyond Earth’s cradle and begin to inhabit other worlds. While we remain dedicated to this fundamental mission, our progress in accessing space continues to yield opportunities that enrich life on Earth. For example, by dramatically reducing the cost of access to space, we have been able to expand our mission to address some of the Earth’s most pressing challenges, including bridging the digital divide by aiming to connect over three billion unconnected people to the internet and humanity’s collective knowledge.
paras.zh: 数十年来，人类在行星与恒星之间穿梭的现实一直显得近在咫尺，却仍被禁锢在科幻小说的书页与屏幕之中。我们有能力更好地理解宇宙、探索宇宙，并最终让生命在宇宙中实现多行星化。我们正在成为一个有能力超越地球摇篮、开始栖居其他世界的文明。在坚守这一根本使命的同时，我们在进入太空方面的进展持续带来丰富地球生活的机遇。例如，通过大幅降低进入太空的成本，我们得以拓展使命，以应对地球上一些最紧迫的挑战，包括通过致力于将超过三十亿未联网人口接入互联网和人类集体知识，弥合数字鸿沟。

paras.en: The rapid emergence of the AI era intensifies the urgency of our mission, as AI has the potential to accelerate not only space exploration, but also transformative societal advancements on Earth. However, AI’s ability to revolutionize human potential is directly dependent on meeting exponentially increasing resource demands. On Earth, the massive expansion of data center capacity to support growing compute demand is significantly outpacing electricity generation, which was effectively flat in the United States for approximately 15 years, growing at a compound annual growth rate of 0.1% from 2008 to 2023. Despite the recent increase in electricity demand from AI data centers, electricity generation in the United States has grown at an annual rate of less than 3% between 2023 and 2025, while electricity generation in China has grown at approximately twice that rate in the same time period. This supply and demand imbalance is already imposing unsustainable strains on terrestrial power grids, supply chains, and the environment. The Sun contains approximately 99.8% of the solar system’s energy and, as a result, we believe it is the only truly scalable solution to terrestrial energy constraints in the age of AI. Harnessing this energy in space is considerably more efficient than on land. Space-based solar arrays can generate more than five times the energy per unit area of terrestrial solar due to continuous illumination, lack of atmospheric interference, and optimal orientation. SpaceX is well-positioned to capture this space-based solar energy through our ability to rapidly access Sun-synchronous orbit through our satellite manufacturing scale and launch capability. As a result, we are expanding our footprint and harnessing the vast resources of space that are essential to sustaining technological development. Our goal is to ensure that AI becomes a force for human flourishing and a benefit to civilization, rather than a catalyst for terrestrial resource depletion and instability.
paras.zh: AI 时代的迅速到来加剧了我们使命的紧迫性，因为 AI 不仅有可能加速太空探索，也有可能加速地球上具有变革性的社会进步。然而，AI 能否彻底释放人类潜能，直接取决于能否满足呈指数级增长的资源需求。在地球上，为支撑不断增长的算力需求而大规模扩张数据中心容量，其速度已显著超过发电量的增长——美国的发电量在大约 15 年间基本持平，2008 年至 2023 年的复合年增长率仅为 0.1%。尽管近期 AI 数据中心带来的电力需求有所上升，但 2023 年至 2025 年间美国发电量的年增长率仍低于 3%，而同期中国的发电量增速约为美国的两倍。这种供需失衡已经对地面电网、供应链和环境造成了不可持续的壓力。太阳蕴含了太阳系约 99.8% 的能量，因此我们认为，在 AI 时代，太阳是唯一真正可规模化解决地球能源约束的方案。在太空利用这一能源的效率远高于在地面利用。由于可连续受照、无大气干扰以及最佳朝向，太空太阳能阵列的单位面积发电量可达地面太阳能的五倍以上。SpaceX 凭借卫星制造规模和发射能力，能够快速进入太阳同步轨道，因而处于获取这一太空太阳能的有利位置。因此，我们正在扩大自身布局，开发利用广袤的太空资源，而这些资源对于维持技术发展至关重要。我们的目标是确保 AI 成为促进人类繁荣的力量、造福文明，而不是加剧地球资源枯竭与不稳定的催化剂。

paras.en: We believe that our current space efforts will catalyze transformative breakthroughs that could reshape terrestrial industries and lead to the emergence of new trillion-dollar markets on the Moon, Mars, and beyond. In particular, we believe our goal of establishing a lunar presence will enable terawatt-scale annual AI compute growth, support deeper space exploration and industrialization, and serve as a stepping stone to establishing a civilization on Mars. We believe the next paradigm shift for humanity is the creation of a resilient, perpetually expanding spacefaring civilization that drives continuous innovation across new frontiers, ultimately propelling us to Kardashev Type II status—we believe we are capable of unlocking an era of unprecedented economic expansion, while also contributing to the safeguards of humanity’s future against existential risk.
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们当前的太空努力将催生具有变革性的突破，这些突破可能重塑地球上的各个产业，并在月球、火星及更远的地方催生出新的万亿美元级市场。特别是，我们相信建立月球存在的目标将支撑太瓦级的年度 AI 算力增长，支持更深入的太空探索与工业化，并成为在火星上建立文明的跳板。我们相信，人类的下一次范式转变是创建一个具有韧性、持续扩张的太空文明，在新边疆推动持续创新，最终推动我们达到卡尔达肖夫 II 型文明状态——我们相信，我们有能力开启一个前所未有的经济扩张时代，同时为人类未来抵御生存性风险作出贡献。

paras.en: SpaceX combines the most transformative and critical technologies in human history, including reusable rockets, a fully global internet service, satellite-to-mobile communications, a real-time information, entertainment and free speech platform, and a truth-seeking AI system designed to accelerate scientific discovery and augment human capabilities.
paras.zh: SpaceX 融合了人类历史上最具变革性和最关键的技术，包括可重复使用火箭、覆盖全球的互联网服务、卫星到移动通信、实时信息、娱乐与言论自由平台，以及一个旨在加速科学发现、增强人类能力的求真型 AI 系统。

paras.en: #### Our Unparalleled Launch Capabilities
paras.zh: #### 我们无与伦比的发射能力

paras.en: Since our founding in 2002, SpaceX has cracked the code on accessing space at scale, transforming an industry characterized by decades of stagnation, risk aversion, and economically perverse cost structures. We design, manufacture, launch, and refurbish reusable launch vehicles that provide cost-efficient, reliable, and high-cadence access to space for our own purposes as well as for third-party commercial and government customers. Our extensive vertical integration and end-to-end control over the entire value chain, from design to launch to operations, allows us to achieve unprecedented speed and cost efficiency.
paras.zh: 自 2002 年成立以来，SpaceX 已破解了规模化进入太空的密码，彻底改变了一个以数十年停滞、规避风险和经济上扭曲的成本结构为特征的行业。我们设计、制造、发射并翻新可重复使用运载火箭，为我们自身以及第三方商业和政府客户提供高性价比、可靠且高频次的太空进入能力。我们广泛的垂直整合以及对从设计到发射再到运营的整个价值链的端到端控制，使我们能够实现前所未有的速度和成本效率。

paras.en: As of March 31, 2026, SpaceX had launched a total mass to orbit of approximately 7,400 metric tons with an over 99% mission success rate across our Falcon rockets. We have completed approximately 650 orbital space launches, and over 540 of those launches were completed by a flight-proven Falcon rocket. With the first successful launch of Falcon 1 in 2008, we became the first private company to successfully launch a liquid-fueled rocket to Earth’s orbit. In December 2015, we achieved what many deemed impossible: landing a rocket launched to space back on Earth. By 2017, we were routinely recovering and reusing the Falcon 9 first-stage booster post-launch, delivering another step-function drop in space access costs via groundbreaking reusability. As of March 31, 2026, our Falcon 9 rockets have demonstrated the ability to refly a first-stage 34 times. With the future deployment of Starship, which is designed to be the world’s first fully and rapidly reusable spacecraft, we aim to reduce the cost to reach orbit by 99% or more relative to the historical average launch cost, establishing the most affordable and scalable path to creating new opportunities in space, such as orbital AI compute and Mars exploration.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，SpaceX 通过猎鹰火箭向轨道发射的总质量约为 7,400 公吨，任务成功率超过 99%。我们已完成约 650 次轨道太空发射，其中超过 540 次由经过飞行验证的猎鹰火箭完成。随着 2008 年猎鹰 1 号首次成功发射，我们成为首家成功将液体燃料火箭发射至地球轨道的私营公司。2015 年 12 月，我们实现了许多人认为不可能的事情：将发射至太空的火箭降落回地球。到 2017 年，我们已常态化地在发射后回收并重复使用猎鹰 9 号一级助推器，通过突破性的可重复使用性，再次实现了太空进入成本的阶跃式下降。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们的猎鹰 9 号火箭已展示出一级火箭重复飞行 34 次的能力。随着未来星舰的部署——其设计目标是成为全球首款完全且快速可重复使用的航天器——我们旨在将入轨成本相对于历史平均发射成本降低 99% 或更多，从而建立最经济、最可扩展的路径，在太空创造新机遇，例如轨道 AI 算力和火星探索。

paras.en: Our principal launch vehicles and spacecraft include:
paras.zh: 我们的主要运载火箭和航天器包括：

paras.en: - Falcon 9. As the world’s first orbital-class rapidly reusable rocket, Falcon 9 was first launched in 2010 and has a payload capacity to LEO of approximately 23 metric tons when fully expendable. Falcon 9 has completed approximately 620 orbital space launches as of March 31, 2026, and an over 99% mission success rate. According to NASA, the first version of Falcon 9 in 2010 reduced launch cost to approximately $2,700 per kilogram, approximately 85% less than the historical average launch cost of $18,500 per kilogram.
paras.zh: - 猎鹰 9 号。作为全球首款轨道级快速可重复使用火箭，猎鹰 9 号于 2010 年首次发射，在完全一次性使用模式下，其近地轨道（LEO）有效载荷能力约为 23 公吨。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，猎鹰 9 号已完成约 620 次轨道太空发射，任务成功率超过 99%。根据 NASA 的数据，2010 年首版猎鹰 9 号将发射成本降至约每公斤 $2,700，比历史平均发射成本每公斤 $18,500 低约 85%。

paras.en: - Falcon Heavy. Falcon Heavy first launched in 2018 when it put a Tesla all-electric sports car (“Tesla Roadster”) and its mannequin passenger, known as Starman, into orbit around the Sun. With a payload capacity to LEO of approximately 64 metric tons, Falcon Heavy is a partially reusable super heavy-lift launch vehicle designed to deliver large payloads to orbit. Falcon Heavy is one of the most powerful operational rockets in the world measured by liftoff thrust, with 11 launches as of March 31, 2026 and a 100% mission success rate.
paras.zh: - 猎鹰重型（Falcon Heavy）。猎鹰重型于 2018 年首次发射，当时它将一辆特斯拉全电动跑车（“Tesla Roadster”）及其名为 Starman 的人体模型乘客送入环绕太阳的轨道。猎鹰重型向 LEO 的运载能力约为 64 公吨，是一种部分可重复使用的超重型运载火箭，旨在将大型有效载荷送入轨道。按起飞推力衡量，猎鹰重型是世界上现役最强大的火箭之一，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日已进行 11 次发射，任务成功率为 100%。

paras.en: - Dragon. Launched by Falcon 9 in 2012, our Dragon spacecraft became the first commercial spacecraft to deliver cargo to and from the International Space Station, an orbiting laboratory that serves as a research facility and destination for human spaceflight, and, eight years later, the first privately built vehicle to fly humans to the orbiting laboratory. Since 2020, our Dragon spacecraft has safely flown 78 crewmembers from 20 countries.
paras.zh: - 龙飞船（Dragon）。我们的龙飞船于 2012 年由猎鹰 9 号发射，成为首个向国际空间站运送货物并返回的商业航天器——国际空间站是一个在轨实验室，既是研究设施，也是载人航天的目的地；八年后，它又成为首个将人类送往该在轨实验室的私人建造航天器。自 2020 年以来，我们的龙飞船已安全搭载来自 20 个国家的 78 名乘员。

paras.en: - Starship. First launched in 2023, Starship is designed to be a fully reusable, super heavy-lift launch vehicle. Starship V3 is designed to deliver 100 metric tons to Earth’s orbit in a fully reusable configuration while enabling rapid turnaround times akin to commercial aviation. Future generations of Starship are being designed to double this payload capacity. To date, we have executed 12 Starship flight tests, with our 12th flight test in May 2026 debuting the next generation Starship vehicle and Super Heavy booster, powered by the next evolution of our Raptor engine and launching from a newly designed pad at Starbase. We expect Starship to commence payload delivery to orbit in the second half of 2026. We have achieved innovative milestones such as catching a booster using “chopstick” arms on the same tower it launched from. We expect this capability will facilitate rapid refurbishment and reuse, allowing for multiple launches per day at reduced costs.
paras.zh: - 星舰（Starship）。星舰于 2023 年首次发射，旨在成为一种完全可重复使用的超重型运载火箭。星舰 V3 旨在以完全可重复使用的构型向地球轨道运送 100 公吨有效载荷，同时实现可与商业航空相媲美的快速周转时间。未来几代星舰的设计目标是将这一运载能力翻倍。迄今为止，我们已执行 12 次星舰飞行测试，其中 2026 年 5 月的第 12 次飞行测试首次亮相了下一代星舰飞行器及超重型助推器，其动力来自我们猛禽（Raptor）发动机的下一代演进版本，并从 Starbase 一座新设计的发射台发射。我们预计星舰将于 2026 年下半年开始向轨道运送有效载荷。我们已实现多项创新里程碑，例如使用发射塔上的“筷子”机械臂捕获助推器，且该发射塔正是其发射所用的同一座塔。我们预计这一能力将有助于快速翻修和重复使用，从而以更低的成本实现每天多次发射。

paras.en: Upon achieving rocket reusability, we recognized the immense potential of our launch business to enable new revenue streams. This led to the development of Starlink, our global satellite internet constellation, consisting of thousand s of LEO satellites designed to provide high-speed, low-latency broadband connectivity to underserved areas worldwide. Although the concept of using satellites for global internet connectivity dates back decades, technical challenges and the prohibitive cost of accessing space and deploying the satellites required for capacity and global coverage historically rendered attempts to provide such connectivity economically unviable. Within three years of our first satellite launch in 2019, we solved the technical and production challenges of the satellites and had deployed the largest LEO constellation in existence. Today, Starlink is the sole low-latency network available globally. By combining increasing launch cadence, expanding cargo capacity, and declining unit costs—driven by rapid reusability—we have generated a compounding competitive advantage. This not only fortifies our core business, but also provides vast new market opportunities uniquely enabled by space.
paras.zh: 在实现火箭可重复使用后，我们认识到我们的发射业务在创造新收入来源方面的巨大潜力。这促成了 Starlink 的开发——这是我们的全球卫星互联网星座，由数千颗 LEO 卫星组成，旨在为全球服务不足的地区提供高速、低延迟的宽带连接。尽管利用卫星实现全球互联网连接的概念可追溯至数十年前，但技术挑战以及进入太空和部署满足容量与全球覆盖所需卫星的高昂成本，历来使提供此类连接的尝试在经济上不可行。在我们于 2019 年首次发射卫星后的三年内，我们解决了卫星的技术和生产挑战，并部署了当时存在的最大 LEO 星座。如今，Starlink 是全球唯一可用的低延迟网络。通过将不断提升的发射频次、不断扩大的运载能力和不断下降的单位成本相结合——这些均由快速可重复使用所驱动——我们形成了复合型竞争优势。这不仅巩固了我们的核心业务，还提供了唯有太空才能带来的广阔新市场机遇。

paras.en: #### Our Leading Capabilities Across Space, Connectivity, and AI
paras.zh: #### 我们在太空、连接与 AI 领域的领先能力

paras.en: Space. While our launch capabilities support our other businesses, such as Starlink Consumer Broadband and Starlink Mobile, we also sell launches to third-party customers. We offer launch services to commercial, civil, international and government customers through our reusable Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy rockets for satellite, cargo, and crew missions. We are the primary launch provider for the U.S. government. In 2025, we launched 11 of 12 National Security Space Launch (“NSSL”) medium and heavy lift missions and all five U.S. crew and cargo missions to the International Space Station for NASA.
paras.zh: 太空。我们的发射能力在支持星链消费宽带和星链移动等其他业务的同时，我们也向第三方客户销售发射服务。我们通过可重复使用的猎鹰 9 号和猎鹰重型火箭，为商业、民用、国际和政府客户提供卫星、货运和载人任务的发射服务。我们是美国政府的主要发射服务提供商。2025 年，我们执行了 12 次国家安全太空发射（“NSSL”）中型和重型运载任务中的 11 次，以及 NASA 全部五次前往国际空间站的美国载人和货运任务。

paras.en: Connectivity. Our Connectivity business includes Starlink Consumer Broadband, Enterprise Solutions, Government Solutions, and Starlink Mobile.
paras.zh: 连接。我们的连接业务包括星链消费宽带、企业解决方案、政府解决方案和星链移动。

paras.en: - Starlink Consumer Broadband. We operate the world’s largest and most advanced space-based internet broadband service. We provide fiber-like download speeds—at a median of 225 Mbps during peak hours for residential users as of March 31, 2026—and the technological capability to provide service everywhere on Earth, including the poles. This service quality is enabled by our vast network of approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, which accounted for approximately 75% of all active maneuverable satellites in orbit as of March 31, 2026. We expect to commence deploying our next-generation V3 satellites, designed to offer one Tbps of downlink capacity per satellite, using Starship in the second half of 2026. We expect that a single Starship launch will be capable of deploying up to 60 V3 satellites to LEO, representing a potential twenty-fold increase in Starlink downlink capacity deployed relative to a Falcon 9 launch.
paras.zh: - 星链消费宽带。我们运营着全球规模最大、最先进的太空互联网宽带服务。我们提供类光纤下载速度——截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，住宅用户在高峰时段的中位下载速度为 225 Mbps——并具备在地球任何地方（包括两极）提供服务的技术能力。这一服务质量得益于我们由约 9,600 颗低地球轨道星链宽带和移动卫星组成的庞大网络，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，这些卫星约占在轨所有活跃可机动卫星的 75%。我们预计将于 2026 年下半年使用星舰开始部署下一代 V3 卫星，该卫星设计为每颗提供 1 Tbps 的下行容量。我们预计单次星舰发射将能够向 LEO 部署多达 60 颗 V3 卫星，这意味着相对于猎鹰 9 号发射，星链部署的下行容量可能增加二十倍。

paras.en: - Enterprise Solutions. SpaceX is a critical partner to a wide array of enterprises. We offer Starlink’s high-speed, low-latency, reliable internet services to enterprise customers across industries including construction, agriculture, retail, telecom, hospitality, aviation, maritime, and land mobility. Starlink’s unique capabilities are well‑suited for deployments across field offices, remote worksites, research stations, drilling rigs, rural hospitals, aircraft, cruise ships, trains, and hotels. We also serve a broad fixed‑site customer base across industries such as retail and financial services that require high availability for critical operations as well as reliable connectivity in remote or hard-to-serve locations.
paras.zh: - 企业解决方案。SpaceX 是众多企业的重要合作伙伴。我们为建筑、农业、零售、电信、酒店、航空、海事和陆地交通等各行业的企业客户提供星链高速、低延迟、可靠的互联网服务。星链的独特能力非常适合在现场办公室、偏远工地、研究站、钻井平台、乡村医院、飞机、游轮、火车和酒店等场景部署。我们还服务于零售和金融服务等行业广泛的固定站点客户群体，这些客户需要关键业务的高可用性，以及在偏远或难以覆盖地点获得可靠连接。

paras.en: - Government Solutions. For our government customers, we provide high-speed, resilient connectivity for public services, social impact, humanitarian efforts, and disaster response in even the most remote and challenging environments. Separately with Starshield, we have leveraged our commercial LEO satellite constellation engineering learnings and operational experiences to develop a secure, dedicated satellite network designed specifically for United States Government customers and national security applications.
paras.zh: - 政府解决方案。对于政府客户，我们即使在最偏远和最具挑战性的环境中，也为公共服务、社会影响、人道主义工作和灾害响应提供高速、有韧性的连接。此外，通过 Starshield，我们利用商业 LEO 卫星星座的工程经验和运营经验，开发了一个安全、专用的卫星网络，专为美国政府客户和国家安全应用而设计。

paras.en: - Starlink Mobile. We provide satellite-to-mobile connectivity, supplementing terrestrial networks and substantially reducing mobile “dead zones” across approximately 30 countries. Through our partnerships with approximately 30 MNOs on six continents, we enable consumers, businesses, and public-sector customers to use their existing phones in more places, support critical connectivity during disasters and power outages, and open new applications for low-bandwidth mobile and IoT devices.
paras.zh: - Starlink Mobile。我们提供卫星到移动设备的连接服务，补充地面网络，并大幅减少约 30 个国家/地区的移动“盲区”。通过与六大洲约 30 家移动网络运营商（MNO）合作，我们使消费者、企业和公共部门客户能够在更多地点使用其现有手机，在灾害和停电期间支持关键连接，并为低带宽移动设备和物联网设备开辟新的应用。

paras.en: AI. We operate a highly vertically integrated AI platform.
paras.zh: AI。我们运营一个高度垂直整合的 AI 平台。

paras.en: - AI Compute Infrastructure. xAI has established a leading position in building and scaling terrestrial AI compute infrastructure, becoming the first company to deploy a coherent gigawatt-scale AI training cluster. We own and operate what we believe to be the largest AI training data center clusters on Earth, including COLOSSUS and COLOSSUS II. The addition of Terafab, a chip manufacturing initiative with Tesla and Intel, aims to further extend our vertical integration to chip design and manufacturing to alleviate potential future chip shortages at SpaceX, optimize compute performance, and potentially reduce overall compute costs. In connection with such collaboration, we have agreed with Tesla on a general framework for the future development of Terafab. Any specific projects undertaken pursuant to this framework will be subject to separate negotiations and agreements (including any development timelines, milestones and capital expenditures) and have not yet been determined. We believe that the key constraints in the continued growth of AI are physical— chip manufacturing, data center infrastructure, and power generation; the future of AI will be determined by the control of the physical stack.
paras.zh: - AI 算力基础设施。xAI 在建设和扩展地面 AI 算力基础设施方面已确立领先地位，成为首家部署连贯的吉瓦级 AI 训练集群的公司。我们拥有并运营我们认为地球上最大的 AI 训练数据中心集群，包括 COLOSSUS 和 COLOSSUS II。与 Tesla 和 Intel 合作新增的芯片制造计划 Terafab，旨在进一步将我们的垂直整合延伸至芯片设计与制造，以缓解 SpaceX 未来潜在的芯片短缺、优化算力性能，并有可能降低整体算力成本。就该等合作而言，我们已与 Tesla 就 Terafab 的未来发展达成总体框架。根据该框架开展的任何具体项目均须另行协商并签订协议（包括任何开发时间表、里程碑和资本支出），且尚未确定。我们认为，AI 持续增长的关键制约因素是物理层面的——芯片制造、数据中心基础设施和发电；AI 的未来将由对物理技术栈的控制所决定。

paras.en: - Truth-Seeking Frontier Model. Since launching Grok-1 in November 2023, we have released four major versions and notable variations thereof, achieving one of the fastest iteration cycles in the industry. Within two years of its initial model release, Grok achieved frontier-level performance in scientific reasoning, as measured by its GPQA Diamond score, an industry benchmark that evaluates AI models on a standardized set of questions written and validated by experts, on a faster timeline than reported by other leading model providers. Building on this trajectory, we expect to continue scaling Grok through subsequent generations. Ongoing training of next‑generation models is expected to scale toward multiple trillions of parameters, which could represent a step change in reasoning in depth and overall intelligence. In this context, the number of parameters refers to the scale of the model, where parameters are the internal numerical values, such as “weights,” that are adjusted during training to enable the model to recognize patterns and relationships in data. A larger number of parameters generally allows the model to capture more complex relationships, store greater amounts of knowledge, and achieve higher levels of reasoning capability.
