Additionally, third parties have in the past, and may in the future, obtain spectrum rights for the purpose of blocking market entry.
paras.zh: 我们的卫星连接服务在美国及国际上受到广泛监管。从美国及外国监管机构取得并维持通信牌照和批准，对我们的连接服务至关重要。我们的卫星连接服务，包括我们在 Starlink Mobile 下提供的全球卫星直连手机连接服务，依赖于无线电频谱的使用权限以及美国 FCC 和其他国家电信监管机构的授权。若无上述牌照和批准，我们通常无法在特定市场提供连接服务。取得必要授权可能是一个复杂且耗时的过程，往往涉及技术协调、公共利益或国家安全审查以及跨境考量，包括在某些司法管辖区，监管程序可能受到保护主义政策或偏好的影响。频谱使用权限本身有限且受到高度监管。2025 年 9 月，我们宣布与 EchoStar 达成最终协议，购买其 AWS-4 和 H-block 频谱牌照。该频谱交易已于 2026 年 5 月 12 日获得 FCC 批准，且在完成前还需满足其他交割条件。我们预计该频谱交易将于 2027 年 11 月交割。无法保证上述条件将及时得到满足或豁免，或根本无法满足或豁免。即使交易完成，也无法保证我们从 EchoStar 购买牌照足以满足我们日益增长的频谱牌照需求，且我们可能无法找到其他方以可接受的条款向我们提供额外频谱牌照，或根本无法找到。我们未来可能就频谱权利寻求额外收购、租赁或其他安排，以支持我们连接服务的扩张，且无法保证我们能够以可接受的条款达成或完成任何此类交易或安排，或根本无法达成或完成。任何此类未来交易或安排可能要求重大资本承诺、持续付款义务及监管批准。此外，我们必须就从 EchoStar 收购的频谱取得多个国际电信监管机构的全球使用权，以使我们的 V2 卫星直连手机服务可在全球范围内使用，且无法保证此类授权将以可接受的条款授予，或根本无法授予。此外，我们使用某些频率的权利通过国际电信联盟（“ITU”）进行协调，并受防止有害干扰的国际协议约束。我们必须遵守 ITU 规则和协调程序，国际频谱分配的变化或全球监管论坛的不利决定也可能减少我们可用的频率或附加降低我们网络性能的条件。此外，第三方过去曾、未来也可能为阻止市场进入而获取频谱权利。

paras.en: Regulatory regimes for communications services vary widely across different countries and are continuously evolving. Each country may impose its own licensing conditions and operating requirements on satellite internet providers – for example, mandates to partner with a local entity, to host certain infrastructure within its borders, or to adhere to specific standards relating to data privacy and cybersecurity (including data localization) and, in some cases, regulators may deny, delay or decline to grant authorization for us to operate or use our spectrum in their jurisdiction at all. Regimes in certain of our target markets may also favor incumbent or legacy telecommunications companies, which may impede, delay, or prevent our ability to enter such markets. Compliance with the different requirements of applicable regulatory regimes can be challenging and costly, and any failure to comply with local laws and regulations could lead to penalties or the loss of our authorization to operate in that region. Furthermore, communications regulatory authorizations often require periodic renewal and ongoing compliance with conditions such as deployment milestones, fee payments, and interference mitigation obligations. If we are unable to obtain, retain, and renew the necessary spectrum rights and service licenses on acceptable terms in each of our target markets, or if regulatory bodies significantly delay our authorizations or impose burdensome requirements, our ability to expand and continue our connectivity services would be jeopardized, which would have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 通信服务的监管制度在不同国家之间差异很大，并且不断演变。每个国家都可能对卫星互联网提供商施加各自的许可条件和运营要求——例如，强制要求与当地实体合作、在本国境内托管某些基础设施，或遵守与数据隐私和网络安全（包括数据本地化）相关的特定标准；在某些情况下，监管机构可能完全拒绝、延迟或不予批准我们在其管辖范围内运营或使用频谱。我们某些目标市场的制度还可能偏向现有或传统电信公司，这可能阻碍、延迟或阻止我们进入此类市场。遵守适用监管制度的不同要求可能具有挑战性且成本高昂，任何未能遵守当地法律法规的行为都可能导致处罚或丧失我们在该地区运营的授权。此外，通信监管授权通常需要定期续期，并持续遵守部署里程碑、费用支付和干扰缓解义务等条件。如果我们无法以可接受的条款在我们每个目标市场获得、保留和续期必要的频谱权利和服务许可证，或者如果监管机构大幅延迟我们的授权或施加繁重的要求，我们扩展和继续提供连接服务的能力将受到损害，这将对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: **Our AI products and X platform are subject to complex and evolving U.S. and foreign laws and regulations regarding privacy, cybersecurity, data use, data combination, data protection, content, AI, competition, youth protection, safety, consumer protection and notification, advertising, e-commerce, sanctions, export controls,and other matters. Many of these laws and regulations are subject to change and uncertain interpretation, and we could be required to make changes to our products and business practices, and be exposed to monetary penalties, increased cost of operations, declines in user growth or engagement, or loss of customers, or other harm to our AI products and X platform.**
paras.zh: **我们的 AI 产品和 X 平台受制于美国及外国在隐私、网络安全、数据使用、数据组合、数据保护、内容、AI、竞争、青少年保护、安全、消费者保护与通知、广告、电子商务、制裁、出口管制及其他事项方面复杂且不断演变的法律法规。其中许多法律法规可能发生变化且解释存在不确定性，我们可能被要求更改我们的产品和业务实践，并可能面临罚款、运营成本增加、用户增长或参与度下降、客户流失，或对我们的 AI 产品和 X 平台造成其他损害。**

paras.en: Our AI products and X platform are subject to a variety of laws and regulations in the United States and abroad, including privacy, cybersecurity, data use, data combination, data protection and personal information, the provision of our services to younger users, biometrics, encryption, rights of publicity and related concepts, content, integrity, intellectual property, advertising, marketing, distribution, data security, data retention and deletion, data localization and storage, data disclosure, AI and machine learning, electronic contracts and other communications, competition, protection of minors, consumer protection, sanctions, export controls, and notification, civil rights, accessibility, product liability, e-commerce, taxation and online payment services, as well as contractual requirements imposed by app stores, payment processors, and other partners. The introduction of new products or services, expansion of our activities in certain jurisdictions, or other actions that we may take may subject us to additional laws, regulations, or other government scrutiny and, in some cases, such laws, regulations, or government scrutiny may limit or delay our ability to introduce new products or services or expand our activities in certain jurisdictions. Particularly, our leadership position in various markets, especially in orbital launch services, could subject us to heightened regulatory scrutiny under competition laws. In addition, these U.S. and foreign laws and regulations may impose different obligations from each other. As a result of these laws, regulations, and requirements, we are exposed to the risk of significant fines and penalties or other adverse consequences, such as changes to our products, services, or business practices.
paras.zh: 我们的 AI 产品和 X 平台受美国和国外各种法律法规的约束，包括隐私、网络安全、数据使用、数据组合、数据保护和个人信息、向年轻用户提供服务、生物识别、加密、公开权及相关概念、内容、诚信、知识产权、广告、营销、分销、数据安全、数据保留与删除、数据本地化与存储、数据披露、AI 与机器学习、电子合同及其他通信、竞争、未成年人保护、消费者保护、制裁、出口管制和通知、公民权利、无障碍、产品责任、电子商务、税务和在线支付服务，以及应用商店、支付处理商和其他合作伙伴施加的合同要求。推出新产品或服务、在某些司法管辖区扩大我们的活动，或我们可能采取的其他行动，可能使我们受到额外的法律、法规或其他政府审查，并且在某些情况下，此类法律、法规或政府审查可能限制或延迟我们在某些司法管辖区推出新产品或服务或扩大活动的能力。特别是，我们在各个市场（尤其是在轨道发射服务领域）的领先地位，可能使我们根据竞争法受到更严格的监管审查。此外，这些美国和外国法律法规可能相互施加不同的义务。由于这些法律、法规和要求，我们面临重大罚款和处罚或其他不利后果的风险，例如我们的产品、服务或业务实践发生变化。

paras.en: Our social media and AI-related activities expose us to a variety of risks related to harmful, misleading or illegal content, accuracy, misinformation and deepfakes, bias, discrimination, toxicity, sycophancy, AI deception, consumer protection and notification, products liability, intellectual property infringement or misappropriation, defamation, data privacy, cybersecurity, and sanctions and export controls. Social media and AI are the subject of increasing legislative and regulatory activity by various governmental and regulatory agencies in jurisdictions around the world, which are applying, or are considering applying, platform moderation, intellectual property, product liability, data privacy, age restrictions, data disclosure, cybersecurity, export controls, consumer protection, or other existing laws and regulations or new general legal frameworks to AI (such as the EU’s AI Act, California’s Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act and New York’s Responsible AI Safety and Education Act). In the United States, an increasing amount of legislative and regulatory activity regarding AI is taking place at the state level. Various other jurisdictions have enacted or are considering enacting regulations focused on AI. Restrictions under such laws or regulations, if implemented, could increase the costs and burdens to our AI segment and its customers, delay or halt deployment of new systems using our AI segment’s products, require us to modify, restrict, or discontinue certain features (including less constrained modes), and reduce the number of new entrants and customers, negatively impacting our AI segment’s business and financial results. If we do not adequately address concerns and regulations relating to the responsible use of AI, public confidence in AI could be undermined, adoption of our AI products and services could slow, and we may suffer reputational or financial harm.
paras.zh: 我们的社交媒体和 AI 相关活动使我们面临多种风险，涉及有害、误导性或非法内容、准确性、虚假信息与深度伪造、偏见、歧视、毒性、谄媚、AI 欺骗、消费者保护与通知、产品责任、知识产权侵权或盗用、诽谤、数据隐私、网络安全以及制裁与出口管制。社交媒体和 AI 正日益成为全球各司法管辖区政府与监管机构立法和监管活动的对象，这些机构正在或正在考虑将平台内容审核、知识产权、产品责任、数据隐私、年龄限制、数据披露、网络安全、出口管制、消费者保护或其他现行法律法规或新的一般性法律框架适用于 AI（例如欧盟《人工智能法案》、加利福尼亚州《前沿人工智能法案》和纽约州《负责任人工智能安全与教育法案》）。在美国，越来越多的 AI 相关立法和监管活动正在州一级展开。其他多个司法管辖区已颁布或正在考虑颁布针对 AI 的法规。此类法律或法规中的限制若得以实施，可能增加我们 AI 板块及其客户的成本和负担，延迟或阻碍使用我们 AI 板块产品的新系统部署，要求我们修改、限制或停止某些功能（包括限制较少的模式），并减少新进入者和客户数量，从而对我们的 AI 板块业务和财务业绩产生负面影响。如果我们未能充分应对与负责任使用 AI 相关的关切和法规，公众对 AI 的信心可能受到削弱，我们 AI 产品和服务的采用可能放缓，我们可能遭受声誉或财务损害。

paras.en: Certain of our AI products, including Grok, offer features or modes designed to generate more candid, direct, or less reserved or irreverent outputs, such as “Spicy” Imagine Mode and “Unhinged” Voice Mode. These features are intended to provide users with greater flexibility and control in how they use our tools. Because these modes may be more irreverent and harsher than our standard offerings, they present heightened risks, including reputational harm, the generation of potentially explicit content and misinformation or deceptive outputs, potential nonconsensual or exploitative imagery, intellectual property infringement, or content that could be viewed as exploitative, harmful, harassing, abusive, or discriminatory. The availability of such features may also increase the risk of regulatory scrutiny, enforcement actions, litigation, or claims of harm, as well as reputational damage, user or advertiser backlash, or limitations on our ability to distribute or monetize our products in certain jurisdictions or through certain partners.
paras.zh: 我们的某些 AI 产品（包括 Grok）提供旨在生成更直率、直接或较少保留、较少恭敬的输出内容的功能或模式，例如“Spicy”Imagine 模式和“Unhinged”语音模式。这些功能旨在为用户提供更大的灵活性和对其使用我们工具方式的控制权。由于这些模式可能比我们的标准产品更为不恭和尖锐，它们带来更高的风险，包括声誉损害、生成可能露骨的内容和虚假信息或欺骗性输出、潜在的非自愿或剥削性图像、知识产权侵权，或可能被视为剥削性、有害、骚扰、辱骂或歧视性的内容。此类功能的可用性还可能增加监管审查、执法行动、诉讼或损害索赔的风险，以及声誉损害、用户或广告主的抵制，或我们在某些司法管辖区或通过某些合作伙伴分销或变现我们产品的能力受到限制的风险。

paras.en: In addition, various regulatory authorities and agencies around the world are actively investigating and making inquiries relating to social media or the use of AI concerning a variety of matters, including investigations and inquiries relating to harmful or illegal content, recommendations, advertising, and consumer protection and notification, which have resulted in, and may in the future result in additional or further investigations and proceedings being brought against us. Certain features that enable more user-directed or less constrained outputs may increase the risk of regulatory scrutiny. For example, we are subject to investigations and inquiries from regulators and law enforcement authorities in the United States and internationally concerning allegations that our AI products were used to create nonconsensual explicit images or content representing children in sexualized contexts, and similar matters. We are subject to ongoing litigation, including putative class action lawsuits, relating to such allegations, and we may be subject to additional litigation in the future concerning these types of allegations. These regulatory inquiries, including those related to misuse of our AI products, such as Grok, and those related to the X platform, could expose us to additional investigations, proceedings, and litigation, regulatory sanctions (including loss of access to certain markets, which has occurred in the past), liability and adverse publicity, any of which would adversely affect our business.
paras.zh: 此外，全球各类监管机关和机构正积极就社交媒体或 AI 使用相关的多种事项开展调查和问询，包括与有害或非法内容、推荐、广告以及消费者保护和通知相关的调查和问询，这些调查和问询已经导致并可能在未来导致针对我们的额外或进一步调查和程序。某些能够实现更多由用户主导或限制更少的输出的功能，可能增加监管审查的风险。例如，我们正受到美国及国际监管机构和执法机关就有关指控开展的调查和问询，该等指控称我们的 AI 产品被用于制作未经同意的露骨图像或描绘儿童性化情境的内容，以及类似事项。我们正面临与此类指控相关的持续诉讼，包括推定集体诉讼，且我们未来可能就此类指控面临额外诉讼。这些监管问询，包括与我们的 AI 产品（如 Grok）被滥用相关的问询，以及与 X 平台相关的问询，可能使我们面临额外调查、程序及诉讼、监管制裁（包括失去进入某些市场的机会，过去曾发生此类情况）、责任及负面宣传，其中任何一项均会对我们的业务产生不利影响。

paras.en: For example, in February 2026, the Irish Data Protection Commission, our AI segment’s privacy regulator in Europe, launched a large-scale inquiry to determine whether our AI segment has complied with its obligations under the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”). This inquiry involves the processing of personal data of European Union data subjects, including children, using generative AI functionality associated with the Grok model within the X platform. In the United States, the Federal Trade Commission has undertaken an inquiry into the chatbots of our AI segment and other major technology companies to understand how these companies have evaluated the safety of their chatbots when acting as companions to children and teens. Regulatory requirements applicable to online platforms and content moderation, and to AI systems, could require us to implement costly compliance measures, restrict certain features or jurisdictions, or expose us to significant fines, liability, penalties, or operational constraints. We are also subject to developer agreements and guidelines imposed by third-party app stores, such as the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Failure to comply with these agreements and guidelines, including those relating to content, could result in the suspension or removal of our mobile applications from such app stores. Any such suspension or removal could materially limit our ability to distribute our mobile applications, and adversely affect our business, results of operations, and financial condition.
paras.zh: 例如，2026 年 2 月，我们的 AI 业务板块在欧洲的隐私监管机构爱尔兰数据保护委员会启动了一项大规模调查，以确定我们的 AI 业务板块是否遵守了欧盟《通用数据保护条例》（“GDPR”）项下的义务。该调查涉及使用 X 平台内与 Grok 模型相关的生成式 AI 功能处理欧盟数据主体（包括儿童）的个人数据。在美国，联邦贸易委员会已对我们的 AI 业务板块及其他大型科技公司的聊天机器人展开问询，以了解这些公司在聊天机器人作为儿童和青少年陪伴者时如何评估其安全性。适用于在线平台和内容审核以及 AI 系统的监管要求，可能要求我们实施成本高昂的合规措施、限制某些功能或司法辖区，或使我们面临重大罚款、责任、处罚或运营限制。我们还受制于第三方应用商店（如 Apple App Store 和 Google Play Store）施加的开发者协议和准则。未能遵守该等协议和准则（包括与内容相关的协议和准则），可能导致我们的移动应用程序被该等应用商店暂停或下架。任何此类暂停或下架均可能实质性限制我们分发移动应用程序的能力，并对我们的业务、经营业绩和财务状况产生不利影响。

paras.en: Authorities around the world have adopted or are considering adopting a number of legislative and regulatory proposals concerning data protection and privacy. Additionally, the increasing adoption of AI technologies, which often rely on the collection of large amounts of data and use of such data to train, fine-tune or otherwise develop AI models, has led data protection authorities around the world to consider and adopt new and evolving interpretations of data protection laws, imposing specific obligations with respect to the processing of personal data, including required notices, consents and opt-outs. Adverse legal rulings, legislation or regulations related to such data privacy matters may result in fines and orders requiring that we change our practices, which could have an adverse effect on how we provide services, and could harm our business, financial condition, results of operations and future prospects. These compliance obligations could also cause us to incur substantial costs or harm the quality and operations of our products and services in ways that harm our business. Further, we are subject to evolving laws and regulations that dictate whether, how, and under what circumstances we can transfer, receive or otherwise process personal data. The validity of various data transfer mechanisms we currently rely upon remains subject to legal, regulatory and political developments globally, which may require us to adapt our existing arrangements. Evolving data protection laws and regulations such as the GDPR and ePrivacy Directive, and regulatory actions affecting our AI segment may restrict or adversely affect the X platform’s advertising services, Grok’s development and training, or the ability to offer certain products and services in certain jurisdictions.
paras.zh: 世界各国主管机关已通过或正在考虑通过多项有关数据保护与隐私的立法和监管提案。此外，AI 技术的日益普及——此类技术往往依赖收集大量数据，并使用该等数据来训练、微调或以其他方式开发 AI 模型——已促使世界各地数据保护主管机关考虑并采纳对数据保护法不断演变的新解释，就个人数据处理施加特定义务，包括所需的告知、同意和退出机制。与此类数据隐私事项相关的不利司法裁决、立法或法规可能导致罚款和命令，要求我们改变做法，这可能对我们提供服务的方式产生不利影响，并可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景。该等合规义务还可能使我们承担重大成本，或以损害我们业务的方式损害我们产品和服务的质量与运营。此外，我们还受制于不断演变的法律法规，这些法律法规规定了我们能否、如何以及在何种情况下传输、接收或以其他方式处理个人数据。我们目前依赖的各种数据传输机制的有效性仍取决于全球范围内的法律、监管和政治动态，这可能要求我们调整现有安排。不断演变的数据保护法律法规（如 GDPR 和《电子隐私指令》）以及影响我们 AI 板块的监管行动，可能限制或不利影响 X 平台的广告服务、Grok 的开发与训练，或在某些司法管辖区提供某些产品和服务的能力。

paras.en: We are also subject to tax laws, regulations, and policies of the U.S. federal, state, and local governments and of comparable taxing authorities in foreign jurisdictions where we conduct business. Changes in tax laws or in their interpretation or enforcement could result in fluctuations in our effective tax rate, exposure to new or additional tax liabilities, or adversely affect our after-tax profitability or financial position. These U.S. federal and state, EU, and other international laws and regulations, which in some cases can be enforced by private parties in addition to government entities, are constantly evolving and can be subject to significant change. As a result, the application, interpretation, and enforcement of these laws and regulations are often uncertain, particularly in the new and rapidly evolving industry in which we operate, and may be interpreted and applied inconsistently from jurisdiction to jurisdiction and inconsistently with our current policies and practices. For example, regulatory or legislative actions or litigation concerning the manner in which we display content to our users, moderate content, provide our services to younger users, or are able to use data in various ways, including for advertising, have in the past and could in the future adversely affect user growth and engagement, affect the manner in which we provide our services, or adversely affect our financial results, including by imposing significant fines that increasingly may be calculated based on global revenue. For example, the UK’s Online Safety Act 2023 and Australia’s Online Safety Amendment (Social Media Minimum Age) Act 2024 impose risk mitigation and age-related requirements on certain online platforms. These laws and regulations, as well as any associated claims, inquiries, or investigations or any government actions, have led to, and may in the future lead to, unfavorable outcomes including increased compliance costs, changes to our products, loss of revenue, delays or impediments in the development of new products, negative publicity and reputational harm, increased operating costs, diversion of management time and attention, and remedies that harm our business, including fines, damages, or orders that we modify or cease existing business practices. In addition, our AI products and the X platform have historically been, and may continue to be, subject to claims and investigations relating to misinformation and deepfakes, defamation, intellectual property infringement or misappropriation, data privacy, cybersecurity, employment matters, advertising practices, and user harms; defending such matters could be costly and divert management attention.
paras.zh: 我们还须遵守美国联邦、州和地方政府以及我们开展业务所在外国司法管辖区同类税务机关的税法、法规和政策。税法或其解释或执行的变化可能导致我们的实际税率波动、面临新的或额外的纳税义务，或对我们的税后盈利能力或财务状况产生不利影响。这些美国联邦和州、欧盟及其他国际法律和法规（在某些情况下除政府实体外还可由私人当事方执行）不断演变，并可能发生重大变化。因此，这些法律和法规的适用、解释和执行往往具有不确定性，尤其是在我们所处的新兴且快速演变的行业中，并且在不同司法管辖区之间以及与我们当前的政策和做法之间可能被不一致地解释和适用。例如，有关我们向用户展示内容、审核内容、向年轻用户提供服务或能够以各种方式（包括用于广告）使用数据的监管或立法行动或诉讼，过去已经并可能在未来对用户增长和参与度产生不利影响，影响我们提供服务的方式，或对我们的财务业绩产生不利影响，包括通过施加可能日益基于全球收入计算的巨额罚款。例如，英国《2023 年在线安全法》和澳大利亚《2024 年在线安全修正案（社交媒体最低年龄）法》对某些在线平台施加了风险缓解和年龄相关要求。这些法律和法规以及任何相关索赔、问询或调查或任何政府行动已经并可能在未来导致不利结果，包括合规成本增加、产品变更、收入损失、新产品开发延迟或受阻、负面宣传和声誉损害、运营成本增加、管理层时间和精力被分散，以及损害我们业务的救济措施，包括罚款、损害赔偿或要求我们修改或停止现有业务做法的命令。此外，我们的 AI 产品和 X 平台历来并可能继续面临与虚假信息和深度伪造、诽谤、知识产权侵权或盗用、数据隐私、网络安全、雇佣事宜、广告做法和用户损害相关的索赔和调查；为此类事项进行辩护可能成本高昂并分散管理层注意力。

paras.en: **Our Starlink and other satellite services are subject to complex and evolving U.S. and foreign laws and regulations, particularly relating to data privacy, cybersecurity, and telecommunications.**
paras.zh: **我们的 Starlink 和其他卫星服务须遵守复杂且不断演变的美国及外国法律和法规，尤其是与数据隐私、网络安全和电信相关的法律和法规。**

paras.en: Our Starlink and other satellite services are subject to a variety of laws and regulations in the United States and abroad covering cybersecurity, privacy, data use, data combination, data protection, data security, data retention and deletion, data localization and storage, and data disclosure to law enforcement agencies. As a satellite internet and communications provider, we collect and otherwise process various kinds of data in connection with our services, such as customer personal information, account registration information, device identifiers, network and connectivity data, and government information. These laws and regulations govern how we handle such information, and they may, among others, impose requirements relating to cybersecurity and privacy governance, data security measures, data security breach notification, cross border data transfers, and customer consent obligations.
paras.zh: 我们的 Starlink 及其他卫星服务须遵守美国及境外关于网络安全、隐私、数据使用、数据组合、数据保护、数据安全、数据保留与删除、数据本地化与存储以及向执法机构披露数据的各类法律法规。作为卫星互联网及通信服务提供商，我们在提供服务过程中收集并以其他方式处理各类数据，例如客户个人信息、账户注册信息、设备标识符、网络与连接数据以及政府信息。上述法律法规规范我们如何处理此类信息，并可能对我们施加与网络安全与隐私治理、数据安全措施、数据安全泄露通知、跨境数据传输及客户同意义务等相关的各项要求。

paras.en: In particular, the California Consumer Privacy Act (as amended), the GDPR (and its equivalent in the United Kingdom) and other data privacy laws and regulations impose stringent and burdensome requirements in connection with the processing of personal information and include significant penalties for non-compliance. Additionally, as a government contractor, we are also subject to the Department of War’s Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification requirements, which requires companies that do business with the Department of War to, depending on the level of scrutiny required, meet or exceed certain specified cybersecurity standards to be eligible for new contract awards. Many of these laws and regulations are subject to change and uncertain interpretation, and their application may vary significantly across jurisdictions. Compliance may require us to modify our policies, procedures, and controls, and increase our compliance costs and operational complexity. We may post public privacy policies and other statements regarding our collection, storage, sharing and other processing of personal information, and any actual or perceived failure to comply with such privacy policies and other statements, as well as the foregoing data privacy and cybersecurity laws and regulations, may subject us to enforcement actions, investigations, litigation, reputational harm or requirements to modify or cease our business practices.
paras.zh: 特别是，《加州消费者隐私法》（经修订）、GDPR（及其英国等效法规）以及其他数据隐私法律法规，对个人信息的处理施加了严格且繁重的合规要求，并对违规行为规定了重大处罚。此外，作为政府承包商，我们还须遵守美国战争部的网络安全成熟度模型认证要求，该要求规定与战争部开展业务的公司须根据所需审查级别达到或超过特定网络安全标准，方有资格获得新合同授予。上述法律法规中许多内容存在变动且解释不确定，其适用在不同司法管辖区可能差异显著。合规可能要求我们修改政策、程序和控制措施，并增加合规成本与运营复杂性。我们可能发布公开隐私政策及其他关于我们收集、存储、共享及以其他方式处理个人信息的声明，任何实际或被认为未能遵守该等隐私政策及其他声明以及上述数据隐私与网络安全法律法规的行为，均可能使我们面临执法行动、调查、诉讼、声誉损害或被要求修改或停止业务实践。

paras.en: **Our business strategy depends on successfully designing, developing, and deploying our products and services, as well as related platforms, infrastructure, and other strategic initiatives, at an unprecedented scale, which presents significant execution, cost, and timing risks.**
paras.zh: **我们的业务战略取决于能否以前所未有的规模成功设计、开发并部署我们的产品与服务，以及相关平台、基础设施和其他战略举措，这带来重大的执行、成本与时间风险。**

paras.en: Our business plan, and ultimately, the achievement of our mission, is predicated on building, commercializing, and operating products and services, as well as related infrastructure and strategic initiatives at a scale that has not previously been achieved. This objective requires us to integrate complex technologies, develop new processes and infrastructure, and coordinate across multiple suppliers, contractors, regulators, and stakeholders. Because we are attempting to execute at a scale for which there is limited precedent, we face heightened uncertainty with respect to design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational performance, which is further heightened by the novel nature of the technologies underlying the products and services we intend to develop.
paras.zh: 我们的商业计划，以及最终实现我们的使命，都建立在以史无前例的规模构建、商业化并运营产品和服务，以及相关基础设施和战略举措的基础之上。这一目标要求我们整合复杂技术、开发新流程和新基础设施，并在多个供应商、承包商、监管机构和利益相关方之间进行协调。由于我们试图以有限的先例可循的规模执行，我们在设计、工程、采购、施工、调试和运营表现方面面临更高的不确定性，而我们拟开发的产品和服务所依托技术的新颖性又进一步加剧了这种不确定性。

paras.en: As a result, timelines for developing and deploying our products and services may be longer than we currently anticipate, and we may encounter delays due to, among other things, technical challenges, including those resulting from the nascent state of certain of our products and services, the unavailability or immaturity of key technologies, supply chain constraints, energy shocks, including related price volatility, labor availability, permitting and regulatory approvals, or the need to redesign or reengineer key components. In addition, the costs associated with developing and deploying our products and services and related platforms, infrastructure and strategic initiatives at scale may exceed our current estimates, including due to inflationary pressures, energy prices, unforeseen engineering complexities, the cost of developing or licensing technologies that are not yet commercially available, competitive dynamics, changes in scope, or the need for additional capital expenditures, contingency reserves or working capital.
paras.zh: 因此，开发和部署我们的产品和服务的时间线可能比我们目前预期的更长，我们可能因各种原因遭遇延迟，包括技术挑战（其中部分源于我们某些产品和服务尚处于早期阶段）、关键技术不可获得或不成熟、供应链限制、能源冲击（包括相关价格波动）、劳动力可获得性、许可和监管审批，或需要重新设计或重新工程化关键组件。此外，与大规模开发和部署我们的产品和服务及相关平台、基础设施和战略举措相关的成本可能超出我们目前的估计，原因包括通胀压力、能源价格、不可预见的工程复杂性、开发或授权尚未商业化的技术的成本、竞争动态、范围变更，或需要额外的资本支出、应急储备或营运资金。

paras.en: If we are unable to successfully execute our growth strategy on the anticipated timeline or within our expected cost parameters, our business, financial condition and results of operations could be materially adversely affected. Delays or cost overruns could also impact our ability to achieve projected returns, meet contractual commitments, access additional financing on acceptable terms, or maintain investor confidence. Moreover, even if we successfully deploy our growth strategy, including Starship, Terafab, orbital AI, and the creation of the lunar economy, they may not perform as expected at scale, which could result in operational inefficiencies, increased costs, reduced revenues, or declines in our stock price.
paras.zh: 如果我们无法在预期时间线内或在我们预期的成本参数内成功执行我们的增长战略，我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩可能受到重大不利影响。延迟或成本超支还可能影响我们实现预期回报、履行合同承诺、以可接受条款获得额外融资或维持投资者信心的能力。此外，即使我们成功部署我们的增长战略（包括 Starship、Terafab、轨道 AI 以及月球经济的创建），它们在大规模下也可能无法如预期般表现，这可能导致运营效率低下、成本增加、收入减少或我们的股价下跌。

paras.en: **We have experienced, and will likely continue to experience, launch delays and failures that could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们已经经历、并且很可能将继续经历发射延迟和失败，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: Launch vehicle underperformance, propulsion anomalies, structural failures, software errors, or other malfunctions could result in launch delays or partial or total mission failures, including the loss of satellites, launch pads, vehicles, or payloads. The occurrence of mission failures or other significant operational disruptions could also expose us to litigation as well as increased scrutiny from regulatory authorities, lead to the imposition of additional compliance requirements, and adversely affect our brand and reputation, and our ability to obtain future licenses, permits, or government contracts. We do not typically obtain insurance coverage for our satellites, payloads, or launch vehicles, and as a result we bear the full financial cost of any such losses. Repeated anomalies or high visibility mission failures could also negatively affect our brand, reputation, ability to win new business, and our customers’ ability to procure launch and in-orbit insurance at competitive rates (to the extent we decide to pursue it). Such repeated anomalies or mission failures could also result in, regulators delaying, conditioning or denying approvals, waivers or licenses required for future launches or reentries, which could reduce our launch cadence and delay the deployment of our satellites and other services. In the past, certain of our launch vehicles have experienced partial or total mission failures, including anomalies that resulted in launch pad destruction, the loss of payloads and damage to launch vehicles. In certain circumstances, mission failures could result in debris from our launch vehicles causing significant damage to persons or property on the ground as well as environmental damage. There can be no assurance that similar or other failures will not occur with future launches. In addition, satellites may be deployed into incorrect or suboptimal orbits due to vehicle performance issues, separation events, or guidance, navigation and control errors. Incorrect orbital placement can materially reduce a satellite’s operational life, impair performance, increase fuel consumption, or render the satellite unusable.
paras.zh: 运载火箭性能不达标、推进异常、结构失效、软件错误或其他故障，可能导致发射延迟或任务部分或完全失败，包括卫星、发射台、运载火箭或有效载荷的损失。任务失败或其他重大运营中断的发生还可能使我们面临诉讼以及监管机构更严格的审查，导致额外合规要求的施加，并对我们的品牌和声誉以及我们获得未来许可证、许可或政府合同的能力产生不利影响。我们通常不为我们的卫星、有效载荷或运载火箭购买保险，因此我们承担任何此类损失的全部财务成本。反复出现的异常或高关注度的任务失败还可能对我们的品牌、声誉、赢得新业务的能力以及我们的客户以有竞争力的费率获得发射和在轨保险的能力（在我们决定购买该保险的范围内）产生负面影响。此类反复出现的异常或任务失败还可能导致监管机构推迟、附加条件或拒绝未来发射或再入所需的批准、豁免或许可，这可能降低我们的发射频率并延迟我们卫星和其他服务的部署。过去，我们的某些运载火箭曾经历部分或完全任务失败，包括导致发射台损毁、有效载荷损失和运载火箭损坏的异常情况。在某些情况下，任务失败可能导致我们的运载火箭碎片对地面人员或财产造成重大损害以及环境损害。无法保证未来发射不会发生类似或其他失败。此外，由于运载火箭性能问题、分离事件或制导、导航和控制错误，卫星可能被部署到错误或次优轨道。错误的轨道部署可能大幅缩短卫星的运行寿命、损害性能、增加燃料消耗或使卫星无法使用。

paras.en: **Our satellites, launch vehicles, and other space-related technologies operate, and in the case of orbital AI compute, will operate, in the harsh and unpredictable environment of space, exposing them to a wide and unique range of space-related risks that could cause them to malfunction or fail, and any such malfunction or failure could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们的卫星、运载火箭和其他太空相关技术在有史以来最为严酷且不可预测的太空环境中运行，就轨道 AI 算力而言，未来也将在该环境中运行，这使它们面临广泛而独特的太空相关风险，可能导致其发生故障或失效，而任何此类故障或失效都可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。**

paras.en: Operating in space subjects our satellites, launch vehicles, spacecraft, and related systems to extreme and highly variable conditions that can adversely affect performance, reduce useful life, or result in total mission failure. Space is inherently hostile. Hardware must withstand: significant vibration and acoustic loads during launch; wide-ranging thermal cycles; radiation from solar and cosmic sources; micrometeoroids and orbital debris; and other environmental hazards, each of which testing cannot fully replicate. In particular, we have not, and no one else has, previously operated or attempted to operate orbital AI compute, and the conditions of space on such AI infrastructure have not been tested. Once deployed, orbital AI compute infrastructure will not be readily accessible, and as a result, will not be easily repaired or upgraded, such that any component failures could result in permanent capacity loss, accelerated depreciation, decommissioning or need for replacement of the infrastructure.
paras.zh: 在太空运行会使我们的卫星、运载火箭、航天器及相关系统面临极端且高度多变的条件，这些条件可能对性能产生不利影响、缩短使用寿命，或导致任务完全失败。太空环境本质上具有敌意。硬件必须承受：发射过程中显著的振动与声学载荷；大幅波动的热循环；来自太阳和宇宙源的辐射；微流星体与轨道碎片；以及其他环境危害，而上述每一项都无法通过测试完全复现。特别是，我们此前从未、也没有其他人曾运营或尝试运营轨道 AI 算力，此类 AI 基础设施在太空中的条件尚未经过测试。一旦部署，轨道 AI 算力基础设施将不易接近，因此也不易维修或升级，任何组件故障都可能导致永久性容量损失、加速折旧、退役或需要更换该基础设施。

paras.en: In addition, space weather events, such as geomagnetic storms, solar flares, and other forms of radiation activity, have in the past disrupted and could in the future disrupt satellite propulsion, power systems, and communications equipment, potentially leading to reduced performance or permanent damage. Although we incorporate certain radiation-hardened components, shielding, and redundancy into our systems, these measures may not be sufficient to prevent material adverse impacts in all scenarios. Failures or performance degradation resulting from these risks could delay deployments, reduce available capacity, increase operating costs, require significant capital expenditures to replace affected assets, or interrupt or degrade services provided to customers. Furthermore, the useful life of our satellites is inherently shorter than that of the information technology systems and infrastructure they host. As a result, we must periodically launch replacement satellites as existing satellites reach the end of their useful lives and are decommissioned, which may truncate the effective lifespan of those underlying information technology systems and infrastructure. Any such events could adversely affect our reputation, compliance with applicable laws and regulations, business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 此外，空间天气事件（如地磁暴、太阳耀斑及其他形式的辐射活动）过去曾干扰、未来也可能干扰卫星推进、电力系统和通信设备，可能导致性能下降或永久性损坏。尽管我们在系统中采用了某些抗辐射组件、屏蔽和冗余设计，但这些措施可能不足以在所有情形下防止重大不利影响。由这些风险导致的故障或性能下降可能延迟部署、降低可用容量、增加运营成本、需要大量资本支出以更换受影响资产，或中断或降低向客户提供的服务。此外，我们卫星的使用寿命本质上短于其所承载的信息技术系统和基础设施。因此，随着现有卫星达到使用寿命终点并退役，我们必须定期发射替换卫星，这可能截短这些底层信息技术系统和基础设施的有效寿命。任何此类事件都可能对我们的声誉、对适用法律和法规的合规性、业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。

paras.en: **The continued proliferation of satellite constellations in Low-Earth Orbit, as well as the risk of collisions with space debris or other spacecraft, could limit or impair our launch flexibility and satellite deployment, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **低地球轨道卫星星座的持续增多，以及与空间碎片或其他航天器发生碰撞的风险，可能限制或损害我们的发射灵活性和卫星部署，进而可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。**

paras.en: The continued proliferation of Low-Earth Orbit constellations can increase the risk of collisions with space debris or other spacecraft if operators fail to adhere to responsible space safety, debris mitigation, or coordination practices. Our growth strategy depends, in part, on continuing to launch additional satellites into Low-Earth Orbit. As the number of satellites and other objects in Low-Earth Orbit continues to grow, the probability of accidental collisions, fragmentation events, or other in-orbit incidents increases, which could result in the loss or degradation of our satellites, increased costs for collision avoidance maneuvers, or the need to replace or reposition assets on an accelerated schedule. Not all satellite operators or other space actors adhere to the same rigorous space safety, debris mitigation, or coordination practices that we adhere to, which may increase the likelihood of congestion, conjunctions, or other operational risks outside of our control and, in extreme cases, could contribute to fragmentation events or cascading debris effects that further increase collision risks in Low-Earth Orbit.
paras.zh: 如果运营商未能遵守负责任的空间安全、碎片减缓或协调实践，近地轨道星座的持续增多可能增加与空间碎片或其他航天器碰撞的风险。我们的增长战略部分依赖于持续向近地轨道发射更多卫星。随着近地轨道中卫星及其他物体数量的持续增长，意外碰撞、解体事件或其他在轨事故的概率随之上升，这可能导致我们的卫星损失或性能下降、避碰机动成本增加，或需要加速更换或重新部署资产。并非所有卫星运营商或其他航天活动参与者都遵守与我们同样严格的空间安全、碎片减缓或协调实践，这可能增加我们无法控制的拥堵、交会或其他运营风险的可能性，在极端情况下，还可能促成解体事件或级联碎片效应，从而进一步增加近地轨道的碰撞风险。

paras.en: In addition, some domestic and international authorities have applied heightened regulatory scrutiny as interest in utilizing Low-Earth Orbit for satellite operations has increased. Debris mitigation regulations may emerge if congestion increases. Failure to meet debris requirements could result in monetary penalties or loss of licensing authority, which would adversely affect our satellite constellation deployment and expansion plans, and future regulatory actions could impose more restrictive operational, deployment, or debris mitigation requirements that could limit our ability to launch or operate satellites in Low-Earth Orbit. In addition, there is a burgeoning effort to further regulate Low-Earth Orbit, MEO, and GSO and establish liability regimes for operators, including regimes similar to those under the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation and Liability Act, which imposes strict liability for environmental contamination or remediation costs, as well as growing concern over the potential environmental effects of emissions and other byproducts from rocket launches in Earth’s upper atmosphere. Additional regulation in this area could adversely impact our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 此外，随着利用近地轨道开展卫星运营的兴趣日益增长，部分国内和国际监管机构已加强监管审查。若拥堵加剧，可能会出台碎片减缓法规。未能满足碎片相关要求可能导致罚款或丧失许可授权，这将对我们的卫星星座部署和扩展计划产生不利影响，且未来的监管行动可能施加更严格的运营、部署或碎片减缓要求，从而限制我们在近地轨道发射或运营卫星的能力。此外，各方正日益努力进一步监管近地轨道、中地球轨道（MEO）和地球同步轨道（GSO），并为运营商建立责任制度，包括类似于《综合环境响应、补偿与责任法》（Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation and Liability Act）下的制度——该法对环境污�染或修复成本规定了严格责任；同时，人们对火箭发射在地球上层大气中产生的排放及其他副产品可能造成的环境影响也日益关注。该领域的额外监管可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。

paras.en: Furthermore, any damage to our satellites or impairment of their functionality resulting from collisions with space debris or other spacecraft could materially and adversely affect our ability to deliver reliable services to our customers, harm our reputation, and expose us to potential contractual liabilities or insurance claims. The growing challenges associated with space debris management may require us to invest in additional technologies or processes to safeguard our assets and maintain compliance with evolving regulatory frameworks, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 此外，因与空间碎片或其他航天器碰撞而对我们卫星造成的任何损害或对其功能的任何削弱，都可能重大不利地影响我们向客户提供可靠服务的能力、损害我们的声誉，并使我们需要承担潜在的合同责任或保险索赔。与空间碎片管理相关的日益严峻的挑战可能要求我们投资于额外技术或流程，以保护我们的资产并保持对不断演变的监管框架的合规，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: **Interruptions in the operation of critical satellite network, ground station, launch, manufacturing, or spacecraft or data center infrastructure could result in significant downtime, operational delays or loss of service, each of which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **关键卫星网络、地面站、发射、制造或航天器或数据中心基础设施的运行中断可能导致严重停机、运营延迟或服务中断，其中任何一项均可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: Our ability to provide reliable services across our Space, Connectivity, and AI business segments depends on the uninterrupted operation of our critical infrastructure, including but not limited to satellite and communications networks, ground stations, launch facilities, and data centers. An interruption or failure affecting any aspect of this infrastructure, whether due to equipment malfunctions, power outages, disruptions in, or unauthorized access to, our computer systems (such as software or hardware failures, or cyberattacks), natural disasters (such as earthquakes, floods, fires, or severe weather events), terrorism, war, sabotage, pandemics, epidemics, or other unforeseen circumstances, could result in significant downtime, operational delays, or complete loss of service. A cyberattack or other hostile act could destroy or disable a significant number of our satellites and, depending on its scale, could trigger a cascading collision event that renders our licensed orbits, and potentially other orbits, unusable for an extended period. Similarly, the use of our satellites to enable communications access in conflict zones may expose us to retaliation from foreign governments and non-state actors. Such an event could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects. These events may disrupt power, damage facilities, interrupt service despite contingency plans or compromise our ability to deliver services to customers as promised, hinder our ability to meet regulatory or contractual requirements, and erode trust among our customers, partners, regulators and stakeholders. In particular, an interruption or failure affecting our critical infrastructure could result in outages of service to our Starlink Subscribers. Any such outage could erode the trust of existing and potential Starlink Subscribers in our service, which could result in the loss of existing or potential subscribers. Certain of our launch and rocket manufacturing facilities are located in seismically active regions and in low-lying coastal areas, making them susceptible to earthquakes and hurricanes, respectively. Such events could damage our launch infrastructure, ground support equipment, manufacturing facilities, or rockets, potentially halting or delaying launch operations and causing us to incur substantial costs. In addition, the complexity and interdependence of our engineering, manufacturing, assembly and terrestrial, space transportation, and infrastructure systems mean that a disruption in one component can have cascading effects throughout our operations. For example, an outage at a data center or ground station could impact command and control functions, mission planning, or real-time telemetry, while interruptions at launch facilities could cause postponements or cancellations of scheduled launches.
paras.zh: 我们在太空、连接和 AI 业务板块提供可靠服务的能力，取决于我们关键基础设施的不间断运行，包括但不限于卫星与通信网络、地面站、发射设施和数据中心。影响该基础设施任何环节的中断或故障，无论是由于设备故障、停电、我们计算机系统受到干扰或未经授权的访问（例如软件或硬件故障，或网络攻击）、自然灾害（例如地震、洪水、火灾或恶劣天气事件）、恐怖主义、战争、破坏活动、大流行病、流行病或其他不可预见的情况，都可能导致严重停机、运营延迟或服务完全丧失。网络攻击或其他敌对行为可能摧毁或使大量卫星失效，并且视其规模，可能引发级联碰撞事件，使我们的许可轨道乃至其他轨道在较长时期内无法使用。同样，在冲突地区使用我们的卫星提供通信接入，可能使我们面临外国政府和非国家行为体的报复。此类事件可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。这些事件可能中断电力、损坏设施、尽管有应急计划仍导致服务中断，或损害我们按承诺向客户提供服务的能力，妨碍我们满足监管或合同要求，并侵蚀客户、合作伙伴、监管机构和利益相关方对我们的信任。特别是，影响我们关键基础设施的中断或故障可能导致 Starlink 订户服务中断。任何此类中断都可能削弱现有和潜在 Starlink 订户对我们服务的信任，从而导致现有或潜在订户流失。我们的部分发射和火箭制造设施位于地震活跃地区和低洼沿海地区，分别使其易受地震和飓风影响。此类事件可能损坏我们的发射基础设施、地面支持设备、制造设施或火箭，可能使发射运营停止或延迟，并导致我们承担重大成本。此外，我们的工程、制造、组装以及地面、太空运输和基础设施系统的复杂性和相互依存性意味着，一个组件的中断可能在整个运营中产生级联效应。例如，数据中心或地面站的中断可能影响指挥与控制功能、任务规划或实时遥测，而发射设施的中断可能导致预定发射推迟或取消。

paras.en: **Adverse global macroeconomic and geopolitical conditions may negatively affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **不利的全球宏观经济和地缘政治状况可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生负面影响。**

paras.en: Adverse global or regional economic and geopolitical conditions could reduce demand for certain of our products and services, which may negatively affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and future prospects. Economic downturns, inflation, higher interest rates, tighter credit conditions, reduced consumer spending, lower business or government investment, or geopolitical developments may negatively affect demand for our offerings. Reduced consumer or enterprise spending for each of our Starlink connectivity services or our AI-related offerings would limit our ability to grow our business, which may slow the pace at which we deploy satellites and expand our constellation or adversely affect the utilization of our launch capabilities.
paras.zh: 不利的全球或地区经济及地缘政治状况可能降低对我们某些产品和服务的需求，进而可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生负面影响。经济下行、通货膨胀、利率上升、信贷条件收紧、消费者支出减少、企业或政府投资下降，或地缘政治事态发展，都可能对我们的产品需求产生负面影响。消费者或企业在我们的 Starlink 连接服务或我们的 AI 相关产品上的支出减少，将限制我们发展业务的能力，这可能减缓我们部署卫星和扩展星座的速度，或对我们发射能力的利用率产生不利影响。

paras.en: **Manufacturing, testing and launching rockets, satellites, and spacecraft, including our efforts to reuse rockets and spacecraft, involve inherent risks that could result in human injury or death, property damage and environmental damage or other adverse environmental impacts due to accidents or equipment failures. Any such events could result in substantial losses, including reputational harm and legal liability, which could have a material adverse effect on our business.**
paras.zh: **制造、测试和发射火箭、卫星及航天器，包括我们为重复使用火箭和航天器所做的努力，涉及固有风险，可能因事故或设备故障导致人员伤亡、财产损失和环境损害或其他不利的环境影响。任何此类事件都可能造成重大损失，包括声誉损害和法律责任，这可能对我们的业务产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: The manufacturing, testing, launching, and recovery of our rockets, satellites, and spacecraft are complex activities that are conducted under challenging conditions and involve a high degree of risk. Our reusable vehicles will reenter Earth’s atmosphere and fly over populated land for extended periods, which carries inherent risks to populations in the event of failure, such as structural breakup, loss of control, or debris dispersal. Although we implement extensive safety protocols and operational safeguards designed to protect personnel and the public, these protocols and safeguards may not in all circumstances prevent exposure of our personnel and potentially members of the public to hazards such as explosions, structural failures or debris dispersal. A manufacturing defect, testing anomaly, launch failure, recovery incident, or similar event involving injury to humans, any human fatalities, property damage, or environmental damage or other adverse environmental impacts could result in substantial losses, including reputational harm and legal liability, which could have a material adverse effect on our business.
paras.zh: 我们火箭、卫星及航天器的制造、测试、发射和回收是在充满挑战的条件下开展的复杂活动，涉及高度风险。我们的可重复使用运载器将重返地球大气层并在人口稠密陆地上空长时间飞行，一旦发生故障，例如结构解体、失控或碎片散落，将对民众构成固有风险。尽管我们实施了旨在保护人员和公众的广泛安全规程和运营保障措施，但这些规程和保障措施未必能在所有情况下防止我们的人员以及可能的公众成员暴露于爆炸、结构失效或碎片散落等危险之中。制造缺陷、测试异常、发射失败、回收事故或涉及人员受伤、任何人员死亡、财产损失、环境损害或其他不利环境影响的类似事件，都可能造成重大损失，包括声誉损害和法律责任，这可能对我们的业务产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: **Although we are focused on the vertical integration of our businesses, we depend on third parties to manufacture and supply certain key components necessary for the provision of our launch, connectivity, and AI services, and any supply shortages or disruptions or failures in their performance could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **尽管我们专注于业务的垂直整合，但我们依赖第三方制造和供应提供发射、连接和 AI 服务所必需的某些关键组件，任何供应短缺或中断或其履约失败都可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: Disruptions in the supply chain for essential raw materials or components, challenges in the supplier qualification process, or increases in the prices of inputs could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects. Despite our supply chain being largely vertically integrated, our reliance on third-party manufacturers and suppliers for key components introduces risks related to supply chain continuity, quality assurance, and vendor performance. We depend on both domestic and international suppliers for certain specialized materials, components, and services that are essential to the production and operation of our launch vehicles, spacecraft, satellites, user terminals (including Starlink consumer terminals), AI segment and related infrastructure. Any failure or delay by these partners to deliver components in the required quantities, within specifications, or on schedule has in the past and may in the future adversely affect our production schedules, operational reliability, and our ability to meet contractual obligations. In addition, disruptions in the supply chain due to shortages, quality issues, natural disasters, geopolitical events, labor disputes, pandemics, epidemics, tariffs or trade restrictions, criminal activity (including terrorism, sabotage or cyberattacks) or other factors outside our control could result in significant delays, increased costs, or an inability to deliver products and services to customers in a timely and cost-effective manner. The process of qualifying new suppliers or transitioning to alternative vendors can be time-consuming and may not be successful, further increasing our exposure to supply chain interruptions. Furthermore, our limited pool of qualified vendors for certain critical products or services exposes us to increased pricing pressures and quality risks. In particular, certain materials and products that are key inputs in our Space, Connectivity, and AI segments are available from a limited number of suppliers, including sole or limited-source suppliers, and our direct chip suppliers are dependent on a concentrated group of advanced semiconductor fabrication facilities. For additional information regarding supply chain risk relating to our AI processors, please see “Our ability to scale our AI products relies on our terrestrial and orbital AI compute infrastructure, which depends on the availability of power, water, AI processors, and other critical components, and telecommunications services, and any shortages or disruptions thereof would materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.” The inability of these suppliers to deliver necessary components of the products in a timely manner and at prices, quality levels, and volumes acceptable to us, or interruptions in supply of materials or products on which these suppliers rely, could have an adverse effect on our ability to meet customer demands and contractual obligations, execute on our growth strategy, or manage our expenses or timelines as expected, which could adversely impact our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 关键原材料或组件的供应链中断、供应商资质认证流程中的挑战，或投入品价格上涨，均可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。尽管我们的供应链在很大程度上实现了垂直整合，但我们依赖第三方制造商和供应商提供关键组件，这带来了与供应链连续性、质量保证和供应商履约相关的风险。我们依赖国内和国际供应商提供某些专业材料、组件和服务，这些对我们的运载火箭、航天器、卫星、用户终端（包括 Starlink 消费级终端）、AI 板块及相关基础设施的生产和运营至关重要。这些合作伙伴未能或延迟按所需数量、规格或时间表交付组件，过去曾对我们的生产计划、运营可靠性及履行合同义务的能力造成不利影响，未来也可能如此。此外，因短缺、质量问题、自然灾害、地缘政治事件、劳资纠纷、大流行病、流行病、关税或贸易限制、犯罪活动（包括恐怖主义、破坏或网络攻击）或其他我们无法控制的因素导致的供应链中断，可能造成重大延误、成本增加，或无法以及时且具成本效益的方式向客户交付产品和服务。认证新供应商或过渡至替代供应商的过程可能耗时较长且未必成功，这进一步增加了我们面临供应链中断的风险。此外，对于某些关键产品或服务，我们合格供应商数量有限，这使我们面临更大的定价压力和质量风险。特别是，我们太空、连接和 AI 板块的某些关键投入材料和产品仅可从有限数量的供应商处获得，包括独家或有限来源供应商，且我们的直接芯片供应商依赖于一组集中的先进半导体制造设施。有关我们 AI 处理器相关供应链风险的更多信息，请参见“我们扩大 AI 产品规模的能力依赖于我们的地面和在轨 AI 算力基础设施，而该基础设施依赖于电力、水、AI 处理器和其他关键组件以及电信服务的可用性，任何短缺或中断都将对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。”若这些供应商无法以及时的方式、按我们可接受的价格、质量水平和数量交付产品的必要组件，或这些供应商所依赖的材料或产品供应中断，可能对我们满足客户需求和合同义务、执行增长战略或按预期管理开支或时间表的能力产生不利影响，进而可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。

paras.en: **Our ability to scale our AI products relies on our terrestrial and orbital AI compute infrastructure, which depends on the availability of power, water, AI processors, and other critical components, and telecommunications services, and any shortages or disruptions thereof would materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们扩展 AI 产品的能力依赖于我们的地面和轨道 AI 算力基础设施，而这又取决于电力、水、AI 处理器及其他关键组件以及电信服务的可用性，上述任何短缺或中断都将对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: Our ability to scale our data center infrastructure, which supports our AI segment, is increasingly constrained by the availability of power and water at economically feasible prices, long lead times, availability of materials, and changing regulatory requirements. For example, energy supply is constrained globally due to the significant increase in demand for, and limited availability of, energy to power AI compute, and significant water resources may be required for cooling large-scale data center operations. Securing this capacity can involve entering into complex, long-lead-time arrangements or proceeding with alternative sources of power generation, and water availability has become a critical consideration in data center site selection, development and operations. We currently rely significantly on natural gas and gas turbine technology to power our data center operations. As such, our ability to scale our infrastructure depends in part on our continued access to natural gas supply at economically feasible prices, the availability of gas turbines and related equipment, and the maintenance of a regulatory environment that permits and supports the use of natural gas for large-scale power generation. In addition, water scarcity, drought conditions, competition for local water resources, or regulatory restrictions on water use could limit our ability to obtain sufficient water for cooling, constrain data center cooling capacity, increase our costs, delay or limit expansion of our data center infrastructure, or require us to implement alternative cooling technologies that may be more costly or less available. Our AI products also rely on GPUs and other processors, servers, network equipment and other critical components sourced from third-party suppliers for use in our data centers. Manufacturing and supply of servers and network equipment for our technical infrastructure, particularly for GPUs and other specialized components, is limited to a small number of qualified suppliers. We do not have any long-term or other material contractual arrangements with our direct chip suppliers, instead procuring all of our GPUs on a purchase-order basis. Our direct chip suppliers are dependent on a concentrated group of advanced semiconductor fabrication facilities, or “fabs.” Any disruption to our upstream supply chain, including fab capacity constraints, manufacturing issues, shortages of raw materials such as silicon wafers or rare earth elements, geopolitical tensions affecting fab operations, or natural disasters impacting key fabrication regions, could limit our chip suppliers’ ability to fulfill our orders, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, and results of operations. Our ability to achieve orbital AI at scale depends on our ability to access a sufficient number of AI chips, significantly more than are currently available to us. While we expect to construct Terafab to address such supply constraints, Terafab may not be successful, in which case we may not have other sources of sufficient AI chips to meet our orbital AI compute demands. While Terafab is intended to expand our internal chip manufacturing capabilities and alleviate potential future AI chip shortages at SpaceX, particularly as we pursue orbital AI at scale, we expect to continue sourcing a significant portion of our compute hardware from third-party suppliers, and there can be no assurance that we will be able to achieve our objectives with respect to Terafab within the expected timeframes, or at all. While we have a framework agreement with Tesla, neither Tesla nor Intel are obligated to remain a part of the project, and we may not enter into any such definitive agreements. Our AI segment also relies on services from third-party telecommunications providers, including connectivity to the cloud, and internet bandwidth suppliers to provide uninterrupted and error-free services through their networks. We may be unable to obtain AI processors or other necessary components or telecommunications services at prices or volumes that are acceptable to us or in a timely manner. Our suppliers and telecommunications and internet service providers also serve other customers, including certain of our competitors, and such suppliers or providers may prioritize capacity for such other customers, increase prices on short notice, require onerous prepayments, or reduce or delay deliveries to us. Any failure by our suppliers and service providers to meet our cost, quality, volume, or delivery requirements, or any shortage or disruption in the supply of chips, telecommunications services or other components required for our AI segment, or any inability to secure sufficient power or water resources for data center operations, could result in service disruption or outages, delay critical data center or network infrastructure upgrades or expansions, impair our ability to train our AI models and meet customer demand for our AI segment products and materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and future prospects.
paras.zh: 我们扩展数据中心基础设施（该基础设施支撑我们的 AI 业务板块）的能力，正日益受到以下因素的制约：以经济可行的价格获取电力和水资源、较长的交付周期、材料的可获得性以及不断变化的监管要求。例如，由于为 AI 算力供电的能源需求大幅增长而供应有限，全球能源供应受到制约；大规模数据中心运营的冷却可能需要大量水资源。为确保获得这一容量，可能需要签订复杂的、交付周期较长的安排，或采用替代发电来源；而水资源的可获得性已成为数据中心选址、开发和运营中的关键考量因素。我们目前严重依赖天然气和燃气轮机技术为数据中心运营供电。因此，我们扩展基础设施的能力部分取决于我们能否持续以经济可行的价格获得天然气供应、燃气轮机及相关设备的可获得性，以及能否维持允许并支持将天然气用于大规模发电的监管环境。此外，水资源短缺、干旱状况、对当地水资源的竞争或对用水量的监管限制，可能限制我们获取足够冷却用水的能力、制约数据中心冷却容量、增加我们的成本、延迟或限制我们数据中心基础设施的扩张，或要求我们采用可能成本更高或可获得性更低的替代冷却技术。我们的 AI 产品还依赖从第三方供应商采购的 GPU 及其他处理器、服务器、网络设备和其他关键组件，用于我们的数据中心。为我们的技术基础设施制造和供应服务器及网络设备（尤其是 GPU 和其他专用组件）仅限于少数合格供应商。我们与直接芯片供应商之间没有任何长期或其他重大合同安排，而是全部以采购订单方式采购 GPU。我们的直接芯片供应商依赖于一组集中的先进半导体制造设施（即“晶圆厂”）。我们上游供应链的任何中断，包括晶圆厂产能限制、制造问题、硅晶圆或稀土元素等原材料短缺、影响晶圆厂运营的地缘政治紧张局势，或影响关键制造地区的自然灾害，都可能限制我们的芯片供应商履行我们订单的能力，从而可能对我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩产生重大不利影响。我们实现规模化轨道 AI 的能力取决于我们能否获得足够数量的 AI 芯片，其数量远超我们目前可获得的水平。尽管我们预期建设 Terafab 以应对此类供应制约，但 Terafab 可能无法成功，在此情况下，我们可能没有其他足够的 AI 芯片来源来满足我们的轨道 AI 算力需求。尽管 Terafab 旨在扩大我们的内部芯片制造能力并缓解 SpaceX 未来潜在的 AI 芯片短缺（尤其是在我们追求规模化轨道 AI 的过程中），我们预计仍将继续从第三方供应商采购相当大一部分算力硬件，且无法保证我们能够在预期时间框架内实现 Terafab 相关目标，或根本无法实现。尽管我们与 Tesla 签订了框架协议，但 Tesla 和 Intel 均无义务继续参与该项目，且我们可能不会签订任何此类最终协议。我们的 AI 业务板块还依赖第三方电信提供商（包括云连接）和互联网带宽供应商的服务，以通过其网络提供不间断且无差错的服务。我们可能无法以可接受的价格或数量、或及时地获得 AI 处理器或其他必要组件或电信服务。我们的供应商以及电信和互联网服务提供商也为其他客户（包括我们的某些竞争对手）提供服务，此类供应商或提供商可能优先为此类其他客户提供容量、在短时间内提价、要求苛刻的预付款，或减少或延迟向我们交付。我们的供应商和服务提供商未能满足我们的成本、质量、数量或交付要求，或我们的 AI 业务板块所需的芯片、电信服务或其他组件出现任何短缺或中断，或未能为数据中心运营获得足够的电力或水资源，均可能导致服务中断或停机、延迟关键数据中心或网络基础设施的升级或扩张、损害我们训练 AI 模型和满足客户对我们 AI 业务板块产品需求的能力，并对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: We also rely on third-party cloud compute providers for a portion of the compute used for our AI segment and may from time to time rely on third-party data center providers, which exposes us to several risks that are beyond our direct control, including vulnerability to outages, cooling capacity constraints, performance issues, and cyberattacks.
paras.zh: 我们还依赖第三方云计算服务商提供我们 AI 板块所使用的部分算力，并可能不时依赖第三方数据中心服务商，这使我们面临若干超出我们直接控制范围的风险，包括易受服务中断、冷却能力受限、性能问题及网络攻击的影响。

paras.en: We have non-cancellable, multi-year capacity commitments to cloud compute providers, requiring payment regardless of usage. A termination or lapse in service from third-party cloud compute and data center providers could expose us to service interruptions, significant delays, and additional expenses to re-architect products for a different provider. Additionally, in the event of nonperformance by us or our providers, or an industry downturn, we may incur liabilities, have excess capacity that we cannot easily redeploy, and fail to receive payments from our counterparties or customers.
paras.zh: 我们对云计算服务商负有不可撤销的多年期容量承诺，无论是否使用均需付款。第三方云计算及数据中心服务商终止或中断服务，可能使我们面临服务中断、重大延误，以及为更换服务商而重新架构产品所产生的额外费用。此外，若我们或我们的服务商未能履约，或出现行业下行，我们可能产生负债、拥有难以轻易重新部署的过剩容量，且无法从交易对手或客户处收到付款。

paras.en: **We face intense competition in the markets in which we operate, and while we have historically outperformed certain competitors in our Space and Connectivity segments, we may not continue to do so, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们在所经营的市场中面临激烈竞争，尽管我们历来在太空和连接板块的表现优于某些竞争对手，但我们可能无法持续保持这一优势，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。**

paras.en: The markets in which we operate are rapidly evolving and intensely competitive, and we face competition from a range of established and emerging companies, including large, well-capitalized technology companies and aerospace firms, including foreign competitors. Some competitors are investing significant capital to develop and deploy satellite constellations and related infrastructure that compete directly with our offerings, and companies based in China and other jurisdictions may benefit from government support, favorable regulatory environments, or strategic national prioritization.
paras.zh: 我们所经营的市场正在快速演变且竞争激烈，我们面临来自一系列成熟企业和新兴企业的竞争，包括资金雄厚的大型科技公司和航空航天企业，其中也包括外国竞争对手。部分竞争对手正投入大量资金开发和部署与我们的产品直接竞争的卫星星座及相关基础设施，而总部位于中国及其他司法辖区的企业可能受益于政府支持、有利的监管环境或国家战略优先安排。

paras.en: Some of our current and potential competitors, particularly in our AI segment, have greater financial, technical, manufacturing, or other resources than we do, and may devote more resources to the development and commercialization of competing products and services. Competitors may adopt more aggressive pricing, secure more favorable supplier or distribution arrangements, bundle services, form strategic alliances or otherwise take actions that enhance their competitive position in ways that could adversely affect our business. In certain markets, regulatory or geopolitical factors may result in preferential treatment for domestic competitors or otherwise limit our ability to compete effectively.
paras.zh: 我们部分现有和潜在竞争对手，尤其是在我们的 AI 板块，拥有比我们更雄厚的财务、技术、制造或其他资源，并可能将更多资源投入竞争性产品和服务的开发与商业化。竞争对手可能采取更激进的定价、争取更有利的供应商或分销安排、捆绑服务、组建战略联盟，或以其他方式采取行动增强其竞争地位，从而可能对我们的业务产生不利影响。在某些市场，监管或地缘政治因素可能导致对本土竞争对手的优待，或以其他方式限制我们有效竞争的能力。

paras.en: Competition continues to intensify as new technologies are developed and new entrants emerge. While we have historically outperformed certain competitors in aspects of our business, such as our Space and Connectivity segments, there can be no assurance that we will maintain this position.
paras.zh: 随着新技术不断开发和新的进入者涌现，竞争持续加剧。尽管我们历来在业务的某些方面（例如我们的太空和连接板块）表现优于某些竞争对手，但无法保证我们将保持这一地位。

paras.en: **We depend on our ability to recruit and retain employees who have advanced engineering and technical skills, and intense competition for such employees may increase costs and affect our ability to meet development and production timelines.**
paras.zh: **我们依赖于招募和留住具备先进工程和技术技能的员工的能力，而此类员工的激烈竞争可能增加成本并影响我们按期完成开发和生产的能力。**

paras.en: We depend on our ability to recruit and retain employees who have advanced engineering and technical skills and, in some cases, employees with the necessary national security clearances to perform under our government contracts or win new business. These employees are in great demand and are likely to remain a limited resource in the foreseeable future. The current tight labor market has adversely impacted our ability to recruit qualified personnel, including engineers, particularly with respect to our AI segment. Increased restrictions on the import or retention of foreign labor may also increase demand for engineering personnel and adversely impact our ability to hire and retain qualified personnel. Continued turnover may impact employee morale and create other challenges as we attempt to scale our AI business. In addition, significant amounts of time and resources are required to train technical and other personnel, and we have in the past lost and may in the future lose new employees to our competitors or other companies before we realize the benefit of our investment in recruiting and training them. Our ability to recruit and retain qualified employees depends on a number of things, including our ability to pay market compensation, provide opportunities for advancement, and secure visa sponsorships and work permits for qualified international candidates. If we are unable to recruit and retain a sufficient number of these employees, then our ability to maintain our competitiveness and grow our business could be negatively affected. In addition, because of the highly technical nature of our products and services, the loss of any significant number of our existing engineering personnel could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects. A significant portion of the talent pool for advanced engineering and technical roles is international, and changes in immigration laws or policies in the jurisdictions in which we operate could limit our ability to hire and retain such candidates and intensify competition for talent.
paras.zh: 我们依赖于招募和留住具备先进工程和技术技能的员工的能力，并在某些情况下依赖于拥有必要国家安全许可的员工，以便根据我们的政府合同履约或赢得新业务。这些员工需求旺盛，并且在可预见的未来很可能仍是一种有限的资源。当前紧张的劳动力市场已对我们招募合格人员（包括工程师）的能力造成不利影响，尤其是在我们的 AI 业务板块方面。对外国劳动力进口或留用的限制增加，也可能推高对工程人员的需求，并对我们招聘和留住合格人员的能力造成不利影响。在我们试图扩大 AI 业务规模的过程中，持续的人员流失可能影响员工士气并带来其他挑战。此外，培训技术人员和其他人员需要投入大量时间和资源，我们过去曾失去、未来也可能失去新员工，他们流向我们的竞争对手或其他公司，而我们尚未从招聘和培训他们的投资中获益。我们招募和留住合格员工的能力取决于诸多因素，包括我们支付市场水平薪酬的能力、提供晋升机会的能力，以及为合格的国际候选人获得签证担保和工作许可的能力。如果我们无法招募和留住足够数量的此类员工，那么我们维持竞争力和发展业务的能力可能会受到负面影响。此外，由于我们的产品和服务具有高度技术性，失去任何大量现有工程人员都可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。先进工程和技术岗位的人才库中有相当一部分是国际人才，我们经营所在司法辖区的移民法律或政策变化可能限制我们招聘和留住此类候选人的能力，并加剧人才竞争。

paras.en: **From time to time, we are involved in litigation, investigations, and other regulatory proceedings which could be costly, time-consuming, and divert management attention, materially adversely affecting our business.**
paras.zh: **我们不时涉及诉讼、调查和其他监管程序，这些事项可能成本高昂、耗时，并分散管理层的注意力，对我们的业务产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: From time to time, we have been and may in the future become involved in various legal proceedings relating to a variety of matters, including intellectual property, commercial, regulatory, product liability, employment, personal injury, class action, employee or contractor health and safety, environmental, whistleblower, securities and other litigation and claims, and governmental and other regulatory investigations and proceedings, including tax examinations. Additionally, our share price may be volatile and, in the past, companies that have experienced volatility in the market price of their stock have been subject to securities litigation, including class action litigation. Such matters could be costly, time-consuming, and divert management’s attention from executing our strategic initiatives and operating our business. The industries in which we operate have historically experienced significant litigation and regulatory scrutiny, and with our public profile, expanding operations and the novel nature of some of our offerings, including our AI solutions, we may face an increased risk of such actions. Litigation and regulatory proceedings are inherently unpredictable. Any adverse judgments, settlements, or regulatory penalties could result in substantial financial costs, reputational harm, and operational disruptions. Certain of our hardware products are new and relatively unproven. If a product defect were to arise, especially one leading to product liability claims, the resulting warranty and damage claims, together with any associated harm to our reputation, could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects. Even if we prevail in these matters, the defense and resolution of litigation and regulatory proceedings may require significant resources and management attention, which could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects. Additionally, the mere initiation of litigation or government inquiries, regardless of the outcome, could negatively impact investor confidence and our stock price. As we continue to innovate and pursue new commercial and government contracts, expand our product offerings, and enter new markets, the likelihood of facing legal and regulatory challenges may increase, further exposing us to these risks. Please refer to “Business—Legal Proceedings” and Note 17, Commitments and Contingencies, in our audited consolidated financial statements and Note 16, Commitments and Contingencies in our unaudited consolidated financial statements include elsewhere in this prospectus.
paras.zh: 我们不时已经并可能在未来卷入与各类事项相关的各种法律程序，包括知识产权、商业、监管、产品责任、雇佣、人身伤害、集体诉讼、员工或承包商健康与安全、环境、举报人、证券及其他诉讼与索赔，以及政府和其它监管调查与程序，包括税务检查。此外，我们的股价可能波动，且过去那些经历过股价波动的公司曾面临证券诉讼，包括集体诉讼。此类事项可能成本高昂、耗时，并分散管理层执行战略举措和经营业务的注意力。我们经营的行业历来面临大量诉讼和监管审查，加之我们的公众知名度、不断扩大的运营以及部分产品（包括我们的 AI 解决方案）的新颖性，我们可能面临此类诉讼风险增加。诉讼和监管程序本质上难以预测。任何不利判决、和解或监管处罚都可能造成重大财务成本、声誉损害和运营中断。我们的某些硬件产品是新的且相对未经检验。如果出现产品缺陷，尤其是导致产品责任索赔的缺陷，由此产生的保修和损害索赔，连同对我们声誉的任何相关损害，可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。即使我们在这些事项中胜诉，诉讼和监管程序的抗辩与解决也可能需要大量资源和管理层关注，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。此外，仅仅启动诉讼或政府调查，无论结果如何，都可能对投资者信心和我们股价产生负面影响。随着我们持续创新并寻求新的商业和政府合同、扩展产品供应并进入新市场，面临法律和监管挑战的可能性可能增加，使我们进一步暴露于这些风险。请参阅本招股说明书其他部分的“业务——法律程序”、我们经审计合并财务报表中的附注 17“承诺与或有事项”，以及我们未经审计合并财务报表中的附注 16“承诺与或有事项”。

paras.en: **Any significant disruption in, or unauthorized access to, our computer and data systems or those of third parties that we utilize in our operations could result in a loss or degradation of service, loss of trust in us and harm to our business.**
paras.zh: **我们的计算机和数据系统，或我们在运营中使用的第三方计算机和数据系统，若发生任何重大中断或未经授权的访问，可能导致服务丢失或降级、对我们的信任丧失以及对我们的业务造成损害。**

paras.en: An operational disruption in, or unauthorized access to, our computer and data systems or those of third parties that we utilize in our operations could compromise sensitive (including classified or otherwise government-controlled), proprietary, confidential, or personal information, impede operations, and result in financial losses, legal liabilities, reputational harm, and erosion of our competitive position in launch services, space-based internet, and mobile phone services. Our business depends on the continuous and secure operation of our information technology systems and infrastructure, including those that support our launch operations, manufacturing facilities, Starlink services, government services, employee databases, and mission-critical communications. Our systems and infrastructure may also be subject to cyberattacks, including sophisticated hacking attempts by nation-states, state-sponsored actors, cybercriminals, or other malicious third parties, which could result in unauthorized access to, disruption of, or degradation of our satellite systems, ground infrastructure, or data networks. Such disruptions or unauthorized access, which may result from a wide variety of incidents or activities, including inadvertent compromises arising from process, coding or human errors, cyberattacks, data breaches, exploitation of known or unknown software or hardware vulnerabilities, malware, ransomware, credential harvesting, computer viruses, social engineering (such as phishing), denial of service attacks, software or hardware failure, or other malicious or disruptive incidents or activities—whether perpetrated by external actors, including nation-states, state-sponsored organizations, or cybercriminal groups, insiders, or other threat actors, any of whom may see their efforts enhanced by the use of AI —could lead to the theft, destruction, or unauthorized disclosure of sensitive (including classified or otherwise government-controlled), proprietary, confidential or personal information, including technical data, customer or partner information, and intellectual property, particularly because some of our products and services involve the collection, storage, and processing of such data and information. Our development and deployment of AI models, internal and third-party AI tools, and other AI applications expose us to increased and novel risks and vulnerabilities, including prompt injection, hallucinations, errors, and other issues related to AI agents, as well as the risk of compromise of valuable intellectual property including source code, model weights, and other assets. Certain internal and external threat actors, such as nation-states, state-sponsored organizations, organized threat networks and corporate espionage actors, among others have and will continue to sustain malicious activities for extended periods and deploy significant resources to attempt, and in some cases succeed, at causing significant disruptions in, or unauthorized access to, our computer systems or those of third parties that we utilize in our operations. Such incidents have in the past and may in the future also disrupt or degrade our ability to design, produce, launch, or manage our products and services, resulting in operational delays, violations of applicable data privacy and cybersecurity laws and regulations, disruptions in, or unauthorized access to, our customers’ computer systems, increased costs, loss of revenue, loss of trust, litigation or regulatory penalties.
paras.zh: 我们运营中所使用的计算机和数据系统或第三方系统若发生运营中断或遭未经授权访问，可能危及敏感信息（包括机密信息或其他受政府管控的信息）、专有信息、保密信息或个人信息，妨碍运营，并导致财务损失、法律责任、声誉损害，以及削弱我们在发射服务、天基互联网和移动电话服务领域的竞争地位。我们的业务依赖于信息技术系统和基础设施的持续、安全运行，包括支持我们发射运营、制造设施、Starlink 服务、政府服务、员工数据库和关键任务通信的系统和基础设施。我们的系统和基础设施还可能遭受网络攻击，包括民族国家、国家支持的行为体、网络犯罪分子或其他恶意第三方实施的复杂黑客攻击，这可能导致我们的卫星系统、地面基础设施或数据网络遭到未经授权访问、中断或性能下降。此类中断或未经授权访问可能源于多种事件或活动，包括因流程、编码或人为错误导致的意外泄露、网络攻击、数据泄露、利用已知或未知的软件或硬件漏洞、恶意软件、勒索软件、凭据窃取、计算机病毒、社会工程（如网络钓鱼）、拒绝服务攻击、软件或硬件故障，或其他恶意或破坏性事件或活动——无论实施者是外部行为体（包括民族国家、国家支持的組織或网络犯罪团伙）、内部人员还是其他威胁行为体，其中任何一方的行动都可能因使用 AI 而得到增强——可能导致敏感信息（包括机密信息或其他受政府管控的信息）、专有信息、保密信息或个人信息（包括技术数据、客户或合作伙伴信息以及知识产权）被窃取、销毁或未经授权披露，尤其是因为我们的一些产品和服务涉及此类数据和信息的收集、存储和处理。我们对 AI 模型的开发和部署、内部和第三方 AI 工具以及其他 AI 应用，使我们面临更多且新型的风险和漏洞，包括提示注入、幻觉、错误以及与 AI 代理相关的其他问题，以及宝贵知识产权（包括源代码、模型权重和其他资产）遭到侵害的风险。某些内部和外部威胁行为体，如民族国家、国家支持的組織、有组织威胁网络和企业间谍行为体等，已经并将继续长期维持恶意活动，并投入大量资源试图——且在某些情况下成功——造成我们计算机系统或我们运营中所使用的第三方计算机系统的重大中断或未经授权访问。此类事件过去已经并可能在未来扰乱或削弱我们设计、生产、发射或管理产品和服务的能力，导致运营延迟、违反适用的数据隐私和网络安全法律法规、客户计算机系统中断或遭未经授权访问、成本增加、收入损失、信任丧失、诉讼或监管处罚。

paras.en: As the scale, frequency, sophistication, or intensity of cyber and data privacy threats continue to evolve, and as our reliance on interconnected systems and third-party vendors grows, we remain exposed to vulnerabilities despite our efforts to implement security measures, monitoring, and incident response protocols. There can be no assurance that our cybersecurity risk management processes, including our policies, procedures, and controls, will be effective in promptly or effectively detecting, containing, or remediating cybersecurity attacks. Any significant security and data breach or system failure could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects, and could result in loss of trust among customers, regulators, government agencies, and partners. Furthermore, our efforts to investigate, mitigate, contain, and remediate the harm caused by a significant disruption in, or unauthorized access to, our computer and data systems or those of third parties that we utilize in our operations may be costly and time-consuming and may not be successful, and we may make errors or fail to take necessary actions. Remediation efforts, litigation, regulatory investigations, and compliance obligations (including obligations to notify appropriate regulators and affected parties) arising from such incidents could require substantial management attention and resources, and we rely on our own funds to cover such losses or liabilities. In addition, rapid changes to U.S. and international cybersecurity and privacy laws and regulations have expanded regulatory regimes and compliance requirements, and regulators continue to undertake enforcement actions in these areas. We expect the regulatory environment to grow more complicated, which may increase our operational and compliance expenditures, as well as those of our suppliers. Moreover, some third parties we utilize in our operations may receive or store information provided by us or by our customers. If these third parties fail to adopt or adhere to adequate data privacy and security practices, or their systems or networks are breached in the manner described above, our data or our customers’ data may be improperly accessed, used, or disclosed to unauthorized recipients, which could result in financial losses, legal liabilities, reputational harm, and additional compliance obligations. We do not control the privacy and cybersecurity measures put in place by such third parties, and any contractual protections with such third parties, such as obligations to indemnify us, if any, may be ineffective or otherwise inadequate.
paras.zh: 随着网络与数据隐私威胁的规模、频率、复杂程度或强度不断演变，以及我们对互联系统和第三方供应商的依赖日益加深，尽管我们努力实施安全措施、监控和事件响应协议，我们仍面临漏洞风险。无法保证我们的网络安全风险管理流程（包括我们的政策、程序和管控措施）能够及时或有效地检测、遏制或修复网络安全攻击。任何重大的安全与数据泄露或系统故障都可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营成果和未来前景产生重大不利影响，并可能导致客户、监管机构、政府机构和合作伙伴对我们失去信任。此外，我们为调查、缓解、遏制和修复因我们的计算机和数据系统或我们在运营中所使用的第三方系统遭受重大中断或未经授权访问所造成的损害而付出的努力可能成本高昂且耗时，且可能不会成功，我们还可能犯错或未能采取必要行动。此类事件引发的修复工作、诉讼、监管调查和合规义务（包括通知相关监管机构和受影响方的义务）可能需耗费大量管理层精力和资源，且我们依赖自有资金来覆盖此类损失或负债。此外，美国和国际网络安全与隐私法律法规的快速变化扩大了监管制度和合规要求，监管机构继续在这些领域采取执法行动。我们预计监管环境将变得更加复杂，这可能增加我们以及我们供应商的运营和合规支出。此外，我们在运营中使用的一些第三方可能会接收或存储我们或我们的客户提供的信息。如果这些第三方未能采取或遵守适当的数据隐私和安全实践，或其系统或网络以上述方式遭到入侵，我们的数据或我们客户的数据可能会被不当访问、使用或披露给未经授权的接收方，这可能导致财务损失、法律责任、声誉损害和额外的合规义务。我们无法控制此类第三方所采取的隐私和网络安全措施，与此类第三方签订的任何合同保护（例如对我们进行赔偿的义务，如有）可能无效或不够充分。

paras.en: **The development and maintenance of the technologies and infrastructure necessary to support our current and future operations will require significant capital expenditures, and if we are unable to generate sufficient cash flow from operations or obtain additional financing on acceptable terms, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects could be materially and adversely affected.**
paras.zh: **开发和维护支持我们当前和未来运营所需的技术和基础设施将需要大量资本支出，如果我们无法从运营中产生足够的现金流或以可接受的条款获得额外融资，我们的业务、财务状况、经营成果和未来前景可能会受到重大不利影响。**

paras.en: Our business requires substantial capital expenditures to design, develop, expand, and maintain our technologies and infrastructure to support our operations. For example, we have incurred significant capital expenditures and expect to increase our capital expenditures substantially in the future in connection with the design, development, and deployment of our satellite constellations, launch vehicles, ground stations, manufacturing facilities, and programs, including Terafab, AI compute infrastructure, data centers, and other supporting infrastructure. These expenditures include, but are not limited to, costs associated with research and development, construction and expansion of production capabilities, acquisition of property and equipment, and ongoing maintenance and upgrades to ensure reliability and competitiveness. In particular, the development, testing, and deployment of Starship in accordance with our anticipated schedule, as well as our pursuit of orbital AI, other space-related services, and lunar and interplanetary missions, will require the investment of significant additional capital resources. In addition, we have made and intend to continue to make substantial capital expenditures to support the growth of our AI products, including costs related to obtaining third-party GPUs, manufacturing our own GPUs, and constructing, leasing, maintaining, enhancing, and expanding our data centers. We may choose to increase or accelerate the pace of any of these investments at any time, which could result in periods of reduced profitability or increased losses as we prioritize long-term growth over near-term financial performance. Many of the products and services that are important for our growth prospects are novel and untested, and therefore our estimates of capital expenditures may prove to be inaccurate.
paras.zh: 我们的业务需要大量资本支出，用于设计、开发、扩展和维护我们的技术与基础设施，以支持我们的运营。例如，我们已发生重大资本支出，并预计未来将大幅增加资本支出，用于设计和开发及部署我们的卫星星座、运载火箭、地面站、制造设施和项目，包括 Terafab、AI 算力基础设施、数据中心及其他配套基础设施。这些支出包括但不限于与研发、生产能力的建设与扩建、购置物业和设备以及为确保可靠性和竞争力而进行的持续维护和升级相关的成本。特别是，按照我们预期的时间表开发、测试和部署 Starship，以及我们推进轨道 AI、其他太空相关服务以及月球和行星际任务，都将需要投入大量额外资本资源。此外，我们已进行并打算继续进行大量资本支出，以支持我们 AI 产品的增长，包括与获取第三方 GPU、制造我们自己的 GPU，以及建设、租赁、维护、增强和扩展我们的数据中心相关的成本。我们可能随时选择增加或加快任何此类投资的步伐，这可能导致利润率下降或亏损增加的时期，因为我们将长期增长置于近期财务表现之上。许多对我们增长前景至关重要的产品和服务是新颖且未经检验的，因此我们对资本支出的估计可能被证明是不准确的。

paras.en: If we raise additional capital through further issuances of equity or convertible debt securities, our shareholders could suffer significant dilution and any new equity securities we issue could have rights, preferences, and privileges superior to those of holders of our Class A common stock.
