The agreements governing our indebtedness contain various restrictive covenants and any additional debt financing secured by us in the future could involve restrictive covenants relating to our capital-raising activities and other financial and operational matters, which could limit our operational flexibility and make it more difficult for us to obtain additional capital and to pursue business opportunities. Our ability to access the capital markets or secure other sources of financing may be adversely affected by factors beyond our control, including fluctuations in market conditions, changes in investor sentiment, increases in interest rates, or adverse events affecting the broader industry or economy.
paras.zh: 如果我们通过进一步发行股权或可转换债务证券来筹集额外资本，我们的股东可能会遭受重大稀释，我们发行的任何新股权证券可能拥有优于我们 A 类普通股持有人的权利、优先权和特权。管辖我们债务的协议包含各种限制性契约，我们未来获得的任何额外债务融资可能涉及与我们的融资活动及其他财务和运营事项相关的限制性契约，这可能限制我们的运营灵活性，并使我们在获取额外资本和寻求商业机会方面更加困难。我们进入资本市场或获得其他融资来源的能力可能受到我们无法控制的因素的不利影响，包括市场状况波动、投资者情绪变化、利率上升或影响更广泛行业或经济的不利事件。

paras.en: **Our substantial level of indebtedness could materially adversely affect our financial condition.**
paras.zh: **我们庞大的债务水平可能对我们的财务状况产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: We have significant indebtedness that could materially adversely affect our business by increasing our vulnerability to general adverse economic and industry conditions; requiring us to dedicate a substantial portion of our cash flow from operations to payments on our indebtedness, thereby reducing the availability of our cash flow to fund operations, our growth strategy, product development and strategic initiatives; limiting our flexibility in planning for, or reacting to, changes in our business and the industry in which we operate; and exposing us to the risk of increased interest rates as our borrowings are, and may in the future be, at variable interest rates. As of March 31, 2026, we had total principal indebtedness outstanding of $29,132 million. Our substantial indebtedness may also adversely affect our credit ratings or outlook, which may increase our cost of capital, limit our access to financing, and impair our ability to obtain additional financing on acceptable terms, or at all. The occurrence of any one of these events could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, and financial condition, and ability to satisfy our obligations under the agreements governing our indebtedness. If we fail to comply with the terms of our debt agreements, our lenders could declare a default and accelerate our repayment obligations, which could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 我们背负着重大债务，这可能对我们的业务产生重大不利影响：增加我们对总体不利经济和行业状况的脆弱性；要求我们将经营现金流的相当一部分用于偿还债务，从而减少可用于为运营、增长战略、产品开发和战略举措提供资金的现金流；限制我们在规划或应对业务及所处行业变化方面的灵活性；以及使我们面临利率上升的风险，因为我们的借款目前按浮动利率计息，未来也可能如此。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们的未偿债务本金总额为 $29,132 million。我们的重大债务还可能对我们的信用评级或评级展望产生不利影响，这可能提高我们的资本成本、限制我们获得融资的渠道，并损害我们以可接受的条件获得额外融资的能力，甚至完全无法获得。上述任何一项事件的发生，都可能对我们的业务、经营业绩和财务状况，以及我们履行债务协议项下义务的能力产生重大不利影响。如果我们未能遵守债务协议的条款，我们的贷款人可能宣布违约并加速我们的还款义务，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: **Our future revenue and operating results depend upon our ability to develop new technologies and respond to changes in customer demands and industry standards in highly competitive markets, and if we are unable to do so, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects may be materially and adversely affected.**
paras.zh: **我们未来的收入和经营业绩取决于我们能否在高度竞争的市场中开发新技术并应对客户需求和行业标准的变化；如果我们无法做到这一点，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景可能受到重大不利影响。**

paras.en: Our future revenue growth and operating results are highly dependent on our ability to design, develop and successfully commercialize new and innovative technologies, products, and services on a timely and cost-effective basis. The markets in which we operate are characterized by rapid and disruptive technological change, evolving industry standards, the emergence of new and well-funded competitors, frequent new product and service introductions, changing customer demands and regulatory changes. In addition, we may expand into new markets, which may lead to similar or additional challenges that we cannot foresee and may require novel innovations to navigate or overcome. As a result, we may from time to time rapidly adjust, modify or change our strategic priorities, capital allocation, product or service focus or operational initiatives across our business in response to these other changes or new markets. In particular, the AI industry is nascent, highly competitive, capital intensive and rapidly changing. There are a number of companies today that develop or may develop products or services that compete with our AI segment, and new competitors may emerge over time. Some of our current or potential competitors in the AI market are large technology companies that have significant financial, technical and marketing resources, and in some cases greater access to data, and others are smaller specialized companies that possess specialized expertise and may have greater flexibility than we do. We also have a limited number of customers for our AI products when compared to certain of our competitors. Current and potential competitors have established, or may in the future establish, cooperative relationships among themselves or with third parties to increase the ability of their AI technologies to address the needs of current and prospective users of our AI products. Furthermore, current or prospective users may decide to develop competing products for particular use cases or to establish strategic relationships with our competitors for such use cases. Current and potential competitors and bad actors, may also attempt to reverse engineer or otherwise replicate our AI technology, including through model extraction or distillation techniques. Increased competition with our AI products could result in price reductions, revenue shortfalls, loss of customers and loss of market share, which may harm our business, financial condition results of operations and future prospects.
paras.zh: 我们未来的收入增长和经营业绩高度依赖于我们能否及时且具有成本效益地设计、开发并成功商业化新的创新技术、产品和服务。我们经营所在的市场具有快速且颠覆性技术变革、行业标准不断演变、资金雄厚的新竞争对手涌现、新产品和服务频繁推出、客户需求不断变化以及监管变化等特点。此外，我们可能拓展至新市场，这可能带来我们无法预见的类似或额外挑战，并可能需要新颖的创新来应对或克服。因此，我们可能不时快速调整、修改或改变我们的战略优先级、资本配置、产品或服务重点或整个业务的运营举措，以应对这些其他变化或新市场。特别是，AI 行业尚处于早期阶段，竞争激烈、资本密集且变化迅速。目前有多家公司开发或可能开发与我们的 AI 板块相竞争的产品或服务，且随着时间推移可能出现新的竞争对手。我们在 AI 市场的一些当前或潜在竞争对手是拥有大量财务、技术和营销资源的大型科技公司，在某些情况下能获取更多数据，另一些则是拥有专业专长且可能比我们更具灵活性的较小专业公司。与某些竞争对手相比，我们 AI 产品的客户数量也有限。当前和潜在竞争对手已经建立或未来可能建立彼此之间或与第三方的合作关系，以增强其 AI 技术满足我们 AI 产品当前和潜在用户需求的能力。此外，当前或潜在用户可能决定针对特定用例开发竞争产品，或针对此类用例与我们的竞争对手建立战略关系。当前和潜在竞争对手以及恶意行为者也可能试图对我们的 AI 技术进行逆向工程或以其他方式复制，包括通过模型提取或蒸馏技术。我们 AI 产品竞争的加剧可能导致价格下降、收入不足、客户流失和市场份额丧失，这可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景。

paras.en: In our Connectivity segment, including Starlink broadband and Starlink Mobile, we face competition from terrestrial fixed network providers, mobile network operators, and other satellite providers, and our services may be less competitive in certain markets, including dense urban areas where terrestrial fiber and wireless networks may offer higher capacity, lower cost, or more consistent performance. In addition, our Starlink Mobile offering operates in a highly competitive and evolving market, and may be affected by the pace of technological development, spectrum availability, and the success of our partnerships with mobile carriers. In addition, the X platform faces intense competition from social media, messaging and media companies and traditional media outlets, such as television, radio and print, for advertising budgets. Advertisers generally do not have long-term commitments to the X platform and may reduce or discontinue their advertising spending for a variety of reasons outside our control. We are expending resources to improve the X platform and improve its attractiveness to users and advertisers. While we have introduced new user interface enhancements, algorithm updates, and other product features, improvements to the X platform, introducing new products and services on the X platform and other initiatives may be costly and difficult to implement, and we cannot be sure that they will be positively received by users, content creators, or advertisers, or provide positive returns on our investment. Losing users who migrate to other platforms may negatively impact our potential subscription or advertising revenue. Additionally, if users do not continue to contribute content and otherwise engage with the X platform, we are unable to provide users with valuable and timely content, or if content that is considered to be problematic or offensive is made available on the X platform, the size of the X platform’s user base and their engagement may decline, leading to a decline in monetizable usage and the loss of potential subscription revenue from such users, and the X platform may experience brand or reputational harm. A decline in users on the X platform, or the volume or quality of their content on the X platform, could also impact the ongoing development of our AI product, which in part utilizes data and user-generated content from the X platform. We plan to publicly launch the Money product on the X platform (the “Money Product”); however, we are competing against large, established companies with significantly greater resources and market presence than us. If we are unable to anticipate technological trends, respond to technological advancements or changing customer demands, or successfully develop and commercialize new or enhanced offerings, we may be unable to establish or maintain a meaningful market position and our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects could be materially and adversely affected.
paras.zh: 在我们的连接业务板块（包括 Starlink 宽带和 Starlink 移动）中，我们面临来自地面固定网络提供商、移动网络运营商以及其他卫星提供商的竞争，且我们的服务在部分市场可能竞争力较弱，包括地面光纤和无线网络可能提供更高容量、更低成本或更稳定性能的密集城区。此外，我们的 Starlink 移动产品所处市场竞争激烈且不断演变，可能受到技术发展速度、频谱可用性以及我们与移动运营商合作成效的影响。此外，X 平台在广告预算方面面临来自社交媒体、消息和媒体公司以及传统媒体渠道（如电视、广播和平面媒体）的激烈竞争。广告主通常对 X 平台没有长期承诺，并可能因我们无法控制的各种原因减少或停止其广告支出。我们正在投入资源以改进 X 平台并提升其对用户和广告主的吸引力。尽管我们已推出新的用户界面增强功能、算法更新及其他产品特性、对 X 平台的改进、在 X 平台上推出新产品和服务以及其他举措，但这些可能成本高昂且难以实施，我们无法确定它们是否会受到用户、内容创作者或广告主的正面评价，或为我们的投资带来正回报。用户流失至其他平台可能对我们的潜在订阅或广告收入产生负面影响。此外，如果用户不再继续贡献内容或以其他方式参与 X 平台，我们便无法为用户提供有价值且及时的内容；或者如果被认为有问题或冒犯性的内容出现在 X 平台上，X 平台的用户规模及其参与度可能下降，导致可变现使用量减少以及来自此类用户的潜在订阅收入损失，且 X 平台可能遭受品牌或声誉损害。X 平台用户数量或其内容数量或质量的下降，也可能影响我们 AI 产品的持续开发，该产品部分利用来自 X 平台的数据和用户生成内容。我们计划在 X 平台上公开发布 Money 产品（「Money 产品」）；然而，我们正与资源及市场影响力远超我们的大型成熟公司竞争。如果我们无法预见技术趋势、应对技术进步或不断变化的客户需求，或成功开发并商业化新的或增强的产品，我们可能无法建立或维持有意义的市场地位，且我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景可能受到重大不利影响。

paras.en: **The estimates of future market opportunity and forecasts of market growth, and our ability to capture such markets, included in this prospectus may prove to be inaccurate.**
paras.zh: **本招股说明书中包含的未来市场机会估计和市场增长预测，以及我们把握此类市场的能力，可能被证明是不准确的。**

paras.en: Our estimates for the total addressable market for our Space, Connectivity and AI businesses, as well as estimates regarding the growth of AI and its impacts, contained elsewhere in this prospectus are based on a number of internal and third-party estimates. For example, our estimates of market opportunity for our Space, Connectivity and AI businesses rely in part on third-party data and a number of internal assumptions. With respect to our Space segment, these estimates rely in part on estimates published by Novaspace regarding the size of the global market for space-enabled solutions, including spacecraft manufacturing, launch services and related activities. Our connectivity market estimates are based in part on estimates of the number of households, businesses, aircraft and maritime vessels globally derived from third-party sources, together with assumptions regarding ARPU and monthly service revenue derived from third-party industry data and our internal expectations regarding pricing, adoption rates and service penetration across different geographic regions and economic environments. Our AI market estimates are based in part on projections of global data center compute demand from third-party sources, including estimates published by RAND Corporation, together with internal assumptions regarding the portion of global compute capacity that may be utilized for AI workloads and other operational assumptions such as power usage, utilization rates and pricing.
paras.zh: 我们在本招股说明书其他部分所载的关于我们太空、连接和 AI 业务的总可寻址市场的估计，以及关于 AI 增长及其影响的估计，均基于若干内部及第三方估计。例如，我们对太空、连接和 AI 业务市场机会的估计部分依赖于第三方数据和若干内部假设。就我们的太空业务板块而言，这些估计部分依赖于 Novaspace 发布的关于太空赋能解决方案（包括航天器制造、发射服务及相关活动）全球市场规模的估计。我们的连接市场估计部分基于从第三方来源得出的全球家庭、企业、飞机和海事船舶数量的估计，以及基于第三方行业数据得出的关于 ARPU 和月度服务收入的假设，以及我们对不同地理区域和经济环境下定价、采用率和服务渗透率的内部预期。我们的 AI 市场估计部分基于第三方来源对全球数据中心算力需求的预测，包括 RAND Corporation 发布的估计，以及关于全球算力容量中可能用于 AI 工作负载的比例的内部假设，以及其他运营假设，如电力使用、利用率和定价。

paras.en: These estimates require us to make numerous assumptions and judgments regarding factors that are inherently uncertain and subject to change, including the pace of technological development, future demand for launch, connectivity and AI services, the rate of adoption of satellite connectivity and AI technologies, the availability and cost of power and computing hardware, the evolution of regulatory frameworks, and broader macroeconomic conditions.
paras.zh: 这些估计要求我们就本质上不确定且可能变化的因素作出大量假设和判断，包括技术发展速度、对发射、连接和 AI 服务的未来需求、卫星连接和 AI 技术的采用率、电力和计算硬件的可用性及成本、监管框架的演变以及更广泛的宏观经济状况。

paras.en: While we believe our assumptions and the data underlying our estimates are reasonable, these assumptions and estimates may not be correct and the conditions supporting our assumptions or estimates may change at any time, thereby reducing the predictive accuracy of these underlying factors. As a result, our estimates of the total addressable market for our services, as well as the expected growth rate for the total addressable market for our services, may prove to be inaccurate.
paras.zh: 尽管我们认为我们的假设及估计所依据的数据是合理的，但这些假设和估计可能并不正确，支持我们假设或估计的条件也可能随时发生变化，从而降低这些基础因素的预测准确性。因此，我们对我们服务总可寻址市场的估计，以及对我们服务总可寻址市场预期增长率的估计，可能被证明是不准确的。

paras.en: **Many of our initiatives, including those to develop orbital AI compute at scale, manufacture AI chips at scale, establish a lunar economy, develop human augmentation systems, and transport humans and cargo to the Moon and Mars, involve significant technical complexity, unproven technologies, or technologies that do not exist or may require significant advancement, and such initiatives may not achieve commercial viability.**
paras.zh: **我们的许多举措，包括大规模开发轨道 AI 算力、大规模制造 AI 芯片、建立月球经济、开发人类增强系统以及将人员和货物运送至月球和火星的举措，涉及重大的技术复杂性、未经证实的技术，或尚不存在或可能需要重大进展的技术，且此类举措可能无法实现商业可行性。**

paras.en: Our initiatives to develop orbital AI compute at scale, establish a lunar economy, develop human augmentation systems, and transport humans and cargo to the Moon and Mars are in early stages of conception, design and development and have not yet been proven at commercial scale, or at all, and may ultimately be unsuccessful. In particular, the timeline for these initiatives, and the launch cadence required to achieve them may be difficult or impossible to determine. These efforts require substantial and ongoing investments of financial, technical, and human resources over extended time horizons, including, but not limited to, research and development, testing, infrastructure, regulatory approvals, and mission execution. The technologies, systems, and operational capabilities required for each of these initiatives involve significant technical complexity and are subject to design, engineering, and performance risks, many of which may only become apparent as development and testing progress. Many of these technologies, systems and operational capabilities are novel and untested, and we expect to incur significant capital expenditures over a period of years before our AI products and services and other strategic initiatives, including AI compute infrastructure and in-orbit, lunar, and interplanetary industrialization efforts, become profitable, which may never occur. In addition, in-orbit refueling of Starship is essential to our lunar, Mars, asteroid mining, and other deep space ambitions beyond geostationary Earth orbit. In-orbit refueling is complex, and we have not yet demonstrated or attempted it. We may not be able to develop, commercialize, scale, or successfully implement these or other strategic initiatives on the timelines we currently anticipate, or at all. Furthermore, the viability of orbital AI compute depends in part on the cost advantages of solar energy relative to existing terrestrial energy sources. To the extent that breakthrough developments in terrestrial energy access, such as advances in nuclear energy, significantly reduce energy costs or alleviate infrastructure constraints, the viability of our orbital AI compute infrastructure may be materially diminished. Even if our orbital AI compute infrastructure proves to be commercially viable, a material slowdown in the growth of AI applications and related compute demand could result in existing terrestrial data centers sufficiently meeting such demand, thereby reducing the need for our orbital AI compute infrastructure. As a result, we may be required to devote financial, technical, human or other resources in excess of our current expectations, and there can be no assurance that these investments will generate adequate revenue, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 我们在大规模开发轨道 AI 算力、建立月球经济、开发人类增强系统以及将人员和货物运送至月球和火星方面的各项举措尚处于构想、设计和开发的早期阶段，尚未在商业规模上得到验证，甚至完全未经验证，最终可能无法成功。特别是，这些举措的时间表以及实现这些目标所需的发射频率可能难以或无法确定。这些工作需要我们在较长的时间跨度内持续投入大量财务、技术和人力资源，包括但不限于研发、测试、基础设施、监管审批和任务执行。上述各项举措所需的技术、系统和运营能力涉及重大的技术复杂性，并面临设计、工程和性能风险，其中许多风险可能只有在开发和测试推进过程中才会显现。上述许多技术、系统和运营能力均为新颖且未经检验，我们预计将在数年时间内产生大量资本支出，之后我们的 AI 产品和服务以及其他战略举措（包括 AI 算力基础设施以及在轨、月球和行星际工业化努力）才可能实现盈利，而盈利可能永远不会实现。此外，星舰的在轨加注对于我们在地球同步轨道以外的月球、火星、小行星采矿及其他深空雄心至关重要。在轨加注十分复杂，我们尚未演示或尝试过。我们可能无法在我们目前预期的时间表内开发、商业化、规模化或成功实施这些或其他战略举措，甚至完全无法实现。此外，轨道 AI 算力的可行性部分取决于太阳能相对于现有地面能源的成本优势。如果地面能源获取方面出现突破性进展（例如核能领域的进步）显著降低能源成本或缓解基础设施制约，我们轨道 AI 算力基础设施的可行性可能会被实质性削弱。即使我们的轨道 AI 算力基础设施被证明具有商业可行性，AI 应用及相关算力需求增长的大幅放缓也可能导致现有地面数据中心足以满足此类需求，从而降低对我们轨道 AI 算力基础设施的需求。因此，我们可能需要投入超出当前预期的财务、技术、人力或其他资源，且无法保证这些投资将产生足够的收入，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。

paras.en: **Several of our anticipated market opportunities, including certain AI, orbital, lunar, and interplanetary transportation and industrial activities, are still emerging and evolving or do not currently exist, and such markets may not develop as we expect, or at all.**
paras.zh: **我们预期的若干市场机会（包括某些 AI、轨道、月球和行星际运输及工业活动）仍处于新兴和演进阶段，或目前尚不存在，此类市场可能不会如我们预期般发展，甚至完全不会发展。**

paras.en: A portion of our anticipated market opportunities is associated with industries described in the section entitled “Business—Future Markets.” Certain of these industries, such as space tourism, human augmentation, and cargo transport to the Moon, are still emerging. Others, including in-orbit manufacturing, passenger transport to the Moon, an established human presence or gateway hub on the Moon, passenger and cargo transport to Mars, energy production on the Moon or Mars, manufacturing capabilities on the Moon or Mars, and asteroid mining do not exist today. Any estimate we make regarding the size or timing of our anticipated market opportunities is inherently uncertain and necessarily involves significant assumptions about future customer demand, adoption, technological development, regulatory conditions and the emergence of a broader commercial market that does not currently exist. While we believe these industries will develop over time, the manner in which they emerge, including the timing of commercialization, the scale and pace of adoption, and the applicable technical, regulatory, geopolitical and economic frameworks may differ materially from our current expectations. If these industries do not develop, develop on slower timelines, at smaller scales, or under different economic or regulatory conditions than we anticipate, this could require us to modify, delay, or abandon certain of our business plans, or cause such plans not to develop at all, which could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 我们预期市场机会的一部分与“业务——未来市场”一节所述行业相关。其中某些行业，如太空旅游、人体增强以及向月球运输货物，仍处于新兴阶段。其他行业，包括在轨制造、月球客运、在月球建立人类存在或门户枢纽、火星客运与货运、月球或火星能源生产、月球或火星制造能力以及小行星采矿，目前尚不存在。我们对于预期市场机会的规模或时间所作的任何估计本质上都具有不确定性，且必然涉及对未来客户需求、采用情况、技术发展、监管条件以及目前尚不存在的更广泛商业市场兴起的重大假设。尽管我们相信这些行业将随时间发展，但其兴起方式，包括商业化时间、采用规模与速度，以及适用的技术、监管、地缘政治和经济框架，可能与我们的当前预期存在重大差异。如果这些行业未能发展、发展时间慢于预期、规模小于预期，或处于与我们预期不同的经济或监管条件下，这可能要求我们修改、推迟或放弃某些业务计划，或导致此类计划根本无法实现，从而可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: **The global nature of our business poses risks with respect to unstable, malicious or arbitrary legal regimes and authorities.**
paras.zh: **我们业务的全球性质带来了与不稳定、恶意或任意法律制度及主管机关相关的风险。**

paras.en: We, particularly through Starlink, maintain global operations. As a result, we may face risks that our operations will be subject to unstable, capricious, or malicious legal regimes and authorities. The increasing militarization of space and the potential development of space-based warfare capabilities may expose our assets and operations to heightened geopolitical and security risks, including the risk that foreign governments or other actors could target our satellites or related infrastructure. Certain foreign governments have publicly discussed the potential use of anti-satellite weapons against the Starlink constellation. These and other actions by foreign governments, whether through military, regulatory or other means, may adversely affect our operations and assets. Even if we attempt to comply with known local laws, our assets (both physical, intangible and financial) may be subject to seizure or other expropriation. There is no guarantee that we will be able to maintain operations in any jurisdiction, and, if our assets or properties are subject to seizure or other expropriation, there can be no assurances that we will be able to recover our assets or properties. Any such legal or other governmental action could have an adverse effect on us. For example, in August 2024, Starlink received an order from Brazil’s Supreme Court that froze Starlink’s Brazilian financial assets and prevented Starlink from conducting financial transactions in Brazil (the “Brazil Asset Seizure”). The action taken by the Brazilian Supreme Court arose out of purported violations of Brazilian law by X, which at the time was not owned by us and was only affiliated with Mr. Musk. It is possible that we may be subject to actions like the Brazil Asset Seizure in the future (whether in Brazil or another country) and, regardless of whether any such action is consistent with local and international law, we may never recover assets seized in any similar action. Additionally, actions that we take to minimize the impact of actions such as the Brazil Asset Seizure to our customers, for example, by continuing to provide service without charge or otherwise altering payment processes and methods to permit customers to maintain service, may have a material impact on our financial performance. As evidenced by the Brazil Asset Seizure, we may be subject to adverse actions from governmental actors on the basis of assumptions, facts or events that are not directly related to our operations and instead relate to the actions of our directors, officers, or shareholders or operations of businesses that are affiliated with them.
paras.zh: 我们，尤其是通过 Starlink，维持着全球运营。因此，我们可能面临如下风险：我们的运营可能受制于不稳定、反复无常或恶意的法律制度和主管机关。太空军事化程度不断上升以及天基作战能力的潜在发展，可能使我们的资产和运营面临更高的地缘政治和安全风险，包括外国政府或其他行为体可能将我们的卫星或相关基础设施作为攻击目标的风险。某些外国政府已公开讨论对 Starlink 星座使用反卫星武器的可能性。外国政府的这些及其他行动，无论是通过军事、监管还是其他手段，都可能对我们的运营和资产造成不利影响。即使我们努力遵守已知的当地法律，我们的资产（包括有形、无形和金融资产）仍可能被扣押或其他征用。我们无法保证能够在任何司法管辖区维持运营，并且，如果我们的资产或财产被扣押或其他征用，也无法保证我们能够收回我们的资产或财产。任何此类法律或其他政府行动都可能对我们造成不利影响。例如，2024 年 8 月，Starlink 收到巴西最高法院的一项命令，该命令冻结了 Starlink 在巴西的金融资产，并阻止 Starlink 在巴西进行金融交易（下称“巴西资产扣押”）。巴西最高法院采取该行动，源于 X 涉嫌违反巴西法律，而 X 当时并非由我们拥有，仅与 Musk 先生存在关联。我们未来可能面临类似巴西资产扣押的行动（无论是在巴西还是在其他国家），并且，无论任何此类行动是否符合当地和国际法律，我们可能永远无法收回在任何类似行动中被扣押的资产。此外，我们为尽量减少巴西资产扣押等行动对客户的影响而采取的行动，例如继续免费提供服务或以其他方式调整支付流程和方式以使客户能够维持服务，可能对我们的财务业绩产生重大影响。正如巴西资产扣押所表明的，我们可能因与我们的运营无直接关系、而是与我们董事、高管或股东的行为或与其关联企业的运营相关的假设、事实或事件，而受到政府行为体的不利行动。

paras.en: **Our services are subject to risks related to supplying services to the U.S. government.**
paras.zh: **我们的服务面临向美国政府提供服务的相关风险。**

paras.en: Supplying services to the U.S. government subjects us to unique risks, including compliance with complex regulations, vulnerability to changes in government priorities or funding levels, and exposure to contractual disputes or audits. In 2025, approximately one-fifth of our revenue was attributable to agencies within the U.S. federal government. As a contractor to various U.S. government agencies, we are subject to extensive federal procurement regulations, including the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), as well as other rules governing cost accounting, cybersecurity, ethics, and national security. These regulations impose stringent requirements on our operations, business practices, and reporting, and noncompliance could result in civil or criminal penalties, suspension or debarment from government contracting, or loss of existing or future business. These requirements, although customary in U.S. government contracts, increase our performance and compliance costs. These costs might increase in the future. For those reasons and in order to achieve our orbital compute goals, we may prioritize our own launch payloads over additional U.S. government contracts or third-party customers. This prioritization of launch capacity may limit revenue growth in our Space segment, and impact our relationship with regulators, and could invite litigation from customers or competitors. In addition, government contracts are susceptible to unilateral termination, reduction in scope, or delays at the government’s convenience, which may occur due to shifting budgetary priorities, changes in defense or space policy, or the reallocation of funding to other programs. The termination or reduction of funding for a government program could result in a loss of anticipated future revenue attributable to that program. The actual receipt of revenue on awards may never occur or may change because a program schedule could change or the program could be canceled, or a contract could be reduced, modified, or terminated early. In addition, in certain circumstances, governments or other customers may be reluctant to rely on our satellite connectivity or defense-related services if they believe the availability of such services could be restricted or suspended based on geopolitical considerations, conflicts, sanctions, or other policy determinations, which could adversely affect our ability to win or retain contracts. In addition, our significant business relationships with U.S. defense and government agencies may cause us to be perceived as closely aligned with the U.S. government or military. This perception could discourage certain consumers, enterprises, or foreign governments from purchasing our products and services which could adversely affect our sales in the United States and internationally. We and our facilities could also be targeted by foreign adversaries and non-state actors due to such perception. Government customers may also subject our contracts to rigorous audits and investigations, which can result in disputes regarding contract performance, cost allowability, or compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Adverse audit findings or contractual disputes could lead to repayments, financial penalties, or restrictions on our ability to compete for future contracts.
paras.zh: 向美国政府提供服务使我们面临特有风险，包括需遵守复杂法规、易受政府优先事项或资金水平变化的影响，以及面临合同纠纷或审计的风险。2025 年，我们约五分之一的收入来自美国联邦政府下属机构。作为多家美国政府机构的承包商，我们须遵守广泛的联邦采购法规，包括《联邦采购条例》（FAR）和《国防联邦采购条例补充规定》（DFARS），以及管辖成本会计、网络安全、道德和国家安全的其他规则。这些法规对我们的运营、商业实践和报告提出了严格要求，不合规可能导致民事或刑事处罚、被暂停或禁止参与政府合同，或失去现有或未来的业务。这些要求虽在美国政府合同中属常规要求，但增加了我们的履约和合规成本。这些成本未来可能进一步增加。基于上述原因，并为实现我们的轨道算力目标，我们可能优先安排自有发射载荷，而非额外的美国政府合同或第三方客户。这种对发射能力的优先安排可能限制我们太空板块的收入增长，影响我们与监管机构的关系，并可能招致客户或竞争对手的诉讼。此外，政府合同可能因政府方便而单方面终止、缩减范围或延迟，其原因可能包括预算优先事项变化、国防或太空政策调整，或将资金重新分配至其他项目。政府项目资金被终止或削减，可能导致该项目的预期未来收入损失。授标项下的收入可能永远不会实际收到，也可能因项目进度变化、项目取消或合同被缩减、修改或提前终止而发生变化。此外，在某些情况下，如果政府或其他客户认为我们的卫星连接或国防相关服务可能因地缘政治考量、冲突、制裁或其他政策决定而受到限制或暂停，他们可能不愿依赖这些服务，这可能不利于我们赢得或保留合同。此外，我们与美国国防和政府机构的重要业务关系可能使外界认为我们与美国政府或军方关系密切。这种看法可能使某些消费者、企业或外国政府不愿购买我们的产品和服务，从而可能不利于我们在美国及国际市场的销售。基于这种看法，我们及我们的设施也可能成为外国对手和非国家行为体的攻击目标。政府客户还可能对我们的合同进行严格审计和调查，从而引发有关合同履约、成本可允许性或遵守适用法律法规的争议。不利的审计结果或合同纠纷可能导致退款、经济处罚，或限制我们参与未来合同竞争的能力。

paras.en: Certain of our government contracts also require that we maintain facility security clearances and that certain of our employees obtain and maintain personnel security clearances. Obtaining and maintaining these clearances involves a lengthy and uncertain process and depends on factors outside of our control, and we may experience delays in receiving required clearances or be unable to hire or retain a sufficient number of employees with the necessary clearances to perform under certain contracts. If we are unable to obtain or maintain required facility or personnel security clearances, we may be unable to bid on, win, or perform certain classified programs, and existing contracts could be terminated or not renewed, which could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 我们的部分政府合同还要求我们维持设施安全许可，并要求我们的某些员工获得并维持人员安全许可。获得和维持这些许可涉及漫长且不确定的过程，并取决于我们无法控制的因素，我们可能在获得所需许可方面出现延迟，或无法聘用或留任足够数量的具备必要许可的员工以履行某些合同。如果我们无法获得或维持所需的设施或人员安全许可，我们可能无法投标、中标或履行某些涉密项目，现有合同可能被终止或不予续签，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: Further, our business is subject to economic sanctions and trade embargo laws, various import regulations, including tariffs, and stringent U.S. import and export control laws. Any failure by us to comply with any of the foregoing could result in our debarment from government contracts, limitations on our ability to enter into contracts with the U.S. government, civil or criminal penalties, fines, investigations, more onerous compliance requirements, or loss of export privileges.
paras.zh: 此外，我们的业务还受经济制裁和贸易禁运法律、各类进口法规（包括关税）以及严格的美国进出口管制法律的约束。我们若未能遵守上述任何规定，可能导致我们被禁止参与政府合同、限制我们与美国政府签订合同的能力、民事或刑事处罚、罚款、调查、更繁重的合规要求，或丧失出口特权。

paras.en: **We derive significant revenue from U.S. government contracts that are subject to competitive bidding, funding approvals and other government budgetary processes, which factors could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们的重大收入来自美国政府合同，这些合同受竞争性招标、资金审批及其他政府预算流程的约束，这些因素可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。**

paras.en: We derive significant revenue from U.S. government contracts that were awarded through a competitive bidding process. Competitive bidding presents a number of risks, including: the need to bid on programs in advance of the completion of their design, which may result in unforeseen technological difficulties and cost overruns; the substantial cost and managerial time and effort that must be spent to prepare bids and proposals for contracts that may not be awarded to us; the need to estimate accurately the resources and cost structure that will be required to service any contract we are awarded; and the expense and delay that may arise if interested parties or our competitors protest or challenge contract awards made to us pursuant to competitive bidding, and the risk that any such protest or challenge could result in the delay of our contract performance, the distraction of management, the resubmission of bids on modified specifications, or in termination, reduction or modification of the awarded contract.
paras.zh: 我们的重大收入来自通过竞争性招标程序授予的美国政府合同。竞争性招标带来诸多风险，包括：需要在项目设计完成之前进行投标，这可能导致意外的技术困难和成本超支；为可能不会授予我们的合同准备投标和提案必须花费大量成本以及管理时间和精力；需要准确估算履行我们获授的任何合同所需的资源和成本结构；以及如果相关利益方或我们的竞争对手对我们依据竞争性招标获得的合同授予提出异议或质疑，可能产生的费用和延迟，以及任何此类异议或质疑可能导致我们合同履行延迟、管理层分心、按修改后的规格重新提交投标，或导致已授予合同被终止、缩减或修改的风险。

paras.en: Our business with governmental entities is subject to changes in policies, priorities, regulations, mandates, and funding levels, any of which could materially impact our operations and financial results. U.S. government program funding is subject to Congressional appropriations on a fiscal year basis even though contract performance may take more than one year. As a result, at the outset of a major program, the contract is usually incrementally funded and additional funds are normally committed to the contract only as Congress makes appropriations in future fiscal years. U.S. government contracts may also be undefinitized at the time of the start of performance. Under undefinitized contract actions, the U.S. government has the ability to unilaterally definitize contracts and, absent a successful appeal of such action, the unilateral definitization of the contract would obligate us to perform under terms and conditions imposed by the U.S. government. Such unilaterally imposed contract terms could include less favorable pricing or terms and conditions more burdensome than those negotiated in other circumstances. U.S. government contracts typically involve long lead times for design and development and are subject to significant changes in contract scheduling.
paras.zh: 我们与政府实体的业务受政策、优先事项、法规、指令和资金水平变化的影响，其中任何一项都可能对我们的运营和财务业绩产生重大影响。美国政府的项目资金按财年受国会拨款约束，即使合同履行可能需要超过一年。因此，在重大项目启动之初，合同通常采用增量拨款方式，通常只有在国会于未来财年完成拨款后才会向合同承诺追加资金。美国政府合同在开始履行时也可能尚未确定。在未确定合同行动下，美国政府有权单方面确定合同，且若对此类行动的上诉不成功，合同被单方面确定将使我们有义务按照美国政府强加的条款和条件履行。此类单方面强加的合同条款可能包括比在其他情况下谈判达成的条款更不利的定价或更繁重的条款和条件。美国政府合同通常涉及较长的设计和开发前置时间，并受合同进度安排重大变化的影响。

paras.en: Additionally, the U.S. government’s budget deficit and the national debt, as well as any inability of the U.S. government to complete its budget process for any government fiscal year and consequently having to shut down or operate on funding levels equivalent to its prior fiscal year pursuant to a “continuing resolution,” could have a material and adverse impact on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 此外，美国政府的预算赤字和国家债务，以及美国政府在任何政府财年无法完成其预算流程、从而不得不根据“持续决议”停摆或按相当于上一财年的资金水平运作，都可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: Moreover, if we fail to establish and maintain important relationships with U.S. government agencies, our ability to successfully maintain and develop new business could be materially and adversely affected. The current political environment in the United States is highly polarized, and shifts in the composition of the U.S. Congress or changes in the presidential administration can result in significant changes in government spending priorities, regulatory posture, and the allocation of contracts and resources across industries and programs. Our relationships with U.S. government agencies and the favorability of the regulatory and procurement environment in which we operate may be affected by which political party controls the presidency or one or both chambers of the U.S. Congress. As a result, there can be no assurance that current government relationships, contracts, or levels of funding will be maintained, and any significant adverse developments could have a material and adverse impact on our growth and competitive position.
paras.zh: 此外，如果我们未能建立并维持与美国政府机构的重要关系，我们成功维持和开发新业务的能力可能受到重大不利影响。美国当前的政治环境高度两极分化，美国国会构成的变化或总统政府的变化可能导致政府支出优先事项、监管立场以及跨行业和项目的合同与资源分配发生重大变化。我们与美国政府机构的关系以及我们所处监管和采购环境的有利程度，可能受到哪个政党控制总统职位或美国国会一院或两院的影响。因此，无法保证当前的政府关系、合同或资金水平将得以维持，任何重大不利发展都可能对我们的增长和竞争地位产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: In addition, our Space segment revenue is primarily derived from fixed-price contracts, under which we agree to deliver specified products or services at a predetermined price regardless of the actual costs incurred. As a result, if we experience cost overruns on these contracts, including from factors outside our control, we are required to absorb the excess costs, which may reduce profitability or result in losses, strain cash flows, and impact our ability to invest in future growth. Any unanticipated increases in labor, material, or other direct or indirect costs—including those arising from inflation, supply chain disruptions, design changes, regulatory requirements, or unforeseen technical challenges—must be borne by us. When these overruns occur, our margins on affected contracts may be significantly reduced or eliminated, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects. Additionally, absorbing excess costs may limit our ability to allocate resources to other strategic initiatives, delay investment in research and development, or constrain our capacity to pursue new business opportunities. In addition, we sometimes receive advanced payments and billings in excess of the amount of revenue we recognize, which we record as deferred revenue. As a result, our cash flows may be subject to fluctuation across periods in a manner that may be unrelated to our underlying performance.
paras.zh: 此外，我们太空板块的收入主要来自固定价格合同，根据该等合同，我们同意按预定价格交付指定产品或服务，而不论实际发生的成本如何。因此，若我们在该等合同上出现成本超支（包括因我们无法控制的因素导致的超支），我们须自行承担超额成本，这可能降低盈利能力或导致亏损、使现金流承压，并影响我们投资未来增长的能力。劳动力、材料或其他直接或间接成本的任何意外增加——包括因通货膨胀、供应链中断、设计变更、监管要求或不可预见的技术挑战而产生的增加——均须由我们承担。当该等超支发生时，受影响合同的利润率可能大幅下降或被完全侵蚀，从而可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。此外，承担超额成本可能限制我们将资源调配至其他战略举措的能力、延迟研发投入，或制约我们把握新业务机会的能力。此外，我们有时会收到超过我们已确认收入金额的预付款和开票款，我们将其记为递延收入。因此，我们的现金流可能在不同期间出现波动，且该等波动可能与我们的基础经营表现无关。

paras.en: **Our ability to expand our Starlink consumer and enterprise connectivity services depends on our ability to increase market awareness and acceptance of connectivity through Starlink, and any failure to do so could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们扩大 Starlink 消费者和企业连接服务的能力取决于我们能否提高市场对通过 Starlink 提供连接服务的认知度和接受度，若未能做到，可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: Our ability to expand our Starlink consumer and enterprise connectivity services depends on our ability to increase market awareness and acceptance of connectivity through Starlink. There can be no assurance that our efforts to increase awareness will be successful. In particular, such efforts may not be successful if we are unable to offer Starlink services at competitive prices. Additionally, constraints in the distribution of user terminals could delay service activations, increase costs, or otherwise limit our ability to scale such services as anticipated. Consumer acceptance may also be hindered by the presence of well-established terrestrial broadband alternatives, as well as lingering perceptions regarding service reliability, latency, and the complexity of satellite-based internet compared to traditional fixed-line solutions.
paras.zh: 我们扩大 Starlink 消费者和企业连接服务的能力取决于我们能否提高市场对通过 Starlink 提供连接服务的认知度和接受度。无法保证我们提升认知度的努力将会成功。特别是，若我们无法以具有竞争力的价格提供 Starlink 服务，该等努力可能不会成功。此外，用户终端分销方面的限制可能延迟服务开通、增加成本，或以其他方式限制我们按预期规模扩展该等服务的能力。消费者接受度还可能因成熟的地面宽带替代方案的存在，以及人们对卫星互联网相较于传统固网方案在服务可靠性、延迟和复杂性方面挥之不去的看法而受到阻碍。

paras.en: **The expansion of our satellite-to-mobile connectivity services depends substantially on our ability to secure and maintain partnerships with mobile network operators and on the adoption of necessary hardware and software modifications by device manufacturers, and any failure to do so could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们卫星直连手机连接服务的扩张在很大程度上取决于我们能否获得并维持与移动网络运营商的合作关系，以及设备制造商能否采用必要的硬件和软件改造，若未能做到，可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: The expansion of our global satellite-to-mobile connectivity offerings depends substantially on our ability to enter into and maintain successful partnerships with telecommunications carriers and spectrum licensees globally, and to obtain country-specific authorizations to offer such connectivity using satellite spectrum bands for which we have international coordination rights. In the United States, we expect to be able to provide 5G-like connectivity to a meaningful portion of existing unmodified devices through our Starlink Mobile Gen2 service utilizing our V2 Mobile satellites, either by operating on spectrum leased to us by MNO partners or by utilizing our own domestic spectrum holdings. However, achieving full 5G NR-NTN compliance and optimal performance would likely require handset manufacturers to implement hardware and software modifications, primarily to the radio-frequency front end, in future devices. The spectrum frequencies in the FCC licenses to be acquired from EchoStar are standardized for terrestrial 5G mobile broadband (3GPP bands n66 and n70). But the 5G NR-NTN bands for these same frequencies, such as n252 and n256, are not currently supported by RF front-end hardware for the provision of 5G-like service in any commercially available mobile devices. We do not have direct contractual arrangements with handset manufacturers; instead, we expect MNO partners, as major purchasers of mobile devices, to encourage or drive such adoption. There can be no assurance that these modifications will be adopted on our preferred timeline, or at all.
paras.zh: 我们全球卫星直连移动连接服务的扩展，在很大程度上取决于我们能否与全球电信运营商和频谱被许可方建立并维持成功的合作关系，以及能否获得特定国家授权，以便使用我们拥有国际协调权的卫星频段提供此类连接。在美国，我们预计能够通过使用 V2 Mobile 卫星的 Starlink Mobile Gen2 服务，向相当一部分现有未改装设备提供类 5G 连接，方式可以是使用移动网络运营商（MNO）合作伙伴租赁给我们的频谱运营，也可以是利用我们自有的国内频谱资产。然而，要实现完整的 5G NR-NTN 合规性和最佳性能，很可能需要手机制造商在未来设备中实施硬件和软件修改，主要是对射频前端进行修改。拟从 EchoStar 收购的 FCC 许可证中的频谱频率是地面 5G 移动宽带（3GPP 频段 n66 和 n70）的标准化频率。但对于这些相同频率的 5G NR-NTN 频段（如 n252 和 n256），目前任何商用移动设备的射频前端硬件均不支持提供类 5G 服务。我们与手机制造商没有直接合同安排；相反，我们预计作为移动设备主要购买方的 MNO 合作伙伴将鼓励或推动此类采用。无法保证这些修改会按我们期望的时间表被采用，或是否会被采用。

paras.en: Internationally, we face similar constraints until handset manufacturers implement hardware and software modifications to support the international spectrum authorizations to be obtained from EchoStar. As a result, our near-term international service strategy depends on our ability to establish MNO spectrum partnerships on a market-by-market basis, which does not require device hardware modifications but is subject to the successful negotiation and execution of commercial agreements in each jurisdiction. Until device manufacturers incorporate support for our international spectrum bands into future handsets, we will be unable to offer 5G-like direct-to-consumer service on our own international spectrum.
paras.zh: 在国际上，我们面临类似限制，直到手机制造商实施硬件和软件修改以支持拟从 EchoStar 获得的国际频谱授权。因此，我们的近期国际服务战略取决于我们能否逐市场建立 MNO 频谱合作伙伴关系，这不需要设备硬件修改，但取决于在每个司法管辖区成功谈判并签署商业协议。在设备制造商将对我们国际频段的支持纳入未来手机之前，我们将无法利用我们自有的国际频谱提供类 5G 的直连消费者服务。

paras.en: The provision of our satellite-to-mobile services also requires regulatory approvals from the FCC and foreign regulatory authorities. Our Gen1 service, utilizing our existing constellation of V1 Mobile satellites, is fully licensed in the United States but requires additional country-by-country approvals to operate internationally. We have signed MNO partnerships for our Gen1 service in approximately 30 countries. These partnerships represent commercial agreements with carriers but do not, by themselves, provide the regulatory approvals necessary to offer service. In addition to at least one MNO partnership, we have obtained required approvals to offer commercial Gen1 service in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Japan, and Australia, as well as in several additional countries.
paras.zh: 提供我们的卫星直连移动服务还需要获得 FCC 和外国监管机构的监管批准。我们的 Gen1 服务利用我们现有的 V1 Mobile 卫星星座，在美国已获得完整许可，但在国际上运营需要逐国获得额外批准。我们已就 Gen1 服务在约 30 个国家签署了 MNO 合作伙伴关系。这些合作伙伴关系代表与运营商的商业协议，但其本身并不提供提供服务所需的监管批准。除至少一个 MNO 合作伙伴关系外，我们已获得在美国、加拿大、英国、日本和澳大利亚以及另外几个国家提供商业 Gen1 服务所需的批准。

paras.en: Our Gen2 service, which will utilize 2 GHz S-band spectrum and a new satellite constellation, requires a license transfer, a constellation license, and spectrum usage approvals in each country in which we seek to operate. For the United States, we have received the relevant license transfer approval from the FCC, and we expect to receive the remaining necessary regulatory authorizations in the second or third quarter of 2026. While these authorizations would be sufficient from a United States regulatory perspective, we still require our V2 Mobile satellites to be in orbit and must complete the acquisition of the relevant spectrum from EchoStar before we can commence our planned commercial Gen2 service in the United States. Internationally, we have filed applications in nearly every country in which we intend to operate our Gen2 service, and approvals have been granted in a limited number of these jurisdictions to date. Each jurisdiction presents its own regulatory process and timeline, and we cannot predict when or whether approvals will be granted in any given market. Subject to regulatory approvals, we are receiving from EchoStar certain assets and authorizations that provide very senior ITU priority for international frequency coordination for our V2 Mobile constellation. Until such approvals are obtained, we also signed a coordination agreement with EchoStar to obtain the protection of its senior ITU priority rights until the authorizations transfer. However, some countries have signaled through public consultations or other actions that they are considering ignoring or diminishing ITU priority as a mechanism to decide which operators are licensed to operate in their country. Several countries and regions have open inquiries that invite input on whether factors other thanITU priority (such as whether the operator originates from the country) should govern the issuance of spectrum licenses, and we cannot be certain the outcome of these proceedings. Delays or failures to obtain necessary approvals could materially delay the deployment and commercialization of our Gen2 service. The failure to enter into or successfully maintain such partnerships, or the failure of device manufacturers to adopt the necessary hardware modifications, or the failure to obtain required regulatory approvals, could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 我们的第二代（Gen2）服务将使用 2 GHz S 频段频谱和新的卫星星座，需要在我们拟运营的每个国家取得许可证转让、星座许可和频谱使用批准。在美国，我们已获得 FCC 的相关许可证转让批准，并预计在 2026 年第二或第三季度获得其余必要的监管授权。尽管从美国监管角度看这些授权已经足够，但我们仍需要我们的 V2 Mobile 卫星入轨，并且必须完成从 EchoStar 收购相关频谱，才能在美国启动我们计划的 Gen2 商业服务。在国际上，我们已在我们拟运营 Gen2 服务的几乎所有国家提交了申请，但迄今为止仅在有限数量的司法辖区获得批准。每个司法辖区都有各自的监管流程和时间表，我们无法预测任何特定市场何时或是否会获得批准。在获得监管批准的前提下，我们正从 EchoStar 接收某些资产和授权，这些资产和授权为我们的 V2 Mobile 星座的国际频率协调提供了非常优先的 ITU 优先权。在获得此类批准之前，我们还与 EchoStar 签署了一项协调协议，以便在授权转让之前获得其优先 ITU 优先权的保护。然而，一些国家已通过公开征求意见或其他行动表示，它们正在考虑无视或削弱 ITU 优先权，以此作为决定哪些运营商获准在本国运营的机制。若干国家和地区已启动公开征询，邀请各方就是否应以 ITU 优先权以外的因素（例如运营商是否源自本国）来决定频谱许可证的发放提出意见，我们无法确定这些程序的结果。延迟或未能获得必要批准可能会实质性延迟我们 Gen2 服务的部署和商业化。未能达成或成功维持此类合作关系，或设备制造商未能采用必要的硬件修改，或未能获得所需的监管批准，都可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: **If the recommendations, forecasts, content, analyses or other output that our AI technologies, including Grok, assist in producing are or are alleged to be deficient, inaccurate, harmful, illegal, or used for an improper purpose, we could continue to be subjected to claims and investigations, and we could be subjected to legal liability and brand, reputational, or competitive harm.**
paras.zh: **如果我们的人工智能技术（包括 Grok）协助生成的建议、预测、内容、分析或其他输出存在或据称存在缺陷、不准确、有害、违法或被用于不当目的，我们可能继续面临索赔和调查，并可能承担法律责任以及品牌、声誉或竞争方面的损害。**

paras.en: AI technologies, the models, algorithms, prompts and datasets on which they rely, and the recommendations, forecasts, analyses or other output that such AI technologies assist in producing, may be flawed, insufficient, of poor quality, rely upon incorrect, inaccurate, harmful or illegal data, reflect unwanted forms of bias, hallucinate, misrepresent, mislead or contain other errors or inadequacies, any of which may not be easily detectable. Although we devote significant resources to develop, test, and maintain our AI technologies, we may not be able to identify or resolve all AI-related issues, deficiencies, and failures before they arise. AI technologies have been known to produce mischaracterized or “hallucinatory” inferences or outputs, and certain of our AI products, such as Grok, have been alleged to be susceptible to “data poisoning” in the past. We may not have insight into, or control over, the practices of third parties who may utilize our AI technologies. As such, third parties have in the past used, and may in the future use, such AI technologies for improper purposes, including through the dissemination of illegal, inaccurate, defamatory or harmful content, intellectual property infringement or misappropriation, furthering bias or discrimination, cybersecurity attacks, including spear phishing and social engineering attacks, data privacy violations, other societal harms, including activities that threaten people’s safety, financial security, or mental well-being on-or offline, or to develop competing technologies. Inappropriate or controversial data practices by data scientists, engineers, and end users of AI technologies, including our AI segment’s systems, could impair the acceptance of AI technologies generally, including our AI products. If the recommendations, forecasts, content, or analyses that our AI technologies assist in producing are or are alleged to be deficient, inaccurate, offensive, illegal, or otherwise harmful, we could be subjected to claims and investigations, and we could be subjected to legal liability and brand, reputational or competitive harm. We have in the past been, and may in the future be, subject to regulatory investigations and litigation related to such claims regarding our recommendations, forecasts, content or analyses. Also please refer to “—Our AI products, X platform, and Starlink services are subject to complex and evolving U.S. and foreign laws and regulations regarding privacy, cybersecurity, data use, data combination, data protection, content, AI, competition, youth protection, safety, consumer protection and notification, advertising, e-commerce, sanctions, export controls,and other matters. Many of these laws and regulations are subject to change and uncertain interpretation, and we could be required to make changes to our products and business practices, and be exposed to monetary penalties, increased cost of operations, declines in user growth or engagement, or loss of customers, or other harm to our AI products, X platform, and Starlink services.” In addition, if we do not have sufficient rights to use the models, algorithms, prompts and datasets on which our AI technologies rely, or the recommendations, forecasts, content, analyses or other output that our AI technologies assist in producing, we could also incur liability through the violation of applicable laws and regulations, third-party intellectual property, privacy or other rights, or contracts to which we are a party. Furthermore, failure to properly disclose the use of consumer-facing AI technologies may result in consumer protection or regulatory enforcement activity. Use of AI technologies, including our AI products, may result in disruptions in, or unauthorized access to, users’ computer systems, which could also lead to the unauthorized disclosure of sensitive (including classified), proprietary, confidential or personal information, new potential cyberattack methods for third parties or an increase in the frequency, sophistication or intensity of cyberattacks. Moreover, if AI technologies are perceived to be significantly disruptive to society, it could lead to governmental or regulatory restrictions or prohibitions on their use, societal concerns or unrest, or both, any of which could materially and adversely affect our ability to develop, deploy, or commercialize AI technologies and execute our business strategy. Our implementation of AI technologies, including through our AI segment’s systems, could result in legal liability, regulatory action, operational disruption, brand, reputational or competitive harm, or other adverse impacts.
paras.zh: AI 技术、其所依赖的模型、算法、提示词和数据集，以及此类 AI 技术协助生成的建议、预测、分析或其他输出，可能存在缺陷、不充分、质量低劣，依赖不正确、不准确、有害或非法的数据，反映不当形式的偏见，产生幻觉、虚假陈述、误导，或包含其他错误或不足，其中任何一项都可能难以被轻易察觉。尽管我们投入大量资源开发、测试和维护我们的 AI 技术，但我们可能无法在相关问题出现之前识别或解决所有与 AI 相关的问题、缺陷和故障。已知 AI 技术会产生错误描述的或“幻觉性”的推断或输出，且我们的某些 AI 产品（如 Grok）过去曾被指称易受“数据投毒”影响。我们可能无法洞察或控制可能使用我们 AI 技术的第三方的做法。因此，第三方过去曾、将来也可能将此类 AI 技术用于不当目的，包括传播非法、不准确、诽谤性或有害内容，侵犯或盗用知识产权，助长偏见或歧视，实施网络安全攻击（包括鱼叉式网络钓鱼和社会工程攻击），侵犯数据隐私，造成其他社会危害（包括在线或线下威胁人身安全、财务安全或心理健康的活动），或用于开发竞争性技术。数据科学家、工程师和 AI 技术（包括我们 AI 板块的系统）的终端用户不当或有争议的数据做法，可能损害 AI 技术（包括我们的 AI 产品）的整体接受度。如果我们的 AI 技术协助生成的建议、预测、内容或分析存在或据称存在缺陷、不准确、冒犯性、非法或其他有害情形，我们可能面临索赔和调查，并可能承担法律责任以及品牌、声誉或竞争方面的损害。我们过去曾、将来也可能因有关我们的建议、预测、内容或分析的此类索赔而受到监管调查和诉讼。另请参阅“——我们的 AI 产品、X 平台和 Starlink 服务受制于复杂且不断演变的美国及外国法律法规，涉及隐私、网络安全、数据使用、数据组合、数据保护、内容、AI、竞争、青少年保护、安全、消费者保护与通知、广告、电子商务、制裁、出口管制及其他事项。其中许多法律法规存在变化和解释不确定性，我们可能被要求更改我们的产品和业务做法，并可能面临罚款、运营成本增加、用户增长或参与度下降、客户流失，或对我们的 AI 产品、X 平台和 Starlink 服务的其他损害。”此外，如果我们对 AI 技术所依赖的模型、算法、提示词和数据集，或对我们的 AI 技术协助生成的建议、预测、内容、分析或其他输出不具备充分权利，我们还可能因违反适用法律法规、第三方知识产权、隐私或其他权利，或我们作为一方的合同而承担责任。此外，未能适当披露面向消费者的 AI 技术的使用，可能导致消费者保护或监管执法行动。使用 AI 技术（包括我们的 AI 产品）可能导致用户计算机系统中断或遭未经授权访问，这也可能导致敏感（包括机密）、专有、保密或个人信息遭未经授权披露，为第三方带来新的潜在网络攻击方法，或导致网络攻击的频率、复杂程度或强度上升。此外，如果 AI 技术被认为对社会具有重大颠覆性，可能导致政府或监管机构对其使用施加限制或禁止、引发社会担忧或动荡，或两者兼有，其中任何一项都可能对我们的 AI 技术开发、部署或商业化能力以及执行业务战略的能力产生重大不利影响。我们实施 AI 技术（包括通过我们 AI 板块的系统）可能导致法律责任、监管行动、运营中断、品牌、声誉或竞争损害，或其他不利影响。

paras.en: **Environmental laws, regulations, litigation, liabilities and proceedings may adversely affect our operations, including our launch operations, manufacturing activities, fuel storage and handling operations, launch facilities and ground infrastructure, and data center operations and expansion plans.**
paras.zh: **环境法律、法规、诉讼、责任和程序可能对我们的运营产生不利影响，包括我们的发射运营、制造活动、燃料储存和处理运营、发射设施和地面基础设施，以及数据中心运营和扩建计划。**

paras.en: Our operations, including our launch operations, manufacturing activities, fuel storage and handling operations, launch facilities and ground infrastructure, and data center operations and expansion plans are subject to a variety of state and federal environmental laws and regulations governing matters such as air emissions, wastewater discharges and the discharge, treatment, storage, disposal and remediation of hazardous substances and wastes, including the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation and Liability Act, the Resource Conservation and Recovery Act, the Clean Air Act, the Clean Water Act and permitting requirements of federal, state and local environmental authorities. Liability under these laws imposes strict liability for environmental contamination or remediation costs. Changing regulatory requirements for permits and approvals relating to operational infrastructure, including energy generation assets (e.g., renewables, generators or grid connections), manufacturing facilities, launch facilities, fuel storage and handling facilities, and data centers may cause delays, higher costs or denials, and a failure to comply with these requirements may result in fines, shutdowns or competitive harm. In addition, growing scrutiny of data centers’ overall ecological footprint could lead to community opposition, fines or mandates for changing existing practices. We are or may become subject to environmental lawsuits and proceedings, and various parties have threatened or brought lawsuits that allege we are unlawfully operating natural gas-fired turbines without required permits at facilities in Southaven, Mississippi. While we have obtained such permits, the outcome of these legal actions is uncertain. Injunctive relief or the rescission of issued permits would prevent our ability to utilize power generation sources that are required for the operation of these data centers and would adversely affect our AI business. We cannot predict with certainty how future legislative or regulatory developments will affect our business, but compliance with new or modified environmental requirements could require us to incur significant unanticipated expenditures that could adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations, speed of deployment and cash flows.
paras.zh: 我们的运营，包括我们的发射运营、制造活动、燃料储存和处理运营、发射设施和地面基础设施，以及数据中心运营和扩建计划，受制于多种州和联邦环境法律和法规，这些法律法规管辖空气排放、废水排放以及危险物质和废物的排放、处理、储存、处置和修复等事项，包括《综合环境反应、赔偿和责任法》《资源保护和回收法》《清洁空气法》《清洁水法》以及联邦、州和地方环境主管部门的许可要求。这些法律下的责任对环境污染或修复费用规定了严格责任。与运营基础设施相关的许可和批准（包括能源发电资产（例如可再生能源、发电机或电网连接）、制造设施、发射设施、燃料储存和处理设施以及数据中心）的监管要求不断变化，可能导致延误、成本增加或申请被拒，未能遵守这些要求可能导致罚款、停业或竞争损害。此外，对数据中心整体生态足迹日益严格的审查可能导致社区反对、罚款或强制要求改变现有做法。我们目前或可能成为环境诉讼和程序的对象，且多方已威胁或提起诉讼，指控我们在密西西比州 Southaven 的设施中未经所需许可非法运营天然气燃气轮机。虽然我们已获得此类许可，但这些法律诉讼的结果尚不确定。禁令救济或撤销已发放的许可将使我们无法利用这些数据中心运营所需的发电来源，并将对我们的 AI 业务产生不利影响。我们无法确定地预测未来的立法或监管发展将如何影响我们的业务，但遵守新的或修改后的环境要求可能要求我们承担重大意外支出，这可能对我们的财务状况、经营业绩、部署速度和现金流产生不利影响。

paras.en: In addition, our launch facilities and related operations are subject to environmental permitting, land use, wetlands, coastal management and other environmental review requirements, such as the National Environmental Policy Act or related federal and state laws, that may give rise to litigation, regulatory enforcement actions or permitting disputes. Environmental groups, regulatory authorities or other stakeholders may challenge our launch activities, launch cadence, construction or expansion of facilities, fuel storage or handling practices, or other operational activities under federal, state or local environmental laws. Such actions may seek injunctive relief, civil penalties or additional environmental review and mitigation measures, any of which could delay launches, restrict operations, increase compliance costs or otherwise adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and future prospects.
paras.zh: 此外，我们的发射设施及相关运营须遵守环境许可、土地利用、湿地、海岸管理及其他环境审查要求，例如《国家环境政策法》或相关联邦及州法律，这些要求可能引发诉讼、监管执法行动或许可争议。环保团体、监管机构或其他利益相关方可能依据联邦、州或地方环境法律，对我们的发射活动、发射频次、设施的建设或扩建、燃料储存或处理做法或其他运营活动提出质疑。此类行动可能寻求禁令救济、民事处罚或额外的环境审查与缓解措施，其中任何一项都可能延迟发射、限制运营、增加合规成本，或以其他方式对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。

paras.en: **We may face substantial potential liability and operational disruptions if we violate the intellectual property rights or other rights of third parties, and if we fail to adequately protect, maintain, defend or enforce our intellectual property and other similar rights, we could lose an important competitive advantage, in each case which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, customer trust and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **若我们侵犯第三方的知识产权或其他权利，我们可能面临重大潜在责任和运营中断；若我们未能充分保护、维持、捍卫或执行我们的知识产权及其他类似权利，我们可能丧失重要的竞争优势，上述任何一种情况均可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩、客户信任和未来前景产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: Our success and ability to compete also depends in part on our ability to operate without infringing, misappropriating or otherwise violating the intellectual property rights of third parties. Companies in the AI and technology industries own large numbers of patents, copyrights, trademarks, and trade secrets, and frequently enter into litigation based on allegations of infringement, misappropriation, or other violations of intellectual property or other rights, including in novel areas such as those relating to AI training and AI outputs. Plaintiffs have in the past and may in the future file infringement or other litigation or administrative or adversarial actions relating to the training or development of our AI models. We cannot guarantee that the operation of our business does not and will not infringe or violate the rights of third parties, and we may be unaware of the intellectual property rights that others may claim cover some or all of our products or services. Moreover, we may not have the freedom to operate unimpeded by the patent or other rights of others. Third parties may have dominating, blocking or other patents or other rights relevant to our technology, of which we are not aware.
paras.zh: 我们的成功和竞争能力还部分取决于我们能否在不侵犯、盗用或以其他方式违反第三方知识产权的情况下开展运营。AI 和技术行业的公司拥有大量专利、著作权、商标和商业秘密，并经常因涉嫌侵权、盗用或其他侵犯知识产权或其他权利的指控而提起诉讼，包括在与 AI 训练和 AI 输出相关等新兴领域。原告过去曾提起、未来也可能提起与我们 AI 模型训练或开发相关的侵权或其他诉讼、行政程序或对抗性程序。我们无法保证我们的业务运营现在不会、将来也不会侵犯或违反第三方的权利，并且我们可能并不知悉他人可能主张涵盖我们部分或全部产品或服务的知识产权。此外，我们可能无法不受他人专利或其他权利的阻碍自由开展运营。第三方可能拥有与我们技术相关的支配性、阻断性或其他专利或其他权利，而我们对此并不知悉。

paras.en: Intellectual property and related laws are constantly evolving, can be highly uncertain and involve complex legal and factual questions for which important principles remain unresolved. For example, in the United States and in many foreign jurisdictions, policies regarding the breadth of claims allowed in patents and scope of protections for content can be inconsistent. We cannot predict future changes in the interpretation of patent, intellectual property and other related laws or changes to patent, intellectual property and other related laws that might be enacted into law by U.S. and foreign legislative bodies.
paras.zh: 知识产权及相关法律处于持续演变之中，可能具有高度不确定性，并涉及复杂的事实与法律问题，其中一些重要原则至今仍未确定。例如，在美国及许多外国司法辖区，有关专利允许的权利要求范围以及内容保护范围的政策可能并不一致。我们无法预测未来专利、知识产权及其他相关法律的解释会发生何种变化，也无法预测美国及外国立法机构可能制定出台的专利、知识产权及其他相关法律会如何变化。

paras.en: We rely on statutory safe harbors, including those set forth in the Digital Millennium Copyright Act and Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act in the United States and the Digital Services Act in the EU, to protect against liability for various activities, including linking, caching, ranking, recommending and hosting. Legislation or court rulings affecting these safe harbors may harm us and may impose significant operational challenges. There are legislative proposals and pending litigation in the United States, EU, and around the world that could diminish or eliminate safe harbor protection for websites and online platforms.
paras.zh: 我们依赖法定安全港条款来防范因各类活动（包括链接、缓存、排序、推荐和托管）而承担的责任，这些条款包括美国《数字千年版权法》和《通信规范法》第 230 条以及欧盟《数字服务法》中的相关规定。影响这些安全港的立法或法院裁决可能对我们造成损害，并可能带来重大的运营挑战。美国、欧盟及世界各地存在立法提案和待决诉讼，可能削弱或取消对网站和在线平台的安全港保护。

paras.en: If we violate, or are alleged to have violated, the intellectual property rights of third parties, including patents, copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets, or other intellectual property rights and related rights, we may be subject to costly and time-consuming litigation, substantial financial penalties, and reputational harm, any of which could materially disrupt our operations, product development and strategic initiatives. As we continue to develop new or update existing technologies, products, and services, there is a risk that third parties may allege that our operations or offerings infringe upon their intellectual property rights. For example, we are currently a defendant in litigation alleging copyright infringement relating to the claimed use of copyrighted works to train our AI models. Other plaintiffs may file infringement or other litigation relating to the training or development of our AI models. In addition, we are currently subject to, and in the future may be subject to claims from various “non-practicing entities” or other companies that own patents and other intellectual property rights that often attempt to aggressively assert their rights in order to extract value from technology companies by threatening costly litigation or that have minimal operations or relevant product revenue and against whom our patents may provide little or no deterrence or protection. We are and may in the future be subject to additional copyright litigation or other litigation, including litigation relating to allegations that we have trained or developed our AI models on copyrighted works in a manner that infringes on copyrights, or in a manner that otherwise violates the intellectual property or other rights of third parties, or that our models produce outputs in a manner that infringes on copyrights or other intellectual property or other rights. Moreover, the impact of AI on intellectual property ownership and licensing rights, including copyrights, has not been fully addressed by U.S. or international courts or other federal, state or international laws or regulations (or by courts, laws or regulations in foreign jurisdictions), and our use of AI models may reduce our ability to protect our own intellectual property. In addition, former employers of our current, former, or future employees may assert claims that such employees have improperly disclosed to us confidential or proprietary information of these former employers. Any such claims or allegations, whether or not they have merit, could result in costly litigation, substantial damages, injunctions against the use of certain technologies, or the need to obtain licenses on unfavorable terms. In addition, certain of our contracts with customers, suppliers, and partners contain indemnification provisions that could require us to defend against infringement or other claims and pay damages or settlements, thereby increasing our financial exposure. The outcome of intellectual property litigation is inherently uncertain, and adverse judgments could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects. If we are unable to obtain necessary licenses, non-infringing substitute technologies, or otherwise mitigate these risks, we may be forced to discontinue certain products or services, delay or curtail research and development activities, or limit our expansion into new markets.
paras.zh: 如果我们侵犯或被指控侵犯第三方的知识产权（包括专利、著作权、商标、商业秘密或其他知识产权及相关权利），我们可能面临成本高昂且旷日持久的诉讼、巨额经济处罚以及声誉损害，其中任何一项都可能对我们的运营、产品开发和战略举措造成重大干扰。随着我们持续开发新技术、新产品和新服务或更新现有技术、产品和服​​务，存在第三方可能指控我们的运营或产品侵犯其知识产权的风险。例如，我们目前是一起诉讼的被告，该诉讼指控我们涉嫌使用受著作权保护的作品训练我们的 AI 模型，构成著作权侵权。其他原告也可能就我们 AI 模型的训练或开发提起侵权或其他诉讼。此外，我们目前及未来可能面临来自各类“非执业实体”或其他拥有专利及其他知识产权的主体的索赔，此类主体往往试图通过威胁提起高成本诉讼来积极主张其权利，以从科技公司获取价值，或其自身运营极少、相关产品收入微薄，我们的专利对其可能几乎不构成或完全不构成威慑或保护。我们目前及未来可能面临额外的著作权诉讼或其他诉讼，包括指控我们以侵犯著作权的方式、或以其他违反第三方知识产权或其他权利的方式，使用受著作权保护的作品训练或开发我们的 AI 模型，或指控我们的模型生成输出内容的方式侵犯著作权或其他知识产权或其他权利。此外，AI 对知识产权归属和许可权利（包括著作权）的影响，尚未被美国或国际法院或其他联邦、州或国际法律或法规（或外国司法辖区的法院、法律或法规）充分解决，我们使用 AI 模型可能削弱我们保护自身知识产权的能力。此外，我们现任、前任或未来员工的 former employers 可能主张该等员工不当向我们披露了其前雇主的保密或专有信息。任何此类索赔或指控，无论是否具有依据，都可能导致高成本诉讼、巨额损害赔偿、禁止使用某些技术的禁令，或需要以不利条件获取许可。此外，我们与客户、供应商和合作伙伴的某些合同包含赔偿条款，可能要求我们针对侵权或其他索赔进行抗辩并支付损害赔偿或和解金，从而增加我们的财务风险敞口。知识产权诉讼的结果本质上具有不确定性，不利判决可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。如果我们无法获得必要的许可、非侵权替代技术，或以其他方式缓解这些风险，我们可能被迫停止某些产品或服务、延迟或缩减研发活动，或限制我们向新市场的扩张。

paras.en: Additionally, failure to adequately protect, maintain, defend, or enforce our intellectual property—including patents, copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets, and proprietary technologies—may lead to loss of competitive advantage, weakened market position, and financial harm from unauthorized use or infringement. We rely and expect to continue to rely upon a combination of patents, trademarks, trade secrets, copyrights, confidentiality procedures, contractual commitments and other legal rights to establish and protect our intellectual property. However, the steps we take to protect our intellectual property and other rights may be inadequate due to various circumstances. We may be unable or choose not to pursue or maintain certain types of intellectual property protection or registration for our intellectual property in the United States or foreign jurisdictions, and the measures we do take may not prevent our competitors or other third parties from independently developing products, services, and technology similar to or duplicative of our products and services. We will not be able to protect our intellectual property if we are unable to enforce our rights or if we do not detect unauthorized use of our intellectual property. In addition, our patents or other intellectual property rights may be challenged, invalidated, circumvented or rendered unenforceable, and pending and future trademark and patent applications may not be approved. While it is our policy to enter into confidentiality agreements with our employees, contractors and other third parties to limit and control access to and disclosure of our trade secrets, intellectual property and confidential information, we may fail to enter into such agreements with all relevant entities and any such agreements may be breached, or this intellectual property may otherwise be disclosed or become known to our competitors, including through hacking, theft, or other misappropriation, including by employees, which could cause us to lose any competitive advantage resulting from these trade secrets, intellectual property and proprietary information. Accordingly, we cannot guarantee that the steps we have taken to protect our intellectual property will be adequate to prevent infringement of our rights or misappropriation of our technology, trade secrets or know-how.
paras.zh: 此外，若未能充分保护、维持、捍卫或执行我们的知识产权——包括专利、著作权、商标、商业秘密及专有技术——可能导致竞争优势丧失、市场地位削弱，并因未经授权的使用或侵权行为而遭受财务损失。我们依赖并预计将继续依赖专利、商标、商业秘密、著作权、保密程序、合同承诺及其他法律权利的组合来确立和保护我们的知识产权。然而，由于各种情况，我们为保护知识产权及其他权利所采取的措施可能并不充分。我们可能无法或选择不寻求或维持在美国或外国司法管辖区对我们的知识产权的某些类型的知识产权保护或注册，且我们所采取的措施可能无法阻止我们的竞争对手或其他第三方独立开发与我们的产品和服务相似或重复的产品、服务和技术。如果我们无法执行我们的权利，或未能发现对我们知识产权的未经授权使用，我们将无法保护我们的知识产权。此外，我们的专利或其他知识产权可能受到质疑、被宣告无效、被规避或变得不可执行，且待决和未来的商标及专利申请可能不会获得批准。尽管我们的政策是与我们的员工、承包商及其他第三方签订保密协议，以限制和控制对我们商业秘密、知识产权和机密信息的访问与披露，但我们可能未能与所有相关实体签订此类协议，且任何此类协议可能被违反，或者该等知识产权可能以其他方式被披露或为我们的竞争对手所知悉，包括通过黑客攻击、盗窃或其他不当挪用行为（包括由员工实施），这可能使我们丧失因这些商业秘密、知识产权和专有信息而产生的任何竞争优势。因此，我们无法保证我们为保护知识产权所采取的措施足以防止对我们权利的侵犯或对我们技术、商业秘密或专有技术的挪用。

paras.en: Additionally, to protect our intellectual property rights, we may be required to spend significant resources to monitor, defend, enforce and protect these rights. Monitoring unauthorized uses of our intellectual property is difficult and costly. We may not be able to detect unauthorized use of, or take appropriate steps to enforce, our intellectual property rights. Litigation may be necessary in the future to enforce our intellectual property rights and to protect our trade secrets, and any such litigation may be costly and time consuming, result in the diversion of time and attention of our management team, and may not be successful or could result in the impairment or loss of portions of our intellectual property. Furthermore, our efforts to enforce our intellectual property rights may be met with defenses, counterclaims and countersuits attacking the validity and enforceability of our intellectual property rights. Despite our efforts, we may not be able to prevent unauthorized use, copy, reverse engineering, misappropriation of our technology or intellectual property rights to create technology that compete with ours, or independent development of similar technologies. Insufficient protection could force us into costly and uncertain litigation or enforcement actions, allowing competitors to launch rival products and eroding our revenue and profitability.
paras.zh: 此外，为保护我们的知识产权，我们可能需要投入大量资源来监控、抗辩、执行和保护这些权利。监控对我们知识产权的未经授权使用既困难又成本高昂。我们可能无法发现对我们知识产权的未经授权使用，或采取适当措施执行我们的知识产权。未来可能有必要提起诉讼以执行我们的知识产权并保护我们的商业秘密，而任何此类诉讼可能成本高昂且耗时，导致我们管理团队的时间和注意力被分散，且可能不会成功，或可能导致我们部分知识产权受到损害或丧失。此外，我们执行知识产权的努力可能会遭遇抗辩、反诉和反请求，攻击我们知识产权的有效性和可执行性。尽管我们做出了努力，我们可能仍无法防止未经授权使用、复制、逆向工程、盗用我们的技术或知识产权以创造与我们竞争的技术，或独立开发类似技术。保护不足可能迫使我们陷入成本高昂且结果不确定的诉讼或执法行动，使竞争对手得以推出竞争产品，并侵蚀我们的收入和盈利能力。

paras.en: **Acquisitions, divestitures, or other strategic transactions we pursue may not achieve the anticipated benefits, synergies or strategic objectives.**
paras.zh: **我们所进行的收购、剥离或其他战略交易可能无法实现预期收益、协同效应或战略目标。**

paras.en: We may not achieve the anticipated benefits, synergies, or strategic objectives of any acquisition, divestiture, or other strategic transaction in a timely manner, or at all, including those we expect from the recent acquisition of xAI, the acquisition of spectrum assets and licenses from EchoStar in connection with our Starlink Mobile initiatives, our collaboration on Terafab with Tesla, Intel or any future partners, project and our recent collaboration with Cursor and any potential acquisition of Cursor, if consummated. Acquisitions, divestitures, or other strategic transactions may present unforeseen liabilities or disruptions to our operations, which could adversely impact our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects. We may assume unexpected obligations or incur costs associated with acquired businesses, including litigation, regulatory compliance, environmental liabilities, or contractual disputes, which could result in material losses or divert management focus from ongoing operations. We may issue a significant amount of equity in connection with future transactions.
paras.zh: 我们可能无法及时或根本无法实现任何收购、剥离或其他战略交易的预期收益、协同效应或战略目标，包括我们预期从近期收购 xAI、就我们的 Starlink Mobile 计划从 EchoStar 收购频谱资产和许可证、我们与 Tesla、Intel 或任何未来合作伙伴在 Terafab 项目上的合作，以及我们近期与 Cursor 的合作及对 Cursor 的任何潜在收购（如完成）中获得的收益。收购、剥离或其他战略交易可能带来不可预见的责任或对我们的运营造成干扰，从而可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。我们可能承担意外义务或产生与所收购业务相关的成本，包括诉讼、监管合规、环境责任或合同纠纷，这可能导致重大损失或使管理层无法专注于持续经营。我们可能就未来交易发行大量股权。

paras.en: Integrating acquired businesses, partnerships, or joint ventures may present significant challenges, including aligning operations, systems, and cultures, which could result in inefficiencies, increased costs, or failure to realize anticipated benefits. The process of integration is often complex and time-consuming, and we may encounter unforeseen difficulties in harmonizing business practices, integrating technologies and IT systems, retaining key personnel, or reconciling differences in corporate cultures and management philosophies. In addition, the integration of acquired entities or new partners exposes us to disruptions in, or unauthorized access to, our computer systems and data or may divert management attention and resources from our core operations, potentially impacting our ability to execute on other strategic initiatives or maintain existing customer relationships. We may also face challenges in achieving expected synergies, cost savings, or strategic objectives within anticipated timeframes, or at all, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects. If we are unable to successfully integrate acquisitions, partnerships, or joint ventures, or if the anticipated benefits of these transactions do not materialize as expected, we could experience operational disruptions, loss of key personnel or customers, increased costs, and diminished competitive position. Any failure to effectively integrate acquired businesses, partnerships, or joint ventures could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.
paras.zh: 整合被收购企业、合作伙伴关系或合资企业可能带来重大挑战，包括协调运营、系统与文化，这可能导致效率低下、成本增加或无法实现预期收益。整合过程往往复杂且耗时，我们可能在统一业务实践、整合技术与 IT 系统、留住关键人员或弥合企业文化与管理理念差异方面遇到无法预见的困难。此外，整合被收购实体或新合作伙伴会使我们的计算机系统和数据面临中断或未经授权访问的风险，或可能分散管理层对核心业务的注意力和资源，从而可能影响我们执行其他战略举措或维持现有客户关系的能力。我们还可能在预期时间框架内（或根本无法）实现预期协同效应、成本节约或战略目标方面面临挑战，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。如果我们无法成功整合收购、合作伙伴关系或合资企业，或者如果这些交易的预期收益未能如期实现，我们可能遭遇运营中断、关键人员或客户流失、成本增加以及竞争地位下降。任何未能有效整合被收购企业、合作伙伴关系或合资企业的情况，都可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: Similarly, divestitures could result in the loss of revenue, disruption of customer or partner relationships, or challenges in separating assets and personnel. There can be no assurance that we will be able to identify, consummate, or integrate future acquisitions, divestitures, or other strategic transactions on favorable terms, or at all, and any such activities may heighten our exposure to operational, financial, and regulatory risks unique to our industry.
paras.zh: 同样，资产剥离可能导致收入损失、客户或合作伙伴关系中断，或在分离资产和人员方面面临挑战。无法保证我们能够以有利条件（或根本无法）识别、完成或整合未来的收购、资产剥离或其他战略交易，而任何此类活动都可能加剧我们面临的本行业特有的运营、财务和监管风险。

paras.en: **We have experienced, and will likely continue to experience, development and manufacturing delays and damage or destruction during pre-launch operations, any of which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们在发射前运营中已经经历并将可能继续经历开发与制造延迟以及损坏或毁损，其中任何一项都可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: The development, manufacturing, and operation of launch vehicles and satellites are complex and capital-intensive activities that are subject to numerous risks. Our launch vehicles, satellites, and related systems have in the past experienced and may in the future experience delays, damage or destruction during design and manufacturing, including delays in fabrication, assembly, inspection, testing, and component qualification. These issues may arise from engineering challenges, supplier performance problems, quality control shortcomings, unexpected design modifications, or disruptions in our manufacturing facilities. Any of these factors may delay development or production schedules, increase costs, or result in hardware that must be reworked or replaced.
paras.zh: 运载火箭和卫星的开发、制造和运营是复杂且资本密集型的活动，面临众多风险。我们的运载火箭、卫星及相关系统过去曾经历、未来也可能经历设计和制造过程中的延迟、损坏或毁损，包括制造、组装、检验、测试和部件鉴定方面的延迟。这些问题可能源于工程挑战、供应商履约问题、质量控制缺陷、意外的设计修改或制造设施中断。任何这些因素都可能延迟开发或生产进度、增加成本，或导致硬件必须返工或更换。

paras.en: Our operations also involve significant risks during pre-launch preparation. Launch vehicles and satellites can be damaged or destroyed during transport, fueling, integration, or ground testing. Furthermore, the early retirement or inoperability of satellites or related infrastructure may require us to accelerate depreciation or recognize impairment charges, thereby adversely affecting our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects. Even minor anomalies may require extensive troubleshooting or repairs, resulting in launch delays, increased mission costs, or the loss of flight hardware. Because launch operations require coordination across multiple systems —including propulsion, avionics, ground infrastructure, and third-party range providers—issues in any one area can lead to postponements or mission cancellations.
paras.zh: 我们的运营在发射前准备阶段也涉及重大风险。运载火箭和卫星可能在运输、加注燃料、集成或地面测试过程中受损或被毁。此外，卫星或相关基础设施的提前退役或无法运行，可能要求我们加速计提折旧或确认减值费用，从而对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和未来前景产生不利影响。即使轻微异常也可能需要大量排查或维修，导致发射延迟、任务成本增加或飞行硬件损失。由于发射运营需要多个系统协同——包括推进系统、航空电子设备、地面基础设施和第三方靶场服务商——任何单一环节的问题都可能导致推迟或任务取消。

paras.en: **Our ability to continue and expand launch and satellite operations depends upon our ability to obtain new and leverage existing U.S. export control and sanctions authorizations, and any significant changes to the geopolitical landscape or U.S. government regulatory approach to licensing could materially and adversely impact our international business operations by compromising existing licenses or limiting our ability to engage in commercial dealings in or involving geopolitically sensitive countries.**
paras.zh: **我们持续开展并扩大发射和卫星运营的能力，取决于我们能否获得新的美国出口管制和制裁授权并利用现有授权；地缘政治格局或美国政府许可监管方式的任何重大变化，都可能损害现有许可证或限制我们在或涉及地缘政治敏感国家开展商业交易的能力，从而对我们的国际业务运营产生重大不利影响。**

paras.en: The launch and satellite operations are subject to stringent export control and economic and trade sanctions laws, including the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (“ITAR”), the Export Administration Regulations, and sanctions administered and enforced by the U.S. Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (“OFAC”). Under U.S. export control laws, we are required to obtain export authorizations from the Departments of Commerce or State to export or share any controlled goods, technology, or software with foreign persons, including foreign person employees, or to foreign destinations. The availability of such authorizations may be impacted by significant changes to the geopolitical landscape. The U.S. government may revise export control regulations, restrict exports to new or additional locations, or otherwise change its approach to licensing in ways that, while outside of our control, materially impact our international supply chain, existing export licenses, and business operations.
