paras.en: In addition, our bylaws will provide that any person or entity purchasing or otherwise acquiring or holding any interest in shares of stock of the Company shall be deemed to have irrevocably and unconditionally waived any right it may have to a trial by jury in any Internal Dispute. This will prevent a shareholder from requesting that a jury decide disputed issues of fact and may discourage lawsuits against us and our directors, officers, other managerial officials, and other employees.
paras.zh: 此外，我们的章程将规定，任何购买或以其他方式取得或持有公司任何股份权益的个人或实体，应被视为已不可撤销且无条件地放弃其在任何内部争议中可能享有的由陪审团审理的任何权利。这将阻止股东请求由陪审团裁决有争议的事实问题，并可能抑制针对我们及我们的董事、高级职员、其他管理人员和其他员工的诉讼。

paras.en: These dispute resolution rules that our bylaws will establish for Internal Disputes, as well as the Arbitration Rules to the extent they will apply, are different from the procedural rules that would normally apply to the litigation of Internal Disputes in state or federal court. They may prevent a shareholder from availing itself of procedural protections that would be available under litigation in state or federal court and may render available or affect adversely the rights and remedies available to shareholders in such proceedings. Particularly in the case of arbitration, including its prohibition on class or collective actions, these dispute resolution rules may also result in greater costs being imposed on shareholders to litigate Internal Disputes, and in some cases involving lower amounts in controversy, the additional costs that may be imposed on shareholders to litigate Internal Disputes could exceed the potential recovery from such litigation.
paras.zh: 我们的章程将就内部争议确立的这些争议解决规则，以及在适用范围内将适用的仲裁规则，不同于通常适用于州法院或联邦法院内部争议诉讼的程序规则。它们可能使股东无法利用在州法院或联邦法院诉讼中可获得的程序性保护，并可能使股东在该等程序中可获得的权利和救济变得可用或受到不利影响。特别是在仲裁的情况下，包括其禁止集体或代表人诉讼的规定，这些争议解决规则还可能导致股东在内部争议诉讼中承担更高的成本，并且在某些争议金额较低的案件中，可能对股东施加的内部争议诉讼额外成本可能超过该等诉讼的潜在追偿金额。

paras.en: Although we maintain that our bylaws, including the Forum Selection Bylaw (and its selection of the Business Court as the sole and exclusive forum for all actions brought under federal securities laws) accord with the law and are enforceable, it is possible that one or more provisions of our bylaws, including those regarding the exclusive forum for Internal Disputes, mandatory arbitration for Other Disputes, or waiver of the right to proceed on a class, mass, or collective basis, may be found by a court to be inapplicable or unenforceable. In addition, the mandatory arbitration provision in our bylaws could be subject to litigation or regulatory scrutiny, which could result in the provision being enjoined or in additional costs or uncertainty. In such case, we may incur additional costs or delays associated with resolving such actions, including in other jurisdictions, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, or results of operations.
paras.zh: 尽管我们坚持认为我们的章程，包括论坛选择章程（及其选择商事法院作为根据联邦证券法提起的所有诉讼的唯一和专属论坛）符合法律且可执行，但我们的章程中的一项或多项条款，包括有关内部争议专属论坛、其他争议强制仲裁或放弃以集体、大规模或代表人方式提起诉讼的权利的条款，有可能被法院认定为不适用或不可执行。此外，我们章程中的强制仲裁条款可能受到诉讼或监管审查，这可能导致该条款被禁止或导致额外成本或不确定性。在此情况下，我们可能因解决该等诉讼（包括在其他司法管辖区）而产生额外成本或延误，这可能对我们的业务、财务状况或经营业绩产生不利影响。

paras.en: - the development and deployment of Starship in accordance with our anticipated schedule (including commencement of payload delivery to orbit in 2026) and launch cadence and our ability to achieve expected performance, reusability, and cost efficiencies;

paras.en: - our ability to solve novel issues and navigate and monetize technologies and environments that have never been accessed or economized before;

paras.en: - our ability to obtain sufficient power, GPUs, and other critical components and manage our supply chain to support our operations and growth;
paras.zh: - 我们获取充足电力、GPU 及其他关键组件并管理供应链以支持我们运营和增长的能力；

paras.en: - our ability to obtain and maintain required regulatory approvals, licenses and spectrum authorizations in the United States and internationally, and the timing, scope, and conditions of such approvals;
paras.zh: - 我们在美国及国际上获得并维持所需监管批准、许可证和频谱授权的能力，以及此类批准的时间、范围和条件；

paras.en: - the competitive landscape in the industries in which we operate and our ability to compete effectively;
paras.zh: - 我们所处行业的竞争格局以及我们有效竞争的能力；

paras.en: - the implementation, interpretation, and impact of current or future regulations including laws and regulations relating to space operations, communications, AI, data privacy, and other areas;
paras.zh: - 当前或未来法规的实施、解释和影响，包括与太空运营、通信、AI、数据隐私及其他领域相关的法律法规；

paras.en: - our ability to realize benefits and manage risks of being a public company; and
paras.zh: - 我们实现上市公司收益并管理相关风险的能力；以及

paras.en: - general economic conditions.

paras.zh: 本招股说明书中的前瞻性陈述仅代表截至本招股说明书日期或本文件另行指定的其他日期的情况。除法律要求外，我们不承担更新这些陈述的任何义务，并提醒您不要过度依赖这些陈述。前瞻性陈述并非对未来业绩的保证，且涉及风险和不确定性。我们基于当前对未来事件的预期和假设作出这些前瞻性陈述。涵盖多年时间跨度或未知时间表的预测、目标、里程碑和预期，在可预测性方面本身就涉及更高的风险，实际结果可能与当前预期存在重大差异。尽管我们的管理层认为这些预期和假设是合理的，但它们本身受到重大的商业、经济、竞争、监管、技术、环境、政治及其他风险、或有事项和不确定性的影响，这些因素难以预测，且许多超出我们的控制范围。这些风险、或有事项和不确定性及其他重要因素在本招股说明书的“风险因素”和“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析”章节中有所描述。如果上述一项或多项风险或不确定性发生，或相关基础假设被证明不正确，我们的实际结果、业绩、成就或计划可能与任何前瞻性陈述中明示或暗示的内容存在重大差异。此外，由于我们经营所处的市场快速演变且某些市场竞争高度激烈，我们可能不时根据技术发展、竞争动态、监管变化或其他因素迅速调整、修改或改变我们的战略优先级、资本配置、产品或服务重点或运营举措，这可能导致实际结果与本文件所载前瞻性陈述中明示或暗示的内容存在重大差异。新的风险不时出现，某些风险本质上为我们所未知，我们的管理层无法预测所有此类风险。许多可能对我们或我们的前景产生重大不利影响的风险和不确定性超出我们的控制范围，或涉及我们业务战略中时间跨度较长或涉及前所未有的尝试的部分。这可能使对某些风险的评估更加困难，您应在评估对我们 A 类普通股的投资时将这些不确定性纳入考量。本招股说明书中的所有前瞻性陈述均受本节警示性声明的整体明确限定。

paras.en: We will receive approximately $74.4 billion of net proceeds from this offering (or $85.7 billion if the underwriters exercise their option to purchase additional shares of Class A common stock in full), based upon the initial public offering price of $135.00 per share after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us. We intend to use the net proceeds from this offering to fund our growth strategy, including the expansion of our AI compute infrastructure, enhancements to our launch infrastructure and launch vehicles, increases in the scale and capacity of our satellite constellations, and any remaining amounts for general corporate purposes.
paras.zh: 基于每股 $135.00 的首次公开发行价格，在扣除承销折扣和佣金以及我们应付的预计发行费用后，我们将从本次发行中获得约 $74.4 billion 的净收益（若承销商全额行使购买额外 A 类普通股的选择权，则为 $85.7 billion）。我们拟将本次发行的净收益用于为我们的增长战略提供资金，包括扩展我们的 AI 算力基础设施、增强我们的发射基础设施和运载火箭、扩大我们卫星星座的规模和容量，以及将任何剩余金额用于一般公司用途。

paras.en: The expected use of net proceeds from this offering represents our intentions based upon our present plans and business conditions. We cannot predict with certainty all of the particular uses for the net proceeds from this offering or the amounts that we will actually spend on each of the uses set forth above. Accordingly, our management will have significant flexibility in applying the net proceeds from this offering. The timing and amount of our actual expenditures will be based on many factors, including cash flows and the anticipated growth of our business.
paras.zh: 本次发行净收益的预期用途代表了我们基于当前计划和业务状况的意图。我们无法确定地预测本次发行净收益的所有具体用途，也无法确定我们实际将在上述各项用途上支出的金额。因此，我们的管理层在运用本次发行净收益方面将拥有较大的灵活性。我们实际支出的时间和金额将取决于诸多因素，包括现金流和我们业务的预期增长。

paras.en: We do not anticipate declaring or paying any cash dividends to holders of our common stock in the foreseeable future. We currently intend to retain future earnings, if any, to finance the growth of our business. Our future dividend policy is within the discretion of our board and will depend upon then-existing conditions, including our results of operations, financial condition, capital requirements, investment opportunities, statutory restrictions on our ability to pay dividends, restrictions in our existing and any future debt agreements and other factors our board may deem relevant. Covenants under our Credit Agreements also restrict our ability to pay dividends, and we may enter into credit agreements or other borrowing arrangements in the future that restrict our ability to declare or pay cash dividends or make distributions in the future. Please refer to “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Liquidity and Capital Resources” for a description of the restrictions on our ability to pay dividends.
paras.zh: 我们预计在可预见的未来不会向我们普通股持有人宣布或支付任何现金股息。我们目前打算保留未来的收益（如有），用于为我们的业务增长提供资金。我们未来的股息政策由董事会酌情决定，并将取决于届时存在的条件，包括我们的经营业绩、财务状况、资本需求、投资机会、对我们支付股息能力的法定限制、我们现有及未来任何债务协议中的限制以及董事会可能认为相关的其他因素。我们信贷协议项下的契约亦限制我们支付股息的能力，且我们未来可能签订信贷协议或其他借款安排，从而限制我们未来宣布或支付现金股息或进行分配的能力。有关对我们支付股息能力的限制的说明，请参阅“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——流动性与资本资源”。

paras.en: Please refer to “Risk Factors—Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure, Ownership of our Class A Common Stock and This Offering—Our ability to provide returns to shareholders will depend on appreciation in our share price, as we do not plan to pay dividends for the foreseeable future.”

paras.en: Purchasers of the Class A common stock in this offering will experience immediate and substantial dilution in the net tangible book value per share of the Class A common stock for accounting purposes. After giving effect to the Class C Reclassification and the Preferred Conversion as if such reclassification and conversion occurred on March 31, 2026, our pro forma net tangible book value as of March 31, 2026 was approximately $28,251 million, or $2.25per share of common stock. Pro forma net tangible book value per share is determined by dividing our tangible net worth (tangible assets less total liabilities) by the total number of outstanding shares of all classes of common stock outstanding immediately prior to the completion of this offering. After giving effect to the sale of shares of Class A common stock in this offering and the payment of underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses by us, our adjusted pro forma net tangible book value as of March 31, 2026 would have been approximately $102,697 million, or $7.85 per share of common stock. This represents an immediate increase in the net tangible book value of $5.60 per share of common stock to Mr. Musk and other existing investors and an immediate dilution (i.e., the difference between the offering price and the adjusted pro forma net tangible book value immediately after this offering) to new investors purchasing shares of Class A common stock in this offering of $127.15 per share. paras.en: (2) If the underwriters exercise their option to purchase additional shares in full, the total consideration paid by our new investors would be approximately $86,249,999,880 (or 51.5%).
paras.zh: (2) 如果承销商全额行使购买额外股份的选择权，我们的新投资者支付的总对价将约为 $86,249,999,880（或 51.5%）。

paras.en: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our audited consolidated financial statements and the related notes and other financial information included elsewhere in this prospectus. In addition to historical consolidated financial information, the following discussion contains forward-looking statements that reflect our plans, estimates, and beliefs. Our actual results could differ materially from those discussed in the forward-looking statements. You should review the sections titled “Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements” for a discussion of forward-looking statements and “Risk Factors” for a discussion of factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from the results described in or implied by the forward-looking statements contained in the following discussion and analysis and elsewhere in this prospectus. Our audited consolidated financial statements and related notes have been prepared to reflect the retrospective combination of the companies for all periods presented as the acquisitions of xAI and X Holdings were accounted for as transactions between entities under common control.
paras.zh: 以下关于我们财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析，应与本招股说明书其他部分所载经审计合并财务报表及相关附注和其他财务信息一并阅读。除历史合并财务信息外，以下讨论还包含反映我们计划、估计和信念的前瞻性陈述。我们的实际结果可能与前瞻性陈述中讨论的结果存在重大差异。您应查阅标题为“关于前瞻性陈述的警示说明”的章节，以了解有关前瞻性陈述的讨论；并查阅“风险因素”章节，以了解可能导致实际结果与以下讨论与分析及本招股说明书其他部分所载前瞻性陈述中描述或暗示的结果存在重大差异的因素。由于对 xAI 和 X Holdings 的收购已按同一控制下实体之间的交易进行会计处理，我们的经审计合并财务报表及相关附注的编制已反映所有列报期间各公司的追溯合并。

paras.en: Our mission is to build the systems and technologies necessary to make life multiplanetary, to understand the true nature of the universe, and to extend the light of consciousness to the stars. To do this, we have formed the most ambitious, vertically integrated innovation engine on (and off) Earth with unmatched capabilities to rapidly manufacture and launch space-based communications that connect the world, to harness the Sun to power a truth-seeking artificial intelligence that advances scientific discovery, and ultimately to build a base on the Moon and cities on other planets.
paras.zh: 我们的使命是构建必要的系统与技术，使生命得以在多行星生存，理解宇宙的真实本质，并将意识之光延伸至群星。为此，我们在地球上（以及地球之外）打造了最具雄心的垂直一体化创新引擎，具备无可匹敌的能力，能够快速制造并发射连接世界的天基通信系统，驾驭太阳能为追求真理、推动科学发现的人工智能提供动力，并最终在月球建立基地、在其他行星建立城市。

paras.en: Starship Flight Test
paras.zh: 星舰飞行测试

paras.en: Founded in 2002, SpaceX is the only company building the integrated hardware and software infrastructure of the future across space, connectivity, and AI. At our core, we are builders. We design, manufacture, launch, and operate products and services built on cutting-edge technologies, including the world’s most advanced rockets and spacecraft. We safely and reliably transport astronauts, satellites, and other payloads on missions that benefit life on Earth. Since 2023, we have launched more than 80% of mass to orbit for the world each year with an over 99% mission success rate with Falcon rockets. We also operate a high-speed, low-latency global broadband data and communications network powered by approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, delivering connectivity to million s of consumer, enterprise, and government customers across 164 countries, territories, and other markets, as of March 31, 2026. Using our dedicated satellite-to-mobile constellation, we offer connectivity services, supplementing terrestrial networks and substantially reducing mobile “dead zones” across approximately 30 countries.
paras.zh: SpaceX 成立于 2002 年，是唯一一家在太空、连接和 AI 领域构建未来软硬件一体化基础设施的公司。我们的核心是建设者。我们设计、制造、发射和运营基于前沿技术的产品与服务，包括全球最先进的火箭和航天器。我们安全可靠地运送宇航员、卫星及其他有效载荷，执行造福地球生命的任务。自 2023 年以来，我们每年以 Falcon 火箭为全球发射了超过 80% 的入轨质量，任务成功率超过 99%。我们还运营一个高速、低延迟的全球宽带数据与通信网络，由约 9,600 颗低地球轨道上的 Starlink 宽带和移动卫星提供支持，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，为 164 个国家、地区及其他市场的数百万消费者、企业和政府客户提供连接。利用我们专用的卫星直连移动星座，我们提供连接服务，补充地面网络，并大幅减少约 30 个国家的移动“盲区”。

paras.en: With the potential to improve both space exploration and life on Earth, AI accelerates SpaceX’s mission to make life multiplanetary, to understand the true nature of the universe, and to extend the light of consciousness to the stars. xAI, which was founded in 2023 and acquired by SpaceX in early 2026, is now an integral pillar of our vertically integrated company. We are rapidly constructing AI compute infrastructure—starting on Earth with the goal of extending to space—at industry-leading pace and cost efficiency. Our infrastructure supports training and inference for Grok, which has emerged as one of the world’s most advanced frontier models. Grok is designed as a truth-seeking AI model, built on our founder Elon Musk’s mission to enable humanity to understand the universe. We believe that accomplishing this mission requires a truth-seeking approach to AI. We define truth seeking as the active, relentless pursuit of what is objectively true about reality, and grounded in evidence, logic, empirical data, and first principles thinking. Our goal is to understand and explain what the universe appears to be doing, as accurately as current knowledge allows. Within two years of its initial model release, Grok achieved frontier-level performance in scientific reasoning, as measured by its GPQA Diamond score, an industry benchmark that evaluates AI models on a standardized set of questions written and validated by experts, on a faster timeline than reported by other leading model providers. Grok also benefits from integration with X, our real-time information, entertainment, and free speech platform, which serves as a foundational distribution and data engine for our AI ecosystem and further enhances Grok’s truth-seeking objective.
paras.zh: AI 具有改善太空探索和地球生命的潜力，加速了 SpaceX 的使命——让生命多行星化、理解宇宙的真正本质，并将意识之光延伸至星辰。xAI 成立于 2023 年，于 2026 年初被 SpaceX 收购，现已成为我们垂直整合公司不可或缺的支柱。我们正以行业领先的速度和成本效率快速构建 AI 算力基础设施——从地球起步，目标是延伸至太空。我们的基础设施支持 Grok 的训练和推理，Grok 已成为全球最先进的前沿模型之一。Grok 被设计为一个追求真相的 AI 模型，建立在我们的创始人 Elon Musk 的使命之上，即让人类理解宇宙。我们相信，实现这一使命需要对 AI 采取追求真相的方法。我们将追求真相定义为积极、不懈地追求关于现实的客观真实，并以证据、逻辑、经验数据和第一性原理思维为基础。我们的目标是，在现有知识允许的范围内，尽可能准确地理解和解释宇宙似乎正在做的事情。在其初始模型发布后的两年内，Grok 在科学推理方面达到了前沿水平，以 GPQA Diamond 分数衡量——这是一项行业基准，通过一组由专家编写和验证的标准化问题来评估 AI 模型——其时间线快于其他领先模型提供商所报告的。Grok 还得益于与 X 的整合，X 是我们的实时信息、娱乐和言论自由平台，作为我们 AI 生态系统的基础分发和数据引擎，并进一步增强 Grok 的追求真相目标。

paras.en: We believe that space represents the largest economic frontier in human history, unlocking unprecedented opportunities in orbit and on Earth. Earth has limits, so we must build infrastructure and industries in space, expanding human capabilities to improve life on Earth and to establish life beyond. Connectivity infrastructure in space is designed to help everyone on Earth have access to education, healthcare, entertainment, and communications, and to enable people to overcome many traditional limits, such as physical and political borders. We believe AI infrastructure in space can utilize the virtually limitless power of the Sun and thereby enable the use of AI as a transformative force for understanding the universe and improving the daily lives of all humans. We believe the convergence of these areas will enable an unprecedented expansion in the global economy, leading to an age of abundance. Our innovations and technological advancements are redefining industries on Earth, while we aim to create new ones on the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We are truly building the infrastructure of the future.
paras.zh: 我们相信，太空代表着人类历史上最大的经济前沿，在轨道上和地球上释放出前所未有的机遇。地球有其极限，因此我们必须在太空中建设基础设施和产业，拓展人类的能力，以改善地球上的生活，并在地球之外建立生命。太空中的连接基础设施旨在帮助地球上的每个人都能获得教育、医疗、娱乐和通信，并使人们能够克服许多传统限制，例如物理边界和政治边界。我们相信，太空中的 AI 基础设施可以利用几乎无限的太阳能，从而使 AI 成为理解宇宙和改善全人类日常生活的变革性力量。我们相信，这些领域的融合将推动全球经济实现前所未有的扩张，引领一个富足时代。我们的创新和技术进步正在重新定义地球上的各个行业，同时我们的目标是在月球、火星及更远的地方创造新的行业。我们正在真正建设未来的基础设施。

paras.en: SpaceX is the only company that has cracked the code on accessing space at scale, revolutionizing an industry characterized by decades of stagnation, risk aversion, and economically perverse cost structures. SpaceX upended this paradigm through the application of first-principles thinking, which rejects industry assumptions and builds solutions based on the fundamental laws of physics. Our intense, mission-driven, engineering-first culture and focus on extreme vertical integration have propelled us to achieve what many deemed impossible. We have demonstrated the ability to achieve groundbreaking technological innovations with speed, quality control, and precision. We pioneered high-cadence, reliable, and affordable access to space with our Falcon family of rockets, with a goal to transform the rocket launch industry into airline-like operations. In 2015, we established at least a 10-year lead over the industry by successfully landing our first Falcon 9 booster back from space before anyone else. We have continued to invest significantly in further increasing our lead by pursuing full and rapid reusability at scale, including investing over $15 billion in our next-generation rocket, Starship.
paras.zh: SpaceX 是唯一一家破解了规模化进入太空难题的公司，彻底改变了一个数十年来停滞不前、规避风险且成本结构在经济上不合理的行业。SpaceX 通过运用第一性原理思维颠覆了这一范式，这种思维拒绝行业假设，并基于物理学的基本定律构建解决方案。我们强烈的、以使命为驱动、工程优先的文化以及对极致垂直整合的专注，推动我们实现了许多人认为不可能的事情。我们已经展示了以速度、质量控制和精度实现突破性技术创新的能力。我们通过猎鹰系列火箭开创了高频率、可靠且可负担的太空进入方式，目标是推动火箭发射行业转型为类似航空公司的运营模式。2015 年，我们成功将首枚猎鹰 9 号助推器从太空回收着陆，领先其他任何人，从而确立了相对于行业至少 10 年的领先优势。我们持续大举投资以进一步扩大领先优势，追求规模化全面快速可重复使用，包括在我们的下一代火箭 Starship 上投资超过 $15 billion。

paras.en: We believe rocket launches and landings should be as routine and commonplace as airplanes taking off and landing. To achieve this sort of cadence, our iterative approach emphasizes rapid designing, testing, and process optimization, putting flight hardware in the flight environment as often as possible. This allows us to accelerate our learning by repeatedly using and improving our systems. This has resulted in a significantly higher flight rate at costs that are much lower than launch programs that existed before SpaceX. For example, according to NASA, the first version of Falcon 9 in 2010 had a launch cost of approximately $2,700 per kilogram, which represented a reduction of approximately 85% compared to the historical average launch cost per kilogram of $18,500. The first version of Falcon Heavy in 2018 further reduced this cost to approximately $1,400 per kilogram, a reduction of approximately 92% compared to the historical average cost. With the future deployment of Starship, which is designed to be the world’s first fully and rapidly reusable spacecraft, we aim to further reduce the cost to reach orbit by 99% or more relative to the historical average launch cost. Central to our cost advantage is the reusability of key hardware—most notably boosters—which we recover, refurbish, and refly many times instead of discarding after single use. This dramatically lowers per-launch costs by minimizing hardware replacement expenses and spreading fixed production costs across repeated uses. Space flight that historically cost billion s per launch now costs in the tens of million s, fundamentally reducing the cost of space access, providing the opportunity to build new enterprises in space.
paras.zh: 我们认为火箭发射和着陆应当像飞机起降一样常规和普遍。为实现这种节奏，我们的迭代方法强调快速设计、测试和流程优化，尽可能频繁地将飞行硬件置于飞行环境中。这使我们能够通过反复使用和改进系统来加速学习。由此，我们实现了显著更高的飞行频率，且成本远低于 SpaceX 之前存在的发射项目。例如，根据 NASA 的数据，2010 年第一版 Falcon 9 的发射成本约为每公斤$2,700，相比历史平均每公斤发射成本$18,500 降低了约 85%。2018 年第一版 Falcon Heavy 进一步将这一成本降至约每公斤$1,400，相比历史平均成本降低了约 92%。随着未来 Starship 的部署——其设计目标是成为世界上首个完全且快速可重复使用的航天器——我们的目标是将入轨成本相对于历史平均发射成本进一步降低 99%或更多。我们成本优势的核心在于关键硬件的可重复使用性——最显著的是助推器——我们将其回收、翻新并多次复飞，而不是单次使用后丢弃。通过最大限度地减少硬件更换费用并将固定生产成本分摊到多次使用中，这大幅降低了每次发射的成本。历史上每次发射耗资数十亿美元的太空飞行现在仅需数千万美元，从根本上降低了太空进入成本，为在太空中建立新企业提供了机会。

paras.en: Similarly, xAI has cracked the code in the complexities of building and scaling AI compute infrastructure, becoming the first company to deploy a coherent gigawatt-scale AI training cluster. We believe the combination of our proprietary AI infrastructure capability, our truth-seeking frontier model, Grok, and our access to real-time data on X creates a formidable competitive advantage, allowing us to maintain a leading position in the development of advanced artificial intelligence. This advantage stems from our complete vertical integration and the common vision infused by our founder, Elon Musk. In just a few years, we have demonstrated an ability to build coherent compute at scale and rapid speed with lower cost. COLOSSUS and COLOSSUS II collectively provide approximately 1.0 gigawatt of compute power, with additional power capacity available for data center operations. We believe speed is a competitive advantage. In order to bring compute clusters online as fast as possible, we employ a vertically integrated, nimble approach to construction. At COLOSSUS, we brought online the first cluster of approximately 100,000 H100 processors, approximately 130 megawatts of compute power, in just 122 days, repurposing the shell of an existing factory. At COLOSSUS II, we brought online the first cluster of approximately 110,000 GB200 processors, approximately 210 megawatts of compute power, even faster in 91 days. As an illustrative comparison, an industry benchmark to bring online a 100 megawatt greenfield data center is approximately two years. Furthermore, in the case of COLOSSUS II, following the initial cluster, we brought online the second cluster of 110,000 GB300 processors and 220 megawatts of compute power in 64 days, demonstrating our ability to rapidly scale our facilities once built. We expect that once fully operational, the next phase of expansion at COLOSSUS II will bring online at least 220,000 additional GB300 processors and over 400 additional megawatts of compute power. We also demonstrated asignificant improvement in cost efficiency, achieving data center construction costs for COLOSSUS II that are considerably lower than industry benchmarks on a per megawatt basis.
paras.zh: 同样，xAI 已攻克了构建和扩展 AI 算力基础设施的复杂难题，成为首家部署连贯的吉瓦级 AI 训练集群的公司。我们相信，我们专有的 AI 基础设施能力、我们追求真相的前沿模型 Grok，以及我们对 X 上实时数据的访问权限，三者结合创造了强大的竞争优势，使我们能够在先进人工智能的开发中保持领先地位。这一优势源于我们完全的垂直整合以及我们的创始人 Elon Musk 所注入的共同愿景。在短短几年内，我们已经展示了以更低成本、大规模、快速构建连贯算力的能力。COLOSSUS 和 COLOSSUS II 合计提供约 1.0 吉瓦的算力，另有额外电力容量可用于数据中心运营。我们相信速度是一种竞争优势。为了尽快让算力集群上线，我们采用垂直整合、灵活敏捷的建设方式。在 COLOSSUS，我们在短短 122 天内让首个约 100,000 块 H100 处理器、约 130 兆瓦算力的集群上线，并改造利用了现有工厂的外壳。在 COLOSSUS II，我们在更快的 91 天内让首个约 110,000 块 GB200 处理器、约 210 兆瓦算力的集群上线。作为说明性对比，让一个 100 兆瓦的新建数据中心上线的行业基准约为两年。此外，在 COLOSSUS II 的案例中，在首个集群之后，我们在 64 天内让第二个由 110,000 块 GB300 处理器和 220 兆瓦算力组成的集群上线，展示了我们一旦建成即可快速扩展设施的能力。我们预计，一旦全面投入运营，COLOSSUS II 的下一阶段扩建将新增至少 220,000 块 GB300 处理器和超过 400 兆瓦的算力。我们还展示了成本效率的显著提升，COLOSSUS II 的数据中心建设成本按每兆瓦计算大幅低于行业基准。

paras.en: We are able to deploy power and compute significantly faster than other AI companies through first-principles thinking, behind-the-meter power generation, coupled with what we believe is the world’s largest network of sustainable battery storage systems, and innovations in advanced liquid cooling, high-density rack layouts, and efficient networking. Our facilities also incorporate innovative design features that limit the effects on regional electricity pricing for neighbors and include advanced water cleaning, reclamation, and recycling processes to support sustainable operations. We partner with utilities and communities to connect to and enhance the grid over time, and do so while pledging to cover costs of all new power delivery infrastructure upgrades to service our data centers, including adequate network upgrade costs, to ensure that these expenses are not passed on to the ordinary household. Our ability to rapidly and cost-effectively scale with the latest processors keeps us ahead of competitors who deploy traditional and more expensive methods. As a result, we believe COLOSSUS II became one of the world’s first data centers to deploy GB200s and GB300s, the most advanced AI processors available at the time, at significant scale, and is currently powering training for our next frontier models, including Grok-5. Furthermore, through our Terafab initiative together with Tesla to build a manufacturing facility capable of producing 1 terawatt per year of compute hardware, we intend to further extend our vertical integration to chip design and manufacturing to alleviate potential future chip shortages at SpaceX, optimize compute performance, and potentially reduce overall compute costs. Intel, which has the ability to design, fabricate, and package ultra-high-performance chips at scale, also joined the Terafab project in early April 2026. Our shovels-to-tokens approach allows us to train and iterate our frontier models at high velocity, accelerating development cycles, eliminating external bottlenecks, and driving rapid, continuous improvements in model performance.
paras.zh: 我们能够通过第一性原理思维、表后发电，以及我们认为的全球最大的可持续电池储能系统网络，再加上先进液冷、高密度机架布局和高效网络方面的创新，以显著快于其他 AI 公司的速度部署电力和算力。我们的设施还采用创新设计特征，限制对邻近地区区域电价的影响，并包含先进的水清洗、回收和再循环流程，以支持可持续运营。我们与公用事业公司和社区合作，随着时间推移接入并增强电网，同时承诺承担为服务我们的数据中心而进行的所有新电力输送基础设施升级的成本，包括充足的网络升级成本，以确保这些费用不会转嫁给普通家庭。我们能够以快速且具成本效益的方式采用最新处理器进行扩展，这使我们领先于采用传统且更昂贵方法的竞争对手。因此，我们认为 COLOSSUS II 成为全球首批大规模部署 GB200 和 GB300（当时可用的最先进 AI 处理器）的数据中心之一，目前正在为我们的下一代前沿模型（包括 Grok-5）的训练提供算力。此外，通过我们与 Tesla 共同建设的 Terafab 计划——建设一座能够每年生产 1 太瓦算力硬件的制造设施——我们打算进一步将垂直整合延伸至芯片设计和制造，以缓解 SpaceX 未来潜在的芯片短缺、优化算力性能，并有可能降低整体算力成本。Intel 具备大规模设计、制造和封装超高性能芯片的能力，也于 2026 年 4 月初加入了 Terafab 项目。我们从“铲子到代币”的方法使我们能够高速训练和迭代我们的前沿模型，加速开发周期，消除外部瓶颈，并推动模型性能快速、持续地提升。

paras.en: We were the first private company to develop and launch a liquid-fuel rocket to reach orbit with the successful launch of Falcon 1 in 2008. In 2019, we were the first to begin deploying a large-scale LEO broadband satellite constellation. In February 2026, we acquired xAI, the first company to build a gigawatt-scale AI training cluster and largest coherent supercomputer. The graphic below illustrates key milestones for ourbusiness.
paras.zh: 我们是第一家开发并发射液体燃料火箭进入轨道的私营公司，于 2008 年成功发射 Falcon 1。2019 年，我们率先开始部署大规模 LEO 宽带卫星星座。2026 年 2 月，我们收购了 xAI，后者是首家建成吉瓦级 AI 训练集群和最大相干超级计算机的公司。下图展示了我们业务的关键里程碑。

paras.en: #### Our Repeatable Business Model
paras.zh: #### 我们可复制的商业模式

paras.en: Our business model is built on a repeatable, engineering-driven framework that combines our unparalleled launch capabilities, extreme vertical integration, rapid iteration, and disciplined capital investment to create durable, large-scale businesses. We execute this framework through the following core principles:
paras.zh: 我们的商业模式建立在一个可复制、工程驱动的框架之上，该框架结合了我们无与伦比的发射能力、极致的垂直整合、快速迭代和严谨的资本投资，以创建持久、大规模的业务。我们通过以下核心原则执行这一框架：

paras.en: 1. Leverage our unparalleled launch capabilities to enable massive scale. Our rockets—with unmatched launch cadence, best-in-class reliability, and dramatically reduced cost-to-orbit—are the foundation that we expect will enable us to create economic opportunities in space and deliver a diversified portfolio of services. Our launch capabilities enable large-scale deployment of assets that would not otherwise be economically viable.
paras.zh: 1. 发挥我们无与伦比的发射能力，实现大规模规模化。我们的火箭——凭借无可匹敌的发射频率、业界一流的可靠性以及大幅降低的入轨成本——是我们预期能够在太空创造经济机会并交付多元化服务组合的基础。我们的发射能力使原本在经济上不可行的大规模资产部署成为可能。

paras.en: 2. Identify and create new trillion-dollar market opportunities. We focus on market opportunities that are useful for humanity and that present trillion-dollar opportunities, including global broadband and mobile connectivity for consumers, enterprises, and governments; and AI applications and computational infrastructure. We prioritize opportunities where structural inefficiencies or legacy technological limitations have constrained supply.
paras.zh: 2. 识别并创造新的万亿美元市场机会。我们专注于对人类有用且蕴含万亿美元机遇的市场机会，包括面向消费者、企业和政府的全球宽带与移动连接；以及 AI 应用和算力基础设施。我们优先关注那些因结构性低效或传统技术局限而供给受限的机会。

paras.en: 3. Design a solution with world-class engineering and first-principles thinking. We apply physics-based engineering and first-principles thinking to design products and systems from the ground up—boiling things down to the most fundamental truths and reasoning up from there. This helps us drive massive, step-function improvements in performance, scalability, and cost.
paras.zh: 3. 以世界级工程和第一性原理思维设计解决方案。我们运用基于物理学的工程方法和第一性原理思维，从零开始设计产品和系统——将事物归结为最基本的真理，并由此向上推理。这有助于我们在性能、可扩展性和成本方面实现巨大的阶跃式改进。

paras.en: 4. Apply “The Algorithm” (make less dumb, delete, optimize, accelerate, automate). We operate under a set of core execution principles that we refer to as “The Algorithm,” a five-step iterative process that we use as our guiding principles day-to-day. We make the requirements less dumb, delete unnecessary processes or parts (embracing the principle that the best part is no part), only then optimize the necessary processes or parts, and then accelerate cycle time (many entities have launched once; no one other than us has ever launched over 100 times per year), and automate only proven processes after the first four steps are completed. We apply the Algorithm across every aspect of our organization, creating a cultural and operational standard of excellence that has defined SpaceX since inception.
paras.zh: 4. 应用“算法”（减少愚蠢、删除、优化、加速、自动化）。我们遵循一套核心执行原则，称之为“算法”，这是一个五步迭代流程，我们将其作为日常工作的指导原则。我们让需求变得不那么愚蠢，删除不必要的流程或部件（秉持“最好的部件就是没有部件”这一原则），然后才优化必要的流程或部件，接着加速周期时间（许多实体只发射过一次；除我们之外，没有任何实体曾实现每年发射超过 100 次），并且仅在前四步完成后才对经过验证的流程进行自动化。我们将该算法应用于组织的方方面面，形成了自 SpaceX 成立以来一直定义着我们的卓越文化与运营标准。

paras.en: 5. Vertically integrate all the way to the end customer. We design and manufacture a significant portion of our components in-house, including engines, avionics, structures, and software, even producing the “tools that make the tools,” enabling us to test, fail, and iterate rapidly. We can then release newer, more advanced hardware with speed and cost efficiency.
paras.zh: 5. 一路垂直整合至终端客户。我们在内部设计和制造相当大一部分组件，包括发动机、航空电子设备、结构和软件，甚至生产“制造工具的工具”，使我们能够快速测试、失败并迭代。随后，我们能够以速度和成本效率推出更新、更先进的硬件。

paras.en: 6. Continuously drive cost down and throughput up. Through rocket reusability, manufacturing at scale, advanced automation, and rigorous operational discipline, we continuously reduce unit costs while increasing launch cadence, satellite network, and AI hosting capacity.
paras.zh: 6. 持续降低成本、提升产能。通过火箭可重复使用、规模化制造、先进自动化和严格的运营纪律，我们持续降低单位成本，同时提高发射频率、卫星网络和 AI 托管容量。

paras.en: 7. Generate significant cash flow and reinvest in the future. As our businesses scale, they generate significant cash flow, which we reinvest into nascent market opportunities—driving a self-reinforcing cycle of constant innovation and potentially creating significant additional value.
paras.zh: 7. 产生可观现金流并再投资于未来。随着业务规模扩大，它们产生可观的现金流，我们将其再投资于新兴市场机会——推动持续创新的自我强化循环，并可能创造可观的额外价值。

paras.en: #### Segments in Our Vertically-Integrated Innovation Engine
paras.zh: #### 我们垂直整合创新引擎中的业务板块

paras.en: We have three reportable segments in our vertically integrated innovation engine: Space, Connectivity, and AI. In our Space segment, we design, manufacture, and launch reusable rockets to provide high cadence, reliable, and affordable access to space at unprecedented scale. In our Connectivity segment, we operate a worldwide high-speed, low-latency broadband data and communications network powered by over 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, delivering connectivity to million s of consumer, enterprise, and government customers across 164 countries, territories, and other markets. In our AI segment, we operate a highly vertically integrated AI platform spanning our truth-seeking frontier model Grok, AI solutions for consumer and enterprise customers, X— our real-time information, entertainment, and free speech platform—and AI computational infrastructure.
paras.zh: 我们的垂直一体化创新引擎包含三个可报告分部：太空、连接和 AI。在太空分部，我们设计、制造并发射可重复使用火箭，以前所未有的规模提供高频次、可靠且经济实惠的太空进入能力。在连接分部，我们运营一个全球高速、低延迟宽带数据与通信网络，由超过 9,600 颗位于低地球轨道的 Starlink 宽带和移动卫星提供支持，为遍布 164 个国家、地区及其他市场的数百万消费者、企业和政府客户提供连接服务。在 AI 分部，我们运营一个高度垂直一体化的 AI 平台，涵盖我们追求真相的前沿模型 Grok、面向消费者和企业客户的 AI 解决方案、X——我们的实时信息、娱乐和言论自由平台——以及 AI 算力基础设施。

paras.en: Our financial results reflect the strength of our operating model and our ability to create and scale multiple new businesses:
paras.zh: 我们的财务业绩体现了我们运营模式的实力，以及我们创建并规模化发展多项新业务的能力：

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, we generated revenue on a consolidated basis of $4,694 million, loss from operations of $(1,943) million and Adjusted EBITDA of $1,127 million. In 2025, we generated revenue on a consolidated basis of $18,674 million, loss from operations of $(2,589) million and Adjusted EBITDA of $6,584 million. Our Space and Connectivity segments contributed the substantial majority of our consolidated revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 and the year ended December 31, 2025, demonstrating the benefits of their scale and operating leverage in our vertically integrated business model;
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们按合并口径实现收入 $4,694 million，经营亏损 $(1,943) million，调整后 EBITDA 为 $1,127 million。2025 年，我们按合并口径实现收入 $18,674 million，经营亏损 $(2,589) million，调整后 EBITDA 为 $6,584 million。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，我们的太空和连接分部贡献了合并收入的绝大部分，体现了其规模优势以及我们垂直一体化业务模式中的经营杠杆效益；

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, our Space segment generated revenue of $619 million, loss from operations of $(662) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $(351) million. In 2025, our Space segment generated revenue of $4,086 million, loss from operations of $(657) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $653 million. Additionally, our Space segment funded $930 million and $3,004 million in research and development expense during the three months ended March 31, 2026 and the year ended December 31, 2025, respectively, for our next-generation Starship launch vehicle program. Starship is designed to enable a step-function change in our launch capability across reusability, payload capacity, and launch cadence, and is the key enabler of our long-term growth strategy by unlocking entirely new categories of missions;
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们的太空分部实现收入 $619 million，经营亏损 $(662) million，分部调整后 EBITDA 为 $(351) million。2025 年，我们的太空分部实现收入 $4,086 million，经营亏损 $(657) million，分部调整后 EBITDA 为 $653 million。此外，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，我们的太空分部分别为我们的下一代 Starship 运载火箭项目投入研发费用 $930 million 和 $3,004 million。Starship 旨在使我们的发射能力在可重复使用性、有效载荷能力和发射频次方面实现阶跃式变革，并通过开启全新类别的任务，成为我们长期增长战略的关键推动因素；

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, our Connectivity segment generated revenue of $3,257 million, income from operations of $1,188 million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $2,087 million. Our Connectivity segment, primarily driven by Starlink, generated revenue of $11,387 million, income from operations of $4,423 million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $7,168 million in 2025, representing year-over-year growth of 49.8%, 120.4%, and 86.2%, respectively, benefiting from subscriber growth, increasing enterprise adoption, and continued improvement in network efficiency;
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们的连接分部实现收入 $3,257 million，经营利润 $1,188 million，分部调整后 EBITDA 为 $2,087 million。我们的连接分部主要由 Starlink 驱动，2025 年实现收入 $11,387 million，经营利润 $4,423 million，分部调整后 EBITDA 为 $7,168 million，同比分别增长 49.8%、120.4% 和 86.2%，受益于订阅用户增长、企业采用率提升以及网络效率的持续改善；

paras.en: - In our newly acquired AI segment, we plan to prioritize growth and investment to capture significant opportunities in AI applications and compute infrastructure. For the three months ended March 31, 2026, our AI segment generated revenue of $818 million, loss from operations of $(2,469) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $(609) million. In 2025, our AI segment generated revenue of $3,201 million, loss from operations of $(6,355) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $(1,237) million, reflecting its earlier stage of development and continued investments to support long-term growth opportunities in AI; and
paras.zh: - 在我们新收购的 AI 业务板块中，我们计划优先考虑增长和投资，以把握 AI 应用和算力基础设施领域的重大机遇。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月，我们的 AI 业务板块实现收入 $818 million，经营亏损 $(2,469) million，板块调整后 EBITDA 为 $(609) million。2025 年，我们的 AI 业务板块实现收入 $3,201 million，经营亏损 $(6,355) million，板块调整后 EBITDA 为 $(1,237) million，反映出该板块处于较早的发展阶段，并持续投入以支持 AI 领域的长期增长机遇；以及

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, capital expenditures for our Space segment was $1,052 million, for our Connectivity segment was $1,332 million and for our AI segment was $7,723 million. In 2025, capital expenditures for our Space segment was $3,832 million, for our Connectivity segment was $4,178 million and for our AI segment was $12,727 million.
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月，我们 Space 业务板块的资本支出为 $1,052 million，Connectivity 业务板块的资本支出为 $1,332 million，AI 业务板块的资本支出为 $7,723 million。2025 年，我们 Space 业务板块的资本支出为 $3,832 million，Connectivity 业务板块的资本支出为 $4,178 million，AI 业务板块的资本支出为 $12,727 million。

paras.en: Segment Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP measure. Please refer to the section titled “—Non-GAAP Financial Measures” for additional information on our non-GAAP financial measures, including reconciliations of Segment Adjusted EBITDA to segment income (loss) from operations, the most directly comparable GAAP measure.
paras.zh: 板块调整后 EBITDA 是一项非 GAAP 指标。有关我们非 GAAP 财务指标的更多信息，包括板块调整后 EBITDA 与板块经营收入（亏损）（最直接可比的 GAAP 指标）的对账，请参阅标题为“—非 GAAP 财务指标”的章节。

paras.en: Since our founding in 2002, SpaceX has cracked the code on accessing space at scale, transforming an industry characterized by decades of stagnation, risk aversion, and economically perverse cost structures. We design, manufacture, launch, and refurbish reusable launch vehicles that provide cost-efficient, reliable, and high-cadence access to space for our own purposes as well as for third-party commercial and government customers. In 2025, we launched from four primary launch pads in the United States and successfully recovered boosters across seven landing facilities including autonomous drone ships and catch towers based on the vehicle type and mission profile. Our extensive vertical integration and end-to-end control over the entire value chain, from design to launch to operations, allows us to achieve unprecedented speed and cost efficiency.
paras.zh: 自 2002 年成立以来，SpaceX 已攻克规模化进入太空的难题，彻底改变了一个以数十年停滞、规避风险和经济上扭曲的成本结构为特征的行业。我们设计、制造、发射并翻新可重复使用运载火箭，为自身用途以及第三方商业和政府客户提供高成本效益、可靠且高频次的太空进入能力。2025 年，我们从美国的四个主要发射台实施发射，并根据飞行器类型和任务剖面，在包括自主无人船和捕获塔在内的七个着陆设施成功回收助推器。我们广泛的垂直整合以及对从设计到发射再到运营的整个价值链的端到端控制，使我们能够实现前所未有的速度和成本效率。

paras.en: Falcon 9 First Stage Booster Landing
paras.zh: Falcon 9 一级助推器着陆

paras.en: As of March 31, 2026, SpaceX had launched a total mass to orbit of approximately 7,400 metric tons with an over 99% mission success rate across our Falcon rockets. We have completed approximately 650 orbital space launches, and over 540 of those launches were completed by a flight-proven Falcon rocket. In 2025 alone, SpaceX completed 170 missions across Falcon and Starship vehicles and 159 flight-proven booster launches with an over 99% success rate on attempted booster recoveries. We launched over 2,200 metric tons, representing over 80% of mass to orbit for the world in 2025. With the first successful launch of Falcon 1 in 2008, we became the first private company to successfully launch a liquid-fueled rocket to Earth’s orbit. Just two years later, in 2010, the commercial debut of the Falcon 9 rocket revolutionized space access by delivering unprecedented cost efficiency. For example, according to NASA, the first version of Falcon 9 in 2010 reduced launch cost to approximately $2,700 per kilogram, which represented a reduction of approximately 85% compared to the historical average launch cost per kilogram of $18,500. The first version of Falcon Heavy in 2018 further reduced this cost to $1,400 per kilogram, a reduction of approximately 92% compared to the historical average. We have also reduced our internal cost of launch through a combination of engineering improvements, manufacturing efficiencies, and economies of scale—most notably, through our ability to drive more frequent reuse of rockets.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，SpaceX 已将总计约 7,400 公吨的质量送入轨道，Falcon 系列火箭的任务成功率超过 99%。我们已完成约 650 次轨道太空发射，其中超过 540 次由经过飞行验证的 Falcon 火箭完成。仅 2025 年，SpaceX 就完成了 Falcon 和 Starship 飞行器共计 170 次任务，并实施了 159 次经过飞行验证的助推器发射，助推器回收尝试成功率超过 99%。2025 年我们发射的质量超过 2,200 公吨，占全球入轨质量的 80%以上。随着 Falcon 1 于 2008 年首次成功发射，我们成为首家成功将液体燃料火箭送入地球轨道的私营公司。仅两年后的 2010 年，Falcon 9 火箭的商业首秀通过带来前所未有的成本效率，彻底改变了太空进入方式。例如，根据 NASA 的数据，2010 年第一版 Falcon 9 将发射成本降至约每公斤 2,700 美元，相较每公斤 18,500 美元的历史平均发射成本降低了约 85%。2018 年第一版 Falcon Heavy 进一步将该成本降至每公斤 1,400 美元，相较历史平均水平降低了约 92%。我们还通过工程改进、制造效率提升和规模经济的结合——最显著的是通过推动火箭更频繁重复使用的能力——降低了内部发射成本。

paras.en: We generate Space revenue primarily through launch and mission services of Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, and Dragon provided to commercial and government customers. We fly to LEO, MEO, GEO, lunar, and interplanetary trajectories, as well as the International Space Station. Our Space segment revenue is derived from fixed-price contracts related to the development and provision of launch services for both commercial customers and governmental agency space programs, either at a “point in time” or “over time.”
paras.zh: 我们的太空业务收入主要来自向商业和政府客户提供的 Falcon 9、Falcon Heavy 和 Dragon 的发射及任务服务。我们飞往 LEO、MEO、GEO、月球和行星际轨道，以及国际空间站。我们的太空业务分部收入来自与商业客户和政府机构太空项目开发和提供发射服务相关的固定价格合同，收入确认方式为“某一时点”或“随时间”。

paras.en: We manage our Space segment to support our businesses and those of our customers. We plan launches and allocate payloads in advance, although it can be difficult to manage the timing of customer payload arrivals. When an expected customer payload for a planned launch is not available, we instead use launch capacity for our satellites. As a result, we adjust expected launch payloads frequently, impacting period-to-period financial comparison. For a majority of customer payloads, revenue and costs are primarily recognized at the launch or deployment of the customer’s spacecraft to its intended orbit, with some revenues and costs being recognized over time. For launches dedicated to deploying our Starlink satellites, we capitalize the associated costs within our Connectivity segment and depreciate them over time, and we do not recognize revenue for those launches in our Space segment. We allocate a significant amount of launch capacity to our Connectivity segment, and expect to allocate a significant amount to our AI segment in the future. Our Space segment revenue only reflects customer launches and other customer activities. As a result, notwithstanding an increasing launch cadence, our Space segment has relatively lower revenue scale and revenue growth compared to our other segments, though its financial results do not reflect the foundational strategic value that it provides to us in bolstering the growth of our Connectivity and AI segments.
paras.zh: 我们管理太空业务板块，以支持我们自身及客户的业务。我们提前规划发射并分配有效载荷，尽管客户有效载荷到达时间的安排可能难以管理。当计划发射的预期客户有效载荷无法就位时，我们转而将发射能力用于我们的卫星。因此，我们会频繁调整预期发射有效载荷，这影响了各期间的财务可比性。对于大多数客户有效载荷，收入和成本主要在客户航天器发射或部署至其预定轨道时确认，部分收入和成本则随时间确认。对于专用于部署我们 Starlink 卫星的发射，我们在互联业务板块内将相关成本资本化并随时间计提折旧，且不在太空业务板块确认这些发射的收入。我们将大量发射能力分配给互联业务板块，并预计未来将向 AI 业务板块分配大量发射能力。我们的太空业务板块收入仅反映客户发射及其他客户活动。因此，尽管发射频次不断增加，我们的太空业务板块与其他业务板块相比，收入规模和收入增长相对较低，但其财务业绩并未反映其为推动我们互联和 AI 业务板块增长所提供的基础性战略价值。

paras.en: Connectivity. Starlink provides global access to high-speed internet, including underserved rural and remote communities worldwide. As of March 31, 2026, we had approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, providing broadband connectivity to approximately 10.3 million Starlink Subscribers across 164 countries, territories, and other markets. We also provide satellite-to-mobile texting and over-the-top voice services to approximately 7.4 million monthly unique devices across approximately 30 countries.
paras.zh: 互联业务。Starlink 提供全球高速互联网接入，包括面向全球服务不足的农村和偏远社区。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们在低地球轨道拥有约 9,600 颗 Starlink 宽带和移动卫星，为遍布 164 个国家、地区和其他市场的约 10.3 百万 Starlink 用户提供宽带连接。我们还向约 30 个国家约 7.4 百万月度独立设备提供卫星到移动短信和 OTT 语音服务。

paras.en: Starlink Mini
paras.zh: Starlink Mini

paras.en: - Starlink Consumer Broadband. We operate the world’s largest and most advanced space-based internet broadband service with median latency at approximately 25 milliseconds as of March 31, 2026. We provide fiber-like download speeds—at a median of 225 Mbps during peak hours for residential users as of March 31, 2026—and the technological capability to provide service everywhere on Earth, including the poles. This service quality is enabled by our vast network of approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, which accounted for approximately 75% of all active maneuverable satellites in orbit as of March 31, 2026. We expect to commence deploying our next-generation V3 satellites, designed to offer one Tbps of downlink capacity per satellite, using Starship in the second half of 2026. We expect that a single Starship launch will be capable of deploying up to 60 V3 satellites to LEO, representing a potential twenty-fold increase in Starlink downlink capacity deployed relative to a Falcon 9 launch. As of March 31, 2026, we had approximately 10.3 million Starlink Subscribers, up approximately 105% from 5.0 million subscribers a year prior. We charge our Starlink Subscribers a monthly subscription fee, which varies based on geographic market and download speed, plus typically a one-time upfront terminal cost.
paras.zh: - Starlink 消费级宽带。我们运营着全球规模最大、最先进的星基互联网宽带服务，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，中位时延约为 25 毫秒。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们为住宅用户提供类光纤下载速度——高峰时段中位下载速度为 225 Mbps——并具备在地球任何地点（包括两极）提供服务的技术能力。这一服务质量得益于我们由约 9,600 颗 Starlink 宽带及移动卫星组成的庞大低地球轨道网络，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，该网络约占在轨所有活跃可机动卫星的 75%。我们预计将于 2026 年下半年使用 Starship 开始部署下一代 V3 卫星，该卫星设计为每颗提供 1 Tbps 的下行容量。我们预计单次 Starship 发射将能够向 LEO 部署最多 60 颗 V3 卫星，这意味着相对于 Falcon 9 发射，Starlink 部署的下行容量可能提升二十倍。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们拥有约 10.3 百万 Starlink 用户，较一年前的 5.0 百万用户增长约 105%。我们向 Starlink 用户收取月度订阅费，该费用根据地理市场和下载速度而有所不同，此外通常还收取一次性终端设备费用。

paras.en: - Enterprise Solutions. SpaceX is a critical partner to a wide array of enterprises. We offer Starlink’s high-speed, low-latency, reliable internet services to enterprise customers across industries including construction, agriculture, retail, telecom, hospitality, aviation, maritime, and land mobility. Starlink’s unique capabilities are well‑suited for deployments across field offices, remote worksites, research stations, drilling rigs, rural hospitals, aircraft, cruise ships, trains, and hotels. Our enterprise customers include companies such as United Airlines, Carnival, Maersk, and John Deere, among others. We also serve a broad fixed‑site customer base across industries such as retail and financial services that require high availability for critical operations as well as reliable connectivity in remote or hard-to-serve locations. As companies continue to invest in secure and resilient networks and backup systems to keep critical infrastructure online—such as point‑of‑sale and payment processing systems—we often start as a backup solution and then transition to being the primary solution. Our enterprise contracts are based on a combination of subscriptions, data consumption, capacity, or other pricing models depending on each customer’s particular needs. Since 2023, no Starlink Enterprise customer having contributed more than $750,000 of annual revenue has voluntarily discontinued their service, demonstrating the strong performance and value of our offering. This is despite the ability of our customers to cancel the service at any time.
paras.zh: - 企业解决方案。SpaceX 是众多企业的重要合作伙伴。我们为建筑、农业、零售、电信、酒店、航空、海事和陆地交通等各行业的企业客户提供 Starlink 高速、低时延、可靠的互联网服务。Starlink 的独特能力非常适合部署于现场办公室、偏远工地、研究站、钻井平台、乡村医院、飞机、邮轮、列车和酒店。我们的企业客户包括 United Airlines、Carnival、Maersk 和 John Deere 等公司。我们还服务于零售和金融服务等行业的广泛固定站点客户群体，这些客户需要关键业务的高可用性，以及偏远或难以覆盖地点的可靠连接。随着企业持续投资于安全且有韧性的网络和备份系统，以保持关键基础设施（如销售点和支付处理系统）在线，我们往往最初作为备份解决方案，随后转变为主要解决方案。我们的企业合同基于订阅、数据用量、容量或其他定价模式的组合，具体取决于各客户的特定需求。自 2023 年以来，年收入贡献超过 $750,000 的 Starlink 企业客户中，没有任何一家主动终止服务，这体现了我们产品的强劲表现和价值，尽管我们的客户可以随时取消服务。

paras.en: - Government Solutions. For our government customers, we provide high-speed, resilient connectivity for public services, social impact, humanitarian efforts, and disaster response in even the most remote and challenging environments. Examples include support for the FEMA in coordinating disaster recovery after hurricanes and wildfires, the NOAA for at-sea testing and environmental monitoring, the Government of the Philippines for linking remote islands, schools, and public institutions, the Government of Jamaica for improving digital access in remote and maritime areas, and the Government of Ecuador for supporting education and healthcare connectivity in isolated communities. Separately with Starshield, we have leveraged our commercial LEO satellite constellation engineering learnings and operational experiences to develop a secure, dedicated satellite network designed specifically for United States Government customers and national security applications.
paras.zh: - 政府解决方案。针对政府客户，我们即使在最偏远、最具挑战性的环境中，也能为公共服务、社会影响、人道主义行动和灾害响应提供高速、高韧性的连接。示例包括：支持 FEMA 在飓风和野火过后协调灾后恢复，支持 NOAA 进行海上测试和环境监测，支持菲律宾政府连接偏远岛屿、学校和公共机构，支持牙买加政府改善偏远地区和海域的数字接入，以及支持厄瓜多尔政府为孤立社区提供教育和医疗连接。此外，通过 Starshield，我们利用商业 LEO 卫星星座的工程经验和运营经验，开发了一个安全、专用的卫星网络，专为美国政府客户和国家安全应用而设计。

paras.en: - Starlink Mobile. We provide satellite-to-mobile connectivity, supplementing terrestrial networks and substantially reducing mobile “dead zones” across approximately 30 countries. We partner with MNOs including major wireless carriers like T-Mobile in the United States, and other international operators including One NZ, Optus, Telstra, Rogers, KDDI, Salt, Entel, Kyivstar, and VMO2. Through these partnerships, we enable consumers, businesses, and public-sector customers to use their existing phones in more places, support critical connectivity during disasters and power outages, and open new applications for low-bandwidth mobile and IoT devices. Our current capabilities under our “V1” constellation (consisting of approximately 650 V1 Mobile satellites in orbit) include light data, text messaging (SMS), and over-the-top voice services (e.g., WhatsApp and FaceTime). We are developing more comprehensive satellite-to-mobile services, including broadband data and IoT connectivity, which are expected to deliver resilient, infrastructure-independent connectivity worldwide and enable 5G connectivity. We have partnerships with approximately 30 MNOs on six continents, covering an area that is home to approximately 1.9 billion people. We charge MNOs either a fixed fee or a per-mobile user fee-based amount, which is typically passed through to the customer via the carrier as an “add-on” feature.
paras.zh: - Starlink Mobile。我们提供卫星到移动终端的连接服务，作为地面网络的补充，大幅减少约 30 个国家/地区的移动“盲区”。我们与移动网络运营商（MNO）合作，包括美国 T-Mobile 等主要无线运营商，以及 One NZ、Optus、Telstra、Rogers、KDDI、Salt、Entel、Kyivstar 和 VMO2 等其他国际运营商。通过这些合作，我们使消费者、企业和公共部门客户能够在更多地点使用其现有手机，在灾害和停电期间支持关键连接，并为低带宽移动设备和物联网设备开辟新的应用。我们目前在“V1”星座（由约 650 颗在轨 V1 Mobile 卫星组成）下的能力包括轻量数据、短信（SMS）和 over-the-top 语音服务（如 WhatsApp 和 FaceTime）。我们正在开发更全面的卫星到移动终端服务，包括宽带数据和物联网连接，预计将在全球范围内提供具有韧性、不依赖基础设施的连接，并实现 5G 连接。我们与六大洲约 30 家 MNO 建立了合作关系，覆盖区域居住着约 19 亿人口。我们向 MNO 收取固定费用或按每移动用户计费的费用，该费用通常由运营商作为“附加”功能转嫁给客户。

paras.en: We generate revenue in our Connectivity segment primarily through subscription fees from consumer subscribers. We drive consumer revenue through monthly subscription fees based on geographic market and download speed, recognizing revenue ratably over the service period, plus typically a one-time sale of a kit. In addition, we generate revenue from enterprises through contracts structured as a combination of subscriptions, data consumption, and capacity, or on a percentage-of-completion basis, depending on each customer’s particular needs. We generate government revenue via long term contracts for Starshield, a secure satellite network designed specifically for government customers and national security applications. We also earn Starlink Mobile revenue through revenue-sharing arrangements with MNO partners, based on connectivity services included in their plans.
paras.zh: 我们在连接业务分部的收入主要来自消费者订阅用户的订阅费。我们通过基于地理市场和下载速度的月度订阅费来驱动消费者收入，在服务期内按比例确认收入，此外通常还包括一次性销售套件。此外，我们通过以订阅、数据使用量和容量相结合的方式构建的合同，或根据每个客户的特定需求按完工百分比法，从企业客户获得收入。我们通过为 Starshield 签订的长期合同获得政府收入，Starshield 是专为政府客户和国家安全应用设计的安全卫星网络。我们还通过与移动网络运营商（MNO）合作伙伴的收入分成安排，基于其套餐中包含的连接服务，获得 Starlink Mobile 收入。

paras.en: In 2025, revenue from consumer subscribers represented over 60% of Connectivity segment revenue. We expect revenue from consumer subscribers, as well as enterprise and government customers, to be the primary driver of Connectivity segment growth, and that Starlink Mobile will become a significant new contributor of Connectivity segment revenue.
paras.zh: 2025 年，来自消费者订阅用户的收入占连接业务分部收入的 60% 以上。我们预计，来自消费者订阅用户以及企业和政府客户的收入将成为连接业务分部增长的主要驱动力，并且 Starlink Mobile 将成为连接业务分部收入的重要新贡献来源。

paras.en: AI. We operate a highly vertically integrated AI platform spanning gigawatt-scale AI compute infrastructure, our truth-seeking frontier AI model, Grok, AI solutions for consumer and enterprise customers, and X, our real-time information, entertainment, and free speech platform. We believe AI is rapidly converging toward AGI, where human cognitive capabilities can be replicated and scaled at machine speeds, profoundly augmenting human productivity. Once an AGI system exists, its true value derives from the ability to create limitless duplicates of human-like intelligence, necessitating vast computational resources and cost-efficient deployment to achieve meaningful scale. Without large-scale, power-efficient infrastructure, AGI cannot be deployed broadly or economically—making such infrastructure a critical strategic differentiator.
paras.zh: AI。我们运营一个高度垂直整合的 AI 平台，涵盖吉瓦级 AI 算力基础设施、我们追求真相的前沿 AI 模型 Grok、面向消费者和企业客户的 AI 解决方案，以及 X——我们的实时信息、娱乐和言论自由平台。我们相信，AI 正迅速向 AGI 演进，在 AGI 中，人类的认知能力可以以机器速度被复制和扩展，从而极大地增强人类生产力。一旦 AGI 系统存在，其真正价值源于能够创造无限复制的人类般智能，这需要庞大的计算资源和具有成本效益的部署才能实现有意义的规模。没有大规模、高能效的基础设施，AGI 就无法广泛或经济地部署——这使得此类基础设施成为关键的战略差异化因素。

paras.en: COLOSSUS II Facility in Memphis, Tennessee
paras.zh: 位于田纳西州孟菲斯的 COLOSSUS II 设施

paras.en: - AI Compute Infrastructure. xAI has established a leading position in building and scaling terrestrial AI compute infrastructure, becoming the first company to deploy a coherent gigawatt-scale AI training cluster. Our AI compute facilities, COLOSSUS and COLOSSUS II, collectively provide approximately 1.0 gigawatt of compute power, with additional power capacity available for data center operations. Our first-principles thinking enables us to build coherent compute at scale and at rapid speed with lower costs than most other companies in the industry. We brought the first cluster of COLOSSUS online in 122 days, repurposing the shell of an existing factory, and the first cluster of COLOSSUS II online even faster in 91 days. As an illustrative comparison, an industry benchmark to bring online a 100 megawatt greenfield data center is approximately two years. We also demonstrated a significant improvement in cost efficiency, achieving data center construction costs for COLOSSUS II that are considerably lower than industry benchmarks on a per megawatt basis. This dual speed and cost advantage stems from our complete vertical integration and the shared culture infused by our founder, Mr. Musk, across our Space, Connectivity, and AI segments. The addition of Terafab, an initiative together with Tesla to build a manufacturing facility capable of producing 1 terawatt per year of compute hardware, aims to further extend our vertical integration to chip design and manufacturing to alleviate potential future chip shortages at SpaceX, optimize compute performance, and potentially reduce overall compute costs. Intel, which has the ability to design, fabricate, and package ultra-high-performance chips at scale, has also joined the Terafab project. We believe that the key constraints in the continued growth of AI are physical—chip manufacturing, data center infrastructure, and power generation; the future of AI will be determined by the control of the physical stack.
paras.zh: - AI 算力基础设施。xAI 在构建和扩展地面 AI 算力基础设施方面已确立领先地位，成为首家部署连贯的吉瓦级 AI 训练集群的公司。我们的 AI 算力设施 COLOSSUS 和 COLOSSUS II 合计提供约 1.0 吉瓦的算力，另有额外电力容量可用于数据中心运营。我们的第一性原理思维使我们能够以低于行业内大多数其他公司的成本，大规模、快速地构建连贯算力。我们在 122 天内使 COLOSSUS 的第一个集群上线，利用了现有工厂的外壳，而 COLOSSUS II 的第一个集群上线更快，仅用 91 天。作为说明性对比，使一个 100 兆瓦的绿地数据中心上线，行业基准约为两年。我们还在成本效率方面展示了显著改善，COLOSSUS II 的数据中心建设成本按每兆瓦计算大幅低于行业基准。这种速度与成本的双重优势源于我们完全的垂直整合，以及我们的创始人马斯克先生在我们的太空、连接和 AI 各业务板块中注入的共同文化。Terafab 的加入——这是一项与 Tesla 共同建设的计划，旨在建设一座每年可生产 1 太瓦算力硬件的制造设施——旨在进一步将我们的垂直整合延伸至芯片设计与制造，以缓解 SpaceX 未来可能出现的芯片短缺、优化算力性能，并有可能降低整体算力成本。Intel 也加入了 Terafab 项目，该公司具备大规模设计、制造和封装超高性能芯片的能力。我们认为，AI 持续增长的关键制约因素是物理层面的——芯片制造、数据中心基础设施和发电；AI 的未来将由对物理技术栈的控制所决定。

paras.en: - Truth-Seeking Frontier Model. xAI has developed one of the world’s most advanced, truth-seeking frontier models with Grok. Since launching Grok-1 in November 2023, we have released four major versions and notable variations thereof, achieving one of the fastest iteration cycles in the industry, culminating in Grok-4.3 (April 2026). Building on this trajectory, we expect to continue scaling Grok through subsequent generations. Ongoing training of next‑generation models is expected to scale toward multiple trillions of parameters, which could represent a step change in reasoning in depth and overall intelligence. In this context, the number of parameters refers to the scale of the model, where parameters are the internal numerical values, such as “weights,” that are adjusted during training to enable the model to recognize patterns and relationships in data. A larger number of parameters generally allows the model to capture more complex relationships, store greater amounts of knowledge, and achieve higher levels of reasoning capability. Within two years of its initial model release, Grok achieved frontier-level performance in scientific reasoning, as measured by its GPQA Diamond score, an industry benchmark that evaluates AI models on a standardized set of questions written and validated by experts, on a faster timeline than reported by other leading model providers. This accelerated rate of innovation stems from our highly vertically integrated stack: full ownership of training infrastructure, access to the world’s most powerful compute clusters, and relentless focus on truth seeking and real-world utility. A key competitive differentiator is Grok’s deep integration with X, enabling proprietary access to a real-time information stream of approximately 350 million daily posts, which enhances freshness, relevance, and contextual awareness for Grok. This direct, real-time access to the information and human discourse on X enhances Grok’s truth-seeking capabilities by grounding outputs in up-to-date knowledge and diverse viewpoints. We believe that this combination of compute infrastructure scale and the massive dataset available to us through X, subject to some limitations for certain content, has allowed us to achieve industry-leading performance and provide model outputs that analyze real-time information on global events. We expect that our compute infrastructure and direct access to real-time data via X constitute substantial performance advantages for Grok that will result in increasingly rapid and dramatic iteration cycles.
paras.zh: - 求真型前沿模型。xAI 借助 Grok 开发出了全球最先进的求真型前沿模型之一。自 2023 年 11 月推出 Grok-1 以来，我们已发布四个主要版本及其重要变体，实现了业界最快的迭代周期之一，最终推出 Grok-4.3（2026 年 4 月）。基于这一发展轨迹，我们预计将通过后续各代产品持续扩展 Grok。下一代模型的持续训练预计将扩展至数万亿参数规模，这可能代表推理深度和整体智能水平的阶跃式变化。在此语境下，参数数量指模型规模，其中参数是模型内部的数值（如“权重”），在训练过程中被调整，以使模型能够识别数据中的模式和关系。参数数量越大，通常使模型能够捕捉更复杂的关系、存储更多知识，并达到更高水平的推理能力。在首次模型发布后的两年内，Grok 在科学推理方面达到了前沿水平（以 GPQA Diamond 得分衡量），该得分是一项行业基准，通过一组由专家编写和验证的标准化问题来评估 AI 模型，且我们达成这一水平的时间线快于其他领先模型提供商所报告的时间线。这种加速的创新速度源于我们高度垂直整合的技术栈：完全拥有训练基础设施、可使用全球最强大的算力集群，以及对求真和现实世界实用性的不懈专注。一个关键的竞争差异化优势是 Grok 与 X 的深度整合，使其能够专有地访问每日约 350 million 条帖子的实时信息流，从而提升 Grok 的时效性、相关性和上下文感知能力。这种对 X 上信息和人类话语的直接、实时访问，通过将输出建立在最新知识和多元观点之上，增强了 Grok 的求真能力。我们相信，算力基础设施规模与通过 X 可获得的海量数据集（受某些内容的若干限制）相结合，使我们能够实现行业领先的性能，并提供分析全球事件实时信息的模型输出。我们预计，我们的算力基础设施以及通过 X 对实时数据的直接访问，将构成 Grok 的重大性能优势，从而带来日益快速和显著的迭代周期。

paras.en: - Consumer and Enterprise Applications. We leverage our leading frontier models and compute infrastructure to deliver consumer and enterprise applications. In under six months, we developed Grok Voice, a real-time speech engine, including in multilingual performance. Our image and video generation system, Imagine, produced approximately 10 billion images and over 2 billion videos per month, on average, for the quarter ending March 31, 2026. Together with Tesla, we are also developing Macrohard, an agentic AI platform designed to be capable of fully emulating digital workflows and augmenting human operation of computers— from coding and product development to management and entire business processes—using sophisticated autonomous agents. We believe Macrohard will have the potential to fundamentally transform how companies are structured and operate, thereby allowing dramatic increases in human productivity. In addition, we believe our existing government relationships and track record as large government contractors are a structural advantage as governments become significant consumers of AI applications.
paras.zh: - 消费者与企业应用。我们利用领先的前沿模型和算力基础设施，提供消费者与企业应用。在不到六个月的时间里，我们开发了 Grok Voice，这是一款实时语音引擎，包括多语言性能。我们的图像和视频生成系统 Imagine，在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的季度内，平均每月生成约 100 亿张图像和超过 20 亿个视频。我们还与 Tesla 共同开发 Macrohard，这是一个代理式 AI 平台，旨在能够完全模拟数字工作流程并增强人类对计算机的操作——从编码和产品开发到管理和整个业务流程——使用复杂的自主代理。我们相信 Macrohard 有潜力从根本上改变公司的结构和运营方式，从而大幅提高人类生产力。此外，我们相信，随着政府成为 AI 应用的重要消费者，我们现有的政府关系和作为大型政府承包商的历史记录是一种结构性优势。

paras.en: Our integrated AI platforms across Grok and X had approximately 1.3 billion supported accounts active in the last twelve months ended March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, including approximately 550 million and 520 million MAUs as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively. Of our MAUs, we had approximately 117 million and 89 million MAUs that used Grok’s AI features as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively.
paras.zh: 我们横跨 Grok 与 X 的集成 AI 平台，在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的过去十二个月及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的过去十二个月中，分别拥有约 13 亿个活跃的受支持账户，其中包括截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日分别约 5.5 亿和 5.2 亿的月活跃用户（MAU）。在我们的 MAU 中，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日，分别约有 1.17 亿和 8900 万 MAU 使用了 Grok 的 AI 功能。

paras.en: While MAUs provide an estimated measure of the size and engagement of our user base, we are focused on revenue and operating margin, and manage our business with the objective of driving sustainable revenue growth and profitability rather than with the primary objective of growing or maintaining MAU levels.
paras.zh: 尽管 MAU 提供了对我们用户群规模和参与度的估算衡量，但我们专注于收入和经营利润率，并以推动可持续收入增长和盈利能力为目标来管理我们的业务，而非以增长或维持 MAU 水平为主要目标。

paras.en: We also monetize user activity through high-impact advertising inventory on X. We believe X’s scale, real-time engagement, and integration with Grok provide a differentiated foundation for building a unified user experience across communication, content discovery, commerce, and financial services, among others. For enterprises that advertise on X, we offer large-scale user engagement, real-time content, and advanced AI-driven performance marketing tools. For enterprises, we offer tailored deployments of Grok customized to specific workflows and security needs through Grok Business and Grok Enterprise, sold on license-, consumption-, or outcome-based pricing models.
paras.zh: 我们还通过 X 上的高影响力广告库存将用户活动变现。我们相信，X 的规模、实时参与度以及与 Grok 的整合，为构建跨通信、内容发现、商业和金融服务等的统一用户体验提供了差异化的基础。对于在 X 上投放广告的企业，我们提供大规模用户参与、实时内容和先进的 AI 驱动效果营销工具。对于企业，我们通过 Grok Business 和 Grok Enterprise 提供针对特定工作流程和安全需求定制的 Grok 部署，采用基于许可、基于用量或基于成果的定价模式销售。

full.sec: Our Capital Allocation and Funding Strategy
full.secZh: 我们的资本配置与融资战略

paras.en: Since our beginning, we have managed through multiple investment cycles. We initially raised capital to fund what is now our Space segment, which generates revenue from commercial and government customers while serving as the backbone for our Connectivity segment. We invested in our Connectivity segment as we generated Segment Adjusted EBITDA from our Space segment, along with additional equity capital that we raised externally, creating a segment that generates predictable and recurring revenue from consumer, enterprise, and government customers. We continue to invest meaningfully in both our Space and Connectivity segments to build out the infrastructure of the future through our next-generation Starship launch platform and our expanded Starlink broadband and mobility networks.
paras.zh: 自成立以来，我们历经了多轮投资周期。我们最初募集资金用于资助如今的空间业务板块，该板块从商业和政府客户获取收入，同时作为我们连接业务板块的支柱。随着空间业务板块产生板块调整后 EBITDA，加之我们在外部募集的额外股权资本，我们对连接业务板块进行了投资，打造出一个从消费者、企业和政府客户获取可预测经常性收入的板块。我们继续对空间和连接两个业务板块进行重大投资，通过我们的下一代星舰发射平台以及扩展后的 Starlink 宽带和移动网络，构建未来的基础设施。

paras.en: We have a stellar track record of capital allocation and value creation in Space and Connectivity. Since SpaceX’s founding in 2002, we have raised over $9 billion of equity capital to fund the development and growth of these two business segments. The Space segment became Segment Adjusted EBITDA positive on a sustained basis beginning in 2018 and the Connectivity segment became in aggregate Segment Adjusted EBITDA positive on a sustained basis beginning in 2023. In 2025, our Space segment generated a loss from operations of $(657) million and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $653 million, including the impact of funding $3,004 million in research and development expense for our next-generation Starship launch vehicle program. In 2025, our Connectivity segment generated income from operations of $4,423 million and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $7,168 million.
paras.zh: 我们在空间和连接领域的资本配置与价值创造方面拥有卓越的过往记录。自 SpaceX 于 2002 年成立以来，我们已募集超过$9 billion 的股权资本，用于资助这两个业务板块的开发和增长。空间业务板块自 2018 年起持续实现板块调整后 EBITDA 为正，连接业务板块自 2023 年起整体持续实现板块调整后 EBITDA 为正。2025 年，我们的空间业务板块产生经营亏损$(657) million，板块调整后 EBITDA 为$653 million，其中包括为我们的下一代星舰运载火箭项目投入$3,004 million 研发费用的影响。2025 年，我们的连接业务板块产生经营利润$4,423 million，板块调整后 EBITDA 为$7,168 million。

paras.en: We acquired xAI in February 2026, which forms the basis of our AI segment. We expect to allocate substantial capital to expand our compute infrastructure, and we expect a multi-year investment horizon before these deployments translate into sustained positive AI Segment Adjusted EBITDA. During this investment period, our capital expenditures will scale as quickly as we are able to deploy power and compute to address the $26.5 trillion potential market opportunity for AI. We plan to access a range of debt and equity financing solutions available to us as a public company to fund future investments in growth and to maintain strong liquidity. We aim to maintain an investment grade credit rating.
paras.zh: 我们于 2026 年 2 月收购了 xAI，这构成了我们 AI 业务板块的基础。我们预计将配置大量资本以扩展我们的算力基础设施，并且我们预计在这些部署转化为持续的 AI 板块调整后 EBITDA 为正之前，将经历多年的投资期。在该投资期内，我们的资本支出将随着我们能够部署电力和算力的速度而快速扩大，以把握 AI 领域$26.5 trillion 的潜在市场机遇。我们计划利用作为上市公司可获得的多种债务和股权融资方案，为未来的增长投资提供资金并保持强劲的流动性。我们的目标是维持投资级信用评级。

paras.en: Segment Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP measure. Please refer to the section titled “—Non-GAAP Financial Measures” for additional information on our non-GAAP financial measures, including reconciliations of Segment Adjusted EBITDA to segment income (loss) from operations, the most directly comparable GAAP measure.
paras.zh: 板块调整后 EBITDA 是一项非 GAAP 指标。有关我们非 GAAP 财务指标的更多信息，包括板块调整后 EBITDA 与板块经营利润（亏损）（最直接可比的 GAAP 指标）的对账，请参阅标题为“—非 GAAP 财务指标”的章节。

paras.en: We use the following key business metrics to evaluate our business, measure our performance, identify trends, formulate business plans, and make strategic decisions.
paras.zh: 我们使用以下关键业务指标来评估我们的业务、衡量我们的业绩、识别趋势、制定业务计划并做出战略决策。

paras.en: #### Space

In our Space segment, we use mass to orbit and launches as key business metrics to measure our scale and throughput. Mass to orbit and launches grow more rapidly than Space segment revenue because these metrics include our internal constellation deployments from which we do not recognize inter-segment revenue.
paras.zh: 在我们的太空板块中，我们使用入轨质量和发射次数作为关键业务指标，以衡量我们的规模和吞吐量。入轨质量和发射次数的增长速度高于太空板块收入，因为这些指标包含我们的内部星座部署，而我们并不从中确认分部间收入。

paras.en: Mass to Orbit: Mass to orbit is the total kilograms of payload that we deploy to orbit in a given period, and is a key indicator of SpaceX’s capacity and scalability that supports Space revenue and drives expansion across our Connectivity and AI segments. We calculate this metric by summing verified mass, including Starlink satellites, customer payloads, and development cargo, from all successful orbital and flight tests. This measure excludes failed or scrubbed attempts. We increased mass to orbit from 1,210 metric tons in 2023 to 1,699 metric tons in 2024 to 2,213 metric tons in 2025, and from 450 metric tons in the three months ended March 31, 2025 to 556 metric tons in the three months ended March 31, 2026. In 2023, 2024, and 2025, mass to orbit included 205, 282, and 312 metric tons attributable to customer payloads, respectively, and 1,005, 1,418, and 1,901 metric tons attributable to internal payloads, respectively (the amounts presented may not add up to the corresponding totals due to rounding). Falcon 9 launches contribute steadily at an average capacity of 13 metric tons per mission since 2023 to various orbits while we transition to Starship. As the most powerful launch system ever developed, we expect that Starship V3 will be able to carry a payload of 100 metric tons, with future generations of Starship being designed to double this payload.
paras.zh: 入轨质量：入轨质量是指在给定期间内我们部署至轨道的有效载荷总千克数，是 SpaceX 运载能力和可扩展性的关键指标，支撑太空收入并推动我们互联板块和 AI 板块的扩张。我们通过汇总所有成功入轨和飞行测试中经核实的质量（包括 Starlink 卫星、客户有效载荷和开发货物）来计算该指标。该指标不包括失败或取消的尝试。我们的入轨质量从 2023 年的 1,210 公吨增至 2024 年的 1,699 公吨，并增至 2025 年的 2,213 公吨；从截至 2025 年 3 月 31 日止三个月的 450 公吨增至截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月的 556 公吨。2023 年、2024 年和 2025 年，入轨质量中分别有 205、282 和 312 公吨来自客户有效载荷，分别有 1,005、1,418 和 1,901 公吨来自内部有效载荷（由于四舍五入，所列金额相加可能不等于相应合计数）。在我们向 Starship 过渡期间，Falcon 9 发射持续以自 2023 年以来每次任务平均 13 公吨的运力向各类轨道运送载荷。作为有史以来研发的最强大发射系统，我们预计 Starship V3 将能够运载 100 公吨的有效载荷，未来几代 Starship 的设计目标是将该有效载荷翻倍。

paras.en: Launches: Launches are a key measure of our operational scale, which in turn supports our revenue growth and mission to expand humanity’s presence in space. Launches in a period represent the sum of all successful orbital and flight tests across our rockets, including internal Starlink deployments, development tests, and launches for our third-party customers, and excluding any cancellations or scrubs that occurred in that period. Falcon 9 is the most active orbital launch vehicle today, with approximately 620 orbital space launches as of March 31, 2026, and an over 99% mission success rate. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, we launched 40 Falcon rockets, of which 39 were flight-proven booster launches, and in 2025, we launched 165 Falcon 9 rockets, of which 157 were flight-proven booster launches. While we have steadily increased our Falcon 9 launch cadence over recent years, we expect Falcon 9 launches to decrease over time. While Falcon 9 currently drives the majority of our launch activity, we expect Starship, which is designed to be the world’s first fully, rapidly, reusable launch vehicle, to become a larger contributor to our launch volume as it enters operational service. To date, we have executed 12 Starship flight tests to advance our goal of rapidly and fully reusable orbital capability, a breakthrough we believe will transform our launch economics and benefit both our business and customers who rely on our launch services. Our 12th flight test in May 2026 debuted the next generation Starship vehicle and Super Heavy booster, powered by the next evolution of our Raptor engine and launching from a newly designed pad at Starbase. We allocate a significant amount of launch capacity to our Connectivity segment, and expect to allocate a significant amount to our AI segment in the future. Our Space segment revenue only reflects our customer launches and customer activities.
paras.zh: 发射次数：发射次数是衡量我们运营规模的关键指标，而运营规模反过来支撑我们的收入增长以及拓展人类在太空存在的使命。某一期间的发射次数代表我们各型火箭所有成功的轨道发射与飞行测试之和，包括内部 Starlink 部署、开发测试以及为第三方客户执行的发射，并排除该期间发生的任何取消或中止。Falcon 9 是当今最活跃的轨道运载火箭，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日已完成约 620 次轨道太空发射，任务成功率超过 99%。在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，我们发射了 40 枚 Falcon 火箭，其中 39 次为经过飞行验证的助推器发射；2025 年，我们发射了 165 枚 Falcon 9 火箭，其中 157 次为经过飞行验证的助推器发射。尽管近年来我们稳步提高了 Falcon 9 的发射频次，但我们预计 Falcon 9 的发射次数将随时间推移而下降。虽然 Falcon 9 目前贡献了我们大部分发射活动，但我们预计 Starship——其设计目标是成为全球首款完全、快速可重复使用的运载火箭——在投入运营服务后将成为我们发射量的更大贡献者。迄今为止，我们已执行 12 次 Starship 飞行测试，以推进我们实现快速、完全可重复使用轨道能力的目标，我们相信这一突破将改变我们的发射经济性，并惠及我们的业务以及依赖我们发射服务的客户。我们于 2026 年 5 月进行的第 12 次飞行测试首次推出了下一代 Starship 飞行器与 Super Heavy 助推器，其搭载我们 Raptor 发动机的下一代演进版本，并从 Starbase 一座新设计的发射台发射。我们将大量发射能力分配给我们的互联业务板块，并预计未来将向我们的 AI 业务板块分配大量发射能力。我们的太空业务板块收入仅反映我们的客户发射和客户活动。

paras.en: (1) With respect to Falcon launches, the number of launches for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024, and 2025 totaled 96, 134, and 165, respectively, of which customer launches totaled 33, 45, and 43, respectively, and internal launches totaled 63, 89, and 122, respectively. The number of Falcon launches for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2026 totaled 36 and 40, respectively, of which customer launches totaled 12 and 7, respectively, and internal launches totaled 24 and 33, respectively. We designate a launch as a “customer launch” if an external customer payload constitutes the primary payload (i.e., where the principal objective is to deliver the customer payload) and the mission parameters (e.g., launch window, orbital parameters, mission profile) are designed around the primary payload’s requirements. To date, all Starship launches have been classified as internal.
paras.zh: (1) 就 Falcon 发射而言，截至 2023 年、2024 年和 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度的发射次数分别为 96 次、134 次和 165 次，其中客户发射分别为 33 次、45 次和 43 次，内部发射分别为 63 次、89 次和 122 次。截至 2025 年和 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月的 Falcon 发射次数分别为 36 次和 40 次，其中客户发射分别为 12 次和 7 次，内部发射分别为 24 次和 33 次。若外部客户载荷构成主要载荷（即主要目标为运送客户载荷），且任务参数（例如发射窗口、轨道参数、任务剖面）围绕主要载荷的需求设计，我们将该次发射指定为“客户发射”。迄今为止，所有 Starship 发射均被归类为内部发射。

paras.en: #### Connectivity
paras.zh: #### 互联业务

paras.en: In our Connectivity segment, we view Starlink Subscribers and Starlink Subscriber ARPU as key business metrics to evaluate our growth and monetization.
paras.zh: 在我们的互联业务板块中，我们将 Starlink 订阅用户数和 Starlink 订阅用户 ARPU 视为评估我们增长和变现能力的关键业务指标。

paras.en: Starlink Subscribers: We define a Starlink Subscriber as a unique Service Line that is directly assigned to a Starlink.com account registered to a person or entity that does not have a direct, negotiated agreement with the Starlink sales team. A Service Line is an individual instance of Starlink broadband internet service provisioned under a subscription plan, generally associated with a specific Starlink terminal or group of terminals, and billed according to Starlink’s service plans and terms of service. The number of Service Lines is distinct from the number of unique devices, account holders, end users or physical persons. An individual, household, or business may share a single Service Line among multiple end-users. Likewise, an individual, household, or business may maintain multiple service lines (e.g., both a Residential Service Line and a separate Roam Service Line, which would be defined as two separate Service Lines and therefore two Starlink Subscribers).
paras.zh: Starlink 订阅用户：我们将 Starlink 订阅用户定义为直接分配给 Starlink.com 账户的唯一服务线路，该账户注册于未与 Starlink 销售团队签订直接协商协议的个人或实体。服务线路是订阅计划下开通的 Starlink 宽带互联网服务的单个实例，通常与特定的 Starlink 终端或终端组相关联，并按照 Starlink 的服务计划和服务条款计费。服务线路数量不同于唯一设备数、账户持有人数、最终用户数或自然人数。个人、家庭或企业可在多个最终用户之间共享单一服务线路。同样，个人、家庭或企业也可保有多个服务线路（例如，同时拥有一个住宅服务线路和一个单独的漫游服务线路，这将定义为两个独立的服务线路，因此为两个 Starlink 订阅用户）。

paras.en: We use this measure to assess the adoption of Starlink as we expand within and across geographies and business segments. Starlink Subscribers includes both Personal (e.g., Residential and Roam) and Business (e.g., Local Priority and Global Priority) subscription plans, but does not include managed enterprise and government customers with contracts in domains including aviation, maritime, land mobility, fixed sites and government entities. We calculate Starlink Subscribers for a period as the number of unique Service Lines at the end of the period. Starlink Subscribers totaled approximately 10.3 million and 5.0 million, up 105% and 91% on a year-over-year basis, in the quarters ended March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025, respectively.
paras.zh: 我们使用该指标来评估 Starlink 在我们于各地域和各业务板块扩张过程中的采用情况。Starlink 订阅用户包括个人（例如住宅和漫游）和商业（例如本地优先和全球优先）订阅计划，但不包括在航空、海事、陆地移动、固定站点和政府实体等领域签订合同的管理型企业客户和政府客户。我们按期末唯一服务线路数量计算某一期间的 Starlink 订阅用户。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 3 月 31 日的季度，Starlink 订阅用户分别约为 10.3 million 和 5.0 million，同比增长 105% 和 91%。

paras.en: Starlink Subscriber ARPU: We calculate ARPU as service revenue generated from Starlink Subscribers during the period divided by (i) the average number of Starlink Subscribers during the period and by (ii) the number of months in the period. Our strategy is focused on driving sustainable revenue growth and expanding our margins through operational efficiencies and technological advancements, rather than prioritizing increases in ARPU. This approach aligns with our long-term vision of expanding global connectivity and market access. We generally expect Starlink Subscriber ARPU to continue to decline over the next few years as the portion of our subscriber base outside North America continues to grow, as we add lower priced service plans, and as we adjust the monthly service plan fees we charge for broadband offerings.
