paras.zh: 我们能够通过第一性原理思维、表后发电，以及我们认为的全球最大的可持续电池储能系统网络，再加上先进液冷、高密度机架布局和高效网络方面的创新，以显著快于其他 AI 公司的速度部署电力和算力。我们的设施还采用了创新设计特征，可限制对周边社区区域电价的影响，并包含先进的水清洗、回收和再循环工艺，以支持可持续运营。我们与公用事业公司和社区合作，逐步接入并增强电网，同时承诺承担为服务我们的数据中心而进行的所有新增电力输送基础设施升级的成本，包括充足的网络升级成本，以确保这些费用不会转嫁给普通家庭。我们能够以快速且具成本效益的方式采用最新处理器进行扩展，这使我们领先于采用传统且更昂贵方法的竞争对手。因此，我们认为 COLOSSUS II 成为全球首批大规模部署 GB200 和 GB300（当时可用的最先进 AI 处理器）的数据中心之一，目前正在为我们的下一代前沿模型（包括 Grok-5）的训练提供算力。此外，通过我们与 Tesla 共同推进的 Terafab 计划——建设一座每年可生产 1 太瓦算力硬件的制造设施——我们打算进一步将垂直整合延伸至芯片设计和制造，以缓解 SpaceX 未来潜在的芯片短缺、优化算力性能，并有可能降低整体算力成本。英特尔具备大规模设计、制造和封装超高性能芯片的能力，也于 2026 年 4 月初加入了 Terafab 项目。我们从“铲子到令牌”的方法使我们能够高速训练和迭代我们的前沿模型，加速开发周期，消除外部瓶颈，并推动模型性能快速、持续地提升。

paras.en: In pursuing our mission, SpaceX has created new opportunities across our three foundational competitive advantages, Space, Connectivity, and AI:
paras.zh: 在追求我们的使命过程中，SpaceX 在我们的三大基础竞争优势——太空、连接和 AI——方面创造了新的机遇：

paras.en: - Space. Launch is one of our foundational competitive advantages. We were the first private company to develop and launch a liquid-fuel rocket to reach orbit (2008), the first private company to successfully dock a private spacecraft with the International Space Station (2012), the first company to propulsively land (2015) and refly an orbital-class rocket booster (2017), the first to begin deploying a large-scale LEO broadband satellite constellation (2019), and the first private company to launch astronauts to orbit, allowing American astronauts to again fly to and from the International Space Station on an American launch vehicle(2020). As of March 31, 2026, SpaceX had completed approximately 650 orbital space launches, and over 540 of those launches were completed by a flight-proven Falcon rocket, drastically reducing the cost of access to space. We are the only private company that is certified by NASA to send human missions to orbit. We are currently developing Starship, designed to be the world’s most powerful launch vehicle. Starship is designed to be a fully and rapidly reusable transportation system capable of carrying larger payloads farther and at lower marginal cost per launch than our current Falcon rockets. Our unparalleled launch capabilities power every aspect of our business.
paras.zh: - 太空。发射是我们的基础竞争优势之一。我们是首家研制并发射液体燃料火箭入轨的私营公司（2008 年），首家成功将私人航天器与国际空间站对接的私营公司（2012 年），首家实现轨道级火箭助推器动力着陆（2015 年）并重复使用（2017 年）的公司，首家开始部署大规模低轨宽带卫星星座的公司（2019 年），也是首家将宇航员送入轨道的私营公司，使美国宇航员得以再次搭乘美国运载火箭往返国际空间站（2020 年）。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，SpaceX 已完成约 650 次轨道太空发射，其中超过 540 次由经过飞行验证的 Falcon 火箭完成，大幅降低了进入太空的成本。我们是唯一获得 NASA 认证可执行载人入轨任务的私营公司。我们目前正在研制 Starship，其设计目标是成为世界上最强大的运载火箭。Starship 旨在成为一种可完全、快速重复使用的运输系统，能够比我们现有的 Falcon 火箭将更大载荷运送至更远距离，且每次发射的边际成本更低。我们无与伦比的发射能力支撑着我们业务的方方面面。

paras.en: - Connectivity. Since activating service for customers in 2020, Starlink has rapidly expanded global access to high-speed internet, prioritizing underserved rural and remote communities worldwide. While building terrestrial networks in such communities can be prohibitively expensive, Starlink is capable of delivering broadband connectivity anywhere on Earth with just a Starlink Kit. As of March 31, 2026, we had approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, operating the world’s most advanced broadband constellation providing internet connectivity to approximately 10.3 million Starlink Subscribers across 164 countries, territories, and other markets. In January 2024, we also began deploying our Starlink Mobile constellation that utilizes separate Starlink satellites with satellite-to-mobile capabilities, substantially reducing mobile “dead zones” around the world. As of March 31, 2026, our dedicated satellite-to-mobile constellation of approximately 650 V1 Mobile satellites provides satellite-to-mobile data, over-the-top voice, and messaging services to approximately 7.4 million monthly unique devices across approximately 30 countries.
paras.zh: - 连接。自 2020 年为客户开通服务以来，Starlink 迅速扩大了全球高速互联网接入，优先服务全球范围内服务不足的农村和偏远社区。在此类社区建设地面网络成本可能高得令人望而却步，而 Starlink 仅需一套 Starlink Kit 即可在地球上任何地方提供宽带连接。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们在低地球轨道拥有约 9,600 颗 Starlink 宽带和移动卫星，运营着世界上最先进的宽带星座，为 164 个国家、地区及其他市场的约 10.3 百万 Starlink 用户提供互联网连接。2024 年 1 月，我们还开始部署 Starlink Mobile 星座，该星座使用具备卫星直连手机能力的独立 Starlink 卫星，大幅减少了全球移动通信“盲区”。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们专用的卫星直连手机星座由约 650 颗 V1 Mobile 卫星组成，为约 30 个国家的约 7.4 百万月度独立设备提供卫星直连手机数据、OTT 语音和消息服务。

paras.en: - AI.We were the first company to deploy a coherent gigawatt-scale AI training cluster. We own and operate what we believe to be the largest AI training data center clusters on Earth, consisting of hundreds of thousand s GPUs —all in the same spirit that enabled us to launch Grok faster than any other leading foundational AI model —while maintaining full vertical integration from on-site power generation and water reclamation to GPU deployment. In under two years, we have established a dual advantage in both cost efficiency and deployment speed at scale. By owning the compute infrastructure and vertically integrating across the full AI stack, we can train and iterate our frontier models at lower cost and higher velocity and accelerate development cycles. This eliminates external bottlenecks and drives rapid, continuous improvements in model performance. The addition of the Terafab initiative aims to further extend our control to the foundational processor layer. We believe that the key constraints in the continued growth of AI are physical—chip manufacturing, data center infrastructure, and power generation; the future of AI will be determined by the control of the physical stack. We believe no other AI company has better control over the full physical stack than SpaceX. We believe this combination of our state-of-the-art AI compute infrastructure, our truth-seeking frontier model, and our access to real-time data on X creates a significant strategic advantage. Our integrated AI platforms across Grok and X had approximately 1.3 billion supported accounts active in the last twelve months ended March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, including approximately 550 million and 520 million MAUs as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively. Of our MAUs, we had approximately 117 million and 89 million MAUs that used Grok’s AI features as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively. Grok’s deep integration with X enables freshness, relevance, and contextual awareness that we believe is a competitive differentiator. This direct, real-time access to the information and human discourse on X enhances Grok’s truth-seeking capabilities by grounding outputs in up-to-date knowledge and diverse viewpoints. As a result, we believe Grok can deliver the most objective and relevant insights and best serve high-frequency, high-value use cases across consumer and enterprise AI applications.
paras.zh: - AI。我们是首家部署连贯的吉瓦级 AI 训练集群的公司。我们拥有并运营着我们认为是地球上最大的 AI 训练数据中心集群，由数十万块 GPU 组成——这一切都秉承着使我们能够比任何其他领先的基础 AI 模型更快推出 Grok 的同一精神——同时保持从现场发电和水回收到 GPU 部署的完全垂直整合。在不到两年时间里，我们已在成本效率和规模化部署速度两方面建立起双重优势。通过拥有算力基础设施并在整个 AI 技术栈上实现垂直整合，我们能够以更低的成本和更高的速度训练和迭代我们的前沿模型，并加速开发周期。这消除了外部瓶颈，推动模型性能快速、持续地提升。Terafab 计划的加入旨在进一步将我们的控制延伸至基础处理器层。我们认为，AI 持续增长的关键制约因素是物理层面的——芯片制造、数据中心基础设施和发电；AI 的未来将由对物理技术栈的控制所决定。我们认为，没有其他 AI 公司比 SpaceX 对完整物理技术栈拥有更好的控制。我们相信，我们最先进的 AI 算力基础设施、追求真相的前沿模型以及对 X 上实时数据的获取，这三者的结合创造了显著的战略优势。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日的过去十二个月内，我们在 Grok 和 X 上的整合 AI 平台拥有约 13 亿个活跃的支持账户，其中截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日的月活跃用户（MAU）分别约为 5.5 亿和 5.2 亿。在我们的 MAU 中，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日，分别约有 1.17 亿和 8,900 万 MAU 使用了 Grok 的 AI 功能。Grok 与 X 的深度整合带来了时效性、相关性和情境感知能力，我们认为这是一项差异化竞争优势。这种对 X 上信息和人类话语的直接、实时访问，通过将输出建立在最新知识和多元观点之上，增强了 Grok 追求真相的能力。因此，我们认为 Grok 能够提供最客观、最相关的洞察，并最好地服务于消费者和企业 AI 应用中高频、高价值的用例。

paras.en: For complex reasoning and agentic workloads, compute is directly correlated with the quality of intelligence and task completion speed. Over the long-term, however, we expect Earth’s finite resources will not be able to sustain the immense computational demands of advanced AI models. Sustainably satisfying this compute demand will require space-based infrastructure that utilizes the ultimate fusion energy source: the Sun. We believe we are the only company with a commercially viable path to building orbital AI compute at scale, due to our unique ability to launch substantial mass into orbit through reusable, cost-efficient rockets, to manufacture secure, reliable, and high-performance satellites at low cost and high volume, and to manage large-scale constellations. We expect that owning scalable, power-efficient infrastructure to train and operate frontier models will be the most important driver for AI differentiation as AI systems converge toward artificial general intelligence (“AGI”)—which has the potential to unlock large-scale productivity gains, scientific discovery, and societal abundance.
paras.zh: 对于复杂推理和智能体工作负载，算力与智能质量和任务完成速度直接相关。然而，从长远来看，我们预计地球有限的资源将无法支撑先进 AI 模型巨大的算力需求。要可持续地满足这一算力需求，需要利用终极聚变能源——太阳——的太空基础设施。我们相信，我们是唯一一家拥有商业化可行路径来大规模建设轨道 AI 算力的公司，这得益于我们独特的能力：通过可重复使用、成本高效的火箭将大量质量送入轨道，以低成本、高产量制造安全、可靠且高性能的卫星，以及管理大型星座。我们预计，随着 AI 系统趋近于通用人工智能（“AGI”）——这有可能释放大规模生产力提升、科学发现和社会富足——拥有可扩展、高能效的基础设施来训练和运行前沿模型，将成为 AI 差异化的最重要驱动因素。

paras.en: We have created distinct new markets across the space, connectivity, and AI industries by building the integrated hardware and software infrastructure of the future and by combining our broad range of capabilities. For example, SpaceX’s recent acquisition of xAI unites SpaceX’s launch capabilities and global connectivity network with xAI’s AI development capabilities. Specifically, we believe SpaceX’s reusable rockets, scaled satellite manufacturing, and operational expertise can enable the cost-effective and rapid deployment of massive AI compute satellite constellations—with potentially million s of satellites—for orbital data centers. We believe these AI compute satellites in Sun-synchronous orbit will be able to handle energy-intensive AI workloads, such as inference demand, at far greater scale and efficiency than terrestrial alternatives, with Starlink providing low-latency, global connectivity linking these orbital AI systems to people around the world and delivering real-time intelligence. Our goal is to leverage our launch leadership, global connectivity network, and AI expertise to allow us to continue building the integrated infrastructure of the future on Earth, the Moon, Mars, and beyond to benefit humanity.
paras.zh: 通过构建未来的集成硬件和软件基础设施，并结合我们广泛的能力，我们在太空、连接和 AI 行业创造了独特的新市场。例如，SpaceX 最近收购 xAI，将 SpaceX 的发射能力和全球连接网络与 xAI 的 AI 开发能力结合在一起。具体而言，我们相信 SpaceX 的可重复使用火箭、规模化卫星制造和运营专长，能够实现大规模 AI 算力卫星星座——可能达到数百万颗卫星——的经济高效快速部署，用于轨道数据中心。我们相信，这些位于太阳同步轨道的 AI 算力卫星将能够以远超地面替代方案的规模和效率处理能源密集型 AI 工作负载，例如推理需求，而 Starlink 提供低延迟的全球连接，将这些轨道 AI 系统与世界各地的人们连接起来，并交付实时智能。我们的目标是利用我们在发射领域的领导地位、全球连接网络和 AI 专长，继续在地球、月球、火星及更远的地方构建未来的集成基础设施，以造福人类。

paras.en: We have an intense, mission-driven, engineering-first culture that seeks to achieve what many have deemed impossible. “The Algorithm,” as it is known internally, is a five-step iterative process that emphasizes making the requirements less dumb, deleting unnecessary processes or parts (embracing the principle that the best part is no part), only then optimizing the necessary processes or parts, accelerating cycle time, and automating only proven processes. We strive to make the incredible and extraordinary accessible and repeatable, and we have grown rapidly by continuously leveraging our core strengths, including:
paras.zh: 我们拥有一种强烈的、使命驱动的、工程优先的文化，致力于实现许多人认为不可能的事情。内部称为“算法”的是一个五步迭代流程，强调让需求变得不那么愚蠢，删除不必要的流程或部件（秉持“最好的部件是没有部件”的原则），然后才优化必要的流程或部件，加快周期时间，并且只对经过验证的流程进行自动化。我们努力让不可思议和非凡的事物变得可及且可重复，并通过不断利用我们的核心优势实现了快速增长，包括：

paras.en: - Global leadership in orbital launch services;
paras.zh: - 在轨道发射服务领域的全球领导地位；

paras.en: - Unrivaled satellite and connectivity platform across design, manufacturing, deployment, and operations;
paras.zh: - 在設計、制造、部署和运营方面无与伦比的卫星和连接平台；

paras.en: - Truth-seeking AI model enhanced by real-time data;
paras.zh: - 由实时数据增强的求真 AI 模型；

paras.en: - Extreme vertical integration enabling high velocity and superior cost efficiency at scale;
paras.zh: - 极致的垂直整合，在规模化下实现高速度与卓越的成本效率；

paras.en: - Unique ability to scale new trillion-dollar markets across Space, Connectivity, and AI;
paras.zh: - 独特的能力，可在太空、连接和 AI 领域开拓新的万亿美元级市场；

paras.en: - Business models that are incredibly difficult to replicate; and
paras.zh: - 极难被复制的商业模式；以及

paras.en: - Our mission-driven culture and world-class talent.
paras.zh: - 我们以使命驱动的文化和世界一流的人才。

paras.en: We have a stellar track record of capital allocation and value creation in Space and Connectivity. Since SpaceX’s founding in 2002, we have raised over $9 billion of equity capital to fund the development and growth of these two business segments. The Space segment became Segment Adjusted EBITDA positive on a sustained basis beginning in 2018 and the Connectivity segment became in aggregate Segment Adjusted EBITDA positive on a sustained basis beginning in 2023. In 2025, our Space segment generated a loss from operations of $(657) million and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $653 million, including the impact of funding $3,004 million in research and development expense for our next-generation Starship launch vehicle program. In 2025, our Connectivity segment generated income from operations of $4,423 million and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $7,168 million.
paras.zh: 我们在太空和连接领域的资本配置与价值创造方面拥有卓越的过往记录。自 SpaceX 于 2002 年成立以来，我们已募集超过 $9 billion 的股权资本，用于资助这两个业务板块的开发与增长。太空板块自 2018 年起持续实现板块调整后 EBITDA 为正，连接板块自 2023 年起整体持续实现板块调整后 EBITDA 为正。2025 年，我们的太空板块产生经营亏损 $(657) million，板块调整后 EBITDA 为 $653 million，其中包括为我们的下一代 Starship 运载火箭项目投入 $3,004 million 研发费用的影响。2025 年，我们的连接板块产生经营利润 $4,423 million，板块调整后 EBITDA 为 $7,168 million。

paras.en: Our financial results reflect the strength of our operating model and our ability to create and scale multiple new businesses:
paras.zh: 我们的财务业绩反映了我们运营模式的实力以及我们创建并规模化多项新业务的能力：

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, we generated revenue on a consolidated basis of $4,694 million, loss from operations of $(1,943) million and Adjusted EBITDA of $1,127 million. In 2025, we generated revenue on a consolidated basis of $18,674 million, loss from operations of $(2,589) million and Adjusted EBITDA of $6,584 million. Our Space and Connectivity segments contributed the substantial majority of our consolidated revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 and the year ended December 31, 2025, demonstrating the benefits of their scale and operating leverage in our vertically integrated business model;
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们按合并口径产生收入 $4,694 million，经营亏损 $(1,943) million，调整后 EBITDA 为 $1,127 million。2025 年，我们按合并口径产生收入 $18,674 million，经营亏损 $(2,589) million，调整后 EBITDA 为 $6,584 million。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，我们的太空板块和连接板块贡献了合并收入的绝大部分，体现了其规模以及我们垂直整合业务模式中经营杠杆所带来的效益；

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, our Space segment generated revenue of $619 million, loss from operations of $(662) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $(351) million. In 2025, our Space segment generated revenue of $4,086 million, loss from operations of $(657) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $653 million Additionally, our Space segment funded $930 million and $3,004 million in research and development expense during the three months ended March 31, 2026 and the year ended December 31, 2025, respectively, for our next-generation Starship launch vehicle program. Starship is designed to enable a step-function change in our launch capability across reusability, payload capacity, and launch cadence, and is the key enabler of our long-term growth strategy by unlocking entirely new categories of missions;
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们的太空板块产生收入 $619 million，经营亏损 $(662) million，板块调整后 EBITDA 为 $(351) million。2025 年，我们的太空板块产生收入 $4,086 million，经营亏损 $(657) million，板块调整后 EBITDA 为 $653 million。此外，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，我们的太空板块分别为我们的下一代 Starship 运载火箭项目投入研发费用 $930 million 和 $3,004 million。Starship 旨在在可重复使用性、有效载荷能力和发射频率方面实现我们发射能力的阶跃式变革，并通过开启全新的任务类别，成为我们长期增长战略的关键推动因素；

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, our Connectivity segment generated revenue of $3,257 million, income from operations of $1,188 million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $2,087 million. Our Connectivity segment, primarily driven by Starlink, generated revenue of $11,387 million, income from operations of $4,423 million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $7,168 million in 2025, representing year-over-year growth of 49.8%, 120.4%, and 86.2%, respectively, benefiting from subscriber growth, increasing enterprise adoption, and continued improvement in network efficiency;
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们的互联业务板块实现收入 $3,257 million、经营利润 $1,188 million、板块调整后 EBITDA $2,087 million。2025 年，我们的互联业务板块（主要由 Starlink 驱动）实现收入 $11,387 million、经营利润 $4,423 million、板块调整后 EBITDA $7,168 million，同比分别增长 49.8%、120.4% 和 86.2%，受益于用户增长、企业采用率提升以及网络效率的持续改善；

paras.en: - In our newly acquired AI segment, we plan to prioritize growth and investment to capture significant opportunities in AI applications and compute infrastructure. For the three months ended March 31, 2026, our AI segment generated revenue of $818 million, loss from operations of $(2,469) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $(609) million. In 2025, our AI segment generated revenue of $3,201 million, loss from operations of $(6,355) million, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $(1,237) million, reflecting its earlier stage of development and continued investments to support long-term growth opportunities in AI; and
paras.zh: - 在我们新收购的 AI 业务板块中，我们计划优先推动增长与投资，以把握 AI 应用和算力基础设施领域的重大机遇。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们的 AI 业务板块实现收入 $818 million、经营亏损 $(2,469) million、板块调整后 EBITDA $(609) million。2025 年，我们的 AI 业务板块实现收入 $3,201 million、经营亏损 $(6,355) million、板块调整后 EBITDA $(1,237) million，反映出其处于较早的发展阶段，并持续投入以支持 AI 领域的长期增长机遇；以及

paras.en: - For the three months ended March 31, 2026, capital expenditures for our Space segment was $1,052 million, for our Connectivity segment was $1,332 million and for our AI segment was $7,723 million. In 2025, capital expenditures for our Space segment was $3,832 million, for our Connectivity segment was $4,178 million and for our AI segment was $12,727 million.
paras.zh: - 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月，我们太空业务板块的资本支出为 $1,052 million，互联业务板块为 $1,332 million，AI 业务板块为 $7,723 million。2025 年，我们太空业务板块的资本支出为 $3,832 million，互联业务板块为 $4,178 million，AI 业务板块为 $12,727 million。

paras.en: Segment Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP measure. Please refer to the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Non-GAAP Financial Measures” for additional information on our non-GAAP financial measures, including reconciliations of Segment Adjusted EBITDA to segment income (loss) from operations, the most directly comparable GAAP measure.
paras.zh: 板块调整后 EBITDA 是一项非 GAAP 指标。有关我们非 GAAP 财务指标的更多信息，包括板块调整后 EBITDA 与板块经营利润（亏损）（最直接可比的 GAAP 指标）的对账，请参阅标题为“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——非 GAAP 财务指标”的章节。

paras.en: For the entirety of its existence, human civilization has lived on a single celestial body: Earth. The current paradigm, in which human civilization is confined to one planet, exposes humanity to existential threats that are unpredictable and uncontrollable on a planetary scale. These threats include naturally occurring catastrophic events—such as asteroid impacts, volcanic activity, or solar fluctuations—as well as man-made global conflicts. Geological and astronomical records indicate a non-zero probability of extinction-level events occurring over periods measurable in million s of years. Reliance on a single planetary home constitutes a single point of failure and carries existential risk with a probability of one that must be solved. By moving beyond the only home we have ever known, we ensure species-level redundancy and that the light of consciousness will not be tied to a single planet subject to the inevitable hazards of a harsh and vast universe. We do not want humans to have the same fate as dinosaurs. We want to give them a reason to look ahead with excitement, with the prospect that we are entering an age of abundance with an endlessly prosperous and exciting future.
paras.zh: 在人类文明存在的整个历程中，我们始终只生活在单一的天体上：地球。当前这种将人类文明局限于一颗行星的范式，使人类暴露于行星尺度上不可预测且无法控制的存在性威胁之中。这些威胁既包括自然发生的灾难性事件——例如小行星撞击、火山活动或太阳活动波动——也包括人为的全球性冲突。地质与天文记录表明，在数以百万年计的时间跨度内，灭绝级事件发生的概率并非为零。依赖单一的行星家园构成了单点故障，并承载着概率为一的存在性风险，这一风险必须得到解决。通过走出我们迄今唯一已知的家园，我们确保物种层面的冗余，并确保意识之光不会系于一颗必然遭受严酷而浩瀚宇宙中种种危险的单一星球。我们不希望人类重蹈恐龙的命运。我们希望给人类一个满怀兴奋展望未来的理由，一个我们正迈入富足时代、拥有无尽繁荣与激动人心未来的前景。

paras.en: Artist Visualization of Life on Mars For decades, a reality where humanity travels between the planets and the stars has felt tantalizingly close but still locked in the pages and screens of science fiction. We are capable of better understanding the universe, exploring the universe, and ultimately making life multiplanetary across the universe. We are becoming a civilization with the ability to reach beyond Earth’s cradle and begin to inhabit other worlds. While we remain dedicated to this fundamental mission, our progress in accessing space continues to yield opportunities that enrich life on Earth.
paras.zh: 火星生命艺术家构想图 数十年来，人类在行星与恒星之间穿梭的现实一直显得近在咫尺，却仍被禁锢在科幻小说的书页与屏幕之中。我们有能力更好地理解宇宙、探索宇宙，并最终让生命在宇宙中多行星化。我们正在成为一个有能力走出地球摇篮、开始栖居其他世界的文明。在始终致力于这一根本使命的同时，我们在进入太空方面的进展持续带来丰富地球生活的机遇。

paras.en: We believe our steps into the expanse will be accelerated by the rapid emergence of AI. As humanity moves into the unknown, we believe AI will be our greatest tool for innovation and navigation, helping us better understand day-to-day life and the universe, and master the complexity of establishing new civilizations in the far-flung reaches of space. For AI to help us understand the universe, we believe it must be able to discard the often popular, but wrong, in favor of the unpopular, but true. By combining the innate human desire to seek truth and explore with our breakthrough technologies, we believe humanity will eventually reach new frontiers across the universe, while enhancing the quality and resilience of life on Earth.
paras.zh: 我们相信，迈向浩瀚宇宙的步伐将因 AI 的迅速崛起而加速。随着人类走向未知，我们相信 AI 将成为我们创新与导航的最伟大工具，帮助我们更好地理解日常生活与宇宙，并驾驭在遥远太空建立新文明的复杂性。为了让 AI 帮助我们理解宇宙，我们认为它必须能够摒弃往往流行却错误的观点，转而选择不受欢迎却真实的观点。通过将人类探寻真理与探索的天性同我们的突破性技术相结合，我们相信人类终将抵达宇宙中的新前沿，同时提升地球生活的质量与韧性。

paras.en: The rapid emergence of the AI era intensifies the urgency of our mission, as AI has the potential to accelerate not only space exploration, but also transformative societal advancements on Earth. However, AI’s ability to revolutionize human potential is directly dependent on meeting exponentially increasing resource demands. On Earth, the massive expansion of data center capacity to support growing compute demand is significantly outpacing electricity generation, which was effectively flat in the United States for approximately 15 years, growing at a compound annual growth rate of 0.1% from 2008 to 2023. Despite the recent increase in electricity demand from AI data centers, electricity generation in the United States has grown at an annual rate of less than 3% between 2023 and 2025, while electricity generation in China has grown at approximately twice that rate in the same time period. U.S. compute demand has already outpaced available power supply with estimated demand of 62 gigawatts in 2025 exceeding the power generation of 49 gigawatts, according to industry sources. We expect the gap between demand for compute and power supply to continue to widen meaningfully as AI compute needs proliferate. Such structural power shortages are expected to intensify over the coming years. This supply and demand imbalance is already imposing unsustainable strains on terrestrial power grids, supply chains, and the environment. The Sun contains approximately 99.8% of the solar system’s energy and, as a result, we believe it is the only truly scalable solution to terrestrial energy constraints in the age of AI. Harnessing this energy in space is considerably more efficient than on land. Space-based solar arrays can generate more than five times the energy per unit area of terrestrial solar due to continuous illumination, lack of atmospheric interference, and optimal orientation. SpaceX is well-positioned to capture this space-based solar energy through our ability to rapidly access Sun-synchronous orbit through our satellite manufacturing scale and launch capability. As a result, we are expanding our footprint and harnessing the vast resources of space that are essential to sustaining technological development. Our goal is to ensure that AI becomes a force for human flourishing and a benefit to civilization, rather than a catalyst for terrestrial resource depletion and instability. We believe owning scalable, power-efficient infrastructure to train and operate frontier models will be the most important competitive differentiator as AI systems converge toward AGI—which has the potential to unlock large-scale productivity gains, scientific discovery, and societal abundance.
paras.zh: AI 时代的迅速到来加剧了我们使命的紧迫性，因为 AI 不仅有可能加速太空探索，也有可能加速地球上具有变革意义的社会进步。然而，AI 能否彻底释放人类潜能，直接取决于能否满足呈指数级增长的资源需求。在地球上，为支持不断增长的算力需求而大规模扩建数据中心容量，其速度已显著超过发电量的增长——美国的发电量在大约 15 年间基本持平，2008 年至 2023 年的复合年增长率仅为 0.1%。尽管近期 AI 数据中心带来的电力需求有所上升，但 2023 年至 2025 年间美国发电量的年增长率仍不足 3%，而同期中国的发电量增速约为美国的两倍。据行业信息来源，美国算力需求已超过可用电力供应，2025 年估计需求为 62 吉瓦，超过 49 吉瓦的发电量。我们预计，随着 AI 算力需求激增，算力需求与电力供应之间的缺口将继续显著扩大。此类结构性电力短缺预计在未来数年将进一步加剧。这种供需失衡已对地面电网、供应链和环境造成不可持续的壓力。太阳蕴含了太阳系约 99.8% 的能量，因此我们认为，在 AI 时代，太阳是唯一真正可规模化的解决方案，能够破解地球能源约束。在太空利用这一能量比在地面高效得多。由于持续受光、无大气干扰以及最佳朝向，太空太阳能阵列的单位面积发电量可达地面太阳能的五倍以上。SpaceX 凭借卫星制造规模和发射能力，能够快速进入太阳同步轨道，因而处于捕获这种太空太阳能的有利位置。因此，我们正在扩大业务版图，开发利用广袤的太空资源——这些资源对于维持技术发展至关重要。我们的目标是确保 AI 成为推动人类繁荣、造福文明的力量，而不是导致地球资源枯竭和不稳定的催化剂。我们相信，随着 AI 系统趋近 AGI——AGI 有潜力释放大规模生产力提升、科学发现和社会富足——拥有可扩展、高能效的基础设施来训练和运行前沿模型，将成为最重要的竞争差异化优势。

paras.en: We believe space represents the largest economic frontier in human history. Our unmatched launch cadence has massively increased access to space, enabling rapid and reliable missions for humans, cargo, and satellites—creating unprecedented opportunities for innovation, scientific discovery, and global connectivity. SpaceX has always been a mission-driven company, founded with the goal of making humanity multiplanetary. By dramatically reducing the cost of access to space, we have been able to expand our mission to address some of the Earth’s most pressing challenges, including bridging the digital divide by aiming to connect over three billion unconnected people to the internet and humanity’s collective knowledge. Starlink is our groundbreaking solution for global internet connectivity, delivering high-speed, low-latency access to the most remote and underserved corners of the world— from Antarctica’s frozen wilderness to vast oceans and towering mountaintops—overcoming barriers posed by traditional terrestrial infrastructure. Starlink’s unparalleled global reach has the potential to enable society to educate billion s of people, to help lift entire communities out of poverty, and to provide essential connectivity to schools, hospitals, and critical services, fostering a more equitable and informed future for humanity. We support essential applications such as education in rural and underserved regions, telemedicine for hard-to-reach patients, seamless connectivity for aviation and maritime users, and resilient communications during natural disasters. For example, during the 2023 Maui wildfires, which devastated Lahaina and left thousand s without power or cellular service, Starlink rapidly deployed over 650 terminals to restore high-speed internet connectivity, enabling first responders, humanitarian organizations, and survivors to coordinate relief efforts, access aid resources, communicate with family, and support recovery in areas where traditional infrastructure had completely failed. During Hurricanes Helene and Milton in 2024 in the southeastern United States, our Starlink terminals provided a rapid lifeline for communication and recovery when traditional cell towers, broadband lines, and power infrastructure were knocked out for days or weeks by widespread damage caused by flooding and high winds.
paras.zh: 我们相信，太空代表着人类历史上最大的经济前沿。我们无可匹敌的发射节奏大幅提升了进入太空的可及性，为人员、货物和卫星提供快速可靠的飞行任务——从而为创新、科学发现和全球互联创造前所未有的机遇。SpaceX 始终是一家以使命驱动的公司，创立之初的目标就是让人类成为多行星物种。通过大幅降低进入太空的成本，我们得以拓展自身使命，以应对地球上一些最紧迫的挑战，包括弥合数字鸿沟——力求将超过三十亿未联网人口接入互联网并获取人类的集体知识。Starlink 是我们为实现全球互联网连接而推出的突破性解决方案，为世界上最偏远和服务最匮乏的角落——从南极洲的冰原荒野到浩瀚海洋和高耸山峰——提供高速、低延迟的接入服务，克服了传统地面基础设施所带来的障碍。Starlink 无与伦比的全球覆盖能力有望帮助社会教育数十亿人，帮助整个社区摆脱贫困，并为学校、医院和关键服务提供必要的连接，从而为人类营造一个更加公平、更加知情的未来。我们支持诸如偏远和服务匮乏地区教育、难以到达患者的远程医疗、航空和海事用户的无缝连接，以及自然灾害期间的韧性通信等关键应用。例如，在 2023 年毛伊岛野火期间，大火摧毁了拉海纳，导致数千人失去电力和蜂窝服务，Starlink 迅速部署了超过 650 台终端以恢复高速互联网连接，使急救人员、人道主义组织和幸存者能够协调救援工作、获取援助资源、与家人沟通，并在传统基础设施完全失效的地区支持灾后恢复。在 2024 年美国东南部遭遇飓风 Helene 和 Milton 期间，当传统蜂窝基站、宽带线路和电力基础设施因洪水和强风造成的大范围破坏而中断数天或数周时，我们的 Starlink 终端为通信和恢复提供了快速的生命线。

paras.en: Our AI technology also has the ability to elevate the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We believe AI has the potential to revolutionize human potential—from advanced manufacturing and infrastructure development to scientific research and medicine—delivering tangible real-world benefits for individuals, organizations, and governments. For example, AI systems can expedite scientific discovery for researchers, aid healthcare professionals in precise medical analysis and diagnosis, and empower educators to craft tailored learning experiences for students. Moreover, these technologies can optimize Earth’s resource allocation, enhance disaster response strategies, and drive efficiencies in transportation and energy systems.
paras.zh: 我们的人工智能技术同样有能力提升世界各地人们和社区的生活质量。我们相信，人工智能有潜力彻底释放人类潜能——从先进制造和基础设施建设到科学研究和医学——为个人、组织和政府带来切实的现实效益。例如，人工智能系统可以帮助研究人员加快科学发现，协助医疗专业人员进行精准的医学分析和诊断，并赋能教育工作者为学生打造量身定制的学习体验。此外，这些技术还可以优化地球的资源分配、增强灾害应对策略，并提升交通和能源系统的效率。

paras.en: We believe that our current space efforts will catalyze transformative breakthroughs that could reshape terrestrial industries and lead to the emergence of new trillion-dollar markets on the Moon, Mars, and beyond. In particular, we believe our goal of establishing a lunar presence will enable terawatt-scale annual AI compute growth, support deeper space exploration and industrialization, and serve as a stepping stone to establishing a civilization on Mars. Due to technological advancements that we are working towards, such as in-space propellant transfer, we believe our Starship vehicle will be capable of landing massive amounts of cargo on the Moon. Once there, we believe it will be possible to establish a permanent presence for scientific and manufacturing pursuits. For example, we believe that factories on the Moon will be able to take advantage of lunar resources to manufacture million s of AI compute satellites and deploy them farther into space. Our goal is to establish a sustainable lunar presence for scientific exploration, industrialization, and as a stepping stone to Mars, serving as a proving ground for habitats, resource utilization, and Starship systems essential for long-term human survival beyond Earth.
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们当前的太空努力将催生变革性突破，这些突破可能重塑地球上的各个产业，并在月球、火星及更远的地方催生新的万亿美元级市场。特别是，我们相信我们建立月球存在的目标将实现太瓦级年度 AI 算力增长，支持更深入的太空探索与工业化，并成为在火星上建立文明的垫脚石。得益于我们正在推进的技术进步，例如在轨推进剂转移，我们相信我们的 Starship 飞行器将能够在月球上着陆大量货物。一旦抵达那里，我们相信将有可能建立永久存在，以开展科学和制造活动。例如，我们相信月球上的工厂将能够利用月球资源制造数百万颗 AI 算力卫星，并将它们部署到更远的太空。我们的目标是建立可持续的月球存在，用于科学探索、工业化，并作为通往火星的垫脚石，为栖息地、资源利用以及长期人类在地球之外生存所必需的 Starship 系统提供试验场。

paras.en: We believe the next paradigm shift for humanity is the creation of a resilient, perpetually expanding spacefaring civilization that drives continuous innovation across new frontiers, ultimately propelling us to Kardashev Type II status—a civilization that harnesses the full energy output of our Sun. In the near term, we expect space-enabled technologies to enhance life on Earth through greater global connectivity and breakthroughs forged in the harsh environments of our solar system, leading to accelerating progress in energy and AI. As we build infrastructure in the Earth’s orbit, and potentially on the Moon, Mars and beyond, we believe we are capable of unlocking an era of unprecedented economic expansion, while also contributing to the safeguards of humanity’s future against existential risk.
paras.zh: 我们相信，人类的下一次范式转变是创建一个具有韧性、持续扩张的太空文明，推动新前沿领域的持续创新，最终将我们推向卡尔达肖夫 II 型文明——一个能够利用太阳全部能量输出的文明。近期，我们预计太空赋能技术将通过增强全球连接性以及在太阳系严酷环境中锻造的突破来改善地球上的生活，从而加速能源和 AI 领域的进步。随着我们在地球轨道以及可能在月球、火星及更远地方建设基础设施，我们相信我们能够开启一个前所未有的经济扩张时代，同时也为人类未来抵御生存性风险作出贡献。

paras.en: Our mission is to build the systems and technologies necessary to make life multiplanetary, to understand the true nature of the universe, and to extend the light of consciousness to the stars. To do this, we’ve formed the most ambitious, vertically integrated innovation engine on (and off) Earth. We are combining the most transformative and critical technologies in human history, including reusable rockets, a fully global internet service, satellite-to-mobile communications that enable connectivity everywhere, our real-time information, entertainment, and free speech platform, and a truth-seeking AI system designed to accelerate scientific discovery and augment human capabilities. These capabilities form a self-reinforcing ecosystem: launch systems deploy and maintain the satellite network, which delivers ubiquitous connectivity and vast data flows; the platform surfaces real-time information and supports open discourse; and AI processes data at scale to drive breakthroughs in physics, materials science, and space exploration. Together, they create a foundation for the development of the infrastructure of the future and the ultimate goal of establishing a self-sustaining human presence on other planets.
paras.zh: 我们的使命是构建必要的系统与技术，使生命得以在多行星上存续，理解宇宙的真实本质，并将意识之光延伸至星辰。为此，我们打造了地球上（以及地球之外）最具雄心、垂直整合程度最高的创新引擎。我们正在融合人类历史上最具变革性和最关键的技术，包括可重复使用火箭、覆盖全球的互联网服务、实现无处不在连接的卫星直连手机通信、我们的实时信息、娱乐与言论自由平台，以及一个旨在加速科学发现、增强人类能力的求真型 AI 系统。这些能力构成了一个自我强化的生态系统：发射系统部署并维护卫星网络，后者提供无处不在的连接和海量数据流；平台呈现实时信息并支持开放讨论；AI 则大规模处理数据，推动物理学、材料科学和太空探索领域的突破。它们共同为未来基础设施的发展奠定了基础，并服务于在其他行星上建立自给自足的人类存在这一终极目标。

paras.en: SpaceX designs, manufactures, launches, and operates the world’s most advanced rockets and spacecraft. We safely and reliably transport astronauts, satellites, and other payloads on missions that benefit life on Earth. Since 2023, we have launched more than 80% of mass to orbit for the world each year with an over 99% mission success rate. We believe our unparalleled launch capabilities represent the foundational competitive advantage that enables all other parts of our business. We operate a high-speed, low-latency broadband data and communications network powered by approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, delivering connectivity to million s of consumer, enterprise, and government customers across 164 countries, territories, and other markets, as of March 31, 2026. We also built one of the world’s most advanced models in under two years and are rapidly scaling the associated AI compute infrastructure—starting on Earth with the goal of extending to space—at industry-leading pace and cost efficiency. We believe that space represents the largest economic frontier in human history and that AI is a transformative force for understanding the universe. Together, we believe that space and AI will enable an age of abundance that will lead to an unprecedented expansion in the global economy. We are the only company that has the foundational infrastructure across hardware and software necessary to drive transformative innovation across space, connectivity, and AI. Our technological advancements are redefining industries on Earth, while aiming to create new ones on the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
paras.zh: SpaceX 设计、制造、发射并运营全球最先进的火箭和航天器。我们安全可靠地运送宇航员、卫星及其他有效载荷，执行造福地球生命的任务。自 2023 年以来，我们每年为全球发射了超过 80% 的入轨质量，任务成功率超过 99%。我们相信，我们无与伦比的发射能力构成了使业务其他所有部分得以实现的基础性竞争优势。我们运营着一个高速、低延迟的宽带数据与通信网络，由低地球轨道上约 9,600 颗 Starlink 宽带和移动卫星提供支持，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，为 164 个国家、地区及其他市场的数百万消费者、企业和政府客户提供连接。我们还在不到两年内构建了全球最先进的模型之一，并以行业领先的速度和成本效率快速扩展相关的 AI 算力基础设施——从地球起步，目标延伸至太空。我们相信，太空代表着人类历史上最大的经济前沿，而 AI 是理解宇宙的变革性力量。我们相信，太空与 AI 将共同开启一个丰裕时代，带来全球经济的空前扩张。我们是唯一一家拥有横跨硬件和软件的基础设施、能够在太空、连接和 AI 领域推动变革性创新的公司。我们的技术进步正在重新定义地球上的各个行业，同时致力于在月球、火星及更远的地方创造新的行业。

paras.en: #### Our Unparalleled Launch Capabilities
paras.zh: #### 我们无与伦比的发射能力

paras.en: Since our founding in 2002, SpaceX has cracked the code on accessing space at scale, transforming an industry characterized by decades of stagnation, risk aversion, and economically perverse cost structures. We design, manufacture, launch, and refurbish reusable launch vehicles that provide cost-efficient, reliable, and high-cadence access to space for our own purposes as well as for third-party commercial and government customers. In 2025, we launched from four primary launch pads in the United States and successfully recovered boosters across seven landing facilities including autonomous drone ships and catch towers based on the vehicle type and mission profile. Our extensive vertical integration and end-to-end control over the entire value chain, from design to launch to operations, allows us to achieve unprecedented speed and cost efficiency.
paras.zh: 自 2002 年成立以来，SpaceX 已攻克规模化进入太空的难题，彻底改变了一个以数十年停滞、规避风险和经济上扭曲的成本结构为特征的行业。我们设计、制造、发射并翻新可重复使用运载火箭，为自身用途以及第三方商业和政府客户提供高性价比、可靠且高频次的太空进入能力。2025 年，我们从美国的四个主要发射台实施发射，并根据飞行器类型和任务剖面，在包括自主无人船和捕获塔在内的七个着陆设施成功回收助推器。我们高度垂直整合，并对从设计到发射再到运营的整个价值链实现端到端控制，这使我们能够实现前所未有的速度和成本效率。

paras.en: As of March 31, 2026, SpaceX had launched a total mass to orbit of approximately 7,400 metric tons with an over 99% mission success rate across our Falcon rockets. We have completed approximately 650 orbital space launches, and over 540 of those launches were completed by a flight-proven Falcon rocket. In 2025 alone, SpaceX completed 170 missions across Falcon and Starship vehicles and 159 flight-proven booster launches with an over 99% success rate on attempted booster recoveries. We launched over 2,200 metric tons, representing over 80% of mass to orbit for the world in 2025. With the first successful launch of Falcon 1 in 2008, we became the first private company to successfully launch a liquid-fueled rocket to Earth’s orbit. Just two years later, in 2010, the commercial debut of the Falcon 9 rocket revolutionized space access by delivering unprecedented cost efficiency. For example, according to NASA, the first version of Falcon 9 in 2010 reduced launch cost to approximately $2,700 per kilogram, which represented a reduction of approximately 85% compared to the historical average launch cost per kilogram of $18,500. The first version of Falcon Heavy in 2018 further reduced this cost to $1,400 per kilogram, a reduction of approximately 92% compared to the historical average. We have also reduced our internal cost of launch through a combination of engineering improvements, manufacturing efficiencies, and economies of scale—most notably, through our ability to drive more frequent reuse of rockets.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，SpaceX 已向轨道发射的总质量约为 7,400 公吨，猎鹰系列火箭的任务成功率超过 99%。我们已完成约 650 次轨道太空发射，其中超过 540 次由经过飞行验证的猎鹰火箭完成。仅在 2025 年，SpaceX 就通过猎鹰和星舰飞行器完成了 170 次任务，并进行了 159 次经过飞行验证的助推器发射，助推器回收尝试成功率超过 99%。2025 年我们发射了超过 2,200 公吨，占全球入轨质量的 80%以上。随着 2008 年猎鹰 1 号首次成功发射，我们成为首家成功将液体燃料火箭送入地球轨道的私营公司。仅仅两年后的 2010 年，猎鹰 9 号火箭的商业首飞通过带来前所未有的成本效率，彻底改变了太空进入方式。例如，根据 NASA 的数据，2010 年猎鹰 9 号首个版本将发射成本降至约每公斤 2,700 美元，与每公斤 18,500 美元的历史平均发射成本相比降低了约 85%。2018 年猎鹰重型首个版本进一步将该成本降至每公斤 1,400 美元，与历史平均水平相比降低了约 92%。我们还通过工程改进、制造效率提升和规模经济的结合，降低了内部发射成本——最显著的是通过推动火箭更频繁地重复使用。

paras.en: In December 2015, we achieved what many deemed impossible: landing a rocket launched to space back on Earth. By 2017, we were routinely recovering and reusing the Falcon 9 first-stage booster post-launch, delivering another step-function drop in space access costs via groundbreaking reusability. As of March 31, 2026, our Falcon 9 rockets have demonstrated the ability to refly a first-stage 34 times. Since 2020, our Dragon spacecraft has safely flown 78 crewmembers from 20 countries. With the future deployment of Starship, which is designed to be the world’s first fully and rapidly reusable spacecraft, we aim to reduce the cost to reach orbit by 99% or more relative to the historical average launch cost, establishing the most affordable and scalable path to creating new opportunities in space, such as orbital AI compute and Mars exploration.
paras.zh: 2015 年 12 月，我们实现了许多人认为不可能的事：将一枚发射至太空的火箭重新降落回地球。到 2017 年，我们已能常规性地在发射后回收并复用 Falcon 9 一级助推器，凭借突破性的可复用能力，再次实现了太空进入成本的阶跃式下降。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们的 Falcon 9 火箭已展示出一级助推器重复飞行 34 次的能力。自 2020 年以来，我们的 Dragon 飞船已安全搭载来自 20 个国家的 78 名乘员飞行。随着未来 Starship 的部署——其设计目标是成为全球首款完全且快速可复用的航天器——我们旨在将进入轨道的成本相对历史平均发射成本降低 99% 或更多，从而打造最经济、最具可扩展性的路径，在太空创造新机遇，例如轨道 AI 算力和火星探索。

paras.en: Booster Reusability Enables Increasing Launch Rates
paras.zh: 助推器可复用性推动发射频率不断提升

paras.en: Our principal launch vehicles and spacecraft include:
paras.zh: 我们的主要运载火箭和航天器包括：

paras.en: - Falcon 9. As the world’s first orbital-class rapidly reusable rocket, Falcon 9 was first launched in 2010 and has a payload capacity to LEO of approximately 23 metric tons when fully expendable. Falcon 9 has completed approximately 620 orbital space launches as of March 31, 2026, and an over 99% mission success rate, making it the most active orbital launch vehicle today. In 2025 alone, we launched 165 Falcon 9 rockets, of which 157 were flight-proven booster launches, and during the three months ended March 31, 2026, we launched 40 Falcon rockets, of which 39 were flight-proven booster launches.
paras.zh: - Falcon 9。作为全球首款轨道级快速可复用火箭，Falcon 9 于 2010 年首飞，在完全一次性使用模式下，其近地轨道（LEO）运载能力约为 23 公吨。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，Falcon 9 已完成约 620 次轨道太空发射，任务成功率超过 99%，是当今发射活动最频繁的轨道运载火箭。仅 2025 年，我们就发射了 165 枚 Falcon 9 火箭，其中 157 次为经过飞行验证的助推器发射；在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，我们发射了 40 枚 Falcon 火箭，其中 39 次为经过飞行验证的助推器发射。

paras.en: - Falcon Heavy. Falcon Heavy first launched in 2018 when it put a Tesla Roadster and its mannequin passenger, known as Starman, into orbit around the Sun. With a payload capacity to LEO of approximately 64 metric tons, Falcon Heavy is a partially reusable super heavy-lift launch vehicle designed to deliver large payloads to orbit. Falcon Heavy is one of the most powerful operational rockets in the world measured by liftoff thrust, with 11 launches as of March 31, 2026 and a 100% mission success rate.
paras.zh: - Falcon Heavy。Falcon Heavy 于 2018 年首飞，当时将一辆 Tesla Roadster 及其假人乘客（名为 Starman）送入环绕太阳的轨道。Falcon Heavy 的近地轨道（LEO）运载能力约为 64 公吨，是一款部分可复用的超重型运载火箭，专为将大型有效载荷送入轨道而设计。按起飞推力衡量，Falcon Heavy 是全球现役最强大的火箭之一，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日已进行 11 次发射，任务成功率 100%。

paras.en: - Dragon. Launched by Falcon 9 in 2012, our Dragon spacecraft became the first commercial spacecraft to deliver cargo to and from the International Space Station and, eight years later, the first privately built vehicle to fly humans to the orbiting laboratory. Since its first flight, Dragon has visited the International Space Station over 50 times, and restored America’s ability to launch astronauts. Dragon has also supported all of NASA’s private astronaut missions to the International Space Station, flown the first all-commercial astronaut crew, completed the first human spaceflight over the Earth’s polar regions, and supported the first-ever commercial spacewalk.
paras.zh: - Dragon。我们的 Dragon 飞船于 2012 年由 Falcon 9 发射，成为首个为国际空间站运送货物并返回的商业航天器；八年后，又成为首个将人类送往该在轨实验室的私人建造航天器。自首飞以来，Dragon 已访问国际空间站超过 50 次，并恢复了美国发射宇航员的能力。Dragon 还支持了 NASA 所有前往国际空间站的私人宇航员任务，运送了首个全商业宇航员乘组，完成了首次飞越地球极地区域的人类太空飞行，并支持了史上首次商业太空行走。

paras.en: - Starship. First launched in 2023, Starship is designed to be a fully reusable, super heavy-lift launch vehicle. Starship V3 is designed to deliver 100 metric tons to Earth’s orbit in a fully reusable configuration while enabling rapid turnaround times akin to commercial aviation. Future generations of Starship are being designed to double this payload capacity. To date, we have executed 12 Starship flight tests, with our 12th flight test in May 2026 debuting the next generation Starship vehicle and Super Heavy booster, powered by the next evolution of our Raptor engine and launching from a newly designed pad at Starbase. We expect Starship to commence payload delivery to orbit in the second half of 2026. We have achieved innovative milestones such as catching a booster using “chopstick” arms on the same tower it launched from. We expect this capability will facilitate rapid refurbishment and reuse, allowing for multiple launches per day at reduced costs.
paras.zh: - Starship。Starship 于 2023 年首次发射，设计为完全可重复使用的超重型运载火箭。Starship V3 设计为在完全可重复使用构型下向地球轨道运送 100 公吨，同时实现类似商业航空的快速周转时间。未来几代 Starship 正被设计为将这一有效载荷能力翻倍。迄今为止，我们已执行 12 次 Starship 飞行测试，其中 2026 年 5 月的第 12 次飞行测试首次亮相下一代 Starship 飞行器与 Super Heavy 助推器，搭载我们 Raptor 发动机的下一代演进版本，并从 Starbase 新设计的发射台发射。我们预计 Starship 将于 2026 年下半年开始向轨道运送有效载荷。我们已实现多项创新里程碑，例如使用发射塔上的“筷子”机械臂捕获助推器，且该发射塔正是其发射所用之塔。我们预计这一能力将促进快速翻修与重复使用，从而实现每日多次发射并降低成本。

paras.en: Upon achieving rocket reusability, we recognized the immense potential of our launch business to enable new revenue streams, as our launch capacity would eventually outstrip demand from traditional space customers alone. This realization, along with our efforts to make life multiplanetary, drove us to reimagine what was possible when access to space became more affordable. Rather than asking what was being done in space, we asked what large-scale global need could be better served from space. This led to the development of Starlink, our global satellite internet constellation, consisting of thousand s of LEO satellites designed to provide high-speed, low-latency broadband connectivity to underserved areas worldwide. Although the concept of using satellites for global internet connectivity dates back decades, technical challenges and the prohibitive cost of accessing space historically rendered attempts to provide such connectivity economically unviable. Within three years of our first satellite launch in 2019, we solved the technical and production challenges of the satellites and had deployed the largest LEO constellation in existence. Today, Starlink is the sole low-latency network available globally.
paras.zh: 在实现火箭可重复使用后，我们认识到我们的发射业务在创造新收入来源方面的巨大潜力，因为我们的发射能力最终将超出仅来自传统太空客户的需求。这一认识，连同我们使生命多行星化的努力，推动我们重新构想当太空访问变得更可负担时所能实现的可能性。我们不是问太空正在做什么，而是问哪些大规模全球需求可以更好地从太空得到满足。这促成了 Starlink 的开发，这是我们的全球卫星互联网星座，由数千颗 LEO 卫星组成，旨在为全球服务不足的地区提供高速、低延迟的宽带连接。尽管利用卫星实现全球互联网连接的概念可追溯至数十年前，但技术挑战和太空访问的 prohibitive 成本历来使提供此类连接的尝试在经济上不可行。在我们 2019 年首次卫星发射后的三年内，我们解决了卫星的技术和生产挑战，并部署了现存最大的 LEO 星座。如今，Starlink 是全球唯一可用的低延迟网络。

paras.en: As the leader in space access, our launch operations are an important and expanding competitive advantage. By combining increasing launch cadence, expanding cargo capacity, and declining unit costs—driven by rapid reusability—we have generated a compounding competitive advantage. This not only fortifies our core business, but also provides vast new market opportunities uniquely enabled by space.
paras.zh: 作为太空访问领域的领导者，我们的发射运营是一项重要且不断扩大的竞争优势。通过结合不断提高的发射频率、扩大的货物运载能力和下降的单位成本——由快速可重复使用所驱动——我们已形成复合型竞争优势。这不仅巩固了我们的核心业务，还提供了由太空独特赋能的广阔新市场机遇。

paras.en: #### Our Leading Capabilities Across Space, Connectivity, and AI
paras.zh: #### 我们在太空、连接和 AI 领域的领先能力

paras.en: Space. While our launch capabilities support our other businesses, such as Starlink Consumer Broadband and Starlink Mobile, we also sell launches to third-party customers. We offer launch services to commercial, civil, and government customers through our reusable Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy rockets for satellite, cargo, and crew missions. We fly to LEO, MEO, GEO, lunar, and interplanetary trajectories, as well as the International Space Station. We are the primary launch provider for the U.S. government. In 2025, we launched 11 of 12 National Security Space Launch (“NSSL”) medium and heavy lift missions and all five U.S. crew and cargo missions to the International Space Station for NASA. We serve commercial and government customers—including NASA, the National Reconnaissance Office (“NRO”), Axiom Space, SES, Eutelsat, and Oneweb. We charge our customers based on the type of rocket, mass to orbit, size of payload, and type of service, such as whether the launch is dedicated to a single customer or part of a “rideshare” with other customers.
paras.zh: 太空。虽然我们的发射能力支持我们的其他业务，例如 Starlink 消费宽带和 Starlink 移动，但我们也向第三方客户销售发射服务。我们通过可重复使用的 Falcon 9 和 Falcon Heavy 火箭，为商业、民用和政府客户提供卫星、货运和载人任务的发射服务。我们的飞行目的地包括 LEO、MEO、GEO、月球和行星际轨道，以及国际空间站。我们是美国政府的主要发射服务提供商。2025 年，我们执行了 12 次国家安全太空发射（“NSSL”）中型和重型运载任务中的 11 次，以及 NASA 全部五次前往国际空间站的美国载人和货运任务。我们服务于商业和政府客户，包括 NASA、国家侦察局（“NRO”）、Axiom Space、SES、Eutelsat 和 Oneweb。我们根据火箭类型、入轨质量、有效载荷大小和服务类型（例如发射是专供单一客户，还是与其他客户“拼车”）向客户收费。

paras.en: Starship is our next-generation reusable rocket vehicle that we expect will expand our launch capability dramatically through full and rapid reusability combined with currently unprecedented mass to orbit capability. As the most powerful launch system ever developed, we expect that Starship V3 will be able to carry a payload of 100 metric tons, and that future generations could reach 200 metric tons, potentially as soon as Starship V4. Starship is designed to deliver our next-generation satellites to orbit, long-haul point-to-point transportation on Earth, the cargo and crew necessary to develop a base on the Moon and a city on Mars for research and human spaceflight development.
paras.zh: Starship 是我们的下一代可重复使用火箭飞行器，我们预计它将通过完全且快速的重复使用，结合目前前所未有的入轨质量能力，大幅扩展我们的发射能力。作为有史以来研发的最强大发射系统，我们预计 Starship V3 将能够运载 100 公吨的有效载荷，而未来几代可能达到 200 公吨，最早可能在 Starship V4 实现。Starship 旨在将我们的下一代卫星送入轨道、实现地球上长距离点对点运输，并运送在月球建立基地、在火星建立城市所需的人员和货物，以开展研究和载人航天开发。

paras.en: Connectivity. Starlink provides global access to high-speed internet, including underserved rural and remote communities worldwide. As of March 31, 2026, we had approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, providing broadband connectivity to approximately 10.3 million Starlink Subscribers across 164 countries, territories, and other markets. We also provide satellite-to-mobile texting and over-the-top voice services to approximately 7.4 million monthly unique devices across approximately 30 countries.
paras.zh: 连接。Starlink 提供全球高速互联网接入，包括为全球服务不足的农村和偏远社区提供接入。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们在低地球轨道拥有约 9,600 颗 Starlink 宽带和移动卫星，为 164 个国家、地区和其他市场的约 10.3 百万 Starlink 用户提供宽带连接。我们还为约 30 个国家的约 7.4 百万月度独立设备提供卫星到移动设备的短信和 OTT 语音服务。

paras.en: - Starlink Consumer Broadband. We operate the world’s largest and most advanced space-based internet broadband service with median latency at approximately 25 milliseconds as of March 31, 2026. We provide fiber-like download speeds—at a median of 225 Mbps during peak hours for residential users as of March 31, 2026—and the technological capability to provide service everywhere on Earth, including the poles. This service quality is enabled by our vast network of approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, which accounted for approximately 75% of all active maneuverable satellites in orbit as of March 31, 2026. We expect to commence deploying our next-generation V3 satellites, designed to offer one Tbps of downlink capacity per satellite, using Starship in the second half of 2026. We expect that a single Starship launch will be capable of deploying up to 60 V3 satellites to LEO, representing a potential twenty-fold increase in Starlink downlink capacity deployed relative to a Falcon 9 launch. As of March 31, 2026, we had approximately 10.3 million Starlink Subscribers, up approximately 105% from 5.0 million subscribers a year prior. We charge our Starlink Subscribers a monthly subscription fee, which varies based on geographic market and download speed, plus typically a one-time upfront terminal cost.
paras.zh: - Starlink 消费级宽带。我们运营着全球规模最大、最先进的星基互联网宽带服务，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，中位时延约为 25 毫秒。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们为住宅用户提供类光纤下载速度——高峰时段中位下载速度为 225 Mbps——并具备在地球任何地点（包括两极）提供服务的技术能力。这一服务质量得益于我们由约 9,600 颗 Starlink 宽带及移动卫星组成的庞大低地球轨道网络，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，该网络约占在轨所有活跃可机动卫星的 75%。我们预计将于 2026 年下半年使用 Starship 开始部署下一代 V3 卫星，该卫星设计为每颗提供 1 Tbps 的下行容量。我们预计单次 Starship 发射将能够向 LEO 部署最多 60 颗 V3 卫星，这意味着相对于 Falcon 9 发射，Starlink 部署的下行容量可能提升二十倍。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们拥有约 10.3 百万 Starlink 用户，较一年前的 5.0 百万用户增长约 105%。我们向 Starlink 用户收取月度订阅费，该费用根据地理市场和下载速度而有所不同，此外通常还收取一次性终端设备费用。

paras.en: - Enterprise Solutions. SpaceX is a critical partner to a wide array of enterprises. We offer Starlink’s high-speed, low-latency, reliable internet services to enterprise customers across industries including construction, agriculture, retail, telecom, hospitality, aviation, maritime, and land mobility. Starlink’s unique capabilities are well‑suited for deployments across field offices, remote worksites, research stations, drilling rigs, rural hospitals, aircraft, cruise ships, trains, and hotels. Our enterprise customers include companies such as United Airlines, Carnival, Maersk, and John Deere, among others. We also serve a broad fixed‑site customer base across industries such as retail and financial services that require high availability for critical operations as well as reliable connectivity in remote or hard-to-serve locations. As companies continue to invest in secure and resilient networks and backup systems to keep critical infrastructure online—such as point‑of‑sale and payment processing systems—we often start as a backup solution and then transition to being the primary solution. Our enterprise contracts are based on a combination of subscriptions, data consumption, capacity, or other pricing models depending on each customer’s particular needs. Since 2023, no Starlink Enterprise customer having contributed more than $750,000 of annual revenue has voluntarily discontinued their service, demonstrating the strong performance and value of our offering. This is despite the ability of our customers to cancel the service at any time.
paras.zh: - 企业解决方案。SpaceX 是众多企业的重要合作伙伴。我们为建筑、农业、零售、电信、酒店、航空、海事和陆地交通等各行业的企业客户提供 Starlink 高速、低时延、可靠的互联网服务。Starlink 的独特能力非常适合部署于现场办公室、偏远工地、研究站、钻井平台、乡村医院、飞机、邮轮、列车和酒店。我们的企业客户包括 United Airlines、Carnival、Maersk 和 John Deere 等公司。我们还服务于零售和金融服务等行业的广泛固定站点客户群体，这些客户需要关键业务的高可用性，以及偏远或难以覆盖地点的可靠连接。随着企业持续投资于安全且有韧性的网络和备份系统，以保持关键基础设施（如销售点和支付处理系统）在线，我们往往最初作为备份解决方案，随后转变为主要解决方案。我们的企业合同基于订阅、数据用量、容量或其他定价模式的组合，具体取决于各客户的特定需求。自 2023 年以来，年收入贡献超过 $750,000 的 Starlink 企业客户中，没有任何一家主动终止服务，这体现了我们产品的强劲表现和价值，尽管我们的客户可以随时取消服务。

paras.en: - Government Solutions. For our government customers, we provide high-speed, resilient connectivity for public services, social impact, humanitarian efforts, and disaster response in even the most remote and challenging environments. Examples include support for the FEMA in coordinating disaster recovery after hurricanes and wildfires, the NOAA for at-sea testing and environmental monitoring, the Government of the Philippines for linking remote islands, schools, and public institutions, the Government of Jamaica for improving digital access in remote and maritime areas, and the Government of Ecuador for supporting education and healthcare connectivity in isolated communities. Separately with Starshield, we have leveraged our commercial LEO satellite constellation engineering learnings and operational experiences to develop a secure, dedicated satellite network designed specifically for United States Government customers and national security applications.
paras.zh: - 政府解决方案。针对政府客户，我们即使在最偏远、最具挑战性的环境中，也能为公共服务、社会影响、人道主义行动和灾害响应提供高速、高韧性的连接。示例包括：支持 FEMA 在飓风和野火过后协调灾后恢复，支持 NOAA 进行海上测试和环境监测，支持菲律宾政府连接偏远岛屿、学校和公共机构，支持牙买加政府改善偏远地区和海域的数字接入，以及支持厄瓜多尔政府在孤立社区支持教育和医疗连接。此外，通过 Starshield，我们利用商业 LEO 卫星星座的工程经验和运营经验，开发了一个安全、专用的卫星网络，专为美国政府客户和国家安全应用而设计。

paras.en: - Starlink Mobile. We provide satellite-to-mobile connectivity, supplementing terrestrial networks and substantially reducing mobile “dead zones” across approximately 30 countries. We partner with MNOs including major wireless carriers like T-Mobile in the United States, and other international operators including One NZ, Optus, Telstra, Rogers, KDDI, Salt, Entel, Kyivstar, and VMO2. Through these partnerships, we enable consumers, businesses, and public-sector customers to use their existing phones in more places, support critical connectivity during disasters and power outages, and open new applications for low-bandwidth mobile and IoT devices. Our current capabilities under our “V1” constellation (consisting of approximately 650 V1 Mobile satellites in orbit) include light data, text messaging (SMS), and over-the-top voice services (e.g., WhatsApp and FaceTime). We are developing more comprehensive satellite-to-mobile services, including broadband data and IoT connectivity, which are expected to deliver resilient, infrastructure-independent connectivity worldwide and enable 5G connectivity. We have partnerships with approximately 30 MNOs on six continents, covering an area that is home to approximately 1.9 billion people. We charge MNOs either a fixed fee or a per-mobile user fee-based amount, which is typically passed through to the customer via the carrier as an “add-on” feature.
paras.zh: - Starlink Mobile。我们提供卫星到移动终端的连接服务，补充地面网络，并大幅减少约 30 个国家/地区的移动“盲区”。我们与移动网络运营商（MNO）合作，包括美国 T-Mobile 等主要无线运营商，以及 One NZ、Optus、Telstra、Rogers、KDDI、Salt、Entel、Kyivstar 和 VMO2 等其他国际运营商。通过这些合作，我们使消费者、企业和公共部门客户能够在更多地点使用其现有手机，在灾害和停电期间支持关键连接，并为低带宽移动设备和物联网设备开辟新的应用。我们目前在“V1”星座（由约 650 颗在轨 V1 Mobile 卫星组成）下的能力包括轻量数据、短信（SMS）和 over-the-top 语音服务（例如 WhatsApp 和 FaceTime）。我们正在开发更全面的卫星到移动终端服务，包括宽带数据和物联网连接，预计将在全球范围内提供具有韧性、不依赖基础设施的连接，并实现 5G 连接。我们与六大洲约 30 家 MNO 建立了合作关系，覆盖区域居住着约 19 亿人口。我们向 MNO 收取固定费用或按每移动用户计费的费用，该费用通常由运营商作为“附加”功能转嫁给客户。

paras.en: Our Global Starlink Subscriber Base
paras.zh: 我们的全球 Starlink 用户基础

paras.en: AI. We operate a highly vertically integrated AI platform spanning gigawatt-scale AI compute infrastructure, our truth-seeking frontier AI model, Grok, AI solutions for consumer and enterprise customers, and X, our real-time information, entertainment, and free speech platform. We believe AI is rapidly converging toward AGI, where human cognitive capabilities can be replicated and scaled at machine speeds, profoundly augmenting human productivity. Once an AGI system exists, its true value derives from the ability to create limitless duplicates of human-like intelligence, necessitating vast computational resources and cost-efficient deployment to achieve meaningful scale. Without large-scale, power-efficient infrastructure, AGI cannot be deployed broadly or economically—making such infrastructure a critical strategic differentiator.
paras.zh: AI。我们运营一个高度垂直整合的 AI 平台，涵盖吉瓦级 AI 算力基础设施、我们探求真理的前沿 AI 模型 Grok、面向消费者和企业客户的 AI 解决方案，以及 X——我们的实时信息、娱乐和言论自由平台。我们相信，AI 正迅速向 AGI 演进，届时人类认知能力将能够以机器速度被复制和扩展，从而极大地增强人类生产力。一旦 AGI 系统存在，其真正价值源于能够创造出无限多个类人智能的副本，这需要海量计算资源和具有成本效益的部署才能实现有意义的规模。如果没有大规模、高能效的基础设施，AGI 就无法广泛或经济地部署——这使得此类基础设施成为关键的战略差异化因素。

paras.en: - AI Compute Infrastructure. xAI has established a leading position in building and scaling terrestrial AI compute infrastructure, becoming the first company to deploy a coherent gigawatt-scale AI training cluster. Our AI compute facilities, COLOSSUS and COLOSSUS II, collectively provide approximately 1.0 gigawatt of compute power, with additional power capacity available for data center operations. Our first-principles thinking enables us to build coherent compute at scale and at rapid speed with lower costs than most other companies in the industry. We brought the first cluster of COLOSSUS online in 122 days, repurposing the shell of an existing factory, and the first cluster of COLOSSUS II online even faster in 91 days. As an illustrative comparison, an industry benchmark to bring online a 100 megawatt greenfield data center is approximately two years. We also demonstrated a significant improvement in cost efficiency, achieving data center construction costs for COLOSSUS II that are considerably lower than industry benchmarks on a per megawatt basis. This dual speed and cost advantage stems from our complete vertical integration and the shared culture infused by our founder, Mr. Musk, across our Space, Connectivity, and AI segments. The addition of Terafab, an initiative together with Tesla to build a manufacturing facility capable of producing 1 terawatt per year of compute hardware, aims to further extend our vertical integration to chip design and manufacturing to alleviate potential future chip shortages at SpaceX, optimize compute performance, and potentially reduce overall compute costs. Intel, which has the ability to design, fabricate, and package ultra-high-performance chips at scale, has also joined the Terafab project. We believe that the key constraints in the continued growth of AI are physical—chip manufacturing, data center infrastructure, and power generation; the future of AI will be determined by the control of the physical stack.
paras.zh: - AI 算力基础设施。xAI 在建设和扩展地面 AI 算力基础设施方面已确立领先地位，成为首家部署连贯的吉瓦级 AI 训练集群的公司。我们的 AI 算力设施 COLOSSUS 和 COLOSSUS II 合计提供约 1.0 吉瓦的算力，另有额外电力容量可用于数据中心运营。我们的第一性原理思维使我们能够以低于行业内大多数其他公司的成本，大规模、快速地构建连贯算力。我们在 122 天内使 COLOSSUS 的第一个集群上线，利用了现有工厂的外壳进行改造；而 COLOSSUS II 的第一个集群上线更快，仅用 91 天。作为说明性对比，行业内使一个 100 兆瓦新建数据中心上线的基准时间约为两年。我们还在成本效率方面展示了显著提升，COLOSSUS II 的数据中心建设成本按每兆瓦计算大幅低于行业基准。这种速度与成本的双重优势源于我们完全的垂直整合，以及我们的创始人马斯克先生在我们的太空、连接和 AI 各业务板块中注入的共同文化。Terafab 的加入——这是一项与 Tesla 共同建设年产能达 1 太瓦算力硬件的制造设施的倡议——旨在进一步将我们的垂直整合延伸至芯片设计与制造，以缓解 SpaceX 未来潜在的芯片短缺、优化算力性能，并有可能降低整体算力成本。Intel 具备大规模设计、制造和封装超高性能芯片的能力，也已加入 Terafab 项目。我们认为，AI 持续增长的关键制约因素是物理层面的——芯片制造、数据中心基础设施和发电；AI 的未来将由对物理技术栈的控制所决定。

paras.en: - Truth-Seeking Frontier Model. xAI has developed one of the world’s most advanced, truth-seeking frontier models with Grok. Since launching Grok-1 in November 2023, we have released four major versions and notable variations thereof, achieving one of the fastest iteration cycles in the industry, culminating in Grok-4.3 (April 2026). Building on this trajectory, we expect to continue scaling Grok through subsequent generations. Ongoing training of next‑generation models is expected to scale toward multiple trillions of parameters, which could represent a step change in reasoning in depth and overall intelligence. In this context, the number of parameters refers to the scale of the model, where parameters are the internal numerical values, such as “weights,” that are adjusted during training to enable the model to recognize patterns and relationships in data. A larger number of parameters generally allows the model to capture more complex relationships, store greater amounts of knowledge, and achieve higher levels of reasoning capability. Within two years of its initial model release, Grok achieved frontier-level performance in scientific reasoning, as measured by its GPQA Diamond score, an industry benchmark that evaluates AI models on a standardized set of questions written and validated by experts, on a faster timeline than reported by other leading model providers. This accelerated rate of innovation stems from our highly vertically integrated stack: full ownership of training infrastructure, access to the world’s most powerful compute clusters, and relentless focus on truth seeking and real-world utility. A key competitive differentiator is Grok’s deep integration with X, enabling proprietary access to a real-time information stream of approximately 350 million daily posts, which enhances freshness, relevance, and contextual awareness for Grok. This direct, real-time access to the information and human discourse on X enhances Grok’s truth-seeking capabilities by grounding outputs in up-to-date knowledge and diverse viewpoints. We believe that this combination of compute infrastructure scale and the massive dataset available to us through X, subject to some limitations for certain content, has allowed us to achieve industry-leading performance and provide model outputs that analyze real-time information on global events. We expect that our compute infrastructure and direct access to real-time data via X constitute substantial performance advantages for Grok that will result in increasingly rapid and dramatic iteration cycles.
paras.zh: - 求真型前沿模型。xAI 借助 Grok 开发出了全球最先进的求真型前沿模型之一。自 2023 年 11 月推出 Grok-1 以来，我们已发布四个主要版本及其重要变体，实现了业界最快的迭代周期之一，最终推出 Grok-4.3（2026 年 4 月）。基于这一发展轨迹，我们预计将通过后续各代产品持续扩展 Grok。下一代模型的持续训练预计将扩展至数万亿参数规模，这可能代表推理深度和整体智能水平的阶跃式变化。在此语境下，参数数量指模型规模，其中参数是模型内部的数值（如“权重”），在训练过程中被调整，以使模型能够识别数据中的模式和关系。参数数量越大，通常使模型能够捕捉更复杂的关系、存储更多知识，并达到更高水平的推理能力。在首次模型发布后的两年内，Grok 在科学推理方面达到了前沿水平（以 GPQA Diamond 得分衡量），该得分是一项行业基准，通过一组由专家编写和验证的标准化问题来评估 AI 模型，且我们达成这一水平的时间线快于其他领先模型提供商所报告的时间线。这种加速的创新速度源于我们高度垂直整合的技术栈：完全拥有训练基础设施、可使用全球最强大的算力集群，以及对求真和现实世界实用性的不懈专注。一个关键的竞争差异化优势是 Grok 与 X 的深度整合，使其能够专有地访问每日约 350 million 条帖子的实时信息流，从而提升 Grok 的时效性、相关性和上下文感知能力。这种对 X 上信息和人类话语的直接、实时访问，通过将输出建立在最新知识和多元观点之上，增强了 Grok 的求真能力。我们相信，算力基础设施规模与通过 X 可获得的海量数据集（受某些内容的若干限制）相结合，使我们能够实现行业领先的性能，并提供分析全球事件实时信息的模型输出。我们预计，我们的算力基础设施以及通过 X 对实时数据的直接访问，将构成 Grok 的重大性能优势，从而带来日益快速和显著的迭代周期。

paras.en: - Consumer and Enterprise Applications. We leverage our leading frontier models and compute infrastructure to deliver consumer and enterprise applications. In under six months, we developed Grok Voice, a real-time speech engine, including in multilingual performance. Our image and video generation system, Imagine, produced approximately 10 billion images and over 2 billion videos per month, on average, for the quarter ending March 31, 2026. Together with Tesla, we are also developing Macrohard, an agentic AI platform designed to be capable of fully emulating digital workflows and augmenting human operation of computers— from coding and product development to management and entire business processes—using sophisticated autonomous agents. We believe Macrohard will have the potential to fundamentally transform how companies are structured and operate, thereby allowing dramatic increases in human productivity. In addition, we believe our existing government relationships and track record as large government contractors are a structural advantage as governments become significant consumers of AI applications.
paras.zh: - 消费者与企业应用。我们利用领先的前沿模型和算力基础设施，提供消费者与企业应用。在不到六个月的时间里，我们开发了 Grok Voice，这是一款实时语音引擎，包括多语言性能。我们的图像和视频生成系统 Imagine，在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的季度内，平均每月生成约 100 亿张图像和超过 20 亿个视频。我们还与 Tesla 共同开发 Macrohard，这是一个代理式 AI 平台，旨在能够完全模拟数字工作流程，并增强人类对计算机的操作——从编码和产品开发到管理和整个业务流程——使用复杂的自主代理。我们相信 Macrohard 有潜力从根本上改变公司的结构和运营方式，从而大幅提高人类生产力。此外，我们认为，随着政府成为 AI 应用的重要消费者，我们现有的政府关系和作为大型政府承包商的历史记录是一种结构性优势。

paras.en: Our integrated AI platforms across Grok and X had approximately 1.3 billion supported accounts active in the last twelve months ended March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, including approximately 550 million and 520 million MAUs as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively. Of our MAUs, we had approximately 117 million and 89 million MAUs that used Grok’s AI features as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively.
paras.zh: 我们横跨 Grok 和 X 的集成 AI 平台在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的过去十二个月及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的过去十二个月中，分别拥有约 13 亿个活跃的受支持账户，其中包括截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日分别约 5.5 亿和 5.2 亿的月活跃用户（MAU）。在我们的 MAU 中，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日，分别约有 1.17 亿和 8900 万 MAU 使用了 Grok 的 AI 功能。

paras.en: We also monetize user activity through high-impact advertising inventory on X. We believe X’s scale, real-time engagement, and integration with Grok provide a differentiated foundation for building a unified user experience across communication, content discovery, commerce, and financial services, among others. For enterprises that advertise on X, we offer large-scale user engagement, real-time content, and advanced AI-driven performance marketing tools. For enterprises, we offer tailored deployments of Grok customized to specific workflows and security needs through Grok Business and Grok Enterprise, sold on license-, consumption-, or outcome-based pricing models.
paras.zh: 我们还通过 X 上的高影响力广告库存将用户活动变现。我们相信，X 的规模、实时参与度以及与 Grok 的整合，为在通信、内容发现、商务和金融服务等领域构建统一的用户体验提供了差异化的基础。对于在 X 上投放广告的企业，我们提供大规模用户参与、实时内容和先进的 AI 驱动效果营销工具。对于企业，我们通过 Grok Business 和 Grok Enterprise 提供根据特定工作流程和安全需求定制的 Grok 部署，采用基于许可、基于消费或基于成果的定价模式销售。

paras.en: #### Collaboration with Tesla
paras.zh: #### 与 Tesla 的合作

paras.en: SpaceX and Tesla developed the early foundation of a strong and constructive partnership through a series of limited but successful commercial engagements. Our relationship with Tesla evolved meaningfully following Tesla’s January 2026 commitment to invest in xAI— an investment that, upon SpaceX’s acquisition of xAI, was converted into an equity interest in SpaceX. Tesla and xAI continue to build upon their longstanding collaborative relationship by evaluating future strategic opportunities between the companies.
paras.zh: SpaceX 和 Tesla 通过一系列有限但成功的商业合作，奠定了强大且建设性伙伴关系的早期基础。在 Tesla 于 2026 年 1 月承诺投资 xAI 之后，我们与 Tesla 的关系发生了有意义的演变——这项投资在 SpaceX 收购 xAI 后转换为 SpaceX 的股权。Tesla 和 xAI 继续在长期合作关系的基础上，评估两家公司之间的未来战略机会。

paras.en: One expected area of collaboration is an AI project called Macrohard. We expect Macrohard to benefit from running on both state-of-the-art processors and cost efficient, next-generation Tesla processors, a critical advantage of our vertical integration.
paras.zh: 一个预期的合作领域是一个名为 Macrohard 的 AI 项目。我们预计 Macrohard 将受益于在最先进的处理器和具有成本效益的下一代 Tesla 处理器上运行，这是我们垂直整合的关键优势。

paras.en: Another expected area of collaboration is Terafab, an announced AI chip manufacturing initiative designed to vertically integrate the design, fabrication, and deployment of advanced logic and memory chips. We believe this initiative will alleviate potential future chip shortages at SpaceX and optimize compute performance. We expect Terafab to be the world’s largest chip manufacturing facility. Our strategy for Terafab is to vertically integrate across the design of lithography masks, fabrication of logic and memory chips, and design of advanced packaging in a single closed-loop plant. Conducting all these activities end-to-end in a single facility enables rapid testing and iterations, allowing us to improve chip design and scale manufacturing faster. We expect that our speed and cost advantage from vertical integration will allow us to scale efficiently in AI chip manufacturing towards our long-term goal of producing one terawatt of compute each year. We are partnering to build Terafab in order to support growth in two kinds of chips—one type optimized for terrestrial edge and inference to be used primarily in Tesla’s Optimus robots and vehicles, and another type optimized for the space environment to be used in our orbital compute infrastructure. While Terafab is intended to expand our internal chip manufacturing capabilities, we expect to continue sourcing a significant portion of our compute hardware from third-party suppliers. We view Terafab as complementary to these relationships, enabling us to augment our access to compute hardware at massive scale and further complete our highly vertically integrated compute platform by extending our control to the foundational chip layer. We believe that the key constraints in the continued growth of AI are physical—chip manufacturing, data center infrastructure, and power generation; the future of AI will be determined by the control of the physical stack. We believe that we are better positioned than other AI companies given our unique control over the full physical stack. We plan to explore other areas of strategic collaboration with Tesla in the future.
paras.zh: 另一个预期合作领域是 Terafab，这是一项已宣布的 AI 芯片制造计划，旨在垂直整合先进逻辑芯片和存储芯片的设计、制造与部署。我们认为，该计划将缓解 SpaceX 未来可能出现的芯片短缺，并优化算力性能。我们预计 Terafab 将成为全球最大的芯片制造设施。我们对 Terafab 的战略是在单一闭环工厂内，垂直整合光刻掩模设计、逻辑芯片和存储芯片制造以及先进封装设计。在单一设施内端到端地开展所有这些活动，能够实现快速测试与迭代，使我们得以更快地改进芯片设计并扩大制造规模。我们预计，垂直整合带来的速度和成本优势将使我们能够在 AI 芯片制造领域高效扩张，朝着每年生产一太瓦算力的长期目标迈进。我们正通过合作方式建设 Terafab，以支持两类芯片的增长——一类针对地面边缘计算和推理进行优化，主要用于 Tesla 的 Optimus 机器人和车辆；另一类针对太空环境进行优化，用于我们的轨道算力基础设施。尽管 Terafab 旨在扩大我们内部的芯片制造能力，但我们预计将继续从第三方供应商采购相当一部分算力硬件。我们将 Terafab 视为对这些合作关系的补充，使我们能够在大规模层面增强算力硬件的获取能力，并通过将控制延伸至基础芯片层，进一步完善我们高度垂直整合的算力平台。我们认为，AI 持续增长的关键制约因素是物理层面的——芯片制造、数据中心基础设施和发电；AI 的未来将由对物理技术栈的控制所决定。我们认为，鉴于我们对整个物理技术栈的独特控制，我们比其他 AI 公司处于更有利的位置。我们计划未来探索与 Tesla 的其他战略合作领域。

paras.en: #### Collaboration with Cursor
paras.zh: #### 与 Cursor 的合作

paras.en: On April 19, 2026, we entered into a compute agreement with Cursor. Cursor develops and operates an AI-native integrated development environment that enables professional software developers and engineering teams to write, edit, review, and refactor code using LLM-powered agents and workflows integrated via its proprietary model harness. In 2025, Cursor launched Composer, its own LLM trained for software development. It recently released Composer 2, which offers improvements in coding performance at lower cost. We believe the compute agreement and any acquisition of Cursor (described below), if completed, will extend our strategy to vertically integrate compute infrastructure, models, and applications, can help accelerate our development of AI-native software tools, and combined with our significant compute capacity, will help strengthen our position in AI-assisted developer productivity. We expect to accelerate the development of our existing AI models, including Grok, through our collaboration with Cursor.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 19 日，我们与 Cursor 签订了一份算力协议。Cursor 开发并运营一个 AI 原生集成开发环境，使专业软件开发人员和工程团队能够通过其专有模型框架集成的 LLM 驱动智能体和工作流来编写、编辑、审查和重构代码。2025 年，Cursor 推出了 Composer，这是其专为软件开发训练的自有 LLM。该公司近期发布了 Composer 2，以更低的成本提供更优的编码性能。我们认为，该算力协议以及对 Cursor 的任何收购（如下文所述）（若完成）将拓展我们垂直整合算力基础设施、模型和应用的战略，有助于加速我们开发 AI 原生软件工具，并且结合我们庞大的算力容量，将有助于巩固我们在 AI 辅助开发者生产力领域的地位。我们预计，通过与 Cursor 的合作，我们将加速开发现有 AI 模型（包括 Grok）。

paras.en: Under the compute agreement, we will provide Cursor with certain GPU cluster compute capacity for use in connection with specified development, training, improvement and other activities related to AI models and other technology and intellectual property. In exchange, Cursor will contribute certain personnel, data and datasets, documentation, technical know-how, workflows, prompts, specifications and software code. We will collaborate with Cursor to improve our existing models, including Grok, and potentially to jointly develop AI models and related model-specific deliverables. Each party retains ownership of its pre-existing and independently developed intellectual property (including, in the case of SpaceX, Grok) and related improvements and derivatives, including where they are utilized in connection with joint development activities. Any jointly developed models will be jointly owned, and each party will have a broad right to use, reproduce, modify, distribute, license, commercialize and otherwise exploit them without an obligation to account to the other party.
paras.zh: 根据算力协议，我们将向 Cursor 提供一定的 GPU 集群算力容量，用于与 AI 模型及其他技术和知识产权相关的特定开发、训练、改进及其他活动。作为交换，Cursor 将提供一定的人员、数据和数据集、文档、技术诀窍、工作流程、提示词、规格说明和软件代码。我们将与 Cursor 合作改进我们现有的模型（包括 Grok），并可能共同开发 AI 模型及相关模型专属交付成果。各方保留其既有及独立开发的知识产权（就 SpaceX 而言包括 Grok）及相关改进和衍生成果的所有权，包括在联合开发活动中使用该等知识产权的情形。任何共同开发的模型将由双方共同拥有，各方均享有广泛的权利对其进行使用、复制、修改、分发、许可、商业化及以其他方式利用，且无需向另一方承担报告义务。

paras.en: We also entered into an option agreement pursuant to which we have the right, but not the obligation, to acquire Cursor. The option agreement generally provides that we may exercise the call option at any time during the 30-day period following the earlier of (i) seven trading days following the completion of this offering and (ii) September 30, 2026. Exercise of the call option is in our sole discretion and subject to further approval by our board of directors. Cursor is also subject to certain exclusivity obligations under the option agreement.
paras.zh: 我们还签订了一份期权协议，据此我们有权（但无义务）收购 Cursor。该期权协议一般规定，我们可在以下两者中较早者之后的 30 天期间内随时行使认购期权：(i) 本次发行完成后七个交易日，及 (ii) 2026 年 9 月 30 日。行使认购期权由我们自行决定，并须经我们董事会进一步批准。Cursor 亦须遵守期权协议项下的若干排他性义务。

paras.en: If we exercise the call option, we would simultaneously execute a merger agreement with Cursor, pursuant to which, following satisfaction of the closing conditions set forth in the merger agreement, including receipt of requisite regulatory approvals, Cursor would become our subsidiary, and, as a result, we would acquire all of Cursor’s cash, intellectual property, personnel, customer contracts and other assets. As of January 31, 2026 (Cursor’s fiscal year-end), Cursor had $3.1 billion of total assets, primarily comprising $2.7 billion of cash and cash equivalents, and $0.55 billion of total liabilities. The purchase price would primarily be allocated to goodwill on our balance sheet. Cursor has historically earned some revenue by providing services to customers and, if we acquired Cursor, we may provide these or similar services to customers after the acquisition although at revenue levels that may vary significantly from historical performance. If we exercise the call option to acquire Cursor, we would expect to retain certain Cursor talent by committing to provide continuing employees with competitive compensation and retention-focused incentives designed to support the long-term value of SpaceX.
paras.zh: 如果我们行使认购期权，我们将同时与 Cursor 签署合并协议，据此，在满足合并协议所载交割条件（包括取得必要的监管批准）后，Cursor 将成为我们的子公司，因此我们将收购 Cursor 的全部现金、知识产权、人员、客户合同及其他资产。截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日（Cursor 的财年末），Cursor 的总资产为 $3.1 billion，主要包括 $2.7 billion 的现金及现金等价物，总负债为 $0.55 billion。购买价款将主要分配至我们资产负债表上的商誉。Cursor 历史上通过向客户提供服务获得部分收入，如果我们收购 Cursor，我们可能在收购后向客户提供该等服务或类似服务，但收入水平可能与历史业绩存在显著差异。如果我们行使认购期权以收购 Cursor，我们预计将通过承诺为留任员工提供有竞争力的薪酬及以留任为重点的激励措施来保留部分 Cursor 人才，该等激励措施旨在支持 SpaceX 的长期价值。

paras.en: The consideration for the acquisition of Cursor, if any, after the closing of this offering would consist of shares of our Class A common stock based on an implied equity value of Cursor of $60.0 billion, and the price of our Class A common stock that equals the volume-weighted average closing price thereof over the seven consecutive trading days immediately preceding the closing of the acquisition. If either (i) we decide to terminate the option agreement or (ii) Cursor is eligible to and decides to terminate due to our material breach of the option agreement (subject to notice and cure provisions), Cursor is entitled to a $1.5 billion termination fee under the option agreement and an $8.5 billion deferred services fee under the compute agreement. These fees are payable in cash (or Class A common stock, if this offering has not been consummated at the time the fees become payable).
paras.zh: 收购 Cursor 的对价（如有）将在本次发行交割后以我们的 A 类普通股支付，该对价基于 Cursor 的隐含股权价值 $60.0 billion，以及等于紧接收购交割前连续七个交易日的成交量加权平均收盘价的我们的 A 类普通股价格。如果 (i) 我们决定终止期权协议，或 (ii) Cursor 因我们重大违反期权协议而有权并决定终止（须遵守通知和补救条款），则 Cursor 有权根据期权协议获得 $1.5 billion 的终止费，并根据算力协议获得 $8.5 billion 的递延服务费。该等费用应以现金支付（或如果费用到期应付时本次发行尚未完成，则以 A 类普通股支付）。

paras.en: Any shares of our Class A common stock issuable pursuant to the merger agreement would be issued in reliance upon the exemption from the registration requirements of the Securities Act provided by Section 4(a)(2) thereof. As a result, any such shares of Class A common stock would be deemed “restricted securities” as such term is defined under Rule 144 under the Securities Act. Such shares of Class A common stock would be eligible for resale only if registered under the Securities Act or if such resales qualify for an exemption from registration.
paras.zh: 根据合并协议可发行的任何我们的 A 类普通股将依据《证券法》第 4(a)(2) 条规定的注册要求豁免进行发行。因此，任何该等 A 类普通股将被视为《证券法》第 144 条所定义的“受限证券”。该等 A 类普通股只有在根据《证券法》注册或该等转售符合注册豁免条件时，才可进行转售。

paras.en: We have conducted preliminary due diligence on Cursor’s business, technology and operations, and expect to continue such diligence in connection with any decision to exercise the call option. We cannot predict whether we will elect to exercise the call option or, if exercised, whether the acquisition will close on the anticipated terms, or at all.
paras.zh: 我们已对 Cursor 的业务、技术和运营进行了初步尽职调查，并预计在就任何行使认购期权的决定进行相关工作时将继续进行该等尽职调查。我们无法预测我们是否会选择行使认购期权，或者如果行使，收购是否会按预期条款完成，或根本无法完成。

paras.en: #### Compute Services Agreements with Third Parties
paras.zh: #### 与第三方的算力服务协议
