It is shifting toward enabling everyday smartphones to remain seamlessly connected when outside traditional cellular or Wi-Fi range, integrating satellite connectivity into routine mobile usage, rather than treating it as a contingency layer. At the same time, telecom operators have been reducing capital expenditures amid slower revenue growth, weaker monetization, and declining returns on invested capital—pressures that have limited their willingness to maintain historically high levels of network deployment. These shifts are also increasing demand for harmonized, scalable spectrum allocations capable of supporting higher-capacity satellite-to-mobile services without interfering with terrestrial networks, with the potential to add an incremental $1.4 trillion of economic growth over the next 10 years, as forecasted by Cellular Telecommunications and Internet Association.
paras.zh: 早期的卫星直连手机服务（即直接连接标准智能手机的服务）于 2020 年代出现，支持基本短信，并在某些情况下于无地面覆盖区域支持语音。这些服务为安全、连续性和远程运营提供了更连贯的通信。然而，它们推出之际正值移动数据消费急剧加速、消费者对“始终在线”设备的期望不断上升之时。因此，卫星直连手机技术如今正超越仅用于紧急通信的范畴。它正转向使日常智能手机在超出传统蜂窝或 Wi-Fi 范围时仍能保持无缝连接，将卫星连接融入日常移动使用，而非将其视为应急层。与此同时，电信运营商在收入增长放缓、变现能力减弱和投资资本回报率下降的背景下一直在削减资本开支——这些压力限制了它们维持历史高水平网络部署的意愿。这些转变也增加了对统一、可扩展频谱分配的需求，此类频谱能够支持更高容量的卫星直连手机服务而不干扰地面网络，据蜂窝电信与互联网协会预测，未来 10 年有望带来 1.4 万亿美元的增量经济增长。

paras.en: These industry shifts have opened the door for deeper collaboration among satellite operators, MNOs, carriers, spectrum owners, device manufacturers, and regulators. As satellite network performance continues to improve and these partnerships expand, satellite-to-mobile offerings—such as Starlink Mobile—are poised to evolve from a “backup” layer into a meaningful complement to terrestrial networks, extending coverage and enhancing overall network resilience and performance.
paras.zh: 这些行业变革为卫星运营商、移动网络运营商（MNO）、电信运营商、频谱所有者、设备制造商和监管机构之间更深入的合作打开了大门。随着卫星网络性能持续提升、这些合作关系不断扩大，卫星直连移动（卫星到移动）服务——例如 Starlink Mobile——正有望从“备份”层演变为地面网络的有力补充，从而扩展覆盖范围并提升整体网络的韧性与性能。

paras.en: #### The AI Industry
paras.zh: #### AI 行业

paras.en: Humanity is defined by our relentless pursuit of knowledge, with each transformative breakthrough dramatically expanding our capacity to create, preserve, and share ideas across time and space. AI marks the next—and arguably most consequential—chapter in this progression. For the first time, we are creating systems that do more than simply amplify or transmit human-generated knowledge. These systems can reason, learn, and generate new knowledge autonomously—synthesizing information, forming hypotheses, and in some domains even making original discoveries. In doing so, they augment, accelerate, and will likely surpass unaided human cognition. This represents a profound shift: we are moving from tools that simply extend the mind to autonomous agents and companions that actively participate in the act of knowing.
paras.zh: 人类之所以为人类，在于我们对知识的不懈追求，而每一次变革性的突破都极大地拓展了我们跨越时间与空间创造、保存和分享思想的能力。AI 标志着这一进程中的下一个——也可以说是最具影响力的——篇章。我们首次创造出这样的系统：它们所做的不仅仅是放大或传递人类生成的知识。这些系统能够自主推理、学习并生成新知识——综合信息、提出假设，并在某些领域甚至做出原创性发现。由此，它们增强、加速，并很可能超越未经辅助的人类认知。这代表着一次深刻的转变：我们正从仅仅延伸心智的工具，迈向主动参与认知过程的自主智能体与伙伴。

paras.en: Over the past decade, the convergence of big data, advances in AI hardware, and the breakthrough development of LLMs have transformed AI from a speculative academic field into a foundational driver of the modern economy.
paras.zh: 过去十年间，大数据、AI 硬件进步以及大语言模型（LLM）的突破性发展，已使 AI 从一门思辨性的学术领域转变为现代经济的基础性驱动力。

paras.en: AI Compute
paras.zh: AI 算力

paras.en: Massive demand for frontier AI models is accelerating the build-out of AI infrastructure at a pace and scale with few historical precedents. Meeting projected AI needs will require $7 trillion in global data center investment through 2030, with generative AI workloads expected to account for roughly 70% of total data-center power demand by the end of the decade. Each new generation of frontier models requires exponentially greater compute, following well-established scaling laws that link model performance to the volume and quality of training data, parameter count, and total compute expected. The rise of agentic AI and the potential emergence of artificial general intelligence are expected to further amplify inference workloads, driving a step-function increase in compute requirements and the corresponding data center capacity needed to support them. Frontier AI has become fundamentally infrastructure-constrained. Only operators with access to massive amounts of power, very large GPU clusters and tightly integrated training infrastructure can train cutting-edge models, and these systems exhibit non-linear performance advantages that compound over time. Compute infrastructure scale helps determine model iteration speed, model quality, and capital efficiency—making infrastructure itself a critical capability.
paras.zh: 对前沿 AI 模型的巨大需求正以历史上鲜有先例的速度和规模加速 AI 基础设施的建设。要满足预计的 AI 需求，到 2030 年全球数据中心投资将需要达到 $7 trillion，而到本十年末，生成式 AI 工作负载预计将占数据中心总电力需求的大约 70%。每一代新的前沿模型都需要指数级增长的算力，这遵循已被充分确立的扩展定律——该定律将模型性能与训练数据的数量和质量、参数规模以及预期总计算量联系起来。智能体式 AI 的兴起以及通用人工智能（AGI）可能出现的预期，预计将进一步放大推理工作负载，推动算力需求及其所需数据中心容量呈阶跃式增长。前沿 AI 已在根本上受制于基础设施。只有能够获取海量电力、超大规模 GPU 集群和高度集成训练基础设施的运营者才能训练尖端模型，而这些系统展现出随时间不断累积的非线性性能优势。算力基础设施规模有助于决定模型迭代速度、模型质量和资本效率——使基础设施本身成为一项关键能力。

paras.en: AI Frontier Models
paras.zh: AI 前沿模型

paras.en: A new class of frontier models has emerged, which includes LLMs and multimodal models. LLMs are neural network-based models trained on massive datasets to interpret user questions and generate responses to highly complex questions. LLMs can synthesize existing research, propose new ideas, and communicate in a natural language that requires no programming expertise by the user. Demand for these tools has been explosive—according to a YouGov survey, approximately 60% of Americans have used AI tools since December 2024, and 34% use AI tools at least weekly. Multimodal models are AI systems that can process, understand, and generate outputs across multiple types of data simultaneously—such as text, images, audio, video, and sometimes other modalities—rather than being limited to just one (like text-only language models). Multimodal models offer several key benefits over traditional unimodal (e.g., text-only) systems by processing and integrating multiple data types like text, images, audio, video, and sometimes sensor data simultaneously. They provide richer contextual understanding, capturing relationships and nuances across modalities that are invisible in isolation, leading to more accurate predictions and reasoning.
paras.zh: 一类新的前沿模型已经出现，其中包括大语言模型（LLM）和多模态模型。LLM 是基于神经网络的模型，通过海量数据集训练，用于理解用户问题并就高度复杂的问题生成回答。LLM 能够综合现有研究、提出新想法，并以无需用户具备编程专业知识的自然语言进行交流。市场对这些工具的需求呈爆发式增长——根据 YouGov 的一项调查，自 2024 年 12 月以来，约 60% 的美国人使用过 AI 工具，34% 的人至少每周使用一次 AI 工具。多模态模型是能够同时处理、理解并跨多种数据类型（如文本、图像、音频、视频，有时还包括其他模态）生成输出的 AI 系统，而非仅限于单一模态（如仅处理文本的语言模型）。多模态模型通过同时处理和整合文本、图像、音频、视频以及有时传感器数据等多种数据类型，相较传统的单模态（如仅文本）系统具有若干关键优势。它们提供更丰富的上下文理解，捕捉在孤立状态下不可见的跨模态关系与细微差别，从而实现更准确的预测和推理。

paras.en: AI frontier models are shaped by the values, objectives, and design choices of their creators. Model intelligence and performance reflect decisions around data curation, training methodologies, alignment frameworks, and system constraints, resulting in different reasoning styles, interpretations, and responses across models. Therefore, values can be embedded in the technology, influencing accuracy, logic, and utility of the model outputs and how well models can serve end users.
paras.zh: AI 前沿模型由其创造者的价值观、目标和设计选择所塑造。模型的智能水平和性能反映了围绕数据筛选、训练方法、对齐框架和系统约束所做的决策，从而导致不同模型在推理风格、解读方式和回答上存在差异。因此，价值观可以被嵌入技术之中，影响模型输出的准确性、逻辑性和实用性，以及模型服务最终用户的效果。

paras.en: Following rapid frontier model innovation and broad adoption of chat-based tools, organizations are now beginning to deploy agentic systems—AI that can use tools and operate with limited supervision. This marks the beginning of what we believe will be a broader transition from co-pilots to agentic systems that enable high-complexity workflows and create materially higher inference demand.
paras.zh: 随着前沿模型的快速创新和基于聊天的工具的广泛采用，各组织现在开始部署智能体系统——即能够使用工具并在有限监督下运行的 AI。我们认为，这标志着从副驾驶向智能体系统更广泛转变的开端，此类系统能够支持高复杂度的工作流程，并创造显著更高的推理需求。

paras.en: Consumer and Enterprise Applications
paras.zh: 消费者与企业应用

paras.en: Advances in digital communication have reshaped how information is created, shared, and consumed, laying the foundation for today’s social media platforms. These platforms have become essential channels for digital advertising by combining large‑scale user engagement with targeted content and ad distribution. Recent advances in AI are further strengthening advertising, allowing enterprises to optimize campaigns and measure outcomes. At the same time, consumer expectations for AI‑powered tools are rising, with users seeking timely, accurate and trustworthy information across an expanding universe of digital content.
paras.zh: 数字通信的进步重塑了信息的创造、分享和消费方式，为当今的社交媒体平台奠定了基础。这些平台通过将大规模用户参与与定向内容和广告分发相结合，已成为数字广告的重要渠道。AI 的最新进展进一步增强了广告能力，使企业能够优化营销活动并衡量结果。与此同时，消费者对 AI 驱动工具的期望不断提高，用户希望在不断扩展的数字内容世界中获得及时、准确且可信的信息。

paras.en: We believe the ongoing convergence of consumer platforms, consumer AI, and integrated digital services will accelerate the emergence of super‑app ecosystems that combine communication, content creation, information, commerce, and banking within a single platform. These trends are expected to expand the role of internet platforms as distribution channels and support next‑generation AI‑enabled applications and advertising solutions.
paras.zh: 我们认为，消费者平台、消费者 AI 和一体化数字服务的持续融合将加速超级应用生态系统的出现，这些生态系统将通信、内容创作、信息、商业和银行业务整合于单一平台之中。这些趋势预计将扩大互联网平台作为分发渠道的作用，并支持下一代 AI 赋能的应用和广告解决方案。

paras.en: For enterprises and governments, frontier models and agentic AI—autonomous systems capable of multi-step reasoning and independent task execution—are beginning to manage increasingly complex processes and workflows. As of February 2026, more than 80% of Fortune 500 companies were using AI active agents. Entire industries are being reshaped by AI-driven applications, including agentic commerce (personalized AI-directed shopping), vibe coding (software development with minimal or no human-written code), and autonomous driving for vehicles.
paras.zh: 对于企业和政府而言，前沿模型与代理式 AI——即能够进行多步推理并独立执行任务的自主系统——正开始管理日益复杂的流程和工作流。截至 2026 年 2 月，超过 80% 的《财富》500 强公司已在使用 AI 活跃代理。整个行业正被 AI 驱动的应用所重塑，包括代理式商务（由 AI 主导的个性化购物）、氛围编程（以极少或无需人工编写代码的方式进行软件开发）以及车辆自动驾驶。

paras.en: The ultimate frontier in AI is human augmentation: creating systems that amplify and multiply human reasoning, creativity, decision-making, and productivity, enabling people to perform highly complex tasks with unprecedented speed, scale, and insight. By enhancing how humans think, learn, and interact, such systems act as cognitive multipliers, supercharging individual and collective capabilities far beyond biological limits. As AI evolves, we expect both consumer platforms and enterprises to adopt increasingly agentic systems that serve as powerful extensions of human intelligence. These tools will orchestrate multi-step workflows, interact seamlessly with business applications, and accelerate operational processes, with humans at the center of judgment, creativity, and strategy. Emerging efforts in enterprise AI illustrate how future systems could coordinate entire business functions as force multipliers—dramatically expanding what a human team can achieve with minimal scaling friction and maximal leverage. Human augmentation also offers a transformative solution to the escalating effort required for breakthroughs in technology and beyond. For example, the human effort needed to sustain Moore’s Law (chip density doubling approximately every two years) has increased eighteenfold since the early 1970s; AI augmentation could reverse this trend by empowering engineers, researchers, and innovators to iterate faster, explore more possibilities, and achieve exponential progress with smaller, core teams of experts.
paras.zh: AI 的终极前沿是人类增强：创造能够放大并倍增人类推理、创造力、决策能力和生产力的系统，使人们能够以前所未有的速度、规模和洞察力执行高度复杂的任务。通过增强人类的思考、学习和互动方式，此类系统充当认知乘数，将个体和集体能力提升至远超生物极限的水平。随着 AI 的演进，我们预计消费平台和企业都将采用日益代理化的系统，作为人类智能的强大延伸。这些工具将编排多步工作流、与业务应用无缝交互并加速运营流程，而人类则处于判断、创造力和战略的核心位置。企业 AI 领域的新兴努力展示了未来系统如何作为力量倍增器协调整个业务职能——以最小的规模化摩擦和最大的杠杆效应大幅扩展人类团队所能取得的成就。人类增强还为技术和其它领域实现突破所需的不断攀升的投入提供了一种变革性解决方案。例如，自 1970 年代初以来，维持摩尔定律（芯片密度大约每两年翻一番）所需的人力投入已增加十八倍；AI 增强可以通过赋能工程师、研究人员和创新者更快迭代、探索更多可能性，并以更小的核心专家团队实现指数级进步，从而扭转这一趋势。

paras.en: As humanity expands beyond Earth, augmented human intelligence will be essential to managing the immense operational, scientific, and logistical complexity of a spacefaring civilization. The core promise of augmentation lies in multiplication: AI not as a substitute for human minds, but as an amplifier for human ingenuity, curiosity and purpose that unlocks new frontiers of what humans can accomplish together.
paras.zh: 随着人类向地球之外扩展，增强的人类智能对于管理太空文明所面临的巨大运营、科学和后勤复杂性将不可或缺。增强的核心承诺在于倍增：AI 不是人类思维的替代品，而是人类智慧、好奇心和使命感的放大器，开启人类共同成就的新前沿。

paras.en: We have an intense, mission-driven, and engineering-first culture that seeks to achieve what many have deemed impossible. We make the incredible and extraordinary possible and repeatable by continuously leveraging our core strengths:
paras.zh: 我们拥有一种强烈、以使命为驱动、以工程为先的文化，致力于实现许多人认为不可能的目标。我们通过持续发挥核心优势，让不可思议与非凡之事变得可能且可复制：

paras.en: #### Global Leadership in Orbital Launch Services
paras.zh: #### 轨道发射服务的全球领导者

paras.en: Our unique ability to reliably, quickly, and cost efficiently launch rockets at scale into space is our core competitive advantage that enables other parts of our business. Our launch capabilities form the foundation of our orbital infrastructure and have created new multi-trillion-dollar opportunities in space, global connectivity, and AI. We believe no other launch provider is competitive at this scale today, nor is likely to become so in the near term. Our fleet of 24 flight-proven, reusable rockets and our growing share of total mass delivered to orbit has increased every year since 2021. Reusability completely changes the economics of space access. Qualified for 40 launches, our reusable rockets can fly multiple times with only minimal refurbishment between missions, sharply lowering the cost per launch, while boosting our launch rate, asset use, and overall efficiency compared to traditional expendable rockets. As a result, we can offer competitive launch prices, rapidly deploy our own satellites and infrastructure, and make it easier and cheaper for us to pursue new opportunities requiring orbital access. Our higher launch rates and reusability also create a virtuous cycle: more flights lead to faster improvements in design, manufacturing, and operations through accumulated experience. Additionally, not only did we demonstrate at least a 10-year advantage over the rest of the industry when we first landed our Falcon 9 booster back from space in 2015, but we have continued to invest significantly in further increasing our lead by pursuing full and rapid reusability at scale, including investing over $15 billion in our next-generation rocket, Starship.
paras.zh: 我们独特的能力——可靠、快速且高成本效益地规模化发射火箭进入太空——是我们的核心竞争优势，它赋能了我们业务的其他部分。我们的发射能力构成了轨道基础设施的基础，并在太空、全球连接和 AI 领域创造了数万亿美元的新机遇。我们相信，目前没有其他发射服务提供商能在这一规模上具备竞争力，短期内也不太可能出现。我们由 24 枚经过飞行验证的可重复使用火箭组成的机队，以及我们不断提升的入轨总质量份额，自 2021 年以来逐年增长。可重复使用性彻底改变了太空准入的经济性。我们的可重复使用火箭具备 40 次发射资格，可在任务之间仅需极少翻新的情况下多次飞行，大幅降低每次发射成本，同时相比传统一次性火箭提升了我们的发射频率、资产利用率和整体效率。因此，我们能够提供有竞争力的发射价格，快速部署自有卫星和基础设施，并使我们更轻松、更低成本地把握需要轨道准入的新机遇。我们更高的发射频率和可重复使用性还形成了良性循环：更多飞行通过积累经验带来设计、制造和运营的更快改进。此外，我们不仅在 2015 年首次让猎鹰 9 号助推器从太空返回着陆时展示了领先行业其他参与者至少 10 年的优势，而且我们持续大举投资，通过追求规模化全面快速可重复使用来进一步扩大领先优势，包括在我们的下一代火箭 Starship 上投资超过 $15 billion。

paras.en: **Unrivaled Satellite and Connectivity Platform across Design, Manufacturing, Deployment, and Operations**
paras.zh: **在设计、制造、部署和运营方面无与伦比的卫星与连接平台**

paras.en: We are able to design, engineer, and manufacture the world’s most advanced satellites at scale, enabling the creation and scaling of new businesses leveraging this core satellite technology platform, including: Starlink Broadband, our space-based internet broadband service; Starlink Mobile, our global satellite-to-mobile service; and emerging AI initiatives. Unlike traditional satellite manufacturers that rely on fragmented supply chains and low-volume production, we have built an integrated satellite platform that spans architecture, chip design, software, power systems, and final assembly. As we rapidly iterate on our next-generation satellites in-house, some others are contracting outsourced manufacturers to build satellite architectures with capacity comparable to satellites that we retired years ago. As of March 31, 2026, our constellation also incorporates over 23,000 inter-satellite lasers that create a dynamic mesh network in space, enabling data traffic to route through orbit rather than relying solely on terrestrial backhaul infrastructure. By controlling satellite design, production, launch and operations, we can tailor payloads, networking capabilities, and power requirements to support new use cases. For example, our AI compute constellations will leverage our core satellite technologies already developed for our existing Starlink constellations. We will build new satellites that can host processors for high-density compute payloads, offer enhanced power generation with larger solar panels and storage systems, and enable higher-capacity networking capabilities to support low-latency workloads in orbit. Our high-throughput manufacturing capabilities—combined with our launch capabilities—enable us to produce and deploy thousand s of satellites per year, an uneconomic proposition for those lacking an ability to deliver substantial mass into space. This capability accelerates our deployment timelines and allows us to commercialize entire constellations with capital efficiency that we believe is difficult to replicate.
paras.zh: 我们能够大规模设计、工程化和制造全球最先进的卫星，从而依托这一核心卫星技术平台创建并扩展新业务，包括：Starlink 宽带，我们的天基互联网宽带服务；Starlink 移动，我们的全球卫星直连移动服务；以及新兴的 AI 计划。与依赖碎片化供应链和小批量生产的传统卫星制造商不同，我们构建了一个涵盖架构、芯片设计、软件、电力系统和总装的集成化卫星平台。随着我们在内部快速迭代下一代卫星，其他一些公司则外包给制造商来构建卫星架构，其能力与我们多年前已退役的卫星相当。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们的星座还集成了超过 23,000 条星间激光链路，在太空中形成动态网状网络，使数据流量能够经由轨道路由，而不仅仅依赖地面回传基础设施。通过掌控卫星设计、生产、发射和运营，我们能够定制有效载荷、网络能力和电力需求，以支持新的应用场景。例如，我们的 AI 算力星座将利用我们已为现有 Starlink 星座开发的核心卫星技术。我们将建造能够承载高密度算力载荷处理器的新卫星，通过更大的太阳能电池板和储能系统提供更强的发电能力，并实现更高容量的网络能力，以支持轨道上的低延迟工作负载。我们的高吞吐量制造能力——结合我们的发射能力——使我们能够每年生产和部署数千颗卫星，而对于那些缺乏将大量质量送入太空能力的公司而言，这是不经济的。这一能力加快了我们的部署时间表，并使我们能够以我们认为难以复制的资本效率将整个星座商业化。

paras.en: Our global connectivity platform, Starlink, is powered by the world’s largest LEO constellation and supported by our vertically integrated launch and satellite manufacturing capabilities to enable the delivery of high-speed, low-latency broadband and mobile connectivity to homes and businesses everywhere in the world. Our vertically integrated model allows us to provide reliable service with unmatched speed and cost across geographies where traditional terrestrial infrastructure has been limited, uneconomical, or unavailable.
paras.zh: 我们的全球连接平台 Starlink 由全球最大的低地球轨道（LEO）星座提供动力，并依托我们垂直整合的发射和卫星制造能力，为全球各地的家庭和企业提供高速、低延迟的宽带和移动连接。我们的垂直整合模式使我们能够在传统地面基础设施有限、不经济或不可用的地区，以无与伦比的速度和成本提供可靠服务。

paras.en: #### Truth-Seeking AI Model Enhanced by Real-Time Data
paras.zh: #### 由实时数据增强的求真 AI 模型

paras.en: AI frontier models are shaped by the values, objectives, and design choices of their creators that influence accuracy, logic, and utility of the model outputs. We believe Grok represents a differentiated approach to AI, grounded in a core objective of truth seeking and powered by continuous, proprietary access to real-time data inflows through its integration with X. With approximately 350 million daily posts, X enables freshness, relevance, and contextual awareness for Grok that we believe is a competitive differentiator. This direct, real-time access to the information and human discourse on X enhances Grok’s truth-seeking capabilities by grounding outputs in up-to-date knowledge and diverse viewpoints.
paras.zh: 前沿 AI 模型由其创造者的价值观、目标和设计选择所塑造，这些因素会影响模型输出的准确性、逻辑性和实用性。我们认为，Grok 代表了一种差异化的 AI 路径，其根基是求真这一核心目标，并依托与 X 的整合，持续、专有地获取实时数据流入。X 每天约有 350 million 条帖子，为 Grok 带来时效性、相关性和语境感知能力，我们认为这是一项差异化竞争优势。这种对 X 上信息和人类话语的直接、实时访问，通过将输出建立在最新知识和多元观点之上，增强了 Grok 的求真能力。

paras.en: This architecture reflects our core philosophy that maximizing truth seeking—through the active, relentless pursuit of what is objectively true about reality, grounded in evidence, logic, empirical data, and first principles thinking— drives superior model outputs and higher utility intelligence. By combining our unique truth-seeking model with proprietary access to one of the world’s largest real-time information platforms, we believe Grok can deliver the most objective and relevant insights and best serve high-frequency, high-value use cases across consumer and enterprise AI applications.
paras.zh: 这一架构体现了我们的核心理念：通过积极、不懈地追求关于现实的客观真实——以证据、逻辑、经验数据和第一性原理思维为基础——来最大化求真，能够驱动更优的模型输出和更高实用性的智能。通过将我们独特的求真模型与对全球最大实时信息平台之一的专有访问相结合，我们相信 Grok 能够提供最客观、最相关的洞见，并最好地服务于消费级和企业级 AI 应用中高频、高价值的用例。

paras.en: **Extreme Vertical Integration Enabling High Velocity and Superior Cost Efficiency at Scale**
paras.zh: **极致的垂直整合，在规模化下实现高速度与卓越的成本效率**

paras.en: While conventional aerospace manufacturing relies heavily on fragmented and outsourced supply chains, we operate with extreme vertical integration. By designing and manufacturing a significant portion of our components in-house, we bypass many of the slow, bloated sourcing channels that structurally constrain the rest of the industry. For example, approximately 80% of Starship, SpaceX’s next-generation launch vehicle, is manufactured in-house. Our vertical integration allows us to achieve iterative cycles in weeks, compared to years for some legacy companies, enabling us to build newer, more technologically advanced products faster than many of our competitors. We believe this technological and logistical gap is widening meaningfully as our speed and cost advantage compound. Our vertical integration extends beyond design and manufacturing—it permeates our entire business model, encompassing engineering, deployment, and operations. We are the only company building integrated hardware and software infrastructure of the future across space, connectivity and AI. This end-to-end control allows us to deliver value through structural advantages in speed, cost and quality.
paras.zh: 传统航空航天制造严重依赖分散且外包的供应链，而我们则以极致的垂直整合方式运营。通过在内部设计和制造相当大一部分组件，我们绕开了许多在结构上制约行业其他企业的缓慢、臃肿的采购渠道。例如，SpaceX 的下一代运载火箭 Starship 约有 80% 在内部制造。我们的垂直整合使我们能够在数周内完成迭代周期，而一些传统公司则需要数年，这使我们能够比许多竞争对手更快地打造更新、技术更先进的产品。我们相信，随着我们的速度和成本优势不断累积，这一技术和物流差距正在显著扩大。我们的垂直整合不仅限于设计和制造——它渗透到我们的整个商业模式，涵盖工程、部署和运营。我们是唯一一家在太空、连接和 AI 领域构建未来集成硬件和软件基础设施的公司。这种端到端的控制使我们能够通过速度、成本和质量方面的结构性优势来创造价值。

paras.en: Our strong belief in the benefits of extreme vertical integration is further exemplified by our acquisition of xAI. We not only develop best-in-class models to support the application layer of AI, where we leverage real-time data ingestion from X (subject to some limitations for certain content), but we also own and operate the physical compute infrastructure required to train and run inference on those models, providing a substantial cost and speed advantage. Through our Terafab initiative together with Tesla and Intel, we intend to further extend our vertical integration to chip design and manufacturing to alleviate potential future chip shortages at SpaceX, optimize compute performance, and reduce overall compute costs. Intel will contribute its expertise in designing, fabricating, and packaging ultra-high-performance chips to help Terafab scale. This highly vertically integrated approach allows us to train and iterate our frontier models at high velocity, accelerating development cycles, eliminating external bottlenecks, and driving rapid, continuous improvements in model performance. Compute availability is also critical for running more complex workloads and delivering higher performance inference at scale. As AI adoption accelerates and demand for low-latency, high-throughput inference increases, we believe operators with the ability to support and efficiently allocate compute across both training and inference workloads are best positioned to win the AI race. Our human augmentation solutions are being designed to capitalize on this shift, enabling us to deliver superior performance for our customers. This advantage of vertical integration exists in both a terrestrial context, where we own our own data centers and the associated power infrastructure, and eventually in a space-based context, where we are planning to build our own orbital AI compute infrastructure. The key constraints in the continued growth of AI are physical—chip manufacturing, data center infrastructure, and power generation. Differentiation is rapidly shifting from model architecture alone to AI compute scale, cost efficiency, power availability, and speed of deployment. We believe that physical infrastructure, not models, will be the primary competitive differentiator for AI companies, and no other AI company has better control over the full physical infrastructure than SpaceX.
paras.zh: 我们对极致垂直整合所带来的益处有着坚定信念，收购 xAI 进一步印证了这一点。我们不仅开发一流的模型以支撑 AI 应用层，在这一层我们利用来自 X 的实时数据摄取（对某些内容存在一定限制），而且我们还拥有并运营训练这些模型及运行推理所需的物理算力基础设施，从而带来显著的成本与速度优势。通过我们与 Tesla 和 Intel 共同推进的 Terafab 计划，我们打算将垂直整合进一步延伸至芯片设计与制造，以缓解 SpaceX 未来可能出现的芯片短缺、优化算力性能并降低整体算力成本。Intel 将贡献其在设计、制造和封装超高性能芯片方面的专长，助力 Terafab 扩大规模。这种高度垂直整合的方式使我们能够高速训练和迭代我们的前沿模型，加快开发周期，消除外部瓶颈，并推动模型性能快速、持续地提升。算力可用性对于运行更复杂的工作负载和规模化交付更高性能的推理同样至关重要。随着 AI 采用加速以及对低延迟、高吞吐推理的需求增长，我们认为，能够在训练和推理工作负载之间支持并高效分配算力的运营者，最有条件赢得 AI 竞赛。我们的人类增强解决方案正围绕这一转变进行设计，使我们能够为客户提供卓越的性能。这种垂直整合优势既存在于地面场景——我们拥有自己的数据中心及相关电力基础设施，最终也将存在于太空场景——我们计划建设自己的轨道 AI 算力基础设施。AI 持续增长的关键制约是物理层面的——芯片制造、数据中心基础设施和发电。差异化正迅速从单纯的模型架构转向 AI 算力规模、成本效率、电力可用性和部署速度。我们认为，物理基础设施而非模型，将成为 AI 公司的主要竞争差异化因素，而在对完整物理基础设施的掌控方面，没有其他 AI 公司能比 SpaceX 做得更好。

paras.en: **Unique Ability to Scale New Trillion-Dollar Markets Across Space, Connectivity, and AI**
paras.zh: **在太空、连接和 AI 领域规模化开拓新的万亿美元市场的独特能力**

paras.en: We believe space represents the largest economic frontier in human history. We believe we have a distinct ability to identify, activate, and commercialize new multi-trillion-dollar markets that did not previously exist. Historically, space access was impaired by high launch costs, low flight cadence, and limited demand. While such constraints may limit others’ ability to access space at a scale, our ability to build large-scale and complex hardware infrastructure is a meaningful competitive advantage. By pioneering the world’s first and only fleet of reusable rockets at scale, we revolutionized space access through dramatically lower cost and unmatched reliability. Lowering costs by orders of magnitude does not just expand the launch market, it enables the creation of entirely new industries on Earth and in space that have historically been technologically and economically infeasible for others to access historically.
paras.zh: 我们相信，太空代表着人类历史上最大的经济前沿。我们相信，我们具备独特的能力，能够识别、激活并将此前并不存在的、规模达数万亿美元的新市场商业化。历史上，进入太空的能力受到发射成本高、飞行频次低和需求有限的制约。尽管这些制约可能限制其他主体大规模进入太空的能力，但我们构建大规模、复杂硬件基础设施的能力是一项有意义的竞争优势。通过开创全球首个也是唯一一个规模化可重复使用火箭机队，我们以大幅降低的成本和无与伦比的可靠性彻底改变了太空进入方式。将成本降低数个数量级不仅扩大了发射市场，还使在地球上和太空中创建全新的产业成为可能，而这些产业在历史上对其他主体而言在技术和经济上都是不可行的。

paras.en: When we have identified a new trillion-dollar market opportunity to pursue, we design a solution rooted in the same world-class engineering and first-principles thinking that has driven our technological breakthroughs and success to date. Our first trillion-dollar market was connectivity: we founded Starlink, a satellite service supported by our low-latency, high-speed LEO constellation. Starlink required the rapid, low-cost deployment of million s of kilograms of hardware into orbit, a feat economically impossible to solve for anyone lacking our foundational launch capabilities. Our Starlink constellation powers a global connectivity platform capable of supporting the world’s largest and most advanced space-based internet broadband service and satellite-to-mobile service, enabling high-speed internet access to homes, enterprises, governments, and mobile users around the world. We believe our next trillion-dollar market is AI compute, and we expect to leverage our rockets and satellites for massive orbital deployments of AI infrastructure. We believe this AI compute infrastructure will help us develop and monetize the Grok model faster than other AI companies that are dependent on finite sources of power on Earth. No other company has built the capabilities to create value across all these end markets at scale.
paras.zh: 当我们识别出一个新的万亿美元市场机会并加以追求时，我们设计的解决方案植根于同样推动我们迄今技术突破和成功的世界级工程能力和第一性原理思维。我们的第一个万亿美元市场是连接：我们创立了 Starlink，这是一项由我们的低延迟、高速 LEO 星座支持的卫星服务。Starlink 需要将数百万公斤的硬件快速、低成本地部署到轨道上，对于任何缺乏我们基础发射能力的主体而言，这在经济上是不可能实现的壮举。我们的 Starlink 星座支撑着一个全球连接平台，能够支持全球最大、最先进的太空互联网宽带服务和卫星到移动服务，为世界各地的家庭、企业、政府和移动用户提供高速互联网接入。我们相信我们的下一个万亿美元市场是 AI 算力，我们预计将利用我们的火箭和卫星大规模在轨部署 AI 基础设施。我们相信，这一 AI 算力基础设施将帮助我们比其他依赖地球上有限电力来源的 AI 公司更快地开发和变现 Grok 模型。没有其他公司构建起能够在所有这些终端市场大规模创造价值的能力。

paras.en: In addition, we believe we are poised to catalyze transformative breakthroughs in other industries on Earth and in space such as long haul point-to-point terrestrial travel, in-orbit manufacturing, passenger and cargo transportation to the Moon and Mars, manufacturing and energy production on the Moon and Mars, and asteroid mining. In particular, we believe that if we achieve our goal of establishing a lunar presence, it will potentially enable terawatt-scale annual AI compute growth, support deeper space exploration and industrialization, and serve as a stepping stone to establishing a civilization on Mars. As we continue to scale and expand into new trillion-dollar markets, we expect our more mature businesses will continue to generate substantial cash flows, enabling us to reinvest in emerging opportunities.
paras.zh: 此外，我们相信我们有望推动地球上和太空中其他行业的变革性突破，例如长途点对点地面旅行、在轨制造、往返月球和火星的客运与货运、在月球和火星上制造和能源生产，以及小行星采矿。特别是，我们相信，如果我们实现建立月球存在的目标，它有可能实现太瓦级的年度 AI 算力增长，支持更深入的太空探索和工业化，并成为在火星上建立文明的垫脚石。随着我们继续扩大规模并拓展进入新的万亿美元市场，我们预计我们更成熟的业务将继续产生可观的现金流，使我们能够再投资于新兴机会。

paras.en: #### Business Models that Are Incredibly Difficult to Replicate
paras.zh: #### 极难复制的商业模式

paras.en: Our business model is simple to describe: leverage our unparalleled launch capabilities to reduce the cost of access to space, apply first-principles thinking and world-class engineering to solve large structural constraints, vertically integrate across the value chain, continuously improve cost efficiency and throughput, and reinvest cash flow to expand our capabilities and create new markets. While simple to describe, we believe this model is extraordinarily difficult to replicate. We believe no other organization can execute this combination of reusable orbital launch systems at industrial scale, breakthrough engineering designs with reliable high-volume manufacturing, full stack proprietary software, and end-to-end operational control. These capabilities reinforce each other, and our vertical integration enables faster innovation cycles and structural cost advantages that widen our competitive advantage.
paras.zh: 我们的商业模式描述起来很简单：利用我们无与伦比的发射能力降低进入太空的成本，运用第一性原理思维和世界级工程能力解决重大的结构性制约，沿价值链进行垂直整合，持续提升成本效率和产能，并将现金流再投资以扩展我们的能力并创造新市场。尽管描述起来简单，但我们认为这一模式极难复制。我们相信，没有其他组织能够执行这一组合：工业规模的复用轨道发射系统、具有可靠大批量制造能力的突破性工程设计、全栈专有软件，以及端到端的运营控制。这些能力相互强化，我们的垂直整合带来了更快的创新周期和结构性成本优势，从而扩大了我们的竞争优势。

paras.en: Our business model has allowed us to build a diversified portfolio of complementary businesses and revenue streams from a common technological foundation. Our Space segment generates revenue from commercial and government customers, while also serving as the backbone for our Connectivity segment which generates highly predictable and recurring subscription revenue from Starlink broadband consumer, enterprise, and government customers, as well as Starlink Mobile subscribers. The result is a powerful, self-reinforcing value creation cycle: success in one business fuels faster growth in the others, enabling reinvestment into the next frontier. We believe this model has the potential to create compounding value across our ecosystem, allowing our lead to grow and become more durable over time.
paras.zh: 我们的商业模式使我们能够在一个共同的技术基础上，构建由互补业务和收入来源组成的多元化组合。我们的太空业务分部从商业和政府客户获得收入，同时还是我们互联业务分部的支柱，后者从 Starlink 宽带消费者、企业和政府客户以及 Starlink Mobile 用户获得高度可预测且经常性的订阅收入。其结果是形成一个强大、自我强化的价值创造循环：一项业务的成功推动其他业务更快增长，从而能够再投资于下一个前沿领域。我们相信，这一模式有潜力在我们的生态系统中创造复利价值，使我们的领先优势不断扩大并随时间推移变得更加持久。

paras.en: #### Mission-Driven Culture and World-Class Talent
paras.zh: #### 使命驱动的文化与世界级人才

paras.en: We have the benefit of being founded and led by Elon Musk, one of the great visionaries of our generation. We believe that our ability to attract and retain world-class technical and engineering talent is a significant competitive advantage. Our founding goal of making life multiplanetary serves as the ultimate mission-driven filter and retention tool, which has only been enhanced by xAI’s truth-seeking mission of understanding the universe. Top engineers are drawn to SpaceX to work on some of the hardest, most consequential problems facing humanity—doing things that have never been done before, like landing and re-using rockets, working towards making humanity multiplanetary, and gaining a better understanding of the mysteries of the universe through AI. They are also drawn to our intense, engineering-led, first-principles culture, which treats the laws of physics as the only true constraints. We reinforce this culture through “The Algorithm,” a five-step iterative process that emphasizes making the requirements less dumb, deleting unnecessary processes or parts (embracing the principle that the best part is no part), only then optimizing what remains, accelerating cycle time, and automating only proven processes. Our organizational philosophy embraces failure as an essential learning opportunity and maintains a relentless focus on efficiency and speed, enabling rapid iteration and repeatable execution on the hardest technical problems. To this end, our engineering-oriented organization maintains access to some of the world’s most selective talent pool. In 2025, we accepted under 2% of our engineering applicants, reflecting our ability to be highly selective and hire among the best talent in the industry. We also foster commitment by aligning employee interests with organizational success: our broad-based employee ownership program ensures that those who help us build the future are also direct beneficiaries of our success. This commitment to quality and mission results in exceptional employee loyalty, reflected by an average tenure across our broader SpaceX leadership team of 12 years.
paras.zh: 我们得益于由埃隆·马斯克创立并领导，他是我们这一代伟大的远见者之一。我们相信，吸引并留住世界级技术与工程人才的能力是我们的重要竞争优势。我们创立之初让生命多行星化的目标，是最终极的使命驱动筛选器与留人工具，而 xAI 理解宇宙的求真使命更进一步强化了这一点。顶尖工程师被吸引到 SpaceX，从事人类面临的一些最艰难、最具重大意义的问题——做前所未有的事情，比如让火箭着陆并重复使用、努力使人类多行星化，以及通过 AI 更好地理解宇宙的奥秘。他们同样被我们强烈、以工程为主导、以第一性原理为核心的文化所吸引，这种文化将物理定律视为唯一真正的约束。我们通过“算法”（The Algorithm）来强化这一文化，这是一个五步迭代流程，强调让需求变得不那么愚蠢、删除不必要的流程或部件（秉持“最好的部件就是没有部件”这一原则）、然后才优化剩余部分、加快周期时间，并且只对已被验证的流程进行自动化。我们的组织理念将失败视为必不可少的学习机会，并始终保持对效率与速度的不懈专注，从而能够在最艰难的技术问题上实现快速迭代与可重复执行。为此，我们以工程为导向的组织得以接触世界上一些最具选择性的顶尖人才库。2025 年，我们的工程岗位申请人录用率不足 2%，这体现了我们高度挑剔、在业内最优秀人才中招聘的能力。我们还通过将员工利益与组织成功相绑定来培养敬业度：我们覆盖面广泛的员工持股计划确保那些帮助我们建设未来的人，也是我们成功的直接受益者。这种对质量与使命的坚持带来了卓越的员工忠诚度，我们更广泛的 SpaceX 领导团队平均任期为 12 年，正体现了这一点。

paras.en: We have created what we believe to be the world’s most ambitious vertically integrated innovation engine that captures significant growth across three domains: Space, Connectivity, and AI. While our Space segment provides us with a foundational competitive advantage that enables all other parts of our business, our Connectivity and AI segments are expected to be the primary driver of revenue growth in the near term. In the next few years, we are focused on increasing the monetization of our existing Connectivity infrastructure and our existing AI user base. We also intend to continue to build out our AI infrastructure, which we expect to enable growth as we address the significant AI market opportunity. Our growth strategy aligns with our value creation cycle where we identify emerging opportunities, invest in innovation, rigorously test and iterate, launch new offerings, and generate strong cash flows to fuel the next wave of breakthroughs.
paras.zh: 我们打造了我们认为是全球最具雄心的垂直一体化创新引擎，在太空、连接和 AI 三大领域捕捉显著增长。我们的太空板块为我们提供了基础性竞争优势，赋能业务的其他所有部分，而我们的连接和 AI 板块预计将成为近期收入增长的主要驱动力。未来几年，我们将专注于提升现有连接基础设施和现有 AI 用户群的变现能力。我们还打算继续建设我们的 AI 基础设施，我们预计这将随着我们把握巨大的 AI 市场机遇而推动增长。我们的增长战略与我们的价值创造周期相一致，即我们识别新兴机遇、投资于创新、严格测试与迭代、推出新 offerings，并产生强劲现金流以推动下一波突破。

paras.en: #### Space

Increase launch payload capacity. We plan to drive meaningful growth in payload delivered to orbit (mass to orbit) through higher launch cadence and increased payload per launch, while enhancing launch efficiency and reducing costs. Our next-generation fully and rapidly reusable Starship V3 vehicle is designed to carry 100 metric tons to Earth’s orbit in a reusable configuration, driving substantial improvements in payload capacity per launch, while enabling significantly more frequent flights, at unparalleled cost efficiency. To date, we have executed 12 Starship flight tests, with our 12th flight test in May 2026 debuting the next generation Starship vehicle and Super Heavy booster, powered by the next evolution of our Raptor engine and launching from a newly designed pad at Starbase. We expect Starship to commence payload delivery to orbit in the second half of 2026. We have achieved innovative milestones, such as the creation of booster catches using “chopstick” arms that facilitate rapid refurbishment and reuse, including launching multiple times per day. To enable a more frequent launch cadence and overall greater payload delivery, we are also expanding our ground launch infrastructure, including investing in additional pads, on-site propellant production, and other support facilities, and investing in future generations of Starship, which could carry 200 metric tons in capacity, potentially as soon as Starship V4. We expect these efforts to continue to drive launch payload growth that is expected to provide the foundational capacity needed to scale our Starlink Broadband and Starlink Mobile constellations that underpin our Connectivity platform. Our growing payload capacity is also intended to underpin the deployment of orbital AI compute that will accelerate our AI business, as well as benefit third-party customers who use our launch offerings.
paras.zh: 提升发射载荷能力。我们计划通过提高发射频次和增加单次发射载荷，推动入轨载荷（入轨质量）实现显著增长，同时提升发射效率并降低成本。我们的下一代完全且快速可重复使用的 Starship V3 飞行器，在设计上可在可重复使用构型下将 100 公吨载荷送入地球轨道，从而大幅提升单次发射载荷能力，同时实现显著更频繁的飞行，并具备无与伦比的成本效率。迄今为止，我们已完成 12 次 Starship 飞行测试，其中 2026 年 5 月的第 12 次飞行测试首次亮相了下一代 Starship 飞行器和 Super Heavy 助推器，搭载我们 Raptor 发动机的下一代演进版本，并从 Starbase 新设计的发射台发射。我们预计 Starship 将于 2026 年下半年开始向轨道运送载荷。我们已实现多项创新里程碑，例如使用“筷子”机械臂完成助推器捕获，从而实现快速翻修和重复使用，包括每天多次发射。为实现更频繁的发射频次和整体更大的载荷运送能力，我们还在扩展地面发射基础设施，包括投资建设更多发射台、现场推进剂生产及其他支持设施，并投资于未来几代 Starship，其运载能力可能达到 200 公吨，最早可能在 Starship V4 实现。我们预计这些努力将继续推动发射载荷增长，预计这将提供扩展 Starlink Broadband 和 Starlink Mobile 星座所需的基础能力，而这些星座构成我们连接平台的基础。我们不断增长的载荷能力还旨在支撑轨道 AI 算力的部署，这将加速我们的 AI 业务，并惠及使用我们发射服务的第三方客户。

paras.en: Establish the lunar economy. Advancing access to the lunar surface represents an important next step in the evolution of our Space segment and is a prerequisite for long-term commercialization beyond Earth. We are focused on developing the capability to transport significant amounts of cargo and crew to the lunar surface in a repeatable and economically viable manner. We believe this capability will also enable creating a petawatt-scale AI constellation through the use of lunar satellite production and a lunar mass driver for launch activities. By leveraging Starship’s expected fully and rapidly reusable capabilities and in‑space refueling, we expect to materially reduce the cost of lunar missions relative to historical norms. Our initial efforts will prioritize lunar cargo landings and returning Americans to the Moon, followed by expanded crewed missions that we believe can establish a continuous flow of cargo and humans between Earth and the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 建立月球经济。推进对月表访问代表着我们太空业务板块演进中的重要下一步，也是实现地球以外长期商业化的先决条件。我们专注于发展以可重复且经济可行的方式向月球表面运送大量货物和人员的能力。我们相信，这一能力还将通过利用月球卫星生产和用于发射活动的月球质量驱动器，使打造拍瓦级 AI 星座成为可能。通过借助星舰（Starship）预期具备的完全且快速可重复使用能力以及太空加注能力，我们预计将相较历史常态大幅降低月球任务成本。我们的初期工作将优先开展月球货运着陆并使美国人重返月球，随后扩大载人任务，我们相信这些任务能够在地球与月球表面之间建立货物与人员的持续流动。

paras.en: We believe that the foundation of a commercial lunar economy begins with achieving infrastructure development, lunar resource utilization, and high bandwidth communications at scale. This requires the ability to mine, extract and process raw material for the production of solar power on the lunar surface. Combined with the ability to locally produce water and fuel, we believe these capabilities would enable sustained lunar operations, support lunar exploration, and provide the foundation for humanity’s permanent presence on the Moon. The lunar base would then allow sustained, high volume testing of new technologies in a space environment much closer to Earth than deep space.
paras.zh: 我们相信，商业月球经济的基础始于实现大规模的基础设施开发、月球资源利用和高带宽通信。这需要具备在月球表面开采、提取和加工原材料以用于太阳能发电生产的能力。结合本地生产水和燃料的能力，我们相信这些能力将支撑持续的月球运营、支持月球探索，并为人类在月球上的永久存在奠定基础。月球基地随后将能够在比深空更接近地球的太空环境中，对新技术进行持续、大批量的测试。

paras.en: We intend to establish lunar‑based manufacturing capabilities, including factories to produce large‑scale AI compute satellites. We believe we can efficiently launch our satellites at scale, namely due to the potential use of a lunar mass driver that is capable of high-frequency, low-cost launches of satellites from the lunar surface. By shifting energy and material and mass-intensive satellite and solar manufacturing activities off Earth that leverage sustainable power generation and the Moon’s low gravity, we aim to significantly reduce costs and terrestrial resource constraints. We expect to use raw materials from the Moon to construct most of the mass of the satellites and ship chips and other lower mass elements from Earth. This roadmap positions the Moon not only as a potential gateway to Mars and space exploration, but as the first space-based industrial economy at scale.
paras.zh: 我们打算建立月球制造能力，包括生产大规模 AI 算力卫星的工厂。我们相信，我们能够高效地规模化发射卫星，这主要得益于可能使用月球质量驱动器，该驱动器能够从月球表面进行高频、低成本的卫星发射。通过将能源及材料与质量密集型的卫星和太阳能制造活动迁离地球，并利用可持续发电和月球低重力环境，我们旨在显著降低成本并缓解地球资源约束。我们预计将使用来自月球的原材料来构建卫星的大部分质量，并从地球运送芯片和其他质量较低的部件。这一路线图使月球不仅成为通往火星和太空探索的潜在门户，更成为首个规模化的太空工业经济体。

paras.en: Once resource utilization capabilities are proven feasible, we believe there is an opportunity to commercialize the harvesting and exportation of rare materials, which is estimated to be present on the Moon in quantities exceeding one million tons and has potential applications in future nuclear energy and quantum computing systems. Large-scale access to these resources, coupled with the Moon’s low gravity, could unlock the potential for scalable growth by establishing a vertically-integrated resource extraction, processing and exportation hub. Using Starship’s high payload capacity, we believe these materials could be economically transported directly to Earth. In parallel, the Moon could function as a proving ground for closed-loop ecosystems, long-duration habitats, and autonomous construction techniques, all of which are essential for industrialization. Over time, this infrastructure has the potential to position the Moon as a strategic industrial and transportation node.
paras.zh: 一旦资源利用能力被证明可行，我们认为将稀有材料的采集与出口商业化存在机会，据估计月球上此类材料的储量超过一百万吨，并在未来的核能与量子计算系统中具有潜在应用。大规模获取这些资源，加之月球低重力环境，有望通过建立垂直一体化的资源开采、加工与出口枢纽，释放规模化增长的潜力。借助星舰（Starship）的高载荷能力，我们认为这些材料可以经济地直接运回地球。与此同时，月球可作为闭环生态系统、长时驻留栖息地及自主建造技术的验证场，而这些都是工业化所必需的。随着时间推移，这一基础设施有望使月球成为战略性的工业与运输节点。

paras.en: Establishing lunar operations for mining, refueling, manufacturing, and habitation is subject to a variety of interconnected engineering and other hurdles as well as known and currently unknown risks and uncertainties. These include hurdles, risks and uncertainties that relate to, among other things, transporting and deploying heavy equipment to the lunar surface, developing reliable power generation and storage systems, extracting and processing lunar resources at commercial scale, operating equipment in extreme temperature, radiation and dust conditions, maintaining communications and navigation infrastructure, and supporting long-duration human presence in a remote and hazardous environment.
paras.zh: 建立月球采矿、加注、制造与驻留运营面临一系列相互关联的工程及其他障碍，以及已知和目前未知的风险与不确定性。这些障碍、风险与不确定性涉及（其中包括）将重型设备运输并部署至月球表面、开发可靠的发电与储能系统、以商业规模开采和加工月球资源、在极端温度、辐射与尘埃条件下运行设备、维护通信与导航基础设施，以及支持人类在偏远且危险环境中长期驻留。

paras.en: #### Connectivity
paras.zh: #### 连接性

paras.en: Grow Starlink Consumer Broadband and enterprise and government customers. In the near term, we are focused on increasing global awareness of our Starlink brand and capabilities to grow our base of Starlink Broadband subscribers and to increase Starlink Broadband adoption in new and existing markets.
paras.zh: 发展 Starlink 消费宽带以及企业和政府客户。短期内，我们专注于提升全球对 Starlink 品牌与能力的认知，以扩大 Starlink 宽带用户基础，并提高 Starlink 宽带在新市场和现有市场的渗透率。

paras.en: - Starlink Consumer Broadband. We have grown the number of Starlink Subscribers rapidly over the last several years. As of March 31, 2026, we had approximately 10.3 million Starlink Subscribers across 164 countries, territories, and other markets. These subscribers represent a small fraction of the estimated 3.3 billion potential end users in the markets we currently serve, many of whom still lack reliable high-speed broadband. Because we report Starlink Subscribers on a per‑Service Line basis, the number of individual end users who access Starlink is already likelymeaningfully higher than 10.3 million, as multiple people may share a single Service Line, including within a household. We intend to grow the number of Starlink Subscribers by expanding our consumer distribution network across thousand s of authorized retail stores globally and execute region-specific marketing campaigns to increase Starlink brand awareness. By clearly demonstrating Starlink’s superior speed, low-latency, affordability, and ease of installation—not only in rural, remote, and infrastructure-limited areas, but also in suburban and urban areas with wireline broadband options—we expect to drive meaningful subscriber and revenue growth.
paras.zh: - Starlink 消费者宽带。过去几年，我们的 Starlink 用户数量快速增长。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们在 164 个国家、地区及其他市场拥有约 10.3 百万名 Starlink 用户。这些用户仅占我们目前所服务市场中估计 3.3 十亿潜在终端用户的一小部分，其中许多人仍缺乏可靠的高速宽带。由于我们按服务线路（Service Line）口径报告 Starlink 用户数，实际接入 Starlink 的个人终端用户数量很可能已显著高于 10.3 百万，因为多条线路可能由多人共用，包括同一家庭内的多人共用。我们计划通过在全球数千家授权零售门店扩展消费者分销网络，并开展针对特定区域的营销活动以提升 Starlink 品牌知名度，从而增加 Starlink 用户数量。通过清晰展示 Starlink 在速度、低延迟、可负担性和安装便捷性方面的优势——不仅在农村、偏远和基础设施受限地区，也在拥有有线宽带选择的郊区和城市地区——我们预计将推动用户数和收入实现显著增长。

paras.en: - Enterprise and Government Starlink Customers. We plan to drive growth in enterprise and government Starlink customers through our direct, vertical-specific sales model. In recent years, we have assembled dedicated sales and engineering teams to market and support fleet-wide conversions in the aviation and maritime sectors. This has enabled partnerships with many of the world’s leading airlines, including United Airlines, Southwest Airlines, American Airlines, Qatar Airways, Lufthansa Group, British Airways, Alaska Airlines, and Hawaiian Airlines, many of which have implemented or committed to fleet-wide Starlink installations for seamless in-flight connectivity. We have also partnered with premier cruise operators, such as Carnival Corporation, Royal Caribbean Group, MSC Cruises, and Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings, for full-fleet deployments that deliver reliable high-speed internet across thousand s of vessels worldwide. In addition, we have partnered with land mobility operators, including John Deere and the California Fire Department, as well as passenger rail operators such as Brightline (Florida), and Italo Treno, to provide remote monitoring and management of their fleets. We are actively driving growth in these sectors by onboarding new major airlines, cruise lines, and land mobility operators around the world, expanding existing relationships through deeper fleet penetration, and introducing advanced service tiers to make Starlink the standard connectivity solution for aviation, maritime, and land mobility customers globally. We also intend to expand our government customer base, securing major contracts with the United States and allied governments while delivering secure, resilient, and mission-critical connectivity for defense operations, humanitarian efforts, disaster response, and national security applications in even the most remote and challenging environments. We also serve a broad fixed‑site customer base across industries such as retail and financial services that require high availability for critical operations as well as reliable connectivity in remote or hard-to-serve locations. As companies continue to invest in secure and resilient networks to keep critical infrastructure—such as point‑of‑sale and payment processing systems—we see an opportunity to grow our broad fixed‑site customer base, often starting as back-up and then transitioning to primary.
paras.zh: - 企业与政府 Starlink 客户。我们计划通过直接、垂直行业专属的销售模式推动企业和政府 Starlink 客户增长。近年来，我们组建了专门的销售和工程团队，以在航空和海事领域推广并支持全机队/全船队转换。这使我们得以与众多全球领先的航空公司建立合作，包括 United Airlines、Southwest Airlines、American Airlines、Qatar Airways、Lufthansa Group、British Airways、Alaska Airlines 和 Hawaiian Airlines，其中许多公司已实施或承诺在全机队安装 Starlink，以实现无缝的机上连接。我们还与顶级邮轮运营商建立了合作，如 Carnival Corporation、Royal Caribbean Group、MSC Cruises 和 Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings，进行全船队部署，为全球数千艘船舶提供可靠的高速互联网。此外，我们还与陆地移动运营商建立了合作，包括 John Deere 和 California Fire Department，以及客运铁路运营商如 Brightline（佛罗里达）和 Italo Treno，为其车队提供远程监控和管理。我们正通过引入全球新的主要航空公司、邮轮公司和陆地移动运营商，通过更深入的机队/车队渗透扩展现有关系，并推出高级服务层级，使 Starlink 成为全球航空、海事和陆地移动客户的标准连接解决方案，从而积极推动这些领域的增长。我们还打算扩大政府客户基础，与美国及盟国政府签订重大合同，为国防行动、人道主义工作、灾害响应和国家安全应用提供安全、有韧性且任务关键的连接，即使在最偏远和最具挑战性的环境中也是如此。我们还服务于零售和金融服务等行业的广泛固定站点客户基础，这些行业需要关键运营的高可用性以及在偏远或难以服务地点的可靠连接。随着企业持续投资于安全和有韧性的网络以维持关键基础设施——如销售点和支付处理系统——我们看到扩大广泛固定站点客户基础的机会，通常从备份开始，然后过渡到主用。

paras.en: Expand our Starlink Mobile offering. As of March 31, 2026, we provide Starlink Mobile services to approximately 7.4 million monthly unique devices across approximately 30 countries. We partner with leading device manufacturers, application developers, and mobile network operators to enhance the services we provide over one satellite network, including over-the-top voice, video, and messaging. In 2025, we entered into agreements to acquire 65 MHz of spectrum in the United States and certain global Mobile Satellite Service spectrum licenses from EchoStar, which will enable a step-change in the possibilities for our Starlink Mobile service. Furthermore, we anticipate that Starship will be able to deploy approximately 50 mobile satellites per launch, significantly increasing capacity per launch and accelerating the deployment of our next-generation constellation. With the deployment of our next-generation constellation, which is designed to fully utilize the acquired spectrum, and the expansion of our MNO partnerships, we aim to further deliver on our goal of providing connectivity for everyone and substantially reducing mobile “dead zones” worldwide—eventually with 5G connectivity to unmodified cell phones and IoT devices globally.
paras.zh: 扩大我们的 Starlink Mobile 业务。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们在约 30 个国家为约 7.4 百万台月度独立设备提供 Starlink Mobile 服务。我们与领先的设备制造商、应用开发商和移动网络运营商合作，以增强我们通过一张卫星网络提供的服务，包括 over-the-top 语音、视频和消息服务。2025 年，我们签订协议，从 EchoStar 收购美国 65 MHz 频谱及若干全球移动卫星服务频谱许可，这将使我们的 Starlink Mobile 服务能力实现跨越式提升。此外，我们预计 Starship 每次发射将能够部署约 50 颗移动卫星，显著提高单次发射的容量，并加速我们下一代星座的部署。随着我们下一代星座的部署（该星座旨在充分利用所收购的频谱）以及我们 MNO 合作伙伴关系的扩展，我们旨在进一步实现为所有人提供连接的目标，并大幅减少全球移动“盲区”——最终为全球未经改装的手机和 IoT 设备提供 5G 连接。

paras.en: Increase the capacity of our constellations. Our current constellations of approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites, including over 3,000 satellites deployed in 2025, support over 700 Tbps of cumulative downlink capacity. To support larger numbers of customers through our Connectivity segment, we plan to materially increase the capacity of our broadband and mobile constellations. For our Starlink broadband constellation, we will continue deployment of more of our V2 Mini satellites, and in the second half of 2026, we expect to begin deployment of our next-generation V3 satellites, each of which is designed to offer one Tbps of downlink capacity per satellite. We expect Starship will be able to deploy up to 60 V3 satellites per launch, representing a twenty-fold increase in downlink capacity deployed per launch compared to Falcon 9, enabling a more rapid expansion of our Starlink broadband constellation at a significantly lower cost. For our Starlink Mobile constellation, we currently have approximately 650 existing dedicated mobile satellites. We are developing more comprehensive satellite-to mobile services, which we refer to as our Starlink Mobile Gen2 services, including broadband data and IoT connectivity, which are expected to deliver resilient, infrastructure-independent connectivity worldwide and enable 5G connectivity.
paras.zh: 提高我们星座的容量。我们目前的星座由约 9,600 颗 Starlink 宽带和移动卫星组成，其中包括 2025 年部署的超过 3,000 颗卫星，支持超过 700 Tbps 的累计下行容量。为通过我们的连接业务板块支持更多客户，我们计划大幅提高宽带和移动星座的容量。对于我们的 Starlink 宽带星座，我们将继续部署更多 V2 Mini 卫星，并预计于 2026 年下半年开始部署我们的下一代 V3 卫星，每颗 V3 卫星的设计下行容量为 1 Tbps。我们预计 Starship 每次发射将能够部署多达 60 颗 V3 卫星，与 Falcon 9 相比，单次发射部署的下行容量将提高二十倍，使我们能够以显著更低的成本更快速地扩展 Starlink 宽带星座。对于我们的 Starlink Mobile 星座，我们目前拥有约 650 颗现有的专用移动卫星。我们正在开发更全面的卫星到移动服务，我们称之为 Starlink Mobile Gen2 服务，包括宽带数据和 IoT 连接，预计将在全球范围内提供具有韧性的、不依赖基础设施的连接，并实现 5G 连接。

paras.en: We plan to expand our mobile constellation by deploying our next-generation V2 Mobile satellites in 2027 which, combined with the EchoStar spectrum acquisition and optimized 5G protocols, are expected to increase capacity by orders of magnitude compared to our first-generation constellation. In the U.S., the FCC approved the EchoStar license transfer in May 2026, and we separately expect to receive the remaining necessary U.S. regulatory authorizations in the second or third quarter of 2026. While these authorizations would be sufficient from a U.S. regulatory perspective, we still require our V2 Mobile satellites to be in orbit and must complete the acquisition of the relevant spectrum from EchoStar before we can commence our planned commercial Gen2 service in the United States. Internationally, we have filed applications in nearly every country in which we intend to operate our Gen2 service, and approvals have been granted in a limited number of these jurisdictions to date. Each international jurisdiction presents its own regulatory process and timeline, and we cannot predict when or whether approvals will be granted in any given market. In addition, our Gen2 service is subject to ITU coordination requirements. We have an operational coordination agreement with EchoStar, which we expect to continue through 2026 and 2027, under which EchoStar has agreed to protect our lower-priority S-band V2 Mobile constellation. By prioritizing these step-change capacity increases in our satellite-to-mobile capabilities, we expect to both enhance high-speed, low-latency service quality in existing markets and provide services to previously capacity-limited and unserved regions, including dense urban areas and emerging markets.
paras.zh: 我们计划于 2027 年部署下一代 V2 Mobile 卫星以扩展我们的移动星座，结合 EchoStar 频谱收购和优化的 5G 协议，预计将比我们的第一代星座提升数个数量级的容量。在美国，FCC 已于 2026 年 5 月批准 EchoStar 的许可证转让，我们另外预计将在 2026 年第二或第三季度获得其余必要的美国监管授权。尽管从美国监管角度看这些授权已足够，但我们仍需要我们的 V2 Mobile 卫星入轨，并且必须完成从 EchoStar 收购相关频谱，才能在美国开始我们计划的商业 Gen2 服务。在国际上，我们已在我们打算运营 Gen2 服务的几乎所有国家提交了申请，迄今为止已在其中有限数量的司法管辖区获得批准。每个国际司法管辖区都有其自身的监管流程和时间表，我们无法预测任何特定市场何时或是否会获得批准。此外，我们的 Gen2 服务还须遵守 ITU 协调要求。我们与 EchoStar 签订了一项运营协调协议，我们预计该协议将持续至 2026 年和 2027 年，根据该协议，EchoStar 已同意保护我们优先级较低的 S 波段 V2 Mobile 星座。通过优先推进这些卫星直连移动能力方面的跨越式容量提升，我们预计既能增强现有市场的高速、低延迟服务质量，又能为此前容量受限和未覆盖的地区（包括密集城市区域和新兴市场）提供服务。

paras.en: Grow consumer AI platform monetization. We plan to continue to grow revenue from our AI platform, the Grok application, by increasing monetization of our existing user base. We will leverage our unique combination of real‑time data, large‑scale distribution, leading foundational model, and hardware expertise to increase the number of Grok subscribers. Subscribers benefit from enhanced functionality, exclusive features, and access to our latest AI models. Since the introduction of our Grok subscription offering in 2025, we have increased the number of available features to add value to our subscribers, including providing access to our latest and enhanced AI tools. We plan to continue adding new features and functionality while releasing increasingly capable Grok models to increase the penetration rate of our subscriber base. Our AI segment has demonstrated exceptional model velocity: since launching Grok, we have developed leading frontier models at a far faster rate of innovation than others. We continue to invest in scaling Grok through subsequent generations, including Grok-5. Our roadmap for future models contains multi-trillion parameter models, which could represent a step change in reasoning depth and overall intelligence. We believe this pace of innovation strengthens the value proposition of our subscription offerings and supports long term subscriber growth. While our subscriber growth has been strong, we believe we are still early in increasing paid penetration across our Grok user base. We further believe there might be an incremental monetization opportunity by introducing advertising into our stand-alone Grok offering.
paras.zh: 提升消费者 AI 平台变现能力。我们计划通过提高现有用户群的变现水平，继续增长我们 AI 平台 Grok 应用的收入。我们将依托实时数据、大规模分发、领先基础模型与硬件专业能力的独特组合，增加 Grok 订阅用户数量。订阅用户可享受增强功能、专属特性以及对我们最新 AI 模型的访问权限。自 2025 年推出 Grok 订阅服务以来，我们不断增加可用功能以为订阅用户创造价值，包括提供对我们最新及增强版 AI 工具的访问权限。我们计划继续增加新特性与功能，同时发布能力日益增强的 Grok 模型，以提高订阅用户群的渗透率。我们的 AI 板块展现出卓越的模型迭代速度：自推出 Grok 以来，我们以远快于其他方的创新速度开发出领先的前沿模型。我们继续投入以通过后续代际（包括 Grok-5）扩展 Grok。我们的未来模型路线图包含数万亿参数模型，这可能代表推理深度与整体智能的阶跃式变化。我们相信这一创新速度强化了我们订阅服务的价值主张，并支撑长期订阅用户增长。尽管我们的订阅用户增长强劲，我们相信在提升 Grok 用户群付费渗透率方面仍处于早期阶段。我们进一步认为，通过在我们的独立 Grok 服务中引入广告，可能存在增量变现机会。

paras.en: Grow X monetization. We intend to drive X revenue growth by increasing engagement across our users, increasing X Premium subscriber conversion, growing advertising revenue per user, and diversifying our advertising base. We continue to evolve X into an “Everything App,” integrating real-time information, communications, media, payments, banking, and more within one consumer app experience. This can improve the usefulness of X, and therefore increase the usage and monetization potential of X. We have demonstrated rapid product launch velocity, with frequent features and products launched since 2023, including Grok integration, long‑form video, audio and video calling, secure messaging, tool calling, long-form articles, and creator tools. We plan to further broaden the value proposition of X through offerings like Money, a product we launched in beta in November 2025, which aims to expand platform utility by enabling payments and other financial services. We updated X chat in 2025, featuring end-to-end encryption and no connection to our ad personalization, unlike other messaging services. We intend to further embed Grok throughout X to enhance discovery, analysis of posts, user support, and personalization, increasing the usefulness of X and further improving the value of a paid subscription.
paras.zh: 提升 X 变现能力。我们打算通过提高用户参与度、提升 X Premium 订阅用户转化率、提高每用户广告收入以及多元化我们的广告主基础，推动 X 收入增长。我们继续将 X 演进为“万能应用”，将实时信息、通信、媒体、支付、银行等整合于一体化的消费者应用体验之中。这可以提升 X 的实用性，从而增加 X 的使用量与变现潜力。我们已展现出快速的产品发布速度，自 2023 年以来频繁推出功能与产品，包括 Grok 集成、长视频、音频与视频通话、安全消息、工具调用、长文文章以及创作者工具。我们计划通过诸如 Money 等产品进一步拓宽 X 的价值主张，Money 是我们于 2025 年 11 月推出的测试版产品，旨在通过支持支付及其他金融服务来扩展平台效用。我们于 2025 年更新了 X 聊天，具备端到端加密且不与我们的广告个性化相关联，这一点与其他消息服务不同。我们打算进一步将 Grok 嵌入整个 X，以增强内容发现、帖子分析、用户支持与个性化，提升 X 的实用性并进一步提高付费订阅的价值。

paras.en: We also expect to grow advertising revenue per user and to diversify our advertiser base over time because of X’s compelling advertiser value proposition—large-scale user engagement, real-time content, and advanced AI-driven performance marketing tools. We intend to drive further advertising revenue growth by improving our performance advertising capabilities, embedding AI to optimize ad campaigns, and launching richer ad formats, including those that increase advertiser return on ad spending and their spend with us. In determining our advertising rates, we use an auction process in which advertisers bid to have their ads shown to the audience they are targeting, except for certain reserved inventory, which is sold on a fixed price basis. We provide advertisers with several engagement metrics, including: the number of impressions, price per ad, clicks, and conversions. Currently, Grok API access is not included in our advertising rates to advertisers. We do not currently sell or offer advertisers the ability to place ads on the Grok API.
paras.zh: 我们还预计，随着时间推移，X 具有吸引力的广告主价值主张——大规模用户互动、实时内容以及先进的 AI 驱动效果营销工具——将推动我们提升单用户广告收入并实现广告主群体的多元化。我们打算通过提升效果广告能力、嵌入 AI 以优化广告活动，以及推出更丰富的广告形式（包括提高广告主广告支出回报率及在我们平台支出的形式）来进一步推动广告收入增长。在确定广告费率时，我们采用拍卖机制，由广告主竞价，使其广告展示给其目标受众，但某些预留库存除外，该等库存按固定价格出售。我们向广告主提供若干互动指标，包括：展示次数、单次广告价格、点击次数和转化次数。目前，Grok API 访问权限未纳入我们向广告主收取的广告费率。我们目前不向广告主出售或提供在 Grok API 上投放广告的能力。

paras.en: We also expect X’s real-time content stream and engagement feedback, subject to some limitations for certain content, to strengthen our advertising product performance and relevance, improving outcomes for both consumers and advertisers, and increasing retention. We also began a phased roll-out of our new advertising platform, including the new X Ads Manager, in April 2026. X Ads Manager is designed to help advertisers launch better campaigns faster, with AI-powered systems enabling more precise, relevant, and dynamic ad delivery and a centralized workflow for campaign creation, optimization, and real-time monitoring. Grok supports this strategy by helping advertisers with campaign creation, creative optimization, and alignment with trending topics and user intent.
paras.zh: 我们还预计，X 的实时内容流和互动反馈（对某些内容存在一定限制）将增强我们广告产品的表现和相关性，改善消费者和广告主双方的结果，并提高留存率。我们还于 2026 年 4 月开始分阶段推出我们的新广告平台，包括新的 X Ads Manager。X Ads Manager 旨在帮助广告主更快地启动更好的广告活动，其 AI 驱动系统可实现更精准、更相关、更动态的广告投放，并提供用于广告活动创建、优化和实时监控的集中式工作流。Grok 通过帮助广告主进行广告活动创建、创意优化以及与热门话题和用户意图保持一致来支持这一战略。

paras.en: Deepen enterprise and government adoption. We believe adoption of AI by both enterprise and government reflects a structural industry shift, with room for substantial long-term growth. Our Grok Business, Grok Enterprise, and xAI Gov offerings position us to scale in tandem with broader enterprise and governmental AI adoption. Our Grok API further extends our reach by enabling developers to integrate our models directly into their applications and workflows. We intend to further support our enterprise offerings with a specialized salesforce and forward deployed engineers, engineers who embed directly with a client to implement our solution, to support customer acquisition and expansion.
paras.zh: 深化企业和政府采用。我们认为，企业和政府对 AI 的采用反映了行业的结构性转变，具有可观的长期增长空间。我们的 Grok Business、Grok Enterprise 和 xAI Gov 产品使我们能够与更广泛的企业和政府 AI 采用同步扩张。我们的 Grok API 通过使开发者能够将我们的模型直接集成到其应用和工作流中，进一步扩展了我们的覆盖范围。我们打算通过专门的销售团队和前置部署工程师（直接嵌入客户现场以实施我们解决方案的工程师）进一步支持我们的企业产品，以支持客户获取和扩展。

paras.en: Increase the scale of our terrestrial power and AI compute infrastructure. We plan to rapidly scale our terrestrial AI compute infrastructure through the continued deployment of large-scale clusters to support the training and inference of our AI models. To rapidly bring gigawatt-scale data centers online, we leverage world-class engineering, first-principles thinking and deep “shovels-to-tokens” vertical integration. Our AI compute facilities, COLOSSUS and COLOSSUS II, collectively provide approximately 1.0 gigawatt of compute power, with additional power capacity available for data center operations. COLOSSUS II will also provide the compute to train our next-generation Grok-5 AI model. We expect that once fully operational, the next phase of expansion at COLOSSUS II will represent an additional 400MW of compute capacity. Our first-principles thinking enables us to build coherent compute at scale and at rapid speed with lower costs than most other companies in the industry. We brought the first cluster of COLOSSUS online in 122 days, repurposing the shell of an existing factory, and the first cluster of COLOSSUS II online even faster in 91 days. As an illustrative comparison, an industry benchmark to bring online a 100 megawatt greenfield data center is approximately two years. We also demonstrated a significant improvement in cost efficiency, achieving data center construction costs for COLOSSUS II that are considerably lower than industry benchmarks on a per megawatt basis. As AI workloads increase in complexity and scale, data center operators face constraints related to power density, cooling, network bandwidth, supply chain management, construction expertise and capital deployment. Our experience in designing mission-critical hardware systems, optimizing power efficiency, and operating distributed infrastructure networks provides a differentiated foundation for continuing to grow and advance the next-generation compute platform. We believe that continued investment in our compute infrastructure is critical to supporting long-term consumer and enterprise growth as AI adoption accelerates, while also providing a powerful foundation for our transition to orbital AI compute at scale.
paras.zh: 扩大我们的地面电力与 AI 算力基础设施规模。我们计划通过持续部署大规模集群来快速扩展地面 AI 算力基础设施，以支持我们 AI 模型的训练与推理。为快速上线吉瓦级数据中心，我们依托世界级工程能力、第一性原理思维以及深度的“从铲子到 token”垂直整合。我们的 AI 算力设施 COLOSSUS 和 COLOSSUS II 合计提供约 1.0 吉瓦的算力，并另有可用电力容量用于数据中心运营。COLOSSUS II 还将提供算力以训练我们的下一代 Grok-5 AI 模型。我们预计，待全面投入运营后，COLOSSUS II 的下一阶段扩建将额外带来 400MW 的算力容量。我们的第一性原理思维使我们能够以低于行业内大多数其他公司的成本，大规模、快速地构建协同一致的算力。我们在 122 天内上线了 COLOSSUS 的首个集群，改造利用了一座现有工厂的外壳；COLOSSUS II 的首个集群上线更快，仅用 91 天。作为说明性对比，行业内上线一座 100 兆瓦新建数据中心的基准时间约为两年。我们还在成本效率方面实现了显著提升，COLOSSUS II 的数据中心建设成本按每兆瓦计算大幅低于行业基准。随着 AI 工作负载的复杂度和规模不断提升，数据中心运营商面临与功率密度、冷却、网络带宽、供应链管理、建设专业能力和资本部署相关的制约。我们在设计关键任务硬件系统、优化能效以及运营分布式基础设施网络方面的经验，为持续发展和推进下一代算力平台提供了差异化的基础。我们相信，随着 AI 采用加速，持续投资于我们的算力基础设施对于支持长期消费者和企业增长至关重要，同时也为我们向规模化轨道 AI 算力转型提供了强大的基础。

paras.en: In addition, our leadership in compute infrastructure positions us to monetize not only AI software applications built on our models, but also the underlying compute that powers them. As we continue to scale our terrestrial compute infrastructure to support internal model development, training, and inference workloads, we intend to sell our high-performance compute capacity to a limited number of third party customers.
paras.zh: 此外，我们在算力基础设施方面的领先地位使我们不仅能够将基于我们模型构建的 AI 软件应用变现，还能够将支撑这些应用的底层算力变现。随着我们持续扩展地面算力基础设施以支持内部模型开发、训练和推理工作负载，我们打算向有限数量的第三方客户出售我们的高性能算力容量。

paras.en: Deploy orbital AI compute at scale. We believe growth of the projected $26.5 trillion-dollar AI market will be constrained by Earth’s inability to rapidly scale power generation, underscoring the challenge of achieving terawatt-scale compute without harming people and the environment. While we expect terrestrial power generation to continue to grow, we believe the physical, environmental, and regulatory constraints will prevent it from delivering the orders-of-magnitude increases needed to match future energy demands of the AI era. Power from the Sun, an enormous, free fusion reactor in the sky, represents approximately 99.8% of the solar system’s energy and offers the only truly scalable solution to terrestrial energy constraints. By combining virtually unlimited solar power in space with our industry-leading launch costs and satellite manufacturing capabilities, we believe we can deliver compute over time at a fundamentally lower cost structure than is possible on Earth. By the end of the decade, we intend to deploy the first modular orbital AI compute shells and begin monetizing capacity through the sale of AI software and AI compute. We aim to launch 100 gigawatts of AI compute capacity on solar-powered satellites each year, equivalent to roughly one fifth of total annual U.S. power production in 2025. The amount of compute capacity we can launch depends on three components—payload, satellite capacity, and launch frequency. With respect to payload, Starship V3 is designed to deliver 100 metric tons to space in a fully reusable configuration while enabling rapid turnaround times, and future generations could reach 200 metric tons, potentially as soon as Starship V4. With respect to satellite capacity, we expect solar cells optimized for the space environment will be produced at a rapid rate, with early satellites generating 100 kilowatts of compute power and scaling from there. Finally, with respect to launch frequency, we expect to be able to scale to thousand s of launches per year. Together, we expect these achievements will allow us to transport approximately one million metric tons to orbit annually, powering 100 gigawatts of AI compute. Such compute capacity will also play a critical role in advancing our human augmentation vision by expanding the reach, speed, and capability of AI beyond what is possible with terrestrial compute infrastructure alone.
paras.zh: 大规模部署轨道 AI 算力。我们认为，预计规模达 $26.5 trillion 的 AI 市场的增长将受制于地球无法快速扩大发电能力，这凸显了在不损害人类与环境的前提下实现太瓦级算力的挑战。尽管我们预计地面发电量将持续增长，但我们认为物理、环境与监管方面的约束将使其无法实现匹配 AI 时代未来能源需求所需的数量级增长。来自太阳的能量——天空中一座巨大且免费的聚变反应堆——约占太阳系能量的 99.8%，为地球能源约束提供了唯一真正可扩展的解决方案。通过将太空中近乎无限的太阳能与我们行业领先的发射成本和卫星制造能力相结合，我们相信随着时间推移，我们能够以从根本上低于地球可能实现的成本结构交付算力。到本十年末，我们打算部署首批模块化轨道 AI 算力舱，并开始通过销售 AI 软件和 AI 算力实现容量变现。我们的目标是在太阳能卫星上每年发射 100 gigawatts 的 AI 算力容量，大致相当于 2025 年美国年总发电量的五分之一。我们能够发射的算力容量取决于三个组成部分——载荷、卫星容量和发射频率。在载荷方面，Starship V3 设计为在完全可重复使用配置下向太空运送 100 metric tons，同时实现快速周转时间，未来世代可能达到 200 metric tons，最早可能在 Starship V4 实现。在卫星容量方面，我们预计针对太空环境优化的太阳能电池将以快速的速度生产，早期卫星将产生 100 kilowatts 的算力功率，并在此基础上扩展。最后，在发射频率方面，我们预计能够扩展至每年数千次发射。综合来看，我们预计这些成就将使我们每年向轨道运送约 one million metric tons，为 100 gigawatts 的 AI 算力提供动力。此类算力容量还将在推进我们的人类增强愿景方面发挥关键作用，使 AI 的覆盖范围、速度和能力超越仅靠地面算力基础设施所能实现的程度。

paras.en: We believe we are well-positioned to execute and deliver orbital AI compute to build the infrastructure of the future. We believe orbital AI compute is an incredibly difficult challenge that only we can solve at scale in the near term.
paras.zh: 我们相信我们处于有利地位，能够执行并交付轨道 AI 算力，以构建未来的基础设施。我们认为轨道 AI 算力是一项极其艰巨的挑战，只有我们能够在近期内大规模解决。

paras.en: Design and manufacture our own chips. We plan to deepen our strategic collaboration with Tesla and Intel through Terafab. In connection with such collaboration, we have agreed with Tesla on a general framework for the future development of Terafab. Any specific projects undertaken pursuant to this framework will be subject to separate negotiations and agreements (including any development timelines, milestones and capital expenditures) and have not yet been determined. We expect Terafab to be the world’s largest chip manufacturing facility, with the goal of eventually achieving one terawatt of annual compute production capacity. While Terafab is intended to expand our internal chip manufacturing capabilities, we expect to continue sourcing a significant portion of our compute hardware from third-party suppliers. We view Terafab as complementary to these relationships, enabling us to augment our access to compute hardware at massive scale and further complete our highly vertically integrated compute platform by extending our control to the foundational chip layer. By developing end-to-end capabilities spanning the design of lithography masks, fabrication of logic and memory chips, and advanced packaging, all in a vertically integrated closed-loop single plant, we will be able to more rapidly iterate to improve chip design and performance. We plan to design chips that are optimized for the space environment. This collaboration directly enables our planned orders-of-magnitude increases in AI compute deployment in orbit which would be constrained by pure reliance on external foundries. Leveraging shared engineering resources, intellectual property, and infrastructure across Tesla and SpaceX, as well as Intel’s expertise in designing, fabricating and packaging ultra-high-performance chips at scale, Terafab is designed to create powerful ecosystem synergies that accelerate innovation cycles and reduce costs. Just as we manufacture approximately 80% of Starship in-house, we expect significant speed and cost advantages from Terafab’s vertical integration. We believe this integration, if achieved, will provide us with a critical competitive advantage in the race to scale AI infrastructure, especially as we begin our orbital AI compute satellite deployments.
paras.zh: 设计并制造我们自己的芯片。我们计划通过 Terafab 深化与 Tesla 和 Intel 的战略合作。就此类合作，我们已与 Tesla 就 Terafab 未来开发的一般框架达成一致。根据该框架开展的任何具体项目均须另行协商并签订协议（包括任何开发时间表、里程碑和资本支出），且尚未确定。我们预计 Terafab 将成为全球最大的芯片制造设施，目标是最终实现每年一太瓦的算力产能。尽管 Terafab 旨在扩大我们的内部芯片制造能力，但我们预计将继续从第三方供应商采购相当一部分算力硬件。我们将 Terafab 视为对这些关系的补充，使我们能够大规模扩充算力硬件的获取渠道，并通过将控制延伸至基础芯片层，进一步完善我们高度垂直整合的算力平台。通过在一座垂直整合的闭环单一工厂内构建涵盖光刻掩模设计、逻辑与存储芯片制造以及先进封装的全流程端到端能力，我们将能够更快速地迭代以改进芯片设计和性能。我们计划设计针对太空环境优化的芯片。这一合作直接使我们得以按计划在轨道上实现 AI 算力部署的数量级增长，而若仅依赖外部代工厂，这一增长将受到制约。借助 Tesla 和 SpaceX 共享的工程资源、知识产权和基础设施，以及 Intel 在大规模设计、制造和封装超高性能芯片方面的专长，Terafab 旨在创造强大的生态系统协同效应，加速创新周期并降低成本。正如我们约 80% 的 Starship 为自主制造，我们预计 Terafab 的垂直整合将带来显著的速度和成本优势。我们相信，这一整合若能实现，将在扩大 AI 基础设施规模的竞赛中为我们提供关键的竞争优势，尤其是在我们开始进行轨道 AI 算力卫星部署之际。

paras.en: Launch digital human augmentation. In partnership with Tesla, we are developing Macrohard, an agentic platform designed to fully emulate digital workflows and augment human operation of computers—from coding and product development to management and entire business processes. Similar to how autonomous systems emulate human inputs to execute complex tasks, Macrohard is designed to augment how humans operate computers and tools to analyze, create, and manage workflows. Unlike other enterprise software and AI applications that primarily digitize workflows and systematize historical processes, our solutions are designed to operate as real-time, intelligence-driven extensions of the user. Macrohard aims to combine our frontier AI model with Tesla’s physical AI prowess to achieve the goal of augmenting the operational functions of entire companies. We expect Macrohard to benefit from running on both state-of-the-art processors and cost efficient Tesla processors, a critical advantage of our vertical integration. We believe Macrohard has the potential to fundamentally transform how companies across all industries are structured and operate, thereby allowing dramatic increases in human productivity and prosperity.
paras.zh: 启动数字人类增强。我们正与特斯拉合作开发 Macrohard，这是一个智能体平台，旨在全面模拟数字化工作流程并增强人类对计算机的操作——从编程和产品开发到管理和整个业务流程。类似于自主系统模拟人类输入以执行复杂任务的方式，Macrohard 旨在增强人类操作计算机和工具以分析、创建和管理工作流程的能力。与其他主要将工作流程数字化并将历史流程系统化的企业软件和 AI 应用不同，我们的解决方案旨在作为用户的实时、智能驱动的延伸来运作。Macrohard 旨在将我们的前沿 AI 模型与特斯拉的物理 AI 能力相结合，以实现增强整个公司运营职能的目标。我们预计 Macrohard 将受益于同时运行在最先进的处理器和具有成本效益的特斯拉处理器上，这是我们垂直整合的关键优势。我们相信 Macrohard 有潜力从根本上改变所有行业公司的组织结构和运营方式，从而大幅提升人类生产力和繁荣。

paras.en: #### Future Markets
paras.zh: #### 未来市场

paras.en: We aim to build the infrastructure of the future in Space, leveraging our foundational competitive advantage, the ability to launch mass at scale. By opening access to space to industries on Earth, we can grow our business by creating new markets. Our technological capabilities enable us to repeatedly create new markets by pushing the boundaries of what space can support. As we continue to advance and scale, we expect to unlock new market opportunities. Over the long-term, we expect our Starship-enabled opportunities to include:
paras.zh: 我们的目标是在太空构建未来的基础设施，利用我们的基础竞争优势——大规模发射能力。通过向地球上的各行业开放太空准入，我们可以通过创造新市场来发展我们的业务。我们的技术能力使我们能够不断突破太空所能支持的边界，从而反复创造新市场。随着我们持续进步和扩张，我们预计将解锁新的市场机遇。从长期来看，我们预计星舰（Starship）带来的机遇将包括：

paras.en: - Point-to-point terrestrial travel. We plan to develop ultra-fast long-haul point-to-point Earth transport using Starship, enabling passengers and cargo to travel between major cities in a fraction of current transit times, revolutionizing global logistics and passenger travel with unprecedented speed and efficiency.
paras.zh: - 点对点地面旅行。我们计划利用星舰开发超高速长途点对点地球运输，使乘客和货物能够以当前运输时间的一小部分在主要城市之间旅行，以前所未有的速度和效率革新全球物流和客运旅行。

paras.en: - Space tourism. With meaningful advances in space technology and the continued build-out of orbital flight infrastructure, we expect increasing interest in human space travel as it becomes easier and more common to access space.
paras.zh: - 太空旅游。随着太空技术的重大进步和轨道飞行基础设施的持续建设，我们预计随着进入太空变得更容易、更普遍，人类太空旅行将受到越来越多的关注。

paras.en: - In-orbit manufacturing. We aim to establish in-space manufacturing facilities that leverage the unique microgravity conditions of space to produce materials, pharmaceuticals, and advanced components that are difficult or impossible to manufacture on Earth, opening new high-value industrial markets.
paras.zh: - 在轨制造。我们的目标是建立太空制造设施，利用太空独特的微重力条件生产在地球上难以或无法制造的材料、药品和先进部件，开辟新的高价值工业市场。

paras.en: - Passenger and cargo transport to the Moon and Mars. We intend to support large-scale passenger and cargo missions to the Moon and Mars, delivering the people, equipment, and supplies needed to establish permanent human settlements and accelerate the path to becoming a self-sustaining multiplanetary civilization.
paras.zh: - 月球和火星的客运与货运。我们打算支持前往月球和火星的大规模客运和货运任务，运送建立永久人类定居点所需的人员、设备和物资，并加速成为自给自足的多行星文明的进程。

paras.en: - Energy production on the Moon and Mars. We aim to develop large-scale solar energy production on the Moon and Mars, taking advantage of the thin atmosphere and constant solar exposure to generate power for manufacturing, habitats, and future infrastructure at scale.
paras.zh: - 月球和火星上的能源生产。我们旨在开发月球和火星上的大规模太阳能生产，利用稀薄大气和持续日照为规模化制造、居住设施及未来基础设施发电。

paras.en: - Manufacturing capabilities on the Moon and Mars. We plan to build manufacturing infrastructure on the Moon and Mars that utilizes local resources to produce fuel, construction materials, and other essential resources, reducing dependence on Earth resupply and enabling sustainable long-term presence.
paras.zh: - 月球和火星上的制造能力。我们计划在月球和火星上建设制造基础设施，利用当地资源生产燃料、建筑材料及其他必需资源，减少对地球补给的依赖，实现可持续的长期驻留。

paras.en: - Asteroid mining. We plan to pursue asteroid mining operations to extract metals and other critical resources from near-Earth and main-belt asteroids, providing abundant raw materials for space-based industries and reducing the need to launch mass from Earth.
paras.zh: - 小行星采矿。我们计划开展小行星采矿作业，从近地小行星和主带小行星中开采金属及其他关键资源，为太空产业提供丰富的原材料，并减少从地球发射质量的需求。

paras.en: We believe space represents the largest economic frontier in human history. Our innovations and technological advancements are redefining existing industries and creating new market opportunities across Space, Connectivity and AI. We believe we have a distinct ability to identify, develop, and commercialize new multi-trillion-dollar markets that did not previously exist. We currently stand alone in our ability to deliver revolutionary breakthroughs across spaceflight and exploration, global connectivity, and artificial intelligence, enabling an age of abundance that we believe has the potential to propel an unprecedented expansion in the global economy.
paras.zh: 我们相信，太空代表着人类历史上最大的经济前沿。我们的创新和技术进步正在重新定义现有产业，并在太空、连接和 AI 领域创造新的市场机遇。我们相信，我们具备独特的能力去识别、开发并商业化此前并不存在的、规模达数万亿美元的新市场。目前，我们在航天飞行与探索、全球连接以及人工智能领域交付革命性突破的能力上独树一帜，从而开启一个富足时代，我们相信这一时代有潜力推动全球经济实现前所未有的扩张。

paras.en: By pioneering the world’s first and only fleet of reusable rockets at scale, we revolutionized space access through dramatically lower cost and unmatched reliability.
