Lowering costs by orders of magnitude creates entirely new industries on Earth and in space that were technologically and economically infeasible for others to access historically. Our first trillion-dollar market was Starlink, a satellite service supported by our low-latency, high-speed LEO constellation that required the rapid, low-cost deployment of million s of kilograms of hardware into orbit. Our Starlink constellation powers a global connectivity platform capable of supporting broadband and mobile services, enabling high-speed internet access to homes, enterprises, governments, and mobile users across virtually any location on Earth. We believe our next trillion-dollar market is AI compute, which we contemplate will leverage our rockets and satellites for massive orbital deployment.
paras.zh: 通过开创全球首个也是唯一一个规模化可重复使用火箭机队，我们以大幅降低的成本和无与伦比的可靠性彻底改变了太空进入方式。将成本降低数个数量级，在地球上和太空中创造了全新的产业，而这些产业在历史上因技术和经济上不可行而令其他方无法涉足。我们的第一个万亿美元市场是 Starlink，这是一项由我们低时延、高速的 LEO 星座支持的卫星服务，该星座需要将数百万公斤的硬件快速、低成本地部署到轨道上。我们的 Starlink 星座驱动着一个全球连接平台，能够支持宽带和移动服务，为地球上几乎任何地点的家庭、企业、政府和移动用户提供高速互联网接入。我们相信我们的下一个万亿美元市场是 AI 算力，我们设想将利用我们的火箭和卫星进行大规模轨道部署。

paras.en: We believe we have identified the largest TAM in human history. We estimate that our quantifiable TAM is $28.5 trillion, consisting of $370 billion in Space from space-enabled solutions; $1.6 trillion in Connectivity across $870 billion in Starlink Broadband and $740 billion in Starlink Mobile as well as additional opportunities in enterprise and government; $26.5 trillion in AI across $2.4 trillion in AI infrastructure, $760 billion in consumer subscriptions, $600 billion in digital advertising, and $22.7 trillion in enterprise applications. For illustrative purposes of sizing our addressable market opportunity, we exclude China and Russia from our global estimates.
paras.zh: 我们相信我们已识别出人类历史上最大的 TAM。我们估计，我们可量化的 TAM 为 $28.5 trillion，其中包括太空领域来自太空赋能解决方案的 $370 billion；连接领域 $1.6 trillion，涵盖 Starlink 宽带 $870 billion 和 Starlink 移动 $740 billion，以及企业和政府领域的额外机遇；AI 领域 $26.5 trillion，涵盖 AI 基础设施 $2.4 trillion、消费者订阅 $760 billion、数字广告 $600 billion 和企业应用 $22.7 trillion。为便于说明我们可服务市场机遇的规模，我们在全球估算中排除了中国和俄罗斯。

paras.en: In addition to the markets we serve today, we believe we are poised to catalyze transformative breakthroughs and create entirely new markets. Given these are longer-term opportunities at earlier stages of development, we do not quantify them in our TAM estimates; however, we believe that over time each of these markets could eventually represent multi-trillion-dollar economic opportunities. These new markets include long haul point-to-point terrestrial travel, space tourism, in-orbit manufacturing, asteroid mining, energy production and manufacturing on the Moon and Mars, and passenger and cargo transportation to the Moon and Mars.
paras.zh: 除了我们今天所服务的市场之外，我们相信我们已准备好催生变革性突破并创造全新的市场。鉴于这些是处于较早发展阶段的较长期机遇，我们未在 TAM 估算中对其进行量化；然而，我们相信随着时间推移，这些市场中的每一个最终都可能代表数万亿美元的经济机遇。这些新市场包括长途点对点地面旅行、太空旅游、在轨制造、小行星采矿、月球和火星上的能源生产与制造，以及往返月球和火星的客运与货运。

paras.en: SpaceX’s Estimated TAM by Segment
paras.zh: SpaceX 按业务板块划分的估计 TAM

paras.en: #### Space

While the size of the space market is massive for any company to address, our capabilities in space represent a foundational competitive advantage that allow us to address markets that represent significant portions of global gross domestic product (“GDP”)—connectivity and AI. We estimate a total market opportunity of $370 billion across space-enabled solutions, with the lunar economy presenting a significant upside not included in the estimate.
paras.zh: 尽管太空市场的规模对任何公司而言都极为庞大，但我们在太空领域的能力构成了一项基础性竞争优势，使我们能够切入占全球国内生产总值（“GDP”）重要组成部分的市场——连接与 AI。我们估计，太空赋能解决方案的总市场机会为 $370 billion，而月球经济则带来了未计入该估算的重大上行空间。

paras.en: Space-Enabled Solutions. According to Novaspace, space-enabled solutions represented a $370 billion market in 2025, including spacecraft manufacturing, launch services, satellite operations, positioning, navigation and timing (“PNT”) devices and value-added services, as well as uncontracted costs of government space agencies. Both commercial and government customers participate in this market, with growing space-based defense budgets reflecting prioritization of security, resilience, and strategic autonomy by governments globally. For the purpose of sizing our TAM, we exclude the value of satellite communications services, as we include those within our Connectivity segment.
paras.zh: 太空赋能解决方案。根据 Novaspace 的数据，太空赋能解决方案在 2025 年构成了一个 $370 billion 的市场，包括航天器制造、发射服务、卫星运营、定位、导航与授时（“PNT”）设备及增值服务，以及政府航天机构未签约的成本。商业和政府客户均参与该市场，且天基国防预算不断增长，反映出全球各国政府对安全、韧性和战略自主的优先重视。为测算我们的 TAM，我们未计入卫星通信服务的价值，因为我们将该部分纳入我们的连接业务板块。

paras.en: Lunar Economy. We believe the development of a sustained human and commercial presence on the Moon has the potential to give rise to a new lunar economy encompassing transportation, infrastructure, communications, energy, manufacturing (including the production of satellites and advanced chips), resource extraction, and scientific and commercial activity. Early demand is already emerging from government space agencies and research institutions, and we expect this to expand over time to include commercial enterprises seeking to leverage the Moon as a platform for logistics, industrial activity, and deep-space exploration. Establishing a lunar economy requires first proving reliable extraction of water ice to sustain life and producing hydrogen-oxygen propellant, alongside building power, transport, and storage infrastructure in an extreme, high-cost environment. If achieved, we believe these same resources and the Moon’s low gravity unlock the potential for scalable growth through an efficient fuel production and refueling hub, creating a strategic access point that can potentially support deeper space industrialization and serve as a stepping stone to establishing a civilization on Mars. Although we believe the potential size and scope of the lunar economy is extraordinarily large, we are not providing an estimate of the TAM for this opportunity at this time because expectations regarding the timing, pace of adoption, regulatory frameworks, and ultimate scope of commercial activity beyond Earth are rapidly evolving alongside the development and deployment of the technology necessary to establish a lunar presence (such as Starship). As the Moon transitions from a scientific outpost into an industrial frontier, SpaceX is positioned to spearhead this revolutionary expansion, and we believe that continued advancements in our launch capabilities, space infrastructure capabilities, and cost efficiency will allow us to meaningfully accelerate the development of a sustainable lunar economy.
paras.zh: 月球经济。我们相信，在月球上建立持续的人类与商业存在，有可能催生一个新的月球经济，涵盖运输、基础设施、通信、能源、制造（包括卫星和先进芯片的生产）、资源开采以及科学与商业活动。早期需求已开始来自政府航天机构和研究机构，我们预计这一需求将随着时间推移而扩大，纳入寻求将月球作为物流、工业活动和深空探索平台的商业企业。建立月球经济首先需要证明能够可靠开采水冰以维持生命并生产氢氧推进剂，同时还需在极端且高成本的环境中建设电力、运输和储存基础设施。若得以实现，我们相信这些相同的资源以及月球低重力将释放通过高效燃料生产和加注枢纽实现可扩展增长的潜力，打造一个战略接入点，有可能支持更深入的太空工业化，并成为在火星上建立文明的垫脚石。尽管我们相信月球经济的潜在规模和范围极其庞大，但我们目前不提供该机会的 TAM 估算，因为有关地球以外商业活动的时间安排、采用速度、监管框架和最终范围的预期，正随着建立月球存在所需技术（如 Starship）的开发和部署而迅速演变。随着月球从科学前哨转变为工业前沿，SpaceX 处于引领这一革命性扩张的有利位置，我们相信，我们在发射能力、太空基础设施能力和成本效率方面的持续进步，将使我们能够显著加速可持续月球经济的发展。

paras.en: #### Connectivity

We believe the global connectivity market represents a substantial and durable opportunity, driven by the increasing reliance of consumers, enterprises, and governments on high-speed, low-latency, reliable connectivity across both terrestrial and remote environments. Across Starlink Broadband and Starlink Mobile, we estimate a total market opportunity of $1.6 trillion reflecting primarily consumer use cases. We believe these traditional use cases, however, do not account for the long-term market opportunity, as connectivity is evolving into a critical infrastructure layer underpinning the global economy, enabling entirely new categories of demand. As high-performance, ubiquitous connectivity becomes embedded across transportation networks, autonomous systems, and smart devices, we expect the scope of the market to extend well beyond the traditional definitions.
paras.zh: 我们相信，全球连接市场代表着重大且持久的机会，其驱动力在于消费者、企业和政府对地面及偏远环境中高速、低延迟、可靠连接日益增长的依赖。在 Starlink Broadband 和 Starlink Mobile 两大业务中，我们估计总市场机会为 $1.6 trillion，主要反映消费者使用场景。然而，我们认为这些传统使用场景并未涵盖长期市场机会，因为连接正演变为支撑全球经济的 critical infrastructure layer，催生全新的需求类别。随着高性能、无处不在的连接嵌入交通网络、自主系统和智能设备，我们预计市场范围将远超传统定义。

paras.en: Starlink Broadband. The global demand for ubiquitous, high-speed broadband internet creates an approximately $870 billion dollar opportunity. Our satellite broadband service, Starlink, is positioned to capture value across multiple massive and rapidly expanding markets:
paras.zh: Starlink Broadband。全球对无处不在的高速宽带互联网的需求创造了约 $870 billion 的机会。我们的卫星宽带服务 Starlink 定位于在多个庞大且快速扩张的市场中获取价值：

paras.en: - Consumer Broadband. As the digital economy continues to expand, ubiquitous, high-speed, reliable internet has become a structural necessity for households worldwide—powering opportunity and the next wave of global prosperity. According to Euromonitor, there were approximately 1.8 billion global households in 2025. As Starlink develops, we believe that our broadband network can connect, and improve the existing connection, of every household globally. Given varying economic conditions and consumer purchasing power across different countries, we use a different monthly ARPU for different parts of the world based on country-specific consumer broadband ARPU from Omdia as we seek to make our service affordable and accessible across different economic development contexts. Region-specific ARPU assumptions result in a weighted average of $31 monthly ARPU for residential broadband internet services globally, according to Omdia. This global average consists of a weighted average monthly ARPU of $43 in high-income markets, $16 in upper-middle income markets, and $9 in lower-middle income and low income markets per World Bank classification. Together this represents a total addressable market of $660 billion based on 1.8 billion households.
paras.zh: - Consumer Broadband。随着数字经济持续扩张，无处不在、高速、可靠的互联网已成为全球家庭的结构性必需品——推动机遇和下一波全球繁荣。根据 Euromonitor,2025 年全球约有 1.8 billion 户家庭。随着 Starlink 的发展，我们相信我们的宽带网络能够连接全球每一户家庭并改善其现有连接。鉴于不同国家的经济状况和消费者购买力各异，我们根据不同地区的国别消费者宽带 ARPU（Omdia 数据）采用不同的月度 ARPU，力求使我们的服务在不同经济发展背景下可负担、可及。根据 Omdia，区域特定的 ARPU 假设得出全球住宅宽带互联网服务的加权平均月度 ARPU 为 $31。该全球平均值由高收入市场的加权平均月度 ARPU $43、中高收入市场的 $16，以及根据世界银行分类的中低收入和低收入市场的 $9 构成。基于 1.8 billion 户家庭，这合计代表 $660 billion 的总可寻址市场。

paras.en: Approximately 40% of the global population lives in rural areas, remaining structurally underserved by terrestrial broadband infrastructure due to unfavorable deployment economics, limited network density and high last-mile costs.
paras.zh: 全球约 40% 的人口居住在农村地区，由于部署经济性不利、网络密度有限和最后一英里成本高昂，这些地区在地面宽带基础设施方面仍处于结构性服务不足状态。

paras.en: This structural imbalance creates a large, durable and relatively uncontested baseline market for satellite-based connectivity solutions. For many of these households, Starlink represents the first viable option for high-speed, low-latency internet access, with limited competition from terrestrial providers. Unlike terrestrial networks, which require significant incremental capital to extend coverage to low-density areas, our space-based architecture enables economically scalable service delivery across these regions with minimal marginal cost per additional user.
paras.zh: 这种结构性失衡为基于卫星的连接解决方案创造了一个庞大、持久且相对无竞争的基线市场。对其中许多家庭而言，Starlink 是首个可行的高速、低延迟互联网接入选择，来自地面提供商的竞争有限。与需要大量增量资本才能将覆盖延伸至低密度地区的地面网络不同，我们的天基架构能够以每新增用户极低的边际成本，在这些地区实现经济可扩展的服务交付。

paras.en: Importantly, while rural and underserved geographies provide a compelling initial adoption vector, we believe Starlink’s value proposition extends well beyond these markets. As network capacity increases and product performance continues to improve, we expect to compete increasingly in suburban and urban environments. Accordingly, while rural households represent a large and durable entry point for our connectivity offering, we view this segment as a foundational layer upon which significantly broader consumer, enterprise and government demand can be built.
paras.zh: 重要的是，尽管农村及服务不足地区提供了极具吸引力的初期采用切入点，但我们认为 Starlink 的价值主张远不止于这些市场。随着网络容量增加和产品性能持续提升，我们预计将在郊区和城市环境中日益展开竞争。因此，尽管农村家庭是我们连接服务的一个庞大且持久的切入点，但我们将该细分市场视为一个基础层，在此基础上可以构建显著更广泛的消费者、企业和政府需求。

paras.en: - Enterprise Solutions. We offer fixed site broadband solutions tailored for the needs of our enterprise customers across many different industries, including construction, agriculture, retail, telecom, hospitality and others. For the purpose of sizing market opportunity, we include small and medium sized businesses within our Enterprise Solutions market opportunity. Our Starlink enterprise offerings can provide important primary or back-up connectivity for every business in the geographies where we are licensed to operate. According to Grand View Research, the global business broadband market in 2025 across small to medium sized business and enterprise usage is estimated to be $200 billion.
paras.zh: - 企业解决方案。我们提供固定站点宽带解决方案，针对建筑、农业、零售、电信、酒店等多个不同行业企业客户的需求量身定制。为估算市场机会，我们将中小企业纳入我们的企业解决方案市场机会。在我们获准运营的地区，我们的 Starlink 企业产品可为每家企业提供重要的主用或备用连接。根据 Grand View Research 的数据，2025 年全球企业宽带市场中中小企业及大型企业使用的规模估计为$200 billion。

paras.en: - Government Solutions. Driven by increasing demand for resilient, low-latency, and highly secure communications in contested and remote environments, defense organizations and governments around the world are increasingly turning to commercial satellite providers with connectivity solutions to supplement and enhance traditional military networks. According to Novaspace, the global satellite communications market driven by defense and government demand in 2025 was $5 billion. The estimate of the government communications market includes only publicly disclosed programs and budgets and does not include classified missions or other restricted uses, which we believe represent additional sources of demand.
paras.zh: - 政府解决方案。受争议环境和偏远环境中对弹性、低延迟和高安全性通信日益增长的需求推动，世界各地的国防组织和政府正日益转向拥有连接解决方案的商业卫星提供商，以补充和增强传统军事网络。根据 Novaspace 的数据，2025 年由国防和政府需求驱动的全球卫星通信市场规模为$5 billion。政府通信市场的估算仅包括公开披露的项目和预算，不包括机密任务或其他受限用途，我们认为这些代表了额外的需求来源。

paras.en: Starlink Mobile. According to Omdia, as of December 31, 2025, there were eight billion mobile connected devices globally. We believe our Starlink Mobile offering will be able to provide continuous global coverage and substantially reduce mobile “dead zones,” which remain areas that are structurally underserved by the limitations of the networks of current mobile network operators. For example, according to the J.D. Power U.S. Wireless Network Quality Performance Study, U.S. wireless customers experienced service problems in approximately one out of every 11 mobile interactions, even in well-connected areas. In addition, an estimated 40% of the global population resided in rural areas in 2024 according to the World Bank, where terrestrial mobile coverage can be limited or unreliable. While we expect Starlink Mobile service today to be most impactful for customers in remote areas uncovered by terrestrial mobile networks, as our constellation grows and our product performance continues to improve, we will compete to be the preferred connectivity experience to our customers no matter where they are located, whether in rural, suburban, or urban areas. The next-generation of Starlink Mobile satellites, in combination with our recent purchase of wireless spectrum from EchoStar, is designed to provide high bandwidth and low latency connectivity directly to end user devices, enabling a connectivity solution on par with terrestrial mobile networks. Given varying economic conditions and consumer purchasing power across different countries, we assume a different monthly ARPU for different parts of the world as we seek to make our service affordable and accessible across different economic development contexts. Our region-specific ARPU assumptions result in a weighted average monthly mobile ARPU of $8 per user. This global average consists of a weighted average monthly ARPU of $18 in high-income markets, $5 in upper-middle income markets, $2 in lower-middle, and $2 in low income markets. Based on the total number of connected devices globally and the mobile ARPU, we estimate the Starlink Mobile market opportunity to be $740 billion. We expect to continue to partner with mobile network operators globally as we expand coverage and participate in the broader mobile connectivity market.
paras.zh: Starlink Mobile。根据 Omdia 的数据，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，全球移动联网设备数量为 80 亿台。我们相信，我们的 Starlink Mobile 产品将能够提供持续的全球覆盖，并大幅减少移动网络“盲区”，这些盲区由于现有移动网络运营商网络的局限性，在结构上始终得不到充分服务。例如，根据 J.D. Power 美国无线网络质量性能研究，美国无线用户大约每 11 次移动交互中就有一次遇到服务问题，即使在连接良好的地区也是如此。此外，根据世界银行的数据，2024 年全球估计有 40% 的人口居住在农村地区，而那里的地面移动覆盖可能有限或不可靠。尽管我们预计如今的 Starlink Mobile 服务对地面移动网络未覆盖的偏远地区客户影响最大，但随着我们的星座规模扩大和产品性能持续提升，我们将努力成为客户首选的连接体验，无论他们身处何地，无论是农村、郊区还是城市地区。下一代 Starlink Mobile 卫星，结合我们近期从 EchoStar 购买的无线频谱，旨在直接向终端用户设备提供高带宽、低时延的连接，从而实现与地面移动网络相当的连接解决方案。鉴于不同国家的经济状况和消费者购买力存在差异，我们为世界不同地区假设了不同的月度 ARPU，力求使我们的服务在不同经济发展背景下都负担得起、易于获取。我们按地区设定的 ARPU 假设得出的加权平均月度移动 ARPU 为每用户 $8。这一全球平均值由以下部分构成：高收入市场加权平均月度 ARPU 为 $18，中高收入市场为 $5，中低收入市场为 $2，低收入市场为 $2。基于全球联网设备总数和移动 ARPU，我们估计 Starlink Mobile 的市场机会为 $740 billion。随着我们扩大覆盖范围并参与更广泛的移动连接市场，我们预计将继续与全球移动网络运营商合作。

paras.en: Additional and Future Starlink Applications. We believe the long-term market opportunity for Starlink extends materially beyond traditional fixed broadband and satellite-to-mobile connectivity. Many of these use cases represent new categories of demand that were not previously addressable with legacy terrestrial or satellite solutions due to limitations in coverage, latency, capacity, or cost. While these additional and future use cases are early stage and not yet captured in conventional industry market definitions, we believe they have the potential to significantly expand the total addressable market for connectivity over time.
paras.zh: 其他及未来的 Starlink 应用。我们相信，Starlink 的长期市场机会将显著超越传统的固定宽带和卫星到移动连接。其中许多用例代表着新的需求类别，由于覆盖范围、时延、容量或成本方面的限制，这些需求此前无法通过传统地面或卫星解决方案得到满足。尽管这些其他及未来的用例尚处于早期阶段，且尚未被纳入常规行业市场定义，但我们相信，随着时间的推移，它们有潜力大幅扩大连接领域的可寻址市场总量。

paras.en: - Enterprise Mobility. Because our Starlink solutions are uniquely well-suited for in-motion environments, remote, or hard-to-serve locations, we are able to provide high-performance connectivity across land, air, and sea. We believe we have a differentiated right to win these verticals as existing connectivity solutions are not able to provide sufficient speed, latency and reliability, with frequent service outages driven by weather, orbital mechanics and coverage gaps. Our Starlink constellation directly addresses these deficiencies, creating a compelling path for us to capture a substantial share of opportunities and to unlock previously unattainable levels of service quality and customer willingness to pay.
paras.zh: - 企业移动业务。由于我们的 Starlink 解决方案特别适合移动环境、偏远或难以覆盖的地点，我们能够在陆地、空中和海上提供高性能连接。我们相信，我们拥有差异化的优势来赢得这些垂直领域，因为现有连接解决方案无法提供足够的速度、时延和可靠性，且因天气、轨道力学和覆盖缺口而频繁出现服务中断。我们的 Starlink 星座直接解决了这些缺陷，为我们开辟了一条极具吸引力的路径，以获取这些机会的相当大份额，并释放此前无法达到的服务质量水平和客户支付意愿。

paras.en: In land mobility, Starlink supports connectivity for vehicle fleets, including trucking, rail, public safety vehicles, and autonomous systems, enabling real-time telematics, route optimization, safety monitoring, and onboard passenger connectivity, as fleets become increasingly connected and data-driven.
paras.zh: 在陆地移动领域，Starlink 为车队提供连接支持，包括货运、铁路、公共安全车辆和自动驾驶系统，随着车队日益互联和数据驱动，实现实时远程信息处理、路线优化、安全监控和车载乘客连接。

paras.en: In aviation, Starlink delivers high-speed, low-latency in-flight connectivity for commercial airlines, business aviation, and government aircraft, supporting passenger broadband, operational communications, and real-time aircraft data transmission, as airlines increasingly prioritize differentiated onboard experiences and operational efficiency. There are approximately 23,900 commercial aircraft, according to Oliver Wyman, and approximately 24,500 privately owned aircraft, according to Corporate Jet Investor, in the world, which can be served by our aviation offering.
paras.zh: 在航空领域，Starlink 为商业航空公司、公务航空和政府飞机提供高速、低时延的机上连接，支持乘客宽带、运营通信和飞机实时数据传输，因为航空公司日益重视差异化的机上体验和运营效率。根据 Oliver Wyman 的数据，全球约有 23,900 架商用飞机，根据 Corporate Jet Investor 的数据，全球约有 24,500 架私人飞机，这些均可由我们的航空产品提供服务。

paras.en: In maritime, Starlink provides connectivity for commercial shipping, offshore energy platforms, cruise lines, and government vessels, enabling crew welfare, operational optimization, safety systems, and real-time data transfer, as connectivity becomes a standard requirement across global fleets. Our potential customer base as of 2025 consists of approximately 99,000 commercial merchant ships, defined as being 100 gross tons or more, approximately 21,000 fishing vessels, and approximately 4,000 cruise ships and private yachts, according to Marine Traffic Dashboard.
paras.zh: 在海事领域，Starlink 为商业航运、海上能源平台、邮轮公司和政府船舶提供连接，随着连接成为全球船队的标准要求，实现船员福利、运营优化、安全系统和实时数据传输。根据 Marine Traffic Dashboard 的数据，截至 2025 年，我们的潜在客户群包括约 99,000 艘商业商船（定义为 100 总吨及以上）、约 21,000 艘渔船以及约 4,000 艘邮轮和私人游艇。

paras.en: - Expanded Enterprise and Government Applications
paras.zh: - 扩展的企业和政府应用

paras.en: Enterprise Back-Up and Failover Connectivity. As connectivity becomes a mission critical component of enterprise operations, we believe back-up and failover connectivity is evolving into a foundational layer of enterprise infrastructure. The increasing cost of downtime, combined with the proliferation of cloud-based and latency-sensitive applications, is driving enterprises to prioritize uptime, business continuity, and network resilience and adopt multi-layered connectivity architectures. We believe this shift will result in a meaningful expansion of the connectivity market.
paras.zh: 企业备份和故障切换连接。随着连接成为企业运营的关键任务组成部分，我们相信备份和故障切换连接正演变为企业基础设施的基础层。停机成本的不断增加，加上基于云和对时延敏感的应用的激增，正推动企业优先考虑正常运行时间、业务连续性和网络韧性，并采用多层连接架构。我们相信这一转变将带来连接市场的显著扩张。

paras.en: Expanded Government Applications. We believe traditional connectivity market estimates do not fully capture the scope of government-related demand, particularly in mission-critical and classified applications. The growing importance of secure communications, real-time intelligence, and resilient network architectures is driving sustained investment in connectivity capabilities across defense and civilian agencies. These use cases tend to command higher value and longer-duration contracts, contributing to a meaningful and durable expansion of the connectivity market.
paras.zh: 政府应用领域的扩展。我们认为，传统连接市场的估算并未充分反映政府相关需求的规模，尤其是在任务关键型和涉密应用中。安全通信、实时情报和弹性网络架构的重要性日益上升，正推动国防和民用机构对连接能力进行持续投资。这类用例往往对应更高价值和更长期限的合同，从而推动连接市场实现显著且持久的扩张。

paras.en: Smart Device Connectivity. The proliferation of connected devices across various physical environments— including sensors, wearables, vehicles, appliances, and infrastructure systems—is driving increasing demand for ubiquitous, reliable, and low-latency connectivity. As of 2025, there were approximately 22 billion IoT connected devices globally, forecasted to reach 47 billion by 2031. As billion s of connected devices generate, transmit, and act on data, connectivity becomes an essential enabler of new categories of economic activity. As these devices grow in scale into the tens of billion s globally and become more intelligent and data-intensive, we believe the scope of the connectivity market will expand significantly beyond traditional human-centric usage.
paras.zh: 智能设备连接。联网设备在各种物理环境中的普及——包括传感器、可穿戴设备、车辆、家电和基础设施系统——正推动对无处不在、可靠且低延迟连接的需求不断增长。截至 2025 年，全球约有 22 billion 台物联网联网设备，预计到 2031 年将达到 47 billion 台。随着数十亿联网设备生成、传输数据并据此采取行动，连接成为新一类经济活动的关键使能要素。随着这些设备的规模在全球范围内增长至数百亿台，并变得更加智能和数据密集，我们认为连接市场的范围将显著扩展，超越传统以人为中心的使用场景。

paras.en: In-Orbit Data Transport. We operate a large constellation of over 23,000 inter-satellite lasers that create a dynamic mesh network in space and enable traffic rerouting through orbit. We believe this laser mesh network will help us unlock a new connectivity market by enabling third-party satellites to utilize our in-orbit data transport layer. While most of our laser mesh network capacity is used to power our Starlink services, we selectively monetize excess capacity through our Plaser program. We allow third parties to purchase our space laser hardware and connect their satellites to our Starlink network, allowing them to offload data to a ground station anywhere on Earth while bypassing the need to build their own relay architecture or ground stations. As satellite constellations grow, we expect market demand for high-throughput, low-latency data relay to increase across commercial and government operators. While this market remains nascent, we believe the opportunity represents a meaningful expansion beyond traditional satellite connectivity TAM.
paras.zh: 在轨数据传输。我们运营着由超过 23,000 条星间激光组成的大型星座，在太空中构建动态网状网络，并支持通过轨道进行流量重路由。我们认为，这一激光网状网络将帮助我们开辟新的连接市场，使第三方卫星能够利用我们的在轨数据传输层。虽然我们激光网状网络的大部分容量用于支持 Starlink 服务，但我们通过 Plaser 计划有选择地将富余容量变现。我们允许第三方购买我们的太空激光硬件，并将其卫星接入我们的 Starlink 网络，使其能够将数据卸载至地球上任何位置的地面站，同时无需自建中继架构或地面站。随着卫星星座不断增长，我们预计商业和政府运营商对高吞吐量、低延迟数据中继的市场需求将增加。尽管这一市场仍处于早期阶段，但我们认为该机会代表着对传统卫星连接 TAM 的显著扩展。

paras.en: #### Artificial Intelligence
paras.zh: #### 人工智能

paras.en: The market for artificial intelligence is currently undergoing explosive structural growth, emerging as a foundational utility for the modern global economy and unlocking a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity. Our frontier models, consumer and enterprise applications, and AI infrastructure solutions are strategically positioned to capture value across four key components of this vast ecosystem, resulting in an estimated total market opportunity of $26.5 trillion.
paras.zh: 人工智能市场目前正经历爆炸性的结构性增长，正在成为现代全球经济的基础性公用事业，并释放出数万亿美元的机会。我们的前沿模型、消费者和企业应用以及 AI 基础设施解决方案在战略上定位于在这一庞大生态系统的四个关键组成部分中获取价值，从而形成估计为 $26.5 trillion 的总市场机会。

paras.en: AI Infrastructure. According to RAND Corporation, global data center compute demand is estimated to be 235 gigawatts in 2030, of which 70% is estimated to be utilized for AI workloads. Assuming a target Power Usage Effectiveness of 1.2 and an all-in chip power consumption per GPU of 1.3 kilowatts per GPU—that of an H100 SXM— this AI workload demand corresponds to 104 million GPUs required. We apply an 80% utilization rate per the National Electrical Installation Standards and a GPU rental rate of $3.33 per hour, according to Silicon Data, which is based on the median of neocloud GPU rental rates in 2025; we note that the rental rate has historically varied subject to market conditions. As a result, we estimate the AI compute infrastructure market opportunity to be approximately $2.4 trillion.
paras.zh: AI 基础设施。根据 RAND Corporation 的数据，2030 年全球数据中心算力需求估计为 235 吉瓦，其中估计有 70% 用于 AI 工作负载。假设目标电能利用效率（PUE）为 1.2，且每块 GPU 的全包芯片功耗为每块 GPU 1.3 千瓦——即 H100 SXM 的功耗水平——则该 AI 工作负载需求对应需要 104 百万块 GPU。我们根据 National Electrical Installation Standards 采用 80% 的利用率，并采用每小时 $3.33 的 GPU 租赁费率，该费率来自 Silicon Data，基于 2025 年 neocloud GPU 租赁费率的中位数；我们注意到，该租赁费率历来会随市场状况而变化。因此，我们估计 AI 算力基础设施的市场机会约为 $2.4 万亿。

paras.en: Consumer Subscriptions. As demand for AI solutions surges, fueled by widespread adoption of AI tools that enhance productivity, creativity, personalization, and real-time assistance in everyday life, consumers are increasingly turning to subscription-based access to high-performance AI platforms. These platforms, equipped with advanced reasoning, seamless real-time data integration, and multimodal capabilities, are essential in today’s ever-more receptive and interconnected world. We believe SpaceX is well positioned to address this opportunity through our X and Grok platforms by delivering a differentiated product centered on truth-seeking and real-time relevance. Our roadmap for future models contains multi-trillion parameter models, which could represent a step change in reasoning depth and overall intelligence. Through Grok’s integration with X and proprietary access to real-time data inflows, we believe we can better address a broader set of high-frequency, high-value consumer use cases and increase user engagement and willingness to pay, positioning Grok to capture a larger share of the consumer AI subscription market relative to standalone, non-integrated offerings. We estimate our market opportunity based on the global population of individuals aged 10 and over in 2025—approximately five and a half billion according to Euromonitor—multiplied by the weighted average monthly subscription revenue of $12, resulting in an annualized market opportunity of approximately $760 billion. Our weighted average monthly revenue assumes different monthly subscription fees across different geographies around the world. We assume $30 monthly cost of a SuperGrok subscription in high-income countries, $8 monthly cost in upper-middle and lower-middle income countries, and significantly lower monthly cost in low income countries, as defined by the World Bank.
paras.zh: 消费者订阅。随着 AI 解决方案需求激增，其推动力来自 AI 工具的广泛采用——这些工具在日常生活中提升生产力、创造力、个性化及实时协助——消费者正日益转向基于订阅的方式获取高性能 AI 平台。这些平台具备高级推理、无缝实时数据集成和多模态能力，在当今愈发乐于接受且互联互通的世界中不可或缺。我们相信，SpaceX 通过我们的 X 和 Grok 平台，能够以围绕求真和实时相关性打造的差异化产品，很好地把握这一机会。我们未来模型路线图包含数万亿参数模型，这可能代表推理深度和整体智能的阶跃式变化。通过 Grok 与 X 的整合以及对实时数据流入的专有访问权限，我们相信能够更好地覆盖更广泛的高频、高价值消费者用例，并提升用户参与度和付费意愿，使 Grok 相对于独立的、非整合型产品，能够占据消费者 AI 订阅市场的更大份额。我们基于 2025 年全球 10 岁及以上人口——根据 Euromonitor 约为五十五亿——乘以 $12 的加权平均月度订阅收入，估算我们的市场机会，得出年化市场机会约为 $760 十亿。我们的加权平均月度收入假设了全球不同地区不同的月度订阅费用。我们假设在高收入国家 SuperGrok 订阅的月度成本为 $30，在中高收入和中低收入国家月度成本为 $8，而在世界银行定义的低收入国家月度成本则显著更低。

paras.en: Digital Advertising. Digital advertising represents a large and growing global market opportunity as businesses increase marketing budgets towards digital platforms that enable targeted advertising, measurable performance, and direct engagement with consumers. In 2025, global digital advertising spending totaled $600 billion according to S&P Global Market Intelligence. We believe that X’s ability to combine large-scale user engagement, real-time content, and advanced AI-driven performance marketing tools positions us well to participate in this significant market opportunity.
paras.zh: 数字广告。随着企业将营销预算更多地投向能够实现定向广告、可衡量效果以及与消费者直接互动的数字平台，数字广告代表着规模庞大且不断增长的全球市场机遇。根据 S&P Global Market Intelligence 的数据，2025 年全球数字广告支出总额达 $600 billion。我们相信，X 能够将大规模用户互动、实时内容与先进的 AI 驱动效果营销工具相结合，这使我们处于有利地位，得以把握这一重大市场机遇。

paras.en: Enterprise Applications. AI is revolutionizing enterprise applications as organizations across industries increasingly adopt AI solutions to automate complex workflows, augment knowledge workers, enhance decision-making, redefine productivity, and improve operational efficiency. Specifically, we believe that our enterprise applications, including Macrohard, agentic AI, will increasingly support knowledge workers across industries by automating routine cognitive tasks, assisting with research and analysis, generating content and code, and refining decision-making processes. Ultimately, we believe this transformation could evolve knowledge workers into empowered managers of autonomous agents, unlocking unprecedented levels of creativity and productivity.
paras.zh: 企业应用。AI 正在革新企业应用，各行业组织日益采用 AI 解决方案，以自动化复杂工作流程、增强知识工作者的能力、提升决策水平、重新定义生产力并提高运营效率。具体而言，我们相信，我们的企业应用（包括 Macrohard、agentic AI）将日益通过自动化常规认知任务、协助研究与分析、生成内容与代码以及优化决策流程，为各行业的知识工作者提供支持。最终，我们相信这一转型可能使知识工作者演变为自主智能体的赋能型管理者，释放前所未有的创造力与生产力。

paras.en: We believe we are still in the early days of AI transforming enterprises, with AI-powered enterprise applications poised to reshape the digital economy. The Digital Cooperation Organization (“DCO”) defines the digital economy as economic activity reliant on, significantly enhanced, or enabled by digital technologies and their applications, including the following products and services: AI and advanced analytics, blockchain and decentralized technologies, cloud services, digital connectivity, digital devices and the IoT, encryption and cybersecurity, immersive technologies, and robotics and autonomous systems. DCO estimates that the digital economy will grow three times faster in 2026 on a year-over-year basis compared to the estimated growth of the global GDP, reaching approximately $22.7 trillion in 2026. In a survey of CTOs, senior technologists, policymakers, and digital economy experts, also conducted by DCO, AI and advanced analytics were identified by 69% of respondents as their top digital technology priority—higher than any other surveyed priority. We believe that our enterprise strategy, which is focused on serving the digital needs of the world’s largest industries with AI solutions, positions us competitively to pursue this rapidly growing opportunity.
paras.zh: 我们相信，AI 变革企业仍处于早期阶段，AI 驱动的企业应用有望重塑数字经济。数字合作组织（“DCO”）将数字经济定义为依赖数字技术及其应用、或由其显著增强或赋能的经济活动，包括以下产品和服务：AI 与高级分析、区块链与去中心化技术、云服务、数字连接、数字设备与物联网、加密与网络安全、沉浸式技术，以及机器人与自主系统。DCO 估计，2026 年数字经济按年同比增速将达到全球 GDP 估计增速的三倍，2026 年规模将达到约 $22.7 trillion。在 DCO 同样开展的一项针对 CTO、资深技术专家、政策制定者和数字经济专家的调查中，69% 的受访者将 AI 与高级分析列为他们的首要数字技术优先事项——高于任何其他受访优先事项。我们相信，我们的企业战略聚焦于以 AI 解决方案服务全球最大行业的数字需求，这使我们在把握这一快速增长机遇方面具备竞争优势。

paras.en: #### Future Markets
paras.zh: #### 未来市场

paras.en: Beyond the established markets reflected in our TAM, we envision that ongoing advancements in our technology and infrastructure will unlock entirely new markets over time. As launch costs decline, satellite capabilities advance, and large-scale compute infrastructure expands, innovative applications and new markets may emerge that harness our integrated infrastructure across space, connectivity, and AI. Although these prospects remain nascent, with uncertain timing and scale—and thus are excluded from our quantified total addressable market estimates—we believe they hold trillions of dollars of eventual potential for groundbreaking innovation and value creation, eventually representing multi-trillion-dollar economic opportunities.
paras.zh: 在我们 TAM 所反映的既有市场之外，我们设想，随着我们技术和基础设施的持续进步，将随时间推移开辟全新的市场。随着发射成本下降、卫星能力提升以及大规模算力基础设施扩张，可能会出现创新应用和新市场，利用我们在太空、连接和 AI 领域的整合基础设施。尽管这些前景仍处于早期阶段，时间与规模均不确定——因此未纳入我们量化的总可寻址市场估算——但我们相信，它们蕴含着数万亿美元的最终潜力，可带来突破性创新与价值创造，最终将代表数万亿美元的经济机遇。

paras.en: Long-Haul Point-to-Point Terrestrial Travel. Our Starship vehicle has the potential to revolutionize terrestrial commercial transportation by achieving an unparalleled combination of speed, reliability and cost efficiency. This capability could reduce most international long-haul flights to under 30 minutes, enabling point-to-point travel to the furthest location in an hour or less. While we must surmount technological, economic and regulatory obstacles to fully capitalize on this opportunity—such as restrictions on supersonic flights over land in certain regions due to sonic booms, and the economic feasibility of shorter routes—we believe we are strategically positioned to take share of the terrestrial logistics and transportation market.
paras.zh: 长途点对点地面旅行。我们的 Starship 运载工具凭借速度、可靠性和成本效率的无可比拟组合，有潜力彻底改变地面商业运输。这一能力可将大多数国际长途航班缩短至 30 分钟以内，实现一小时内或更短时间抵达最远目的地的点对点旅行。尽管我们必须克服技术、经济和监管障碍才能充分把握这一机遇——例如某些地区因音爆而对陆地上空超音速飞行的限制，以及较短航线的经济可行性——但我们相信，我们在战略上处于有利位置，能够抢占地面物流与运输市场的份额。

paras.en: Space Tourism. Historically, human spaceflight has been limited to government astronauts, augmented by a limited number of privately funded missions. Yet, with meaningful advances in space technology and the ongoing expansion of orbital flight infrastructure, we anticipate a gradual increase in accessibility of spaceflight over time, potentially enabling a new category of commercial human spaceflight and tourism. Under 30 people out of the global population visited Earth’s orbit in 2025, which we believe could be a far greater number in the future.
paras.zh: 太空旅游。历史上，载人航天一直局限于政府宇航员，辅以数量有限的私人资助任务。然而，随着太空技术的实质性进步和轨道飞行基础设施的持续扩张，我们预计太空飞行的可及性将随时间逐步提高，有可能催生商业载人航天与旅游的新类别。2025 年全球人口中不到 30 人访问了地球轨道，我们相信未来这一数字可能远高于此。

paras.en: Passenger and Cargo Transport to the Moon and Mars. Looking further ahead, advances in reusable launch systems and deep-space transportation infrastructure may enable new forms of interplanetary logistics, including passenger and cargo transportation to the Moon and Mars. Supporting a sustained human presence on another planet would require the regular transport of people, equipment, and materials at a scale not previously possible.
paras.zh: 前往月球和火星的客运与货运。放眼更远的未来，可重复使用发射系统和深空运输基础设施的进步可能催生新的星际物流形式，包括前往月球和火星的客运与货运。要在另一颗行星上维持持续的人类存在，需要以前所未有的规模定期运输人员、设备和物资。

paras.en: Energy Production and Manufacturing on the Moon and Mars. Establishing a sustained human and industrial presence on the Moon and Mars would require reliable, large-scale energy generation to support habitats, manufacturing, and scientific operations. Potential solutions could include solar power systems, taking advantage of the thin atmosphere, constant solar exposure, and other advanced energy technologies designed to operate in the unique environmental conditions of the Moon and Mars. Over time, we believe that advances in planetary infrastructure may enable manufacturing on the Moon and Mars using locally available resources.
paras.zh: 月球和火星上的能源生产与制造。要在月球和火星上建立持续的人类与工业存在，需要可靠的大规模能源发电来支持居住舱、制造和科学作业。潜在解决方案可能包括太阳能系统，利用稀薄大气、持续日照以及其他专为月球和火星独特环境条件运行而设计的先进能源技术。随着时间推移，我们相信行星基础设施的进步可能使利用当地可用资源在月球和火星上进行制造成为可能。

paras.en: In-Orbit Manufacturing. Terrestrial manufacturing is inherently constrained by gravity, which imposes fundamental limitations on processes at the atomic and molecular level. Establishing in-orbit infrastructure unlocks large-scale, high-value production free from those traditional barriers, enabling breakthroughs in precision and efficiency. The microgravity environment of space fosters innovative advancements in key industries, such as pharmaceuticals—where it enhances drug solubility, purity, crystallization, and stability—as well as, advanced materials and semiconductors, allowing for superior crystal formation and material properties unattainable on Earth. Beyond these particle-level innovations, in-orbit facilities overcome Earth’s energy constraints by harnessing abundant, uninterrupted solar power, facilitating energy-intensive operations with unparalleled sustainability.
paras.zh: 在轨制造。地面制造本质上受制于重力，而重力对原子和分子层面的工艺施加了根本性限制。建立在轨基础设施可释放大规模、高价值的生产能力，摆脱这些传统障碍，从而在精度和效率方面实现突破。太空的微重力环境推动关键行业的创新进步，例如制药业——微重力可提升药物的溶解度、纯度、结晶度和稳定性——以及先进材料和半导体，实现地球上无法达到的优异晶体形成和材料特性。除这些粒子层面的创新外，在轨设施通过利用丰富且不间断的太阳能克服地球的能源约束，以无与伦比的可持续性支持能源密集型作业。

paras.en: Asteroid Mining. Asteroid resources, including platinum-group metals, rare earth elements, nickel, cobalt, iron and water, represent a vast untapped reservoir beyond Earth’s gravity well, with some near-Earth objects containing concentrations of elements far exceeding typical terrestrial ore grades. With meaningful advances in reusable launch capabilities, autonomous robotics, and in-situ processing technologies, we believe the accessibility of asteroid resources will expand over time, unlocking a new category of commercial space resource extraction. We believe our experience in launch systems, spacecraft development, and space infrastructure uniquely positions us to pursue asteroid mining operations to extract metals and other critical resources from near-Earth and main-belt asteroids, providing abundant raw materials for space-based infrastructure, reducing the need to launch all mass from Earth.
paras.zh: 小行星采矿。小行星资源，包括铂族金属、稀土元素、镍、钴、铁和水，代表着地球重力井之外一个巨大的未开发资源库，部分近地天体所含的元素浓度远超典型的地面矿石品位。随着可重复使用运载能力、自主机器人和原位处理技术取得实质性进展，我们相信小行星资源的可及性将随时间不断扩大，开辟商业太空资源开采的新类别。我们相信，我们在运载系统、航天器开发和太空基础设施方面的经验使我们具备独特优势，能够开展小行星采矿作业，从近地小行星和主带小行星中提取金属和其他关键资源，为天基基础设施提供丰富的原材料，减少从地球发射全部质量的需求。

full.secZh: 我们的解决方案与服务

paras.en: #### Unparalleled Launch Capability
paras.zh: #### 无与伦比的发射能力

paras.en: Our unmatched launch capability is the foundational competitive advantage that enables our unique solutions and services. We are the market leader in orbital launch, providing low-cost, reliable, and frequent access to space for commercial and government customers. Our launch services are built around a fleet of reusable rockets and spacecraft. SpaceX’s family of rocket systems and spacecraft address missions ranging from routine cargo delivery to the International Space Station to deep-space exploration. The Falcon class of rockets delivered over 80% of mass to orbit in the year ending December 31, 2025. Starship, a two-stage super heavy-lift launch vehicle that we have been flight testing since 2023, further enhances our industry-defining launch offerings.
paras.zh: 我们无可匹敌的发射能力是使我们独特解决方案和服务得以实现的基础性竞争优势。我们是轨道发射领域的市场领导者，为商业和政府客户提供低成本、可靠且高频的太空进入服务。我们的发射服务围绕一支可重复使用火箭与航天器机队构建。SpaceX 的火箭系统与航天器系列可满足从国际空间站常规货运到深空探索的各类任务需求。在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的年度内，Falcon 系列火箭运送至轨道的质量占比超过 80%。Starship 是一款两级超重型运载火箭，我们自 2023 年起持续对其进行飞行测试，它进一步增强了我们行业标杆性的发射产品。

paras.en: Separate from our fleet of reusable rockets, SpaceX’s launch advantage is equally underpinned by our fleet of advanced spacecraft. Our International Space Station cargo and human spaceflight missions are launched on Falcon 9 and flown on the Dragon crew and cargo spacecraft. The vehicles autonomously dock to the station, delivering pressurized and unpressurized cargo, and passengers. Both Dragon variants are partially reusable and perform fully autonomous rendezvous, docking, and return operations.
paras.zh: 除可重复使用火箭机队之外，SpaceX 的发射优势同样依托于我们先进的航天器机队。我们的国际空间站货运与载人航天任务由 Falcon 9 发射，并由 Dragon 载人及货运航天器执行飞行。这些航天器自主对接空间站，运送加压与非加压货物及乘员。两款 Dragon 型号均为部分可重复使用，并可执行全自主的交会、对接与返回操作。

paras.en: #### Our Fleet of Launch Vehicles and Spacecraft
paras.zh: #### 我们的运载火箭与航天器机队

paras.en: Our Fleet of Launch Vehicles
paras.zh: 我们的运载火箭机队

paras.en: Falcon 9. The Falcon 9 rocket is a reusable, two-stage rocket designed and manufactured by SpaceX for the safe, reliable, and cost-effective transport of satellites, scientific payloads, cargo, and crew to Earth orbit and beyond. Powered by liquid oxygen and rocket-grade kerosene, the first-stage is equipped with nine Merlin 1D engines producing over 1.7 million pounds of thrust at sea level, while the second stage utilizes a single vacuum-optimized Merlin engine for precise orbital insertion. First launched in 2010, Falcon 9 is the world’s first orbital-class rapidly reusable rocket, and has become the most active orbital launch vehicle today, with approximately 620 orbital space launches as of March 31, 2026 and an over 99% mission success rate. Falcon 9 is capable of delivering approximately 23 metric tons to LEO and eight metric tons to geosynchronous transfer orbit. Reusability allows SpaceX to refly the most expensive parts of the rocket, which in turn drives down the cost of space access. Falcon 9’s reusable components primarily include its booster, which lands on one of our autonomous drone ships out on the ocean or on one of our landing zones near our launch pads ahead of being refurbished for a future launch, and its payload fairing halves, which are recovered via parachute-assisted splashdowns and are refurbished and reused after retrieval. The second stage is not designed for recovery or reuse and instead safely deorbits after successful payload deployment.
paras.zh: Falcon 9。Falcon 9 火箭是由 SpaceX 设计并制造的可重复使用两级火箭，用于安全、可靠且经济高效地将卫星、科学载荷、货物及乘员运送至地球轨道及更远区域。该火箭以液氧和火箭级煤油为动力，第一级配备九台 Merlin 1D 发动机，在海平面产生超过 1.7 百万磅推力，第二级则采用单台真空优化 Merlin 发动机以实现精确入轨。Falcon 9 于 2010 年首飞，是全球首款轨道级快速可重复使用火箭，如今已成为当今发射活动最频繁的轨道运载火箭，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日已完成约 620 次轨道太空发射，任务成功率超过 99%。Falcon 9 可将约 23 公吨载荷运送至 LEO，将八公吨载荷运送至地球同步转移轨道。可重复使用性使 SpaceX 能够再次飞行火箭中成本最高的部件，从而降低太空进入成本。Falcon 9 的可重复使用部件主要包括其助推器——该助推器在完成翻新以供未来发射之前，会降落于我们位于海上的自主无人船之一或发射台附近的着陆区之一——以及其有效载荷整流罩两半，后者通过降落伞辅助溅落回收，并在打捞后经翻新和重复使用。第二级并非为回收或重复使用而设计，而是在成功部署有效载荷后安全离轨。

paras.en: Falcon 9 Overview
paras.zh: Falcon 9 概览

paras.en: Falcon 9 introduced a combination of technical innovation, cost reduction, and operational scale that materially altered the economics of orbital launch and established our position as the leading commercial launch provider.
paras.zh: Falcon 9 融合了技术创新、成本降低与运营规模，实质性改变了轨道发射的经济性，并确立了我们的领先商业发射提供商地位。

paras.en: - First Orbital-Class Rapidly Reusable Rocket: In December 2015, Falcon 9 achieved the first vertical landing of an orbital-class booster, followed in April 2016 by the first autonomous drone ship landing in the Atlantic Ocean. Reuse of boosters and fairings, a practice pioneered by SpaceX in the launch industry, fundamentally enables our launch rate and capacity and forms the basis for the launch system’s inherent reliability. Through recovering, inspecting, and evaluating flown hardware, SpaceX gains insight into system performance that would not be otherwise achievable. Partial reusability for orbital spaceflight has reduced cost per ton to orbit by approximately 85% as compared to the historical average launch cost per kilogram of $18,500.
paras.zh: - 首枚轨道级快速可重复使用火箭：2015 年 12 月，Falcon 9 实现了轨道级助推器的首次垂直着陆，随后于 2016 年 4 月实现了大西洋上首次自主无人船着陆。助推器和整流罩的重复使用——这一由 SpaceX 在发射行业开创的做法——从根本上支撑了我们的发射频率和运力，并构成了发射系统固有可靠性的基础。通过回收、检查和评估已飞行硬件，SpaceX 得以深入了解系统性能，这是其他方式无法实现的。轨道航天飞行的部分可重复使用已将每吨入轨成本较每公斤 $18,500 的历史平均发射成本降低约 85%。

paras.en: - Reusability Enabled Cost Structure Advantage: Reuse of the first-stage—representing the majority of vehicle manufacturing cost—has materially reduced marginal launch costs relative to fully expendable systems.
paras.zh: - 可重复使用带来的成本结构优势：第一级——占飞行器制造成本的大部分——的重复使用，相对于完全一次性使用的系统大幅降低了边际发射成本。

paras.en: - Highest Operational Tempo in History: With approximately 620 orbital space launches over 15 years of operation, Falcon 9 is the most frequently flown active orbital launch vehicle to date. In 2025, Falcon 9 conducted 165 launches, accounting for over half of all global orbital launches in the year while delivering over 80% of mass to orbit.
paras.zh: - 史上最高运营频次：在 15 年的运营中完成约 620 次轨道太空发射，Falcon 9 是迄今为止飞行最频繁的现役轨道运载火箭。2025 年，Falcon 9 完成了 165 次发射，占当年全球所有轨道发射的一半以上，同时将超过 80% 的质量送入轨道。

paras.en: - Track Record of Success: As of March 31, 2026, Falcon 9 has achieved an over 99% mission success rate. Falcon 9 has achieved over 570 successful booster landings and more than 540 launches completed by a flight-proven Falcon rocket, underscoring the reliability of its reusability architecture.
paras.zh: - 成功记录：截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，Falcon 9 的任务成功率超过 99%。Falcon 9 已实现超过 570 次助推器成功着陆，并有超过 540 次发射由经过飞行验证的 Falcon 火箭完成，凸显了其可重复使用架构的可靠性。

paras.en: - Human Spaceflight Certified: Falcon 9, paired with SpaceX’s Dragon crew spacecraft, is the only U.S.-based launch vehicle certified by NASA under the Commercial Crew Program to transport astronauts to and from the International Space Station. As of December 31, 2025, Falcon 9 has successfully launched 19 human spaceflight missions with a 100% mission success rate.
paras.zh: - 载人航天认证：Falcon 9 与 SpaceX 的 Dragon 载人飞船搭配，是唯一获得 NASA 商业载人计划认证、可往返国际空间站运送宇航员的美国发射载具。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Falcon 9 已成功执行 19 次载人航天任务，任务成功率达 100%。

paras.en: - In-House Engine Development and Manufacturing: Falcon 9 is powered by Merlin engines that are designed, developed, and manufactured in‑house, providing vertical integration across propulsion design, production, and testing. The Merlin engine achieves one of the highest thrust‑to‑weight ratios of any rocket engine in operational service, contributing to Falcon 9’s performance and payload capacity.
paras.zh: - 内部发动机研发与制造：Falcon 9 由 Merlin 发动机提供动力，该发动机的设计、开发和制造均在内部完成，实现了推进系统设计、生产和测试的垂直整合。Merlin 发动机在现役火箭发动机中拥有最高的推重比之一，为 Falcon 9 的性能和有效载荷能力做出了贡献。

paras.en: Falcon 9
paras.zh: Falcon 9

paras.en: As we transition primary production and development resources toward the fully and rapidly reusable Starship system, Falcon 9 continues to serve as the backbone of our launch revenue base; generating high-margin recurring cash flows while providing critical operational experience in high-cadence reuse. The proven capabilities of Falcon 9 established us as the leading provider of launch services globally and laid the technological and economic foundation for the next era of space transportation.
paras.zh: 随着我们将主要生产和开发资源转向完全且快速可重复使用的 Starship 系统，Falcon 9 继续作为我们发射收入基础的支柱；产生高利润率的经常性现金流，同时在高频次重复使用方面提供关键的运营经验。Falcon 9 经过验证的能力确立了我们在全球发射服务领域的领先供应商地位，并为下一代太空运输奠定了技术和经济基础。

paras.en: Falcon Heavy. Falcon Heavy is a partially reusable super heavy-lift launch vehicle, designed to deliver large payloads to orbit. Building on the proven architecture of the Falcon 9 rocket, Falcon Heavy is composed of three reusable Falcon 9 nine-engine boosters whose combined 27 Merlin engines generate more than five million pounds of thrust at liftoff—one of the most powerful operational rockets in the world today. It is capable of carrying approximately 64 metric tons of payload to LEO and 27 metric tons to geosynchronous transfer orbit. Falcon Heavy’s reusable components primarily include its three boosters, which are designed to land vertically on drone ships in the ocean and landing zones near our launch sites, and its payload-faring halves, which are recovered via parachute-assisted splashdown and are refurbished and reused after retrieval. The second stage is not designed for recovery or reuse and is designed to safely deorbit after successful payload deployment, similar to Falcon 9.
paras.zh: Falcon Heavy。Falcon Heavy 是一种部分可重复使用的超重型运载火箭，旨在将大型有效载荷送入轨道。Falcon Heavy 基于 Falcon 9 火箭经过验证的架构，由三个可重复使用的 Falcon 9 九发动机助推器组成，其合计 27 台 Merlin 发动机在起飞时产生超过五百万磅的推力——是当今世界上推力最大的现役火箭之一。它能够将约 64 公吨的有效载荷送入 LEO，将 27 公吨的有效载荷送入地球同步转移轨道。Falcon Heavy 的可重复使用部件主要包括其三个助推器（设计为垂直降落在海上无人船和我们发射场附近的着陆区）及其有效载荷整流罩两半（通过降落伞辅助溅落回收，并在打捞后经翻新和重复使用）。第二级不设计为可回收或可重复使用，其设计是在成功部署有效载荷后安全离轨，与 Falcon 9 类似。

paras.en: Falcon Heavy Overview
paras.zh: Falcon Heavy 概览

paras.en: - Reusability: Falcon Heavy incorporates a design focused on reusability, which has contributed to lowering the cost of access to space and altering the launch industry’s economic model for large or high-value payloads. The vehicle’s two side boosters, equipped with hypersonic grid fins and advanced propulsion systems, enable controlled recovery and soft landings. This capability enables reusability, with missions launching on flight-proven boosters generally priced below those of traditional expendable flights. Our Falcon 9 boosters, which are qualified for up to 40 flights, are also used on Falcon Heavy, with an average of 6 flights per booster on Falcon Heavy. Although our Falcon 9 boosters have been engineered and demonstrated to support up to 40 flights, we have established a maximum accounting useful life of 25 flights as an estimate based on forecasted utilization. This estimate reflects: (i) our strategic transition to Starship, which is expected to materially reduce future Falcon 9 flight demand; and (ii) restrictions under certain government contracts that prohibit the use of boosters flown more than five times on their missions. These useful life estimates are periodically reassessed based on engineering qualification data, post-flight inspections, recovery success rates, actual fleet performance, cost sensitivity analyses, and the long-range launch manifest.
paras.zh: - 可重复使用性：Falcon Heavy 采用了以可重复使用为重点的设计，这有助于降低进入太空的成本，并改变了发射行业针对大型或高价值有效载荷的经济模式。该运载器的两个侧助推器配备高超声速栅格翼和先进推进系统，可实现受控回收和软着陆。这一能力实现了可重复使用，使用经过飞行验证的助推器执行的任务定价通常低于传统一次性飞行。我们的 Falcon 9 助推器具备最多 40 次飞行的资格，也用于 Falcon Heavy，在 Falcon Heavy 上每个助推器平均飞行 6 次。尽管我们的 Falcon 9 助推器经过工程设计并已证明可支持最多 40 次飞行，但我们基于预测利用率将最大会计使用寿命设定为 25 次飞行作为估计。该估计反映了：(i) 我们向 Starship 的战略转型，预计将实质性减少未来的 Falcon 9 飞行需求；以及 (ii) 某些政府合同下的限制，禁止在其任务中使用飞行超过五次的助推器。这些使用寿命估计会根据工程鉴定数据、飞行后检查、回收成功率、实际机队性能、成本敏感性分析和长期发射计划定期重新评估。

paras.en: Falcon Heavy
paras.zh: Falcon Heavy

paras.en: - Exploratory Missions Beyond Earth’s Orbit: Falcon Heavy first launched in February 2018, when it put a Tesla Roadster and its mannequin passenger, Starman, into orbit around the Sun. This was the first instance of a car sent into deep space and demonstrated the rocket’s capability for trans-Mars injection. Since its inaugural flight, Falcon Heavy has completed missions that expanded the scope of space exploration and commercial spaceflight. Falcon Heavy has been selected by NASA to launch critical weather satellites, interplanetary probes including Europa Clipper (Jupiter) and Dragonfly (Saturn), and the upcoming Nancy Grace Roman telescope, designed to study exoplanets and dark energy and matter.
paras.zh: - 地球轨道以外的探索任务：Falcon Heavy 于 2018 年 2 月首次发射，当时它将一辆 Tesla Roadster 及其假人乘客 Starman 送入环绕太阳的轨道。这是首次将汽车送入深空，并展示了该火箭进行火星转移注入的能力。自首飞以来，Falcon Heavy 已完成多项扩展太空探索和商业航天范围的任务。Falcon Heavy 已被 NASA 选中发射关键气象卫星、行星际探测器（包括 Europa Clipper（木星）和 Dragonfly（土星））以及即将发射的 Nancy Grace Roman 望远镜，后者旨在研究系外行星以及暗能量和暗物质。

paras.en: Starman in Orbit
paras.zh: Starman 在轨

paras.en: - Perfect Performance Record: As of March 31, 2026, Falcon Heavy had successfully completed 11 launches, all resulting in successful payload delivery. Falcon Heavy flown boosters have also safely completed 18 total recoveries and 16 reflights. It was certified for National Security Space Launch in 2019, authorizing its use for U.S. government operations alongside Falcon 9.
paras.zh: - 完美的性能记录：截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，Falcon Heavy 已成功完成 11 次发射，全部实现有效载荷成功送达。Falcon Heavy 已飞行过的助推器还安全完成了总计 18 次回收和 16 次复飞。该火箭于 2019 年获得国家安全太空发射认证，获准与 Falcon 9 一同用于美国政府任务。

paras.en: Starship. A fully reusable two-stage super heavy-lift launch vehicle, Starship stands to fundamentally transform spaceflight by making it more accessible, cost-effective, and scalable than ever before. Comprising the Super Heavy booster (powered by 33 Raptor engines) and the Starship upper stage (with three sea-level and three vacuum Raptor engines), Starship V3 is designed to deliver 100 metric tons to space in a fully reusable configuration while enabling rapid turnaround times akin to commercial aviation, and future generations could reach 200 metric tons, potentially as soon as Starship V4. To date, we have executed 12 Starship flight tests, with our 12th flight test in May 2026 debuting the next generation Starship vehicle and Super Heavy booster, powered by the next evolution of our Raptor engine and launching from a newly designed pad at Starbase. We expect Starship to commence payload delivery to orbit in the second half of 2026. We have achieved innovative milestones, including multiple successful ascents of the world’s most powerful rocket; the launch, return, catch, and reuse of the Super Heavy booster; the return of its upper stage within three meters of its intended landing point; the transfer of approximately five metric tons of cryogenic propellant between tanks while in space, a first of its kind operation that provides key data for future full-scale propellant transfer operations; successful in-space relights of the Raptor engines; and multiple controlled reentries through Earth’s atmosphere. The purpose of flight tests is to collect data so no result, even loss of a vehicle, is considered a failure because we learn something.
paras.zh: Starship。作为一种完全可重复使用的两级超重型运载火箭，Starship 有望从根本上变革太空飞行，使其比以往任何时候都更易获得、更具成本效益且更可扩展。Starship 由 Super Heavy 助推器（由 33 台 Raptor 发动机提供动力）和 Starship 上面级（配备三台海平面版和三台真空版 Raptor 发动机）组成，Starship V3 的设计目标是在完全可重复使用构型下向太空运送 100 公吨，同时实现堪比商业航空的快速周转时间，而未来各代产品有望达到 200 公吨，最早可能在 Starship V4 实现。迄今为止，我们已执行 12 次 Starship 飞行测试，其中 2026 年 5 月的第 12 次飞行测试首次亮相了下一代 Starship 飞行器和 Super Heavy 助推器，二者由我们下一代 Raptor 发动机提供动力，并从 Starbase 一座新设计的发射台发射。我们预计 Starship 将于 2026 年下半年开始向轨道运送有效载荷。我们已实现多项创新里程碑，包括全球最强火箭的多次成功上升；Super Heavy 助推器的发射、返回、捕获和复用；其上面级返回至距预定着陆点三米以内；在太空飞行期间于贮箱之间转移约五公吨低温推进剂，这是一项史无前例的操作，为未来全面规模的推进剂转移操作提供了关键数据；Raptor 发动机在太空中的多次成功重新点火；以及多次受控再入地球大气层。飞行测试的目的是收集数据，因此任何结果，甚至飞行器损失，都不被视为失败，因为我们从中有所收获。

paras.en: Starship is a key enabler of our growth objectives, including the deployment of next-generation V3 satellites, satellite-to-mobile constellations, and orbital AI compute at scale. Achieving our targeted launch cadence with Starship will require significant progress on several key milestones and the investment of significant capital resources. These include: securing additional land and developing high-rate launch sites and supporting infrastructure across multiple locations; scaling production of Starship vehicles and Raptor engines; constructing propellant production facilities, including air separation units and methane liquefaction plants co-located with launch sites; securing sufficient power supply; and obtaining the necessary regulatory approvals, particularly from the FAA, to support a high launch cadence while addressing public safety and environmental considerations. Our development of Starship and its associated infrastructure assumes continued successful iteration through flight testing, regulatory progress, supply chain scaling, and cost reduction driven by increasing reusability. We have made substantial investments in manufacturing scale-up, including Starfactory for high-volume vehicle production, multiple large-scale vertical integration and refurbishment facilities, additional launch towers, test infrastructure, propellant production assets, and power generation capabilities.
paras.zh: 星舰是我们实现增长目标的关键推动因素，包括部署下一代 V3 卫星、卫星直连手机星座以及规模化轨道 AI 算力。要实现星舰的目标发射频率，需要在若干关键里程碑上取得重大进展，并投入大量资本资源。这些包括：获取额外土地并在多个地点开发高频次发射场及配套基础设施；扩大星舰飞行器和 Raptor 发动机的产能；建设推进剂生产设施，包括与发射场同址的空分装置和甲烷液化厂；确保充足的电力供应；以及获得必要的监管批准，尤其是来自 FAA 的批准，以支持高频次发射，同时兼顾公共安全和环境考量。我们对星舰及其相关基础设施的开发，假设能够通过飞行测试持续成功迭代、监管取得进展、供应链规模化，以及由可重复使用性提升驱动的成本下降。我们已在制造规模化方面投入巨资，包括用于大批量飞行器生产的 Starfactory、多个大型垂直整合与翻新设施、额外发射塔、测试基础设施、推进剂生产资产以及发电能力。

paras.en: Full reusability of Starship’s upper stage is not required to deploy our V3 satellites and V2 Mobile satellites in low-Earth orbit. In-orbit refueling is also not required for any of these LEO programs and is instead intended for missions beyond LEO, such as lunar and interplanetary transport. Starship’s substantial payload capacity to LEO, even in partially reusable or expendable configurations, enables meaningful progress toward these objectives. We have already demonstrated Super Heavy booster reusability in multiple integrated flight tests. As a result, meaningful advancement across the deployment of next-generation V3 satellites, satellite-to-mobile constellations, and the orbital AI compute program is not dependent on achieving full reusability.
paras.zh: 部署我们的 V3 卫星和 V2 Mobile 卫星至低地球轨道并不需要星舰上面级的完全可重复使用。这些 LEO 项目也均不需要在轨加注，在轨加注是为 LEO 以外的任务（如月球和行星际运输）而设计的。星舰对 LEO 的强大有效载荷能力，即使在部分可重复使用或一次性使用配置下，也能推动这些目标取得实质性进展。我们已在多次综合飞行测试中展示了 Super Heavy 助推器的可重复使用性。因此，在部署下一代 V3 卫星、卫星直连手机星座以及轨道 AI 算力项目方面取得实质性进展，并不依赖于实现完全可重复使用。

paras.en: Starship Overview
paras.zh: 星舰概览

paras.en: - Full and Rapid Reusability and Drastically Reduced Launch Costs: Starship’s core design innovation is its full and rapid approach to reusability: both stages return to Earth for catch and rapid refurbishment. The Super Heavy booster returns to the launch site following stage separation and is caught mid-air by the launch tower’s mechanical arms, also known as “chopsticks,” to facilitate immediate inspection, refurbishment, and relaunch.
paras.zh: - 完全且快速的可重复使用与发射成本大幅降低：星舰的核心设计创新在于其完全且快速的可重复使用方式：两级均返回地球进行捕获和快速翻新。Super Heavy 助推器在级间分离后返回发射场，并由发射塔的机械臂（又称“筷子”）在空中捕获，以便立即进行检查、翻新和再次发射。

paras.en: “Chopstick” Super Heavy Booster Catch
paras.zh: “筷子”捕获 Super Heavy 助推器

paras.en: The Starship upper stage, after orbital delivery or missions beyond, is designed to reenter protected by advanced heat shield tiles, execute a propulsive landing burn, and be similarly caught mid-air by the launch tower’s mechanical arms. We believe that Starship’s full and rapid reusability will enable sub-one hour reflights, causing a paradigm shift in launch cadence.
paras.zh: 星舰上面级在完成轨道交付或更远任务后，设计为在先进隔热瓦的保护下再入，执行推进式着陆点火，并同样由发射塔的机械臂在空中捕获。我们相信，星舰的完全且快速可重复使用将实现一小时以内的再次飞行，从而带来发射频率的范式转变。

paras.en: Starship Landing Burn
paras.zh: 星舰着陆点火

paras.en: - Improvements in Engine Development Underpin Starship’s Massive Payload Capacity: With a payload bay volume rivaling the pressurized sections of the International Space Station, Starship is designed to deploy structures like space station modules, large telescopes, our next-generation V3 satellites, and future AI compute satellites. Starship is powered by 39 Raptor engines, which are full-flow staged combustion cycle rocket engines burning cryogenic liquid methane and liquid oxygen. Raptor engines offer nearly triple the thrust per engine, higher efficiency, and better performance for heavy-lift and deep space missions compared to the Merlin engine used on Falcon 9. Each Raptor 3 engine in Starship saves nearly a ton of vehicle mass compared to previous generations by removing heat shields and simplifying plumbing. Starship’s capacity enables the next leg of our growth, including scaling our Starlink Mobile constellation and orbital AI compute.
paras.zh: - 发动机研发的进步支撑星舰庞大的有效载荷能力：星舰的有效载荷舱容积可与国际空间站的加压舱段相媲美，其设计目标是部署空间站模块、大型望远镜、我们的下一代 V3 卫星以及未来的 AI 算力卫星等结构。星舰由 39 台 Raptor 发动机提供动力，这些发动机是全流量分级燃烧循环火箭发动机，燃烧低温液态甲烷和液氧。与 Falcon 9 所使用的 Merlin 发动机相比，Raptor 发动机的单台推力接近其三倍，效率更高，在重型运载和深空任务中的性能也更优。星舰上的每台 Raptor 3 发动机通过取消隔热罩和简化管路，相比前几代可节省近一吨的飞行器质量。星舰的运载能力支撑我们下一阶段的增长，包括扩展我们的 Starlink Mobile 星座和轨道 AI 算力。

paras.en: - Orbital Refueling: Starship’s expected orbital refueling capability will allow tanker variants to refill the upper stage in LEO and extend its range for deep-space missions beyond Earth’s orbit. These capabilities are expected to revolutionize mission architecture, with each Starship designed to be capable of transporting large numbers of people or hundreds of metric tons of cargo to destinations like the surface of the Moon and Mars.
paras.zh: - 轨道加注：星舰预期的轨道加注能力将使加油机型号能够在 LEO 为上面级补充推进剂，并延长其航程以执行地球轨道以外的深空任务。这些能力预计将彻底改变任务架构，每艘星舰的设计目标都是能够将大量人员或数百公吨货物运送至月球表面和火星等目的地。

paras.en: - Sustainable Human Exploration Beyond Earth: Starship was designed from the beginning to fly to other worlds and enable self-growing bases on the Moon, an entire civilization on Mars, and ultimately expansion beyond our solar system. As NASA’s Human Landing System for Artemis, Starship is built to deliver astronauts and cargo to the lunar surface and serve as the key enabler for supporting permanent presence on the Moon.
paras.zh: - 地球以外的可持续人类探索：星舰从一开始就设计为飞往其他世界，并支持在月球上建立可自我生长的基地、在火星上建立完整的文明，最终向太阳系以外扩张。作为 NASA 阿尔忒弥斯计划的人类着陆系统，星舰旨在将宇航员和货物运送至月球表面，并成为支持月球长期驻留的关键使能者。

paras.en: - Versatility Across Mission Profiles: Beyond deep space, Starship is designed to adapt to diverse roles including the U.S. Space Force’s Rocket Cargo program for rapid point-to-point global logistics, Starlink and other commercial satellite constellations, in-orbit manufacturing components and hardware, space tourism, and others.
paras.zh: - 跨任务构型的多用途性：除深空任务外，星舰的设计还适应多种角色，包括美国太空军的火箭货运计划（用于快速点对点全球物流）、Starlink 及其他商业卫星星座、在轨制造部件和硬件、太空旅游等。

paras.en: Starship is designed to enable a step-function advancement in our capabilities, featuring rapid, full reusability of both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship spacecraft to achieve unprecedented throughput at significantly reduced costs compared to existing systems. As Starship progresses toward full operational utilization, the Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy platforms will remain key assets for specialized missions, including NASA crew rotations and national security payloads.
paras.zh: 星舰旨在实现我们能力的阶跃式提升，其特点是超重型助推器和星舰飞船均可快速、完全重复使用，从而以相比现有系统显著降低的成本实现前所未有的吞吐量。随着星舰逐步迈向全面运营使用，Falcon 9 和 Falcon Heavy 平台仍将是执行专项任务的关键资产，包括 NASA 乘组轮换和国家安全载荷。

paras.en: Dragon Cargo Spacecraft. The Dragon cargo spacecraft is an uncrewed vehicle designed primarily for transporting cargo to and from the International Space Station under NASA’s Commercial Resupply Services program. As an evolution of the original Dragon spacecraft, this vehicle represents a critical component of our portfolio, enabling reliable, cost-effective logistics for space missions. The spacecraft consists of a pressurized section for environmentally controlled cargo and an unpressurized trunk section for additional payloads. It has a launch payload mass of up to 6,000 kilograms and a return payload mass of 3,000 kilograms, making it uniquely suited for both delivery and retrieval of scientific experiments, supplies, and hardware, and establishing SpaceX as the only company capable of returning significant amounts of cargo from the International Space Station back to Earth.
paras.zh: 龙货运飞船。龙货运飞船是一种无人驾驶飞行器，主要设计用于在 NASA 商业补给服务计划下往返国际空间站运送货物。作为初代龙飞船的演进型号，该飞行器是我们产品组合中的关键组成部分，为太空任务提供可靠、高性价比的物流服务。该飞船由一个用于环境受控货物的加压舱段和一个用于额外有效载荷的非加压后备舱段组成。其发射有效载荷质量最高达 6,000 千克，返回有效载荷质量为 3,000 千克，使其特别适合运送和回收科学实验、补给品及硬件，并使 SpaceX 成为唯一能够从国际空间站向地球返回大量货物的公司。

paras.en: Dragon Cargo Overview
paras.zh: 龙货运飞船概览

paras.en: - Key features: Key highlights of the Dragon cargo spacecraft include its propulsion system with 16 Draco thrusters for precise orbital maneuvering, autonomous docking capabilities via NASA’s International Docking System Standard (IDSS), and a trunk equipped with solar panels for power generation during flight.
paras.zh: - 关键特性：龙货运飞船的关键亮点包括配备 16 台 Draco 推进器的推进系统，用于精确轨道机动；通过 NASA 国际对接系统标准（IDSS）实现自主对接能力；以及配备太阳能电池板的后备舱段，用于飞行期间发电。

paras.en: - Launch vehicle, return mechanism and mission profiles: The spacecraft is launched atop the Falcon 9 rocket and returns to Earth via parachute-assisted splashdown in the ocean, where it is recovered for refurbishment and reuse. Dragon supports extended in-orbit durations, typically spending several weeks docked to the International Space Station before undocking with returned cargo.
paras.zh: - 运载火箭、返回机制与任务剖面：该飞船由猎鹰 9 号火箭发射升空，并通过降落伞辅助溅落海洋返回地球，随后被回收进行翻新和重复使用。龙飞船支持延长在轨驻留时间，通常在国际空间站对接数周后脱离，并携带返回货物。

paras.en: - Historic accomplishments: Launched by Falcon 9 in 2012, our Dragon spacecraft became the first commercial spacecraft to deliver cargo to and from the International Space Station and, eight years later, the first privately built vehicle to fly humans to the orbiting laboratory. This achievement ended U.S. reliance on foreign vehicles for International Space Station resupply following the Space Shuttle’s retirement in 2011. The original Dragon variant (later known as Dragon 1) established a critical role in advancing research on the space station as the only spacecraft capable of returning significant amounts of cargo to Earth. The upgraded cargo spacecraft pioneered autonomous docking without robotic arm assistance, delivered major hardware upgrades for the station including new solar arrays, and recently debuted the ability to reboost the station’s altitude. It remains the only reusable cargo spacecraft in operation. As of March 31, 2026, our Dragon spacecraft has completed over 30 cargo missions to the International Space Station.
paras.zh: - 历史成就：我们的龙飞船于 2012 年由猎鹰 9 号发射，成为首个往返国际空间站运送货物的商业航天器，并在八年后成为首个将人类送往该轨道实验室的私人建造飞行器。这一成就结束了自 2011 年航天飞机退役后美国在国际空间站补给方面对外国飞行器的依赖。初代龙飞船型号（后称龙 1）作为唯一能够向地球返回大量货物的航天器，在推进空间站研究方面确立了关键作用。升级后的货运飞船开创了无需机械臂辅助的自主对接，为空间站运送了包括新太阳能电池阵列在内的重大硬件升级，并于近期首次展示了提升空间站轨道高度的能力。它仍是唯一在役的可重复使用货运飞船。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们的龙飞船已完成超过 30 次国际空间站货运任务。

paras.en: Dragon Crew Spacecraft. Dragon is engineered to fly humans to and from Earth orbit, including the International Space Station. The spacecraft is designed to accommodate up to seven passengers, with a pressurized cabin for crew habitation, life support systems, and cargo.
paras.zh: 龙载人飞船。龙飞船专为将人类送往地球轨道并返回而设计，包括国际空间站。该飞船设计可容纳最多七名乘客，配备用于乘员居住的加压舱、生命支持系统和货物空间。

paras.en: Dragon Orbiting Earth's Poles
paras.zh: 龙飞船绕地球两极飞行

paras.en: - Key features: Dragon Crew spacecraft is equipped with advanced avionics, touchscreen interfaces for manual control, and an integrated trunk with solar power generation. Dragon Crew’s propulsion includes 16 Draco thrusters for orbital adjustments and 8 Super Draco engines for its launch escape system, enabling rapid separation from the rocket in the unlikely event of an emergency.
paras.zh: - 主要特点：龙飞船乘员版（Dragon Crew）航天器配备了先进航空电子设备、用于手动控制的触摸屏界面，以及集成太阳能发电的货舱。龙飞船乘员版的推进系统包括 16 台 Draco 推力器用于轨道调整，以及 8 台 Super Draco 发动机用于发射逃逸系统，可在极不可能发生的紧急情况下实现与火箭的快速分离。

paras.en: - Launch vehicle, return mechanism and mission profiles: The spacecraft is launched atop the Falcon 9 rocket and returns to Earth via parachute-assisted splashdown in the ocean, where it is recovered for refurbishment and reuse. The design emphasizes reusability, with vehicles certified for multiple flights after refurbishment, and supports missions lasting up to nine months on the International Space Station.
paras.zh: - 运载火箭、返回机制与任务概况：该航天器由猎鹰 9 号（Falcon 9）火箭发射升空，并通过降落伞辅助溅落海洋返回地球，随后被回收进行翻新和重复使用。该设计强调可重复使用性，飞行器经翻新后获认证可执行多次飞行，并支持在国际空间站上持续长达九个月的任务。

paras.en: - Historic accomplishments: Revolutionary accomplishments of Dragon include being the first privately developed spacecraft to transport humans to and from the International Space Station, achieved during the Demo-2 mission in May 2020 which carried NASA astronauts Doug Hurley and Bob Behnken. This milestone returned human spaceflight capabilities to the United States for the first time since the Space Shuttle’s retirement in 2011, reducing dependence on foreign spacecraft. Dragon has enabled regular astronaut rotations under NASA’s Commercial Crew Program, flying nearly 15 successful Crew and Private Astronaut missions to the International Space Station to date, while pioneering space tourism by carrying commercial astronauts on private flights. Its autonomous docking technology, life support for extended durations, and abort system have set new safety standards achieving a flawless record in crewed operations.
paras.zh: - 历史性成就：龙飞船的革命性成就包括成为首个将人类运送至国际空间站并返回的私人研制航天器，这一成就在 2020 年 5 月的 Demo-2 任务中实现，搭载了 NASA 宇航员 Doug Hurley 和 Bob Behnken。这一里程碑使美国自 2011 年航天飞机退役以来首次恢复载人航天能力，减少了对国外航天器的依赖。龙飞船已在 NASA 商业载人计划（Commercial Crew Program）下实现常规宇航员轮换，迄今已执行近 15 次成功的乘员及私人宇航员任务前往国际空间站，同时通过搭载商业宇航员执行私人飞行开创了太空旅游先河。其自主对接技术、长时间生命保障和逃逸系统树立了新的安全标准，在载人运营中保持了完美记录。

paras.en: #### Connectivity
paras.zh: #### 连接性

paras.en: Starlink Consumer Broadband
paras.zh: Starlink 消费者宽带

paras.en: Starlink Consumer Broadband is a broadband network powered by our global LEO satellite constellation, designed to deliver high-speed, low-latency internet connectivity anywhere on Earth. The service provides fiber-like download speeds with latency low enough to support intensive real-time applications, such as content streaming, video calls, and online gaming, while requiring only visible sight to the sky and electricity for installation. Since launch, Starlink has scaled rapidly, serving approximately 10.3 million subscribers across 164 countries, territories, and other markets as of March 31, 2026.
paras.zh: Starlink 消费者宽带是由我们的全球低地球轨道（LEO）卫星星座提供支持的宽带网络，旨在为地球任何地点提供高速、低延迟的互联网连接。该服务提供类似光纤的下载速度，延迟低到足以支持内容流媒体、视频通话和在线游戏等高强度实时应用，同时安装仅需可见天空和电力。自推出以来，Starlink 迅速扩张，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，已在 164 个国家、地区及其他市场服务约 10.3 百万用户。

paras.en: Starlink Consumer Broadband is enabled by the largest satellite constellation in human history with approximately 9,000 broadband satellites as of March 31, 2026, operating in LEO to deliver latency comparable to many terrestrial broadband connections. We launched approximately 3,100 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites in 2025, which is approximately five times more than the total number of active satellites in the entire second largest LEO satellite constellation. We provide download speeds exceeding 400 Mbps with round-trip latencies as low as 21 milliseconds —performance that rivals or surpasses traditional terrestrial broadband while also reaching locations no traditional fiber or cellular network can economically serve. Satellite-based communications are uniquely suited to reach underserved and remote areas by delivering coverage directly from LEO without requiring local infrastructure. In contrast, terrestrial networks depend on costly, ground-based buildouts that are often uneconomical in low-density or hard-to-access regions. As of March 31, 2026, the constellation incorporated over 23,000 inter-satellite lasers that create a dynamic mesh network in space, enabling traffic to route through orbit rather than relying solely on terrestrial backhaul infrastructure. Satellites autonomously maneuver to avoid collisions and are designed for controlled end-of-life deorbit, supporting long-term orbital sustainability. Successive generations of our broadband satellites, including V3 satellites, are expected to increase throughput, power capacity, and network efficiency, with production vertically integrated and performed largely in-house. Our focus on vertical integration has allowed us to reduce the Starlink satellite manufacturing cost per one Gbps of downlink capacity by approximately three times from Starlink V1 Broadband satellites to V2 Mini satellites. We expect to achieve a total cost reduction of nine times from Starlink V1 Broadband satellites to V3 satellites.
paras.zh: Starlink 消费宽带依托人类历史上最大的卫星星座实现，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日拥有约 9,000 颗宽带卫星，在低地球轨道（LEO）运行，可提供与许多地面宽带连接相当的时延。我们在 2025 年发射了约 3,100 颗 Starlink 宽带和移动卫星，约为整个第二大 LEO 卫星星座在轨卫星总数的五倍。我们提供的下载速度超过 400 Mbps，往返时延低至 21 毫秒——这一性能可与传统地面宽带相媲美甚至超越，同时还能覆盖传统光纤或蜂窝网络在经济上无法服务的地区。基于卫星的通信具有独特优势，可直接从 LEO 提供覆盖，无需本地基础设施，从而触达服务不足和偏远地区。相比之下，地面网络依赖昂贵的地面建设，在低密度或难以进入的地区往往不具经济性。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，该星座包含超过 23,000 条星间激光链路，在太空中构建动态网状网络，使流量可经由轨道路由，而不必完全依赖地面回传基础设施。卫星可自主机动以规避碰撞，并设计为受控寿命终止离轨，支持长期轨道可持续性。我们宽带卫星的后续各代产品（包括 V3 卫星）预计将提升吞吐量、功率容量和网络效率，生产采用垂直整合模式，且大部分在内部完成。我们对垂直整合的专注使我们得以将 Starlink 卫星每 Gbps 下行容量的制造成本从 Starlink V1 宽带卫星到 V2 Mini 卫星降低约三倍。我们预计从 Starlink V1 宽带卫星到 V3 卫星将实现总计九倍的成本降低。

paras.en: Starlink Broadband V2 Mini and V3 Satellites
paras.zh: Starlink 宽带 V2 Mini 与 V3 卫星

paras.en: On Earth, users access the network through proprietary Starlink terminals that we design and manufacture. As of March 31, 2026, we have reduced the cost of Starlink terminals—achieving an approximately 59% reduction in the average manufacturing cost of a Starlink Kit since 2022—while improving performance and reliability, which we believe collectively provides us a meaningful and durable competitive advantage over other terrestrial and satellite broadband providers. Our portfolio of terminals, which we are able to manufacture and sell for a fraction of the cost of terminals used by other satellite internet providers, includes three primary consumer configurations including: a Standard terminal designed for fixed residential and small business use, featuring a wide field of view; a Mini terminal roughly the size of a laptop, designed for mobility and travel use cases with a built-in Wi-Fi router and the ability to operate on portable battery systems or 12V vehicle power; and the Performance terminal, designed for demanding environments, with a maximum download speed over 450 Mbps and a higher power consumption of 110W or more under load. Each type of terminal is designed to be quick and seamless for a consumer to self-set up, support in-motion connectivity up to speeds of 100 mph, and deliver global, oceanwide coverage for consumer maritime use. We believe that this combination of low cost, portability (particularly in the case of our Starlink Mini terminal), and ease of installation of our terminals will help scale our consumer broadband offering.
paras.zh: 在地球上，用户通过我们设计和制造的专有 Starlink 终端接入网络。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们已降低 Starlink 终端的成本——自 2022 年以来，Starlink Kit 的平均制造成本降低了约 59%——同时提升了性能和可靠性，我们认为这共同为我们提供了相对于其他地面和卫星宽带提供商的有意义且持久的竞争优势。我们的终端产品组合能够以其他卫星互联网提供商所用终端成本的一小部分进行制造和销售，包括三种主要消费者配置：Standard 终端，专为固定住宅和小型企业使用而设计，具有宽广的视野；Mini 终端，大小约相当于一台笔记本电脑，专为移动和旅行使用场景设计，内置 Wi-Fi 路由器，并能够在便携式电池系统或 12V 车辆电源上运行；以及 Performance 终端，专为严苛环境设计，最大下载速度超过 450 Mbps，负载下功耗更高，为 110W 或以上。每种终端均设计为消费者可快速、无缝地自行安装，支持最高 100 mph 速度的移动连接，并为消费者海事用途提供全球、全海洋覆盖。我们认为，这种低成本、便携性（尤其是我们的 Starlink Mini 终端）和终端易于安装的组合将有助于扩大我们的消费者宽带业务规模。

paras.en: Starlink Standard and Mini User Terminals
paras.zh: Starlink Standard 和 Mini 用户终端

paras.en: We monetize Starlink primarily through subscription plans paired with hardware sales. Service tiers vary by speed, priority access, geographic coverage, and mobility requirements, including Local and Global Priority options for small to medium sized business, enterprise, and government Starlink customers. As the constellation scales and capacity expands with next-generation satellites, we expect Starlink to continue growing as a global, recurring-revenue connectivity platform and foundational layer of a space-enabled digital economy.
paras.zh: 我们主要通过订阅计划配合硬件销售来实现 Starlink 的变现。服务层级因速度、优先接入、地理覆盖和移动性要求而异，包括面向中小型企业、企业和政府 Starlink 客户的 Local 和 Global Priority 选项。随着星座规模扩大以及下一代卫星带来的容量扩展，我们预计 Starlink 将继续作为全球经常性收入连接平台和太空赋能数字经济的基础层而增长。

paras.en: Enterprise Solutions
paras.zh: 企业解决方案

paras.en: Enterprise Solutions offers the same fundamental advantages of Starlink Consumer Broadband—high throughput, low-latency, and global coverage—into mission-critical, in-motion, and distributed connectivity environments for enterprises. Starlink’s architecture is designed to deliver consistent performance across routes, oceans, and remote industrial sites. Enterprise services are supported by dedicated hardware configurations and commercial structures tailored to usage intensity, service-level requirements, and fleet-scale deployments.
paras.zh: 企业解决方案将 Starlink 消费者宽带的相同基本优势——高吞吐量、低延迟和全球覆盖——带入企业关键任务、移动中和分布式连接环境。Starlink 的架构旨在在路线、海洋和偏远工业场址提供一致性能。企业服务由专用硬件配置和针对使用强度、服务级别要求和车队规模部署量身定制的商业结构提供支持。

paras.en: Enterprise Solutions
paras.zh: 企业解决方案

paras.en: Aviation Connectivity
paras.zh: 航空连接

paras.en: Starlink Aviation provides broadband connectivity for commercial and private aircraft, enabling high-quality internet service for passengers and crew from gate to gate, including during taxi and prior to take-off. The service is differentiated by materially lower latency and higher throughput than legacy in-flight connectivity systems, enabling streaming, video conferencing, and real-time applications at scale while in flight—even bandwidth-intensive applications such as gaming, previously impractical from an airplane. Starlink’s global network is designed to eliminate “dead zones” and supports performance on polar and high-latitude routes that can be challenging for traditional providers. In recent years, we have assembled dedicated sales and engineering teams to market and support fleet-wide conversions in the aviation sector. This has enabled partnerships with many of the world’s leading airlines, including United Airlines, Southwest Airlines, American Airlines, Qatar Airways, Lufthansa Group, British Airways, Alaska Airlines, and Hawaiian Airlines, many of which have implemented or committed to fleet-wide Starlink installations for seamless in-flight connectivity.
paras.zh: Starlink Aviation 为商用和私人飞机提供宽带连接，使乘客和机组人员从登机口到登机口全程（包括滑行期间和起飞前）都能获得高质量互联网服务。该服务与传统的机上连接系统相比，具有显著更低的时延和更高的吞吐量，从而在飞行途中能够大规模支持流媒体、视频会议和实时应用——甚至包括此前在飞机上无法实现的游戏等高带宽应用。Starlink 的全球网络旨在消除“盲区”，并支持在极地和高纬度航线上保持性能，而这些航线对传统提供商而言可能颇具挑战。近年来，我们组建了专门的销售和工程团队，以在航空领域推广和支持全机队改装。这使我们得以与众多全球领先航空公司建立合作，包括 United Airlines、Southwest Airlines、American Airlines、Qatar Airways、Lufthansa Group、British Airways、Alaska Airlines 和 Hawaiian Airlines，其中许多航空公司已实施或承诺进行全机队 Starlink 安装，以实现无缝的机上连接。

paras.en: Maritime Connectivity
paras.zh: 海事连接

paras.en: Starlink Maritime provides broadband connectivity for vessels operating in coastal and deep-ocean environments, supporting both operational requirements (navigation, telemetry, maintenance, logistics) and end-user connectivity (crew welfare and passenger internet). The service is designed for consistent coverage regardless of proximity to land, including routes that may experience service degradation under legacy satellite architectures. Starlink terminals are engineered for marine operating conditions and are designed to be installed or swapped efficiently alongside existing onboard communications systems, reducing downtime during retrofit. For many maritime operators, Starlink functions as a wholesale or “syndicated” connectivity layer: vessel owners or cruise operators purchase and allocate capacity across passengers, crew, and critical ship systems, including when reselling Wi-Fi access as an onboard service. Pricing structures vary by vessel class, expected consumption, coverage requirements (coastal vs. ocean), and priority level, and are generally implemented through recurring subscription arrangements with fleet-based commercial terms.
