These frameworks impose obligations regarding, among other things, the collection, use, storage, protection, disclosure, transfer, and other processing of data, including personal information, and may restrict or condition cross-border data transfers, require data localization, or impose content moderation or other platform-related requirements, and may be interpreted or enforced in ways that are inconsistent, unclear, or subject to significant regulatory discretion. The risks are particularly acute for us because we operate globally across multiple industries and develop cutting-edge technologies that present novel regulatory and security issues. The data we collect and otherwise process is integral to our business, technology, and services, and regulatory restrictions or limitations on our ability to secure and process such data could materially affect our operations and business model.
paras.zh: 我们受制于复杂且不断演变的全球法律与监管框架，这些框架涉及隐私、网络安全、AI、数据保护、合法访问、内容审核和数字平台监管，此外还涉及我们在开展业务过程中作出的合同及其他承诺，以及我们的内部和外部政策、程序和控制措施。这些法律和法规因司法管辖区和行业而异，并不统一，可能相互冲突或施加重叠或不一致的义务，并且仍在不断演变和涌现。特别是，《加州消费者隐私法》（经修订）、欧盟《通用数据保护条例》（及其在英国的对等法规）以及其他数据隐私法律法规，对个人信息的处理施加了严格且繁重的合规要求，并对不合规行为规定了重大处罚。此外，作为政府承包商，我们还须遵守战争部的网络安全成熟度模型认证要求，该要求规定与战争部开展业务的公司须根据所需的安全等级，达到或超过特定的网络安全标准，方有资格获得新的合同授予。这些法律以及其他原本并非为处理隐私、网络安全、AI、数据保护、合法访问、内容审核或数字平台问题而制定的现有法律，其解释和适用具有不确定性，并且在适用于新技术和数据驱动的产品与服务时仍在不断发展。这些框架对数据的收集、使用、存储、保护、披露、传输及其他处理（包括个人信息）等事项施加义务，并可能限制跨境数据传输或对其设定条件、要求数据本地化，或施加内容审核或其他与平台相关的要求，且其解释或执行方式可能不一致、不明确，或受制于监管机构的重大自由裁量权。这些风险对我们尤为严峻，因为我们在多个行业开展全球业务，并开发会带来新型监管和安全问题的前沿技术。我们收集及以其他方式处理的数据对我们的业务、技术和服务至关重要，而监管对我们获取和处理此类数据能力的限制或约束，可能对我们的运营和商业模式产生重大影响。

paras.en: In addition, our products and services, including those enabled by AI, may also be subject to online safety and youth-protection laws and regulations. Such laws and regulations may impose obligations relating to content risk mitigation, age assurance, platform governance, and, in certain jurisdictions, content reporting and removal requirements. For example, the UK’s Online Safety Act 2023 and Australia’s Online Safety Amendment (Social Media Minimum Age) Act 2024 impose risk mitigation and age-related requirements on certain online platforms. As a result of these requirements or to otherwise seek to maintain the safety of our platforms, we maintain content policies and enforcement mechanisms across our platforms and related products and services. These include a combination of automated detection tools, classifiers and filters, algorithmic signals, and human review processes. We also employ measures to help detect and challenge suspicious accounts during sign-up and ongoing use, provide user reporting channels, and apply enforcement actions. Additional safeguards to help mitigate safety concerns include age-related controls, content restrictions, and specialized modes; and labeling or watermarks on certain outputs and other market-specific restrictions on certain content categories where required by local laws.
paras.zh: 此外，我们的产品和服务（包括由 AI 赋能的产品和服务）还可能受到在线安全和青少年保护相关法律法规的约束。此类法律法规可能就内容风险缓解、年龄验证、平台治理以及在部分司法管辖区内的内容报告与删除要求等方面施加义务。例如，英国《2023 年在线安全法》和澳大利亚《2024 年在线安全修正案（社交媒体最低年龄）法》对特定在线平台施加了风险缓解和年龄相关要求。基于这些要求，或为以其他方式维护我们平台的安全，我们在各平台及相关产品和服务中维持内容政策与执行机制。这些机制包括自动化检测工具、分类器和过滤器、算法信号以及人工审核流程的组合。我们还采取措施，在注册和持续使用过程中帮助检测和质询可疑账户，提供用户举报渠道，并采取执行措施。其他有助于缓解安全顾虑的保障措施包括年龄相关控制、内容限制和专用模式，以及在当地法律要求时对特定输出内容加注标签或水印，并对特定内容类别实施其他针对特定市场的限制。

paras.en: This evolving landscape will continue to affect our ability to maintain, develop, or launch products and services, including those that rely on the processing of personal information or other sensitive data, including targeted advertising and other data-driven offerings, and may require market-specific changes to our products, services, or business practices, increasing operational complexity and cost. In addition, emerging laws and regulations seeking to restrict cross-border transfer of or access to certain data in light of perceived national security considerations may increase compliance costs and restrict our operational flexibility, investment activities, or ability to achieve our strategic objectives. As our business evolves, and if we expand into additional industries or jurisdictions, our compliance requirements and associated costs may increase and we may be subject to heightened regulatory scrutiny.
paras.zh: 这一不断演变的格局将继续影响我们维护、开发或推出产品和服务的能力，包括那些依赖处理个人信息或其他敏感数据的产品和服务，例如定向广告和其他数据驱动型服务，并可能要求我们针对特定市场对产品、服务或业务实践作出调整，从而增加运营复杂性和成本。此外，出于国家安全考量而新出台的、旨在限制特定数据跨境传输或访问的法律法规，可能增加合规成本，并限制我们的运营灵活性、投资活动或实现战略目标的能力。随着业务发展，以及如果我们拓展至更多行业或司法管辖区，我们的合规要求及相关成本可能增加，我们可能面临更严格的监管审查。

paras.en: We also face cybersecurity risks, including the potential unlawful, accidental, or unauthorized access to, or use, disclosure, alteration, loss, or disruption of, our technology, products, systems, and data, or those of our service providers and partners, which could result in a loss of confidentiality, integrity, or availability. We operate in industries that have been, and will continue to be, targeted by sophisticated and persistent internal and external threat actors, including those controlled by or affiliated with nation states. For additional information, please refer to “Risk Factors—Risks Related to Our Business—Any significant disruption in, or unauthorized access to, our computer and data systems or those of third parties that we utilize in our operations could result in a loss or degradation of service, loss of trust in us and harm to our business.” Many jurisdictions impose mandatory breach notification and reporting obligations, and compliance with such requirements can be costly, time-sensitive, and operationally burdensome, and we may bear such costs in the event of a material incident. As we continue to use and integrate advanced technologies, including AI systems and models, into our operations, products, and services, our exposure to cybersecurity incidents may increase, particularly as threat actors also try to adopt and deploy AI-enabled tools to evade detection and compromise systems or data. Compliance with applicable privacy, cybersecurity, AI, data protection, lawful access, content moderation and digital platform obligations can be costly and operationally demanding and may require changes to our products, services, business practices, or technical infrastructure.
paras.zh: 我们还面临网络安全风险，包括我们的技术、产品、系统和数据，或我们的服务提供商和合作伙伴的技术、产品、系统和数据，可能遭到非法、意外或未经授权的访问、使用、披露、篡改、丢失或中断，从而可能导致机密性、完整性或可用性受损。我们经营的行业一直并将继续成为复杂且持续的内部和外部威胁行为者的攻击目标，包括由国家支持或与国家有关联的威胁行为者。如需更多信息，请参阅“风险因素——与我们的业务相关的风险——我们的计算机和数据系统，或我们在运营中使用的第三方计算机和数据系统若发生任何重大中断或未经授权的访问，可能导致服务丢失或降级、对我们信任的丧失以及对我们的业务造成损害。”许多司法管辖区规定了强制性的违规通知和报告义务，遵守此类要求可能成本高昂、时间紧迫且运营负担沉重，若发生重大事件，我们可能承担此类成本。随着我们继续使用先进技术（包括 AI 系统和模型）并将其整合到我们的运营、产品和服务中，我们面临的网络安全事件风险可能增加，尤其是当威胁行为者也试图采用和部署 AI 赋能工具以规避检测并入侵系统或数据时。遵守适用的隐私、网络安全、AI、数据保护、合法访问、内容审核和数字平台义务可能成本高昂且运营要求高，并可能需要更改我们的产品、服务、业务实践或技术基础设施。

paras.en: Our operations and facilities, as well as existing and planned infrastructure, are subject to an extensive regulatory framework of federal, state, local, and foreign environmental, health, and safety laws, and regulations and permits that govern, among other things, employee health and safety, discharges of pollutants into the air and water, the generation, handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous materials and wastes and the investigation and remediation of certain materials, substances, and wastes. These include various regulations promulgated by federal, state, and local regulatory agencies and legislative bodies. Certain of our operations, including launch, reentry, testing, and manufacturing activities and the development or expansion of facilities, as well as the siting, construction and operation of data centers, may require environmental reviews, consultations, and permits and may be subject to conditions or mitigation measures that could increase costs or limit operations.
paras.zh: 我们的运营和设施，以及现有和规划中的基础设施，受制于联邦、州、地方及外国环境、健康和安全法律、法规和许可构成的广泛监管框架，这些法律法规和许可涉及（除其他事项外）员工健康与安全、向空气和水体排放污染物、危险材料和废物的产生、处理、储存和处置，以及特定材料、物质和废物的调查与修复。这些包括联邦、州和地方监管机构及立法机构颁布的各项法规。我们的某些运营活动，包括发射、再入、测试和制造活动以及设施的开发或扩建，以及数据中心的选址、建设和运营，可能需要环境审查、咨询和许可，并可能受到可能增加成本或限制运营的条件或缓解措施的约束。

paras.en: We are required to obtain a number of permits and entitlements from various government agencies to construct and operate our facilities, including zoning, land use and building code permits, air quality permits for permanent combustion equipment (including both diesel generators and natural gas turbines), stormwater and wastewater discharge permits, and fire and life safety approvals. We have issued or pending permit applications for certain of our facilities. For additional information, please refer to “Risk Factors—Risks Related to Our Business— Environmental laws, regulations, litigation, liabilities and proceedings may adversely affect our operations, including our launch operations, manufacturing activities, fuel storage and handling operations, launch facilities and ground infrastructure, and data center operations and expansion plans.”
paras.zh: 我们需要从多个政府机构获得多项许可和授权，以建设和运营我们的设施，包括分区、土地使用和建筑规范许可、永久燃烧设备（包括柴油发电机和天然气涡轮机）的空气质量许可、雨水和废水排放许可，以及消防和生命安全批准。我们已就某些设施提交或正在等待许可申请。如需更多信息，请参阅“风险因素——与我们的业务相关的风险——环境法律、法规、诉讼、责任和程序可能对我们的运营产生不利影响，包括我们的发射运营、制造活动、燃料储存和处理运营、发射设施和地面基础设施，以及数据中心运营和扩建计划。”

paras.en: A portion of our revenue is derived from contracts, directly or indirectly, with the U.S. government. We have numerous direct contracts with the U.S. government, primarily NASA, the Department of War, the General Services Administration, and certain Intelligence Community agencies. These contracts focus mainly on launch services, spacecraft development, and satellite deployment, and artificial intelligence products. We are almost always the prime contractor on our government contracts, and we rarely use subcontractors. All of our launch contracts with U.S. government agencies are firm fixed-price contracts with milestone-based payments.
paras.zh: 我们的一部分收入来自与美国政府直接或间接签订的合同。我们与美国政府签有大量直接合同，主要来自 NASA、战争部、总务管理局以及某些情报界机构。这些合同主要集中于发射服务、航天器开发、卫星部署以及人工智能产品。在我们的政府合同中，我们几乎总是主承包商，很少使用分包商。我们与美国政府机构签订的所有发射合同均为固定总价合同，按里程碑付款。

paras.en: These contracts are subject to U.S. government contracting rules and regulations (Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS)), and therefore, we are subject to the business risks specific to the defense industry. These regulations impose stringent requirements on our operations, business practices and reporting, and noncompliance could result in civil or criminal penalties, suspension or debarment from government contracting, or loss of existing or future business. These requirements, although customary in U.S. government contracts, increase our performance and compliance costs. These costs might increase in the future. The U.S. government has the ability to unilaterally: (i) declare us ineligible to receive new contracts; (ii) terminate existing contracts at its convenience and without advance notice; (iii) reduce the scope and value of existing contracts; (iv) audit our contract-related costs and fees, including allocated indirect costs; and (v) revoke required security clearances. Violations of government procurement laws could result in civil or criminal penalties.
paras.zh: 这些合同受美国政府合同规则和法规（《联邦采购条例》（FAR）和《国防联邦采购条例补充》（DFARS））约束，因此我们面临国防行业特有的业务风险。这些法规对我们的运营、商业惯例和报告提出严格要求，不合规可能导致民事或刑事处罚、被暂停或取消政府承包资格，或失去现有或未来业务。这些要求虽在美国政府合同中属常规要求，但增加了我们的履约和合规成本。这些成本未来可能增加。美国政府有权单方面：(i) 宣布我们无资格获得新合同；(ii) 出于便利且无需事先通知终止现有合同；(iii) 缩减现有合同的范围和价值；(iv) 审计我们与合同相关的成本和费用，包括分摊的间接成本；以及 (v) 撤销所需的安全许可。违反政府采购法律可能导致民事或刑事处罚。

paras.en: We are also required to maintain special security clearances and comply with executive orders, federal laws and regulations, and customer security requirements for classified programs, and our government contracts impose cybersecurity and information assurance requirements, including implementation of information security protections in accordance with NIST Special Publication 800-171 and obligations to review and report certain cyber incidents. Failure to comply could result in suspension of payments, termination of contracts, civil or criminal penalties, or exclusion from future government contracting opportunities. For additional information, please refer to “Risk Factors—Risks Related to Our Business—Our services are subject to risks related to supplying services to the U.S. government.”
paras.zh: 我们还被要求持有特殊安全许可，并遵守涉密项目的行政命令、联邦法律和法规以及客户安全要求，我们的政府合同还施加了网络安全和信息保障要求，包括按照 NIST Special Publication 800-171 实施信息安全保护，以及审查和报告某些网络事件的义务。未能遵守可能导致暂停付款、终止合同、民事或刑事处罚，或被排除在未来政府承包机会之外。更多信息请参阅“风险因素——与我们业务相关的风险——我们的服务面临向美国政府提供服务相关的风险”。

paras.en: In addition, in connection with preparing leased real property for our launch operations at Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral, Florida, and Space Launch Complex 4 at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, we make significant capital improvements and install extensive real and personal property at these government-owned sites. The launch facilities we build are a unique capital improvement compared to standard commercial use sites because the federal government specifically designates these launch sites for aerospace activities, such as rocket launches. Given the specific use requirements of these government-owned sites, we have historically entered into handover agreements with the relevant government entities upon expiration or termination of the leases, pursuant to which the improvements are transferred to the government rather than removed. This fact pattern has historically been the case with previous leases such as at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
paras.zh: 此外，为在佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心和卡纳维拉尔角以及加利福尼亚州范登堡太空军基地 4 号航天发射综合体准备租赁不动产以开展发射运营，我们在这些政府所有的场址进行了重大资本改良并安装了大量不动产和动产。与标准商业用途场址相比，我们建造的发射设施是一项独特的资本改良，因为联邦政府专门将这些发射场址指定用于火箭发射等航空航天活动。鉴于这些政府所有场址的特定用途要求，我们历来在租约到期或终止时与相关政府实体签订移交协议，据此将改良设施移交给政府而非拆除。这一事实模式在以往的租约中一直如此，例如在卡纳维拉尔角太空军基地。

paras.en: We are involved in the legal proceedings described in Note 17, Commitments and Contingencies, in our audited consolidated financial statements and Note 16, Commitments and Contingencies in our unaudited consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus, and we are subject to other claims and litigation arising in the ordinary course of business. The outcome of any litigation is inherently uncertain, and if decided adversely to us, or if we determine that settlement of particular litigation is appropriate, we may be subject to liability that could have a material adverse effect on our business.
paras.zh: 我们涉及本招股说明书其他部分所载经审计合并财务报表附注 17“承诺与或有事项”以及未经审计合并财务报表附注 16“承诺与或有事项”中所述的法律诉讼，并且我们可能面临在正常业务过程中产生的其他索赔和诉讼。任何诉讼的结果本质上具有不确定性，如果判决对我们不利，或者如果我们认定对特定诉讼进行和解是适当的，我们可能承担的责任可能对我们的业务产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: Elon Musk has served as our Chief Executive Officer, Chief Technical Officer and Chairman of our board since May 2002. Mr. Musk is also the Technoking of Tesla and has served as Chief Executive Officer of Tesla since October 2008. Mr. Musk was Chief Technology Officer and on the board of directors of X, beginning October 2022 and served as the Chief Executive Officer and on the board of directors of xAI, beginning March 2023, in each case through the March 2025 merger of X and xAI. Following the merger, Mr. Musk served as the President, Treasurer, and Chief Executive Officer and on the board of directors of xAI, until it was acquired by the Company in February 2026. Mr. Musk is also a founder and Chief Executive Officer of Neuralink Corp., a company focused on developing brain-machine interfaces, and The Boring Company, an infrastructure company. Prior to the Company, Mr. Musk co-founded PayPal, an electronic payment system, which was acquired by eBay in October 2002, and Zip2 Corporation, a provider of Internet enterprise software and services, which was acquired by Compaq in March 1999. Mr. Musk serves on the board of directors of Tesla and previously served on the board of directors of Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc. from April 2021 to June 2022. Mr. Musk holds a B.A. in Physics from the University of Pennsylvania and a B.S. in Business from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania. Mr. Musk brings to our board historical knowledge, operational and technical expertise, and continuity.
paras.zh: 自 2002 年 5 月起，Elon Musk 一直担任我们的首席执行官、首席技术官及董事会主席。Musk 先生同时是 Tesla 的 Technoking，并自 2008 年 10 月起担任 Tesla 首席执行官。Musk 先生自 2022 年 10 月起担任 X 的首席技术官及董事会成员，并自 2023 年 3 月起担任 xAI 的首席执行官及董事会成员，上述职务均持续至 2025 年 3 月 X 与 xAI 合并之时。合并完成后，Musk 先生担任 xAI 的总裁、财务主管及首席执行官，并担任其董事会成员，直至 xAI 于 2026 年 2 月被本公司收购。Musk 先生同时是 Neuralink Corp.（一家专注于开发脑机接口的公司）和 The Boring Company（一家基础设施公司）的创始人兼首席执行官。在加入本公司之前，Musk 先生联合创立了电子支付系统 PayPal（该公司于 2002 年 10 月被 eBay 收购）以及互联网企业软件与服务提供商 Zip2 Corporation（该公司于 1999 年 3 月被 Compaq 收购）。Musk 先生担任 Tesla 董事会成员，并曾于 2021 年 4 月至 2022 年 6 月期间担任 Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.董事会成员。Musk 先生持有宾夕法尼亚大学物理学学士学位及宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院商学学士学位。Musk 先生为我们的董事会带来了历史积淀、运营与技术专长以及延续性。

paras.en: Gwynne Shotwell has served as our President and Chief Operating Officer since 2008 and has been a member of our board since March 2009. Previously, Ms. Shotwell served as our Vice President, Business Development, from 2002 to 2008. Prior to joining the Company, Ms. Shotwell held positions with Microcosm, Inc., an aerospace company, as a director, and The Aerospace Corporation, an independent, non-profit organization performing objective technical analyses and assessments for a variety of government, civil, and commercial customers, as a senior project engineer. Ms. Shotwell also serves on the board of directors of Polaris, Inc., a manufacturer of powersports vehicles, and on Northwestern University’s Board of Trustees. Ms. Shotwell was inducted into the National Academy of Engineering and was previously named the Satellite Executive of the Year, included on Time’s 100 Most Influential People, and Fortune Magazine’s World’s 50 Greatest Leaders. Ms. Shotwell holds a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering and an M.S. in Applied Mathematics from Northwestern University. As one of the key members of our leadership team, Ms. Shotwell brings to our board extensive operational experience and in-house knowledge of the Company’s operations, technology, research and development and business management.
paras.zh: Gwynne Shotwell 自 2008 年起担任我们的总裁兼首席运营官，并自 2009 年 3 月起担任我们的董事会成员。此前，Shotwell 女士于 2002 年至 2008 年担任我们的业务发展副总裁。在加入本公司之前，Shotwell 女士曾在航空航天公司 Microcosm, Inc.担任董事，并在 The Aerospace Corporation（一家为各类政府、民用及商业客户开展客观技术分析与评估的独立非营利组织）担任高级项目工程师。Shotwell 女士同时担任动力运动车辆制造商 Polaris, Inc.的董事会成员，以及西北大学董事会成员。Shotwell 女士入选美国国家工程院，并曾获评年度卫星高管，入选《时代》周刊 100 位最具影响力人物以及《财富》杂志全球 50 位最伟大领袖。Shotwell 女士持有西北大学机械工程学士学位及应用数学硕士学位。作为我们领导团队的核心成员之一，Shotwell 女士为我们的董事会带来了丰富的运营经验以及对公司运营、技术、研发和业务管理的内部深入了解。

paras.en: Bret Johnsen has served as our Chief Financial Officer since 2011. In this role, Mr. Johnsen leads our global finance organization and is responsible for our long-term financial strategy, internal financial operations, interactions with the financial community, and the financial aspects of our growth initiatives. With more than two decades of experience in financial leadership, primarily in high-profile technology and semiconductor companies, his leadership continues to play a key role in driving our financial performance, long-term value creation and operational discipline. Prior to joining the Company, Mr. Johnsen served as Chief Financial Officer at Mindspeed Technologies, Inc., a publicly traded semiconductor company, from 2008 to 2011. Prior to that role, he spent nearly a decade at Broadcom Inc., a global semiconductor company, from 1999 to 2008, holding roles of increasing responsibility within the organization, including serving as Vice President and Corporate Controller. Mr. Johnsen serves as a Trustee of the University of Southern California and holds a B.S. in Accounting from the University of Southern California and an M.S. in Finance from San Diego State University, and he is a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
paras.zh: Bret Johnsen 自 2011 年起担任我们的首席财务官。在该职位上，Johnsen 先生领导我们的全球财务组织，负责我们的长期财务战略、内部财务运营、与金融界的沟通以及我们增长举措的财务方面。凭借二十多年在财务领导岗位上的经验，主要是在知名科技和半导体公司，他的领导持续在推动我们的财务业绩、长期价值创造和运营纪律方面发挥关键作用。在加入本公司之前，Johnsen 先生于 2008 年至 2011 年担任 Mindspeed Technologies, Inc.（一家上市半导体公司）的首席财务官。在此之前，他于 1999 年至 2008 年在全球半导体公司 Broadcom Inc. 任职近十年，在组织内担任职责日益增加的职务，包括担任副总裁兼公司财务总监。Johnsen 先生担任南加州大学受托人，并持有南加州大学会计学学士学位和圣迭戈州立大学金融学硕士学位，且为注册会计师（CPA）。

paras.en: Ira Ehrenpreis has served on our board since February 2026. Mr. Ehrenpreis is a founder and managing member of DBL Partners, a leading impact investing venture capital firm, formed in 2015. Previously, he was a partner at Technology Partners, a venture capital firm. Mr. Ehrenpreis serves on the board of directors of Tesla. He serves as the Chairman of the VCNetwork, the largest and most active California venture capital organization. Mr. Ehrenpreis also serves as the Chair of the National Association of Corporate Directors (NACD) Northern California and the Co-Chair of the Stanford Precourt Institute for Energy Advisory Council. Among several other awards and honors, Mr. Ehrenpreis has been named a member of the NACD Directorship 100 for being “one of the most influential leaders in the boardroom and corporate governance community.” Mr. Ehrenpreis holds a B.A. from the University of California, Los Angeles and a J.D. and M.B.A. from Stanford University. Mr. Ehrenpreis brings to our board experience in the technology, impact and venture capital industries, as well as valuable insights in corporate governance, strategic growth and shareholder values.
paras.zh: Ira Ehrenpreis 自 2026 年 2 月起担任我们的董事会成员。Ehrenpreis 先生是 DBL Partners 的创始人兼管理成员，该公司是一家领先的影响力投资风险投资公司，成立于 2015 年。此前，他曾是风险投资公司 Technology Partners 的合伙人。Ehrenpreis 先生担任 Tesla 的董事会成员。他担任 VCNetwork 的主席，该组织是加利福尼亚州规模最大、最活跃的风险投资组织。Ehrenpreis 先生还担任全国公司董事协会（NACD）北加州分会主席，以及斯坦福 Precourt 能源研究所顾问委员会联合主席。除其他多项奖项和荣誉外，Ehrenpreis 先生还因“董事会和公司治理界最具影响力的领导者之一”而入选 NACD Directorship 100。Ehrenpreis 先生拥有加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校的文学学士学位，以及斯坦福大学的法学博士学位和工商管理硕士学位。Ehrenpreis 先生为我们的董事会带来了在科技、影响力投资和风险投资行业的经验，以及在公司治理、战略增长和股东价值方面的宝贵见解。

paras.en: Randy Glein has served on our board since February 2026 and previously served as a board observer since 2009. Mr. Glein is co-founder and managing partner of DFJ Growth, a venture capital firm that has invested in more than 100 growth-stage technology companies over the past 20 years. He currently serves on the board of directors of several private technology companies and has previously served on the board of directors of Anaplan, Inc. and Tremor Video, Inc. Prior to DFJ Growth, Mr. Glein served as Chief Financial Officer of FeedBurner (acquired by Google in 2007) and Vice President of Tribune Company and its corporate investment group, Tribune Ventures. Mr. Glein began his career in the aerospace industry as a systems engineer with Hughes Space & Communications and in business development roles with its DIRECTV and New Ventures units. Mr. Glein holds a B.S.E.E. in Electrical Engineering from the University of Florida, an M.S.E.E. in Electrical Engineering from the University of Southern California, and an M.B.A. from the UCLA Anderson School of Management. Mr. Glein brings to our board experience in the venture capital industry and more than 35 years of business and leadership experience in the technology, media, and satellite communications industries.
paras.zh: Randy Glein 自 2026 年 2 月起担任我们的董事会成员，此前自 2009 年起担任董事会观察员。Glein 先生是风险投资公司 DFJ Growth 的联合创始人兼管理合伙人，该公司在过去 20 年间投资了 100 多家成长期科技公司。他目前担任多家私营科技公司的董事会成员，此前曾担任 Anaplan, Inc. 和 Tremor Video, Inc. 的董事会成员。在 DFJ Growth 之前，Glein 先生曾担任 FeedBurner（于 2007 年被 Google 收购）的首席财务官，以及 Tribune Company 及其企业投资集团 Tribune Ventures 的副总裁。Glein 先生的职业生涯始于航空航天行业，曾担任 Hughes Space & Communications 的系统工程师，并在其 DIRECTV 和新业务部门担任业务拓展职务。Glein 先生拥有佛罗里达大学电气工程学士学位、南加利福尼亚大学电气工程硕士学位，以及 UCLA Anderson 管理学院的工商管理硕士学位。Glein 先生为我们的董事会带来了在风险投资行业的经验，以及在科技、媒体和卫星通信行业超过 35 年的商业和领导经验。

paras.en: Antonio J. Gracias has served on our board since October 2010. Since 2001, Mr. Gracias has been Chief Executive Officer and Chief Investment Officer of Valor Management LLC, a private equity firm. As Founder, CEO, and CIO of Valor, he oversees one of the leading growth-focused investment firms in the United States with over $55 billion in assets under management. He has served on the board of Neuralink Corp., a company focused on developing brain-machine interfaces, since May 2026, served on the board of The Boring Company, an infrastructure company, since May 2026 and served as a director of Harmony Biosciences Holdings, Inc., a pharmaceutical company, from September 2017 to May 2026. He also served as a director of Marathon Pharmaceuticals, LLC from November 2013 until its acquisition by PTC Therapeutics in May 2017, and SolarCity Corporation from 2012 to 2016. Mr. Gracias previously served as a director of Tesla from 2007 to 2021 helping take the company public and acting as Lead Independent Director for eight years. Prior to founding Valor Management LLC in 2001, Mr. Gracias served as Founder and Managing Member of MG Capital, a private equity firm headquartered in Chicago, where he was the lead transaction principal from 1995 through 2000. Prior to MG Capital, Mr. Gracias was an associate with Goldman, Sachs & Co. in New York, where he served the firm’s institutional clients in the International Equity Division. Mr. Gracias is also actively involved in philanthropic activities. He is a trustee of The Aspen Institute, where he was a 2009 Henry Crown Fellow, an Aspen Institute program designed to engage the next generation of leaders in the challenge of community-spirited leadership. Additionally, he serves as a member of several prestigious non-profit and endowment boards, including the Board of Visitors for the Georgetown University School of Foreign Service and the Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering at the University of Chicago. He is also a member of the University of Chicago Board of Trustees. Mr. Gracias holds a joint B.S. and M.S.F.S. (Honors Degree) in International Finance and Economics from the Georgetown University School of Foreign Service and a J.D. from the University of Chicago Law School. Mr. Gracias brings to our board skills and experience in investment strategy, portfolio company management and improvement, operations of business, and finance across several industries, including aerospace, technology, and manufacturing.
paras.zh: Antonio J. Gracias 自 2010 年 10 月起担任我们的董事会成员。自 2001 年起，Gracias 先生一直担任私募股权公司 Valor Management LLC 的首席执行官兼首席投资官。作为 Valor 的创始人、首席执行官兼首席投资官，他负责管理美国领先的以增长为重点的投资公司之一，管理资产超过 $55 billion。他自 2026 年 5 月起担任 Neuralink Corp.（一家专注于开发脑机接口的公司）的董事会成员，自 2026 年 5 月起担任 The Boring Company（一家基础设施公司）的董事会成员，并于 2017 年 9 月至 2026 年 5 月担任制药公司 Harmony Biosciences Holdings, Inc. 的董事。他还于 2013 年 11 月至 2017 年 5 月 Marathon Pharmaceuticals, LLC 被 PTC Therapeutics 收购期间担任该公司董事，并于 2012 年至 2016 年担任 SolarCity Corporation 的董事。Gracias 先生此前曾于 2007 年至 2021 年担任 Tesla 的董事，协助该公司完成上市，并担任首席独立董事八年。在 2001 年创立 Valor Management LLC 之前，Gracias 先生曾担任总部位于芝加哥的私募股权公司 MG Capital 的创始人兼管理成员，并于 1995 年至 2000 年期间担任主要交易负责人。在 MG Capital 之前，Gracias 先生曾在纽约的 Goldman, Sachs & Co. 担任助理，在国际股票部为该公司的机构客户提供服务。Gracias 先生还积极参与慈善活动。他是 The Aspen Institute 的受托人，并于 2009 年成为该机构的 Henry Crown Fellow，该项目旨在让下一代领导者参与社区精神领导力的挑战。此外，他还担任多个知名非营利组织和捐赠基金董事会的成员，包括乔治城大学外交学院和芝加哥大学普利兹克分子工程学院的访问委员会。他还是芝加哥大学董事会的成员。Gracias 先生拥有乔治城大学外交学院国际金融与经济学的理学学士和理学硕士（荣誉学位）联合学位，以及芝加哥大学法学院的法学博士学位。Gracias 先生为我们的董事会带来了投资策略、投资组合公司管理与改进、业务运营以及多个行业（包括航空航天、科技和制造业）财务方面的技能和经验。

paras.en: Donald Harrison has served on our board since February 2015. Mr. Harrison has served as President, Global Partnerships and Corporate Development at Google LLC, a technology company, since 2017. Mr. Harrison previously served as Vice-President, Corporate Development at Google from 2012 to 2017 and as Vice-President and Deputy General Counsel from 2005 to 2012. Mr. Harrison also sits on the board of directors of Reliance Jio, the largest mobile telecommunications services provider in India. Mr. Harrison holds a B.A. in Philosophy and Political Science from the University of King’s College and a J.D. and LLB from the University of Toronto. Mr. Harrison brings to our board years of business and leadership experience and provides valuable experience in the areas of strategic transactions and partnerships.
paras.zh: Donald Harrison 自 2015 年 2 月起担任我们的董事会成员。Harrison 先生自 2017 年起担任科技公司 Google LLC 的全球合作与企业发展总裁。Harrison 先生此前于 2012 年至 2017 年担任 Google 企业发展副总裁，并于 2005 年至 2012 年担任副总裁兼副总法律顾问。Harrison 先生还担任印度最大的移动电信服务提供商 Reliance Jio 的董事会成员。Harrison 先生拥有国王大学学院（University of King's College）哲学与政治学学士学位，以及多伦多大学的 J.D. 和 LLB 学位。Harrison 先生为我们的董事会带来了多年的商业和领导经验，并在战略交易和合作领域提供了宝贵的经验。

paras.en: Steve Jurvetson has served on our board since March 2009. Mr. Jurvetson is a co-founder of Future Ventures, a venture capital firm, which he founded in 2019, and previously he co-founded and served as Managing Director of Draper Fisher Jurvetson, a venture capital firm, from 1995 to 2017. Mr. Jurvetson serves as a director of The Metals Company, a deep sea mining exploration company, and also previously served as a director of Tesla from 2009 to 2020, and NeoPhotonics Corp. from 2004 to 2011. Mr. Jurvetson also served as a director of Planet Labs from 2011 to 2017 and a director of D-Wave from 2003 to 2020. Before co-founding Future Ventures and Draper Fisher Jurvetson, Mr. Jurvetson was an R&D Engineer at Hewlett-Packard, where seven of his chip designs were fabricated. He also worked in product marketing at Apple Inc. and NeXT and management consulting with Bain & Company. Mr. Jurvetson holds B.S. and M.S. degrees in Electrical Engineering from Stanford University and an M.B.A. from the Stanford Business School. Mr. Jurvetson brings to our board experience in the venture capital industry and years of business and leadership experience.
paras.zh: Steve Jurvetson 自 2009 年 3 月起担任我们的董事会成员。Jurvetson 先生是风险投资公司 Future Ventures 的联合创始人，该公司由他于 2019 年创立；此前，他于 1995 年至 2017 年联合创立风险投资公司 Draper Fisher Jurvetson 并担任董事总经理。Jurvetson 先生担任深海采矿勘探公司 The Metals Company 的董事，并曾于 2009 年至 2020 年担任 Tesla 的董事，于 2004 年至 2011 年担任 NeoPhotonics Corp. 的董事。Jurvetson 先生还曾于 2011 年至 2017 年担任 Planet Labs 的董事，并于 2003 年至 2020 年担任 D-Wave 的董事。在联合创立 Future Ventures 和 Draper Fisher Jurvetson 之前，Jurvetson 先生是 Hewlett-Packard 的研发工程师，其七项芯片设计在那里被制造出来。他还曾在 Apple Inc. 和 NeXT 从事产品营销工作，并在 Bain & Company 从事管理咨询工作。Jurvetson 先生拥有斯坦福大学电气工程学士和硕士学位，以及斯坦福商学院 M.B.A. 学位。Jurvetson 先生为我们的董事会带来了风险投资行业的经验以及多年的商业和领导经验。

paras.en: Luke Nosek has served on our board since July 2008. Mr. Nosek co-founded Gigafund, a venture capital firm, in July 2017, and has been Managing Partner since inception. Mr. Nosek previously co-founded Founders Fund, a venture capital fund, in April 2006, and served as General Partner through July 2017. Prior to that, Mr. Nosek co-founded and served as Vice President of Business Development, Vice President of Marketing, and Vice President of Strategy of PayPal, an electronic payment system, from November 1998 to February 2002. Mr. Nosek also serves as a member of the board of directors of various private companies, including Last Energy, a nuclear energy company that designs and manufactures small modular reactors, Emerald Cloud Lab, which operates remotely accessible and largely autonomous life science laboratories, and ResearchGate, an online platform connecting scientists and researchers with each other and their work. Mr. Nosek also served as a board member of DeepMind prior to its acquisition by Google. Mr. Nosek holds a B.S. in Computer Engineering from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. Mr. Nosek brings to the board experience in the venture capital industry and years of business and leadership experience.
paras.zh: Luke Nosek 自 2008 年 7 月起担任我们的董事会成员。Nosek 先生于 2017 年 7 月联合创立了风险投资公司 Gigafund，并自成立起担任管理合伙人。Nosek 先生此前于 2006 年 4 月联合创立了风险投资基金 Founders Fund，并担任普通合伙人至 2017 年 7 月。在此之前，Nosek 先生于 1998 年 11 月至 2002 年 2 月联合创立了电子支付系统 PayPal，并担任业务发展副总裁、市场营销副总裁和战略副总裁。Nosek 先生还担任多家私营公司的董事会成员，包括设计和制造小型模块化反应堆的核能公司 Last Energy、运营可远程访问且基本自主的生命科学实验室的 Emerald Cloud Lab，以及连接科学家和研究人员及其研究成果的在线平台 ResearchGate。Nosek 先生还曾在 DeepMind 被 Google 收购前担任其董事会成员。Nosek 先生拥有伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校计算机工程学士学位。Nosek 先生为董事会带来了风险投资行业的经验以及多年的商业和领导经验。

paras.en: On October 16, 2018, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York entered a final judgment approving the terms of a settlement, filed with the court on September 29, 2018, in connection with the actions taken by the SEC relating to Mr. Musk’s August 7, 2018 Twitter (now known as X) posts stating that he was considering taking Tesla private at a specified price and with secured financing. The SEC alleged that these posts were materially false and misleading, in violation of Section 10(b) of the Exchange Act and Rule 10b-5 thereunder. In settling the action, Mr. Musk did not admit or deny the SEC’s allegations and consented to the entry of a judgment that enjoined him from violating these laws, ordered him to pay a $20 million civil penalty and required him to comply with procedures implemented by Tesla with respect to preclearing his public statements about Tesla. While he was required to step down as chairman of the board of Tesla for three years, there is no restriction on Mr. Musk’s ability to serve as an officer or director on the board of directors of any public or private company. On April 26, 2019, this settlement was amended to further clarify the pre-clearance procedures applicable to his making certain public statements about Tesla. The amendment was subsequently approved by the District Court.
paras.zh: 2018 年 10 月 16 日，美国纽约南区联邦地区法院作出终审判决，批准了 2018 年 9 月 29 日提交法院的和解协议条款，该和解涉及 SEC 就马斯克先生 2018 年 8 月 7 日在 Twitter（现称 X）上发布帖子所称其正考虑以特定价格并借助已获担保的融资将特斯拉私有化一事所采取的行动。SEC 指控这些帖子存在重大虚假和误导性陈述，违反了《交易法》第 10(b)条及据此制定的第 10b-5 条规则。在和解该案时，马斯克先生既未承认也未否认 SEC 的指控，并同意接受一项判决：禁止其违反上述法律，判令其支付$20 million 民事罚款，并要求其遵守特斯拉就其公开声明事先审批所实施的程序。虽然他被要求辞去特斯拉董事会董事长职务三年，但对马斯克先生担任任何上市或非上市公司董事会高管或董事的能力并无限制。2019 年 4 月 26 日，该和解协议经修订，以进一步明确适用于其就特斯拉发表某些公开声明的事先审批程序。该修订随后获得地区法院批准。

paras.en: On April 3, 2026, in Pampena v. Musk, the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California entered a partial judgment against Mr. Musk in his personal capacity only in favor of lead plaintiffs on behalf of themselves and a class of investors who sold certain Twitter, Inc. equity securities between May 13 and October 4, 2022. The judgment is based on a jury verdict rendered on March 20, 2026 that found (i) in favor of plaintiffs on claims alleging that Mr. Musk violated Section 10(b) of the Exchange Act and Rule 10b-5 thereunder in connection with two statements made by Mr. Musk in May 2022 and (ii) in favor of Mr. Musk on claims challenging a third statement and alleging a “scheme to defraud” under Rules 10b-5(a) and (c). The claims in this case all concern Mr. Musk’s then-pending potential purchase of Twitter, Inc. On May 1, 2026, Mr. Musk challenged the partial judgment by filing a post-trial motion for judgment as a matter of law and motion to decertify the class. The motion practice is ongoing, and the Court is expected to hear these motions in June 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 3 日，在 Pampena 诉 Musk 一案中，美国加利福尼亚北区联邦地区法院仅以马斯克先生个人身份对其作出部分判决，支持首席原告代表其自身及一个在 2022 年 5 月 13 日至 10 月 4 日期间出售某些 Twitter, Inc.股权证券的投资者集体提出的主张。该判决基于 2026 年 3 月 20 日作出的陪审团裁决，该裁决认定：(i) 就指控马斯克先生 2022 年 5 月所作两项声明违反《交易法》第 10(b)条及据此制定的第 10b-5 条规则的主张，支持原告；以及(ii) 就质疑第三项声明并依据第 10b-5(a)和(c)条规则指控“欺诈计划”的主张，支持马斯克先生。本案中的主张均涉及马斯克先生当时尚待完成的对 Twitter, Inc.的潜在收购。2026 年 5 月 1 日，马斯克先生通过提交审后依法判决动议及撤销集体认证动议，对部分判决提出异议。该动议程序仍在进行中，法院预计将于 2026 年 6 月审理这些动议。

paras.en: There are no family relationships among any of our directors or executive officers.
paras.zh: 我们的任何董事或高级管理人员之间均不存在亲属关系。

paras.en: Upon completion of this offering, Mr. Musk will hold approximately 91.6% of our outstanding Class B common stock, which under our charter, as described under “Description of Capital Stock,” will be entitled to elect 51% of the total number of authorized directors (rounded up to the nearest whole number), and 82.4% of the total voting power of our outstanding common stock (or 82.3% if the underwriters exercise their option to purchase additional shares of Class A common stock in full). As a result, we will be a “controlled company” within the meaning of Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas corporate governance standards. Under the listing rules of Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas, a company of which more than 50% of the voting power with respect to director elections is held by another person or group of persons acting together is a “controlled company” and may elect not to comply with certain Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas corporate governance requirements, including the requirements that:
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，Musk 先生将持有我们约 91.6% 的已发行 B 类普通股，根据我们的公司章程（详见“股本说明”），该等股份有权选举获授权董事总人数的 51%（向上取整至最接近的整数），并占我们已发行普通股总投票权的 82.4%（若承销商全额行使购买额外 A 类普通股的选择权，则为 82.3%）。因此，我们将成为 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 公司治理标准所指的“受控公司”。根据 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 的上市规则，若某公司董事选举投票权超过 50% 由另一人或共同行动的一组人持有，该公司即为“受控公司”，并可以选择不遵守 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 的某些公司治理要求，包括以下要求：

paras.en: - a majority of such company’s board of directors consist of independent directors as defined under the listing rules of Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas;
paras.zh: - 该公司董事会多数成员应为 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 上市规则所定义的独立董事；

paras.en: - director nominees be selected or recommended for board of directors’ selection by a nominating committee composed entirely of independent directors, with a written charter addressing the nominations process as required under the listing rules of Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas;
paras.zh: - 董事候选人应由完全由独立董事组成的提名委员会遴选或推荐供董事会遴选，并制定书面章程，按 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 上市规则的要求规定提名程序；

paras.en: - the compensation committee be composed entirely of independent directors with a written charter addressing the committee’s purpose and responsibilities; and
paras.zh: - 薪酬委员会应完全由独立董事组成，并制定书面章程规定委员会的宗旨和职责；以及

paras.en: - annual performance evaluations of the compensation and nominating committees be conducted.
paras.zh: - 对薪酬委员会和提名委员会进行年度绩效评估。

paras.en: Following the completion of this offering, we intend to utilize certain of these exemptions. As a result, we do not expect to have a compensation and nominating committee that is composed entirely of independent directors or that has a committee charter that addresses all Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas requirements applicable to companies that are not controlled companies. Additionally, we may elect to take advantage of certain other exemptions in the future for as long as we remain a “controlled company.” Accordingly, our Class A shareholders will not have the same protections afforded to shareholders of companies that are subject to all of the corporate governance requirements of Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas. In the event that we cease to be a “controlled company” and our shares continue to be listed on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas, we will be required to comply with all of the applicable governance requirements within the applicable transition periods.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，我们打算利用其中某些豁免。因此，我们预计不会设立完全由独立董事组成的薪酬和提名委员会，也不会设立涵盖 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 对非受控公司适用的全部要求的委员会章程。此外，在我们仍为“受控公司”期间，我们未来可能会选择利用某些其他豁免。因此，我们的 A 类股东将无法享有受 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 全部公司治理要求约束的公司的股东所获得的同等保护。如果我们不再属于“受控公司”且我们的股份继续在 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 上市，我们将被要求在适用的过渡期内遵守所有适用的治理要求。

paras.en: Upon the consummation of the offering, our board will consist of eight directors. Subject to the terms of our charter and bylaws, the number of directors on our board will be determined from time to time by our board. Under the terms of our charter, the holders of our outstanding Class B common stock, voting separately as a class, will have the right to elect 51% of the total number of authorized directors, rounded up to the nearest whole number (the “Class B Directors”). Holders of Class A and Class B common stock, voting together as a single class, will elect the remaining members of our board (the “Common Stock Directors”). We expect that upon the completion of the offering Mr. Musk, Gwynne Shotwell, Antonio J. Gracias, Donald Harrison, and Luke Nosek will serve as the initial Class B Directors and Ira Ehrenpreis, Randy Glein, and Steve Jurvetson will serve as the initial Common Stock Directors.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，我们的董事会将由八名董事组成。根据我们公司章程和章程细则的条款，我们董事会的董事人数将不时由董事会确定。根据我们公司章程的条款，我们已发行 B 类普通股的持有人，作为一个类别单独投票，将有权选举授权董事总数的 51%，向上取整至最接近的整数（“B 类董事”）。A 类普通股和 B 类普通股的持有人，作为一个单一类别共同投票，将选举我们董事会的其余成员（“普通股董事”）。我们预计，在本次发行完成后，Musk 先生、Gwynne Shotwell、Antonio J. Gracias、Donald Harrison 和 Luke Nosek 将担任初始 B 类董事，Ira Ehrenpreis、Randy Glein 和 Steve Jurvetson 将担任初始普通股董事。

paras.en: Our board will be subject to annual elections. Each director will hold office until the next annual meeting of our shareholders and until his or her successor is duly elected and qualified or until his or her earlier death, resignation or removal (as provided in our charter). For additional information, please refer to “Description of Capital Stock.”
paras.zh: 我们的董事会将实行年度选举。每位董事的任期将持续至我们的下一届年度股东大会，直至其继任者被正式选举并符合资格，或直至其提前死亡、辞职或被免职（按我们公司章程的规定）。如需更多信息，请参阅“股本说明”。

full.sec: Role of our Board in Risk Oversight
full.secZh: 董事会在风险监督中的作用

paras.en: We face a number of risks, including those described under the section titled “Risk Factors” included elsewhere in this prospectus. Our board believes that risk management is an important part of establishing, updating and executing on our business strategy. Our board, as a whole and at the committee level, has oversight responsibility relating to risks that could affect our corporate strategy, business objectives, compliance, operations and financial condition and performance. Our board focuses its oversight on the most significant risks facing us and on the processes to identify, prioritize, assess, manage and mitigate those risks. While our board has an oversight role, management is principally tasked with direct responsibility for management and assessment of risks and the implementation of processes and controls to mitigate their effects on us.
paras.zh: 我们面临多项风险，包括本招股说明书其他部分“风险因素”一节所述的风险。我们的董事会认为，风险管理是制定、更新和执行我们业务战略的重要组成部分。我们的董事会作为一个整体以及在委员会层面，对可能影响我们公司战略、业务目标、合规、运营以及财务状况和业绩的风险负有监督责任。我们的董事会将监督重点放在我们面临的最重大风险，以及识别、优先排序、评估、管理和缓解这些风险的流程上。虽然我们的董事会承担监督职责，但管理层主要负责直接管理和评估风险，并实施流程和控制措施以减轻风险对我们的影响。

paras.en: Based upon information requested from and provided by each director concerning his or her background, employment and affiliations, our board has determined that each of Ira Ehrenpreis, Randy Glein, Donald Harrison, Steve Jurvetson, and Luke Nosek is independent within the meaning of the listing standards of Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas currently in effect. In making this determination, our board considered the relationships that each of these directors has with our company and all other facts and circumstances our board deemed relevant in determining their independence, including (i) the beneficial ownership of our capital stock by each such director and/or investment funds or other entities affiliated with them and (ii) the relationships set forth below under “Certain Relationships and Related Person Transactions.” The board also considered that Donald Harrison was employed by an organization that does business with Company. The amount received by the Company or such other organization in each of the last three fiscal years did not exceed the greater of $200,000 or 5% of either the Company’s or such organization’s consolidated gross revenues.
paras.zh: 根据向各位董事索取并由其提供的有关其背景、任职及关联关系的信息，我们的董事会已认定，Ira Ehrenpreis、Randy Glein、Donald Harrison、Steve Jurvetson 和 Luke Nosek 各自符合纳斯达克及 Nasdaq Texas 现行上市规则中关于独立性的含义。在作出该认定时，我们的董事会考虑了上述各位董事与本公司之间的关系，以及董事会在认定其独立性时认为相关的所有其他事实和情况，包括(i)上述各位董事和/或与其关联的投资基金或其他实体对我们股本的实益所有权，以及(ii)下文“特定关系及关联人士交易”项下所述的关系。董事会还考虑了 Donald Harrison 受雇于一家与本公司有业务往来的机构。本公司或该等其他机构在过去三个财年各年收到的金额均未超过 200,000 美元与本公司或该机构合并总收入的 5% 两者中的较高者。

paras.en: Upon the completion of this offering, as provided in our charter, our board will continue to be led by Mr. Musk. Pursuant to the terms of our charter, he can only be removed from the board and these leadership positions by the affirmative vote of the holders of a majority of the outstanding shares of our Class B common stock, voting separately as a class.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，根据我们章程的规定，我们的董事会将继续由马斯克先生领导。根据我们章程的条款，只有经我们 B 类普通股已发行股份的多数持有人作为单独类别表决投赞成票，才能将其从董事会及上述领导职位上免职。

paras.en: Our board has concluded that our current leadership structure is appropriate at this time.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会已得出结论，认为我们目前的领导结构在现阶段是适当的。

paras.en: In connection with the completion of this offering, our board established an audit committee and a compensation and nominating committee. Audit and compensation and nominating committees will be governed by their charters that will be available on our website at www.spacex.com. Pursuant to our bylaws, our board may, from time to time, establish other committees to facilitate the management of our business and operations. Information contained on our website or linked therein or otherwise connected thereto does not constitute part of nor is it incorporated by reference into this prospectus or the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.
paras.zh: 与本此发行完成相关，我们的董事会设立了审计委员会以及薪酬与提名委员会。审计委员会和薪酬与提名委员会将受其章程管辖，该等章程将在我们的网站 www.spacex.com 上提供。根据我们的章程细则，我们的董事会可不时设立其他委员会，以促进我们业务和运营的管理。我们网站上包含的信息或通过其链接或以其他方式与其相关的信息，不构成本招股说明书或本招股说明书作为其一部分的注册声明的一部分，也不通过引用并入其中。

paras.en: #### Audit Committee
paras.zh: #### 审计委员会

paras.en: The primary responsibilities of our audit committee will include, among other things:
paras.zh: 我们的审计委员会的主要职责将包括（但不限于）：

paras.en: - assisting our board in its oversight responsibilities regarding the integrity of our financial statements, our compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, the independent accountant’s qualifications and independence and our accounting and financial reporting processes of and the audits of our financial statements;
paras.zh: - 协助我们的董事会在以下方面履行监督职责：我们财务报表的完整性、我们对法律和监管要求的遵守情况、独立会计师的资质和独立性，以及我们的会计和财务报告流程及我们财务报表的审计；

paras.en: - preparing the report required by the SEC for inclusion in our annual proxy or information statement;
paras.zh: - 编制 SEC 要求纳入我们年度委托书或信息声明中的报告；

paras.en: - approving audit and non-audit services to be performed by the independent accountants; and
paras.zh: - 批准由独立会计师执行的审计和非审计服务；以及

paras.en: - performing such other functions as our board may from time to time assign to the audit committee.
paras.zh: - 履行我们的董事会可能不时分配给审计委员会的其他职能。

paras.en: The audit committee will be empowered to retain any advisors as it deems necessary or appropriate to assist it in fulfilling its responsibilities, and to approve the fees and other retention terms of such advisors.
paras.zh: 审计委员会将有权聘请其认为必要或适当的任何顾问，以协助其履行职责，并批准该等顾问的费用和其他聘用条款。

paras.en: Upon the completion of this offering, Randy Glein and Steve Jurvetson are expected to be the members of our audit committee. Randy Glein is expected to qualify as an “audit committee financial expert” as such term is defined under the rules of the SEC implementing Section 407 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and each of Randy Glein and Steve Jurvetson qualifies as an independent director for purposes of Rule 10A-3 of the Exchange Act and the listing standards of Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas. We will identify the third member to serve on the audit committee within the applicable one year period under the Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas listing rules. Randy Glein is expected to serve as the chair of the audit committee.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，Randy Glein 和 Steve Jurvetson 预计将担任我们审计委员会的成员。Randy Glein 预计将符合 SEC 实施《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》第 407 条规则所定义的“审计委员会财务专家”资格，且 Randy Glein 和 Steve Jurvetson 各自符合《交易法》第 10A-3 条规则以及 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 上市标准所规定的独立董事资格。我们将在 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 上市规则规定的适用一年期限内确定担任审计委员会成员的第三名人选。Randy Glein 预计将担任审计委员会主席。

paras.en: #### Compensation and Nominating Committee
paras.zh: #### 薪酬与提名委员会

paras.en: The primary responsibilities of our compensation and nominating committee will include, among other things:
paras.zh: 我们的薪酬与提名委员会的主要职责将包括（但不限于）：

paras.en: - overseeing the Company’s overall compensation philosophy;
paras.zh: - 监督公司的整体薪酬理念；

paras.en: - reviewing and approving, or recommending to the full board for approval, the compensation and other benefits for executive officers;
paras.zh: - 审议并批准或向全体董事会建议批准高级管理人员的薪酬及其他福利；

paras.en: - reviewing and recommending to our board for approval the form and amount of compensation for our independent directors;
paras.zh: - 审议并向董事会建议批准独立董事的薪酬形式及金额；

paras.en: - making recommendations to our board regarding director candidates and assisting our board in determining the composition of our board and its committees, subject to the terms of our charter; and
paras.zh: - 就董事候选人向董事会提出建议，并协助董事会确定董事会及其各委员会的构成，但须遵守公司章程的条款；以及

paras.en: - performing such other functions as our board may from time to time assign to the committee.
paras.zh: - 履行董事会不时授予该委员会的其他职能。

paras.en: Upon the completion of this offering, Ira Ehrenpreis, Antonio J. Gracias, and Luke Nosek are expected to be the members of our compensation and nominating committee. As a “controlled company,” we will rely upon the exemption from Nasdaq’s and Nasdaq Texas’ requirement that we have a compensation and nominating committee that is composed entirely of independent directors with a committee charter that addresses all Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas’ requirements applicable to companies that are not controlled companies. Each of Ira Ehrenpreis and Luke Nosek qualifies as an independent director under the listing standards of Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas, including the heightened independence standards for members of a compensation committee, and as a “non-employee director” as defined in Rule 16b-3 of the Exchange Act. Ira Ehrenpreis is expected to serve as the chair of the compensation and nominating committee.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，Ira Ehrenpreis、Antonio J. Gracias 和 Luke Nosek 预计将担任我们的薪酬与提名委员会成员。作为一家“受控公司”，我们将依赖纳斯达克和 Nasdaq Texas 相关要求的豁免，该等要求规定我们必须设立一个全部由独立董事组成的薪酬与提名委员会，且该委员会章程须涵盖纳斯达克和 Nasdaq Texas 适用于非受控公司的全部要求。Ira Ehrenpreis 和 Luke Nosek 均符合纳斯达克和 Nasdaq Texas 上市标准下的独立董事资格，包括薪酬委员会成员的更高独立性标准，并符合《交易法》第 16b-3 条所定义的“非雇员董事”资格。Ira Ehrenpreis 预计将担任薪酬与提名委员会主席。

full.sec: Compensation Committee Interlocks and Insider Participation
full.secZh: 薪酬委员会交叉任职与内部人参与

paras.en: During the last completed fiscal year, we were not a publicly traded company and did not have a compensation committee or any other committee serving a similar function. Historically, the board has been responsible for determining, and has made all decisions regarding, the compensation for Mr. Musk. With respect to those expected to serve as our other executive officers, Mr. Musk has had primary responsibility for compensation-related decisions; however, all equity awards were approved by the board.
paras.zh: 在最近一个已完成的财年中，我们并非上市公司，且未设立薪酬委员会或任何履行类似职能的其他委员会。历史上，董事会一直负责确定并已就马斯克先生的薪酬作出所有决定。对于预计将担任我们其他执行高管的人员，马斯克先生对薪酬相关决策负有主要责任；但所有股权奖励均已由董事会批准。

full.sec: Code of Business Conduct and Ethics

paras.en: In connection with this offering, our board will adopt a code of business conduct and ethics applicable to our employees, directors and officers, in accordance with applicable SEC rules and the corporate governance rules of Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas. We expect that any amendments to the code or any waivers of its requirements applicable to our directors and executive officers will be disclosed on our website at www.spacex.com, as and to the extent required by applicable SEC rules and the corporate governance rules of Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas. Information contained on our website or linked therein or otherwise connected thereto does not constitute part of, nor is it incorporated by reference into, this prospectus or the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.
paras.zh: 就本次发行而言，我们的董事会将根据适用的 SEC 规则以及纳斯达克和 Nasdaq Texas 的公司治理规则，通过一项适用于我们的员工、董事和高级管理人员的商业行为与道德准则。我们预计，对该准则的任何修订，或对其适用于我们的董事和高级管理人员的要求的任何豁免，将按照适用 SEC 规则以及纳斯达克和 Nasdaq Texas 公司治理规则的要求，在 www.spacex.com 网站上予以披露。我们网站上包含的信息、或通过链接指向或与之相关的信息，均不构成本招股说明书或本招股说明书所构成其一部分的注册声明的一部分，亦未通过引用并入其中。

paras.en: In connection with the completion of this offering, we intend to adopt corporate governance guidelines, which will set forth expectations for directors, director qualification standards, committee structure and functions and other policies for the governance of our company. A copy of our corporate governance guidelines will be posted on our website at www.spacex.com. Information contained on our website or linked therein or otherwise connected thereto does not constitute part of, nor is it incorporated by reference into, this prospectus or the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.
paras.zh: 为配合本次发行完成，我们拟采纳公司治理准则，其中将载明对董事的期望、董事任职资格标准、委员会架构与职能以及本公司治理的其他政策。我们的公司治理准则副本将发布于我们的网站 www.spacex.com。我们网站所载、通过链接指向或以其他方式与之关联的信息，均不构成本招股说明书或本招股说明书所构成其一部分的注册声明的一部分，亦未通过援引方式纳入其中。

paras.en: This Compensation Discussion and Analysis, or CD&A, provides an overview of our executive compensation philosophy, objectives, and design and each element of our executive compensation program with regard to the compensation awarded, to, earned by, or paid to the following named executive officers (collectively, our “NEOs”) for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (the “2025 Fiscal Year”), which includes all of our executive officers for the 2025 Fiscal Year. For the 2025 Fiscal Year, our NEOs were:
paras.zh: 本薪酬讨论与分析（CD&A）概述了我们的高管薪酬理念、目标与设计，以及我们高管薪酬计划的各项要素，涉及以下列名高管（合称“NEO”）在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的财年（“2025 财年”）内获授、赚取或支付的薪酬，其中包含我们 2025 财年的全部高管。2025 财年，我们的 NEO 为：

paras.en: **Name**

Elon Musk Chief Executive Officer, Chief Technical Officer and Chairman of the Board
Gwynne Shotwell President, Chief Operating Officer and Director
Bret Johnsen Chief Financial Officer
paras.zh:
Elon Musk 首席执行官、首席技术官兼董事会主席
Gwynne Shotwell 总裁、首席运营官兼董事
Bret Johnsen 首席财务官

full.secZh: 我们的薪酬理念与目标

paras.en: Our compensation program is designed to attract, retain and reward executives and employees, with a heavy emphasis on equity compensation to provide employees with a financial stake in our business and an ownership mindset. We offer a number of programs that allow employees to voluntarily elect to receive elements of their compensation in equity or to otherwise increase their ownership interests in the Company.
paras.zh: 我们的薪酬计划旨在吸引、留任并激励高管和员工，其中高度重视股权激励，使员工在我们的业务中拥有财务利益并具备主人翁意识。我们提供多项计划，允许员工自愿选择以股权形式获得部分薪酬，或以其他方式增加其在公司的持股权益。

paras.en: Historically, our board has been responsible for determining, and has made all decisions regarding, the compensation for Mr. Musk. With respect to the other NEOs, Mr. Musk has had primary responsibility for compensation-related decisions (in consultation with Ms. Shotwell with respect to Mr. Johnsen’s compensation). All equity awards are approved by our board.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，我们的董事会一直负责确定并已就马斯克先生的薪酬作出所有决定。对于其他 NEO，马斯克先生对薪酬相关决策负有主要责任（就 Johnsen 先生的薪酬而言，与 Shotwell 女士协商）。所有股权奖励均由我们的董事会批准。

paras.en: In connection with this offering, we established a compensation and nominating committee of our board who will oversee our executive compensation program going forward. The compensation and nominating committee, in consultation with Mr. Musk (other than with respect to his own compensation), will have primary responsibility for evaluating and approving the compensation of our NEOs or making recommendations regarding such compensation to our board when appropriate, including with respect to Mr. Musk’s compensation.
paras.zh: 就本次发行而言，我们设立了董事会薪酬与提名委员会，该委员会将负责监督我们未来的高管薪酬计划。薪酬与提名委员会在与马斯克先生协商（就其本人薪酬除外）后，将主要负责评估和批准我们 NEO 的薪酬，或在适当时就此类薪酬向我们的董事会提出建议，包括就马斯克先生的薪酬提出建议。

paras.en: #### Base Salary
paras.zh: #### 基本工资

paras.en: Each NEO’s base salary is a fixed component of compensation for performing specific job duties and functions. Base salaries are generally reviewed on an annual basis, taking into account the NEO’s experience and responsibilities. Mr. Musk’s base salary of $54,080 has remained unchanged since 2019, and prior to our relocation to Texas in 2024 was tied to California’s minimum salary for exempt employees. Mr. Musk has historically determined the base salary for Ms. Shotwell, which was increased from $1,040,000 to $1,080,000 effective April 20, 2025. Mr. Musk and Ms. Shotwell have historically determined the base salary for Mr. Johnsen, which was increased from $780,000 to $825,000 on April 6, 2025, with retroactive effect for the full 2025 Fiscal Year.
paras.zh: 每位 NEO 的基本工资是履行特定工作职责和职能的固定薪酬组成部分。基本工资通常每年审核一次，并考虑 NEO 的经验和职责。马斯克先生 54,080 美元的基本工资自 2019 年以来一直未变，且在我们于 2024 年迁至德克萨斯州之前，该工资与加利福尼亚州豁免员工最低工资挂钩。马斯克先生历来确定肖特韦尔女士的基本工资，该工资自 2025 年 4 月 20 日起从 1,040,000 美元提高至 1,080,000 美元。马斯克先生和肖特韦尔女士历来确定约翰森先生的基本工资，该工资于 2025 年 4 月 6 日从 780,000 美元提高至 825,000 美元，并对 2025 财年全年具有追溯效力。

paras.en: As participants in a broader employee equity election program, our NEOs, other than Mr. Musk, were eligible to elect to receive all or a portion of their base salary in the form of restricted stock units (“RSUs”). For the 2025 Fiscal Year, Ms. Shotwell received $353,077 of her base salary in cash and the remainder as a grant of 19,650 RSUs that vested 50% on May 15, 2025 and 50% on November 15, 2025, and Mr. Johnsen elected to receive his base salary fully in cash. The base salaries paid to our NEOs reflect the only cash compensation that they are eligible to receive, as no NEO participates in an annual bonus program.
paras.zh: 作为更广泛的员工股权选择计划的参与者，除马斯克先生外，我们的 NEO 有资格选择以限制性股票单位（“RSU”）形式领取全部或部分基本工资。2025 财年，肖特韦尔女士以现金形式领取了其基本工资中的 353,077 美元，其余部分以 19,650 份 RSU 授予的形式领取，该等 RSU 于 2025 年 5 月 15 日归属 50%，于 2025 年 11 月 15 日归属 50%；约翰森先生选择以现金形式全额领取其基本工资。支付给我们 NEO 的基本工资反映了他们有资格获得的唯一现金薪酬，因为没有 NEO 参与年度奖金计划。

paras.en: #### Long-Term Incentive Compensation
paras.zh: #### 长期激励薪酬

paras.en: In 2025, we granted long-term incentive compensation under our 2024 Equity Incentive Plan (the “2024 Plan”), which replaced our 2015 Equity Incentive Plan (the “2015 Plan”) with respect to new grants; however, outstanding grants under the 2015 Plan remained outstanding and subject to the terms of the 2015 Plan, which are substantially similar to the terms of the 2024 Plan. The 2024 Plan provides for the issuance of up to 365,950,000 shares of Class C common stock thereunder pursuant to stock options (which may be either incentive stock options or nonstatutory stock options), RSUs, and other equity awards, in each case, on the terms determined by our board. It is expected that, in connection with and following the completion of this offering, all outstanding awards under the 2015 Plan and the 2024 Plan will remain outstanding and continue to be subject to their existing terms; however, awards in respect of Class C common stock will be converted into awards in respect of Class A common stock on a one-for-one basis as part of the Class C Reclassification. It is expected that the 2024 Plan will be amended and restated in connection with this offering, as described below.
paras.zh: 2025 年，我们根据 2024 年股权激励计划（“2024 年计划”）授予了长期激励薪酬，该计划就新授予而言取代了我们的 2015 年股权激励计划（“2015 年计划”）；然而，2015 年计划项下的未兑现授予仍然未兑现，并受 2015 年计划条款约束，该等条款与 2024 年计划条款基本相似。2024 年计划规定，可根据股票期权（可为激励性股票期权或非法定股票期权）、RSU 和其他股权奖励发行最多 365,950,000 股 C 类普通股，每种情况均按我们董事会确定的条款进行。预计在本次发行完成时及之后，2015 年计划和 2024 年计划项下的所有未兑现奖励将继续未兑现，并继续受其现有条款约束；然而，作为 C 类重新分类的一部分，有关 C 类普通股的奖励将按一比一的比例转换为有关 A 类普通股的奖励。预计 2024 年计划将就本次发行进行修订和重述，如下文所述。

paras.en: Given his significant ownership interest in our Company, Mr. Musk was not granted any annual long-term incentive compensation in 2025, and generally does not participate in our annual long-term incentive compensation program. However, as part of our efforts to further incentivize Mr. Musk to achieve our long-term business objectives, the board granted him a performance-based award of restricted shares of Class B common stock in January 2026, as described further under “—2026 Compensation Developments” below.
paras.zh: 鉴于马斯克先生在本公司的重大所有权权益，马斯克先生在 2025 年未获授予任何年度长期激励薪酬，且通常不参与我们的年度长期激励薪酬计划。然而，作为我们进一步激励马斯克先生实现长期业务目标的努力的一部分，董事会于 2026 年 1 月向其授予了一项基于业绩的 B 类普通股限制性股份奖励，详见下文“—2026 年薪酬发展”所述。

paras.en: Ms. Shotwell was eligible to participate in our long-term incentive election program with a target award of $5 million, pursuant to which she could elect to receive 20% of her target award in cash or RSUs that vest after six months and 80% of her target award in cash vesting over five years, RSUs vesting over five years or stock options vesting over six years. In accordance with her elections, on May 10, 2025, our board granted Ms. Shotwell 27,030 RSUs, representing $1 million of her target award, that vested on November 15, 2025 and stock options to purchase 324,325 shares of Class C common stock, representing $4 million of her target award, which vest as to 12.5% on May 15, 2027 and monthly thereafter in equal installments through November 15, 2030, in each case, subject to Ms. Shotwell’s continued employment with us through the applicable vesting date.
paras.zh: Shotwell 女士有资格参与我们的长期激励选择计划，目标授予价值为 $5 million，根据该计划，她可以选择以现金或六个月后归属的 RSU 形式获得其目标授予价值的 20%，以及以五年内归属的现金、五年内归属的 RSU 或六年内归属的股票期权形式获得其目标授予价值的 80%。根据她的选择，2025 年 5 月 10 日，我们的董事会授予 Shotwell 女士 27,030 份 RSU（代表其目标授予价值中的 $1 million），该等 RSU 于 2025 年 11 月 15 日归属；并授予其可购买 324,325 股 C 类普通股的股票期权（代表其目标授予价值中的 $4 million），该等期权于 2027 年 5 月 15 日归属 12.5%，此后每月等额归属，直至 2030 年 11 月 15 日；在每种情况下，均以 Shotwell 女士在适用归属日期前持续受雇于我们为前提。

paras.en: Because Mr. Johnsen held outstanding stock options tied to aggressive performance milestones, a portion of which were adjusted in 2026 as described further under “—2026 Compensation Developments” below, he was not eligible to participate in the long-term incentive election program described above. Instead, Mr. Johnsen’s long-term incentive award for the 2025 Fiscal Year consisted exclusively of stock options to purchase 324,325 shares of Class C common stock, which was granted by our board on May 10, 2025. These stock options vest as to 40% in equal monthly installments from January 1, 2027 through December 1, 2027 and as to 60% in equal monthly installments from January 1, 2028 through December 1, 2030, in each case, subject to Mr. Johnsen’s continued employment with us through the applicable vesting date.
paras.zh: 由于 Johnsen 先生持有与激进业绩里程碑挂钩的未行使股票期权（其中一部分已于 2026 年调整，详见下文“——2026 年薪酬发展”），他没有资格参与上述长期激励选择计划。因此，Johnsen 先生在 2025 财年的长期激励授予完全由可购买 324,325 股 C 类普通股的股票期权构成，该等期权由我们的董事会于 2025 年 5 月 10 日授予。该等股票期权自 2027 年 1 月 1 日至 2027 年 12 月 1 日按月等额归属 40%，并自 2028 年 1 月 1 日至 2030 年 12 月 1 日按月等额归属 60%；在每种情况下，均以 Johnsen 先生在适用归属日期前持续受雇于我们为前提。

paras.en: On October 20, 2025, as a special equity grant intended to further promote their retention, reward their individual performance, and encourage efforts to continue growing the Company, our board granted Ms. Shotwell stock options to purchase 3,537,740 shares of Class C common stock and granted Mr. Johnsen stock options to purchase 141,510 shares of Class C common stock. These special stock options vest as to 20% on September 30, 2027 and monthly thereafter in equal installments through September 30, 2031, in each case, subject to the NEO’s continued employment with us through the applicable vesting date.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月 20 日，作为旨在进一步促进留任、奖励个人业绩并鼓励继续推动公司增长的特殊股权授予，我们的董事会授予 Shotwell 女士可购买 3,537,740 股 C 类普通股的股票期权，并授予 Johnsen 先生可购买 141,510 股 C 类普通股的股票期权。该等特殊股票期权于 2027 年 9 月 30 日归属 20%，此后每月等额归属，直至 2031 年 9 月 30 日；在每种情况下，均以该 NEO 在适用归属日期前持续受雇于我们为前提。

paras.en: #### Other Elements of Compensation
paras.zh: #### 薪酬的其他要素

paras.en: Retirement Benefits
paras.zh: 退休福利

paras.en: All of our U.S. employees, including our NEOs, are eligible to participate in our 401(k) plan, which is a broad-based, tax-qualified defined contribution retirement plan. Under the 401(k) plan, we may make discretionary matching and non-elective contributions, subject to certain limits under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”), and such contributions would vest ratably and would be 100% vested after five years of credited service; however, no such company contributions were made for 2025.
paras.zh: 我们所有美国员工（包括我们的 NEO）均有资格参与我们的 401(k) 计划，该计划是一项面向广泛员工、符合税务资格的界定供款退休计划。根据 401(k) 计划，我们可作出酌情匹配供款和非选择性供款，但须遵守经修订的《1986 年国内税收法典》（“法典”）的某些限制；该等供款将按比例归属，并在五年计入服务期后 100% 归属；但是，2025 年未作出任何此类公司供款。

paras.en: Employee Stock Purchase Plans
paras.zh: 员工购股计划

paras.en: Historically, we have provided two employee stock purchase plans in which all of our U.S. employees, including the NEOs, are eligible to participate. Our Amended and Restated 2017 Employee Stock Purchase Plan (the “2017 ESPP”) is intended to qualify under Section 423 of the Code and allows eligible employees to purchase shares of Class C common stock using accumulated payroll contributions at a discount. It is expected that the 2017 ESPP will be amended and restated in connection with this offering, as described below. Our 2023 Non-Qualified ESPP (the “NQ ESPP”) is not intended to qualify under Section 423 of the Code and allows eligible employees to purchase shares of Class C common stock using accumulated payroll contributions at fair market value. Our NQ ESPP will be discontinued in connection with this offering.
paras.zh: 历史上，我们提供了两项员工购股计划，我们所有美国员工（包括 NEO）均有资格参与。我们经修订和重述的 2017 年员工购股计划（“2017 ESPP”）旨在符合《税法》第 423 条规定的资格条件，并允许符合条件的员工使用累积的工资扣款以折扣价购买 C 类普通股股票。预计 2017 ESPP 将根据本次发行进行修订和重述，具体如下所述。我们的 2023 年非合格 ESPP（“NQ ESPP”）不旨在符合《税法》第 423 条规定的资格条件，并允许符合条件的员工使用累积的工资扣款按公平市场价值购买 C 类普通股股票。我们的 NQ ESPP 将根据本次发行终止。

paras.en: #### 2026 Compensation Developments

On January 13, 2026, our board approved the grant of 1 billion performance-based restricted shares of Class B common stock to Mr. Musk. The restricted shares vest upon (i) our achievement of specified market capitalization milestones across 15 equal tranches and (ii) the Company’s establishment of a permanent human colony on Mars with at least one million inhabitants, in each case, subject to Mr. Musk’s continued employment with us through the date on which achievement is certified by our board. Mr. Musk has the right to vote all of these performance-based restricted shares of Class B common stock that remain outstanding. For any tranche of the award to vest, both the applicable market capitalization milestone for such tranche and the human colony milestone must be met. In connection with the xAI Merger that closed on February 2, 2026, the market capitalization milestones were equitably adjusted in accordance with the terms of the award agreement to the following:
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月 13 日，我们的董事会批准向马斯克先生授予 10 亿股基于业绩的 B 类普通股限制性股票。该等限制性股票在以下条件满足时归属：(i) 我们实现指定的市值里程碑，分为 15 个等额批次，以及 (ii) 公司建立至少拥有一百万居民的永久性火星人类殖民地；在每种情况下，均须马斯克先生持续受雇于我们直至董事会认证达成之日。马斯克先生有权对所有这些仍发行在外的基于业绩的 B 类普通股限制性股票进行投票。任何批次奖励的归属，均须同时满足该批次适用的市值里程碑和人类殖民地里程碑。就于 2026 年 2 月 2 日完成交割的 xAI 合并而言，市值里程碑已根据奖励协议条款进行公平调整，调整如下：

paras.en: Milestone
paras.zh: 里程碑

paras.en: In connection with the xAI Merger, we also assumed a performance stock award originally granted to Mr. Musk by xAI on November 26, 2025. In accordance with the terms of that award agreement, the award was adjusted to account for the xAI Merger and, following such adjustment, reflected Mr. Musk’s right to receive shares of our Class A common stock equal to 0.20% of the fully diluted capitalization of the Company upon achievement of each of 12 valuation milestones ranging from $1.065 trillion to $6.565 trillion, with each milestone reflecting $500 billion in additional valuation, in each case, subject to Mr. Musk’s continued employment with us. The first valuation milestone was achieved prior to the xAI Merger, and Mr. Musk was issued 25,172,695 shares of our Class A common stock in settlement of that portion of the award. On March 23, 2026, this award and the 25,172,695 shares earned upon achievement of the first valuation milestone were cancelled and replaced with a grant of 302,072,285 performance-based restricted shares of Class B common stock, which vest upon both (i) achievement of specified market capitalization milestones across 12 equal tranches ranging from $1.065 trillion to $6.565 trillion, with each milestone reflecting $500 billion in additional valuation, and (ii) the Company’s completion of non-Earth-based data centers capable of delivering 100 terawatts of compute per year, in each case, subject to Mr. Musk’s continued employment with us through the date on which achievement is certified by our board. Mr. Musk has the right to vote all of these performance-based restricted shares of Class B common stock that remain outstanding.
paras.zh: 就 xAI 合并而言，我们还承接了一项最初由 xAI 于 2025 年 11 月 26 日授予马斯克先生的业绩股票奖励。根据该奖励协议的条款，该奖励已就 xAI 合并进行了调整；经调整后，该奖励体现为马斯克先生有权在实现 12 个估值里程碑（从 $1.065 万亿到 $6.565 万亿，每个里程碑对应 $5000 亿的估值增量）中的每一个后，获得相当于公司完全稀释后资本总额 0.20% 的公司 A 类普通股股份，且每一情形均以马斯克先生继续受雇于我们为前提。第一个估值里程碑已在 xAI 合并前实现，马斯克先生已就该部分奖励获发 25,172,695 股公司 A 类普通股。2026 年 3 月 23 日，该奖励及因实现第一个估值里程碑而获得的 25,172,695 股股份被注销，并替换为 302,072,285 股基于业绩的 B 类普通股限制性股份授予；该等股份在以下两项条件均满足时归属：(i) 实现 12 个等额批次（从 $1.065 万亿到 $6.565 万亿，每个里程碑对应 $5000 亿的估值增量）中规定的市值里程碑，以及 (ii) 公司完成能够每年提供 100 太瓦算力的非地球数据中心，且每一情形均以马斯克先生继续受雇于我们直至董事会认证相关成就之日为前提。马斯克先生有权对所有这些仍发行在外的基于业绩的 B 类普通股限制性股份进行投票。

paras.en: On January 4, 2026, our board approved an amendment to Mr. Johnsen’s 4 million performance-based stock options originally granted in 2024. In lieu of vesting based on free cash flow achievement in excess of a baseline, 371,125 of the stock options will vest for each $10 billion in adjusted EBITDA achieved during the 2025 through 2029 fiscal years, assessed on an annual basis. For purposes of this award, adjusted EBITDA is calculated as income from operations excluding (i) depreciation and amortization, (ii) share-based compensation, (iii) impairment, and (iv) restructuring impacts. Once a tranche of the stock options have become earned as a result of our adjusted EBITDA performance as of the end of a particular fiscal year, such stock options remain subject to an additional one-year and one day service-based vesting requirement following December 31 of the fiscal year in which such tranche was earned. None of the stock options became earned on account of our 2025 Fiscal Year adjusted EBITDA performance.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月 4 日，我们的董事会批准对 Johnsen 先生最初于 2024 年授予的 400 万份基于业绩的股票期权进行修订。替代以超过基线的自由现金流达成情况作为归属条件，在 2025 至 2029 财年期间，每实现 $10 billion 的调整后 EBITDA，将有 371,125 份股票期权归属，按年度进行评估。就本奖励而言，调整后 EBITDA 计算为经营利润，不包括 (i) 折旧和摊销、(ii) 股份支付薪酬、(iii) 减值，以及 (iv) 重组影响。一旦某一批次的股票期权因截至某一特定财年末我们的调整后 EBITDA 业绩而获得，该等股票期权仍需在该批次获得所在财年的 12 月 31 日之后满足额外一年零一天的服务期归属要求。由于我们 2025 财年的调整后 EBITDA 业绩，没有任何股票期权获得归属。
