full.sec: Potential Payments Upon Termination or Change in Control
full.secZh: 终止雇佣或控制权变更时的潜在付款

paras.en: None of our NEOs are party to an employment agreement or severance arrangement that provides for payments or benefits upon termination of employment or a change in control of the Company. Under the terms of the RSU award agreements, in the event of an NEO’s death, the RSUs scheduled to vest within the following 12-month period would become vested. No NEOs held outstanding RSUs as of December 31, 2025. No other equity award agreements provide for benefits upon termination of employment or a change in control of the Company.
paras.zh: 我们的任何 NEO 均未签署任何雇佣协议或遣散安排，规定在雇佣终止或公司控制权变更时支付款项或提供福利。根据 RSU 授予协议的条款，若 NEO 身故，原定于其后 12 个月内归属的 RSU 将予以归属。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，没有任何 NEO 持有未归属的 RSU。其他任何股权授予协议均未规定在雇佣终止或公司控制权变更时提供福利。

paras.en: **Amended and Restated 2024 Equity Incentive Plan**
paras.zh: **经修订和重述的 2024 年股权激励计划**

paras.en: In connection with this offering, we amended and restated our 2024 Plan (the “A&R 2024 Plan”). The purpose of the A&R 2024 Plan is to secure and retain the services of eligible employees, directors and consultants to provide incentives for such persons to exert maximum efforts for the success of the Company and to provide a means by which such eligible recipients may be given an opportunity to benefit from increases in value of our Class A common stock. The A&R 2024 Plan allows for the grant of stock options, both incentive stock options and “nonstatutory” stock options; stock appreciation rights (“SARs”); restricted stock; RSUs; and other equity awards. We refer to these collectively herein as “Awards.”
paras.zh: 就本次发行而言，我们修订并重述了我们的 2024 年计划（下称“经修订和重述的 2024 年计划”）。经修订和重述的 2024 年计划的目的是确保并留住合资格员工、董事和顾问的服务，激励该等人员为公司成功付出最大努力，并为该等合资格获授人提供从我们 A 类普通股价值增长中获益的机会。经修订和重述的 2024 年计划允许授予股票期权（包括激励性股票期权和“非法定”股票期权）、股票增值权（“SARs”）、限制性股票、RSU 及其他股权奖励。我们在本文中统称其为“奖励”。

paras.en: The following description of the A&R 2024 Plan is not intended to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the complete text of the A&R 2024 Plan, a copy of which will be filed as an exhibit to the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. Please read the A&R 2024 Plan in its entirety.
paras.zh: 以下对经修订和重述的 2024 年计划的描述并非完整描述，其全部内容以经修订和重述的 2024 年计划的完整文本为准，该文本将作为本招股说明书所构成部分的注册声明的附件提交。请完整阅读经修订和重述的 2024 年计划。

paras.en: #### Administration

The A&R 2024 Plan will be administered by our board or a committee thereof designated by our board to administer the A&R 2024 Plan, which we refer to herein as the “Plan Administrator.” The Plan Administrator will have broad authority, subject to the provisions of the A&R 2024 Plan, to administer and interpret the A&R 2024 Plan and Awards granted thereunder. All decisions and actions of the Plan Administrator will be final, binding and conclusive on all persons.
paras.zh: 经修订和重述的 2024 年计划将由我们的董事会或董事会指定负责管理经修订和重述的 2024 年计划的委员会管理，我们在本文中称其为“计划管理人”。在经修订和重述的 2024 年计划条款的约束下，计划管理人将拥有广泛的管理和解释经修订和重述的 2024 年计划及据此授予的奖励的权力。计划管理人的所有决定和行动对所有人均为最终、具有约束力和决定性的。

paras.en: #### Stock Subject to A&R 2024 Plan
paras.zh: #### 经修订和重述的 2024 年计划项下的股票

paras.en: The maximum number of shares of Class A common stock that may be issued under the A&R 2024 Plan will not exceed 365,950,000 shares (the “Share Reserve”), inclusive of shares issued under the 2024 Plan prior to the adoption of the A&R 2024 Plan. The Share Reserve is subject to certain adjustments in the event of a change in our capitalization. Shares of Class A common stock issued under the A&R 2024 Plan may be authorized but unissued or reacquired shares, including shares repurchased by the Company on the open market or otherwise.
paras.zh: 经修订和重述的 2024 年计划项下可发行的 A 类普通股最大股数不超过 365,950,000 股（“股份储备”），包括在通过经修订和重述的 2024 年计划之前根据 2024 年计划发行的股份。股份储备在我们资本结构发生变动时将进行某些调整。根据经修订和重述的 2024 年计划发行的 A 类普通股可以是已授权但未发行或重新取得的股份，包括公司在公开市场或其他方式回购的股份。

paras.en: Shares of Class A common stock subject to any award under our 2012 Equity Incentive Plan or the 2015 Plan that expires, terminates or is forfeited or that are reacquired, withheld or not issued to satisfy a tax withholding obligation will be added to the Share Reserve. Shares of Class A common stock subject to any award under the A&R 2024 Plan that expires, terminates or is forfeited or that are reacquired, withheld or not issued to satisfy a tax withholding obligation or payment of an exercise price will be again be available for issuance under the A&R 2024 Plan.
paras.zh: 根据我们的 2012 年股权激励计划或 2015 年计划授予的任何奖励所对应的 A 类普通股股份，若到期、终止或被没收，或被重新收购、扣留或未发行以满足预扣税义务，则该等股份将被加入股份储备。根据 A&R 2024 计划授予的任何奖励所对应的 A 类普通股股份，若到期、终止或被没收，或被重新收购、扣留或未发行以满足预扣税义务或支付行权价，则该等股份将再次可用于 A&R 2024 计划项下的发行。

paras.en: #### Eligibility
paras.zh: #### 参与资格

paras.en: Current or prospective employees, non-employee directors and consultants of the Company and its affiliates will be eligible to participate in the A&R 2024 Plan.
paras.zh: 公司及其关联方的现任或潜在员工、非员工董事及顾问将有资格参与 A&R 2024 计划。

paras.en: #### Types of Awards
paras.zh: #### 奖励类型

paras.en: Stock Options. Stock options granted under the A&R 2024 Plan may be granted as incentive stock options or nonstatutory stock options, in either case with a term not to exceed 10 years (or five years for incentive stock options granted to 10% shareholders). Subject to the express provisions of the A&R 2024 Plan, stock options generally may be exercised over such period, in installments or otherwise, as the Plan Administrator may determine. The exercise price for any stock option granted may not generally be less than the fair market value of the Class A common stock subject to that option on the grant date (or 110% of the fair market value for incentive stock options granted to 10% shareholders). The exercise price may be paid in cash or such other method as determined by the Plan Administrator, including an irrevocable commitment by a broker to pay over such amount from a sale of the shares issuable under an option, the delivery of previously owned shares, or withholding of shares deliverable upon exercise.
paras.zh: 股票期权。根据 A&R 2024 计划授予的股票期权可作为激励性股票期权或非法定股票期权授予，无论哪种情形，其期限均不得超过 10 年（对于授予 10% 股东的激励性股票期权，则为五年）。在遵守 A&R 2024 计划明确条款的前提下，股票期权通常可在计划管理人确定的期间内、分期或以其他方式行使。任何已授予股票期权的行权价通常不得低于授予日该期权所对应 A 类普通股的公允市场价值（对于授予 10% 股东的激励性股票期权，则为公允市场价值的 110%）。行权价可以现金或计划管理人确定的其他方式支付，包括由经纪人不可撤销地承诺从出售期权项下可发行股份的所得款项中支付该金额、交付先前持有的股份，或扣留行使时可交付的股份。

paras.en: Stock Appreciation Rights. SARs represent, upon exercise, the right to receive the amount by which the fair market value of the Class A common stock at the time of exercise exceeds the exercise price of the SAR. This amount is payable in Class A common stock, cash, or a combination thereof, or in any other form of consideration at the Plan Administrator’s discretion. The exercise price for any SARs may not generally be less than the fair market value of the Class A common stock subject to the SAR on the grant date and may not have a term in excess of 10 years.
paras.zh: 股票增值权。股票增值权（SAR）在行使时代表有权获得行使时 A 类普通股的公允市场价值超过该 SAR 行权价的金额。该金额可以 A 类普通股、现金或其组合，或计划管理人酌情决定的其他任何形式的对价支付。任何 SAR 的行权价通常不得低于授予日该 SAR 所对应 A 类普通股的公允市场价值，且期限不得超过 10 年。

paras.en: Restricted Stock and RSUs. Awards of restricted stock consist of shares of stock that are transferred to the participant subject to restrictions that may result in forfeiture if specified conditions are not satisfied. RSUs result in the transfer of shares of Class A common stock, cash or other form of consideration to the participant only after specified conditions are satisfied. The Plan Administrator will determine the restrictions and conditions applicable to each award of restricted stock or RSUs, which may include performance vesting conditions.
paras.zh: 限制性股票和 RSU。限制性股票奖励由转让给参与者的股份构成，但须遵守相关限制，若未满足特定条件，可能导致没收。RSU 仅在满足特定条件后，才向参与者转让 A 类普通股股份、现金或其他形式的对价。计划管理人将确定适用于每项限制性股票或 RSU 奖励的限制和条件，其中可能包括业绩归属条件。

paras.en: Other Equity Awards. Other equity awards are Awards valued in whole or in part by reference to, or otherwise based, on Class A common stock, including the appreciation in value thereof. Other equity awards may be granted either alone or in tandem with other Awards under the A&R 2024 Plan.
paras.zh: 其他股权奖励。其他股权奖励是指全部或部分参照 A 类普通股（包括其价值增值）估值或以其他方式基于 A 类普通股的奖励。其他股权奖励可单独授予，也可与 A&R 2024 计划项下的其他奖励搭配授予。

paras.en: #### Performance Criteria
paras.zh: #### 绩效标准

paras.en: The Plan Administrator may specify certain performance criteria which must be satisfied before Awards will be granted or will vest. The performance goals may vary from participant to participant, group to group, and period to period.
paras.zh: 计划管理人可指定某些绩效标准，在授予或归属奖励之前必须满足该等标准。绩效目标可能因参与者、群体和期间的不同而有所差异。

paras.en: #### Transferability
paras.zh: #### 可转让性

paras.en: Except as otherwise permitted by the Plan Administrator, Awards generally are not transferable except by will or by the laws of descent and distribution, and each stock option or SAR will be exercisable during the lifetime of the participant only by the participant.
paras.zh: 除计划管理人另有允许外，奖励一般不可转让，但通过遗嘱或继承与分配相关法律转让的除外；每项股票期权或 SAR 在参与者生前仅可由参与者本人行使。

paras.en: #### Clawback
Awards will be subject to recoupment in accordance with any clawback policy that we adopt, including any clawback policy required under Rule 10D-1 of the Exchange Act.
paras.zh: 奖励将根据我们采纳的任何追回政策予以追回，包括《交易法》第 10D-1 条所要求的任何追回政策。

paras.en: #### Amendment and Termination
paras.zh: #### 修订与终止

paras.en: The Plan Administrator may amend, suspend or terminate the A&R 2024 Plan at any time; however certain enumerated material amendments may not be made without shareholder approval. Suspension or termination of the A&R 2024 Plan may not impair the rights and obligations of any outstanding Award. The Plan Administrator may also amend any outstanding Award, subject to the participant’s consent in the event such amendment impairs such participant’s rights under such Award. The A&R 2024 Plan has been adopted by our board in connection with this offering and will terminate on December 10, 2034, unless earlier terminated by our board.
paras.zh: 计划管理人可随时修订、暂停或终止经修订及重述的 2024 年计划；但若干列明的重大修订未经股东批准不得作出。暂停或终止经修订及重述的 2024 年计划不得损害任何未决奖励项下的权利和义务。计划管理人亦可修订任何未决奖励，但若该等修订损害参与者在相应奖励项下的权利，则须取得该参与者同意。经修订及重述的 2024 年计划已由我们的董事会就本次发行予以采纳，并将于 2034 年 12 月 10 日终止，除非我们的董事会提前终止。

paras.en: **Second Amended and Restated 2017 Employee Stock Purchase Plan**
paras.zh: **第二份经修订及重述的 2017 年员工购股计划**

paras.en: In connection with this offering, we further amended and restated our 2017 ESPP. The purpose of the A&R 2017 ESPP is to encourage and enable our eligible employees to acquire a proprietary interest in us through the ownership of our Class A common stock. The A&R 2017 ESPP, and the rights of participants to make purchases thereunder, is intended to qualify under the provisions of Section 423 of the Code.
paras.zh: 就本次发行，我们进一步修订并重述了我们的 2017 年员工购股计划（ESPP）。经修订及重述的 2017 年 ESPP 旨在鼓励并促使我们的合资格员工通过持有我们的 A 类普通股取得对我们的所有权权益。经修订及重述的 2017 年 ESPP 及参与者据此进行购买的权利，拟符合《美国国内税收法典》第 423 条的规定。

paras.en: The following description of the A&R 2017 ESPP is not intended to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the complete text of the A&R 2017 ESPP, a copy of which will be filed as an exhibit to the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. Please read the A&R 2017 ESPP in its entirety.
paras.zh: 以下对经修订及重述的 2017 年 ESPP 的说明并非完整说明，其整体受经修订及重述的 2017 年 ESPP 完整文本的约束，该文本的副本将作为本招股说明书所构成注册声明的附件提交。请完整阅读经修订及重述的 2017 年 ESPP。

paras.en: #### Administration

The A&R 2017 ESPP will be administered by our board or a committee thereof designated by our board to administer the A&R 2017 ESPP, which we refer to herein as the “ESPP Administrator.” The ESPP Administrator has the final power to determine all questions of policy and expediency that may arise in the administration of the A&R 2017 ESPP. The ESPP Administrator may delegate its responsibilities under the A&R 2017 ESPP to one or more other persons.
paras.zh: 经修订及重述的 2017 年员工购股计划（A&R 2017 ESPP）将由我们的董事会或董事会指定负责管理该计划的委员会（本文称为“ESPP 管理人”）管理。ESPP 管理人对在管理 A&R 2017 ESPP 过程中可能产生的所有政策及权宜问题拥有最终决定权。ESPP 管理人可将其在 A&R 2017 ESPP 项下的职责委托给一名或多名其他人员。

paras.en: #### Stock Subject to A&R 2017 ESPP
paras.zh: #### A&R 2017 ESPP 项下可发行的股票

paras.en: The maximum number of shares of Class A common stock that may be issued under the A&R 2017 ESPP will not exceed 75,000,000 shares (the “ESPP Share Pool”), inclusive of shares issued under the 2017 ESPP prior to the adoption of the A&R 2017 Plan. The ESPP Share Pool is subject to certain adjustments in the event of a change in our capitalization. Shares of Class A common stock issued under the A&R 2017 ESPP may be either authorized and unissued shares or previously issued shares acquired by us. A participant does not have the rights of a shareholder until the shares are actually issued to the participant.
paras.zh: 根据 A&R 2017 ESPP 可发行的 A 类普通股最大股数不超过 75,000,000 股（“ESPP 股份池”），其中包括在通过经修订及重述的 2017 年计划之前根据 2017 ESPP 已发行的股份。ESPP 股份池在我们资本结构发生变化时将进行若干调整。根据 A&R 2017 ESPP 发行的 A 类普通股可以是已授权但未发行的股份，也可以是我们回购的已发行股份。在股份实际发行给参与者之前，参与者不享有股东权利。

paras.en: #### Eligibility; Limitations
paras.zh: #### 资格；限制

paras.en: An employee is eligible to participate in the A&R 2017 ESPP if the employee has been continuously employed by us our one of our related corporations incorporated in the United States since at least the last day of the calendar month preceding the month in which the offering date occurs and does not own 5% or more of the combined voting power of the Company or any related corporations (as determined under Section 423 and 424 of the Code). Eligible employees must enroll in a particular offering at least 10 business days prior to the offering date of such offering, and once enrolled for an offering, employees will be automatically enrolled in subsequent offerings unless the employee withdraws.
paras.zh: 如果员工自要约日所在月份前一个日历月的最后一天起至少持续受雇于我们或我们在美国注册成立的一家关联公司，且不拥有公司或任何关联公司合计投票权 5% 或以上（依据《税法》第 423 条和第 424 条确定），则该员工有资格参与 A&R 2017 ESPP。合资格员工必须在某项要约的要约日前至少 10 个工作日登记参与该要约，且一旦登记参与某项要约，员工将自动登记参与后续要约，除非员工退出。

paras.en: A participant is not permitted to purchase shares of our Class A common stock with a fair market value in excess of $25,000 in any one calendar year (calculated based on the fair market value on the offering date).
paras.zh: 参与者不得在任何单一日历年内购买公允价值超过 $25,000 的我们的 A 类普通股（按要约日的公允价值计算）。

paras.en: #### Offerings

The offerings and purchase periods will be determined by the ESPP Administrator, subject to limitations under the Section 423 of the Code. It is expected that we will continue six-month successive purchase periods with purchase dates occurring on April 15th and October 15th of each year.
paras.zh: 要约及购买期将由 ESPP 管理人确定，但须遵守《税法》第 423 条的限制。预计我们将继续采用连续六个月的购买期，购买日分别为每年 4 月 15 日和 10 月 15 日。

paras.en: During the purchase period, a participant may contribute between 1% and 100% of their eligible earnings (in whole percentage increments) through payroll deductions. A participant may change their payroll deduction prior to the beginning of an offering; however, during an offering, a participant may not increase the contribution percentage and may only decrease it up to two times (with the second decrease required to be to 0%), subject to the withdrawal provisions. At the end of each offering period, unless the participant has withdrawn from the A&R 2017 ESPP, payroll deductions are applied automatically to purchase shares of Class A common stock at the purchase price described below. The number of shares purchased is determined by dividing the payroll deductions by the applicable purchase price, with any remaining funds held in the participant’s account for the subsequent purchase period (subject to the withdrawal provisions).
paras.zh: 在购买期内，参与人可通过工资扣款缴纳其合格收入的 1% 至 100%（以整数百分比递增）。参与人可在要约期开始前变更其工资扣款；但在要约期内，参与人不得提高缴款比例，且最多只能下调两次（第二次下调必须降至 0%），并须遵守退出条款的规定。在每个要约期结束时，除非参与人已退出经修订及重述的 2017 年员工购股计划（A&R 2017 ESPP），否则工资扣款将自动用于按下述购买价格购买 A 类普通股。所购股份数量以工资扣款除以适用购买价格确定，剩余资金留存于参与人账户中用于后续购买期（须遵守退出条款的规定）。

paras.en: In the event of a participant’s termination of employment or a participant’s withdrawal from an offering (which may occur at any time prior to the ten-business day period preceding the purchase date), such participant’s accumulated deductions will be returned to the participant as soon as administratively practicable.
paras.zh: 若参与人终止雇佣关系或退出某项要约（可在购买日前十个营业日之前的任何时间进行），该参与人的累计扣款将在行政上可行的情况下尽快退还予该参与人。

paras.en: #### Purchase Price
paras.zh: #### 购买价格

paras.en: The price per share at which shares are purchased under the A&R 2017 ESPP in a particular offering period is determined by the ESPP Administrator, but in no event will be less than 85% of the lower of the fair market value of the Class A common stock on the offering date or the fair market value of the Class A common stock on the purchase date.
paras.zh: 在特定要约期内，根据经修订及重述的 2017 年员工购股计划（A&R 2017 ESPP）购买股份的每股价格由员工购股计划管理人（ESPP Administrator）确定，但在任何情况下不得低于以下两者中较低者的 85%：要约日 A 类普通股的公允市场价值，或购买日 A 类普通股的公允市场价值。

paras.en: #### Adjustments

In the event of any reorganizations, recapitalizations, stock splits, reverse stock splits, stock dividends, extraordinary dividends or distributions, or similar events, the ESPP Administrator will appropriately adjust the number and class of shares available under the A&R 2017 ESPP and subject to the purchase limits under each ongoing offering and the applicable purchase price of such shares in each ongoing offering.
paras.zh: 若发生任何重组、资本重组、股票拆分、反向股票拆分、股票股息、特别股息或分配或类似事件，员工购股计划管理人将适当调整经修订及重述的 2017 年员工购股计划（A&R 2017 ESPP）下可供发行的股份数量及类别、每项进行中的要约项下的购买限额以及该等股份在每项进行中的要约中的适用购买价格。

paras.en: #### Transferability
paras.zh: #### 可转让性

paras.en: Rights to purchase Class A common stock under the A&R 2017 ESPP may not be transferred by a participant and may be exercised during a participant’s lifetime only by the participant.
paras.zh: 参与人不得转让经修订及重述的 2017 年员工购股计划（A&R 2017 ESPP）项下购买 A 类普通股的权利，且该等权利在参与人在世期间仅可由参与人本人行使。

paras.en: #### Amendment and Termination
paras.zh: #### 修订与终止

paras.en: The A&R 2017 ESPP became effective when it was approved by our board. Our board may amend, alter, or discontinue the A&R 2017 ESPP in any respect at any time, subject to shareholder approval as required by applicable laws and regulations.
paras.zh: 经修订及重述的 2017 年员工购股计划（A&R 2017 ESPP）经我们的董事会批准后生效。我们的董事会可随时以任何方式修订、变更或终止经修订及重述的 2017 年员工购股计划（A&R 2017 ESPP），但须遵守适用法律法规要求的股东批准。

paras.en: During 2025, our non-employee directors did not receive cash or equity compensation for their service on our board. Mr. Musk and Ms. Shotwell do not receive any additional compensation for their respective services as directors.
paras.zh: 2025 年期间，我们的非雇员董事未因其在董事会的服务而获得现金或股权报酬。Musk 先生和 Shotwell 女士未因其各自的董事服务获得任何额外报酬。

paras.en:
CERTAIN RELATIONSHIPS AND RELATED PERSON · TRANSACTIONS
The following is a description of certain relationships and transactions that exist, are proposed to exist or have
existed or that we have entered into or propose to enter into with our directors, executive officers, holders of more
than 5% of our capital stock or their affiliates and immediate family members since January 1, 2023 and where:
• we have been or are to be a participant;
• the amount involved exceeded or will exceed $120,000; and
• any of our directors, executive officers, or holders of more than 5% of our capital stock, or any immediate
family member of, or persons sharing their household with, any of these individuals, had or will have a direct or
indirect material interest.
paras.zh:
特定关系与关联人士 · 交易
以下描述的是自 2023 年 1 月 1 日以来存在、拟存在或曾经存在，或我们已订立或拟订立的某些关系与交易，涉及我们的董事、高级管理人员、持有我们超过 5% 资本的股东或其关联方及直系亲属，且满足：
• 我们曾经或将要作为参与方；
• 所涉金额已超过或将超过 $120,000；以及
• 我们的任何董事、高级管理人员或持有我们超过 5% 资本的股东，或上述任何个人的任何直系亲属或与其同住的人员，已经或将会拥有直接或间接的重大利益。

full.secZh: 关于 xAI 合并的说明

paras.en: On February 2, 2026, we effected the xAI Merger, pursuant to which we acquired xAI (which includes X). For the purposes of the disclosures set forth in this section pursuant to Item 404 of Regulation S-K, the transactions described below also include certain agreements and transactions originally entered into by xAI or X Holdings prior to the xAI Merger to the extent that such agreements and transactions are ongoing following the consummation of the xAI Merger.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月 2 日，我们完成了 xAI 合并，据此我们收购了 xAI（其中包含 X）。就本节依据《S-K 条例》第 404 项所作披露而言，下文所述交易还包括 xAI 或 X Holdings 在 xAI 合并之前最初订立的若干协议和交易，前提是该等协议和交易在 xAI 合并完成后仍在持续。

full.sec: Transactions with Elon Musk and Affiliated Entities
full.secZh: 与 Elon Musk 及关联实体的交易

paras.en: Elon Musk, our founder, Chief Executive Officer, Chief Technical Officer, Chairman of our board, and principal shareholder, also serves as the Technoking, Chief Executive Officer and director of Tesla, and is an approximately 20% shareholder of Tesla as of November 10, 2025. Mr. Musk is also the founder of several other ventures, including The Boring Company (an infrastructure company). In addition, Mr. Musk was a stockholder, director, and officer of each of xAI and X prior to the X Merger and the xAI Merger. We have certain relationships and/or transactions with Mr. Musk and affiliated entities, as described below.
paras.zh: 我们的创始人、首席执行官、首席技术官、董事会主席兼主要股东 Elon Musk 同时担任 Tesla 的 Technoking、首席执行官兼董事，截至 2025 年 11 月 10 日，其持有 Tesla 约 20% 的股份。Musk 先生还是其他多家企业的创始人，包括 The Boring Company（一家基础设施公司）。此外，在 X 合并和 xAI 合并之前，Musk 先生曾是 xAI 和 X 各自的股东、董事和高管。我们与 Musk 先生及关联实体之间存在若干关系和/或交易，具体如下所述。

paras.en: #### Transactions with Tesla
paras.zh: #### 与 Tesla 的交易

paras.en: Tesla is the beneficial owner of 18,990,195 shares of our Class A common stock as of May 1, 2026, representing an ownership interest of less than 1.0% of the total outstanding number of shares of our Class A common stock, after giving effect to the sale of shares of Class A common stock in this offering.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 5 月 1 日，Tesla 实益持有我们 18,990,195 股 A 类普通股，在本次发行中出售 A 类普通股生效后，占我们 A 类普通股流通总股数的所有权权益不足 1.0%。

paras.en: Tesla designs, develops, manufactures, sells, and leases fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to its customers. We have historically collaborated with Tesla through commercial, licensing, and support agreements. Certain amounts presented below that may have been incurred in one year could be paid in another year.
paras.zh: Tesla 设计、开发、制造、销售和租赁纯电动汽车以及发电和储能系统，为其客户提供 AI 相关及增强型软件和服务。我们历来通过商业、许可和支持协议与 Tesla 开展合作。下文列示的某些金额可能在某一年度发生而在另一年度支付。

paras.en: - SpaceX commercial, licensing and support agreements. We are party with Tesla to certain agreements which generally relate to commercial, licensing, and support agreements and standardized commercial transactions with Tesla done on terms no less favorable to SpaceX than those generally available to unaffiliated third parties under similar circumstances. Pursuant to those agreements, we obtained goods and services of $11 million in 2023, $4 million in 2024, $147 million in 2025, and$4.0 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026.
paras.zh: - SpaceX 商业、许可和支持协议。我们与 Tesla 签订了若干协议，这些协议通常涉及商业、许可和支持协议以及与 Tesla 的标准化商业交易，其条款对 SpaceX 而言不低于在类似情况下通常向非关联第三方提供的条款。根据该等协议，我们于 2023 年、2024 年、2025 年以及 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间分别获得金额为 $11 million、$4 million、$147 million 和 $4.0 million 的商品和服务。

paras.en: - xAI commercial, licensing and support agreements. xAI is party to certain commercial, licensing, and support agreements with Tesla. Under these agreements, xAI obtained goods and services of $191 million in 2024, $506 million in 2025, and $303 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026 ($269 million of which relates to purchases of Megapacks in April 2026), and xAI recognized revenue of $2 million in 2025 and $1 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026 from Tesla.
paras.zh: - xAI 商业、许可和支持协议。xAI 与 Tesla 签订了若干商业、许可和支持协议。根据该等协议，xAI 于 2024 年、2025 年以及 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间分别获得金额为 $191 million、$506 million 和 $303 million 的商品和服务（其中 $269 million 与 2026 年 4 月购买 Megapack 有关），且 xAI 于 2025 年以及 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间分别确认来自 Tesla 的收入 $2 million 和 $1 million。

paras.en: - X Holdings advertising agreements. Tesla has directly and indirectly purchased advertising on our X platform. These amounts totaled $0.5 million in 2024, $4 million in 2025, and $0.1 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026.
paras.zh: - X Holdings 广告协议。Tesla 直接和间接在我们的 X 平台上购买广告。该等金额于 2024 年、2025 年以及 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间合计分别为 $0.5 million、$4 million 和 $0.1 million。

paras.en: - Aircraft usage. Since April 2016, we have owned and operated aircraft used by Mr. Musk, in his capacity as the Chief Executive Officer of Tesla, and other Tesla personnel for business travel, and we have invoiced Tesla for the use of such aircraft owned and operated by us at rates determined by Tesla and SpaceX, subject to rules of the Federal Aviation Administration governing such arrangements. For such aircraft use, we charged Tesla $1 million in 2023, $1 million in 2024, $2 million in 2025, and $0 from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026.
paras.zh: - 飞机使用。自 2016 年 4 月起，我们拥有并运营供 Musk 先生（以其 Tesla 首席执行官身份）及其他 Tesla 人员进行商务差旅的飞机，我们就 Tesla 使用该等由我们拥有并运营的飞机向 Tesla 开具账单，费率由 Tesla 和 SpaceX 确定，并须遵守美国联邦航空管理局管辖该等安排的规则。就该等飞机使用，我们于 2023 年、2024 年、2025 年以及 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间分别向 Tesla 收取 $1 million、$1 million、$2 million 和 $0。

paras.en: #### Transactions with The Boring Company
paras.zh: #### 与 The Boring Company 的交易

paras.en: In 2024, X entered into a lease for office space with a subsidiary owned by The Boring Company (an entity affiliated with Mr. Musk). Under this agreement, X made lease payments of $0.1 million in 2024, $1 million in 2025, and $0.3 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026. In addition, SpaceX incurred expenses of $1 million in 2025 in connection with the construction of tunnels by The Boring Company in Bastrop, Texas.
paras.zh: 2024 年，X 与 The Boring Company（一家与 Musk 先生有关联的实体）旗下子公司签订了一份办公场地租赁协议。根据该协议，X 于 2024 年支付租赁款项 $0.1 million，于 2025 年支付 $1 million，并于 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间支付 $0.3 million。此外，SpaceX 于 2025 年就 The Boring Company 在德克萨斯州 Bastrop 建造隧道产生费用 $1 million。

paras.en: #### Relationships with Musk Industries LLC
paras.zh: #### 与 Musk Industries LLC 的关系

paras.en: xAI leases a real property owned by the Musk Industries LLC, which is owned by Mr. Musk. Under this agreement, xAI made lease payments of $0.5 million in 2024, $2 million in 2025, and $1 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026.
paras.zh: xAI 租赁了 Musk Industries LLC 拥有的一处不动产，该公司由 Musk 先生拥有。根据该协议，xAI 于 2024 年支付租赁款项 $0.5 million，于 2025 年支付 $2 million，并于 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间支付 $1 million。

paras.en: #### Security Services provided to Mr. Musk
paras.zh: #### 向 Musk 先生提供的安保服务

paras.en: We are party to a services agreement with a security company owned by Mr. Musk and organized to provide security services concerning him, including in connection with his duties to and work for SpaceX. SpaceX incurred expenses of $2 million for such SpaceX-related security services in 2023, $3 million for such security services in 2024, $4 million for such security services in 2025, and $2 million for such security services from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026.
paras.zh: 我们与一家由 Musk 先生拥有的安保公司签订了服务协议，该公司设立的目的是为其提供安保服务，包括与其对 SpaceX 的职责和为 SpaceX 所做工作相关的安保服务。SpaceX 于 2023 年就该等与 SpaceX 相关的安保服务产生费用 $2 million，于 2024 年就该等安保服务产生费用 $3 million，于 2025 年就该等安保服务产生费用 $4 million，并于 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间就该等安保服务产生费用 $2 million。

full.sec: Relationship with Antonio J. Gracias and Affiliated Entities
full.secZh: 与 Antonio J. Gracias 及关联实体的关系

paras.en: #### Transactions with Valor Equity Partners and Affiliated Entities
paras.zh: #### 与 Valor Equity Partners 及关联实体的交易

paras.en: Mr. Antonio J. Gracias, a member of our board, also serves as the founder, CEO and Chief Investment Officer of Valor Equity Partners (together with its affiliates, “Valor”).
paras.zh: 我们的董事会成员 Antonio J. Gracias 先生同时担任 Valor Equity Partners（连同其关联方，合称“Valor”）的创始人、首席执行官兼首席投资官。

paras.en: Certain subsidiaries of xAI, have entered into certain equipment lease, sublease, and access agreements with Valor. These arrangements include (i) an equipment lease agreement under which a subsidiary of xAI leases computing and related equipment from Valor, which provides for aggregate cash payments of $6,986 million to be made by such subsidiary over the life of the lease, (ii) a second equipment lease agreement under which such subsidiary leases certain computing and related equipment from Valor, which provides for aggregate cash payments of $6,633 million to be made by such subsidiary over the life of the lease, and (iii) a third equipment lease under which such subsidiary leases certain computing and related equipment from Valor, which provides for aggregate cash payments of $6,587 million to be made by such subsidiary over the life of the lease. The lessees’ payments and performance obligations under these agreements are guaranteed by Space Exploration Technologies Corp. or one of its subsidiaries. Pursuant to the lease agreements described above, our subsidiaries have made payments of $885 million in 2025, and$1,917 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026.
paras.zh: xAI 的若干子公司已与 Valor 签订若干设备租赁、转租赁及接入协议。该等安排包括：(i) 一份设备租赁协议，据此 xAI 的一家子公司向 Valor 租赁算力及相关设备，该协议约定该子公司将在租赁期内支付合计 $6,986 million 的现金款项；(ii) 第二份设备租赁协议，据此该子公司向 Valor 租赁若干算力及相关设备，该协议约定该子公司将在租赁期内支付合计 $6,633 million 的现金款项；以及 (iii) 第三份设备租赁协议，据此该子公司向 Valor 租赁若干算力及相关设备，该协议约定该子公司将在租赁期内支付合计 $6,587 million 的现金款项。承租方在该等协议项下的付款及履约义务由 Space Exploration Technologies Corp. 或其一家子公司提供担保。根据上述租赁协议，我们的子公司已于 2025 年支付 $885 million，并于 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间支付 $1,917 million。

paras.en: In connection with certain X API services, X received payments from Valor of $1 million in 2024, $1 million in 2025, and $0.1 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026.
paras.zh: 就若干 X API 服务而言，X 于 2024 年收到 Valor 支付的 $1 million，于 2025 年收到 $1 million，并于 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间收到 $0.1 million。

full.sec: Other Transactions with our Directors and Executive Officers
full.secZh: 与我们的董事和高管的其他交易

paras.en: We own and operate, through our subsidiary, Falcon Landing, LLC, three aircraft for use by our directors, executive officers and employees in connection with the performance of their duties for business purposes. One of the aircraft is maintained and serviced by Craft Aviation Services, LLC, an affiliate of Mr. Musk. The amount of the expenses incurred by us for the maintenance and service of this aircraft was $1 million in 2023, $1 million in 2024, $3 million in 2025, and $3 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026. As disclosed above, we have also invoiced Tesla for their use of one of the aircraft owned and operated by us at rates determined by Tesla and SpaceX, subject to rules of the Federal Aviation Administration governing such arrangements.
paras.zh: 我们通过子公司 Falcon Landing, LLC 拥有并运营三架飞机，供我们的董事、高级管理人员和员工为业务目的履行其职责时使用。其中一架飞机由 Craft Aviation Services, LLC（Mr. Musk 的关联方）进行维护和保养。我们为该飞机的维护和保养发生的费用金额在 2023 年为 $1 million,2024 年为 $1 million,2025 年为 $3 million，以及 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间为 $3 million。如上文所披露，我们还就 Tesla 使用我们拥有并运营的其中一架飞机向 Tesla 开具了发票，费率由 Tesla 和 SpaceX 确定，并须遵守美国联邦航空管理局管辖此类安排的规则。

paras.en: In certain circumstances, when our aircraft are unavailable, Mr. Musk uses his personal aircraft for SpaceX business purposes and is reimbursed by us, subject to rules of the Federal Aviation Administration governing such arrangements. In connection with the use of such aircraft, SpaceX has incurred expenses of $0.1 million in 2023, $3 million in 2024, $2 million in 2025, and $0.2 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026.
paras.zh: 在某些情况下，当我们的飞机不可用时，Mr. Musk 将其个人飞机用于 SpaceX 的业务目的，并由我们向其报销，须遵守美国联邦航空管理局管辖此类安排的规则。就使用该等飞机而言，SpaceX 在 2023 年发生了 $0.1 million 的费用，2024 年为 $3 million,2025 年为 $2 million，以及 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间为 $0.2 million。

paras.en: Ms. Shotwell, our President, Chief Operating Officer and Director, and Mr. Johnsen, our Chief Financial Officer, separately co-own an aircraft for their personal use. In certain circumstances, when none of our aircraft are available for business use, our directors and employees, including Ms. Shotwell and Mr. Johnsen, have used this aircraft for SpaceX business purposes. Any leasing fees for the use of such aircraft for our business purposes have been waived by the owners, and we have agreed to assume the cost of maintenance, crew and operation of such aircraft for such use, subject to rules of the Federal Aviation Administration governing such arrangements. In connection with the use of this aircraft, SpaceX has incurred expenses of $3 million in 2023, $3 million in 2024, $3 million in 2025, and $1 million from January 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026.
paras.zh: 我们的总裁、首席运营官兼董事 Ms. Shotwell 和我们的首席财务官 Mr. Johnsen 共同拥有一架供其个人使用的飞机。在某些情况下，当我们的飞机均无法用于业务用途时，我们的董事和员工（包括 Ms. Shotwell 和 Mr. Johnsen）曾将该飞机用于 SpaceX 的业务目的。所有者已放弃就为我们业务目的使用该飞机收取的任何租赁费用，且我们已同意承担该飞机用于此类用途的维护、机组和运营成本，须遵守美国联邦航空管理局管辖此类安排的规则。就使用该飞机而言，SpaceX 在 2023 年发生了 $3 million 的费用，2024 年为 $3 million,2025 年为 $3 million，以及 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间为 $1 million。

paras.en: Certain existing investors in our equity securities, including entities affiliated with Elon Musk, Google, Valor, and DFJ Growth, are party to an Amended and Restated Investors’ Rights Agreement, dated as of August 4, 2020 (the “Investors’ Rights Agreement”). Under the Investors’ Rights Agreement, such existing investors are entitled to registration rights with respect to shares of our Class A common stock beneficially owned by them (collectively, the “Registrable Securities”). These registration rights, if exercised, would require us to register such existing investors’ Registrable Securities under the Securities Act, and would facilitate the resale of such securities by such existing investors into the public markets.
paras.zh: 我们的股权证券的某些现有投资者（包括与 Elon Musk、Google、Valor 和 DFJ Growth 关联的实体）是日期为 2020 年 8 月 4 日的《经修订和重述的投资者权利协议》（“投资者权利协议”）的缔约方。根据投资者权利协议，该等现有投资者就其实益拥有的 A 类普通股股份（统称“可登记证券”）享有登记权。该等登记权如被行使，将要求我们根据《证券法》登记该等现有投资者的可登记证券，并将便利该等现有投资者将该等证券转售至公开市场。

paras.en: We will pay all registration expenses, other than underwriting discounts and commissions, associated with registrations effected pursuant to the Investors’ Rights Agreement, subject to limited exceptions.
paras.zh: 我们将支付与根据投资者权利协议进行的登记相关的所有登记费用（承销折扣和佣金除外），但受限于有限的例外情形。

paras.en: #### Demand Registration Rights
paras.zh: #### 要求登记权

paras.en: At any time commencing six months after the effective date of the first registration statement for a public offering of our securities (other than a registration on certain registration forms or for transactions not providing for the sale of Registrable Securities), such holders of a majority of the then‑outstanding Registrable Securities, excluding for this purpose shares issuable or issued upon conversion of certain series of our preferred stock, may request that we file a registration statement within 60 days after receipt of the request covering the offer and sale of Registrable Securities, provided that, among other things, the anticipated aggregate offering price, net of underwriting discounts and selling expenses, exceeds $250.0 million. Further, the initiating holders may require that such registration be an underwritten offering, in which case the underwriter will be selected by a majority in interest of the initiating holders, subject to our reasonable approval.
paras.zh: 在我们首次公开发行证券的注册声明生效日（不包括以某些登记表格进行的登记或不涉及可登记证券出售的交易）起六个月后的任何时间，当时已发行可登记证券的多数持有人（为此目的不包括因转换我们某些系列优先股而可发行或已发行的股份）可要求我们在收到请求后 60 天内提交一份涵盖可登记证券要约和出售的注册声明，前提是（其中包括）预计总发行价（扣除承销折扣和销售费用后）超过 $250.0 million。此外，发起持有人可要求该等登记为承销发行，在此情况下，承销商将由发起持有人中利益占多数者选定，但须经我们合理批准。

paras.en: #### Piggyback Registration Rights
paras.zh: #### 附带登记权

paras.en: If we propose to register any of our securities under the Securities Act for sale to the public for cash (other than on certain registration forms or for transactions that do not permit piggyback participation), we must promptly give each holder of Registrable Securities notice of such proposed registration and, upon timely request, cause to be registered all Registrable Securities that such holder requests to be included, subject to any cutbacks, as permitted by the agreement.
paras.zh: 如果我们拟根据《证券法》登记我们的任何证券以向公众进行现金出售（不包括以某些登记表格进行的登记或不允许附带参与的交易），我们必须及时向每名可登记证券持有人发出该等拟议登记的通知，并在及时请求的情况下，登记该等持有人请求纳入的所有可登记证券，但须受协议允许的任何削减的限制。

full.sec: Policies and Procedures for Review of Related Person Transactions
full.secZh: 关联人交易审查政策与程序

paras.en: In connection with the completion of this offering, we will adopt a written policy pursuant to which the audit committee will review and approve or disapprove certain “related person transactions” (as defined in the policy and summarized below) with our directors, executive officers and holders of more than 5% of any class of our voting securities and certain of their family members and affiliates. In approving or disapproving any such transaction, we expect that our audit committee will consider the relevant facts and circumstances available and deemed relevant to the audit committee. Any member of the audit committee who is a related person with respect to a transaction under review will not be permitted to participate in the deliberations or vote on approval or disapproval of the transaction. In addition, certain transactions (including compensation arrangements with our executives and directors) will constitute pre-approved related person transactions under the terms of our policy.
paras.zh: 与本招股说明书所述发行完成相关，我们将采用一项书面政策，据此，审计委员会将审查并批准或不批准与我们董事、高级管理人员以及任何类别有表决权证券 5%以上持有人及其若干家庭成员和关联方之间的某些“关联人交易”（定义见该政策，概述如下）。在批准或不批准任何此类交易时，我们预期审计委员会将考虑可获得的且被其认为相关的有关事实和情况。审计委员会中任何与所审查交易相关的关联人成员，均不得参与该交易的审议或就批准或不批准该交易进行表决。此外，根据我们政策的条款，某些交易（包括与我们高管和董事的薪酬安排）将构成预先批准的关联人交易。

paras.en: For purposes of the policy, (i) “related person transaction” is a transaction, arrangement or relationship in which we or any of our subsidiaries was, is or will be a participant, the amount of which involved exceeds $120,000, and in which any related person had, has or will have a direct or indirect material interest; and (ii) “related person” means: (1) any person who is, or at any time during the applicable period was, one of our executive officers or one of our directors; (2) any person who is known by us to be the beneficial owner of more than 5.0% of any class of our common stock; and (3) any immediate family member of any of the foregoing persons, which means any child, stepchild, parent, stepparent, spouse, sibling, mother-in-law, father-in-law, son-in-law, daughter-in-law, brother-in-law or sister-in-law of a director, executive officer or a beneficial owner of more than 5.0% of any class of our common stock, and any person (other than a tenant or employee) sharing the household of such director, executive officer or beneficial owner of more than 5.0% of any class of our common stock.
paras.zh: 就本政策而言，(i)“关联人交易”是指我们或我们的任何子公司曾经、现在或将要参与的交易、安排或关系，其涉及金额超过$120,000，且任何关联人在其中曾经、现在或将要拥有直接或间接的重大利益；以及(ii)“关联人”是指：(1) 任何现在担任或在本政策适用期间内任何时候曾担任我们高级管理人员或董事的人员；(2) 我们已知的任何类别普通股 5.0%以上的实益拥有人；以及(3) 上述任何人员的任何直系家庭成员，即董事、高级管理人员或任何类别普通股 5.0%以上实益拥有人的任何子女、继子女、父母、继父母、配偶、兄弟姐妹、岳母、岳父、女婿、儿媳、姐夫或妹夫，以及与该董事、高级管理人员或任何类别普通股 5.0%以上实益拥有人共同居住的任何人员（租户或雇员除外）。
