paras.en: (8) The amounts in the table with respect to Class A Common Stock do not include the shares of Class B Common Stock beneficially owned by the persons listed therein. Each share of Class B common stock is convertible at any time at the option of the holder into one share of our Class A common stock. In addition, subject to certain exceptions, each share of Class B common stock will convert automatically into one share of Class A common stock upon any sale of such share of Class B common stock or any legal or beneficial interest in such share, as described in “Description of Capital Stock—Common Stock—Conversion.” Beneficial ownership is determined in accordance with the rules of the SEC, which generally attribute ownership to persons who have or share voting or investment power with respect to the relevant securities. Shares of Class A Common Stock that may be acquired within 60 days upon conversion of outstanding Class B Common Stock are deemed to be beneficially owned. Securities not outstanding, but included in the beneficial ownership of each such person, are deemed to be outstanding for the purpose of computing the percentage of outstanding securities of the class owned by such person, but are not deemed to be outstanding for the purpose of computing the percentage of the class(es) of securities owned by any other person. Except as indicated in these footnotes, and subject to community property laws where applicable, the persons named in the table have sole voting and investment power with respect to all securities shown as beneficially owned by them. Moreover, as described in “Description of Capital Stock—Voting Rights,” subject to the terms of our charter, each holder of our Class A common stock is entitled to one vote per share, and each holder of our Class B common stock is entitled to ten votes per share. Holders of our Class B common stock, voting separately as a class, are entitled to elect 51% of the total number of authorized directors (rounded up to the nearest whole number).
paras.zh: (8) 表中与 A 类普通股相关的金额不包括表中所列人士实益拥有的 B 类普通股股份。B 类普通股每股可由持有人随时选择转换为一股我们的 A 类普通股。此外，除某些例外情况外，B 类普通股每股在发生任何 B 类普通股股份或该股份的任何法定或实益权益的出售时，将自动转换为一股 A 类普通股，详见“股本说明——普通股——转换”。实益所有权依据 SEC 规则确定，该规则通常将所有权归属于对相关证券拥有或共享投票权或投资权的人士。可在 60 天内因转换已发行 B 类普通股而获得的 A 类普通股股份被视为实益拥有。非已发行但计入各该人士实益所有权的证券，就计算该人士所拥有该类已发行证券百分比而言被视为已发行，但就计算任何其他人士所拥有证券类别百分比而言不被视为已发行。除该等脚注中所述外，并在适用时受夫妻共同财产法约束，表中列名人士对其显示为实益拥有的所有证券拥有唯一投票权和投资权。此外，如“股本说明——投票权”所述，受我们章程条款约束，我们 A 类普通股每股持有人有权每股一票，我们 B 类普通股每股持有人有权每股十票。我们 B 类普通股持有人作为单独类别投票，有权选举授权董事总人数的 51%（向上取整至最接近的整数）。

paras.en: The following summary of the Company’s capital stock and charter and bylaws (each as in effect upon completion of this offering) does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the provisions of applicable law and to our charter and bylaws, which are filed as exhibits to the registration statement of which this prospectus is a part. To understand the material terms of our common stock and preferred stock, you should read our charter and our bylaws in their entirety. For purposes of this section, the term “common stock” refers to our Class A, Class B, and Class C common stock.
paras.zh: 以下关于公司股本以及章程和细则（各自在本次发行完成时生效）的概述并不旨在完整，其全部内容受制于适用法律规定以及我们的章程和细则，该等章程和细则已作为本招股说明书所构成注册声明的附件提交。为理解我们普通股和优先股的重大条款，您应完整阅读我们的章程和细则。就本节而言，“普通股”一词指我们的 A 类、B 类和 C 类普通股。

paras.en: Upon completion of this offering, the authorized capital stock of the Company will consist of 36,132,150,000 shares of Class A common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of which 7,380,196,910 shares will be issued and outstanding, 6,125,000,000 shares of Class B common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of which 5,695,668,265 shares will be issued and outstanding, 10,000,000,000 shares of Class C common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of which no shares will be issued and outstanding, and 2,400,000,000 shares of preferred stock, par value $0.001 per share, of which no shares will be issued and outstanding.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，公司的授权股本将由 36,132,150,000 股 A 类普通股（每股面值$0.001）组成，其中 7,380,196,910 股将为已发行且流通在外；6,125,000,000 股 B 类普通股（每股面值$0.001），其中 5,695,668,265 股将为已发行且流通在外；10,000,000,000 股 C 类普通股（每股面值$0.001），其中无股份为已发行且流通在外；以及 2,400,000,000 股优先股（每股面值$0.001），其中无股份为已发行且流通在外。

paras.en: #### Voting Rights
paras.zh: #### 投票权

paras.en: General
paras.zh: 一般规定

paras.en: Subject to the terms of our charter, each holder of our Class A common stock is entitled to one vote per share; each holder of our Class B common stock is entitled to ten votes per share; and the holders of our Class C common stock will have no voting rights. Generally speaking, with respect to matters to be voted on by shareholders of the Company, the holders of all classes of our voting common stock will vote together as a single class. Notwithstanding the foregoing, our charter will provide that (i) as further described below, (1) holders of our Class B common stock, voting separately as a class, are entitled to elect 51% of the total number of authorized directors (rounded up to the nearest whole number); and (2) removal of Mr. Musk from his board and leadership roles (Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of our board) requires the approval of the holders of at least a majority of the voting power of the outstanding shares of Class B common stock, voting separately as a class; and (ii) in addition to any other required vote, under our charter, the approval of the Class B common stock, voting separately as a class, is required to approve (1) any amendment to our charter that would make any change in the rights, powers, preferences and privileges of the Class B common stock (including with respect to Class B Directors); and (2) certain combinations, mergers or sales, as described in our charter. Otherwise, classes of common stock will not be entitled to any separate class votes, as our charter will provide for an opt-out from class votes that would otherwise be required under the TBOC.
paras.zh: 根据我们章程的规定，我们 A 类普通股的每位持有人每股享有 1 票投票权；我们 B 类普通股的每位持有人每股享有 10 票投票权；我们 C 类普通股的持有人将不享有投票权。一般而言，对于需由公司股东投票表决的事项，我们所有类别有投票权普通股的持有人将作为一个单一类别共同投票。尽管有前述规定，我们的章程将规定：(i) 如下文进一步所述，(1) 我们 B 类普通股的持有人作为单独类别投票，有权选举获授权董事总人数的 51%（向上取整至最接近的整数）；以及 (2) 罢免 Musk 先生在其董事会及领导职务（首席执行官兼董事会主席）需要至少持有 B 类普通股已发行股份多数投票权的持有人作为单独类别投票批准；以及 (ii) 除任何其他所需投票外，根据我们的章程，批准以下事项需要 B 类普通股作为单独类别投票批准：(1) 对我们的章程作出的任何会改变 B 类普通股权利、权力、优先权和特权的修订（包括与 B 类董事相关的修订）；以及 (2) 我们章程中所述的某些合并、兼并或出售。除此之外，各类普通股将无权进行任何单独的类别投票，因为我们的章程将规定选择退出 TBOC 下原本要求的类别投票。

paras.en: Election and Removal of Directors
paras.zh: 董事的选举与罢免

paras.en: With respect to the election of directors, our charter will provide that (i) holders of our Class B common stock, voting separately as a class, are entitled to elect 51% of the total number of authorized directors (rounded up to the nearest whole number) for so long as any shares of Class B common stock remain outstanding; and that (ii) holders of all classes of our voting common stock, voting together as a single class, are entitled to elect the remaining directors (the “Common Stock Directors”). Class B Directors may be removed with or without cause by the affirmative vote of the holders of at least a majority of the voting power of the outstanding shares of Class B common stock, voting separately as a class. Vacancies occurring with respect to the Class B Directors, including as a result of newly created directorships on the board, may be filled at any time by the affirmative vote of the holders of at least a majority of the voting power of the outstanding shares of Class B common stock, voting separately as a class, or by the remaining Class B Directors, and not any other persons, subject to the terms of our charter. Common Stock Directors may be removed with or without cause by the affirmative vote of the holders of at least a majority of the voting power of the outstanding shares of voting common stock, voting together as a single class. Vacancies occurring with respect to the Common Stock Directors, including as a result of newly created directorships on the board, may be filled at any time by the affirmative vote of the holders of at least a majority of the voting power of the outstanding shares of voting common stock, voting together as a single class, or by the remaining directors, subject to the terms of our charter.
paras.zh: 关于董事选举，我们的章程将规定：(i) 只要有任何 B 类普通股股份仍为流通在外，B 类普通股持有人作为单独类别单独投票，有权选举授权董事总人数的 51%（向上取整至最接近的整数）；以及 (ii) 我们所有类别的有表决权普通股持有人作为单一类别共同投票，有权选举其余董事（“普通股董事”）。B 类董事可由持有 B 类普通股流通在外股份至少多数表决权的持有人作为单独类别单独投票，以肯定性表决方式随时或无故罢免。B 类董事出现的空缺，包括因董事会新设董事席位而产生的空缺，可根据我们章程的条款，由持有 B 类普通股流通在外股份至少多数表决权的持有人作为单独类别单独投票，或由其余 B 类董事（而非任何其他人士）以肯定性表决方式随时填补。普通股董事可由持有有表决权普通股流通在外股份至少多数表决权的持有人作为单一类别共同投票，以肯定性表决方式随时或无故罢免。普通股董事出现的空缺，包括因董事会新设董事席位而产生的空缺，可根据我们章程的条款，由持有有表决权普通股流通在外股份至少多数表决权的持有人作为单一类别共同投票，或由其余董事以肯定性表决方式随时填补。

paras.en: Upon completion of this offering, Mr. Musk will continue to serve as our Chief Executive Officer, Chief Technical Officer and Chairman of the board. Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, pursuant to the terms of our charter, Mr. Musk will only be subject to removal from the board and from his Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the board leadership positions with the approval of the holders of at least a majority of the voting power of the outstanding shares of our Class B common stock, voting separately as a class.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，Musk 先生将继续担任我们的首席执行官、首席技术官和董事会主席。尽管有上一段的规定，根据我们章程的条款，只有在持有我们 B 类普通股流通在外股份至少多数表决权的持有人作为单独类别单独投票批准的情况下，Musk 先生方可被免去董事会职务以及其首席执行官和董事会主席的领导职务。

paras.en: Notwithstanding the above, each of the voting rights described above will be subject to the rights that may be granted in the future to the holders of any one or more series of preferred stock, as applicable.
paras.zh: 尽管有上述规定，上述各项表决权均受限于未来可能授予任何一类或多类优先股持有人的权利（如适用）。

paras.en: #### Dividends

Subject to the prior rights of holders of all classes and series of the Company’s capital stock at the time outstanding having prior rights as to dividends, the holders of shares of Class A common stock, Class B common stock and Class C common stock will be entitled to receive such dividends as may be declared from time to time by the board. Any dividends paid to the holders of shares of Class A common stock, Class B common stock and Class C common stock will be paid pro rata, on an equal priority, pari passu basis.
paras.zh: 在受限于公司届时流通在外的全部类别和系列股本中享有股息优先权的持有人的优先权利的前提下，A 类普通股、B 类普通股和 C 类普通股股份的持有人有权获得董事会不时宣布的股息。向 A 类普通股、B 类普通股和 C 类普通股股份持有人支付的任何股息将按比例、以同等优先顺位、同权同序（pari passu）基准支付。

paras.en: #### Dissolution and Liquidation
paras.zh: #### 解散和清算

paras.en: Upon the Company’s liquidation, dissolution or winding up, holders of shares of Class A common stock, Class B common stock and Class C common stock are entitled to share ratably in all assets remaining after payment of liabilities and the liquidation preference of any then outstanding shares of capital stock of the Company.
paras.zh: 在公司清算、解散或停业清理时，A 类普通股、B 类普通股和 C 类普通股的持有人有权按比例分享在清偿负债及当时已发行的任何公司股本清算优先权后剩余的全部资产。

paras.en: #### Conversion

Holders of our Class A common stock and Class C common stock do not have conversion rights. Each share of Class B common stock is convertible at any time at the option of the holder into one share of our Class A common stock. In addition, subject to certain exceptions specified in the charter that do not constitute a “Transfer” (as defined below) and other than in the case of certain “permitted transfers” (as summarized below), each share of Class B common stock will convert automatically into one share of Class A common stock upon any sale, assignment, encumbrance, transfer, conveyance, hypothecation, pledge, gift, or other transfer or disposition of any kind of such share of Class B common stock or any legal or beneficial interest in such share, whether or not for value and whether voluntary or involuntary or by operation of law, including, without limitation, the transfer of, or entering into a binding agreement with respect to, voting control over such share by proxy or otherwise (each, a “Transfer”).
paras.zh: 我们的 A 类普通股和 C 类普通股持有人不享有转换权。每股 B 类普通股可由持有人选择随时转换为一股我们的 A 类普通股。此外，除章程中规定的某些不构成“转让”（定义见下文）的例外情形以及某些“允许的转让”（概述如下）情形外，任何 B 类普通股股份或该股份的任何法律或实益权益的任何出售、出让、设押、转让、让与、质押、抵押、赠与或其他任何形式的转让或处置，无论是否有偿、无论自愿或非自愿或依法律实施，包括但不限于通过委托或其他方式对该股份表决控制权的转让或就此订立有约束力的协议（每一项均称为“转让”），该等 B 类普通股股份将自动转换为一股 A 类普通股。

paras.en: For purposes of our charter, “permitted transfers” will include transfers to and from (i) the registered holders of Class B common stock; (ii) each natural person who transferred shares of Class B common stock or equity awards (including any option or warrant exercisable or convertible into shares of Class B common stock) to certain “permitted entities” (as defined in the charter); (iii) one or more family members of shareholders specified in clauses (i) and (ii); (iv) certain other trusts, general partnerships, limited partnerships, limited liability companies, corporations, or other entities owned by certain qualified shareholders (as defined in the charter), including certain permitted non-for-profits; as well as (v) certain transfers to bona fide trusts for the benefit of a charitable organization, contributions to which are deductible for federal income, estate, gift and generation skipping transfer tax purposes, to certain retirement accounts, and for certain estate or succession planning purposes. “Permitted Transferees” will include a transferee of shares of Class B common stock received in a Transfer that constitutes a “permitted transfer.”
paras.zh: 就我们的章程而言，“允许的转让”将包括向以下各方及由以下各方进行的转让：(i) B 类普通股的登记持有人；(ii) 每一位向某些“允许的实体”（定义见章程）转让 B 类普通股股份或股权奖励（包括任何可行权或可转换为 B 类普通股股份的期权或认股权证）的自然人；(iii) 第 (i) 和 (ii) 项所述股东的一名或多名家庭成员；(iv) 由某些合格股东（定义见章程）拥有的某些其他信托、普通合伙企业、有限合伙企业、有限责任公司、公司或其他实体，包括某些允许的非营利组织；以及 (v) 向为慈善组织利益设立的善意信托的某些转让（对该等信托的出资可在联邦所得税、遗产税、赠与税和隔代转移税目的下扣除）、向某些退休账户的转让以及为某些遗产或继承规划目的的转让。“允许的受让人”将包括在构成“允许的转让”的转让中受让 B 类普通股股份的受让人。

paras.en: #### No Preemptive or Other Rights
paras.zh: #### 无优先认购权或其他权利

paras.en: Holders of the Company’s Class A common stock, Class B common stock, and Class C common stock do not have preemptive, subscription, redemption rights, or sinking fund.
paras.zh: 公司 A 类普通股、B 类普通股和 C 类普通股的持有人不享有优先认购权、认购权、赎回权或偿债基金。

paras.en: #### Issuance of Additional Shares
paras.zh: #### 增发股份

paras.en: We may issue additional authorized shares of Class A common stock, Class B common stock and Class C common stock at any time or from time to time, subject to applicable provisions of our charter, our bylaws and Texas law. Our charter will provide that additional shares of Class B common stock may only be issued in the future to Mr. Musk, his family members and certain entities permitted under our charter.
paras.zh: 我们可随时或不时发行额外的已授权 A 类普通股、B 类普通股和 C 类普通股股份，但须遵守我们章程、公司章程细则和得克萨斯州法律的适用规定。我们的章程将规定，额外的 B 类普通股股份未来只能向马斯克先生、其家庭成员及我们章程允许的某些实体发行。

paras.en: Our charter authorizes our board, subject to any limitations prescribed by applicable law and any stock exchange, without further shareholder approval, to establish and to issue from time to time one or more series of preferred stock. Each series of preferred stock will have the powers, designations, preferences and relative, participation, optional or other rights, if any, including voting rights, and the qualifications, limitations or restrictions thereof, if any, and the number of shares constituting the series, as determined by the board. Any issuance of preferred stock could have the effect of decreasing the market price of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 我们的章程授权董事会，在适用法律及任何证券交易所规定的任何限制的约束下，无需股东进一步批准，即可不时设立并发行一个或多个系列的优先股。每一系列优先股将具有董事会确定的权力、名称、优先权及相对权利、参与权、选择权或其他权利（如有），包括投票权，以及其资格、限制或约束（如有），以及构成该系列的股份数量。任何优先股的发行都可能产生降低我们 A 类普通股市场价格的效果。

full.sec: Anti-takeover Effects of Provisions of Our Charter, our Bylaws and Texas Law
full.secZh: 公司章程、章程细则及得克萨斯州法律中条款的反收购效果

paras.en: Some provisions of Texas law, and our charter and our bylaws contain provisions that could make the following transactions more difficult: acquisitions of us by means of a tender offer, a proxy contest or otherwise; or removal of our incumbent officers and directors. These provisions may also have the effect of preventing changes in our management. It is possible that these provisions could make it more difficult to accomplish or could deter transactions that shareholders may otherwise consider to be in their best interest or in our best interests, including transactions that might result in a premium over the market price for our shares of Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州法律的某些条款以及我们的公司章程和章程细则包含的条款可能使以下交易更加困难：通过要约收购、代理权争夺或其他方式收购我们；或罢免我们的现任高级管理人员和董事。这些条款还可能具有阻止我们管理层变动的效果。这些条款有可能使股东原本可能认为符合其最佳利益或符合我们最佳利益的交易更难完成或受到阻挠，包括可能导致我们的 A 类普通股股票市场价格出现溢价的交易。

paras.en: These provisions, as summarized below, are expected to discourage coercive takeover practices and inadequate takeover bids. These provisions are also designed to encourage persons seeking to acquire control of us to first negotiate with us. We believe that the benefits of increased protection and our potential ability to negotiate with the proponent of an unfriendly or unsolicited proposal to acquire or restructure us outweigh the disadvantages of discouraging these proposals because, among other things, negotiation of these proposals could result in an improvement of their terms.
paras.zh: 如下文所概述，这些条款预计将抑制强制性的收购做法和不充分的收购要约。这些条款还旨在鼓励寻求获得我们控制权的人首先与我们进行协商。我们认为，加强保护所带来的好处以及我们与提出不友好或主动收购或重组提议的人进行协商的潜在能力，超过了抑制这些提议所带来的不利之处，因为除其他事项外，对这些提议进行协商可能会改善其条款。

paras.en: #### Anti-takeover statute under Texas law
paras.zh: #### 德克萨斯州法律下的反收购法规

paras.en: We will be subject to Section 21.606 of the TBOC, which in general, prohibits a publicly held Texas corporation, like the Company after the completion of this offering, from engaging, under certain circumstances, in a business combination with an affiliated shareholder (as defined in the TBOC) for a period of three years following the date the person became an affiliated shareholder unless:
paras.zh: 我们将受《德克萨斯州商业组织法典》（TBOC）第 21.606 条的约束，该条一般禁止像本公司这样在本次发行完成后成为公开持股的德克萨斯州公司在某些情况下，在某人成为关联股东（定义见 TBOC）之日起三年内与该关联股东进行业务合并，除非：

paras.en: - the board approved either the business combination or the transaction that resulted in the shareholder becoming an affiliated shareholder before the affiliated shareholder’s share acquisition date; or
paras.zh: - 董事会在关联股东取得股份之日之前批准了该业务合并或导致该股东成为关联股东的交易；或

paras.en: - at or subsequent to the date of the transaction, the business combination is approved by the board and authorized at an annual or special meeting of shareholders, and not by written consent, by the affirmative vote of at least two-thirds of the outstanding voting shares not beneficially owned by the affiliated shareholder or any of its affiliates or associates at a meeting of shareholders called for that purpose not less than six months after the affiliated shareholder’s share acquisition date.
paras.zh: - 在该交易之日或之后，业务合并经董事会批准，并在为该目的召开的、距关联股东取得股份之日不少于六个月的股东年会上或特别会议上，经亲自或委托代理人出席的、有权在会上投票的已发行有表决权股份的至少三分之二赞成票授权，且该等股份不包括关联股东或其任何关联方或联系人实益拥有的股份。

paras.en: #### Provisions of our charter and our bylaws that may have an anti-takeover effect
paras.zh: #### 我们公司章程和章程细则中可能具有反收购效果的条款

paras.en: Election of Class B Directors
paras.zh: B 类董事的选举

paras.en: As discussed above, our charter will provide that holders of our Class B common stock, voting separately as a class, are entitled to elect 51% of the total number of authorized directors (rounded up to the nearest whole number). Upon completion of this offering, Mr. Musk will beneficially own 849,494,440 shares of our Class A common stock and 5,569,053,075 shares of our Class B common stock (including 350,000,000 shares of Class B common stock underlying options), representing approximately 84.4% of the combined voting power of our outstanding shares of voting common stock. As the holder of a majority of our outstanding shares of Class B common stock, Mr. Musk will be able to elect, remove or fill any vacancy among the Class B Directors. As a result, Mr. Musk will have the power to control the outcome of matters requiring shareholder approval, including election of the board, and our business and affairs. This may have the effect of deferring, delaying or discouraging hostile takeovers, or changes in control or management, of the Company.
paras.zh: 如上文所述，我们的章程将规定，B 类普通股持有人作为单独类别进行表决，有权选举获授权董事总人数的 51%（向上取整至最接近的整数）。本次发行完成后，Musk 先生将实益持有 849,494,440 股我们的 A 类普通股和 5,569,053,075 股我们的 B 类普通股（包括 350,000,000 股 B 类普通股标的期权），约占我们已发行有表决权普通股合计表决权的 84.4%。作为我们已发行 B 类普通股多数股份的持有人，Musk 先生将能够选举、罢免或填补 B 类董事的任何空缺。因此，Musk 先生将有权控制需要股东批准的事项的结果，包括董事会选举，以及我们的业务和事务。这可能具有推迟、延迟或阻止针对本公司的敌意收购或控制权或管理层变更的效果。

paras.en: No cumulative voting
paras.zh: 无累积投票制

paras.en: Our charter will not permit cumulative voting in the election of directors.
paras.zh: 我们的章程将不允许在董事选举中进行累积投票。

paras.en: Special meetings of shareholders
paras.zh: 股东特别会议

paras.en: Our charter will provide that special meetings of shareholders may be called by the chairman of the board, the chief executive officer, the president (to the extent required by the TBOC), our board, our founder or by shareholders holding not less than 50% (or the highest percentage of ownership that may be set under the TBOC) of the Company’s then outstanding shares of capital stock entitled to vote on the proposed action at the meeting.
paras.zh: 我们的章程将规定，股东特别会议可由董事会主席、首席执行官、总裁（在 TBOC 要求的范围内）、我们的董事会、我们的创始人或持有不少于本公司届时已发行且有权就会议拟议行动表决的股本 50%（或 TBOC 下可设定的最高持股比例）的股东召集。

paras.en: Shareholder action by written consent
paras.zh: 股东书面同意行动

paras.en: Our charter will provide that any action required to be taken at any annual or special meeting of the shareholders may be taken without a meeting, without prior notice and without a vote if a consent or consents in writing, setting forth the action so taken, is signed by the holders of outstanding stock having not less than the minimum number of votes that would be necessary to authorize or take such action at a meeting at which all shares of stock entitled to vote thereon were present and voted. Our charter will also provide that any action required or permitted to be taken by the holders of Class B common stock, voting separately as a class, may be taken without a meeting, without prior notice and without a vote if a consent or consents in writing, setting forth the action so taken, is signed by the holders of outstanding Class B common stock having not less than the minimum number of votes that would be necessary to authorize or take such action at a meeting at which all shares of Class B common stock entitled to vote thereon were present and voted.
paras.zh: 我们的章程将规定，任何须在任何年度或特别股东会议上采取的行动，如经持有不少于在全体有权表决的股份均出席并表决的会议上授权或采取该行动所需最低表决票数的已发行股份持有人签署书面同意书，载明所采取的行动，则可不经会议、不经事先通知且不经表决而采取。我们的章程还将规定，B 类普通股持有人作为单独类别表决所需或允许采取的任何行动，如经持有不少于在全体有权表决的 B 类普通股均出席并表决的会议上授权或采取该行动所需最低表决票数的已发行 B 类普通股持有人签署书面同意书，载明所采取的行动，则可不经会议、不经事先通知且不经表决而采取。

paras.en: Requirements for advance notification of shareholder meetings, nominations and proposals
paras.zh: 股东会议、提名和提案的提前通知要求

paras.en: Our bylaws will establish advance notice procedures with respect to shareholder proposals and the nomination of candidates for election as a director. In order for any matter to be “properly brought” before a meeting, a shareholder (other than Mr. Musk and his permitted transferees) must comply with such advance notice procedures and provide us with certain information.
paras.zh: 我们的章程将就股东提案和董事选举候选人提名设立提前通知程序。为使任何事项在会议前“被适当提出”，股东（Musk 先生及其许可受让人除外）必须遵守该等提前通知程序并向我们提供某些信息。

paras.en: Section 21.373 of the TBOC permits a “nationally listed corporation” to amend its governing documents to elect to impose stock ownership requirements on shareholders seeking to submit a proposal on a matter (other than director nominations and procedural resolutions ancillary to the conduct of a shareholder meeting) to the shareholders of such corporation for approval at a shareholder meeting. If a “nationally listed corporation” elects to be governed by Section 21.373 of the TBOC, a shareholder or group of shareholders may submit a proposal on a matter to the shareholders of such corporation for approval at a meeting of shareholders only if such shareholder or group of shareholders (i) holds an amount of voting shares (determined as of the date of submission of the proposal) equal to at least $1,000,000 in market value or 3% of the corporation’s voting shares, and (ii) holds such amount for a continuous period of at least six months before the date of the meeting and throughout the entire duration of the meeting and (iii) solicits the holders of shares representing at least 67% of the voting power of shares entitled to vote on the proposal at the shareholder meeting. For the purpose of this paragraph, “voting shares” means shares that entitle the holder of the shares to vote on the proposal. Our bylaws will adopt these requirements for submitting a shareholder proposal to go into effect immediately upon the completion of this offering, when we will qualify as a “nationally listed corporation.”
paras.zh: TBOC 第 21.373 条允许“全国性上市公司”修订其治理文件，以选择对拟向该公司股东提交提案（董事提名及与股东会议进行相关的程序性决议除外）以供股东会议批准的股东施加持股要求。若“全国性上市公司”选择受 TBOC 第 21.373 条约束，则一名股东或一组股东只有在满足以下条件时，方可向该公司股东提交提案以供股东会议批准：(i) 该股东或该组股东持有（按提案提交之日确定）市值至少为 $1,000,000 或占公司有表决权股份 3% 的有表决权股份；(ii) 在会议日期之前连续持有该等股份至少六个月，并在会议整个期间持续持有；且 (iii) 征集持有至少占有权在股东会议上就该提案投票的股份表决权 67% 的股份持有人。就本段而言，“有表决权股份”指赋予其持有人就该提案投票权利的股份。我们的章程将采纳这些提交股东提案的要求，并自本次发行完成之日起立即生效，届时我们将符合“全国性上市公司”的资格。

paras.en: Authorized but unissued shares
paras.zh: 已授权但未发行的股份

paras.en: As mentioned above, our authorized but unissued shares of common stock and preferred stock will generally be available for future issuance without the approval of our shareholders. The TBOC does not require shareholder approval for any issuance of authorized shares. However, the Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas listing requirements require shareholder approval of certain issuances equal to or exceeding 20% of the then-outstanding voting power or the then-outstanding number of shares of common stock. We may issue additional shares for a variety of corporate purposes, including future public offerings to raise additional capital, corporate acquisitions and employee benefit plans.
paras.zh: 如上所述，我们已授权但未发行的普通股和优先股通常可在未经股东批准的情况下用于未来发行。TBOC 不要求任何已授权股份的发行须经股东批准。然而，纳斯达克和 Nasdaq Texas 的上市要求规定，某些发行若等于或超过当时已发行表决权的 20% 或当时已发行普通股股数的 20%，则须经股东批准。我们可能出于多种公司目的发行额外股份，包括为筹集额外资本而进行的未来公开发行、公司收购和员工福利计划。

paras.en: Under our charter, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, we will renounce any interest or expectancy of the Company or its subsidiaries in, or in being offered an opportunity to participate in, certain business opportunities (as specified in our charter) that are from time to time presented to any member of the board or board observer or attendee, regardless of whether any such person is an employee of the Company and their respective affiliates (other than the Company and its subsidiaries) (together, the “Business Opportunities Exempt Party”), even if the business opportunity is one that we or our subsidiaries might reasonably be deemed to have pursued or had the ability or desire to pursue if granted the opportunity to do so, and no Business Opportunities Exempt Party shall have any duty to present any such business opportunity to us or be liable to us or any of our subsidiaries or any shareholder, including for breach of any fiduciary or other duty, as a director or officer or controlling shareholder or otherwise, and we shall indemnify each Business Opportunities Exempt Party against any claim that such person is liable to us or our shareholders for breach of any fiduciary duty, by reason of the fact that such person (i) fails to present any such business opportunity, (ii) pursues, acquires or exploits any such business opportunity, or (iii) directs, sells, assigns or transfers any such business opportunity to another person or entity, unless, in the case of a person who is our director or officer, such business opportunity is presented to, or acquired, created or developed by, or otherwise comes into the possession of, such Business Opportunities Exempt Party expressly and solely in his or her capacity as an employee, director, board observer or attendee, or shareholder of the Company.
paras.zh: 根据我们的公司章程，在适用法律允许的最大范围内，我们将放弃本公司或其子公司对不时向董事会任何成员或董事会观察员或列席人员提供的某些商业机会（如公司章程所规定）所享有的任何权益或期待权益，或获得参与该等商业机会的机会的权益，无论任何该等人士是否为本公司及其各自关联方（本公司和其子公司除外）（合称“商业机会豁免方”）的雇员，即使该商业机会属于若给予机会我们或我们的子公司可能会合理地被认定本会寻求、或本有能力或意愿寻求的商业机会，且任何商业机会豁免方均无义务向我们提供任何该等商业机会，也不对我们或我们的任何子公司或任何股东承担责任，包括因作为董事、高级管理人员、控股股东或其他身份违反任何信义义务或其他义务而承担责任，并且我们将就任何声称该等人士因以下事实而对我们或我们的股东负有违反信义义务责任的索赔，对每一商业机会豁免方作出赔偿：(i) 未提供任何该等商业机会，(ii) 寻求、获取或利用任何该等商业机会，或 (iii) 将任何该等商业机会指示、出售、转让或转移给另一人士或实体，但如该人士为本公司董事或高级管理人员，则该商业机会系明确且仅以其作为本公司雇员、董事、董事会观察员或列席人员或股东的身份向该商业机会豁免方提供、或由其获取、创设或开发、或以其他方式为其所持有的情形除外。

full.sec: Exclusive Forum and Venue and Arbitration, Jury Trial Waiver
full.secZh: 专属法院与审判地及仲裁、陪审团审判豁免

paras.en: Our bylaws will provide that, unless the Company consents in writing to the selection of an alternative forum, the sole and exclusive forum for any of the filing, adjudication and trial of all disputes (“Internal Disputes”) between (i) one or more shareholders and (ii) the Company or its directors, officers, or controlling persons, or any underwriter of securities issued by the Company (or controlling person thereof) relating to any of the following: (1) any derivative proceeding, meaning a civil dispute brought in the right of the Company; (2) any action based on the governance, governing documents, or internal affairs of the Company; (3) any action based on state or federal securities or trade regulation laws; (4) any action based on the alleged act(s) or omission(s) by a person in its capacity as a shareholder, controlling person, director, officer, or other managerial official of the Company; (5) any action based on the alleged breach(es) by one or more shareholders, controlling persons, directors, officers, or other managerial officials of a duty owed, in his or her capacity as such, to the Company or to any shareholder thereof; (6) an action seeking to hold a shareholder, controlling person, director, officer, or other managerial official of the Company liable for an obligation of the Company, other than on account of a written contract signed by the person to be held liable in a capacity other than as a shareholder or managerial official; and (7) any action arising out of the TBOC, will be the Business Court. Please read carefully “Risk Factors—Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure, Ownership of our Class A Common Stock and This Offering—The TBOC and our charter include provisions that may limit shareholders’ ability to bring a cause of action against our directors or officers for certain acts or omissions in their capacity as directors or officers of the Company, including minimum share ownership for derivative proceedings and the presumption of the business judgment rule,” “Risk Factors—Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure, Ownership of our Class A Common Stock and This Offering—Our bylaws will impose minimum stock ownership and solicitation requirements on shareholders seeking to submit proposals for shareholder approval, which could limit the ability of our shareholders to bring matters before a meeting of shareholders,” and “Risk Factors—Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure, Ownership of our Class A Common Stock and This Offering—Our bylaws place restrictions on the forum, venue and procedures for legal actions or proceedings initiated by our shareholders, including certain requirements for mandatory arbitration. These provisions could limit our shareholders’ ability to pursue certain claims and/or increase the cost of doing so and could also affect the procedures, rights, and remedies available to our shareholders in such legal actions or proceedings.”
paras.zh: 我们的章程将规定，除非公司以书面形式同意选择替代法院，否则对于以下各方之间所有争议（“内部争议”）的提起、裁决和审理，专属且排他的法院应为商事法院：(i) 一名或多名股东与 (ii) 公司或其董事、高级管理人员或控制人，或公司所发行证券的任何承销商（或其控制人）之间，涉及以下任何事项：(1) 任何派生诉讼，即代表公司提起的民事争议；(2) 任何基于公司治理、治理文件或内部事务的诉讼；(3) 任何基于州或联邦证券法或贸易监管法的诉讼；(4) 任何基于某人以股东、控制人、董事、高级管理人员或公司其他管理官员身份作出的被指控作为或不作为的诉讼；(5) 任何基于一名或多名股东、控制人、董事、高级管理人员或其他管理官员被指控违反其以该等身份对公司或其任何股东所负义务的诉讼；(6) 寻求要求公司股东、控制人、董事、高级管理人员或其他管理官员对公司义务承担责任的诉讼，但基于该被要求承担责任之人以非股东或管理官员身份签署的书面合同而产生的责任除外；以及 (7) 任何根据 TBOC 产生的诉讼。请仔细阅读“风险因素——与我们公司结构、A 类普通股所有权及本次发行相关的风险——TBOC 和我们的章程包含可能限制股东就董事或高级管理人员以公司董事或高级管理人员身份作出的某些作为或不作为对其提起诉讼的能力的条款，包括派生诉讼的最低持股要求以及商业判断规则的推定”、“风险因素——与我们公司结构、A 类普通股所有权及本次发行相关的风险——我们的章程将对寻求提交股东批准提案的股东施加最低持股和征集要求，这可能限制我们股东将事项提交股东会议的能力”，以及“风险因素——与我们公司结构、A 类普通股所有权及本次发行相关的风险——我们的章程对我们股东提起的法律诉讼或程序的地点、审判地和程序施加限制，包括强制仲裁的某些要求。这些条款可能限制我们股东主张某些索赔的能力和/或增加这样做的成本，也可能影响我们股东在此类法律诉讼或程序中可获得的程序、权利和救济。”

paras.en: Our bylaws will further provide that to the extent, and solely to the extent, that a court of competent jurisdiction (which is a court that possesses personal and subject matter jurisdiction) declines in a final and unappealable judgment to transfer an Internal Dispute to the Business Court (such Internal Dispute, an “Other Dispute”), such Other Dispute, irrespective of the amount in dispute, shall be exclusively and finally settled by arbitration before the International Chamber of Commerce (“ICC”) in Houston, Texas, conducted under the Expedited Procedure Provisions of the Rules (the “Arbitration Rules”) of the ICC as those rules may be periodically updated. If a court declines to transfer an Internal Dispute to the Business Court, but such court is later held not to have personal or subject matter jurisdiction with respect to such Internal Dispute, the arbitration provision would not be triggered because such action would be required to be dismissed and subsequently brought in a court of competent jurisdiction.
paras.zh: 我们的章程将进一步规定，在有管辖权的法院（即拥有属人管辖权和属事管辖权的法院）以终局且不可上诉的判决拒绝将内部争议移交商事法院的情况下，且仅在该情况下，该等内部争议（下称“其他争议”）无论争议金额多少，均应专属且终局地通过仲裁解决，仲裁由国际商会（“ICC”）在德克萨斯州休斯顿进行，依据 ICC《规则》（下称“仲裁规则”）的快速程序条款（该等规则可能不时更新）进行。如法院拒绝将内部争议移交商事法院，但该法院其后被认定对该等内部争议不具有属人管辖权或属事管辖权，则仲裁条款将不会被触发，因为该等诉讼应予驳回并随后在有管辖权的法院提起。

paras.en: Our bylaws will provide the following for arbitration:
paras.zh: 我们的章程将就仲裁作出如下规定：

paras.en: - The tribunal will include one arbitrator for claims of $5 million or less or a panel of three arbitrators for claims exceeding $5 million, and our bylaws will specify procedures governing the selection of the panel. The ICC fees and arbitrator(s) fees will be governed by the ICC fee and arbitrator fee schedule as may apply depending on the nature and amount of the claim.
paras.zh: - 对于金额为 $5 million 或以下的请求，仲裁庭由一名仲裁员组成；对于金额超过 $5 million 的请求，由三名仲裁员组成的仲裁庭审理，且我们的章程将规定仲裁庭成员的选定程序。ICC 费用和仲裁员费用将依据 ICC 费用及仲裁员费用表确定，该费用表可能根据请求的性质和金额适用。

paras.en: - If more than three claims arising from the same or similar conduct, transaction, or occurrence are submitted to arbitration within any three-year period, all but the first-filed claim shall be stayed pending final resolution of that first-filed claim. In such circumstance, the Company and each shareholder asserting such a claim shall bear equal shares of the ICC fees and arbitrator(s) fees. However, if any shareholder party or parties are ultimately successful on all of their claims, the Company shall reimburse the successful shareholder party or parties for the ICC fees and arbitrator(s) fees paid by such shareholder party or parties.
paras.zh: - 如在任何三年期间内，因相同或类似行为、交易或事件产生的超过三项请求被提交仲裁，则除最先提交的请求外，其余所有请求均应中止，直至该最先提交的请求获得终局解决。在此情况下，本公司和提出该等请求的每名股东应平均分担 ICC 费用和仲裁员费用。但是，如任何股东一方或多方最终就其全部请求获得胜诉，本公司应就该股东一方或多方已支付的 ICC 费用和仲裁员费用向其予以补偿。

paras.en: - If more than three claims are submitted by the same shareholder(s) within any three-year period, then the Company shall pay the ICC fees and arbitrator(s) fees associated with the first three claims only. However, if any shareholder party or parties are ultimately successful on all of their claims, the Company shall reimburse the successful shareholder party or parties for the ICC fees and arbitrator(s) fees paid by such shareholder party or parties.
paras.zh: - 如任何股东在任何三年期间内提交超过三项请求，则本公司仅支付与前三项请求相关的 ICC 费用和仲裁员费用。但是，如任何股东一方或多方最终就其全部请求获得胜诉，本公司应就该股东一方或多方已支付的 ICC 费用和仲裁员费用向其予以补偿。

paras.en: - If any claim submitted to arbitration is determined by the tribunal to be frivolous, without reasonable cause, or for an improper purpose such as bad faith or vexatious litigation, the Company shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorney’s fees and costs incurred in defending against such claim, including any ICC fees and arbitrator(s) fees.
paras.zh: - 如提交仲裁的任何请求被仲裁庭认定为无实质意义、缺乏合理理由，或出于恶意或缠讼等不当目的，本公司有权追偿其为抗辩该等请求而发生的合理律师费和成本，包括任何 ICC 费用和仲裁员费用。

paras.en: - The tribunal’s authority is subject to the same limits as the authority of a judge in a Texas court of law. The tribunal does not have authority to issue an award that (i) exceeds the tribunal’s authority under the Texas Arbitration Act; (ii) contains a reversible error of state or federal law, including as to the admissibility of evidence, or a clearly erroneous finding of fact; or (iii) applies a cause of action or provides a remedy not expressly provided for under applicable Texas or federal law. The tribunal’s application of the pleading and discovery limitations imposed by the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act is mandatory for applicable claims and shall not constitute a refusal to hear evidence pertinent and/or material to the controversy under Texas or federal law.
paras.zh: - 仲裁庭的权限受制于与德克萨斯州法院法官权限相同的限制。仲裁庭无权作出以下裁决：(i) 超出《德克萨斯州仲裁法》项下仲裁庭权限的裁决；(ii) 包含州法或联邦法上的可撤销错误（包括关于证据可采性的错误）或明显错误的事实认定的裁决；或 (iii) 适用未在适用的德克萨斯州或联邦法律中明确规定的诉讼事由或提供未在适用的德克萨斯州或联邦法律中明确规定的救济的裁决。仲裁庭适用《私人证券诉讼改革法》所规定的诉答和证据开示限制，对于适用的请求具有强制性，且不构成根据德克萨斯州或联邦法律拒绝听取与争议相关和/或重要的证据。

paras.en: - Pursuant to the Texas Arbitration Act, the scope of judicial review of the tribunal’s award includes the ordinary grounds for vacatur, modification, and correction imposed by the Texas Civil Practice & Remedies Code §§ 171.088 and 171.091, and is expanded beyond what is otherwise available under the Texas Civil Practice & Remedies Code to include review of whether the award: (i) contains a reversible error of state or federal law, including as to the admissibility of evidence, or a clearly erroneous finding of fact; or (ii) applies a cause of action or provides a remedy not expressly provided for under applicable Texas or federal law. The arbitral tribunal’s award and the findings of fact and conclusions of law shall be reviewable upon the same standards of review as if said award and supporting findings of fact and conclusions of law were entered by a Texas court.
paras.zh: - 根据《德克萨斯州仲裁法》，对仲裁庭裁决的司法审查范围包括《德克萨斯州民事实践与救济法典》第 171.088 条和第 171.091 条所规定的撤销、变更和更正的一般理由，并扩展至超出《德克萨斯州民事实践与救济法典》原本可用的范围，包括审查裁决是否：(i) 包含州法或联邦法上的可撤销错误（包括关于证据可采性的错误）或明显错误的事实认定；或 (ii) 适用未在适用的德克萨斯州或联邦法律中明确规定的诉讼事由或提供未在适用的德克萨斯州或联邦法律中明确规定的救济。对仲裁庭的裁决以及事实认定和法律结论，应按照与德克萨斯州法院作出的上述裁决及支持性事实认定和法律结论相同的审查标准进行审查。

paras.en: - Any action seeking to confirm, vacate, modify, correct, or otherwise challenge the tribunal’s award shall be brought in the Business Court. In any such action, the parties shall file all court filings under seal, to the fullest extent allowed by applicable law.
paras.zh: - 任何寻求确认、撤销、变更、更正或以其他方式质疑仲裁庭裁决的诉讼，均应提交至商事法院。在任何此类诉讼中，各方应在适用法律允许的最大范围内，对所有法院文件进行密封提交。

paras.en: Our bylaws will further provide that to the extent, and solely to the extent, that a court of competent jurisdiction determines in a final and unappealable judgment that the requirement that Other Disputes be exclusively and finally settled by arbitration is unenforceable in whole or part, the sole and exclusive forum and venue for such Other Disputes which are determined not to be subject to mandatory arbitration shall be the United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas, Houston Division (the “Federal Court”), or if a court of competent jurisdiction determines in a final and unappealable judgment that the Federal Court lacks jurisdiction over any such Other Dispute, the sole and exclusive forum and venue for such Other Dispute shall be the state district courts of Harris County, Texas.
paras.zh: 我们的章程将进一步规定，在有管辖权的法院以终局且不可上诉的判决认定其他争议应排他且终局地通过仲裁解决的要求全部或部分不可执行的范围内（且仅在该范围内），对于被认定不受强制仲裁约束的该等其他争议，唯一且排他的管辖法院和审判地应为美国德克萨斯州南区联邦地区法院休斯顿分院（“联邦法院”）；或者，如果有管辖权的法院以终局且不可上诉的判决认定联邦法院对任何该等其他争议缺乏管辖权，则该等其他争议的唯一且排他的管辖法院和审判地应为德克萨斯州哈里斯县的州地区法院。

paras.en: Our bylaws will further provide that Other Disputes will be governed either by Texas state law or federal law, depending on the claim asserted.
paras.zh: 我们的章程将进一步规定，其他争议将根据所主张的请求，适用德克萨斯州法或联邦法。

paras.en: Our bylaws will also provide that:
paras.zh: 我们的章程还将规定：

paras.en: - The Company and each shareholder, director, and officer of the Company irrevocably and unconditionally waives, and any person or entity purchasing or otherwise acquiring or holding any interest in shares of stock of the Company shall be deemed to have irrevocably and unconditionally waived, any right it may have to a trial by jury in any legal action or proceeding relating to Internal Disputes described above.
paras.zh: - 公司及公司的每一位股东、董事和高级管理人员不可撤销且无条件地放弃，任何购买或以其他方式取得或持有公司股票权益的个人或实体应被视为已不可撤销且无条件地放弃，其在任何与上述内部争议相关的法律诉讼或程序中可能享有的由陪审团审理的任何权利。

paras.en: - Internal Disputes may not be brought as a class, or consolidated or joined, except at the Company’s option.
paras.zh: - 除公司选择外，内部争议不得作为集体诉讼提起，也不得合并或联合审理。

paras.en: Although we believe these provisions will benefit us by providing increased consistency in the application of Texas law for the specified types of actions and proceedings, the provisions may have the effect of discouraging or increasing the costs of lawsuits against our directors, officers, other managerial officials employees and agents. However, it is possible that, in connection with a future legal proceeding, a court could rule that all or a portion of these provisions in our bylaws purporting to require an exclusive forum for certain disputes, to waive the right to a jury trial or to require arbitration for shareholder claims are inapplicable, unconstitutional or otherwise unenforceable.
paras.zh: 尽管我们认为这些条款将通过为特定类型的诉讼和程序提供德克萨斯州法律适用上更高的一致性而使我们受益，但这些条款可能具有抑制或增加针对我们的董事、高级管理人员、其他管理官员、员工和代理人提起诉讼的成本的效果。然而，在未来的法律程序中，法院有可能裁定我们章程中旨在要求某些争议适用专属法院、放弃陪审团审理权利或要求股东索赔进行仲裁的这些条款的全部或部分不适用、违宪或在其他方面不可执行。

full.sec: Stock Ownership Requirement for Derivative Suits

paras.en: Our bylaws will specify that the required ownership threshold for a shareholder or group of shareholders to institute or maintain a derivative proceeding in the right of the Company for purposes of Section 21.552(a)(3) of the TBOC will be 3% of the outstanding shares of the Company. This provision will continue to apply so long as any shares of the Company’s common stock are listed for trading on a national securities exchange or the Company affirmatively elects to be governed by TBOC 21.419 and has 500 or more shareholders.
paras.zh: 我们的章程将规定，就《得克萨斯州商业组织法典》（TBOC）第 21.552(a)(3) 条而言，股东或股东集团为以公司名义提起或维持派生诉讼所需的持股门槛为公司已发行股份的 3%。只要公司任何普通股仍在全国性证券交易所上市交易，或公司主动选择受 TBOC 21.419 管辖且股东人数达到 500 名或以上，该条款将持续适用。

full.sec: Limitations on Liability and Indemnification of Officers and Directors
full.secZh: 高管和董事的责任限制与赔偿

paras.en: Our charter will include a provision eliminating the liability of our directors and officers for monetary damages for an act or omission by the person in the person’s capacity as a director or officer, respectively, except for: (i) a breach of the duty of loyalty to the Company or its shareholders; (ii) an act or omission not in good faith that constitutes a breach of duty of the person to the Company or involves intentional misconduct or a knowing violation of applicable law; (iii) a transaction from which the director or officer obtains an improper benefit, regardless of whether the benefit resulted from an action taken within the scope of the person’s duties; or (iv) an act or omission for which the liability of a director or officer is expressly provided by an applicable statute (such as wrongful distributions). Our charter also will provide that if the TBOC is amended in the future to authorize corporate action further eliminating or limiting of the personal liability of directors and officers, the liability of directors and officers will be eliminated or limited to the fullest extent permitted by the TBOC as so amended.
paras.zh: 我们的公司章程将包含一项条款，免除我们的董事和高级管理人员因其以董事或高级管理人员身份作出的作为或不作为而承担的金钱损害赔偿责任，但以下情形除外：(i) 违反对公司或其股东的忠实义务；(ii) 非善意的作为或不作为，构成该人员对公司义务的违反，或涉及故意不当行为或明知违反适用法律；(iii) 董事或高级管理人员从中获得不当利益的交易，无论该利益是否源于该人员在其职责范围内采取的行动；或 (iv) 适用法规明确规定董事或高级管理人员应承担责任的行为或不作为（例如不当分配）。我们的公司章程还将规定，如果 TBOC 未来被修订以授权进一步免除或限制董事和高级管理人员的个人责任的公司行为，则董事和高级管理人员的责任将在经如此修订的 TBOC 所允许的最大范围内予以免除或限制。

paras.en: Any amendment, repeal or modification of these provisions will be prospective only and would not affect any limitation on liability of a director or officer for acts or omissions that occurred prior to any such amendment, repeal or modification.
paras.zh: 对上述条款的任何修订、废止或修改均仅具有前瞻性效力，且不会影响对董事或高级管理人员在任何该等修订、废止或修改之前发生的作为或不作为所享有的任何责任限制。

paras.en: Our bylaws also provide that we will indemnify and advance expenses to our directors and officers to the fullest extent permitted by the TBOC, subject to reimbursement in the event it is ultimately determined that the individual was not entitled to indemnification under the TBOC or the indemnification agreement. Our bylaws also will permit us to purchase insurance on behalf of any officer, director, employee, or other agent for any liability arising out of that person’s actions as our officer, director, employee or agent, regardless of whether the TBOC would permit indemnification. We intend to enter into indemnification agreements with each of our current and future directors and officers. These agreements will require us to indemnify these individuals against liability that may arise by reason of their service to us, and to advance expenses incurred as a result of any proceeding against them as to which they could be indemnified. As permitted by the TBOC, because these agreements are expected to be approved by our shareholders, the agreements may require indemnification or payment of expenses in favor of the indemnitee in certain circumstances in which we would not otherwise have the power to do so under the provisions of the TBOC or our charter or bylaws. We believe that the limitation of liability provision that will be in our charter and the indemnification agreements will facilitate our ability to continue to attract and retain qualified individuals to serve as directors and officers.
paras.zh: 我们的章程还规定，我们将在 TBOC 所允许的最大范围内对我们的董事和高级管理人员进行赔偿并预付费用，但如果在最终确定该个人无权根据 TBOC 或赔偿协议获得赔偿的情况下，须予以返还。我们的章程还将允许我们代表任何高级管理人员、董事、员工或其他代理人就其以我们的高级管理人员、董事、员工或代理人身份采取行动所产生的任何责任购买保险，无论 TBOC 是否允许赔偿。我们打算与我们现任和未来的每一位董事和高级管理人员签订赔偿协议。该等协议将要求我们就这些个人因其向我们提供服务而可能产生的责任进行赔偿，并预付因其可能有权获得赔偿的任何针对他们的诉讼程序所产生的费用。在 TBOC 允许的情况下，由于该等协议预计将获得我们股东的批准，该等协议可能要求在某些情况下向受赔偿人进行赔偿或支付费用，而根据 TBOC 或我们的公司章程或章程细则的规定，我们在该等情况下本无权这样做。我们认为，将载入我们公司章程的责任限制条款以及赔偿协议将有助于我们继续吸引和留住合格人士担任董事和高级管理人员。

paras.en: Our bylaws will provide that the Company affirmatively elects to be governed by Section 21.419 of the TBOC and any successor provision thereto. Because the Company will have a class of voting common stock (our Class A common stock) listed on a national securities exchange, Section 21.419 will also be deemed to apply to the Company. Under Section 21.419 of the TBOC, in taking or declining to take any action on any matters of a corporation’s business, a director or officer of the Company is presumed to act (i) in good faith, (ii) on an informed basis, (iii) in furtherance of the interests of the Company, and (iv) in obedience to the law and the Company’s governing documents. In addition, neither the Company nor any of its shareholders has a cause of action against the director or officer as a result of any act or omission in the person’s capacity as such unless the claimant rebuts one or more of the foregoing presumptions and it is proven by the claimant that (A) the director’s or officer’s act or omission constitutes a breach of one or more of the person’s duties as a director or officer and (B) the breach involved fraud, intentional misconduct, an ultra vires act or a knowing violation of law.
paras.zh: 我们的章程将规定，公司明确选择受《得克萨斯州商业组织法典》（TBOC）第 21.419 条及其任何后续条款的约束。由于公司将拥有一类在全国性证券交易所上市的有表决权普通股（我们的 A 类普通股），第 21.419 条也将被视为适用于公司。根据 TBOC 第 21.419 条，在就公司业务的任何事项采取或不采取任何行动时，公司董事或高管被推定 (i) 出于善意、(ii) 在知情的基础上、(iii) 为促进公司利益，且 (iv) 遵守法律和公司章程文件。此外，除非索赔人反驳上述一项或多项推定，且索赔人证明 (A) 董事或高管的作为或不作为构成对该人士作为董事或高管的一项或多项义务的违反，且 (B) 该违反涉及欺诈、故意不当行为、越权行为或明知违反法律，否则公司及其任何股东均不得因该人士以此种身份作出的任何作为或不作为对该董事或高管提起诉讼。

paras.en: Section 21.418 of the TBOC provides that, at any time a corporation’s voting common stock is listed for trading on a national securities exchange, the corporation’s directors and officers will not be liable to the corporation or its shareholders for claims alleging a breach of duty arising from the making, authorization, or performance of a contract or transaction solely because the director or officer had an interest in the transaction unless the claim would be permitted under Section 21.419 of the TBOC as described above. Because the Company will have a class of voting common stock (our Class A common stock) listed on a national securities exchange, Section 21.418 of the TBOC will be deemed to apply to the Company.
paras.zh: TBOC 第 21.418 条规定，在公司有表决权普通股于全国性证券交易所上市交易的任何时间，公司董事和高级管理人员不就仅因该董事或高级管理人员在合同或交易中拥有利益而提出的、指控其因订立、授权或履行该合同或交易而违反义务的索赔向公司或其股东承担责任，除非该索赔依据上文所述 TBOC 第 21.419 条应予允许。由于公司将有一类有表决权普通股（我们的 A 类普通股）在全国性证券交易所上市，TBOC 第 21.418 条将被视为适用于公司。

paras.en: For a description of registration rights with respect to our Class A common stock, see “Certain Relationships and Related Person Transactions—Investors’ Rights Agreement.”
paras.zh: 有关我们 A 类普通股注册权的说明，请参见“某些关系及关联人士交易——投资者权利协议”。

paras.en: The transfer agent and registrar for our Class A common stock is Fidelity Stock Transfer Solutions LLC. Its address is 245 Summer Street, Boston, Massachusetts 02210, and its phone number is (617) 563-5800.
paras.zh: 我们 A 类普通股的过户代理及登记机构为 Fidelity Stock Transfer Solutions LLC。其地址为 245 Summer Street, Boston, Massachusetts 02210，电话号码为 (617) 563-5800。

paras.en: We have been approved to list our Class A common stock on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas under the symbol “SPCX.”
paras.zh: 我们已获准在纳斯达克和纳斯达克得克萨斯以股票代码“SPCX”上市我们的 A 类普通股。

paras.en: Prior to this offering, there has been no public market for our Class A common stock. Future sales of our Class A common stock in the public market, or the availability of such shares for sale in the public market, could adversely affect the market price of our Class A common stock prevailing from time to time. As described below, only a limited number of shares will be available for sale shortly after this offering due to contractual and legal restrictions on resale. Nevertheless, sales of a substantial number of shares of our Class A common stock in the public market after such restrictions lapse, or the perception that those sales may occur, could adversely affect the prevailing market price of our Class A common stock at such time and our ability to raise equity-related capital at a time and price we deem appropriate.

paras.en: After completion of this offering, we will register the resale of shares of our Class A common stock that have been issued pursuant to various historical equity compensation plans. Such shares will be registered on Form S-8. The resale registration of these shares will result in the shares becoming immediately eligible for resale in the public market without restriction under the Securities Act immediately upon the effectiveness of such registration statement, subject to certain limitations applicable to any affiliates and any applicable lock-up agreements.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，我们将登记依据各项历史股权激励计划已发行的 A 类普通股的回售。该等股份将以 S-8 表格进行登记。该等股份的回售登记将使得该等股份在该登记声明生效后立即具备在公开市场回售的资格，且不受《证券法》限制，但须遵守适用于任何关联方的某些限制及任何适用的锁定期协议。

paras.en: In general, under Rule 144 under the Securities Act as currently in effect, a person (or persons whose shares are aggregated) who is not deemed to have been an affiliate of ours at any time during the three months preceding a sale, and who has beneficially owned restricted securities within the meaning of Rule 144 for at least six months (including any period of consecutive ownership of preceding non-affiliated holders) would be entitled to sell those shares, but only (i) once we have been subject to the public company reporting requirements of the Exchange Act for at least 90 days and (ii) subject to the availability of current public information about us. A non-affiliated person (who has been unaffiliated for at least the past three months) who has beneficially owned restricted securities within the meaning of Rule 144 for at least one year would be entitled to sell those shares without regard to the provisions of Rule 144 (including before we have been subject to the public company reporting requirements of the Exchange Act for at least 90 days).
paras.zh: 一般而言，根据现行有效的《证券法》第 144 条规则，某人（或其股份被合并计算的人士）在出售前三个月内任何时候均不被视为我们的关联方，且其实益拥有第 144 条规则所指的限制性证券至少六个月（包括前手非关联持有人的任何连续持有期），则该人士有权出售该等股份，但仅限于(i)我们已受《交易法》上市公司报告要求约束至少 90 天，且(ii)须有关于我们的当前公开信息可供查阅。非关联人士（在过去至少三个月内一直为非关联方）实益拥有第 144 条规则所指的限制性证券至少一年的，有权出售该等股份，而无须遵守第 144 条规则的规定（包括在我们已受《交易法》上市公司报告要求约束至少 90 天之前）。

paras.en: Beginning 90 days after the effective date of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part, a person (or persons whose shares are aggregated) who is deemed to be an affiliate of ours and who has beneficially owned restricted securities within the meaning of Rule 144 for at least 12 total months would be entitled to sell within any three-month period a number of shares that does not exceed the greater of
paras.zh: 自本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之日起 90 天后，被视为我们关联方且实益拥有第 144 条规则所指的限制性证券合计至少 12 个月的人士（或其股份被合并计算的人士），有权在任何三个月期间内出售不超过以下两者中较大者的股份数量：

paras.en: - 1% of the number of shares of our Class A common stock then outstanding, which will equal approximately73.8 million shares immediately after the completion of this offering; or
paras.zh: - 届时已发行的 A 类普通股股份数量的 1%，在本发行完成后将约等于 73.8 百万股；或

paras.en: - the average weekly trading volume of our Class A common stock reported through Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas during the four calendar weeks preceding the filing of a notice on Form 144 with respect to such sale.
paras.zh: - 在就此类出售提交 Form 144 通知之前的四个日历周内，通过 Nasdaq 和 Nasdaq Texas 报告的我们 A 类普通股的平均每周交易量。

paras.en: Such sales under Rule 144 by our “affiliates” or persons selling shares on behalf of our “affiliates” are also subject to certain manner of sale provisions, notice requirements and the availability of current public information about us.
paras.zh: 我们的“关联方”或代表我们的“关联方”出售股份的人士根据第 144 条规则进行的此类出售，还须遵守某些出售方式规定、通知要求以及关于我们的当前公开信息可供查阅的要求。

paras.en: Regulation S under the Securities Act (“Regulation S”) provides that ordinary shares owned by any person may be sold without registration in the United States, provided that the sale is effected in an offshore transaction and no directed selling efforts are made in the United States (as these terms are defined in Regulation S), subject to certain other conditions. In general, this means that our Class A common stock may be sold outside the United States under certain circumstances without registration in the United States being required.
paras.zh: 《证券法》下的 S 条例（“S 条例”）规定，任何人拥有的普通股均可在美国境内无需注册而出售，前提是该出售系在离岸交易中完成，且未在美国境内进行定向销售努力（该等术语的定义见 S 条例），并须满足某些其他条件。一般而言，这意味着我们的 A 类普通股可在特定情形下于美国境外出售，而无需在美国境内进行注册。

paras.en: In general, under Rule 701 under the Securities Act, any of our employees, directors, officers, consultants or advisors who purchases shares from us in connection with a compensatory stock or option plan or other written agreement before the effective date of this offering is entitled to sell such shares 90 days after the effective date of this offering in reliance on Rule 144, without having to comply with the holding period requirement of Rule 144 and, in the case of non-affiliates, without having to comply with the public information, volume limitation or notice filing provisions of Rule 144. The SEC has indicated that Rule 701 will apply to typical stock options granted by an issuer before it becomes subject to the reporting requirements of the Exchange Act, along with the shares acquired upon exercise of such options, including exercises after the date of this prospectus.
paras.zh: 一般而言，根据《证券法》第 701 条规则，我们的任何员工、董事、高级管理人员、顾问或咨询人在本次发行生效日之前，因补偿性股票或期权计划或其他书面协议向我们购买股份的，有权在本次发行生效日之后 90 天依据第 144 条规则出售该等股份，而无需遵守第 144 条规则的持有期要求，且对于非关联方而言，无需遵守第 144 条规则的公开信息、数量限制或通知备案规定。SEC 已表示，第 701 条规则将适用于发行人在其受《交易法》报告要求约束之前授予的典型股票期权，以及行使该等期权所获得的股份，包括在招股说明书日期之后行使所获得的股份。

full.secZh: 员工计划下发行的股票

paras.en: We intend to file a registration statement on Form S-8 under the Securities Act to register stock issuable under our A&R 2024 Plan and A&R 2017 ESPP and to register stock issuable pursuant to outstanding awards under our other Equity Plans. This registration statement on Form S-8 is expected to be filed following the effective date of the registration statement of which this prospectus is a part and will be effective immediately upon filing. Accordingly, shares of Class A common stock registered under such registration statement will be available for sale in the open market following the effective date, unless such shares are subject to vesting restrictions with us or the lock-up and market standoff restrictions described above.
paras.zh: 我们拟根据《证券法》提交一份 S-8 表格注册声明，以注册根据我们经修订和重述的 2024 年计划及经修订和重述的 2017 年员工购股计划（ESPP）可发行的股票，并注册根据我们其他股权计划项下未兑现奖励可发行的股票。该 S-8 表格注册声明预计将在本招股说明书所构成的注册声明生效日期之后提交，并将在提交时立即生效。因此，根据该注册声明注册的 A 类普通股股份将在生效日期之后可在公开市场出售，除非该等股份受限于我们施加的归属限制或上述锁定期和市场禁售限制。

paras.en: The following discussion is a summary of the material U.S. federal income tax consequences of the purchase, ownership, and disposition of shares of our Class A common stock by a Non-U.S. Holder (as defined below). This discussion does not address all aspects of U.S. federal income taxation that may be relevant to particular taxpayers in light of their special circumstances (including the impact of the Medicare contribution tax on net investment income and the alternative minimum tax) or to taxpayers subject to special tax rules (including a “controlled foreign corporation,” a “passive foreign investment company,” a company that accumulates earnings to avoid U.S. federal income tax, a tax-exempt organization or a governmental organization, a financial institution, a person that elects to mark their securities to market, a person required to conform the timing of income accruals to financial statements pursuant to Section 451 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”), a person holding our Class A common stock as part of a hedge, straddle, or other risk reduction strategy or as part of a conversion transaction or other integrated investment, a person who holds or receives our Class A common stock pursuant to the exercise of any employee stock option or otherwise as compensation, a tax-qualified retirement plan, a “qualified foreign pension fund” as defined in Section 897(l)(2) of “Code” or an entity all of the interests of which are held by qualified foreign pension funds, a broker or dealer in securities or currencies, a U.S. expatriate, a former U.S. citizen or resident, or a partnership or other entity or arrangement treated as a partnership for U.S. federal income tax purposes).
paras.zh: 以下讨论概述了非美国持有人（定义见下文）购买、持有和处置本公司 A 类普通股股份在重大美国联邦所得税方面的后果。本讨论并未涵盖可能对特定纳税人因其特殊情况而相关的美国联邦所得税所有方面（包括对净投资收入征收的医疗保险附加税以及替代性最低税的影响），也未涵盖受特殊税务规则约束的纳税人(包括“受控外国公司”、“被动外国投资公司”、为规避美国联邦所得税而累积收益的公司、免税组织或政府组织、金融机构、选择将其证券按市值计价的人、根据经修订的 1986 年《国内税收法典》（以下简称“《法典》”）第 451 条须将收入应计时间与财务报表保持一致的人、将本公司 A 类普通股作为对冲、跨式或其他风险降低策略的一部分或作为转换交易或其他综合投资的一部分持有的人、根据行使任何员工股票期权或其他作为补偿方式而持有或获得本公司 A 类普通股的人、税收合格退休计划、《法典》第 897(l)(2)条所定义的“合格外国养老基金”或其全部权益均由合格外国养老基金持有的实体、证券或货币经纪商或交易商、美国侨民、前美国公民或居民，或合伙企业或其他在美国联邦所得税目的下被视为合伙企业的实体或安排)。

paras.en: Except as specifically provided herein, this discussion does not address any aspect of U.S. federal taxation other than U.S. federal income taxation or any aspect of state, local or foreign taxation. In addition, this discussion deals only with U.S. federal income tax consequences to a Non-U.S. Holder that acquires our Class A common stock in this offering and holds our Class A common stock as a capital asset.
paras.zh: 除本文件另有明确规定外，本讨论不涉及美国联邦所得税以外的任何美国联邦税务方面，也不涉及任何州、地方或外国税务方面。此外，本讨论仅涉及在本次发行中购买本公司 A 类普通股并将本公司 A 类普通股作为资本资产持有的非美国持有人的美国联邦所得税后果。

paras.en: This discussion is based on the Code, Treasury Regulations promulgated thereunder, judicial decisions, and published rulings and administrative pronouncements of the Internal Revenue Service (the “IRS”), in each case, in effect as of the date hereof. These authorities may change or be subject to differing interpretations. Any such change or differing interpretation may be applied retroactively in a manner that could adversely affect a Non-U.S. Holder of our Class A common stock. We have not sought and will not seek any rulings from the IRS regarding the matters discussed below. We cannot assure that the IRS or a court will not take a contrary position to that discussed below regarding the tax consequences of the purchase, ownership, and disposition of our Class A common stock, or that a change in law will not alter significantly the tax considerations that we describe in this summary.
paras.zh: 本讨论基于《法典》、据此颁布的《财政部条例》、司法判决以及美国国税局（以下简称“IRS”）已公布的裁定和行政公告，且均以本文件日期生效的版本为准。这些权威依据可能发生变化或受到不同解释。任何此类变化或不同解释可能以具有追溯效力的方式适用，从而可能对本公司 A 类普通股的非美国持有人产生不利影响。我们未曾且不会就下述事项向 IRS 寻求任何裁定。我们无法保证 IRS 或法院不会就购买、持有和处置本公司 A 类普通股的税务后果采取与下述讨论相反的立场，也无法保证法律的变化不会显著改变我们在本摘要中描述的税务考量。

paras.en: A “Non-U.S. Holder” is a beneficial owner of our Class A common stock that is an individual, corporation (or other entity treated as a corporation for U.S. federal income tax purposes), trust or estate that is not, for U.S. federal income tax purposes:
paras.zh: “非美国持有人”是指作为我们 A 类普通股受益所有人的个人、公司（或就美国联邦所得税目的被视为公司的其他实体）、信托或遗产，且就美国联邦所得税目的不属于以下情形：

paras.en: - an individual who is a citizen or resident of the United States;
paras.zh: - 美国公民或居民的个人；

paras.en: - a corporation created or organized in or under the laws of the United States or any State thereof (including the District of Columbia);
paras.zh: - 在美国或美国任何州（包括哥伦比亚特区）法律下设立或组织的公司；

paras.en: - an estate, the income of which is subject to U.S. federal income taxation regardless of its source; or
paras.zh: - 其收入无论来源如何均须缴纳美国联邦所得税的遗产；或

paras.en: - a trust, the administration of which is subject to the primary supervision of a court within the United States and for which one or more U.S. persons have the authority to control all substantial decisions, or that has a valid election in effect under applicable Treasury Regulations to be treated as a U.S. person.
paras.zh: - 其管理受美国境内法院的主要监督、且一名或多名美国人有权控制其所有重大决定的信托，或根据适用的财政部法规作出有效选择被视为美国人的信托。

paras.en: If a partnership or an entity or arrangement treated as a partnership for U.S. federal income tax purposes holds our Class A common stock, the U.S. federal income tax treatment of a partner generally will depend upon the status of the partner and the activities of the partnership. Partnerships holding our Class A common stock and partners in such partnerships should consult their tax advisors concerning the U.S. federal income and other tax consequences of investing in our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 如果就美国联邦所得税目的被视为合伙企业的合伙企业、实体或安排持有我们的 A 类普通股，合伙人的美国联邦所得税待遇通常取决于合伙人的身份及合伙企业的活动。持有我们 A 类普通股的合伙企业及该等合伙企业的合伙人应就投资我们 A 类普通股的美国联邦所得税及其他税务后果咨询其税务顾问。

paras.en: THIS DISCUSSION OF U.S. FEDERAL INCOME TAX CONSIDERATIONS IS FOR GENERAL INFORMATION PURPOSES ONLY AND IS NOT TAX ADVICE. PROSPECTIVE HOLDERS SHOULD CONSULT THEIR TAX ADVISORS CONCERNING THE U.S. FEDERAL INCOME TAX CONSEQUENCES TO THEM OF PURCHASING, OWNING, AND DISPOSING OF OUR CLASS A COMMON STOCK, AS WELL AS THE APPLICATION OF ANY U.S. FEDERAL NON-INCOME, STATE, LOCAL AND NON-U.S. INCOME, GIFT, ESTATE AND OTHER TAX LAWS.
paras.zh: 本关于美国联邦所得税考虑因素的讨论仅供一般信息参考，不构成税务建议。潜在持有人应就购买、持有和处置我们 A 类普通股对其产生的美国联邦所得税后果，以及任何美国联邦非所得税、州、地方和非美国所得税、赠与税、遗产税及其他税法适用问题，咨询其税务顾问。

paras.en: As described in the section titled “Dividend Policy,” we do not anticipate declaring or paying dividends to holders of our Class A common stock in the foreseeable future. However, if we do make distributions of cash or property on our Class A common stock (other than certain pro rata distributions of our stock), such distributions will be treated as dividends to the extent paid out of our current or accumulated earnings and profits (as determined under U.S. federal income tax principles). Amounts not treated as dividends for U.S. federal income tax purposes will be treated as a tax-free return of capital and first be applied against and reduce a Non-U.S. Holder’s tax basis in its shares of our Class A common stock, but not below zero. Any excess will be treated as capital gain from the sale or exchange of the Non-U.S. Holder’s shares of Class A common stock taxable as described below under “—Sale or Disposition of Class A Common Stock.”
paras.zh: 如“股息政策”一节所述，我们预计在可预见的未来不会就我们的 A 类普通股向持有人宣布或支付股息。但是，如果我们确实就我们的 A 类普通股进行现金或财产分配（某些按比例进行的股票分配除外），则该等分配在从我们当期或累计收益及利润（按美国联邦所得税原则确定）中支付的范围内，将被视为股息。就美国联邦所得税目的不被视为股息的金额，将被视为免税的资本返还，并首先用于冲减非美国持有人的 A 类普通股股份的计税基础，但不得低于零。任何超出部分将被视为非美国持有人出售或交换其 A 类普通股股份的资本利得，其税务处理如下文“——A 类普通股的出售或处置”所述。

paras.en: Subject to the discussion below on backup withholding and FATCA, dividends paid to a Non-U.S. Holder of our Class A common stock that are not effectively connected with the Non-U.S. Holder’s conduct of a trade or business within the United States will generally be subject to withholding of U.S. federal income tax at a 30% rate or such lower rate as may be specified by an applicable income tax treaty, provided the Non-U.S. Holder furnishes a valid IRS Form W-8BEN or W-8BEN-E (or other applicable documentation) certifying qualification for the lower treaty rate. These certifications must be provided to the applicable withholding agent prior to the payment of dividends and must be updated periodically. A Non-U.S. Holder that does not timely furnish the required documentation, but is eligible for a reduced rate of withholding tax under an income tax treaty, may obtain a refund or credit of any excess amounts withheld by filing an appropriate claim for refund with the IRS. Non-U.S. Holders should consult their tax advisors regarding their entitlement to benefits under an applicable income tax treaty and the manner of claiming the benefits of such treaty.
paras.zh: 在受下文关于备用预扣税和 FATCA 的讨论约束的前提下，向非美国持有人支付的、与该非美国持有人在美国境内开展贸易或业务无实际关联的 A 类普通股股息，一般应按 30%的税率或适用的所得税条约可能规定的较低税率缴纳美国联邦所得税预扣税，前提是该非美国持有人提供有效的 IRS Form W-8BEN 或 W-8BEN-E（或其他适用文件），证明其符合享受较低条约税率的资格。该等证明必须在支付股息之前提供给适用的预扣义务人，并须定期更新。未及时提供所需文件、但根据所得税条约有资格享受较低预扣税率的非美国持有人，可通过向 IRS 提交适当的退税申请，获得任何超额预扣金额的退税或抵免。非美国持有人应就其根据适用所得税条约享有的优惠待遇及申请该等条约优惠的方式咨询其税务顾问。

paras.en: Dividends that are effectively connected with a Non-U.S. Holder’s conduct of a trade or business within the United States (and, if required by an applicable income tax treaty, are attributable to a permanent establishment or fixed base that such holder maintains or maintained in the United States) are not subject to the withholding tax described above but instead are subject to U.S. federal income tax on a net income basis at applicable graduated U.S. federal income tax rates. In order for its effectively connected dividends to be exempt from the withholding tax described above, a Non-U.S. Holder will be required to provide a duly completed and properly executed IRS Form W-8ECI, certifying that the dividends are effectively connected with the Non-U.S. Holder’s conduct of a trade or business within the United States. Dividends received by a Non-U.S. Holder that is a corporation that are effectively connected with its conduct of a trade or business within the United States may be subject to an additional “branch profits tax” at a 30% rate or such lower rate as may be specified by an applicable income tax treaty. Non-U.S. Holders should consult their tax advisors regarding any applicable tax treaties that may provide for different rules.
paras.zh: 与非美国持有人在美国境内开展贸易或业务有实际关联的股息（且若适用所得税条约有要求，归属于该持有人在美国维持或曾维持的常设机构或固定基地的股息）不适用上述预扣税，而是按适用的美国联邦所得税累进税率，以净所得为基础缴纳美国联邦所得税。为使有实际关联的股息免于适用上述预扣税，非美国持有人须提供正式填写并妥善签署的 IRS W-8ECI 表格，证明该股息与非美国持有人在美国境内开展贸易或业务有实际关联。非美国持有人如为公司，其收到的股息若与其在美国境内开展贸易或业务有实际关联，可能需缴纳额外的“分支机构利润税”，税率为 30% 或适用所得税条约规定的较低税率。非美国持有人应就任何可能规定不同规则的适用税收条约咨询其税务顾问。

full.sec: Sale or Disposition of Class A Common Stock
full.secZh: A 类普通股的出售或处置

paras.en: Subject to the discussion below on backup withholding and FATCA, a Non-U.S. Holder generally will not be subject to U.S. federal income or withholding tax on any gain recognized upon the sale, exchange or other taxable disposition of shares of our Class A common stock, unless:
paras.zh: 在受限于下文关于备用预扣税和 FATCA 的讨论的前提下，非美国持有人通常无需就出售、交换或以其他方式处置我们的 A 类普通股股份所确认的任何收益缴纳美国联邦所得税或预扣税，除非：

paras.en: - such gain is effectively connected with the conduct by such Non-U.S. Holder of a trade or business within the United States and, if the Non-U.S. Holder is entitled to claim treaty benefits (and the Non-U.S. Holder complies with applicable certification and other requirements), is attributable to a permanent establishment or fixed base maintained by the Non-U.S. Holder within the United States;
paras.zh: - 该等收益与该非美国持有人在美国境内开展的贸易或业务存在实际关联，且（如该非美国持有人有权主张协定优惠，并遵守适用的证明及其他要求）可归属于该非美国持有人在美国境内维持的常设机构或固定基地；

paras.en: - such Non-U.S. Holder is a nonresident alien individual who is present in the United States for 183 days or more in the taxable year of disposition and certain other conditions are met; or
paras.zh: - 该非美国持有人为在处置的纳税年度内在美国境内停留 183 天或以上的非居民外国人个人，且满足某些其他条件；或

paras.en: - we are or have been a “United States real property holding corporation” for U.S. federal income tax purposes at any time within the shorter of the five-year period ending on the date of disposition or the period that such Non-U.S. Holder held shares of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: - 我们在截至处置之日止的五年期间与该非美国持有人持有我们的 A 类普通股股份的期间两者中较短者的任何时间内，是或曾经是美国联邦所得税目的下的“美国不动产控股公司”。

paras.en: A Non-U.S. Holder described in the first bullet point immediately above will be subject to tax on the gain derived from the sale or other disposition in the same manner as if the Non-U.S. Holder were a U.S. person as defined under the Code. In addition, if any Non-U.S. Holder described in the first bullet point immediately above is a corporation, the gain realized by such Non-U.S. Holder may be subject to an additional “branch profits tax” at a 30% rate or such lower rate as may be specified by an applicable income tax treaty. An individual Non-U.S. Holder described in the second bullet point immediately above will be subject to a 30% (or such lower rate as may be specified by an applicable income tax treaty) tax on the gain derived from the sale or other taxable disposition, which gain may be offset by U.S. source capital losses even though the individual is not considered a resident of the United States, provided the Non-U.S. Holder has timely filed U.S. federal income tax returns with respect to such losses.
paras.zh: 上述第一项要点所述的非美国持有人，将就其出售或其他处置所取得的收益，以与该非美国持有人为《税法》所定义的美国人士相同的方式纳税。此外，如上述第一项要点所述的任何非美国持有人为公司，则该非美国持有人实现的收益可能需按 30% 的税率或适用所得税协定可能规定的较低税率缴纳额外的“分支机构利润税”。上述第二项要点所述的非美国个人持有人，将就其出售或其他应税处置所取得的收益按 30%（或适用所得税协定可能规定的较低税率）的税率纳税，该等收益可用美国来源的资本损失予以抵销，即使该个人不被视为美国居民，前提是该非美国持有人已就该等损失及时申报美国联邦所得税申报表。

paras.en: Generally, a corporation is a “United States real property holding corporation” (“USRPHC”) if the fair market value of its United States real property interests equals or exceeds 50% of the sum of the fair market value of its worldwide real property interests and its other assets used or held for use in a trade or business (all as determined for U.S. federal income tax purposes). We believe we are not and do not anticipate becoming a USRPHC for U.S. federal income tax purposes. However, because the determination of whether we are a USRPHC depends on the fair market value of our U.S. real property interests relative to the fair market value of our business assets, there can be no assurances that we are not a USRPHC or will not become one in the future. Even if we became a USRPHC, a Non-U.S. Holder would not be subject to U.S. federal income tax on a sale, exchange, or other taxable disposition of our Class A common stock by reason of our status as USRPHC so long as our Class A common stock is regularly traded on an established securities market (within the meaning of the applicable regulations) and such Non-U.S. Holder does not own and is not deemed to own (directly, indirectly or constructively) more than 5% of our outstanding Class A common stock at any time during the shorter of the five year period ending on the date of disposition and such holder’s holding period. Each Non-U.S. Holder should consult its tax advisor regarding the possible consequences to them if we are, or were to become, a USRPHC.
paras.zh: 一般而言，如果一家公司的美国不动产权益的公允市场价值等于或超过其全球不动产权益以及其在贸易或业务中使用或持有的其他资产的公允市场价值总和的 50%（均按美国联邦所得税目的确定），则该公司即为“美国不动产持有公司”（“USRPHC”）。我们认为我们目前不是、且预计不会成为美国联邦所得税目的下的 USRPHC。然而，由于我们是否为 USRPHC 取决于我们的美国不动产权益相对于我们业务资产的公允市场价值，因此无法保证我们不是 USRPHC 或未来不会成为 USRPHC。即使我们成为 USRPHC，只要我们的 A 类普通股在成熟证券市场（按适用法规的含义）定期交易，且该非美国持有人在下述期间中较短者内的任何时间均未拥有且不被视为（直接、间接或推定）拥有我们已发行 A 类普通股的 5% 以上——该期间为截至处置之日止的五年期间与该持有人持有期中较短者——则该非美国持有人不会因我们的 USRPHC 身份而就出售、交换或其他应税处置我们的 A 类普通股缴纳美国联邦所得税。各非美国持有人应就其在我们是或将成为 USRPHC 的情况下可能对其产生的后果咨询其税务顾问。

full.sec: Information Reporting Requirements and Backup Withholding
full.secZh: 信息报告要求与备用预扣税

paras.en: The amount of dividends or proceeds paid to a Non-U.S. Holder, the name and address of the Non-U.S. Holder and the amount of tax, if any, withheld generally will be reported to the IRS. Copies of these information returns may also be made available under the provisions of a specific treaty or agreement to the tax authorities of the country in which the Non-U.S. Holder resides. A Non-U.S. Holder generally will be required to provide proper certification (usually on an IRS Form W-8BEN, W-8BEN-E or W-8ECI, as applicable) to establish that the Non-U.S. Holder is not a U.S. person or otherwise qualifies for an exemption in order to avoid backup withholding tax with respect to our payment of dividends on, or the proceeds from the disposition of, our Class A common stock. Backup withholding is not an additional tax. Any amounts withheld under the backup withholding rules will be allowed as a refund or a credit against that Non-U.S. Holder’s U.S. federal income tax liability provided the required information is timely furnished to the IRS. Each Non-U.S. Holder should consult its tax advisor regarding the application of the information reporting rules and backup withholding to it.
paras.zh: 向非美国持有人支付的股息或处置所得款项金额、该非美国持有人的姓名和地址以及预扣税款金额（如有）通常将向 IRS 申报。该等申报表的副本也可能根据特定条约或协定的规定提供给该非美国持有人所在国家的税务机关。非美国持有人通常需要提供适当的证明（通常为适用的 IRS 表格 W-8BEN、W-8BEN-E 或 W-8ECI），以证明该非美国持有人并非美国人士或符合豁免条件，从而避免就我们支付的 A 类普通股股息或处置 A 类普通股所得款项被适用备用预扣税。备用预扣税并非额外税款。根据备用预扣税规则预扣的任何金额，只要及时向 IRS 提供所需信息，将允许作为该非美国持有人美国联邦所得税纳税义务的退款或抵免。各非美国持有人应就其适用的信息申报规则和备用预扣税咨询其税务顾问。

full.sec: Additional Withholding Tax on Payments Made to Foreign Accounts
full.secZh: 向外国账户付款的额外预扣税

paras.en: Withholding taxes may be imposed under Sections 1471 to 1474 of the Code, the Treasury Regulations promulgated thereunder and other official guidance (commonly referred to as “FATCA”) on certain types of payments made to non-U.S. financial institutions and certain other non-U.S. entities. Specifically, a 30% withholding tax may be imposed on dividends on, or (subject to the proposed Treasury Regulations discussed below) gross proceeds from the sale or other disposition of, our Class A common stock paid to a “foreign financial institution” or a “non-financial foreign entity” (each as defined in the Code), unless applicable exceptions apply. Foreign financial institutions located in jurisdictions that have an intergovernmental agreement with the United States governing FATCA may be subject to different rules.
paras.zh: 根据《税法》第 1471 条至第 1474 条、据此颁布的财政部条例及其他官方指引（通常称为“FATCA”），某些类型的向非美国金融机构及某些其他非美国实体支付的款项可能被征收预提税。具体而言，对于我们向“外国金融机构”或“非金融外国实体”（各自定义见《税法》）支付的 A 类普通股股息，或（在受限于下文所述拟议财政部条例的前提下）出售或以其他方式处置 A 类普通股所得的毛收入，可能被征收 30% 的预提税，除非适用例外情形。位于与美国签有管辖 FATCA 的政府间协议之司法管辖区的外国金融机构可能适用不同规则。

paras.en: Under the applicable Treasury Regulations and administrative guidance, withholding under FATCA generally applies to payments of dividends on our Class A common stock. However, under proposed Treasury Regulations (on which taxpayers may rely until final Treasury Regulations are issued), this withholding tax will not apply to the gross proceeds from the sale, exchange, redemption or other taxable disposition of our Class A common stock. There can be no assurance that the proposed Treasury Regulations will be finalized in their present form.
paras.zh: 根据适用的财政部条例及行政指引，FATCA 项下的预提税一般适用于我们 A 类普通股的股息支付。但是，根据拟议的财政部条例（在最终财政部条例颁布之前，纳税人可依赖该拟议条例），该预提税将不适用于出售、交换、赎回或以其他方式应税处置我们 A 类普通股所得的毛收入。无法保证拟议的财政部条例将按现有形式最终定稿。

paras.en: The underwriters and the representatives are collectively referred to as the “underwriters” and the “representatives,” respectively. The underwriters are offering the shares of Class A common stock subject to their acceptance of such shares from us and subject to prior sale. The underwriting agreement provides that the obligations of the several underwriters to pay for and accept delivery of the shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus are subject to the approval of certain legal matters by their counsel and to certain other conditions. The underwriters are obligated to take and pay for all of the shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus if any such shares are taken.
