paras.en: The estimated offering expenses payable by us, exclusive of the underwriting discounts and commissions, are approximately $55 million. We have agreed to reimburse the underwriters for their reasonable expenses relating to clearance of this offering with the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority up to $200,000. Underwriting commissions and expenses, as well as all items of compensation under FINRA Rule 5110, will not exceed 5% of the gross offering proceeds. Following the completion of this offering, underwriters’ counsel has agreed to inform FINRA of any new information of which it has become aware regarding items of underwriting compensation.
paras.zh: 我们应支付的预计发行费用（不包括承销折扣及佣金）约为 $55 million。我们已同意就本次发行与美国金融业监管局（FINRA）进行清算相关的合理费用向承销商报销，最高不超过 $200,000。根据 FINRA 规则 5110，承销佣金及费用以及所有补偿项目合计将不超过发行募集资金总额的 5%。本次发行完成后，承销商法律顾问已同意将其知悉的与承销补偿项目有关的任何新信息告知 FINRA。

paras.en: The underwriters have informed us that they do not intend sales to discretionary accounts to exceed 5% of the total number of shares of Class A common stock offered by them.
paras.zh: 承销商已告知我们，其不打算向全权委托账户的销售超过其发售的 A 类普通股总股数的 5%。

paras.en: We have been approved to list our Class A common stock on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas under the trading symbol “SPCX.”
paras.zh: 我们已获准在 Nasdaq 及 Nasdaq Texas 上市我们的 A 类普通股，交易代码为“SPCX”。

paras.en: In addition to allocations made to retail investors by the underwriters, we currently anticipate that certain of the shares of Class A common stock offered hereby will, at our request, be offered to retail investors through Charles Schwab & Co., Inc., Fidelity Brokerage Services LLC and Fidelity Capital Markets, a division of National Financial Services LLC, Robinhood Financial, LLC, and SoFi Securities LLC, as selling group members, via their respective online brokerage platforms. We also anticipate that certain of the shares of Class A common stock will be offered to retail investors through E*TRADE by Morgan Stanley , an affiliate of Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, one of the underwriters of this offering. These platforms are not affiliated with us. Purchases through these platforms will be subject to the terms, conditions and requirements set by each selling group member. Any purchase of our Class A common stock in this offering through these platforms will be at the same initial public offering price, and at the same time, as any other purchases in this offering, including purchases by institutions and other large investors. The selling group members’ platforms and information on the selling group members’ applications do not form a part of nor are they incorporated by reference into this prospectus.
paras.zh: 除承销商向散户投资者作出的配售外，我们目前预计，经我们请求，本次发行的部分 A 类普通股将通过作为出售集团成员的 Charles Schwab & Co., Inc.、Fidelity Brokerage Services LLC 及 National Financial Services LLC 旗下 Fidelity Capital Markets、Robinhood Financial, LLC 和 SoFi Securities LLC，经由其各自的在线经纪平台向散户投资者发售。我们还预计，部分 A 类普通股将通过 Morgan Stanley 旗下的 E*TRADE 向散户投资者发售，Morgan Stanley 是本次发行承销商之一 Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC 的关联方。这些平台与我们无关联关系。通过这些平台进行的购买将受各出售集团成员设定的条款、条件和要求约束。通过上述平台在本次发行中购买我们 A 类普通股的任何交易，将与本次发行中的其他任何购买（包括机构和大型投资者的购买）适用相同的首次公开发行价格，并在同一时间进行。出售集团成员的平台及出售集团成员应用程序上的信息不构成本招股说明书的一部分，亦未通过援引方式纳入本招股说明书。

paras.en: We have agreed with the underwriters that during the period of 180 days after the date of this prospectus (the “lock-up period”), without the prior written consent of Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, on behalf of the underwriters, subject to certain exceptions, we will not (a) offer, sell, contract to sell, pledge, grant any option to purchase, make any short sale or otherwise transfer or dispose of, directly or indirectly, or file with the SEC a registration statement under the Securities Act relating to, any shares of our common stock or other securities substantially similar to our common stock, including but not limited to any options or warrants to purchase shares of our common stock or any securities that are convertible into or exchangeable for, or that represent the right to receive, common stock or any such substantially similar securities (“lock-up securities”), or publicly disclose the intention to do any of the foregoing, or (b) enter into any swap or other agreement that transfers to another, in whole or in part, any of the economic consequences of ownership of any of our common stock or such other securities, whether any such transaction described in clause (a) or (b) above is to be settled by delivery of our common stock or such other securities, in cash or otherwise (other than the shares sold in this offering or pursuant to employee stock option plans existing on, or upon the conversion or exchange of convertible or exchangeable securities outstanding as of, the date of this offering).
paras.zh: 我们已与承销商达成一致，在本招股说明书日期后 180 天期间（“锁定期”）内，未经 Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC（代表承销商）事先书面同意，除特定例外情形外，我们不会 (a) 要约、出售、订立出售合同、质押、授予任何购买选择权、进行任何卖空或以其他方式直接或间接转让或处置，或向 SEC 提交与我们的任何普通股或与我们的普通股实质上相似的其他证券（包括但不限于购买我们普通股的任何选择权或认股权证，或可转换为或可交换为普通股或代表收取普通股权利的任何证券，或任何该等实质上相似的证券（“锁定证券”））有关的《证券法》项下的注册声明，或公开披露进行上述任何行为的意图，或 (b) 订立任何互换或其他协议，将我们任何普通股或该等其他证券所有权的任何经济后果全部或部分转移给另一方，无论上述 (a) 或 (b) 项所述的任何此类交易是否以交付我们的普通股或该等其他证券、现金或其他方式结算（本次发行中出售的股份，或根据本次发行之日存在的员工股票期权计划，或在本次发行之日已发行的可转换或可交换证券转换或交换时发行的股份除外）。

paras.en: These restrictions do not apply to: (a) the shares sold in this offering, (b) the issuance by us of our common stock upon the exercise (including any net exercise) of an option or warrant, the vesting and settlement (including any net settlement) of restricted stock units or similar equity awards or the reclassification or conversion of a security, in each case outstanding on the date hereof and identified herein, (c) the grant or issuance by us, or exercise or settlement (in cash, shares of our common stock, or otherwise), of options, stock appreciation rights, restricted stock awards, restricted stock units, performance stock awards or any other type of equity award or arrangement to our employees, officers, directors, advisors or consultants pursuant to our employee benefit plans described herein or the issuance by us of our common stock pursuant to our employee stock purchase plan described herein, (d) the filing by us of one or more registration statements with the SEC on Form S-8 or any successor form thereto with respect to any of our employee benefit plans described herein, (e) the establishment or amendment of a trading plan on behalf of our shareholders, officers or directors pursuant to Rule 10b5-1 under the Exchange Act for the transfer of shares of our common stock; provided that (i) such plan does not provide for the transfer of our common stock during the lock-up period (except to the extent otherwise allowed pursuant to the terms of a lock-up agreement) and (ii) to the extent a public announcement or filing under the Exchange Act, if any, is required of, or voluntarily made by, us regarding the establishment or amendment of such plan, such announcement or filing shall include a statement to the effect that no transfer of our common stock may be made under such plan during any lock-up period to which such shareholder, officer or director is bound, (f) sales of our common stock on behalf of our employees to satisfy the withholding taxes payable upon the vesting, exercise or settlement of such employee’s equity awards pursuant to our employee benefit plans described herein, (g) the sale, exchange, or issuance of, or entry into an agreement to sell, exchange, or issue, our common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our common stock (including, without limitation, options, restricted stock, restricted stock units, or warrants) in connection with any acquisition of the equity interests or assets of any person, the acquisition by the Company or its subsidiary by any means of any license, right to use, business, properties, assets, products, technologies or person, in one or a series of transactions (whether by means of merger, stock or equity purchase, asset purchase or otherwise), including pursuant to an employee benefit plan assumed by us in connection with such transaction, or in connection with joint ventures, commercial relationships or other strategic or collaborative corporate transactions or alliances, or any announcement or filing of a registration statement related thereto.
paras.zh: 该等限制不适用于：(a) 本次发行中出售的股份；(b) 本公司因行使（包括任何净额行使）期权或认股权证、限制性股票单位或类似股权奖励的归属与结算（包括任何净额结算）或证券的重新分类或转换而发行普通股，且上述各项均于本协议签署之日尚未行使完毕并在本文件中予以载明；(c) 本公司根据本文件所述员工福利计划向本公司员工、高级管理人员、董事、顾问或咨询人员授予或发行，或由其行使或结算（以现金、本公司普通股或其他方式）期权、股票增值权、限制性股票奖励、限制性股票单位、业绩股票奖励或任何其他类型的股权奖励或安排，或本公司根据本文件所述员工购股计划发行普通股；(d) 本公司就本文件所述任何员工福利计划向 SEC 提交一份或多份 S-8 表格或任何后续表格的注册声明；(e) 本公司股东、高级管理人员或董事根据《交易法》第 10b5-1 条规则就本公司普通股转让设立或修订交易计划；但前提是 (i) 该计划未规定在锁定期内转让本公司普通股（除非锁定期协议条款另有允许），且 (ii) 若本公司须就设立或修订该计划作出《交易法》项下的公告或备案（如有），或本公司自愿作出该等公告或备案，则该等公告或备案应包含一项声明，说明在该股东、高级管理人员或董事受约束的任何锁定期内，不得根据该计划转让本公司普通股；(f) 代表本公司员工出售本公司普通股，以支付该员工股权奖励根据本文件所述员工福利计划归属、行使或结算时应缴纳的预扣税款；(g) 就收购任何人士的股权或资产、本公司或其子公司以任何方式收购任何许可、使用权、业务、财产、资产、产品、技术或人士（无论通过合并、股票或股权购买、资产购买或其他方式，在一项或一系列交易中），包括根据本公司就该等交易承继的员工福利计划，或就合资企业、商业关系或其他战略或合作性公司交易或联盟，出售、交换或发行本公司普通股或可转换为本公司普通股或可行使或可交换为本公司普通股的证券（包括但不限于期权、限制性股票、限制性股票单位或认股权证），或订立出售、交换或发行该等证券的协议，或就上述事项作出任何公告或提交相关注册声明。

paras.en: All shares of our common stock outstanding immediately prior to this offering will be subject to restrictions on Transfer (as defined below) in connection with this offering as follows. Shareholders (including our founder) may not (and may not cause or direct any of their affiliates to), without the prior written consent of Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, on behalf of the underwriters: (a) offer, sell, contract to sell, pledge, grant any option, right or warrant to purchase, purchase any option or contract to sell, lend or otherwise transfer or dispose of (directly or indirectly) any shares of our common stock, or any options, rights, or warrants to purchase any shares of our common stock or any securities convertible into, exchangeable for or that represent the right to receive shares of our common stock (such shares of our common stock, options, rights, warrants or other securities, collectively, the “lock-up securities”), including without limitation any such lock-up securities now owned or hereafter acquired by such lock-up party, (b) engage in any hedging or other transaction or arrangement (including, without limitation, any short sale or the purchase or sale of, or entry into, any put or call option, or combination thereof, forward, swap or any other derivative transaction or instrument, however described or defined) which is designed to or which reasonably could be expected to lead to or result in a sale, loan, pledge, or other disposition (whether by such lock-up party or someone other than such lock-up party), or transfer of any of the economic consequences of ownership, in whole or in part, directly or indirectly, of any lock-up securities, whether any such transaction or arrangement (or instrument provided for thereunder) would be settled by delivery of our common stock or such other securities, in cash or otherwise (for purposes of this section, any such sale, loan, pledge, or other disposition, or transfer of economic consequences, a “Transfer”), (c) make any demand for or exercise any right with respect to the registration of any lock-up securities, or (d) otherwise publicly announce any intention to engage in or cause any action, activity, transaction or arrangement described in clause (a), (b) or (c) above.
paras.zh: 本次发行前已发行的全部普通股股份，均须就本次发行遵守下述转让限制（定义见下文）。股东（包括我们的创始人）未经高盛有限责任公司代表承销商事先书面同意，不得（也不得促使或指示其任何关联方）：(a) 要约、出售、订立出售合同、质押、授予任何购买期权、权利或认股权证、购买任何出售期权或合同、出借或以其他方式转让或处置（直接或间接）任何普通股股份，或任何购买普通股股份的期权、权利或认股权证，或任何可转换为、可交换为或代表有权收取普通股股份的证券（该等普通股股份、期权、权利、认股权证或其他证券，统称“锁定证券”），包括但不限于该锁定方现在拥有或此后获得的任何该等锁定证券；(b) 进行任何对冲或其他交易或安排（包括但不限于任何卖空，或购买或出售、或订立任何看跌或看涨期权或其组合、远期、互换或任何其他衍生交易或工具，无论其如何描述或定义），该等交易或安排旨在或合理预期会导致或产生对任何锁定证券的全部或部分、直接或间接的出售、贷款、质押或其他处置（无论由该锁定方或该锁定方以外的其他人进行），或转让任何锁定证券所有权的任何经济后果，无论任何该等交易或安排（或其项下规定的工具）是否将通过交付我们的普通股或该等其他证券、现金或其他方式结算（就本节而言，任何该等出售、贷款、质押或其他处置，或经济后果的转让，均为“转让”）；(c) 就任何锁定证券的登记提出任何要求或行使任何权利；或 (d) 以其他方式公开宣布任何从事或促使采取上述 (a)、(b) 或 (c) 项所述任何行动、活动、交易或安排的意图。

paras.en: The restrictions on Transfer of the lock-up securities do not apply to the:
paras.zh: 锁定证券的转让限制不适用于：

paras.en: a. Transfer by the lock-up party of the lock-up securities: (i) as one or more bona fide gifts or charitable contributions, or for bona fide estate planning purposes, including without limitation to charitable organizations or educational institutions, (ii) upon death by will, testamentary document or intestate succession, (iii) if the lock-up party is a natural person, to any member of the lock-up party’s immediate family, to other dependents or to any trust, partnership, limited liability company or other entity for the direct or indirect benefit of the lock-up party or the immediate family of the lock-up party or, if the lock-up party is a trust to a trustor, trustee or beneficiary of the trust or the estate of a trustor, trustee or beneficiary of such trust, (iv) to a corporation, partnership, limited liability company or other entity of which the lock-up party and the immediate family of the lock-up party are the legal and beneficial owner of all of the outstanding equity securities or similar interests, (v) to a nominee or custodian of a person or entity to whom a disposition or transfer would be permissible under clauses (a)(i) through (iv) above, (vi) if the lock-up party is a corporation, partnership, limited liability company, trust or other business entity, (A) to another corporation, partnership, limited liability company, trust or other business entity that is an affiliate of the lock-up party, or to any investment fund or other entity which fund or entity is controlling, controlled by, managing or managed by, advises or is advised by, sub-advises or is sub-advised by or under common control with the lock-up party or affiliates of the lock-up party or (B) as part of a distribution, transfer or other disposition by the lock-up party to its stockholders, current or former partners, members, managers, beneficiaries or other equityholders of the lock-up party or its affiliates or to the estate of any such stockholders, partners, members, manager, beneficiaries or other equityholders, (vii) by operation of law, such as pursuant to a qualified domestic order, divorce settlement, divorce decree or separation agreement or other order of a court or regulatory agency, (viii) to us from our or any of our subsidiaries’ employee or service provider upon death, disability or termination of employment, in each case, of such employee or service provider, (ix) if the lock-up party is not our officer or director or a stockholder holding 10% or more of our common stock, in connection with a Transfer of the lock-up party’s shares of common stock acquired (A) from the underwriters in this offering or (B) in open market transactions after the pricing date of this offering, (x) to us in connection with the vesting, settlement or exercise of restricted stock units, options, warrants, exchange, conversion or other rights to purchase or otherwise acquire shares of common stock (including, in each case, by way of “net” or “cashless” exercise, settlement or similar procedure) that are vested, vest or are scheduled to expire or automatically vest during the applicable lock-up period, including any transfer to us for the purpose of satisfying any tax obligations (including withholdings and estimated taxes) or remittance payments due as a result of the grant, vesting, settlement or exercise of such restricted stock units, options, warrants, exchange, conversion or other rights, or in connection with the conversion of convertible securities, in all such cases of this clause (x) pursuant to equity awards granted under a stock incentive plan, long-term incentive plan or other equity award plan or arrangement, or pursuant to the terms of convertible or exchangeable securities, as applicable, each as described herein, provided that any securities received by the lock-up party upon such vesting, settlement, exercise or conversion must be subject to the terms of a lock-up agreement, (xi) in “sell to cover” or similar open market transactions to satisfy any exercise price or tax withholding obligations as a result of the exercise, vesting and/or settlement of equity awards (including options and restricted stock units) held by the lock-up party and issued pursuant to a stock incentive plan, long-term incentive plan or other equity award plan or arrangement, each as described herein, provided that, any shares of common stock retained by the lock-up party after giving effect to this provision must be subject to the terms of a lock-up agreement, (xii) to us or any of our subsidiaries pursuant to an agreement under which we or any such subsidiary have the option to repurchase shares or a right of first refusal with respect to transfer of such shares, (xiii) to us or any of our subsidiaries pursuant to an agreement under which the holder of shares or other securities convertible into or exercisable for shares has the option to require us or such subsidiary to repurchase such shares or other securities convertible into or exercisable for shares, (xiv) to us in connection with a tender offer by us for outstanding equity securities or other repurchase transaction by us that is approved by our board of directors, (xv) in certain cases, to any third-party pledgee in a bona fide transaction as collateral to secure obligations pursuant to a lending or similar financing arrangement effective on the date of this offering between such third party (or its affiliates or designees) and the lock-up party and/or its affiliates, or otherwise any action by the lock-up party and/or its affiliates to permit such pledgee to enforce its security interest under such arrangement by selling, transferring, appropriating or otherwise disposing of the lock-up securities, (xvi) a de minimis amount of shares held by mutual funds or their affiliates, or (xvii) the prior written consent of Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC on behalf of the underwriters; provided that (A) in the case of clauses (a)(i), (ii), (iii), (iv), (v) and (vi) above, such transfer or distribution must not involve a disposition for value, (B) in the case of clauses (a)(i), (ii), (iii), (iv), (v), (vi), (vii) and (xv) above, it is a condition to the transfer or distribution that the donee, devisee, transferee or distributee, as the case may be, must sign and deliver a lock-up agreement for the balance of the applicable lock-up period (C) in the case of clauses (a)(ii), (iii), (iv), (v), and (vi) above, no filing by any party (including, without limitation, any donor, donee, devisee, transferor, transferee, distributor or distributee) under the Exchange Act or other public filing, report or announcement reporting a reduction in beneficial ownership of lock-up securities must be required or must be voluntarily made in connection with such transfer or distribution, and (D) in the case of clauses (a)(i), (vii), (viii), (ix), (x), (xi), (xii), (xiii), (xiv) and (xv) above, no filing under the Exchange Act or other public filing, report or announcement must be voluntarily made in connection with such transfer or distribution, and if any such filing, report or announcement reporting a reduction in beneficial ownership of lock-up securities must be legally required in connection with such transfer or distribution during the applicable lock-up period, such filing, report or announcement must clearly indicate in the footnotes thereto (A) the circumstances of such transfer or distribution and (B) in the case of a transfer or distribution pursuant to clauses (a)(i) or (vii) above, that the donee, devisee, transferee or distributee has agreed to be bound by a lock-up agreement;
paras.zh: a. 锁定期方转让锁定期证券：(i) 作为一项或多项善意赠与或慈善捐赠，或出于善意的遗产规划目的，包括但不限于向慈善组织或教育机构转让；(ii) 因死亡而依遗嘱、遗嘱文件或无遗嘱继承；(iii) 若锁定期方为自然人，向其直系家庭成员、其他受抚养人，或为锁定期方或锁定期方直系家庭的直接或间接利益而向任何信托、合伙企业、有限责任公司或其他实体转让，或若锁定期方为信托，则向该信托的委托人、受托人或受益人，或该信托的委托人、受托人或受益人的遗产转让；(iv) 向锁定期方及锁定期方直系家庭为全部已发行权益证券或类似权益的法定及实益拥有人的公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司或其他实体转让；(v) 向根据上述第(a)(i)至(iv)项允许进行处置或转让的人或实体的代名人或托管人转让；(vi) 若锁定期方为公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司、信托或其他商业实体，(A) 向作为锁定期方关联方的另一公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司、信托或其他商业实体转让，或向任何投资基金或其他实体转让，而该基金或实体控制、受控于、管理或受管理于、提供咨询或接受咨询、提供副咨询或接受副咨询，或与锁定期方或锁定期方关联方处于共同控制之下，或 (B) 作为锁定期方向其股东、现任或前任合伙人、成员、管理人、受益人或其他权益持有人，或向其关联方的该等股东、合伙人、成员、管理人、受益人或其他权益持有人，或向任何该等股东、合伙人、成员、管理人、受益人或其他权益持有人的遗产进行分配、转让或其他处置的一部分；(vii) 依法律运作，例如依据适格家庭关系令、离婚和解协议、离婚判决或分居协议，或法院或监管机构的其他命令；(viii) 向我们或我们任何子公司转让，系因该员工或服务提供者死亡、残疾或终止雇佣（在每种情况下，针对该员工或服务提供者）；(ix) 若锁定期方并非我们的高级管理人员或董事，亦非持有我们普通股 10%或以上的股东，则与锁定期方转让其普通股股份相关，该等股份系 (A) 在本发行中从承销商处取得，或 (B) 在本发行定价日之后通过公开市场交易取得；(x) 向我们转让，系与限制性股票单位、期权、认股权证、交换权、转换权或其他购买或以其他方式取得普通股股份的权利的归属、结算或行使相关（在每种情况下，包括通过“净额”或“无现金”行使、结算或类似程序），该等权利已归属、将归属或计划在适用锁定期内到期或自动归属，包括为满足因授予、归属、结算或行使该等限制性股票单位、期权、认股权证、交换权、转换权或其他权利而到期的任何税务义务（包括预扣税和预估税）或汇款款项而向我们进行的任何转让，或与可转换证券的转换相关，在所有这些第(x)项情况下，系依据股票激励计划、长期激励计划或其他股权奖励计划或安排授予的股权奖励，或依据可转换或可交换证券的条款（如适用），均如本文所述，但前提是锁定期方在该等归属、结算、行使或转换时收到的任何证券必须受锁定期协议条款的约束；(xi) 在“卖出补足”或类似公开市场交易中，为满足因行使、归属和/或结算锁定期方持有并依据股票激励计划、长期激励计划或其他股权奖励计划或安排发行的股权奖励（包括期权和限制性股票单位）而产生的任何行权价或税务预扣义务，均如本文所述，但前提是锁定期方在实施本条规定后保留的任何普通股股份必须受锁定期协议条款的约束；(xii) 向我们或我们任何子公司转让，系依据我们或任何该等子公司有权回购股份或对转让该等股份享有优先购买权的协议；(xiii) 向我们或我们任何子公司转让，系依据股份或其他可转换为股份或可行使为股份的证券持有人有权要求我们或该子公司回购该等股份或其他可转换为股份或可行使为股份的证券的协议；(xiv) 向我们转让，系与我们对我们已发行权益证券的要约收购或经我们董事会批准的其他回购交易相关；(xv) 在某些情况下，向任何第三方质押权人转让，系在善意交易中作为担保，以担保该第三方（或其关联方或指定人）与锁定期方和/或其关联方之间于本发行日生效的贷款或类似融资安排项下的义务，或锁定期方和/或其关联方采取的任何其他行动，以允许该质押权人通过出售、转让、挪用或以其他方式处置锁定期证券来强制执行其在该安排项下的担保权益；(xvi) 共同基金或其关联方持有的极少量股份；或 (xvii) 经 Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC 代表承销商事先书面同意；但前提是 (A) 对于上述第(a)(i)、(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)和(vi)项，该等转让或分配不得涉及有偿处置；(B) 对于上述第(a)(i)、(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)、(vi)、(vii)和(xv)项，转让或分配的条件是受赠人、受遗赠人、受让人或分配对象（视情况而定）必须签署并交付适用于适用锁定期剩余期间的锁定期协议；(C) 对于上述第(a)(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)和(vi)项，任何一方（包括但不限于任何赠与人、受赠人、受遗赠人、转让人、受让人、分配人或分配对象）均不得被要求或主动进行任何根据《交易法》提交的、报告锁定期证券实益所有权减少的申报、报告或公告，且不得与该等转让或分配相关主动进行；(D) 对于上述第(a)(i)、(vii)、(viii)、(ix)、(x)、(xi)、(xii)、(xiii)、(xiv)和(xv)项，不得与该等转让或分配相关主动进行任何根据《交易法》提交的申报、报告或公告，且若在适用锁定期内与该等转让或分配相关，法律要求进行任何报告锁定期证券实益所有权减少的该等申报、报告或公告，则该等申报、报告或公告必须在其脚注中明确说明 (A) 该等转让或分配的情形，以及 (B) 对于依据上述第(a)(i)或(vii)项进行的转让或分配，受赠人、受遗赠人、受让人或分配对象已同意受锁定期协议约束；

paras.en: b. entry into or amendment of a written plan meeting the requirements of Rule 10b5-1 under the Exchange Act relating to the Transfer of the lock-up securities of the lock-up party, if then permitted by us, provided that none of the securities subject to such plan may be Transferred until after the expiration of the applicable lock-up period, other than as permitted by the lock-up agreement, and no public announcement, report or filing under the Exchange Act, or any other public filing, report or announcement, must be voluntarily made (whether by or on behalf of the lock-up party, us or any other party) regarding, or that otherwise discloses, the establishment of such plan during the applicable lock-up period, and if any such filing, report or announcement must be legally required during the applicable lock-up period, such filing, report or announcement must clearly indicate that that none of the securities subject to such plan may be Transferred pursuant to such plan until after the expiration of the applicable lock-up period;
paras.zh: b. 订立或修订符合《交易法》第 10b5-1 条规则要求的书面计划，涉及锁定期一方转让锁定期证券，前提是当时经我们允许，但该计划所涉证券在适用的锁定期届满前不得转让（锁定期协议允许的除外），且在该适用锁定期内，不得就该计划的设立自愿作出任何公告、报告或向《交易法》项下提交任何文件，或作出任何其他公开备案、报告或公告（无论由锁定期一方、我们或任何其他方作出或代表其作出），亦不得以其他方式披露该计划的设立；若在该适用锁定期内依法须作出任何该等备案、报告或公告，则该等备案、报告或公告必须明确表明，该计划所涉证券在该适用锁定期届满前不得依据该计划转让；

paras.en: c. (i) Transfer by the lock-up party of the lock-up securities pursuant to a bona fide third-party tender offer, merger, consolidation or other similar transaction that is approved by our board of directors and made to all our holders of capital stock involving a change of control, and (ii) entry into any lock-up, voting or similar agreement pursuant to which the lock-up party may agree to transfer, sell, tender or otherwise dispose of shares of common stock or such other securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for common stock in connection with a transaction described in clause (i) above; provided that in the event that such tender offer, merger, consolidation or other similar transaction is not completed, the lock-up securities must remain subject to the lock-up restrictions;
paras.zh: c. (i) 锁定期一方依据经我们董事会批准、向我们全体股本持有人作出且涉及控制权变更的善意第三方要约收购、合并、兼并或其他类似交易转让锁定期证券，以及 (ii) 订立任何锁定期、投票或类似协议，据此锁定期一方可同意就上述第 (i) 项所述交易转让、出售、要约出售或以其他方式处置普通股股份或可转换为普通股或可行使或可交换为普通股的其他证券；但若该要约收购、合并、兼并或其他类似交易未能完成，则锁定期证券仍须受锁定期限制约束；

paras.en: d. Transfer by the lock-up party of the lock-up securities to us in connection with (i) the conversion of our outstanding preferred stock into shares of common stock in connection with the consummation of this offering or (ii) the conversion, reclassification, redemption, exchange of any shares of any class of common stock or lock-up securities into shares of another class of common stock, provided that any such shares of common stock or lock-up securities received upon such conversion, reclassification, redemption or exchange pursuant to clause (i) or (ii) must be subject to the terms of a lock-up agreement; and
paras.zh: d. 锁定期一方向我们转让锁定期证券，涉及 (i) 与本发售完成相关的我们已发行优先股转换为普通股股份，或 (ii) 任何类别的普通股或锁定期证券的任何股份转换为另一类别普通股股份的转换、重分类、赎回、交换，但依据第 (i) 或 (ii) 项在该等转换、重分类、赎回或交换时收到的任何该等普通股股份或锁定期证券须受锁定期协议条款约束；以及

paras.en: e. exercise of any option to purchase any lock-up securities pursuant to any of our or our subsidiaries’ stock incentive plan, long-term incentive plan, stock purchase plan or other equity award plan or arrangement, each as described herein, on a cash basis, and the receipt by the lock-up party from us of lock-up securities upon such exercise, provided that the underlying lock-up securities must be subject to the terms of a lock-up agreement.
paras.zh: e. 依据我们或我们子公司的股票激励计划、长期激励计划、股票购买计划或其他股权奖励计划或安排（均如本文件所述）以现金方式行使任何购买任何锁定期证券的期权，以及锁定期一方在该等行使时从我们处收到锁定期证券，但相关锁定期证券须受锁定期协议条款约束。

paras.en: Our founder has agreed with the underwriters that all of the shares of our common stock owned by him are subject to the restrictions described above until immediately after the close of the trading day on the 366th day after the date of this prospectus. In addition, our founder may make Permitted Transfers (as defined in our charter), subject to the restrictions described in clauses (A), (B), and (D) of paragraph a. above. Our founder’s shares are not subject to any early release provisions during the lock-up period.
paras.zh: 我们的创始人已与承销商达成一致，其拥有的全部普通股股份在本招股说明书日期后第 366 个交易日收盘后立即之前，均受上述限制约束。此外，我们的创始人可以进行许可转让（定义见我们的公司章程），但须遵守上文第 a 段第 (A)、(B) 和 (D) 项所述的限制。我们创始人的股份在锁定期内不受任何提前解禁条款的约束。

paras.en: Several of our shareholders have agreed with the underwriters that certain shares of our common stock owned by them are subject to the restrictions described above until the beginning of the second full trading day immediately following public release of our quarterly financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2027 (such period of time, the “extended lock-up period”), subject to specified early release provisions described below.
paras.zh: 我们的若干股东已与承销商达成一致，其拥有的若干普通股股份在紧接我们截至 2027 年 6 月 30 日止季度的季度财务业绩公开发布后的第二个完整交易日开始之前，均受上述限制约束（该期间称为“延长锁定期”），但须遵守下文所述的特定提前解禁条款。

paras.en: The shares subject to the extended lock-up period, together with the shares held by our founder (which are subject to a 366-day lock-up period), represent approximately 7.8 billion shares of common stock, or greater than 63% of our shares outstanding immediately prior to this offering.
paras.zh: 受延长锁定期约束的股份，连同我们创始人持有的股份（受 366 天锁定期约束），合计约占 7.8  billion 股普通股，或超过本次发行前我们已发行股份的 63%。

paras.en: For those shares subject to the extended lock-up period (which does not include shares held by our founder), there are automatic early releases from the restrictions on Transfer commencing in the first quarter of 2027 as follows:
paras.zh: 对于受延长锁定期约束的股份（不包括我们创始人持有的股份），自 2027 年第一季度起，将按如下方式自动提前解除转让限制：

paras.en: a. on or after the second full trading day on Nasdaq immediately following the public release of our quarterly financial results (which for this purpose does not include “flash” numbers or preliminary, partial earnings) for the quarter ended December 31, 2026, up to 20% of the shares may be Transferred;
paras.zh: a. 在我们截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日止季度的季度财务业绩（就此而言，不包括“快报”数字或初步、部分盈利数据）公开发布后纳斯达克第二个完整交易日或之后，最多可转让 20% 的股份；

paras.en: b. on or after March 18, 2027 (the date that is 280 days after the date of this prospectus), up to an additional 10% of the shares may be Transferred;
paras.zh: b. 在 2027 年 3 月 18 日（即本招股说明书日期后 280 天）或之后，最多可额外转让 10% 的股份；

paras.en: c. on or after the second full trading day on Nasdaq immediately following the public release of our quarterly financial results (which for this purpose does not include “flash” numbers or preliminary, partial earnings) for the quarter ended March 31, 2027, up to an additional 20% of the shares may be Transferred;
paras.zh: c. 在我们截至 2027 年 3 月 31 日止季度的季度财务业绩（就此而言，不包括“快报”数字或初步、部分盈利数据）公开发布后纳斯达克第二个完整交易日或之后，最多可额外转让 20% 的股份；

paras.en: d. on or after May 17, 2027 (the date that is 340 days after the date of this prospectus), up to an additional 10% of the shares may be Transferred;
paras.zh: d. 在 2027 年 5 月 17 日（即本招股说明书日期后 340 天）或之后，最多可额外转让 10% 的股份；

paras.en: e. on or after June 12, 2027 (the date that is 366 days after the date of this prospectus), up to an additional 20% of the shares may be Transferred; and
paras.zh: e. 在 2027 年 6 月 12 日（即本招股说明书日期后 366 天）或之后，最多可额外转让 20% 的股份；以及

paras.en: f. on or after the second full trading day on Nasdaq immediately following the public release of our quarterly financial results (which for this purpose does not include “flash” numbers or preliminary, partial earnings) for the quarter ended June 30, 2027, all of the shares may be Transferred.
paras.zh: f. 在我们截至 2027 年 6 月 30 日止季度的季度财务业绩（就此而言，不包括“快报”数字或初步、部分盈利数据）公开发布后纳斯达克第二个完整交易日或之后，全部股份均可转让。

paras.en: All other outstanding shares of our common stock are subject to the Transfer restrictions described above until immediately after the close of the trading day on the 180th day after the date of this prospectus (such period of time, the “180-day lock-up period”), subject to the early release provisions described below.
paras.zh: 我们所有其他已发行普通股股份在本招股说明书日期后第 180 个交易日收盘后立即之前，均受上述转让限制约束（该期间称为“180 天锁定期”），但须遵守下文所述的提前解禁条款。

paras.en: For those shares subject to the 180-day lock-up period, there are automatic early releases from the restrictions on Transfer commencing in the third quarter of 2026 as follows:
paras.zh: 对于受 180 天锁定期约束的该等股份，自 2026 年第三季度起，转让限制将按如下方式自动提前解除：

paras.en: a. on or after the second full trading day on Nasdaq immediately following the public release of our quarterly financial results (which for this purpose does not include “flash” numbers or preliminary, partial earnings) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (such date, the “First Earnings Release Date”), up to 20% of the shares may be Transferred;
paras.zh: a. 在我们公开披露截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的季度财务业绩（就此而言，不包括“快报”数字或初步的、部分盈利数据）后，纳斯达克第二个完整交易日或之后（该日期称为“首次业绩发布日”），最多 20% 的股份可被转让；

paras.en: b. if the reported closing price of our Class A common stock on Nasdaq is at least 30% greater than the public offering price set forth on the cover page of this prospectus for at least five of the ten consecutive trading days ending on, and including, the First Earnings Release Date, on or after the second full trading day immediately after the First Earnings Release Date, up to an additional 10% of the shares may be Transferred;
paras.zh: b. 如果在截至并包括首次业绩发布日止的连续十个交易日中至少有五个交易日，我们 A 类普通股在纳斯达克的报告收盘价至少比本招股说明书封面所载的首次公开发行价格高出 30%，则在首次业绩发布日之后的第二个完整交易日或之后，最多可额外转让 10% 的股份；

paras.en: c. up to an additional 7% of the shares may be Transferred on or after each of August 20, 2026, September 9, 2026, September 24, 2026, October 9, 2026, October 24, 2026 (the dates that are 70 days, 90 days, 105 days, 120 days, and 135 days, respectively, after the date of this prospectus);
paras.zh: c. 在 2026 年 8 月 20 日、2026 年 9 月 9 日、2026 年 9 月 24 日、2026 年 10 月 9 日、2026 年 10 月 24 日（分别为本招股说明书日期后第 70 天、90 天、105 天、120 天和 135 天）各自当日或之后，最多可额外转让 7% 的股份；

paras.en: d. on or after the second full trading day on Nasdaq immediately following the public release of our quarterly financial results (which for this purpose does not include “flash” numbers or preliminary, partial earnings) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, up to an additional 28% of the shares may be Transferred; and
paras.zh: d. 在我们公开披露截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的季度财务业绩（就此而言，不包括“快报”数字或初步的、部分盈利数据）后，纳斯达克第二个完整交易日或之后，最多可额外转让 28% 的股份；以及

paras.en: In order to facilitate the offering of our Class A common stock, the underwriters, with Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC acting as stabilization agent, may engage in transactions that stabilize, maintain or otherwise affect the price of our Class A common stock. Specifically, the underwriters may sell more shares of Class A common stock than they are obligated to purchase under the underwriting agreement, creating a short position. A short sale is covered if the short position is no greater than the number of shares available for purchase by the underwriters under the option to purchase additional shares. The underwriters can close out a covered short sale by exercising the option to purchase additional shares or purchasing shares in the open market. In determining the source of shares to close out a covered short sale, the underwriters will consider, among other things, the open market price of our Class A common stock compared to the price available under the option to purchase additional shares. The underwriters may also sell shares of Class A common stock in excess of the option to purchase additional shares, creating a naked short position. The underwriters must close out any naked short position by purchasing shares of Class A common stock in the open market. A naked short position is more likely to be created if the underwriters are concerned that there may be downward pressure on the price of our Class A common stock in the open market after pricing that could adversely affect investors who purchase shares of Class A common stock in this offering. As an additional means of facilitating this offering, the underwriters may bid for, and purchase, shares of Class A common stock in the open market to stabilize the price of our Class A common stock. These activities may raise or maintain the market price of our Class A common stock above independent market levels or prevent or retard a decline in the market price of our Class A common stock. The underwriters are not required to engage in these activities and may end any of these activities at any time.
paras.zh: 为便利我们 A 类普通股的发行，承销商（由 Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC 担任稳定市场代理人）可从事旨在稳定、维持或以其他方式影响我们 A 类普通股价格的交易。具体而言，承销商可出售超过其在承销协议项下有义务购买的 A 类普通股股份，从而形成空头头寸。若空头头寸不超过承销商根据超额配售选择权可购买的股份数量，则该卖空为补平卖空。承销商可通过行使超额配售选择权或在公开市场购买股份来平补补平卖空。在确定用于平补补平卖空的股份来源时，承销商将考虑（其中包括）我们 A 类普通股的公开市场价格与超额配售选择权项下可购买价格之间的比较。承销商亦可出售超过超额配售选择权数量的 A 类普通股股份，从而形成裸空头头寸。承销商必须通过在公开市场购买 A 类普通股股份来平补任何裸空头头寸。若承销商担心定价后我们 A 类普通股的公开市场价格可能面临下行压力，从而可能对本次发行中购买 A 类普通股股份的投资者产生不利影响，则更有可能形成裸空头头寸。作为便利本次发行的额外手段，承销商可在公开市场出价购买 A 类普通股股份，以稳定我们 A 类普通股的价格。该等活动可能使我们的 A 类普通股市场价格高于独立市场水平或维持在该水平，或阻止或延缓我们 A 类普通股市场价格的下跌。承销商无义务从事该等活动，并可随时终止任何该等活动。

paras.en: Prior to this offering, there has been no public market for our Class A common stock. The initial public offering price has been determined by negotiations between us and the representatives. Among the factors considered in determining the initial public offering price were prevailing market conditions, our future prospects and those of our industry in general, our historical financial and operating performance in recent periods, an assessment by our management and the consideration of the above factors in relation to market valuation of companies engaged in activities similar to ours.
paras.zh: 在本次发行之前，我们的 A 类普通股不存在公开市场。首次公开发行价格由我们与承销商代表协商确定。在确定首次公开发行价格时考虑的因素包括：当前市场状况、我们及我们所在行业的整体未来前景、我们近期的历史财务和经营业绩、我们管理层的评估，以及结合上述因素对从事与我们类似业务的公司的市场估值所进行的考量。

paras.en: At our request, the underwriters have reserved up to five percent of the shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus for sale at the initial public offering price through a directed share program to certain employees and persons selected based on the discretion of our executive officers, which may include parties with whom we have a business relationship and friends and family of our executive officers. If purchased by these persons, these shares will not be subject to a lock-up restriction. The number of shares of Class A common stock available for sale to the general public will be reduced by the number of reserved shares sold to these persons. Any reserved shares not purchased by these persons will be offered by the underwriters to the general public on the same basis as the other shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus. We have agreed to indemnify the underwriters and their affiliates against certain liabilities and expenses, including liabilities under the Securities Act, in connection with sales of the shares reserved for the directed share program. Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, an underwriter in this offering, and its affiliates will administer the global directed share program.
paras.zh: 应我们的要求，承销商已预留最多百分之五的本次招股说明书发售的 A 类普通股股份，通过定向股份计划按首次公开发行价格向特定员工及由我们高级管理人员酌情选定的人员出售，其中可能包括与我们存在业务关系的各方以及我们高级管理人员的亲友。若上述人员购买，该等股份将不受锁定期限制。向公众发售的 A 类普通股股份数量将减去向上述人员出售的预留股份数量。上述人员未购买的任何预留股份将由承销商按与本次招股说明书发售的其他 A 类普通股股份相同的基础向公众发售。我们已同意就定向股份计划预留股份的销售事宜，赔偿承销商及其关联方因特定责任和费用（包括《证券法》项下的责任）而遭受的损失。本次发行的承销商之一 Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC 及其关联方将管理全球定向股份计划。

We do not currently intend to list our Class A common stock on any exchange in such jurisdictions.

The underwriters may use one or more affiliates in order to offer and sell shares outside of the United States. No shares of our Class A common stock will be offered or sold in any jurisdiction except by or through brokers or dealers duly registered under the applicable securities laws of that jurisdiction, or in circumstances where any exemption from such registration requirements is available.
paras.zh: 在适用法律允许的范围内，承销商可以在美国、澳大利亚、加拿大、欧洲经济区、日本、瑞士和英国以外的地区发售我们的 A 类普通股。承销商可以使用一个或多个关联方在美国境外发售和出售股份。除通过在该司法管辖区适用证券法下正式注册的经纪商或交易商，或在可获得此类注册要求豁免的情况下，我们的 A 类普通股不会在任何司法管辖区发售或出售。

paras.en: #### Brazil

The offer and sale of the shares of Class A common stock have not been and will not be registered with the Brazilian Securities Commission (Comissão de Valores Mobiliários, or “CVM”) and, therefore, will not be carried out by any means that would constitute a public offering in Brazil under CVM Resolution No. 160, dated 13 July 2022, as amended, or unauthorized distribution under Brazilian laws and regulations. The shares of Class A common stock will be authorized for trading on organized non-Brazilian securities markets and may only be offered to Brazilian Professional Investors (as defined by applicable CVM regulation), who may only acquire the shares of Class A common stock through a non-Brazilian account, with settlement outside Brazil in non-Brazilian currency. The trading of the shares of Class A common stock on regulated securities markets in Brazil is prohibited.
paras.zh: A 类普通股股份的发售和出售未曾且将不会在巴西证券委员会（Comissão de Valores Mobiliários，简称“CVM”）注册，因此，不会以任何根据 2022 年 7 月 13 日第 160 号 CVM 决议（经修订）构成在巴西公开发售的方式，或根据巴西法律法规构成未经授权分销的方式进行。A 类普通股股份将获准在巴西境外的有组织证券市场交易，且仅可向巴西专业投资者（按适用 CVM 法规的定义）发售，该等投资者仅可通过巴西境外账户购买 A 类普通股股份，并在巴西境外以非巴西货币结算。禁止在巴西受监管证券市场交易 A 类普通股股份。

paras.en: #### Chile

The shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus are not registered in the Securities Registry (Registro de Valores) or subject to the control of the Chilean Securities and Exchange Commission (Superintendencia de Valores y Seguros de Chile). This prospectus and other offering materials relating to the offer of the shares of Class A common stock do not constitute a public offer of, or an invitation to subscribe for or purchase, the shares of Class A common stock in the Republic of Chile, other than to individually identified purchasers pursuant to a private offering within the meaning of Article 4 of the Chilean Securities Market Act (Ley de Mercado de Valores) (an offer that is not “addressed to the public at large or to a certain sector or specific group of the public”).
paras.zh: 本招股说明书发售的 A 类普通股股份未在证券登记处（Registro de Valores）登记，亦不受智利证券和保险委员会（Superintendencia de Valores y Seguros de Chile）监管。本招股说明书及与 A 类普通股股份发售相关的其他发售材料不构成在智利共和国对 A 类普通股股份的公开发售或认购或购买要约，但依据《智利证券市场法》（Ley de Mercado de Valores）第 4 条含义范围内的私募发行向个别确定的购买人发售除外（即并非“面向广大公众或公众的某一行业或特定群体”的要约）。

paras.en: #### Colombia
paras.zh: #### 哥伦比亚

paras.en: The shares of Class A common stock have not been and will not be registered with the Colombian National Registry of Securities and Issuers (Registro Nacional de Valores y Emisores - RNVE) maintained by the Financial Superintendence of Colombia (Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; the “SFC”) and, therefore, the shares of Class A common stock may not be publicly offered or delivered in Colombia. However, the shares of Class A common stock may be offered in Colombia under Colombian law pursuant to the private placement exemption set forth in the Colombian regulation (Decree 2555 of 2010), in accordance of which an offering shall be deemed a private placement if it is addressed to fewer than one hundred (100) specific persons (article 6.1.1.1.1, Decree 2555 of 2010). These materials are solely our responsibility and have not been reviewed or authorized by the SFC and may not be publicly distributed in Colombia. In making an investment decision, all investors, including any Colombian investor who may acquire shares of the Class A common stock from time to time, must rely on their own examination of the terms of the offering and shares of the Class A common stock, including the merits and risks involved.
paras.zh: A 类普通股股份未曾且将不会在由哥伦比亚金融监管局（Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia，简称“SFC”）维护的哥伦比亚国家证券和发行人登记处（Registro Nacional de Valores y Emisores - RNVE）注册，因此，A 类普通股股份不得在哥伦比亚公开发售或交付。但是，A 类普通股股份可依据哥伦比亚法规（2010 年第 2555 号法令）规定的私募豁免在哥伦比亚发售，根据该规定，如要约面向少于一百(100)名特定人士，则应视为私募发行（2010 年第 2555 号法令第 6.1.1.1.1 条）。本材料仅由我们负责，未经 SFC 审阅或授权，且不得在哥伦比亚公开分发。在作出投资决策时，所有投资者，包括可能不时购买 A 类普通股股份的任何哥伦比亚投资者，必须依赖其自身对本次发售条款及 A 类普通股股份的审查，包括所涉优点和风险。

paras.zh: 就欧洲经济区（EEA）各成员国（各称“相关成员国”）而言，除以下情形外，未在任何相关成员国发售或将发售任何 A 类普通股：(i)欧洲招股说明书所拟在德国、丹麦、法国、荷兰、挪威、西班牙和瑞典进行的欧洲公开发售（前提是该招股说明书已获主管机关批准，并已通知丹麦、法国、荷兰、挪威、西班牙和瑞典各自的主管机关，且均已根据《招股说明书条例》予以公布）；以及(ii)对于除欧洲公开发售中所发售的 A 类普通股以外的任何股份，在任何相关成员国根据《招股说明书条例》下列豁免情形随时进行的发售：

paras.en: - to any qualified investor as defined under Article 2 of the Prospectus Regulation;
paras.zh: - 向《招股说明书条例》第 2 条所定义的任何合格投资者发售；

paras.en: - to fewer than 150 natural or legal persons (other than qualified investors as defined under Article 2 of the Prospectus Regulation), subject to obtaining the prior consent of the representatives for any such offer; or
paras.zh: - 向少于 150 名自然人或法人（《招股说明书条例》第 2 条所定义的合格投资者除外）发售，但须就任何该等发售事先取得代表的同意；或

paras.en: - in any other circumstances falling within the scope of application of Article 1(4) of the Prospectus Regulation,
paras.zh: - 属于《招股说明书条例》第 1(4)条适用范围的其他任何情形，

paras.en: provided that no such offer of shares of Class A common stock shall require us or any underwriter to publish a prospectus pursuant to Article 3 of the Prospectus Regulation or supplement a prospectus pursuant to Article 23 of the Prospectus Regulation and each person who initially acquires the shares of Class A common stock or to whom any offer is made will be deemed to have represented, warranted and agreed to and with each of us and the underwriters that it is a qualified investor within the meaning of Article 2 point (e) of the Prospectus Regulation.
paras.zh: 前提是任何该等 A 类普通股的发售均不要求我们或任何承销商根据《招股说明书条例》第 3 条发布招股说明书，或根据《招股说明书条例》第 23 条补充招股说明书；且每位初始取得 A 类普通股的人士或任何发售对象将被视为已向我们及承销商各自声明、保证并同意，其属于《招股说明书条例》第 2 条第(e)点所指的合格投资者。

paras.en: In the case of any shares of Class A common stock being offered to a financial intermediary as that term is used in Article 5(1) of the Prospectus Regulation, each financial intermediary will also be deemed to have represented, warranted and agreed that the shares of Class A common stock acquired by it in the offer have not been acquired on a non-discretionary basis on behalf of, nor have they been acquired with a view to their offer or resale to, persons in circumstances which may give rise to an offer of the shares of Class A common stock to the public, other than their offer or resale in a Relevant State to qualified investors as so defined or in circumstances in which the prior consent of the underwriters has been obtained to each such proposed offer or resale.
paras.zh: 若向《招股说明书条例》第 5(1) 条所指的金融中介机构发售任何 A 类普通股股份，则各金融中介机构亦将被视为已声明、保证并同意，其在本次发售中取得的 A 类普通股股份并非以非自主决定方式代表他人取得，亦非为向可能引致向公众发售 A 类普通股股份的情形下的人士发售或转售而取得，但其在相关成员国向所定义的合格投资者发售或转售，或已就每一项该等拟议发售或转售取得承销商事先同意的情形除外。

paras.en: For the purposes of this provision, the expression an “offer to the public” in relation to the shares of Class A common stock in any Relevant State means the communication in any form and by any means of sufficient information on the terms of the offer and the shares of Class A common stock to be offered so as to enable an investor to decide to purchase or subscribe for the shares of Class A common stock.

paras.en: #### Israel
paras.zh: #### 以色列

paras.en: In the State of Israel this prospectus shall not be regarded as an offer to the public to purchase shares of Class A common stock under the Israeli Securities Law, 5728—1968, which requires a prospectus to be published and authorized by the Israel Securities Authority, if it complies with certain provisions of Section 15 of the Israeli Securities Law, 5728–1968, including, inter alia, if: (i) the offer is made, distributed or directed to not more than 35 investors, subject to certain conditions (the “Addressed Investors”), or (ii) the offer is made, distributed or directed to certain qualified investors defined in the First Addendum of the Israeli Securities Law, 5728—1968, subject to certain conditions (the “Qualified Investors”). The Qualified Investors shall not be taken into account in the count of the Addressed Investors and may be offered to purchase securities in addition to the 35 Addressed Investors. We have not and will not take any action that would require it to publish a prospectus in accordance with and subject to the Israeli Securities Law, 5728—1968. We have not and will not distribute this prospectus or make, distribute or direct an offer to subscribe for our Class A common stock to any person within the State of Israel, other than to Qualified Investors and up to 35 Addressed Investors.
paras.zh: 在以色列国，本招股说明书不应被视为依据 5728—1968 年《以色列证券法》向公众要约购买 A 类普通股股份；该法要求，招股说明书须在符合 5728—1968 年《以色列证券法》第 15 条若干规定的情况下予以发布并经以色列证券管理局授权，其中包括：(i) 该要约仅向不超过 35 名投资者作出、分发或定向发出（须满足若干条件）（“定向投资者”），或 (ii) 该要约仅向 5728—1968 年《以色列证券法》第一附录所界定的若干合格投资者作出、分发或定向发出（须满足若干条件）（“合格投资者”）。合格投资者不计入定向投资者人数，并可在 35 名定向投资者之外另行获邀购买证券。我们未曾且将不会采取任何会要求其依据 5728—1968 年《以色列证券法》发布招股说明书的行动。除向合格投资者及最多 35 名定向投资者外，我们未曾且将不会在以色列国境内向任何人分发本招股说明书，或作出、分发或定向发出认购我们 A 类普通股的要约。

paras.en: Qualified Investors may have to submit written evidence that they meet the definitions set out in of the First Addendum to the Israeli Securities Law, 5728—1968. In particular, we may request, as a condition to be offered shares of Class A common stock, that Qualified Investors will each represent, warrant and certify to us and/or to anyone acting on our behalf: (i) that it is an investor falling within one of the categories listed in the First Addendum to the Israeli Securities Law, 5728—1968; (ii) which of the categories listed in the First Addendum to the Israeli Securities Law, 5728—1968 regarding Qualified Investors is applicable to it; (iii) that it will abide by all provisions set forth in the Israeli Securities Law, 5728—1968 and the regulations promulgated thereunder in connection with the offer to be issued shares of Class A common stock; (iv) that the shares of Class A common stock that it will be issued are, subject to exemptions available under the Israeli Securities Law, 5728—1968: (a) for its own account; (b) for investment purposes only; and (c) not issued with a view to resale within the State of Israel, other than in accordance with the provisions of the Israeli Securities Law, 5728—1968; and (v) that it is willing to provide further evidence of its Qualified Investor status. Addressed Investors may have to submit written evidence in respect of their identity and may have to sign and submit a declaration containing, inter alia, the Addressed Investor’s name, address and passport number or Israeli identification number.
paras.zh: 合格投资者可能须提交书面证据，证明其符合《5728—1968 年以色列证券法》第一附录所载的定义。特别是，作为向其发售 A 类普通股股份的一项条件，我们可能要求每位合格投资者向我们和/或任何代表我们行事的人作出如下陈述、保证及证明：(i) 其属于《5728—1968 年以色列证券法》第一附录所列类别之一的投资者；(ii) 《5728—1968 年以色列证券法》第一附录中关于合格投资者的哪一类别适用于其；(iii) 其将遵守《5728—1968 年以色列证券法》及其项下颁布的法规中与本次发售 A 类普通股股份相关的所有规定；(iv) 在遵守《5728—1968 年以色列证券法》所规定的豁免的前提下，向其发行的 A 类普通股股份：(a) 为其自身账户持有；(b) 仅用于投资目的；且 (c) 并非以在以色列国境内转售为目的而发行，但依照《5728—1968 年以色列证券法》的规定进行的转售除外；以及 (v) 其愿意提供关于其合格投资者身份的进一步证据。收件投资者可能须就其身份提交书面证据，并可能须签署及提交一份声明，其中除其他事项外，载明收件投资者的姓名、地址及护照号码或以色列身份证号码。

paras.en: No prospectus or other offering material or document in connection with the offer and sale of shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus has been or will be registered with the Securities Commission of Malaysia (the “Malaysian Commission”) for the Malaysian Commission’s approval pursuant to the Capital Markets and Services Act 2007. Accordingly, this prospectus and any other document or material in connection with the offer or sale, or invitation for subscription or purchase, of the shares of Class A common stock may not be circulated or distributed, nor may the shares of Class A common stock be offered or sold, or be made the subject of an invitation for subscription or purchase, whether directly or indirectly, to persons in Malaysia other than (i) a closed-end fund approved by the Malaysian Commission; (ii) a holder of a Capital Markets Services License; (iii) a person who acquires shares of Class A common stock, as principal, if the offer is on terms that the shares if Class A common stock may only be acquired at a consideration of not less than RM250,000 (or its equivalent in foreign currencies) for each transaction; (iv) an individual whose total net personal assets or total net joint assets with his or her spouse exceeds RM3 million (or its equivalent in foreign currencies), excluding the value of the primary residence of the individual; (v) an individual who has a gross annual income exceeding RM300,000 (or its equivalent in foreign currencies) per annum in the preceding twelve months; (vi) an individual who, jointly with his or her spouse, has a gross annual income of RM400,000 (or its equivalent in foreign currencies), per annum in the preceding twelve months; (ix) a bank licensee or insurance licensee as defined in the Labuan Financial Services and Securities Act 2010; (x) an Islamic bank licensee or takaful licensee as defined in the Labuan Financial Services and Securities Act 2010; and (xi) any other person as may be specified by the Commission; provided that, in each of the preceding categories (i) to (xi), the distribution of the shares of Class A common stock is made by a holder of a Capital Markets Services License who carries on the business of dealing in securities. The distribution in Malaysia of this prospectus is subject to Malaysian laws. This prospectus does not constitute and may not be used for the purpose of a public offering or an issue, offer for subscription or purchase, or invitation to subscribe for or purchase any securities requiring the registration of a prospectus with the Malaysian Commission under the Capital Markets and Services Act 2007.
paras.zh: 与本招股说明书所发售的 A 类普通股股份的要约和出售相关的任何招股说明书或其他发售材料或文件，均未且不会依据《2007 年资本市场与服务法》提交马来西亚证券委员会（下称“马来西亚委员会”）登记以取得其批准。因此，本招股说明书及与 A 类普通股股份的要约或出售、或认购或购买邀请相关的任何其他文件或材料，不得向马来西亚境内人士传播或分发，A 类普通股股份亦不得直接或间接向马来西亚境内人士要约或出售，或作为认购或购买邀请的标的，但以下情形除外：(i) 经马来西亚委员会批准的封闭式基金；(ii) 资本市场服务牌照持有人；(iii) 以本人身份取得 A 类普通股股份的人士，且该要约的条款规定每笔交易取得 A 类普通股股份的对价不低于 RM250,000（或等值外币）；(iv) 个人净资产总额或与其配偶的联合净资产总额超过 RM3 百万（或等值外币）的个人，但不包括该个人主要居所的价值；(v) 在前十二个月内年度总收入超过 RM300,000（或等值外币）的个人；(vi) 与其配偶在前十二个月内年度总收入合计为 RM400,000（或等值外币）的个人；(vii) 根据最近经审计账目净资产总额超过 RM10 百万（或等值外币）的公司；(viii) 净资产总额超过 RM10 百万（或等值外币）的合伙企业；(ix) 《2010 年纳闽金融服务与证券法》所定义的银行持牌人或保险持牌人；(x) 《2010 年纳闽金融服务与证券法》所定义的伊斯兰银行持牌人或回教保险（takaful）持牌人；以及(xi) 马来西亚委员会可能指定的任何其他人士；但前提是，在上述(i)至(xi)各类情形中，A 类普通股股份的分发须由从事证券交易业务的资本市场服务牌照持有人进行。本招股说明书在马来西亚的分发受马来西亚法律约束。本招股说明书不构成、亦不得用于根据《2007 年资本市场与服务法》须向马来西亚委员会登记招股说明书的任何证券的公开发行或发行、认购或购买要约、或认购或购买邀请。

paras.en: #### Opinion on the Financial Statements
paras.zh: #### 对财务报表的意见

paras.en: We have audited the accompanying consolidated balance sheets of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. and its subsidiaries (the “Company”) as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, and the related consolidated statements of operations, of comprehensive income (loss), of redeemable convertible preferred stock and shareholders' equity and of cash flows for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2025, including the related notes (collectively referred to as the “consolidated financial statements”). In our opinion, the consolidated financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the financial position of the Company as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, and the results of its operations and its cash flows for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2025 in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America.
paras.zh: 我们已审计了随附的 Space Exploration Technologies Corp. 及其子公司（以下简称“公司”）截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日的合并资产负债表，以及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止三年期间各年度的相关合并经营报表、综合收益（亏损）表、可赎回可转换优先股及股东权益表和现金流量表，包括相关附注（统称为“合并财务报表”）。我们认为，合并财务报表在所有重大方面公允反映了公司截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日的财务状况，以及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止三年期间各年度的经营成果和现金流量，符合美国公认会计原则。

paras.en: #### Basis for Opinion
paras.zh: #### 意见基础

paras.en: These consolidated financial statements are the responsibility of the Company’s management. Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company’s consolidated financial statements based on our audits. We are a public accounting firm registered with the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (PCAOB) and are required to be independent with respect to the Company in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB.
paras.zh: 这些合并财务报表由公司管理层负责。我们的责任是在审计的基础上对公司的合并财务报表发表意见。我们是一家在美国公众公司会计监督委员会（PCAOB）注册的会计师事务所，并须根据美国联邦证券法律以及美国证券交易委员会和 PCAOB 的适用规则和规定，对公司保持独立性。

paras.en: We conducted our audits of these consolidated financial statements in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB. Those standards require that we plan and perform the audits to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the consolidated financial statements are free of material misstatement, whether due to error or fraud.
paras.zh: 我们按照 PCAOB 的标准对这些合并财务报表执行了审计。这些标准要求我们计划和执行审计，以就合并财务报表是否不存在由于错误或舞弊导致的重大错报获取合理保证。

paras.en: Our audits included performing procedures to assess the risks of material misstatement of the consolidated financial statements, whether due to error or fraud, and performing procedures that respond to those risks. Such procedures included examining, on a test basis, evidence regarding the amounts and disclosures in the consolidated financial statements. Our audits also included evaluating the accounting principles used and significant estimates made by management, as well as evaluating the overall presentation of the consolidated financial statements. We believe that our audits provide a reasonable basis for our opinion.
paras.zh: 我们的审计包括执行程序以评估合并财务报表是否存在由于错误或舞弊导致的重大错报风险，以及执行应对这些风险的程序。此类程序包括在测试基础上检查有关合并财务报表中金额和披露的证据。我们的审计还包括评价管理层采用的会计原则和作出的重大估计，以及评价合并财务报表的整体列报。我们认为，我们的审计为我们的意见提供了合理基础。

paras.en: The critical audit matter communicated below is a matter arising from the current period audit of the consolidated financial statements that was communicated or required to be communicated to the audit committee and that (i) relates to accounts or disclosures that are material to the consolidated financial statements and (ii) involved our especially challenging, subjective, or complex judgments. The communication of critical audit matters does not alter in any way our opinion on the consolidatedfinancial statements, taken as a whole, and we are not, by communicating the critical audit matter below, providing a separate opinion on the critical audit matter or on the accounts or disclosures to which it relates.
paras.zh: 下文所述关键审计事项系本期对合并财务报表审计中产生的事项，该事项已传达或要求传达给审计委员会，且(i)涉及对合并财务报表具有重要性的账目或披露，以及(ii)涉及我们特别具有挑战性、主观性或复杂性的判断。关键审计事项的传达不以任何方式改变我们对合并财务报表整体的意见，且我们通过下文传达关键审计事项，并非就该关键审计事项或其所涉及的账目或披露提供单独意见。

paras.en: Revenue Recognition – Estimate of Total Cost at Completion for Certain Contracts Recognized Over Time
paras.zh: 收入确认——对按时间确认的某些合同完工总成本的估计

paras.en: As described in Notes 2 and 3 to the consolidated financial statements, the Company recognized revenue of $4.1 billion and $11.4 billion for the year ended December 31, 2025 within the Space and Connectivity segments, respectively, a portion of which related to contracts recognized over time using the cost-to-cost input method. Under the cost-to-cost input method, the Company records revenue based upon costs (such as materials and labor hours) incurred to date relative to the total estimated cost at completion. Developing the estimated total cost at completion for each performance obligation requires the use of significant management judgment, including assumptions regarding (i) launch timing, labor hours, allocation of shared costs for launch vehicles that have been identified as reusable for multiple launches, as well as expected technological changes to launch vehicles and spacecraft for Space contracts, and (ii) labor hours, allocation of shared costs used in the production of satellites, satellite material costs, as well as expected technological changes to satellites for Connectivity contracts. The Company recognizes changes in estimated contract revenue or costs at completion and the resulting changes in contract profit on a cumulative basis.
paras.zh: 如合并财务报表附注 2 和附注 3 所述，公司在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度内，在太空与连接业务板块分别确认收入$4.1 billion 和$11.4 billion，其中一部分涉及采用成本比成本投入法按时间确认的合同。在成本比成本投入法下，公司根据迄今发生的成本（如材料和人工工时）相对于完工总估计成本确认收入。为每项履约义务制定完工总估计成本需要管理层运用重大判断，包括有关以下方面的假设：(i)发射时间安排、人工工时、被认定为可多次发射重复使用的运载火箭的共享成本分摊，以及太空合同项下运载火箭和航天器预期技术变化；以及(ii)人工工时、卫星生产中使用的共享成本分摊、卫星材料成本，以及连接合同项下卫星预期技术变化。公司以累计基础确认合同收入或完工成本估计的变动以及由此产生的合同利润变动。

paras.en: The principal considerations for our determination that performing procedures relating to revenue recognition – estimate of total cost at completion for certain contracts recognized over time is a critical audit matter are (i) the significant judgment by management in developing the estimate of total cost at completion, including significant judgments and assumptions on a contract by contract basis, and (ii) a high degree of auditor judgment, subjectivity, and effort in performing procedures and evaluating audit evidence related to management’s estimate of total cost at completion, including estimated labor hours.
paras.zh: 我们认定执行与收入确认——对按时间确认的某些合同完工总成本的估计相关的程序为关键审计事项的主要考虑因素是：(i)管理层在制定完工总估计成本时作出的重大判断，包括逐合同作出的重大判断和假设；以及(ii)审计师在执行程序及评价与管理层完工总估计成本（包括估计人工工时）相关的审计证据时的高度判断、主观性和工作量。

paras.en: Addressing the matter involved performing procedures and evaluating audit evidence in connection with forming our overall opinion on the consolidated financial statements. These procedures included, among others, (i) testing the completeness and accuracy of underlying data used by management related to actual costs to date, (ii) testing management’s process for developing the estimate of total cost at completion, including evaluating on a test basis, the reasonableness of certain significant judgments and assumptions considered by management specific to each contract, including estimated labor hours. Evaluating the significant judgments and assumptions related to the estimates of total cost at completion involved evaluating whether the significant judgments and assumptions used by management were reasonable considering (i) management’s historical forecasting accuracy; (ii) evidence to support the relevant aforementioned assumptions; (iii) the consistent application of accounting policies; and (iv) the timely identification of circumstances which may require a modification to a previous estimate.
paras.zh: 就相关事项执行的程序及评价审计证据，与我们形成对合并财务报表整体意见相关。这些程序包括（其中包括）：(i) 测试管理层使用的与迄今实际成本相关的底层数据的完整性和准确性；(ii) 测试管理层编制完工总成本估计的流程，包括以抽样方式评价管理层针对每份合同所考虑的某些重大判断和假设（包括估计工时）的合理性。评价与完工总成本估计相关的重大判断和假设，涉及评价管理层使用的重大判断和假设是否合理，考量因素包括：(i) 管理层过往预测的准确性；(ii) 支持上述相关假设的证据；(iii) 会计政策的一贯应用；以及 (iv) 及时识别可能需要修改先前估计的情形。

paras.en: #### Description of Business
paras.zh: #### 业务描述

paras.en: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. and its wholly owned subsidiaries, collectively referred to as the “Company” or “SpaceX,” operate three segments – (i) the Space segment designs, manufactures, and launches reusable rockets to provide high cadence, reliable, and affordable access to space at unprecedented scale, (ii) the Connectivity segment operates a worldwide high-speed, low-latency broadband network powered by thousand s of Starlink satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, delivering connectivity to million s of consumer, enterprise, and government customers through our Starlink offering, and (iii) theAI segment operates a vertically integrated AI platform spanning a frontier LLM Grok, AI solutions for consumer and enterprise customers, X — a real-time information, entertainment, and free speech platform — and AI computational infrastructure.
paras.zh: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. 及其全资子公司（合称“公司”或“SpaceX”）经营三个业务板块——(i) 太空板块设计、制造并发射可重复使用火箭，以前所未有的规模提供高频次、可靠且经济实惠的太空进入能力；(ii) 连接板块运营一个由数千颗低地球轨道 Starlink 卫星驱动的全球高速、低延迟宽带网络，通过我们的 Starlink 产品为数百万消费者、企业和政府客户提供连接服务；以及 (iii) AI 板块运营一个垂直整合的 AI 平台，涵盖前沿大语言模型 Grok、面向消费者和企业客户的 AI 解决方案、X——一个实时信息、娱乐和言论自由平台——以及 AI 算力基础设施。

paras.en: SpaceX is advancing the boundaries of space technology and human spaceflight through its Falcon launch vehicles and Dragon spacecraft and is currently developing Starship, a fully reusable transportation system that is designed to carry crew, cargo, satellites, and data centers to Earth orbit, the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
paras.zh: SpaceX 正通过其 Falcon 运载火箭和 Dragon 飞船拓展太空技术和载人航天的边界，目前正在开发 Starship，这是一种完全可重复使用的运输系统，旨在将乘员、货物、卫星和数据中心运送至地球轨道、月球、火星及更远的地方。

paras.en: SpaceX operates Starlink which delivers high-speed, low-latency broadband internet to customers around the globe, including to those who live in some of the most remote places on Earth. The Company also provides access to satellite-to-mobile texting and voice services to mobile users (referred to as “Starlink Mobile”).
paras.zh: SpaceX 运营 Starlink，为全球客户提供高速、低延迟的宽带互联网服务，包括居住在地球上一些最偏远地区的客户。公司还为移动用户提供卫星到移动设备的短信和语音服务（称为“Starlink Mobile”）。

paras.en: SpaceX operates a global platform for public conversation known as X (formerly known as Twitter) as well as the Grok suite of text and multi-modal AI models, accessible to individual users via online platforms such as x.com and to enterprise clients for applications in research, productivity, and decision-making.
paras.zh: SpaceX 运营一个名为 X（前身为 Twitter）的全球公共对话平台，以及 Grok 系列文本和多模态 AI 模型，个人用户可通过 x.com 等在线平台访问，企业客户可将其用于研究、生产力和决策应用。

paras.en: The Company ’s corporate headquarters is located in Starbase, Texas. SpaceX was incorporated in the state of Delaware on March 14, 2002 and converted into a corporation organized under the laws of the State of Texas on February 14, 2024.
paras.zh: 公司总部位于德克萨斯州 Starbase。SpaceX 于 2002 年 3 月 14 日在特拉华州注册成立，并于 2024 年 2 月 14 日转换为根据德克萨斯州法律组建的公司。

paras.en: On May 4, 2026, the Company effected a five-for-one forward stock split of its authorized, issued, and outstanding shares of Class A, Class B, and Class C Common Stock (“2026 Stock Split”). The conversion rate of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock was proportionately adjusted to factor in the 2026 Stock Split. All share and per share information has been retroactively adjusted to reflect the 2026 Stock Split for all periods presented.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月 4 日，公司对其已授权、已发行和流通的 A 类、B 类和 C 类普通股实施了五拆一的股票拆分（“2026 年股票拆分”）。SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股的转换率已按比例调整以反映 2026 年股票拆分。所有股份和每股信息均已追溯调整，以反映所列示所有期间的 2026 年股票拆分。

paras.en: On February 2, 2026, the Company completed its acquisition of X.AI Holdings Corp. (“xAI”), pursuant to which xAI became a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (“xAI Merger”). Prior to the xAI Merger, on March 28, 2025, xAI completed its acquisition of X Holdings Corp. (“X”) and X.AI Corp., in which X and X.AI Corp. became wholly-owned subsidiaries of xAI (“X Merger”, and collectively with xAI Merger, “Mergers”). X.AI Corp began operations in March 2023 and Twitter, Inc. (“Twitter”) was acquired by Mr. Elon Musk in October 2022. The Mergers were each effected through a share exchange.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月 2 日，公司完成了对 X.AI Holdings Corp.（“xAI”）的收购，据此 xAI 成为公司的全资子公司（“xAI 合并”）。在 xAI 合并之前，xAI 于 2025 年 3 月 28 日完成了对 X Holdings Corp.（“X”）和 X.AI Corp. 的收购，其中 X 和 X.AI Corp. 成为 xAI 的全资子公司（“X 合并”，与 xAI 合并合称“合并”）。X.AI Corp 于 2023 年 3 月开始运营，Twitter, Inc.（“Twitter”）于 2022 年 10 月被 Elon Musk 先生收购。各次合并均通过换股方式实施。

paras.en: The Mergers have been accounted for as reorganizations of entities under common control as Mr. Elon Musk had a controlling financial interest in the Company, xAI and X through his majority voting interest in each such entity during the years presented in these consolidated financial statements. The Company’s consolidated financial statements have been prepared to reflect the retrospective combination of the net assets of the entities at their historical carrying amounts for all periods presented. No new goodwill or other intangible assets have been recorded and all historical related party transactions between the entities have been eliminated in consolidation. The capital stock and shareholders’ equity for all periods presented reflects a continuation of the historical SpaceX capital stock and shareholders’ equity, combined with the historical capital stock and shareholders’ equity of X and xAI merged under common control, as adjusted by the respective exchange ratios used to effect the Mergers, except for xAI’s historical redeemable convertible preferred stock. This presentation constitutes a change in reporting entity. Refer to Note 13, Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock and Shareholders’ Equity for additional details.
paras.zh: 上述合并已作为同一控制下实体的重组进行会计处理，因为在本次合并财务报表所列报的各年度内，Elon Musk 先生通过其在公司、xAI 和 X 各自持有的多数投票权益，对上述每一实体均拥有控制性财务权益。公司合并财务报表的编制旨在反映各实体净资产在所有列报期间按历史账面价值进行的追溯合并。未确认任何新的商誉或其他无形资产，且各实体之间所有历史关联方交易均已在合并中抵销。所有列报期间的股本及股东权益反映的是历史 SpaceX 股本及股东权益的延续，并与 X 和 xAI 在同一控制下合并的历史股本及股东权益相结合，并按实施上述合并所采用的相应换股比例进行调整，但 xAI 的历史可赎回可转换优先股除外。本列报方式构成报告主体的变更。更多详情请参见附注 13“可赎回可转换优先股及股东权益”。

paras.en: As the consolidated financial statements already reflect the reorganization of entities under common control for all periods presented, separate financial statements of xAI and X are not provided.
paras.zh: 由于合并财务报表已在所有列报期间反映了同一控制下实体的重组，故未单独提供 xAI 和 X 的财务报表。

full.sec: Note 2 - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies
full.secZh: 附注 2 - 重要会计政策摘要

paras.en: #### Basis of Presentation
paras.zh: #### 列报基础

paras.en: The consolidated financial statements are presented in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”) in the United States of America (“U.S.”).
paras.zh: 合并财务报表按照美国（“美国”）公认会计原则（“GAAP”）列报。

paras.en: #### Principles of Consolidation
paras.zh: #### 合并原则

paras.en: The consolidated financial statements include the accounts of the Company and its wholly owned subsidiaries. All intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated in consolidation.
paras.zh: 合并财务报表包括公司及其全资子公司的账目。所有公司间余额和交易已在合并中抵销。

paras.en: #### Use of Estimates
paras.zh: #### 估计的使用

paras.en: The preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with U.S. GAAP requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the reported amounts of assets and liabilities, the disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the consolidated financial statements, and the reported amounts of revenue and expenses during the reporting period. Actual results could differ from those estimates. Amounts which are subject to significant judgment and use of estimates include revenues recognized over time using the cost-to-cost input method, the determination of valuation allowances associated with deferred tax assets and estimates of tax liabilities, reserves for excess and obsolete inventory, fair value of indefinite-lived intangible assets and goodwill, useful lives of property, plant, and equipment, the determination of incremental borrowing rate for lease liabilities, litigation and settlement costs, and the valuation and assumptions underlying share-based compensation. On an ongoing basis, the Company evaluates its estimates compared to historical experience and current trends, which forms the basis for making judgments about the carrying value of assets and liabilities. In addition, the Company engages valuation specialists to assist in the valuation of equity instruments.
paras.zh: 按照美国 GAAP 编制合并财务报表要求管理层作出估计和假设，这些估计和假设会影响合并财务报表日资产和负债的 reported 金额、或有资产和负债的披露，以及报告期内收入和费用的 reported 金额。实际结果可能与这些估计存在差异。需要作出重大判断和使用估计的金额包括：采用成本法（cost-to-cost）投入法随时间确认的收入、与递延所得税资产相关的估值备抵的确定及税务负债的估计、超额和过时存货的准备、使用寿命不确定的无形资产和商誉的公允价值、物业、厂房和设备的可使用年限、租赁负债增量借款利率的确定、诉讼和和解费用，以及股权激励的估值和假设。公司持续将估计与历史经验和当前趋势进行比较，以此作为判断资产和负债账面价值的基础。此外，公司聘请估值专家协助进行权益工具的估值。

paras.en: #### Concentration of Supplier Risk
paras.zh: #### 供应商风险集中

paras.en: Certain materials and products that are key inputs in the Company’s Space, Connectivity, and AI segments are available from a limited number of suppliers, including sole or limited-source suppliers; and the Company’s direct chip suppliers are dependent on a concentrated group of advanced semiconductor fabrication facilities. The Company believes that alternative suppliers are available for many, but not all, of these products and services. The inability of these suppliers to deliver necessary components of the products in a timely manner and at prices, quality levels, and volumes acceptable to the Company, or interruptions in supply of materials or products on which these suppliers rely, could have an adverse effect on the Company’s ability to meet customer demands and contractual obligations, to execute on its growth strategy, or to manage its expenses or timelines as expected, which could adversely impact the Company’s financial condition and operating results.
paras.zh: 公司太空、连接和 AI 板块所需的关键投入品中的某些材料和产品仅可从有限数量的供应商处获得，包括独家或有限来源供应商；且公司的直接芯片供应商依赖于集中的先进半导体制造设施群体。公司认为，对于许多（但并非全部）此类产品和服务，存在替代供应商。如果这些供应商无法及时以公司可接受的价格、质量水平和数量交付产品的必要组件，或者这些供应商所依赖的材料或产品供应中断，可能会对公司满足客户需求和合同义务、执行增长战略或按预期管理其费用或时间表的能力产生不利影响，进而可能对公司的财务状况和经营业绩产生不利影响。

paras.en: #### Cash and Cash Equivalents and Restricted Cash
paras.zh: #### 现金及现金等价物和受限现金

paras.en: Cash and cash equivalents consist of cash in checking accounts, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit at high quality financial institutions primarily in the U.S. All highly liquid investments with an original maturity of three months or less at the date of purchase are considered to be cash equivalents. The Company maintains certain cash and cash equivalents for which the withdrawal or use is restricted. The restricted cash and cash equivalents are generally held in separate, dedicated accounts required to secure letters of credit related to various customer, insurance, and facility lease agreements.
paras.zh: 现金及现金等价物包括主要位于美国的高质量金融机构的支票账户、货币市场账户和定期存单中的现金。所有在购买日原始到期期限为三个月或以内的高流动性投资均被视为现金等价物。公司持有若干提取或使用受到限制的现金及现金等价物。受限现金及现金等价物通常存放于独立的专用账户中，用于为与各类客户、保险及设施租赁协议相关的信用证提供担保。

paras.zh: 如合并现金流量表所示，公司的现金及现金等价物和受限现金总额如下：
