paras.en: In the normal course of its business, the Company is involved from time to time in various arbitrations, class actions, commercial litigation, investigations and other legal, regulatory or governmental actions, including the significant matters described below that could have a material impact on our results of operations. The Company assesses, in conjunction with its legal counsel, the need to record a liability for litigation and contingencies. With respect to the cases, actions, and inquiries described below, the Company evaluates the associated developments on a regular basis and will accrue a liability when it believes a loss is probable and the amount can be reasonably estimated. In addition, the Company believes there is a reasonable possibility that it may incur a loss in some of these matters and the loss may be material or exceed its estimated ranges of possible loss.
paras.zh: 在日常经营过程中，公司不时涉及各类仲裁、集体诉讼、商业诉讼、调查及其他法律、监管或政府行动，包括下文所述可能对我们的经营业绩产生重大影响的重大事项。公司会同其法律顾问评估是否需要就诉讼及或有事项计提负债。对于下文所述的案件、行动及问询，公司定期评估相关进展，并在认为损失很可能发生且金额能够合理估计时计提负债。此外，公司认为，在其中部分事项中其可能发生损失，且该等损失可能重大或超出其估计的可能损失区间。

paras.en: The outcomes of the matters described in this section, such as whether the likelihood of loss is remote, reasonably possible, or probable, or if and when the reasonably possible range of loss is estimable, are inherently uncertain, and unless specified otherwise, possible losses are not reasonably estimable at this time. If one or more of these matters were resolved against the Company for amounts above management’s estimates, the Company’s financial condition and results of operations, including in a particular reporting period in which any such outcome becomes probable and estimable, could be materially adversely affected.
paras.zh: 本节所述事项的结果，例如损失的可能性属于极小、合理可能还是很可能，或者合理可能的损失区间是否以及何时能够估计，本质上具有不确定性；除另有说明外，目前无法合理估计可能的损失。如果上述一项或多项事项以超出管理层估计的金额对公司作出不利裁决，公司的财务状况和经营业绩（包括在任何此类结果变得很可能且能够估计的特定报告期内）可能受到重大不利影响。

paras.en: In November 2022, the European Union’s Digital Services Act (“DSA”) came into force as a result of which X has to comply with extensive content moderation and other duties. The Company published its first Transparency Report under the DSA in November 2023. In December 2023, the European Commission (“EC”) opened a formal investigation into X and its Irish subsidiary, Twitter International Unlimited Company (“TIUC”), which was later renamed to X Internet Unlimited Company (XIUC). On July 12, 2024, in relation to alleged breaches of Articles 25(1), 39 and 40(12) of the DSA, the EC issued preliminary findings that X’s blue checkmark is deceptive, its advertisement repository does not meet DSA requirements, and it grants inadequate access to data to third-party researchers. On September 26, 2024, XIUC and X submitted their observations challenging the EC’s preliminary findings. On December 5, 2025, the EC delivered a final decision in which it upheld its preliminary findings and imposed a fine of EUR 120 million on XIUC, X., x.AI, and Elon Musk (together, the “parties”). On February 16, 2026, the parties challenged the EC’s decision in the General Court of the European Union. This challenge remains pending.
paras.zh: 2022 年 11 月，欧盟《数字服务法》（“DSA”）生效，X 因此须遵守广泛的内容审核及其他义务。公司于 2023 年 11 月发布了其根据 DSA 的首份透明度报告。2023 年 12 月，欧盟委员会（“EC”）对 X 及其爱尔兰子公司 Twitter International Unlimited Company（“TIUC”，后更名为 X Internet Unlimited Company（XIUC））启动正式调查。2024 年 7 月 12 日，就涉嫌违反 DSA 第 25(1)条、第 39 条和第 40(12)条一事，EC 发布初步认定，认为 X 的蓝色认证标记具有欺骗性、其广告库不符合 DSA 要求，且其向第三方研究人员提供的数据访问权限不足。2024 年 9 月 26 日，XIUC 与 X 提交意见，对 EC 的初步认定提出异议。2025 年 12 月 5 日，EC 作出最终决定，维持其初步认定，并对 XIUC、X.、x.AI 及 Elon Musk（合称“各方”）处以 EUR 120 million 罚款。2026 年 2 月 16 日，各方在欧洲联盟普通法院对 EC 的决定提出异议。该异议目前仍在审理中。

paras.en: In March 2016, non-practicing entity Youtoo Technologies filed suit against Twitter, Inc. in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas alleging its Vine and Periscope products infringe Youtoo’s video-sharing patents (the ‘304, ‘506, and ‘997 patents). On Twitter’s motion, the district court dismissed the ‘304 and ’506 patents as invalid. Twitter filed petitions for Inter Partes Review before the Patent Trial and Appeals Board (PTAB) challenging all three patents-in-suit. The PTAB upheld the ‘304 and ‘506 Patents and invalidated the ‘997 Patent; the Federal Circuit affirmed. On March 16, 2020, Plaintiff (now Vidstream LLC, which allegedly acquired the patents from Youtoo Technologies in a bankruptcy proceeding), moved the Court to reconsider its earlier ruling invalidating the ‘304 and ‘506 patents. On April 1, 2022, the Court reversed its original ruling on the ‘304 and ‘506 patents. On September 27, 2024, Vidstream filed a motion for partial summary judgment, which the Court granted in part. The case went to a jury trial, and on April 16, 2025, the jury rendered a verdict finding (i) that Twitter did not infringe any claim of the ‘506 patent and two out of three claims of the ‘304 patent and that each of those patent claims was invalid, but (ii) that Twitter willfully infringed one claim of the ‘304 patent. The jury awarded Plaintiff $105 million in damages. In November 2025, the district court affirmed the jury’s award and awarded an additional $67 million in prejudgment interest. Twitter has appealed and Vidstream has cross-appealed. Both appeals remain pending before the Federal Circuit.
paras.zh: 2016 年 3 月，非执业实体 Youtoo Technologies 在美国德克萨斯州北区联邦地区法院对 Twitter, Inc. 提起诉讼，指控其 Vine 和 Periscope 产品侵犯 Youtoo 的视频共享专利（‘304、‘506 和 ‘997 专利）。经 Twitter 动议，地区法院以无效为由驳回 ‘304 和 ‘506 专利。Twitter 向专利审判与上诉委员会（PTAB）提交多方复审请求，对全部三项涉案专利提出异议。PTAB 维持 ‘304 和 ‘506 专利有效，并宣告 ‘997 专利无效；联邦巡回法院予以维持。2020 年 3 月 16 日，原告（现为 Vidstream LLC，据称其在破产程序中从 Youtoo Technologies 处取得上述专利）向法院提出动议，请求重新考虑其此前宣告 ‘304 和 ‘506 专利无效的裁定。2022 年 4 月 1 日，法院推翻其关于 ‘304 和 ‘506 专利的原裁定。2024 年 9 月 27 日，Vidstream 提交部分简易判决动议，法院部分准许。该案进入陪审团审理，2025 年 4 月 16 日，陪审团作出裁决，认定 (i) Twitter 未侵犯 ‘506 专利的任何权利要求以及 ‘304 专利三项权利要求中的两项，且上述各项专利权利要求均无效，但 (ii) Twitter 故意侵犯了 ‘304 专利的一项权利要求。陪审团判给原告 $105 million 损害赔偿。2025 年 11 月，地区法院维持陪审团裁决，并另行判给 $67 million 判决前利息。Twitter 已提起上诉，Vidstream 已提起交叉上诉。两起上诉目前均在联邦巡回法院审理中。

paras.en: In June 2023, music publishing companies that are members of the National Music Publishers’ Association (the “NMPA”) filed a complaint against X in the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Tennessee, claiming direct, contributory, and vicarious copyright infringement based on Twitter’s alleged failure to expeditiously take down infringing music posted by users after the music publishers allegedly gave Twitter notice of those infringements. The music publishers also allege that Twitter did not suspend the accounts of “repeat infringers,” so that Twitter is not entitled to a “safe harbor” from liability under the DMCA. X filed a motion to dismiss the complaint on August 14, 2023. On March 5, 2024, the Court dismissed plaintiffs’ direct infringement and vicarious infringement claims, and part of plaintiffs’ claim for contributory infringement. X answered the complaint on April 9, 2024. Litigation was stayed from June 11, 2025 to September 9, 2025 for settlement discussions that were not successful. Accordingly, discovery is ongoing.
paras.zh: 2023 年 6 月，作为全国音乐出版商协会（“NMPA”）成员的几家音乐出版公司在美国田纳西州中区联邦地区法院对 X 提起诉讼，主张直接侵权、帮助侵权及替代侵权著作权责任，理由是据称音乐出版商已就用户发布的侵权音乐向 Twitter 发出通知后，Twitter 未能迅速下架该等侵权内容。音乐出版商还主张，Twitter 未暂停“重复侵权者”的账户，因此 Twitter 无权依据 DMCA 享有责任“避风港”。X 于 2023 年 8 月 14 日提出驳回起诉的动议。2024 年 3 月 5 日，法院驳回了原告的直接侵权和替代侵权主张，以及原告帮助侵权主张的一部分。X 于 2024 年 4 月 9 日对起诉状作出答辩。自 2025 年 6 月 11 日至 2025 年 9 月 9 日，诉讼因和解磋商而中止，但磋商未能成功。因此，证据开示仍在进行中。

paras.en: In September 2023, Dutch foundation Stichting Data Bescherming Nederland (“SDBN”) filed a putative class action lawsuit in the District Court of Amsterdam in the Netherlands against TIUC, Twitter, Inc., X Corp., and Twitter Netherlands b.v. related to Twitter’s operation of the MoPub platform. SDBN primarily claims that MoPub’s real-time bidding ad exchange violated the GDPR. SDBN claims to represent 11 million Dutch internet users who downloaded and used third-party mobile apps containing the MoPub software development kit during the period 2013-2022 and it seeks a monetary award in the range of € 250 to € 2,500 per person. On February 4, 2026, the Court declined to allow the case to proceed as a class action and indicated that it is considering staying the proceedings until the Court of Justice of the European Union has ruled in a separate case concerning the applicability of Dutch class action requirements to GDPR claims. The Twitter parties filed a brief in support of the proposed stay, which the plaintiffs opposed, on March 4, 2026.
paras.zh: 2023 年 9 月，荷兰基金会 Stichting Data Bescherming Nederland（“SDBN”）在荷兰阿姆斯特丹地区法院对 TIUC、Twitter, Inc.、X Corp.和 Twitter Netherlands b.v.提起一项拟议集体诉讼，涉及 Twitter 对 MoPub 平台的运营。SDBN 主要主张 MoPub 的实时竞价广告交易平台违反了 GDPR。SDBN 声称其代表 11 百万名荷兰互联网用户，该等用户在 2013-2022 年期间下载并使用了包含 MoPub 软件开发工具包的第三方移动应用，并寻求按每人€ 250 至€ 2,500 的金额判给赔偿。2026 年 2 月 4 日，法院不予准许本案作为集体诉讼继续进行，并表示其正考虑中止诉讼程序，直至欧盟法院就另一宗涉及荷兰集体诉讼要求是否适用于 GDPR 主张的案件作出裁决。Twitter 各方于 2026 年 3 月 4 日提交了支持拟议中止的书面意见，原告对此表示反对。

paras.en: In August 2024, Dutch foundation Stichting Onderzoek Marktinformatie (SOMI) initiated a collective action in the District Court of Amsterdam in the Netherlands on behalf of approximately 7.8 million Dutch X users. Among other things, SOMI seeks damages against TIUC, X Corp. and Twitter Netherlands B.V. (collectively, the “X entities”) for: (1) alleged data breaches and insufficient security measures; (2) alleged unauthorized microtargeting and lack of transparency; and (3) the alleged failure to moderate hate speech and the obstruction of research, all in violation of the GDPR and/or DSA. The alleged data breaches relate to a Twitter API bug that came to light in 2022 and that had allowed persons who knew the email address or phone number of a user to determine the user’s Twitter ID. SOMI has requested compensation (to be assessed at a later stage) for each member of the class, including symbolic damages of EUR 1 for each member of the class that is allegedly affected by hate speech on the X platform. The X entities filed a procedural defense on March 12, 2025. A hearing has been scheduled for April 2, 2026.
paras.zh: 2024 年 8 月，荷兰基金会 Stichting Onderzoek Marktinformatie（SOMI）代表约 7.8 百万名荷兰 X 用户，在荷兰阿姆斯特丹地区法院提起集体诉讼。SOMI 请求判令 TIUC、X Corp. 和 Twitter Netherlands B.V.（合称“X 实体”）就以下事项承担损害赔偿等责任：(1) 涉嫌数据泄露及安全措施不足；(2) 涉嫌未经授权的微定向投放及缺乏透明度；(3) 涉嫌未能对仇恨言论进行审核以及妨碍研究，上述行为均违反 GDPR 和/或 DSA。所指控的数据泄露涉及 2022 年曝光的一处 Twitter API 漏洞，该漏洞曾使知悉用户电子邮件地址或电话号码的人能够确定该用户的 Twitter ID。SOMI 已请求为每一位集体成员提供赔偿（具体金额将在后续阶段评估），其中包括向每一位据称在 X 平台上受到仇恨言论影响的集体成员支付 1 欧元的象征性损害赔偿。X 实体于 2025 年 3 月 12 日提交了程序性抗辩。听证会已定于 2026 年 4 月 2 日举行。

paras.en: In September 2025, non-practicing entity Search and Share Technologies, LLC (“SaS”) filed a patent complaint against X Corp. in the Federal District Court for the Western District of Texas. SaS alleges that X Corp. infringed on U.S. Patent Nos. 10,180,952 and 11,106,744, through features in its mobile app and website enabling users to interact with content through dedicated interfaces that directly share what other users see in ranked feeds and search results. SaS filed an Amended Complaint on January 5, 2026. On January 20, 2026, X Corp. moved to dismiss SaS’s willful infringement and induced infringement claims. On February 3, 2026, SAS responded to, but did not oppose, X Corp.’s partial motion to dismiss. On February 10, 2026, X Corp. filed its reply. On February 4, 2026, X Corp. filed an IPR petition challenging the ‘744 Patent and on February 18, 2026, filed an IPR petition challenging the '952 Patent.
paras.zh: 2025 年 9 月，非执业实体 Search and Share Technologies, LLC（“SaS”）在德克萨斯州西区联邦地区法院对 X Corp. 提起专利诉讼。SaS 指控 X Corp. 通过其移动应用和网站中的功能侵犯了美国专利第 10,180,952 号和第 11,106,744 号，这些功能使用户能够通过专用界面与内容进行交互，直接分享其他用户在排序信息流和搜索结果中看到的内容。SaS 于 2026 年 1 月 5 日提交了修订起诉状。2026 年 1 月 20 日，X Corp. 提出动议，请求驳回 SaS 的故意侵权和诱导侵权主张。2026 年 2 月 3 日，SAS 对 X Corp. 的部分驳回动议作出回应，但未提出异议。2026 年 2 月 10 日，X Corp. 提交了答辩状。2026 年 2 月 4 日，X Corp. 提交了针对 '744 专利的 IPR 申请，并于 2026 年 2 月 18 日提交了针对 '952 专利的 IPR 申请。

paras.en: Beginning in January 2026, the Company and certain subsidiaries have been named as defendants in multiple lawsuits arising from Grok’s image-generation and editing features. The complaints generally allege that Grok’s image-generation and editing features enabled the creation and dissemination of nonconsensual explicit images and/ or content representing women and/or children in sexualized contexts. The actions include Jane Doe v. X.AI Corp. and X.AI LLC, instituted in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California on January 23, 2026, and Jane Doe 1 et al. v. X.AI Corp. and X.AI LLC (the “Jane Doe 1 Case”) instituted in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California on March 16, 2026. These cases are putative class actions, asserting claims including, among other things, claims of strict liability, negligence, nuisance, rights of privacy or publicity, and, in the Jane Doe 1 Case, certain federal statutory claims. Plaintiffs in these two cases seek, among other things, compensatory, statutory and punitive damages, restitution, disgorgement and injunctive relief. In addition, a case, Mayor and City Council of Baltimore ex rel. Ebony M. Thompson v. X Corp., X.AI Corp., X.AI LLC, and Space Exploration Technologies Corp, was instituted in the Baltimore City Circuit Court on March 24, 2026 (the “Baltimore Case”). The plaintiff in the Baltimore Case, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore, asserts similar claims to those in the two cases discussed above under Baltimore’s Consumer Protection Ordinances. The plaintiff in the Baltimore Case seeks statutory penaltiesand/or injunctive relief. The defendants intend to defend themselves vigorously in these actions.
paras.zh: 自 2026 年 1 月起，公司及若干子公司因 Grok 的图像生成和编辑功能而在多起诉讼中被列为被告。起诉状普遍指控 Grok 的图像生成和编辑功能使得未经同意的露骨图像和/或在性化语境中描绘女性和/或儿童的内容得以创建和传播。这些诉讼包括于 2026 年 1 月 23 日在美国加利福尼亚州北区联邦地区法院提起的 Jane Doe 诉 X.AI Corp.和 X.AI LLC 案，以及于 2026 年 3 月 16 日在美国加利福尼亚州北区联邦地区法院提起的 Jane Doe 1 等人诉 X.AI Corp.和 X.AI LLC 案（“Jane Doe 1 案”）。这些案件为推定集体诉讼，主张的请求包括严格责任、过失、妨害、隐私权或公开权，以及在 Jane Doe 1 案中的某些联邦法定请求。这两起案件的原告寻求补偿性、法定和惩罚性损害赔偿、返还、交出违法所得及禁令救济等。此外，2026 年 3 月 24 日，巴尔的摩市长和市议会代表 Ebony M. Thompson 诉 X Corp.、X.AI Corp.、X.AI LLC 和 Space Exploration Technologies Corp.一案在巴尔的摩市巡回法院提起（“巴尔的摩案”）。巴尔的摩案的原告巴尔的摩市长和市议会根据巴尔的摩的消费者保护条例主张与上述两案类似的请求。巴尔的摩案的原告寻求法定罚款和/或禁令救济。被告打算在这些诉讼中积极抗辩。

paras.en: The Company has recorded an accrual of $530 million for litigation losses that are probable and reasonably estimable in Accrued expenses and other current liabilities and Other liabilities on the consolidated balance sheet as of December 31, 2025. For other matters, the Company is not currently able to estimate the reasonably possible loss or range of loss.
paras.zh: 公司已在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的合并资产负债表上的应计费用及其他流动负债和其他负债中，就很可能发生且能够合理估计的诉讼损失计提了$530 million。对于其他事项，公司目前无法估计合理可能的损失或损失范围。

paras.en: #### Non-Income Taxes
paras.zh: #### 非所得税

paras.en: The Company is under various non-income tax audits by domestic and foreign tax authorities. These audits primarily revolve around routine inquiries, refund requests, and employee benefits. The Company accrues non-income taxes that may result from these audits when they are probable and can be reasonably estimated. Due to the complexity and uncertainty of some of these matters, however, as well as the judicial process in certain jurisdictions, the final outcome of these audits may be materially different from the Company’s expectations.
paras.zh: 公司正在接受国内外税务机关的各项非所得税审计。这些审计主要涉及常规询问、退税请求和员工福利。公司对可能因这些审计产生的非所得税，在很可能发生且能够合理估计时进行计提。然而，由于其中某些事项的复杂性和不确定性，以及某些司法管辖区的司法程序，这些审计的最终结果可能与公司的预期存在重大差异。

paras.en: #### Indemnifications

In the ordinary course of business, the Company may provide indemnifications of varying scope and terms to customers, vendors, lessors, investors, directors, officers, employees, and other parties with respect to certain matters, including, but not limited to, losses arising out of the Company’s breach of certain agreements, services to be provided by the Company, or from intellectual property infringement claims made by third parties. These indemnifications may survive the termination of the underlying agreement and the maximum potential amount of future payments the Company could be required to make under these indemnification provisions may not be subject to maximum loss clauses. It is not possible to determine the maximum potential amount under these indemnification agreements due to the unique facts and circumstances involved in each particular agreement. Historically, payments made by us under these agreements have not had a material impact on our consolidated financial statements. At December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company has not accrued a liability for any indemnification claims, because the likelihood of incurring a payment obligation, if any, in connection with any such indemnification claims is not probable or reasonably estimable.
paras.zh: 在日常业务过程中，公司可能就某些事项向客户、供应商、出租人、投资者、董事、高级管理人员、员工及其他方提供范围和条款各异的赔偿，包括但不限于因公司违反某些协议、公司拟提供的服务或第三方提起的知识产权侵权索赔而产生的损失。该等赔偿可能在相关基础协议终止后继续有效，且公司根据该等赔偿条款可能被要求支付的未来付款最高潜在金额可能不受最高损失条款的限制。由于每份具体协议所涉及的独特事实和情况，无法确定该等赔偿协议项下的最高潜在金额。历史上，我们根据该等协议支付的款项未对我们的合并财务报表产生重大影响。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，公司未就任何赔偿索赔计提负债，因为就任何该等赔偿索赔而言，产生付款义务（如有）的可能性并非很可能或无法合理估计。

paras.en: The Company periodically does business with certain entities with which its CEO and directors are affiliated.
paras.zh: 公司会不时与其首席执行官和董事有关联的某些实体开展业务。

paras.en: During the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company purchased $506 million and $191 million of Megapack products, respectively, from Tesla, Inc. (“Tesla”) recorded in Property, plant, and equipment, net in the consolidated balance sheets. The Company also obtained $131 million of Cybertrucks at manufacturer’s suggested retail price from Tesla recorded in Property, plant, and equipment, net in the consolidated balance sheets during the year ended December 31, 2025.
paras.zh: 在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年度内，公司分别从 Tesla, Inc.（“Tesla”）购买了 $506 million 和 $191 million 的 Megapack 产品，并计入合并资产负债表中的物业、厂房及设备净额。在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的年度内，公司还按制造商建议零售价从 Tesla 获得了 $131 million 的 Cybertrucks，并计入合并资产负债表中的物业、厂房及设备净额。

paras.en: On October 12, 2025, and as subsequently amended on November 10, 2025, CTC, a subsidiary of xAI and an indirect subsidiary of the Company, entered into an equipment lease agreement with Valor Equity Partners (“Valor”) for certain AI infrastructure hardware (the “Valor transaction”). The founder, CEO and Chief Investment Officer of Valor, Antonio J. Gracias, serves as one of the directors of the Company. The Valor transaction was deemed to be a failed sale-leaseback transaction and the Company recorded the related debt of $455 million and $4,052 million within Debt and finance leases, current and Debt and finance leases, net of current, respectively, as of December 31, 2025 in the Company’s consolidated balance sheets, and $66 million in Interest expense for the year ended December 31, 2025 in the Company’s consolidated statements of operations. Refer to Note 10, Debt for additional details. The related asset is recorded within Property, plant, and equipment, net in the Company’s consolidated balance sheets.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月 12 日，并经随后于 2025 年 11 月 10 日修订，CTC（xAI 的子公司、公司的间接子公司）与 Valor Equity Partners（“Valor”）就某些 AI 基础设施硬件签订了设备租赁协议（“Valor 交易”）。Valor 的创始人、首席执行官兼首席投资官 Antonio J. Gracias 担任公司董事之一。Valor 交易被视为失败的售后回租交易，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，公司分别在公司合并资产负债表中的债务和融资租赁、流动以及债务和融资租赁、扣除流动部分后的净额中记录了相关债务 $455 million 和 $4,052 million，并在公司截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度的合并经营报表中记录了 $66 million 的利息费用。更多详情请参阅附注 10“债务”。相关资产计入公司合并资产负债表中的物业、厂房及设备净额。

paras.en: In 2025, Elon Musk, through his trust, purchased $1,421 million of common stock from current and former employees.
paras.zh: 2025 年，Elon Musk 通过其信托从现任和前任员工处购买了 $1,421 million 的普通股。

paras.en: Other transactions with Tesla and other related parties during the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023 were immaterial.
paras.zh: 在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年和 2023 年的年度内，与 Tesla 及其他关联方的其他交易均不重大。

paras.en: Following the Mergers, the Company evaluated how to view and measure performance of the combined company and potential realignment of individual entity’s historical segment structure. Following this evaluation, the Company determined that as a combined company, effective in Q1 2026, the Company’s Chief Executive Officer, as the Chief Operating Decision Maker (“CODM”), organizes the Company, manages resource allocations, and measures performance among three operating and reportable segments: (i) Space, (ii) Connectivity, and (iii) AI. Prior period presentations for segments conform to the current segment reporting structure.
paras.zh: 合并完成后，公司评估了如何审视和衡量合并后公司的业绩，以及各实体历史分部结构可能进行的重新调整。经此评估，公司确定作为合并后公司，自 2026 年第一季度起生效，公司首席执行官作为首席经营决策者（“CODM”），按三个经营及报告分部来组织公司、管理资源配置并衡量业绩：(i) 太空、(ii) 连接 和 (iii) AI。分部的前期列报已与当前分部报告结构保持一致。

paras.en: The Company’s CODM assesses performance and allocates resources to operating segments based on segment income (loss) from operations by comparing actual income (loss) from operations to historical results and previously forecasted financial information. The Company’s CODM does not evaluate operating and reportable segments using asset or liability information.
paras.zh: 公司 CODM 根据分部经营利润（亏损）评估业绩并向经营分部配置资源，方法是将实际经营利润（亏损）与历史业绩及此前预测的财务信息进行比较。公司 CODM 不使用资产或负债信息来评估经营及报告分部。

paras.en: In 2022. paras.en: #### Officer Equity Awards
paras.zh: #### 高管股权奖励

paras.en: In January 2026, the Company granted 1,000 million performance-based restricted shares of Class B common stock to Elon Musk. The restricted shares vest upon (i) the Company’s achievement of specified market capitalization milestones across 15 equal tranches ranging from $500 billion to $7.5 trillion, with each milestone reflecting $500 billion in additional valuation, and (ii) the Company’s establishment of a permanent human colony on Mars with at least one million inhabitants, in each case, subject to Mr. Musk’s continued employment.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，公司向 Elon Musk 授予 1,000 百万股基于业绩的 B 类普通股限制性股票。该等限制性股票在以下条件满足时归属：(i) 公司实现指定的市值里程碑，分为 15 个等额批次，市值区间为 $500 billion 至 $7.5 trillion，每个里程碑对应 $500 billion 的额外估值；以及 (ii) 公司建立至少拥有一百万居民的永久火星人类殖民地；在每种情况下，均须以 Musk 先生持续任职为前提。

paras.en: In March 2026, the Company cancelled Mr. Musk’s xAI Award and replaced it with a grant of 302.1 million performance-based restricted shares of Class B common stock, which vest upon (i) the achievement of specified market capitalization milestones across 12 equal tranches ranging from $1.065 trillion to $6.565 trillion, with each milestone reflecting $500 billion in additional valuation, and (ii) the Company’s completion of non-Earth-based data centers capable of delivering 100 terawatts of compute per year, in each case, subject to Mr. Musk’s continued employment.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月，公司取消了 Musk 先生的 xAI 奖励，并以授予 302.1 百万股基于业绩的 B 类普通股限制性股票替代，该等限制性股票在以下条件满足时归属：(i) 公司实现指定的市值里程碑，分为 12 个等额批次，市值区间为 $1.065 trillion 至 $6.565 trillion，每个里程碑对应 $500 billion 的额外估值；以及 (ii) 公司完成能够每年交付 100 terawatts 算力的非地球数据中心；在每种情况下，均须以 Musk 先生持续任职为前提。

paras.en: In January 2026, the Company approved an amendment to 4 million performance-based stock options granted to Bret Johnsen, Chief Financial Officer, that were originally issued in 2024. In lieu of vesting based on free cash flow achievement in excess of a baseline, 371 thousand of the stock options will vest for each $10 billion in adjusted EBITDA achieved during the 2025 through 2029 fiscal years, assessed on an annual basis. For purposes of this award, adjusted EBITDA is calculated as income from operations excluding (i) depreciation and amortization, (ii) share-based compensation, (iii) impairment, and (iv) restructuring impacts. Once a tranche of the stock options have become earned as a result of the Company’s adjusted EBITDA performance as of the end of a particular fiscal year, such stock options remain subject to an additional one-year and one day service-based vesting requirement following December 31 of the fiscal year in which such tranche was earned. The number of options granted was not changed in the amendment. None of the stock options became earned on account of the Company’s adjusted EBITDA performance for the year ended December 31, 2025.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，公司批准对 2024 年原授予首席财务官 Bret Johnsen 的 4 百万份基于业绩的股票期权进行修订。替代以超过基线的自由现金流实现情况作为归属条件，在 2025 至 2029 财年期间，每实现 $10 billion 的调整后 EBITDA，将有 371 千份股票期权归属，按年度评估。就本奖励而言，调整后 EBITDA 计算为经营利润，不包括 (i) 折旧和摊销、(ii) 股份支付费用、(iii) 减值以及 (iv) 重组影响。一旦某一批次股票期权因公司截至某一特定财年末的调整后 EBITDA 业绩而获得，该等股票期权仍须在该批次获得所在财年的 12 月 31 日之后满足额外一年零一天的服务期归属要求。本次修订未改变授予的期权数量。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，公司调整后 EBITDA 业绩未使任何股票期权获得归属。

paras.en: #### Share Repurchases
paras.zh: #### 股份回购

paras.en: Between January and March 2026, the Company repurchased Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock and Common Stock from eligible current and former employees as well as third-party investors totaling $1,396 million.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月至 3 月期间，公司从符合条件的现任和前任员工以及第三方投资者处回购了可赎回可转换优先股和普通股，合计 $1,396 million。

paras.en: #### Sale-Leaseback Transaction
paras.zh: #### 售后回租交易

paras.en: In January 2026, and as further amended on February 18, 2026, CTC entered into an equipment lease agreement with Valor for certain AI infrastructure hardware (“Valor transaction II”). Similar to the Valor transaction, the Valor transaction II was considered to be a transaction with a related party. The Valor transaction II is deemed to be a failed sale-leaseback transaction and the Company recorded the related debt of $5,365 million in the Company’s consolidated balance sheets.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，并于 2026 年 2 月 18 日进一步修订，CTC 与 Valor 就若干 AI 基础设施硬件订立设备租赁协议（“Valor 交易 II”）。与 Valor 交易类似，Valor 交易 II 被视为关联方交易。Valor 交易 II 被视为失败的售后回租交易，公司在其合并资产负债表中记录了相关债务$5,365 million。

paras.en: #### xAI Merger Closing
paras.zh: #### xAI 合并交割

paras.en: Pursuant to the terms of the xAI Merger on February 2, 2026, the Company issued, prior to the 2026 Stock Split, 321.7 million shares of Class A Common Stock, 121.7 million shares of Class B Common Stock and paid $2,947 million in cash to holders of xAI Common Stock and Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock. Refer to Note 13, Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock and Shareholders’ Equity for additional details.
paras.zh: 根据 xAI 合并的条款，于 2026 年 2 月 2 日，公司在 2026 年股票拆分之前，向 xAI 普通股及可赎回可转换优先股持有人发行了 321.7 million 股 A 类普通股、121.7 million 股 B 类普通股，并支付了$2,947 million 现金。更多详情参见附注 13“可赎回可转换优先股与股东权益”。

paras.en: #### Tesla’s xAI Investment and SpaceX Class A Common Stock Issuance
paras.zh: #### Tesla 对 xAI 的投资及 SpaceX A 类普通股发行

paras.en: In January 2026, Tesla entered into an agreement with xAI to invest $2,000 million via a purchase of xAI Series E Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock. Pursuant to the terms of that agreement and a letter agreement entered into between xAI and Tesla on January 16, 2026, xAI’s issuance of the shares of Series E Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, and Tesla’s payment therefore, was conditioned upon the receipt of required regulatory approvals.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，Tesla 与 xAI 订立协议，通过购买 xAI E 系列可赎回可转换优先股投资$2,000 million。根据该协议以及 xAI 与 Tesla 于 2026 年 1 月 16 日订立的函件协议，xAI 发行 E 系列可赎回可转换优先股股份以及 Tesla 就此支付款项，均以取得所需监管批准为条件。

paras.en: Following the xAI Merger, Tesla’s right to acquire Series E Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock of xAI was converted into the right to acquire SpaceX Class A common stock. On March 12, 2026, following expiration of the applicable regulatory waiting period, SpaceX issued 3.8 million shares of Class A Common Stock (on a pre-2026 Stock Split basis) to Tesla in accordance with the terms of the foregoing agreements.
paras.zh: xAI 合并完成后，Tesla 收购 xAI E 系列可赎回可转换优先股的权利转换为收购 SpaceX A 类普通股的权利。2026 年 3 月 12 日，在适用监管等待期届满后，SpaceX 根据上述协议条款向 Tesla 发行了 3.8 million 股 A 类普通股（按 2026 年股票拆分前基准计算）。

paras.en: #### Tesla Collaboration
paras.zh: #### Tesla 合作

paras.en: In March 2026, the Company announced a collaboration with Tesla to build a chip manufacturing facility (referred to asTerafab).
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月，公司宣布与 Tesla 合作建设一座芯片制造工厂（称为 Terafab）。

paras.en: #### SpaceX Bridge Loan Credit Agreement
paras.zh: #### SpaceX 过桥贷款信贷协议

paras.en: In March 2026, SpaceX entered into a new bridge loan credit agreement (“SpaceX Bridge Loan”) for $20,000 million with a syndicate of banks. The SpaceX Bridge Loan matures on September 2, 2027 with two three-month extensions, at the option of the Company, reaching a final maturity date of March 2, 2028. The SpaceX Bridge Loan proceeds were used to extinguish and pay off the X B-1 Term Loan, X B-3 Term Loan, xAI Fixed Rate Loan, xAI Floating Rate Loan, and the xAI 12.5% Senior Secured Notes. The SpaceX Bridge Loan bears interest at a rate per annum of (i) between 0.75%-1.75%, dependent upon the debt rating of the Company, plus the relevant Term SOFR or (ii) the highest of (a) the Federal Funds Rate plus 0.5%, (b) the Prime Rate, (c) Term SOFR plus 1.0% and (d) 1.0%, plus an applicable margin ranging from 0.00% to 0.75% (depending on the Company’s debt rating). Obligations under the SpaceX Bridge Loan were guaranteed jointly and severally by certain subsidiaries of the Company. The SpaceX Bridge Loan is repayable at any time, in whole or in part, without premium or penalty. The Company is required to meet various covenants, including meeting certain reporting requirements, and certain financial covenants.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月，SpaceX 与银团签订了一项新的过桥贷款信贷协议（“SpaceX 过桥贷款”），金额为 $20,000 million。SpaceX 过桥贷款于 2027 年 9 月 2 日到期，经公司选择可两次各延长三个月，最终到期日为 2028 年 3 月 2 日。SpaceX 过桥贷款所得款项用于清偿并偿还 X B-1 定期贷款、X B-3 定期贷款、xAI 固定利率贷款、xAI 浮动利率贷款及 xAI 12.5% 优先担保票据。SpaceX 过桥贷款的年利率为 (i) 0.75%-1.75%（取决于公司的债务评级）加相关 Term SOFR，或 (ii) 以下三者中的最高者：(a) 联邦基金利率加 0.5%，(b) 最优惠利率，(c) Term SOFR 加 1.0%，以及 (d) 1.0%，再加 0.00% 至 0.75% 的适用利差（取决于公司的债务评级）。SpaceX 过桥贷款项下的义务由公司若干子公司提供连带责任保证。SpaceX 过桥贷款可随时全部或部分偿还，无需支付溢价或罚金。公司须遵守各项契约，包括满足若干报告要求及若干财务契约。

paras.en: Concurrently with the SpaceX Bridge Loan, the Company repaid the outstanding principal and accrued interests of the X B-1 Term Loan, X B-3 Term Loan, xAI Fixed Rate Term Loan, xAI Floating Rate Term Loan and xAI 12.5% Secured Senior Notes for an aggregate amount of $18,905 million, including $1,163 million of prepayment penalty.
paras.zh: 在签订 SpaceX 过桥贷款的同时，公司偿还了 X B-1 定期贷款、X B-3 定期贷款、xAI 固定利率定期贷款、xAI 浮动利率定期贷款及 xAI 12.5% 担保优先票据的未偿本金及应计利息，合计金额为 $18,905 million，其中包括 $1,163 million 的提前还款罚金。

paras.en: #### Purchase Commitments
paras.zh: #### 采购承诺

paras.en: In March 2026, the Company executed a purchase agreement with an unaffiliated third party to acquire additional turbines for the AI infrastructure totaling $805 million through 2029.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月，公司与一家无关联第三方签署了一项采购协议，以在 2029 年前采购更多涡轮机用于 AI 基础设施，总金额为 $805 million。

paras.en: #### Collaboration Agreement
paras.zh: #### 合作协议

paras.en: On April 19, 2026, the Company entered into a compute agreement with Anysphere, Inc., doing business as Cursor, a San Francisco-based private software company (“Cursor”). Pursuant to the compute agreement, the Company will collaborate with Cursor to improve the Company’s existing models, including Grok, and potentially to jointly develop AI models and related model-specific deliverables.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 19 日，公司与 Anysphere, Inc.（以 Cursor 名义经营，一家总部位于旧金山的私营软件公司，简称“Cursor”）签订了一份算力协议。根据该算力协议，公司将与 Cursor 合作改进公司现有模型（包括 Grok），并可能共同开发 AI 模型及相关模型专属交付成果。

paras.en: Concurrent with the compute agreement, the Company also entered into an option agreement for the right, but not the obligation, to acquire Cursor. The option agreement generally provides that the Company may exercise the call option at any time during the 30-day period following the earlier of (i) seven trading days following the completion of the Company’s IPO and (ii) September 30, 2026. Exercise of the call option is in the Company’s sole discretion and subject to further approval by the board of directors. Cursor is also subject to certain exclusivity obligations under the option agreement. The consideration for the acquisition of Cursor would consist of shares of Class A common stock based on an implied equity value of Cursor of $60.0 billion, and the price of Class A common stock that equals, if the acquisition closed prior to the completion of this offering, the most recent quarterly valuation, or, if the acquisition closed after the completion of the Company’s IPO, the volume-weighted average closing price thereof over the seven consecutive trading days immediately preceding the closing of the acquisition. If either (i) the Company decides to terminate the option agreement or (ii) Cursor is eligible to and decides to terminate due to the Company’s material breach of the option agreement, Cursor is entitled to a $1.5 billion termination fee under the option agreement and an $8.5 billion deferred services fee under the compute agreement. These fees are payable in cash (or Class A common stock, if the Company’s IPO has not been consummated at the time the fees become payable).
paras.zh: 在签订算力协议的同时，公司还签订了一份期权协议，获得收购 Cursor 的权利（但非义务）。该期权协议一般规定，公司可在以下两者中较早者之后的 30 天期间内随时行使该看涨期权：(i) 公司 IPO 完成后的第七个交易日，及 (ii) 2026 年 9 月 30 日。行使该看涨期权由公司自行决定，并须经董事会进一步批准。Cursor 亦须遵守期权协议项下的若干排他性义务。收购 Cursor 的对价将包括 A 类普通股股份，基于 Cursor 的隐含股权价值 $60.0 billion 计算，A 类普通股的价格等于：若收购在本发行完成前交割，则为最近一次季度估值；若收购在公司 IPO 完成后交割，则为紧接收购交割前连续七个交易日的成交量加权平均收盘价。若 (i) 公司决定终止期权协议，或 (ii) Cursor 因公司重大违反期权协议而有资格并决定终止，则 Cursor 有权根据期权协议获得 $1.5 billion 的终止费，并根据算力协议获得 $8.5 billion 的递延服务费。该等费用应以现金支付（若费用到期应付时公司 IPO 尚未完成，则以 A 类普通股支付）。

paras.en: The Company has conducted preliminary due diligence on Cursor’s business, technology and operations, and expect to continue such diligence in connection with any decision to exercise the call option. The Company cannot predict whether the Company will elect to exercise the call option or, if exercised, whether the acquisition will close on the anticipated terms or at all.
paras.zh: 公司已对 Cursor 的业务、技术和运营进行了初步尽职调查，并预计在就任何行使看涨期权的决定进行相关工作时继续开展该等尽职调查。公司无法预测公司是否会选择行使该看涨期权，或若行使，收购是否会按预期条款完成或根本无法完成。

paras.en: #### Sale-Leaseback Transaction
paras.zh: #### 售后回租交易

paras.en: On April 24, 2026, CTC entered into a five-year equipment lease agreement with Valor, a related party, for certain AI infrastructure hardware (“Valor transaction III”) for total undiscounted lease payments of $6,587 million.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 24 日，CTC 与关联方 Valor 就若干 AI 基础设施硬件签订了一份为期五年的设备租赁协议（“Valor 交易 III”），未折现租赁付款总额为 $6,587 million。

paras.en: #### Asset Acquisition
paras.zh: #### 资产收购

paras.en: On April 30, 2026, the Company entered into an asset purchase agreement with an unaffiliated third party to purchase certain mobile gas turbines and related packages for approximately $2,000 million (the “Turbine Acquisition”). The closing of the Turbine Acquisition is expected to occur in May 2026 and is subject to customary closing conditions. The seller has also agreed to enter into a post-closing services agreement to support the Company's turbine operations. The Turbine Acquisition will help provide power to the Company's data centers.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 30 日，本公司与一家无关联第三方订立资产购买协议，以约$2,000 million 购买若干移动式燃气轮机及相关配套设备（“燃气轮机收购”）。燃气轮机收购预计于 2026 年 5 月完成交割，并须满足惯常交割条件。卖方亦已同意订立交割后服务协议，以支持本公司的燃气轮机运营。燃气轮机收购将有助于为本公司的数据中心提供电力。

paras.en: #### Cloud Services Agreement
paras.zh: #### 云服务协议

paras.en: On May 3, 2026, the Company entered into a cloud services agreement with Anthropic PBC, an AI research and development public benefit corporation, with respect to access to compute capacity. Pursuant to this agreement, the customer has agreed to pay a monthly fee through May 2029, with capacity ramping in May 2026 at a reduced fee. The agreement may be terminated by either party upon 90 days’ notice. The customer will retain ownership and intellectual property rights in its content, AI models, and related data.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月 3 日，本公司与 Anthropic PBC（一家 AI 研发公益公司）就获取算力容量订立云服务协议。根据该协议，客户已同意在 2029 年 5 月前按月支付费用，其中 2026 年 5 月产能爬坡期间按较低费率收费。任何一方均可在提前 90 天通知后终止该协议。客户将保留其内容、AI 模型及相关数据的所有权和知识产权。

paras.en: #### Description of Business
paras.zh: #### 业务描述

paras.en: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. and its wholly owned subsidiaries, collectively referred to as the “Company” or “SpaceX,” operate three segments – (i) the Space segment designs, manufactures, and launches reusable rockets to provide high cadence, reliable, and affordable access to space at unprecedented scale, (ii) the Connectivity segment operates a worldwide high-speed, low-latency broadband network powered by thousand s of Starlink satellites in Low-Earth Orbit, delivering connectivity to million s of consumer, enterprise, and government customers through our Starlink offering, and (iii) the AI segment operates a vertically integrated AI platform spanning a frontier LLM Grok, AI solutions for consumer and enterprise customers, X — a real-time information, entertainment, and free speech platform — and AI computational infrastructure.
paras.zh: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. 及其全资子公司（统称“公司”或“SpaceX”）经营三个业务板块——(i) 太空板块设计、制造并发射可重复使用火箭，以前所未有的规模提供高频次、可靠且可负担的太空进入能力；(ii) 连接板块运营一个由数千颗低地球轨道 Starlink 卫星支持的全球高速、低延迟宽带网络，通过我们的 Starlink 产品为数百万消费者、企业和政府客户提供连接服务；(iii) AI 板块运营一个垂直整合的 AI 平台，涵盖前沿大语言模型 Grok、面向消费者和企业客户的 AI 解决方案、X——一个实时信息、娱乐和言论自由平台——以及 AI 算力基础设施。

paras.en: On February 2, 2026 (“xAI Merger Date”), the Company completed its acquisition of X.AI Holdings Corp. (“xAI”), pursuant to which xAI became a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (“xAI Merger”). Prior to the xAI Merger, on March 28, 2025, xAI completed its acquisition of X Holdings Corp. (“X”) and X.AI Corp., in which X and X.AI Corp. became wholly-owned subsidiaries of xAI (“X Merger”, and collectively with xAI Merger, “Mergers”). X.AI Corp began operations in March 2023 and Twitter, Inc. (“Twitter”) was acquired by Mr. Elon Musk in October 2022. The Mergers were each effected through a share exchange.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月 2 日（“xAI 合并日”），公司完成了对 X.AI Holdings Corp.（“xAI”）的收购，据此 xAI 成为公司的全资子公司（“xAI 合并”）。在 xAI 合并之前，xAI 于 2025 年 3 月 28 日完成了对 X Holdings Corp.（“X”）和 X.AI Corp. 的收购，其中 X 和 X.AI Corp. 成为 xAI 的全资子公司（“X 合并”，与 xAI 合并合称“合并”）。X.AI Corp 于 2023 年 3 月开始运营，Twitter, Inc.（“Twitter”）于 2022 年 10 月被 Elon Musk 先生收购。各项合并均通过换股方式实施。

paras.en: The Mergers have been accounted for as reorganizations of entities under common control as Mr. Elon Musk had a controlling financial interest in the Company, xAI and X through his majority voting interest in each such entity during the periods presented in these consolidated financial statements. The Company’s consolidated financial statements have been prepared to reflect the retrospective combination of the net assets of the entities at their historical carrying amounts for all periods presented. No new goodwill or other intangible assets have been recorded and all historical related party transactions between the entities have been eliminated in consolidation. The capital stock and shareholders’ equity for all periods presented reflects a continuation of the historical SpaceX capital stock and shareholders’ equity, combined with the historical capital stock and shareholders’ equity of X and xAI merged under common control, as adjusted by the respective exchange ratios used to effect the Mergers, except for xAI’s historical redeemable convertible preferred stock through the date of the xAI Merger. All of xAI’s redeemable convertible preferred stock were converted to SpaceX common stock as part of the xAI Merger and are presented as such from the date of the xAI Merger. This presentation constitutes a change in reporting entity. Refer to Note 12 - Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock and Shareholders’ Equity for additional details.
paras.zh: 上述合并已作为同一控制下实体的重组进行会计处理，因为在本合并财务报表所列示期间内，Elon Musk 先生通过其在公司、xAI 和 X 各实体中的多数投票权益，对上述各实体均拥有控制性财务权益。公司的合并财务报表已按所有列示期间各实体净资产的歷史账面价值进行追溯合并编制。未确认新的商誉或其他无形资产，各实体之间所有历史关联方交易已在合并中抵销。所有列示期间的股本和股东权益反映为 SpaceX 历史股本和股东权益的延续，并与同一控制下合并的 X 和 xAI 的历史股本和股东权益合并，并按实施合并所采用的相应换股比例进行调整，但 xAI 在 xAI 合并日之前的历史可赎回可转换优先股除外。作为 xAI 合并的一部分，xAI 的全部可赎回可转换优先股已转换为 SpaceX 普通股，并自 xAI 合并日起按此列示。本列报构成报告主体的变更。更多详情请参见附注 12——可赎回可转换优先股和股东权益。

paras.en: On May 4, 2026, the Company effected a five-for-one forward stock split of its authorized, issued, and outstanding shares of Class A, Class B, and Class C Common Stock (“2026 Stock Split”). The conversion rate of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock was proportionately adjusted to factor in the 2026 Stock Split. All share and per share information has been retroactively adjusted to reflect the 2026 Stock Split for all periods presented.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月 4 日，公司对其已授权、已发行及流通在外的 A 类、B 类和 C 类普通股实施了五拆一的前向股票拆分（“2026 年股票拆分”）。SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股的转换比例已按比例调整，以反映 2026 年股票拆分的影响。所有股份及每股信息均已追溯调整，以反映 2026 年股票拆分对所列示各期间的影响。

paras.en: #### Use of Estimates
paras.zh: #### 估计的使用

paras.en: The preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with U.S. GAAP requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the reported amounts of assets and liabilities, the disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the consolidated financial statements, and the reported amounts of revenue and expenses during the reporting period. Actual results could differ from those estimates. Amounts which are subject to significant judgment and use of estimates include revenues recognized over time using the cost-to-cost input method, the determination of valuation allowances associated with deferred tax assets and estimates of tax liabilities, reserves for excess and obsolete inventory, fair value of indefinite-lived intangible assets and goodwill, useful lives of property, plant, and equipment, the determination of incremental borrowing rate for lease liabilities, litigation and settlement costs, and the valuation and assumptions underlying share-based compensation. On an ongoing basis, the Company evaluates its estimates compared to historical experience and current trends, which forms the basis for making judgments about the carrying value of assets and liabilities. In addition, the Company engages valuation specialists to assist in the valuation of equity instruments.
paras.zh: 按照美国 GAAP 编制合并财务报表要求管理层作出估计和假设，该等估计和假设影响合并财务报表日资产和负债的 reported 金额、或有资产和负债的披露，以及报告期内收入和费用的 reported 金额。实际结果可能与这些估计存在差异。需要作出重大判断和使用估计的金额包括：采用成本法（cost-to-cost）投入法随时间确认的收入、与递延所得税资产相关的估值备抵的确定及税务负债的估计、超额和过时存货的储备、使用寿命不确定的无形资产和商誉的公允价值、物业、厂房和设备的可使用年限、租赁负债增量借款利率的确定、诉讼和和解费用，以及股权激励的估值和相关假设。公司持续将估计与历史经验和当前趋势进行比较，以此作为判断资产和负债账面价值的基础。此外，公司聘请估值专家协助对权益工具进行估值。

paras.en: #### Recent Accounting Pronouncements
paras.zh: #### 近期会计公告

paras.en: In December 2025, the FASB issued ASU No. 2025-11, Interim Reporting (Topic 270): Narrow-Scope Improvements. The ASU improves the guidance in Topic 270 by improving the navigability of the required interim disclosures and clarifying when that guidance is applicable. The amendments also provide additional guidance on what disclosures should be provided in interim reporting periods. The amendments add to Topic 270 a principle that requires entities to disclose events since the end of the last annual reporting period that have a material impact on the entity. The ASU is effective for interim reporting periods within annual reporting periods beginning after December 15, 2027. Adoption of this ASU can either be applied prospectively or retrospectively to any or all prior periods presented in the financial statements, and early adoption is permitted. The Company is currently evaluating the provisions of this ASU and does not expect this ASU to have a material impact on the consolidated financial statements.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月，FASB 发布了 ASU No. 2025-11《中期报告（主题 270）：窄范围改进》。该 ASU 通过改进所要求的中期披露的可导航性并澄清该指引的适用情形，完善了主题 270 中的指引。该修订还就中期报告期间应提供的披露内容提供了补充指引。该修订在主题 270 中新增了一项原则，要求主体披露自上一会计年度报告期末以来对主体具有重大影响的事项。该 ASU 对自 2027 年 12 月 15 日之后开始的会计年度报告期内的中期报告期生效。采用该 ASU 时，可选择前瞻性适用，或追溯适用于财务报表中所列示的任何或全部前期，并允许提前采用。公司目前正在评估该 ASU 的规定，并预计该 ASU 不会对合并财务报表产生重大影响。

paras.en: Recently adopted accounting pronouncements
paras.zh: 近期已采用的会计公告

paras.en: In July 2025, the FASB issued ASU No. 2025-05, Financial Instruments—Credit Losses (Topic 326): Measurement of Credit Losses for Accounts Receivable and Contract Assets. The amendments in this update provide a practical expedient permitting an entity to assume that conditions at the balance sheet date remain unchanged over the life of the asset when estimating expected credit losses for current classified accounts receivable and contract assets. The Company adopted this ASU on a prospective basis effective January 1, 2026. While this ASU was adopted, the Company did not elect the practical expedient permitted under this ASU. Therefore, the adoption has no impact on the consolidated financial statements.
paras.zh: 2025 年 7 月，FASB 发布了 ASU No. 2025-05《金融工具——信用损失（主题 326）：应收账款和合同资产的信用损失计量》。本次更新中的修订提供了一项实务便捷方法，允许主体在估计当前分类的应收账款和合同资产的预期信用损失时，假设资产负债表日的状况在资产存续期内保持不变。公司自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起以前瞻性基础采用该 ASU。尽管采用了该 ASU，公司并未选择该 ASU 所允许的实务便捷方法。因此，该采用对合并财务报表没有影响。

paras.en: #### Backlog
paras.zh: #### 订单储备

paras.en: The Company’s backlog represents the transaction price of performance obligations to customers for which work remains to be performed. The amount of backlog increases with new contracts or additions to existing contracts and decreases as revenue is recognized on existing contracts. Contracts are included in backlog when an enforceable agreement has been reached. Backlog does not include amounts related to performance obligations that are billed and recognized as they are delivered, optional purchases that do not represent material rights and any estimated amounts of variable consideration that are subject to constraint. Backlog totaled $27,621 million as of March 31, 2026, of which $13,236 million was recognized as deferred revenue at March 31, 2026. Approximately 36% is expected to be recognized within one year, and approximately 46% is expected to be recognized between one and three years, with the remaining 18% to be recognized thereafter.
paras.zh: 公司的积压订单代表尚待履行的客户履约义务的交易价格。积压订单金额随新合同或现有合同的增加而增加，并随现有合同收入的确认而减少。当达成可强制执行的协议时，合同即计入积压订单。积压订单不包括在交付时即开票并确认的履约义务相关金额、不构成重大权利的可选购买，以及受限制的任何可变对价估计金额。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，积压订单总额为 $27,621 million，其中 $13,236 million 于 2026 年 3 月 31 日确认为递延收入。预计约 36% 将在一年内确认，约 46% 将在一年至三年内确认，其余 18% 将在此后确认。

paras.en: #### SpaceX Bridge Loan
paras.zh: #### SpaceX 过桥贷款

paras.en: General. In March 2026, SpaceX entered into a new bridge loan credit agreement (the “SpaceX Bridge Loan”) with a syndicate of lenders, providing for an unsecured bridge term loan facility in an aggregate principal amount of $20,000 million. The SpaceX Bridge Loan matures on September 2, 2027, with two three-month extensions at the Company’s option, subject to the absence of a continuing default and the payment of an extension fee of 0.25% of the aggregate outstanding principal per extension, resulting in a final extended maturity date in March 2028.
paras.zh: 一般事项。2026 年 3 月，SpaceX 与一个贷款银团订立了一项新的过桥贷款信贷协议（“SpaceX 过桥贷款”），提供本金总额为 $20,000 million 的无担保过桥定期贷款融资。SpaceX 过桥贷款于 2027 年 9 月 2 日到期，公司可选择两次各三个月的展期，前提是不存在持续违约，且每次展期须支付相当于未偿本金总额 0.25%的展期费，最终展期到期日为 2028 年 3 月。

paras.en: Proceeds. The proceeds of the SpaceX Bridge Loan were used to repay the X B-1 Term Loan, the X B-3 Term Loan, the xAI Fixed Rate Loan, the xAI Floating Rate Loan, and the xAI 12.5% Senior Secured Notes (as defined and described below). The remaining proceeds were used for general corporate purposes.
paras.zh: 所得款项用途。SpaceX 过桥贷款的所得款项用于偿还 X B-1 定期贷款、X B-3 定期贷款、xAI 固定利率贷款、xAI 浮动利率贷款及 xAI 12.5% 优先担保票据（定义及说明见下文）。剩余所得款项用于一般公司用途。

paras.en: Interest Rates. The SpaceX Bridge Loan bears interest, at the Company’s election, at a rate per annum equal to (i) Term SOFR plus an applicable margin ranging from 0.75%-1.75% (depending on the Company’s debt rating), or (ii) a base rate equal to the highest of (a) the Federal Funds Rate plus 0.5%, (b) the Prime Rate, (c) Term SOFR plus 1.00% and (d) 1.00%, plus an applicable margin ranging from 0.00% to 0.75% (depending on the Company’s debt rating). In addition, the Company is obligated to pay duration fees equal to 0.125% of outstanding principal on the first anniversary of closing and 0.25% of outstanding principal on the fifteen-month anniversary of closing. The effective interest rate on outstanding borrowings under the SpaceX Bridge Loan was 4.58% as of March 31, 2026.
paras.zh: 利率。SpaceX 过桥贷款按公司选择，按年利率计息，利率等于(i) Term SOFR 加上 0.75%-1.75%的适用利差（取决于公司的债务评级），或(ii) 基准利率，即以下各项中的最高者：(a) 联邦基金利率加 0.5%,(b) 最优惠利率，(c) Term SOFR 加 1.00%及(d) 1.00%，加上 0.00%至 0.75%的适用利差（取决于公司的债务评级）。此外，公司有义务支付期限费，金额为交割一周年时未偿本金的 0.125%及交割十五个月周年时未偿本金的 0.25%。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，SpaceX 过桥贷款项下未偿借款的实际利率为 4.58%。

paras.en: Principal Repayments. The SpaceX Bridge Loan may be prepaid at any time, in whole or in part, without premium or penalty. The Company is required to use the net proceeds of certain debt financings to repay amounts outstanding under the SpaceX Bridge Loan and to apply the net proceeds of a qualified initial public offering (“IPO”) to repay such amounts within six months following receipt.
paras.zh: 本金偿还。SpaceX 过桥贷款可随时全部或部分提前偿还，无需支付溢价或罚金。公司须将某些债务融资的净所得款项用于偿还 SpaceX 过桥贷款项下的未偿金额，并须在收到合格首次公开发行（“IPO”）净所得款项后六个月内将该等款项用于偿还上述金额。

paras.en: Guarantors and Collateral. The obligations of the Company under the SpaceX Bridge Loan are guaranteed on a joint and several basis by X Corp., X.AI LLC, and CTC Property LLC (each a subsidiary of the Company).
paras.zh: 担保人与抵押品。公司于 SpaceX 过桥贷款项下的义务由 X Corp.、X.AI LLC 及 CTC Property LLC（均为公司的子公司）以连带责任方式提供担保。

paras.en: Covenants. The SpaceX Bridge Loan contains customary events of default and affirmative and negative covenants, including restrictions on liens, subsidiary indebtedness, fundamental changes (including a prohibition on the disposition of Starlink assets and other material businesses outside the consolidated group), and changes in the nature of the Company’s business. The sole financial maintenance covenant requires the Company to maintain a Consolidated Leverage Ratio — defined as consolidated funded indebtedness (net of 85% of unrestricted cash) to Consolidated EBITDA (as defined in the SpaceX Bridge Loan) — of no greater than 3.75 to 1.0 as of the end of each fiscal quarter, with a temporary step-up to 4.25 to 1.0 for four fiscal quarters following a qualifying acquisition of at least $1.0 billion. The Company was in compliance with the covenants as of March 31, 2026.
paras.zh: 承诺事项。SpaceX 过桥贷款包含惯常的违约事件及肯定性和否定性承诺，包括对留置权、子公司债务、根本性变更（包括禁止在合并集团之外处置 Starlink 资产及其他重要业务）以及公司业务性质变更的限制。唯一的财务维持承诺要求公司维持合并杠杆率——定义为合并融资债务（扣除 85%的非受限现金）与合并 EBITDA（SpaceX 过桥贷款中定义）之比——在每个财政季度末不高于 3.75 比 1.0，在完成至少 $1.0 billion 的合格收购后四个财政季度内临时上调至 4.25 比 1.0。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，公司遵守了上述承诺。

paras.en: Accounting Treatment. The Company accounted for the repayment of the X B-1 Term Loan, the X B-3 Term Loan, the xAI Fixed Rate Loan, the xAI Floating Rate Loan and the xAI 12.5% Senior Secured Notes as an extinguishment of debt, resulting in a loss on extinguishment of $1,526 million, recorded in Other expense, net.
paras.zh: 会计处理。公司将 X B-1 定期贷款、X B-3 定期贷款、xAI 固定利率贷款、xAI 浮动利率贷款及 xAI 12.5% 优先担保票据的偿还作为债务清偿进行会计处理，由此产生 1,526 百万美元的清偿损失，计入其他费用净额。

paras.en: #### SpaceX Credit Facility
paras.zh: #### SpaceX 信贷融资

paras.en: General. In February 2025, the Company entered into a five-year senior unsecured revolving credit agreement (“SpaceX Credit Facility”) with a syndicate of banks, under which the Company may draw up to $1,500 million, subject to a customary financial covenant and other reporting requirements. The SpaceX Credit Facility terminates, and all outstanding loans become due and payable, on February 7, 2030, unless the parties agree to an extension. No amounts were borrowed under the SpaceX Credit Facility during the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025.
paras.zh: 概述。2025 年 2 月，公司与银团签订了为期五年的高级无担保循环信贷协议（“SpaceX 信贷融资”），根据该协议，公司可提取最高 1,500 百万美元，但须遵守惯常的财务契约及其他报告要求。除非各方同意延期，SpaceX 信贷融资将于 2030 年 2 月 7 日终止，届时所有未偿还贷款到期应付。在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，公司未在 SpaceX 信贷融资项下提取任何款项。

paras.en: Amendment. In March 2026, the Company entered into a First Amendment to Credit Agreement and Waiver (the “First Amendment”) with its lenders, in connection with the Company’s entry into the SpaceX Bridge Loan (as defined above). The First Amendment, among other things, (i) waived certain specified defaults and (ii) amended certain definitions and covenants under the SpaceX Credit Facility to conform to the terms of the SpaceX Bridge Loan.
paras.zh: 修订。2026 年 3 月，就公司签订 SpaceX 过桥贷款（定义见上文）事宜，公司与贷款方签订了《信贷协议第一修订及豁免》（“第一修订”）。第一修订除其他事项外，(i) 豁免了某些特定违约，且 (ii) 修订了 SpaceX 信贷融资项下的某些定义和契约，以与 SpaceX 过桥贷款的条款保持一致。

paras.en: Interest Rates. Under the SpaceX Credit Facility, borrowings bear interest at the Company’s option, at a rate per annum of (i) between 0.75%-1.25%, depending on the Company’s current debt rating, plus the relevant Term SOFR or (ii) between 0.0%-0.25% depending on the Company’s current debt rating plus the greater of (a) the Federal Funds Rate plus 0.5%, (b) the Prime Rate, (c) Term SOFR plus 1.0% and (d) 1.0%. The Company may also borrow in various alternative currencies at various alternative rates, including rates based on SONIA for Pound Sterling loans and EURIBOR for Euro loans plus an applicable margin. The fee for undrawn amounts is between 0.07%-0.11% per annum, depending on the Company’s current debt rating. Interest is payable either monthly or quarterly, depending on the interest loan option.
paras.zh: 利率。根据 SpaceX 信贷融资，借款按公司选择，按年利率计息：(i) 根据公司当前债务评级，为 0.75%-1.25% 加上相关期限 SOFR，或 (ii) 根据公司当前债务评级，为 0.0%-0.25% 加上以下较高者：(a) 联邦基金利率加 0.5%，(b) 最优惠利率，(c) 期限 SOFR 加 1.0%，及 (d) 1.0%。公司还可按各种替代利率以各种替代货币借款，包括英镑贷款基于 SONIA 的利率和欧元贷款基于 EURIBOR 的利率加上适用利差。未提取款项的费用为每年 0.07%-0.11%，具体取决于公司当前债务评级。利息按月或按季支付，取决于利息贷款选择。

paras.en: Covenants. The Company was in compliance with the covenants as of March 31, 2026; however, the Company had a technical default when the Company acquired xAI on February 2, 2026 due to the amount of debt assumed as part of the acquisition at the subsidiary level. On March 2, 2026, the Company obtained a waiver from the syndicate of banks and amended the SpaceX Credit Facility allowing for the debt refinance completed on March 2, 2026, resulting in the Company being in compliance with all covenants.
paras.zh: 契约。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，公司遵守了各项契约；然而，公司于 2026 年 2 月 2 日收购 xAI 时，因作为收购一部分在子公司层面承担的债务金额而出现技术性违约。2026 年 3 月 2 日，公司获得银团的豁免，并修订了 SpaceX 信贷融资，允许于 2026 年 3 月 2 日完成债务再融资，从而使公司遵守所有契约。

paras.en: #### X 2027 and 2030 Notes

General. In 2019, a subsidiary of X, an indirect subsidiary of the Company, issued $700 million aggregate principal amount of 3.875% senior notes due 2027 (the “X 2027 Notes”) in a private placement. The X 2027 Notes mature on December 15, 2027. In 2022, a subsidiary of X issued $1,000 million aggregate principal amount of 5.000% senior notes due 2030 (the “X 2030 Notes”) in a private placement. The X 2030 Notes mature on March 1, 2030. The X 2027 and X 2030 Notes represent senior unsecured obligations of the Company.
paras.zh: 一般事项。2019 年，本公司间接子公司 X 的子公司以非公开发行方式发行了本金总额 700 百万美元、票面利率 3.875%、于 2027 年到期的优先票据（以下简称“X 2027 票据”）。X 2027 票据于 2027 年 12 月 15 日到期。2022 年，X 的子公司以非公开发行方式发行了本金总额 1,000 百万美元、票面利率 5.000%、于 2030 年到期的优先票据（以下简称“X 2030 票据”）。X 2030 票据于 2030 年 3 月 1 日到期。X 2027 票据和 X 2030 票据构成本公司的优先无担保债务。

paras.en: Interest Rates. For the X 2027 Notes, the interest rate is fixed at 3.875% per annum and interest is payable semi-annually in arrears on June 15 and December 15 of each year. For the X 2030 Notes, the interest rate is fixed at 5.000% per annum and interest is payable semi-annually in arrears on March 1 and September 1 of each year.
paras.zh: 利率。X 2027 票据的利率固定为每年 3.875%，利息于每年 6 月 15 日和 12 月 15 日每半年期末支付。X 2030 票据的利率固定为每年 5.000%，利息于每年 3 月 1 日和 9 月 1 日每半年期末支付。

paras.en: Principal Repayments. In November 2022, the Company purchased approximately $675 million aggregate principal amount of X 2027 Notes and $998 million aggregate principal amount of the X 2030 Notes in settlement of the change in control of Twitter. The X 2027 Notes and X 2030 Notes that remain outstanding may be redeemed at the option of the Company, in whole or in part, at any time prior to September 15, 2027 and December 1, 2029, respectively, at a price equal to 100.0% of the principal amounts plus a “make-whole” premium and accrued and unpaid interest, if any, up to, but excluding, the redemption date.
paras.zh: 本金偿还。2022 年 11 月，本公司就 Twitter 控制权变更的结算，购买了本金总额约 675 百万美元的 X 2027 票据和本金总额 998 百万美元的 X 2030 票据。剩余未偿还的 X 2027 票据和 X 2030 票据可由本公司选择，分别于 2027 年 9 月 15 日和 2029 年 12 月 1 日之前的任何时间全部或部分赎回，赎回价格等于本金的 100.0% 加上“全额补偿”溢价以及截至（但不包括）赎回日已计提但未支付的利息（如有）。

paras.en: Covenants. The Company was in compliance with the covenants as of March 31, 2026.
paras.zh: 契约条款。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，本公司遵守了各项契约条款。

paras.en: #### X First Lien Senior Credit Facilities
paras.zh: #### X 第一留置权优先担保信贷融资

paras.en: General. In 2022, X Corp., an indirect subsidiary of the Company, entered into the First Lien Credit Agreement which provided for a new term loan commitment of $6,705 million (“X B-1 Term Loan”) and a $500 million Secured First Lien Revolving Credit Facility (including a letter of credit subfacility with an aggregate face value of up to $100 million) (together referred to as “X First Lien Senior Credit Facilities”). The Secured First Lien Revolving Credit Facility matures on October 27, 2027 and the X B-1 Term Loan matures on October 27, 2029.
paras.zh: 一般事项。2022 年，本公司的间接子公司 X Corp. 签订了《第一留置权信贷协议》，该协议提供了 6,705 百万美元的新定期贷款承诺（“X B-1 定期贷款”）和 500 百万美元的担保第一留置权循环信贷融资（包括面值总额最高为 100 百万美元的信用证子融资）（合称“X 第一留置权优先担保信贷融资”）。担保第一留置权循环信贷融资于 2027 年 10 月 27 日到期，X B-1 定期贷款于 2029 年 10 月 27 日到期。

paras.en: Amendments. In February 2025, X Corp., an indirect subsidiary of the Company, amended the X First Lien Senior Credit Facilities and entered into a new term loan commitment for $4,741 million with a maturity date of October 27, 2029 (“X B-3 Term Loan”) and reduced the Secured First Lien Revolving Credit Facility commitment to $0. As part of the issuance of the X B-3 Term Loan, the Company is required to pay an arrangement fee of $51 million, which is due and payable on February 19, 2027. In April 2025, the Company entered into an amendment to the X B-3 Term Loan for an additional commitment of $1,225 million with the same terms and conditions, increasing the total X B-3 Term Loan borrowings to $5,966 million.
paras.zh: 修订。2025 年 2 月，本公司的间接子公司 X Corp. 修订了 X 第一留置权优先担保信贷融资，并签订了 4,741 百万美元的新定期贷款承诺，到期日为 2029 年 10 月 27 日（“X B-3 定期贷款”），并将担保第一留置权循环信贷融资承诺减少至 0。作为 X B-3 定期贷款发行的一部分，本公司须支付 51 百万美元的安排费，该费用应于 2027 年 2 月 19 日到期支付。2025 年 4 月，本公司就 X B-3 定期贷款签订修订协议，按相同条款和条件增加 1,225 百万美元的承诺，使 X B-3 定期贷款借款总额增至 5,966 百万美元。

paras.en: Interest Rates. The X B-1 Term Loan bore interest at a rate per annum of, initially, adjusted Term SOFR plus 6.50%. The Secured First Lien Revolving Credit Facility bore interest at a rate per annum of, initially, an adjusted Term SOFR plus 4.50%, with leverage-based step-downs. Undrawn commitments under the Secured First Lien Revolving Credit Facility were subject to an unused commitment fee of 0.50% per annum, subject to quarterly leverage based step-downs. The X B-3 Term Loan had a fixed interest rate of 9.50% per annum. Interest on the X B-1 Term Loan and X B-3 Term Loan was payable monthly, quarterly, or bi-annually at the option of the Company.
paras.zh: 利率。X B-1 定期贷款的年利率最初为调整后 Term SOFR 加 6.50%。有担保第一留置权循环信贷额度的年利率最初为调整后 Term SOFR 加 4.50%，并根据杠杆率分档下调。有担保第一留置权循环信贷额度项下的未提取承诺须支付每年 0.50% 的未使用承诺费，并根据杠杆率按季度分档下调。X B-3 定期贷款的年利率为固定利率 9.50%。X B-1 定期贷款和 X B-3 定期贷款的利息由公司选择按月、按季度或每半年支付。

paras.en: Principal Repayments. On March 2, 2026, the Company repaid the full outstanding principal balance and accrued interest, including a prepayment penalty of $425 million, resulting in the extinguishment of the X B-1 Term Loan and X B-3 Term Loan. The X B-1 Term Loan was repayable at any time, in whole or in part, without premium or penalty, subject to mandatory quarterly prepayments of principal beginning on the last day of the fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2023, in amounts equal to 0.25% of the original principal amount of borrowings thereunder, with the unpaid balance being payable on the final maturity date thereof. The X B-1 Term Loan was also subject to additional customary mandatory prepayment provisions from the proceeds of certain debt issuances and asset sales, as well as sweeps of a portion of excess cash flow, subject to certain leverage-based step-downs and exceptions. The X B-3 Term Loan had prepayment penalties of 107.13% of the outstanding principal before October 27, 2026, 104.75% of the outstanding principal before October 27, 2027, and 102.38% of the outstanding principal before October 27, 2028.
paras.zh: 本金偿还。2026 年 3 月 2 日，公司偿还了全部未偿本金余额及应计利息，其中包括 425 百万美元的提前还款罚金，从而导致 X B-1 定期贷款和 X B-3 定期贷款被清偿。X B-1 定期贷款可随时全部或部分偿还，无需支付溢价或罚金，但须自截至 2023 年 3 月 31 日的财政季度最后一日开始，按季度强制偿还本金，金额相当于其项下借款原始本金金额的 0.25%，未偿余额于其最终到期日支付。X B-1 定期贷款还须遵守惯常的额外强制提前还款条款，即以某些债务发行和资产出售的所得款项进行提前还款，以及按超额现金流的一定比例进行提前还款，并须遵守某些基于杠杆率的分档下调及例外情形。X B-3 定期贷款的提前还款罚金为：2026 年 10 月 27 日之前为未偿本金的 107.13%,2027 年 10 月 27 日之前为未偿本金的 104.75%,2028 年 10 月 27 日之前为未偿本金的 102.38%。

paras.en: Guarantors and Collateral. Obligations under the First Lien Senior Credit Facilities were guaranteed by X, and were collateralized by a first priority lien on substantially all of the assets of X and its subsidiaries (subject to customary exceptions).
paras.zh: 担保人与抵押品。第一留置权优先信贷额度项下的义务由 X 提供担保，并以 X 及其子公司实质上全部资产的第一优先留置权作为抵押（须遵守惯常例外情形）。

paras.en: #### xAI First Lien Credit Agreement
paras.zh: #### xAI 第一留置权信贷协议

paras.en: General. In June 2025, X.AI Corp. and X.AI LLC, indirect subsidiaries of the Company, entered into the First Lien Credit Agreement to provide borrowings up to $2,000 million. The Company executed a $1,000 million Fixed Rate Term Loan maturing on June 30, 2030 (“xAI Fixed Rate Term Loan”); and a $1,000 million Floating Rate Term Loan maturing on June 30, 2030 (“xAI Floating Rate Term Loan”).
paras.zh: 概述。2025 年 6 月，公司间接子公司 X.AI Corp. 与 X.AI LLC 订立第一留置权信贷协议，以提供最高 2,000 百万美元的借款。公司签署了一笔 1,000 百万美元、于 2030 年 6 月 30 日到期的固定利率定期贷款（“xAI 固定利率定期贷款”），以及一笔 1,000 百万美元、于 2030 年 6 月 30 日到期的浮动利率定期贷款（“xAI 浮动利率定期贷款”）。

paras.en: Interest Rates. The xAI Fixed Rate Term Loan had a fixed interest rate of 12.50% per annum and the xAI Floating Rate Term Loan had a floating interest rate per annum of Term SOFR plus 7.25% or ABR plus 6.25%. Interest on the xAI Fixed Rate Term Loan was payable bi-annually on January 31 and July 31, commencing on January 31, 2026. Interest on the xAI Floating Rate Term loan was payable monthly, quarterly, or bi-annually at the option of the Company.
paras.zh: 利率。xAI 固定利率定期贷款的年利率为固定利率 12.50%,xAI 浮动利率定期贷款的年利率为 Term SOFR 加 7.25% 或 ABR 加 6.25% 的浮动利率。xAI 固定利率定期贷款的利息自 2026 年 1 月 31 日起，于每年 1 月 31 日和 7 月 31 日每半年支付一次。xAI 浮动利率定期贷款的利息由公司选择按月、按季度或每半年支付。

paras.en: Principal Repayments. On March 2, 2026, the Company repaid the full outstanding principal balance and accrued interest, including a prepayment penalty of $221 million, resulting in the extinguishment of the xAI Fixed Rate Term Loan and xAI Floating Rate Term Loan. The xAI Fixed Rate Term Loan and the xAI Floating Rate Term Loan had prepayment penalties of 103% on the principal outstanding balance prior to June 30, 2027 and 101% on the principal outstanding balance prior to June 30, 2028.
paras.zh: 本金偿还。2026 年 3 月 2 日，公司偿还了全部未偿本金余额及应计利息，其中包括 221 百万美元的提前还款罚金，从而导致 xAI 固定利率定期贷款和 xAI 浮动利率定期贷款被清偿。xAI 固定利率定期贷款和 xAI 浮动利率定期贷款在 2027 年 6 月 30 日之前对未偿本金余额设有 103% 的提前还款罚金，在 2028 年 6 月 30 日之前对未偿本金余额设有 101% 的提前还款罚金。

paras.en: Guarantors. Obligations under the xAI Fixed Rate Term Loan and xAI Floating Rate Term Loan were guaranteed each jointly and severally by X.AI Corp. and the following subsidiaries of X.AI Corp.: AIQ Phase LLC, CTC Holding LLC, CTC, LLZ Build LLC, and MZX.
paras.zh: 担保人。xAI 固定利率定期贷款和 xAI 浮动利率定期贷款项下的义务由 X.AI Corp.及其以下子公司共同及分别提供担保：AIQ Phase LLC、CTC Holding LLC、CTC、LLZ Build LLC 和 MZX。

paras.en: #### xAI 12.5% Secured Senior Notes
paras.zh: #### xAI 12.5%有担保优先票据

paras.en: General. In June 2025, X.AI LLC and, X.AI Co Issuer Corp, indirect subsidiaries of the Company, issued $3,000 million aggregate principal amount of 12.5% interest Senior Secured Notes due in 2030 (“xAI 12.5% Senior Secured Notes”). The Senior Secured Notes were issued at 100% of the principal amount and the entire principal amount will be due on June 30, 2030.
paras.zh: 一般事项。2025 年 6 月，本公司间接子公司 X.AI LLC 及 X.AI Co Issuer Corp 发行了本金总额 3,000 百万美元、年利率 12.5%、于 2030 年到期的优先担保票据（“xAI 12.5% 优先担保票据”）。该优先担保票据按本金金额的 100% 发行，全部本金金额将于 2030 年 6 月 30 日到期。

paras.en: Interest Rates. The xAI 12.5% Senior Secured Notes had a fixed interest rate of 12.50% per annum. Interest was payable bi-annually on January 15 and July 15, commencing on January 15, 2026.
paras.zh: 利率。xAI 12.5%优先有担保票据的固定年利率为 12.50%。利息每半年于 1 月 15 日和 7 月 15 日支付，自 2026 年 1 月 15 日开始。

paras.en: Principal Repayments. On March 5, 2026, the Company repaid the full outstanding principal balance and accrued interest, including a prepayment penalty of $518 million, resulting in the extinguishment of the xAI 12.5% Senior Secured Notes. The xAI 12.5% Senior Secured Notes had prepayment penalties of 106.25% on the principal outstanding balance prior to July 15, 2027 and 103.13% on the principal outstanding balance prior to July 15, 2028.
paras.zh: 本金偿还。2026 年 3 月 5 日，公司偿还了全部未偿本金余额及应计利息，其中包括 518 百万美元的提前还款罚金，从而导致 xAI 12.5% 优先担保票据的清偿。xAI 12.5% 优先担保票据规定，在 2027 年 7 月 15 日之前对未偿本金余额收取 106.25% 的提前还款罚金，在 2028 年 7 月 15 日之前对未偿本金余额收取 103.13% 的提前还款罚金。

paras.en: Guarantors. Obligations under the xAI 12.5% Senior Secured Notes were guaranteed each jointly and severally by xAI and the following subsidiaries of xAI: AIQ Phase LLC, CTC Holding LLC, CTC, LLZ Build LLC, and MZX.
paras.zh: 担保人。xAI 12.5%优先有担保票据项下的义务由 xAI 及其以下子公司共同及分别提供担保：AIQ Phase LLC、CTC Holding LLC、CTC、LLZ Build LLC 和 MZX。

paras.en: #### xAI Revolving Line of Credit
paras.zh: #### xAI 循环信贷额度

paras.en: General. In April 2024 and amended through March 2026, a subsidiary of xAI, an indirect subsidiary of the Company, entered into a revolving line of credit up to borrowing capacity of $250 million. The Company had no borrowings under the line of credit during the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025.
paras.zh: 一般事项。2024 年 4 月，公司的一家间接子公司——xAI 的一家子公司——签订了一项最高借款额度为 $250 million 的循环信贷额度，并于 2026 年 3 月前进行了修订。在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，公司在该循环信贷额度下没有借款。

paras.en: Interest Rates. Interest on any borrowings is calculated based on the 30-day average SOFR plus the International Swaps and Derivatives Association spread adjustment plus a spread of 40 basis points.
paras.zh: 利率。任何借款的利息按 30 天平均 SOFR 加上国际掉期与衍生工具协会利差调整，再加 40 个基点的利差计算。

paras.en: Guarantors and Collateral. The agreement permits borrowings up to the value of the pledged collateral held in custody, less any outstanding loan balances, accrued interest, and fees. The pledged collateral consisted of securities held in xAI’s custodial account.
paras.zh: 担保人与抵押品。该协议允许借款金额不超过托管持有的质押抵押品价值减去任何未偿贷款余额、应计利息和费用后的金额。质押抵押品由 xAI 托管账户中持有的证券组成。

paras.en: #### Other Financings
paras.zh: #### 其他融资

paras.en: The Company has entered into various other financing arrangements, generally collateralized by specific machinery and equipment. These arrangements have an average fixed interest rate of 4.4% and 5.5% per annum as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively, with principal and interest payments due monthly, and in certain instances, a lump sum payment at the end of term.
paras.zh: 公司已签订多项其他融资安排，通常以特定机器和设备作为抵押。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 12 月 31 日，这些安排的平均固定利率分别为每年 4.4% 和 5.5%，本金和利息按月支付，并在某些情况下于期末一次性支付。

paras.en: In addition, in November 2025 and January 2026, CTC completed sale-leaseback transactions for its AI infrastructure assets which would have been deemed finance leases resulting in failed sale-leaseback transactions. As a result, the Company recorded the related debt of $1,121 million and $7,920 million within Debt and finance leases, current and Debt and finance leases, net of current, respectively, in the Company’s consolidated balance sheets as of March 31, 2026 for these two failed sale-leaseback transactions. Refer to Note 17, Related Party Transactions for additional details.
paras.zh: 此外，在 2025 年 11 月和 2026 年 1 月，CTC 完成了其 AI 基础设施资产的售后回租交易，这些交易本应被视为融资租赁，从而导致售后回租交易未能成立。因此，就这两项未能成立的售后回租交易，公司在其截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的合并资产负债表中，分别将相关债务 $1,121 million 和 $7,920 million 计入“债务及融资租赁，流动”和“债务及融资租赁，扣除流动部分”。更多详情请参见附注 17“关联方交易”。

full.sec: Note 12 - Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock and Shareholders’ Equity
full.secZh: 附注 12 - 可赎回可转换优先股及股东权益

paras.en: #### SpaceX Preferred and Common Stock
paras.zh: #### SpaceX 优先股与普通股

paras.en: The Company has five classes of stock - four classes to be designated Class A common stock (“Class A”), Class B common stock (“Class B”), Class C common stock (“Class C”), Class D common stock (“Class D”) (collectively the “SpaceX Common Stock”), and one class of stock to be designated preferred stock and subdivided into several series of redeemable convertible preferred stock (collectively the “SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock”). All references to “Class” refer to that particular class of SpaceX Common Stock and all references to “Series” refer to that particular series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock.
paras.zh: 公司共有五类股票——其中四类被指定为 A 类普通股（“A 类”）、B 类普通股（“B 类”）、C 类普通股（“C 类”）、D 类普通股（“D 类”）（合称“SpaceX 普通股”），另有一类被指定为优先股并细分为若干系列的可赎回可转换优先股（合称“SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股”）。所有对“类”的引用均指 SpaceX 普通股的该特定类别，所有对“系列”的引用均指 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股的该特定系列。

paras.en: As of March 31, 2026, the total number of shares of SpaceX Common Stock the Company is authorized to issue is 54,657 million shares, each with a par value of $0.001 per share, except for Class D, which has a par value of $0.0001 per share. 36,132 million shares are Class A, 6,125 million shares are Class B, 10,000 million shares are Class C, and 2,400 million shares are Class D. The total number of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock that the Company is authorized to issue is 2,607 million shares, of which 2,400 million shares are undesignated.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，公司获授权发行的 SpaceX 普通股总股数为 54,657 百万股，每股面值 $0.001，但 D 类除外，其面值为每股 $0.0001。其中 36,132 百万股为 A 类，6,125 百万股为 B 类，10,000 百万股为 C 类，2,400 百万股为 D 类。公司获授权发行的 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股总股数为 2,607 百万股，其中 2,400 百万股为未指定类别。

paras.en: With the exception of the expanded conversion rights described below, there were no changes to the dividend provisions, liquidation preferences, conversion rights, redemption rights or the voting rights of the SpaceX Convertible Redeemable Preferred Stock and SpaceX Common Stock during the three months ended March 31, 2026.
paras.zh: 除下文所述的扩大后的转换权外，在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，SpaceX 可转换可赎回优先股和 SpaceX 普通股的股息条款、清算优先权、转换权、赎回权或投票权均未发生变化。

paras.en: In May 2026, the Board approved the 2026 Stock Split, pursuant to which each share of the Class A, Class B, and Class C SpaceX Common Stock issued and outstanding was split into five shares of the same class of SpaceX Common Stock.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月，董事会批准了 2026 年股票拆分，据此，已发行在外的每股 A 类、B 类和 C 类 SpaceX 普通股被拆分为五股同一类别的 SpaceX 普通股。

paras.en: #### xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock and Common Stock
paras.zh: #### xAI 可赎回可转换优先股与普通股

paras.en: On March 28, 2025, xAI adopted an Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation, which established its capital structure and designated multiple classes of common stock and several series of redeemable convertible preferred stock. The Articles were subsequently amended and restated through January 30, 2026 (collectively, the “xAI Articles of Incorporation”) to add and authorize additional series of redeemable convertible preferred stock with no economic changes to any previously existing series.
paras.zh: 2025 年 3 月 28 日，xAI 通过了经修订和重述的公司章程，确立了其资本结构，并指定了多个类别的普通股和若干系列的可赎回可转换优先股。该章程随后于 2026 年 1 月 30 日经修订和重述（合称“xAI 公司章程”），以增加并授权额外的可赎回可转换优先股系列，且未对任何先前存在的系列产生经济上的变化。

paras.en: Pursuant to the xAI Articles of Incorporation, xAI’s authorized capitalization prior to the xAI Merger consisted of three classes of common, stock, which are designated Class A common stock (“xAI Class A”), Class B common stock (“xAI Class B”), Limited Voting common stock (“xAI Limited Voting”), (collectively the “xAI Common Stock”) and several series of redeemable convertible preferred stock (collectively the “xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock”). All references to “xAI Class” refer to that particular class of xAI Common Stock and all references to “xAI Series” refer to that particular series of xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock.
paras.zh: 根据 xAI 公司章程，在 xAI 合并之前，xAI 的获授权资本由三类普通股组成，分别被指定为 A 类普通股（“xAI A 类”）、B 类普通股（“xAI B 类”）、有限投票权普通股（“xAI 有限投票权”）（合称“xAI 普通股”），以及若干系列的可赎回可转换优先股（合称“xAI 可赎回可转换优先股”）。所有对“xAI 类”的引用均指 xAI 普通股的该特定类别，所有对“xAI 系列”的引用均指 xAI 可赎回可转换优先股的该特定系列。

paras.en: #### Effect of the xAI Merger
paras.zh: #### xAI 合并的影响

paras.en: xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
paras.zh: xAI 可赎回可转换优先股

paras.en: On xAI Merger Date, all outstanding shares of xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock converted into shares of SpaceX Common Stock, based on the share-for-share exchange mechanics specified in the Merger Agreement. Each share of xAI Series A‑1, B, C, D, and E redeemable convertible preferred stock (classified as “xAI Low Vote Stock”) was converted into 0.1433 shares of SpaceX Class A Common Stock per preferred share (on a pre-2026 Stock Split basis), rounded up to the nearest whole number for fractional shares. Each share of xAI Series A redeemable convertible preferred stock (classified as “xAI High Vote Stock”) was converted into 0.1433 shares of SpaceX Class B Common Stock per preferred share (on a pre-2026 Stock Split basis), rounded up to the nearest whole number for fractional shares. For xAI Series A Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, all holders that were an eligible service provider could elect to receive cash of $75.46 per share of xAI Series A Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock (on a pre-2026 Stock Split basis). Upon conversion, all shares of xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock were canceled and retired, and former xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock shareholders received the applicable shares of SpaceX Common Stock. Any shares of xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock previously held by the Company were canceled and retired and did not receive any consideration.
paras.zh: 在 xAI 合并日，xAI 可赎回可转换优先股的全部流通股按照合并协议规定的换股机制转换为 SpaceX 普通股股份。xAI A-1、B、C、D 和 E 系列可赎回可转换优先股的每一股（归类为“xAI 低投票权股票”）按每股优先股转换为 0.1433 股 SpaceX A 类普通股（按 2026 年股票拆分前基准计算），零碎股份向上取整至最接近的整数。xAI A 系列可赎回可转换优先股的每一股（归类为“xAI 高投票权股票”）按每股优先股转换为 0.1433 股 SpaceX B 类普通股（按 2026 年股票拆分前基准计算），零碎股份向上取整至最接近的整数。对于 xAI A 系列可赎回可转换优先股，所有属于合格服务提供商的持有人可选择就每股 xAI A 系列可赎回可转换优先股收取现金 $75.46（按 2026 年股票拆分前基准计算）。转换完成后，xAI 可赎回可转换优先股的全部股份均被注销并退股，原 xAI 可赎回可转换优先股股东获得相应数量的 SpaceX 普通股股份。公司此前持有的任何 xAI 可赎回可转换优先股股份均被注销并退股，且未获得任何对价。

paras.en: Because the xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock was legally outstanding during all historical periods prior to the xAI Merger and represented a separate equity class of a legally distinct predecessor entity, the conversion of xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock into SpaceX Common Stock is recognized only as of the closing of the xAI Merger, and not retrospectively. Accordingly, the historical consolidated balance sheets and consolidated statements of redeemable convertible preferred stock and shareholders’ equity reflect the xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock as outstanding xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock consistent with its legal form and rights during those periods and are not recast on an as-converted basis for all periods presented prior to the xAI Merger Date. The impact of the conversion is presented separately in the consolidated statements of redeemable convertible preferred stock and shareholders’ equity for the three months ended March 31, 2026.
paras.zh: 由于 xAI 可赎回可转换优先股在 xAI 合并之前的全部历史期间内均为法定流通在外股份，且代表一家在法律上独立的前身实体的单独权益类别，因此 xAI 可赎回可转换优先股转换为 SpaceX 普通股仅在 xAI 合并交割时确认，而不进行追溯确认。相应地，历史合并资产负债表以及可赎回可转换优先股和股东权益合并报表将 xAI 可赎回可转换优先股反映为流通在外的 xAI 可赎回可转换优先股，与其在该等期间内的法律形式和权利一致，且不会就 xAI 合并日之前的全部列报期间按转换后基准进行重述。转换的影响在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三个月的可赎回可转换优先股和股东权益合并报表中单独列示。

paras.en: xAI Warrants
paras.zh: xAI 认股权证

paras.en: xAI also issued warrants to customers that were outstanding as of the effective date of the xAI Merger, which had a ten-year term originally set to expire in 2035, with an exercise price equal to the par value of the stock, and vesting terms that resulted in the warrants vesting proportionally to the payments received under the related agreement. The closing of the xAI Merger triggered an acceleration clause in which all outstanding xAI warrants, both vested and unvested components, were automatically exercised on a cashless basis exercised and converted into fully vested SpaceX Class A Common Stock at the exchange ratio of 0.1433 (on a pre-2026 Stock Split basis).
paras.zh: xAI 还向客户发行了截至 xAI 合并生效日仍流通在外的认股权证，该等认股权证期限为十年，原定于 2035 年到期，行权价等于股票面值，其归属条款使得认股权证按相关协议项下收到的付款比例归属。xAI 合并的交割触发了加速条款，据此全部流通在外的 xAI 认股权证（包括已归属和未归属部分）均以无现金方式自动行权，并按 0.1433 的换股比例（按 2026 年股票拆分前基准计算）转换为已完全归属的 SpaceX A 类普通股。

paras.en: xAI and X Common Stock
paras.zh: xAI 和 X 普通股

paras.en: Upon the effective date of the xAI Merger, every outstanding share of xAI Common Stock, whether Class A, Class B, or Limited Voting, converted into the right to receive SpaceX Common Stock at a fixed exchange ratio of 0.1433 SpaceX shares per share of xAI Common Stock, unless the holder was an eligible service provider and elected to receive cash of $75.46 per share of xAI Class A or Class B (on a pre-2026 Stock Split basis). No fractional SpaceX shares were issued and all share amounts were rounded up to the nearest whole number. Any shares of xAI Common Stock previously held by the Company were canceled and retired and did not receive any consideration.
paras.zh: 在 xAI 合并生效日，xAI 普通股（无论是 A 类、B 类还是有限投票权股）的每一股流通股均转换为收取 SpaceX 普通股的权利，固定换股比例为每股 xAI 普通股换取 0.1433 股 SpaceX 股份，但持有人为符合条件的服务提供者并选择就每股 xAI A 类或 B 类股份（按 2026 年股票拆分前基准）收取 $75.46 现金的除外。未发行任何零碎 SpaceX 股份，所有股份数量均向上取整至最接近的整数。公司此前持有的任何 xAI 普通股股份均被注销并收回，且未获得任何对价。

paras.en: Effect of the X Merger
paras.zh: X 合并的影响

paras.en: Upon the effective date of the X Merger, each class of common stock of X Holdings Corp. (“X Common Stock”) was converted to 2.776 shares of xAI Common Stock of the same class (rounded down to the nearest whole share), each class of common stock of X.AI Corp. (“xAI Corp. Common Stock”) was converted to 1.000 share of xAI Common Stock of the same class, and each series of X.AI Corp. preferred stock (“xAI Corp. Preferred Stock”) (other than shares held by X or any of its subsidiaries) was converted to 1.000 share of xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock of the same series.
paras.zh: 在 X 合并生效日，X Holdings Corp.（“X 普通股”）的每一类普通股均转换为 2.776 股同一类别的 xAI 普通股（向下取整至最接近的整数股），X.AI Corp.（“xAI Corp. 普通股”）的每一类普通股均转换为 1.000 股同一类别的 xAI 普通股，且 X.AI Corp. 的每一系列优先股（“xAI Corp. 优先股”）（X 或其任何子公司持有的股份除外）均转换为 1.000 股同一系列的 xAI 可赎回可转换优先股。

paras.en: As a result of the Mergers, all of X, X.AI Corp. and xAI Common Stock are being presented in the historical financial statements as if they had been converted into SpaceX Common Stock at the applicable exchange rate for all periods presented through the date of the xAI Merger. As such, all shares of historical X, X.AI Corp. and xAI Common Stock are included in the share counts for SpaceX Common Stock below. X.AI Corp. and xAI Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock are being presented in the consolidated financial statements at historical values with an adjustment to the conversion rate at the applicable exchange ratio per the xAI Merger.
paras.zh: 由于上述合并，在截至 xAI 合并日期的所有列报期间，X、X.AI Corp. 和 xAI 普通股在历史财务报表中均按适用汇率视同已转换为 SpaceX 普通股列报。因此，历史 X、X.AI Corp. 和 xAI 普通股的所有股份均计入下文 SpaceX 普通股的股份数量中。X.AI Corp. 和 xAI 可赎回可转换优先股在合并财务报表中按历史价值列报，并按 xAI 合并规定的适用换股比例对转换率进行调整。
