paras.en: The following describes the various rights and preferences of the SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock:
paras.zh: 以下描述 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股的各种权利和优先权：

paras.en: Dividend Provisions
paras.zh: 股息条款

paras.en: On a per annum basis, holders of shares of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock are entitled to receive dividends prior and in preference to any declaration or payment of any dividend to common shareholders at a rate described in the table above for each outstanding share of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock. Any such dividends are declared at the discretion of the Board of Directors and are not cumulative. For the period from inception through March 31, 2026, no dividends on SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock have been declared. The SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock do not participate in distributions beyond their preferred dividend as described above.
paras.zh: 在每年基础上，SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股持有人有权在向普通股股东宣派或支付任何股息之前并优先于其获得股息，股息率见上表所列的每股已发行 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股。任何此类股息由董事会酌情宣派，且不累积。自成立至 2026 年 3 月 31 日期间，未宣派 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股的股息。SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股不参与上述优先股息之外的分配。

paras.en: Liquidation Preference
paras.zh: 清算优先权

paras.en: The series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock listed in the table above were issued by the Company chronologically and in alphabetical order, with Series A issued first and Series N issued most recently. Each series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock is senior in rank to all earlier issued series and junior in rank to all later issued series, except that: (i) Series A, A-1, B, B-1, and C SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock are all on parity with each other and junior in rank to all subsequently issued series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock; and (ii) series E, F, and G SpaceX redeemable convertible preferred stock are all on parity with each other, are senior in rank to all earlier issued series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, and junior in rank to all subsequently issued series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock.
paras.zh: 上表所列的各系列 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股由公司按时间顺序并按字母顺序发行，A 轮最先发行，N 轮最近发行。各系列 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股的级别均高于所有先前发行的系列，并低于所有后续发行的系列，但以下情况除外：(i) A、A-1、B、B-1 和 C 轮 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股彼此级别相同，并低于所有后续发行的 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股系列；以及 (ii) E、F 和 G 轮 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股彼此级别相同，高于所有先前发行的 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股系列，并低于所有后续发行的 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股系列。

paras.en: In the event of a liquidation, dissolution, or winding up of the Company, holders of a given series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock are entitled to receive, in preference to the holders of SpaceX Common Stock and any junior-ranking SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, the liquidation preference indicated in the table above for such series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, plus any declared but unpaid dividends. Holders of all series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock are entitled to receive the greater of the liquidation preference per share indicated above, or the amount each series would be entitled to receive if all such outstanding SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock were converted to Class A or Class B SpaceX Common Stock, as applicable, immediately prior to such liquidation, dissolution, or winding up of the Company. Upon completion of the distributions described above, if any assets remain in the Company, the then remaining assets will be distributed on an equal priority, pro rata basis to the holders of SpaceX Common Stock.
paras.zh: 在公司清算、解散或停业清算时，某一特定系列 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股的持有人有权优先于 SpaceX 普通股持有人及任何级别较低的 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股持有人，获得上表中该系列 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股所列的清算优先额，加上任何已宣派但未支付的股息。所有系列 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股的持有人有权获得以下两者中的较高者：上述每股清算优先额，或假设所有该等已发行 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股在公司清算、解散或停业清算前立即转换为 A 类或 B 类 SpaceX 普通股（视适用情况而定）时各系列有权获得的金额。在上述分配完成后，如公司仍有任何剩余资产，则届时剩余的资产将按同等优先顺序、按比例分配给 SpaceX 普通股持有人。

paras.en: Conversion Rights
paras.zh: 转换权

paras.en: Each share of Series A and Series B SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock is convertible at the option of the holder at any time after the date of issuance of such share into shares of Class A, Class B, or Class C SpaceX Common Stock and each share of all other series of preferred stock are convertible at the option of the holder at any time after the date of issuance of such share into shares of Class A or Class C SpaceX Common Stock. The number of shares of SpaceX Common Stock to which a holder of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock is entitled shall be at a conversion rate determined by dividing the initial price by the conversion price. Each share of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock is convertible into fifty shares of SpaceX Common Stock following the 2026 Stock Split. The conversion price is subject to adjustment set forth in the charter for certain dilutive issuances, splits and combinations.
paras.zh: A 系列和 B 系列 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股的每股股份，可在该股份发行日期之后的任何时间由持有人选择转换为 A 类、B 类或 C 类 SpaceX 普通股股份；所有其他系列优先股的每股股份，可在该股份发行日期之后的任何时间由持有人选择转换为 A 类或 C 类 SpaceX 普通股股份。SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股持有人有权获得的 SpaceX 普通股股份数量应按转换率确定，该转换率以初始价格除以转换价格计算。在 2026 年股票拆分之后，每股 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股可转换为五十股 SpaceX 普通股。转换价格须根据公司章程中针对某些稀释性发行、拆分和合并所规定的情形进行调整。

paras.en: The SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock automatically converts upon the earlier of (i) the Company’s sale of its common stock in a public offering pursuant to a registration statement under the Securities Act of 1933, in which the pre-public offering market capitalization of the Company is at least $6.0 billion and which results in aggregate cash proceeds to the Company of not less than $250 million (“Qualified IPO”) or (ii) the date specified by written consent or agreement of the applicable holders of shares of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock (with respect to each applicable series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock), voting in accordance with the charter.
paras.zh: SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股在以下两者中较早发生者时自动转换：(i) 公司根据 1933 年证券法下的注册声明以公开发行方式出售其普通股，且公司公开发行前市值至少为 $6.0 billion，并向公司带来不少于 $250 million 的合计现金所得（“合格 IPO”）；或 (ii) 由相关 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股股份持有人（就各适用系列 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股而言）按照公司章程以书面同意或协议方式指定的日期。

paras.en: In the event of a transfer of a share of Series A or Series B (other than a Permitted Transfer as defined in the charter), such share shall automatically be cancelled and converted into a corresponding share of Series A-1 or Series B-1.
paras.zh: 如发生 A 系列或 B 系列股份的转让（公司章程所定义的许可转让除外），该股份应自动注销并转换为相应的 A-1 系列或 B-1 系列股份。

paras.en: Voting Rights
paras.zh: 投票权

paras.en: Holders of each share of Series A and Series B have the right to ten votes for each share of Class B into which such share is convertible. Holders of each share of all other series of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock have the right to one vote for each share of Class A into which such share is convertible. Such holders will have full voting rights and powers equal to the voting rights and powers of the holders of SpaceX Common Stock, except as required by law.
paras.zh: A 轮和 B 轮每一股的持有人，就其可转换成的每一股 B 类普通股享有十票投票权。SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股所有其他系列每一股的持有人，就其可转换成的每一股 A 类普通股享有一票投票权。除法律另有规定外，该等持有人将享有与 SpaceX 普通股持有人同等的完整投票权和权力。

paras.en: Classification
paras.zh: 分类

paras.en: The liquidation preference provisions of the SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock are considered contingent redemption provisions as deemed liquidation events such as a change of control are not solely within the control of the Company. Accordingly, SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock are presented outside of permanent equity on the Company’s consolidated balance sheets as Redeemable convertible preferred stock. SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock has not been remeasured to their redemption amount as they are not currently redeemable or probable of becoming redeemable.
paras.zh: SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股的清算优先权条款被视为或有赎回条款，因为控制权变更等视同清算事件并非仅由公司控制。因此，SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股在公司的合并资产负债表上作为可赎回可转换优先股列示于永久权益之外。由于该等股份目前不可赎回或不太可能变为可赎回，SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股未按赎回金额重新计量。

paras.en: The following describes the various rights and preferences of the SpaceX Common Stock:
paras.zh: 以下描述 SpaceX 普通股的各项权利和优先权：

paras.en: Dividend Provisions
paras.zh: 股息条款

paras.en: Subject to the prior rights of holders of all classes and series of stock at the time outstanding having prior rights as to dividends, holders of SpaceX Common Stock shall be entitled to receive, when, as and if declared by the Board of Directors, out of any funds legally available, such dividends as may be declared from time to time by the Board of Directors. For the period from inception through March 31, 2026, no dividends were declared on SpaceX Common Stock.
paras.zh: 在受当时已发行的、对股息享有优先权的各类别及各系列股票持有人优先权利的限制下，SpaceX 普通股持有人有权在董事会宣布时、按宣布的方式并在宣布的范围内，从合法可用资金中收取董事会不时宣布的股息。自成立至 2026 年 3 月 31 日期间，SpaceX 普通股未宣布任何股息。

paras.en: Liquidation Rights
paras.zh: 清算权利

paras.en: In the event of a liquidation, dissolution, or winding up of the Company, upon the completion of the distributions required with respect to the SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, if assets remain in the Company, the then remaining assets will be distributed on an equal priority, pro rata basis to the holders of SpaceX Common Stock.
paras.zh: 在公司清算、解散或停业清算的情况下，在完成就 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股所需进行的分配后，如公司仍有资产剩余，则届时剩余的资产将按同等优先顺序、按比例分配给 SpaceX 普通股持有人。

paras.en: Conversion Rights
paras.zh: 转换权

paras.en: Each share of Class B is convertible at the option of the holder, at any time, into one share of Class A. Each share of Class B will automatically convert into one share of Class A upon a transfer, other than a Permitted Transfer (as defined in the charter), of such share of Class B.
paras.zh: 每股 B 类普通股可由持有人选择随时转换为一股 A 类普通股。每股 B 类普通股在发生转让（经许可的转让（定义见公司章程）除外）时，将自动转换为一股 A 类普通股。

paras.en: Voting Rights
paras.zh: 投票权

paras.en: Each holder of Class A is entitled to one vote for each share held. Each holder of Class B is entitled to ten votes for each share held. The holders of Class C have no voting rights, except as required by law. Voting rights with respect to Class D will be established when and if any shares of Class D are issued by the Board of Directors.
paras.zh: 每位 A 类普通股持有人就其持有的每股股份享有一票投票权。每位 B 类普通股持有人就其持有的每股股份享有十票投票权。C 类普通股持有人不享有投票权，但法律另有规定的除外。D 类普通股的投票权将在董事会发行任何 D 类普通股时予以确定。

paras.en: Reserve for Unissued Shares of Common Stock
paras.zh: 普通股未发行股份的预留

paras.en: The Company is required to reserve and keep available out of its authorized but unissued shares of SpaceX Common Stock such number of shares sufficient to effect the conversion of all outstanding shares of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock and Class B, as applicable, plus shares granted and available for grant under the Company’s share plans.
paras.zh: 公司须从其已授权但未发行的 SpaceX 普通股中预留并保持足够数量的股份，以用于全部已发行的 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股及 B 类普通股（如适用）的转换，加上公司股份计划项下已授予及可供授予的股份。

paras.en: #### Share Repurchases
paras.zh: #### 股份回购

paras.en: During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the Company repurchased $2,413 million or 25.4 million shares of SpaceX Common Stock from eligible current and former xAI employees as part of the xAI Merger. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the Company also repurchased of 30.5 million shares of SpaceX Common Stock and 2.1 million shares of SpaceX Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock for $1,933 million in a number of unrelated transactions with existing shareholders at their then-current fair market value.
paras.zh: 在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，作为 xAI 合并的一部分，公司以 $2,413 百万向符合条件的现任及前任 xAI 员工回购了 25.4 百万股 SpaceX 普通股。在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，公司还在与现有股东的多项互不关联的交易中，按当时的公允价值以 $1,933 百万回购了 30.5 百万股 SpaceX 普通股和 2.1 百万股 SpaceX 可赎回可转换优先股。

paras.en: Similarly, the Company repurchased $508 million or 28.0 million shares of SpaceX Common Stock from eligible current and former employees and existing shareholders during the three ended March 31, 2025. The Company only repurchased shares held by eligible participants for more than six months at a purchase price per share equal to the then current fair market value.
paras.zh: 同样，在截至 2025 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，公司以 $508 百万向符合条件的现任及前任员工和现有股东回购了 28.0 百万股 SpaceX 普通股。公司仅回购符合条件的参与人持有超过六个月的股份，每股购买价格等于当时的公允价值。

paras.en: All SpaceX shares repurchased to date have been retired.
paras.zh: 迄今为止回购的所有 SpaceX 股份均已注销。

paras.en: #### X and xAI Mergers
paras.zh: #### X 与 xAI 合并

paras.en: As part of the xAI Merger, each xAI option for a share of xAI common stock outstanding and unexercised at the time of the xAI Merger (vested and unvested) was converted into a SpaceX option to receive 0.1433 shares of SpaceX Class A or Class B Common Stock (on a pre-2026 Stock Split basis), as applicable, under the same terms and conditions (including the vesting and exercisability conditions) as the original xAI stock options at an exercise price equal to the original xAI option exercise price divided by 0.1433. Each xAI RSU that was vested and outstanding was converted to the right to receive 0.1433 of a share of SpaceX Class A or Class B Common Stock (on a pre-2026 Stock Split basis), as applicable. Each xAI RSU that was unvested was converted to 0.1433 of a SpaceX RSU. Each xAI RSA was converted to 0.1433 shares of SpaceX RSA for SpaceX Class A or Class B Common Stock (on a pre-2026 Stock Split basis), as applicable, with the same terms and conditions (including the vesting terms). Refer to Note 12, Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock and Shareholders’ Equity for additional details.
paras.zh: 作为 xAI 合并的一部分，在 xAI 合并时已发行且未行权的每一份 xAI 普通股期权（无论已归属或未归属）均被转换为 SpaceX 期权，可按适用情况获得 0.1433 股 SpaceX A 类或 B 类普通股（按 2026 年股票拆分前基准计算），其条款和条件（包括归属和可行权条件）与原始 xAI 股票期权相同，行权价等于原始 xAI 期权行权价除以 0.1433。每一份已归属且尚未行权的 xAI RSU 均被转换为获得 0.1433 股 SpaceX A 类或 B 类普通股（按 2026 年股票拆分前基准计算）的权利（按适用情况）。每一份未归属的 xAI RSU 均被转换为 0.1433 份 SpaceX RSU。每一份 xAI RSA 均被转换为 0.1433 股 SpaceX RSA，对应 SpaceX A 类或 B 类普通股（按 2026 年股票拆分前基准计算，按适用情况），条款和条件（包括归属条款）相同。更多详情请参见附注 12“可赎回可转换优先股与股东权益”。

paras.en: As part of the X Merger, each X RSU that was outstanding was converted to a xAI RSU to receive 2.776 shares of xAI Common Stock.
paras.zh: 作为 X 合并的一部分，每一份尚未行权的 X RSU 均被转换为 xAI RSU，可获得 2.776 股 xAI 普通股。

paras.en: #### General

The Company grants RSUs, RSAs, and non-statutory options to eligible employees, key executives, and certain non-employee service providers (collectively, the “Plans”). The Company also has a number of performance-based awards. The Company offers an ESPP, under which eligible employees can purchase the Company’s Common Stock at a discounted price. The Company also offers a Non-Qualified Employee Stock Purchase Plan (“NQ ESPP”), under which employees can purchase the Company’s Common Stock at the fair market value. In April 2026, the Company cancelled the NQ ESPP.
paras.zh: 公司向符合条件的员工、关键高管及若干非雇员服务提供者授予 RSU、RSA 和非法定期权（统称“计划”）。公司还拥有若干基于业绩的奖励。公司提供一项 ESPP，符合条件的员工可据此以折扣价购买公司普通股。公司还提供一项非合格员工购股计划（“NQ ESPP”），员工可据此按公平市场价值购买公司普通股。2026 年 4 月，公司取消了 NQ ESPP。

paras.en: #### Officer Equity Awards
paras.zh: #### 高管股权奖励

paras.en: In January 2026, the Company granted 1,000 million performance-based restricted shares of Class B common stock to Elon Musk. The restricted shares vest upon (i) the Company’s achievement of specified market capitalization milestones across 15 equal tranches ranging from $500 billion to $7.5 trillion, with each milestone reflecting $500 billion in additional valuation, and (ii) the Company’s establishment of a permanent human colony on Mars with at least one million inhabitants, in each case, subject to Mr. Musk’s continued employment (“SpaceX CEO Award”). The grant date fair value of the SpaceX CEO Award was determined to be$90.40 to $95.92 per share for each tranche.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，公司向 Elon Musk 授予 1,000 百万股基于业绩的 B 类普通股限制性股票。该限制性股票在以下条件满足时归属：(i) 公司实现指定的市值里程碑，分为 15 个等额批次，市值区间为 $500 billion 至 $7.5 trillion，每个里程碑对应 $500 billion 的额外估值；以及 (ii) 公司建立至少拥有一百万居民的永久火星人类殖民地；在每种情况下，均须以 Musk 先生继续任职为前提（“SpaceX CEO 奖励”）。SpaceX CEO 奖励的授予日公允价值确定为每批次每股 $90.40 至 $95.92。

paras.en: In November 2025, the Company granted a performance-based award (“xAI Award”) to Elon Musk consisting of twelve tranches with certain market, performance and service conditions. In March 2026, the Company cancelled the xAI Award and replaced it with a grant of 302.1 million performance-based restricted shares of Class B common stock, which vest upon (i) the achievement of specified market capitalization milestones across 12 equal tranches ranging from $1.065 trillion to $6.565 trillion, with each milestone reflecting $500 billion in additional valuation, and (ii) the Company’s completion of non-Earth-based data centers capable of delivering 100 terawatts of compute per year, in each case, subject to Mr. Musk’s continued employment (“AI CEO Award”). The grant date fair value of the AI CEO Award was determined to be $91.47 to $95.92per share for each tranche. The cancellation of the xAI Award and the grant of the AI CEO Award was considered an accounting modification. Share-based compensation will continue to be recognized over the original remaining service period equal to the fair value of the portion of the original xAI Award that was deemed probable of vesting as of the modification date. No incremental expense will be recognized based on the modified terms of the new AI CEO Award until the new performance conditions are deemed probable of vesting.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月，公司向 Elon Musk 授予了一项基于业绩的奖励（“xAI 奖励”），该奖励由十二个批次组成，并附带若干市场、业绩及服务条件。2026 年 3 月，公司取消了 xAI 奖励，并以授予 302.1 百万股基于业绩的 B 类普通股限制性股票作为替代，该等股份在以下条件达成时归属：(i) 在 12 个等额批次中实现指定的市值里程碑，市值区间为$1.065 万亿至$6.565 万亿，每个里程碑对应$500 十亿美元的估值增量，以及 (ii) 公司完成能够每年提供 100 太瓦算力的非地球数据中心，在每种情况下，均须以 Musk 先生持续任职为前提（“AI CEO 奖励”）。AI CEO 奖励的授予日公允价值确定为每个批次每股$91.47 至$95.92。取消 xAI 奖励并授予 AI CEO 奖励被视为会计上的修改。股份支付费用将继续在原始剩余服务期内确认，金额等于截至修改日原 xAI 奖励中被认为很可能归属部分的公允价值。在新业绩条件被认为很可能归属之前，不会基于新 AI CEO 奖励的修改条款确认任何增量费用。

paras.en: Share-based compensation expense recognition for the SpaceX CEO Award and AI CEO Award commences when the performance condition milestone is considered probable of achievement for each award regardless of the progress made towards achieving the next market capitalization milestone. As of March 31, 2026, both performance milestones were considered improbable and no share-based compensation expense has been recognized related to the SpaceX CEO Award and AI CEO Award . Once the performance milestone is considered probable of achievement, share-based compensation expense associated with the tranche will be recognized over the expected achievement date of the performance milestone.
paras.zh: SpaceX CEO 奖励和 AI CEO 奖励的股份支付费用确认，在每项奖励的业绩条件里程碑被认为很可能达成时开始，无论实现下一个市值里程碑的进展如何。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，两项业绩里程碑均被认为不可能达成，且未就 SpaceX CEO 奖励和 AI CEO 奖励确认任何股份支付费用。一旦业绩里程碑被认为很可能达成，与该批次相关的股份支付费用将在该业绩里程碑的预期达成日期内确认。

paras.en: In January 2026, the Company approved an amendment to 4 million performance-based stock options granted to Bret Johnsen, Chief Financial Officer, that were originally issued in 2024 (“CFO Award”). In lieu of vesting based on free cash flow achievement in excess of a baseline, 371 thousand of the stock options will vest for each $10 billion in adjusted EBITDA achieved during the 2025 through 2029 fiscal years, assessed on an annual basis. For purposes of this award, adjusted EBITDA is calculated as income from operations excluding (i) depreciation and amortization, (ii) share-based compensation, (iii) impairment, and (iv) restructuring impacts. Once a tranche of the stock options have become earned as a result of the Company’s adjusted EBITDA performance as of the end of a particular fiscal year, such stock options remain subject to an additional one-year and one day service-based vesting requirement following December 31 of the fiscal year in which such tranche was earned. The number of options granted was not changed in the amendment. The impact of the modification of the CFO Award was not material.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，公司批准对 2024 年原授予首席财务官 Bret Johnsen 的 4 百万份基于业绩的股票期权（“CFO 奖励”）进行修订。替代基于超过基线的自由现金流达成情况归属的方式，在 2025 至 2029 财年期间，每实现$10 十亿美元的调整后 EBITDA，将有 371 千份股票期权归属，按年度评估。就本奖励而言，调整后 EBITDA 计算为经营利润，不包括 (i) 折旧和摊销，(ii) 股份支付费用，(iii) 减值，以及 (iv) 重组影响。一旦某一批次股票期权因公司截至某一特定财年末的调整后 EBITDA 业绩而获得，该等股票期权仍需在该批次获得所在财年 12 月 31 日之后满足额外一年零一天的服务期归属要求。修订未改变授予的期权数量。CFO 奖励修改的影响不重大。

paras.en: The SpaceX CEO Award and AI CEO Award do not have a defined performance period other than Mr. Musk’s continued employment through the date each milestone is achieved. Therefore, an analysis was performed for an expected term of ten to fifty years and a midpoint of thirty years was used. The Company determined the expected volatility assumption using the frequency of daily historical prices of comparable public companies’ common stock for a period equal to the expected term. The risk-free interest rate assumption is based upon observed interest rates on U.S. Government securities for a period consistent with the expected term. The dividend yield assumption is based on the Company’s history and expectation of dividend payouts. The Company has never declared or paid any cash dividends on its Common Stock and does not anticipate paying any cash dividends in the foreseeable future.
paras.zh: SpaceX CEO 奖励和 AI CEO 奖励除马斯克先生持续任职至各里程碑实现之日外，并无明确的业绩期。因此，对十至五十年的预期期限进行了分析，并采用了三十年的中点值。公司使用可比上市公司普通股在等于预期期限的期间内的每日历史价格频率来确定预期波动率假设。无风险利率假设基于与预期期限一致的期间内观察到的美国政府证券利率。股息率假设基于公司的历史及对股息支付的预期。公司从未就其普通股宣布或支付任何现金股息，且预计在可预见的未来不会支付任何现金股息。

paras.en: In assessing the realizability of deferred tax assets, the Company considered whether it is more likely than not that some or all of its net deferred tax assets will not be realizable based on the relevant weight of all positive and negative evidence. As of March 31, 2026, the Company continues to maintain a full valuation allowance against its deferred tax assets in the United States, with the exception of certain state deferred tax assets and transferrable investment tax credits that are expected to be realizable. The Company has also recorded valuation allowances in certain foreign jurisdictions where it concluded that it is more likely than not that the deferred tax assets will not be realized. The Company will continue to assess the realizability of its deferred tax assets in future periods and will adjust the valuation allowance as necessary based on changes in facts and circumstances.
paras.zh: 在评估递延所得税资产的可实现性时，公司综合考虑了所有正面和负面证据的相关权重，判断其部分或全部净递延所得税资产是否很可能无法实现。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，公司继续对其在美国的递延所得税资产维持全额估值备抵，但预计可实现的部分州递延所得税资产和可转让投资税收抵免除外。公司还在其认定递延所得税资产很可能无法实现的某些境外税收管辖区计提了估值备抵。公司将继续评估其递延所得税资产在未来期间的可实现性，并将根据事实和情况的变化在必要时调整估值备抵。

paras.en: #### Legal Proceedings
paras.zh: #### 法律诉讼

paras.en: In the normal course of its business, the Company is involved from time to time in various arbitrations, class actions, commercial litigation, investigations and other legal, regulatory or governmental actions, including the significant matters described below that could have a material impact on our results of operations. The Company assesses, in conjunction with its legal counsel, the need to record a liability for litigation and contingencies. With respect to the cases, actions, and inquiries described below, the Company evaluates the associated developments on a regular basis and will accrue a liability when it believes a loss is probable and the amount can be reasonably estimated. In addition, the Company believes there is a reasonable possibility that it may incur a loss in some of these matters and the loss may be material or exceed its estimated ranges of possible loss.
paras.zh: 在日常经营过程中，公司不时涉及各类仲裁、集体诉讼、商事诉讼、调查及其他法律、监管或政府行动，包括下文所述可能对我们的经营业绩产生重大影响的重大事项。公司与其法律顾问共同评估是否需要为诉讼及或有事项计提负债。对于下文所述的案件、诉讼及问询，公司定期评估相关进展，并在认为损失很可能发生且金额能够合理估计时计提负债。此外，公司认为，在其中部分事项中其可能发生损失，且该损失可能重大或超出其估计的可能损失区间。

paras.en: The outcomes of the matters described in this section, such as whether the likelihood of loss is remote, reasonably possible, or probable, or if and when the reasonably possible range of loss is estimable, are inherently uncertain, and unless specified otherwise, possible losses are not reasonably estimable at this time. If one or more of these matters were resolved against the Company for amounts above management’s estimates, the Company’s financial condition and results of operations, including in a particular reporting period in which any such outcome becomes probable and estimable, could be materially adversely affected.
paras.zh: 本节所述事项的结果，例如损失的可能性属于极小、合理可能还是很可能，或者合理可能的损失区间是否以及何时能够估计，本质上具有不确定性；除另有说明外，目前无法合理估计可能的损失。若上述一项或多项事项以高于管理层估计的金额对公司作出不利裁决，公司的财务状况和经营业绩（包括在任何此类结果变得很可能且能够估计的特定报告期内）可能受到重大不利影响。

paras.en: In November 2022, the European Union’s Digital Services Act (“DSA”) came into force as a result of which X has to comply with extensive content moderation and other duties. The Company published its first Transparency Report under the DSA in November 2023. In December 2023, the European Commission (“EC”) opened a formal investigation into X and its Irish subsidiary, Twitter International Unlimited Company (“TIUC”), which was later renamed to X Internet Unlimited Company (XIUC). On July 12, 2024, in relation to alleged breaches of Articles 25(1), 39 and 40(12) of the DSA, the EC issued preliminary findings that X’s blue checkmark is deceptive, its advertisement repository does not meet DSA requirements, and it grants inadequate access to data to third-party researchers. On September 26, 2024, XIUC and X submitted their observations challenging the EC’s preliminary findings. On December 5, 2025, the EC delivered a final decision in which it upheld its preliminary findings and imposed a fine of EUR 120 million on XIUC, X., x.AI, and Elon Musk (together, the “parties”). On February 16, 2026, the parties challenged the EC’s decision in the General Court of the European Union. This challenge remains pending.
paras.zh: 2022 年 11 月，欧盟《数字服务法》（“DSA”）生效，X 因此须遵守广泛的内容审核及其他义务。公司于 2023 年 11 月发布了其根据 DSA 的首份透明度报告。2023 年 12 月，欧盟委员会（“EC”）对 X 及其爱尔兰子公司 Twitter International Unlimited Company（“TIUC”，后更名为 X Internet Unlimited Company（XIUC））启动正式调查。2024 年 7 月 12 日，就涉嫌违反 DSA 第 25(1)条、第 39 条和第 40(12)条一事，EC 发布初步认定，认为 X 的蓝色认证标记具有欺骗性、其广告库不符合 DSA 要求，且其向第三方研究人员提供的数据访问权限不足。2024 年 9 月 26 日，XIUC 与 X 提交意见，对 EC 的初步认定提出异议。2025 年 12 月 5 日，EC 作出最终决定，维持其初步认定，并对 XIUC、X.、x.AI 及 Elon Musk（合称“各方”）处以 EUR 120 million 罚款。2026 年 2 月 16 日，各方在欧洲联盟普通法院对 EC 的决定提出异议。该异议目前仍在审理中。

paras.en: In March 2016, non-practicing entity Youtoo Technologies filed suit against Twitter, Inc. in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas alleging its Vine and Periscope products infringe Youtoo’s video-sharing patents (the ‘304, ‘506, and ‘997 patents). On Twitter’s motion, the district court dismissed the ‘304 and ’506 patents as invalid. Twitter filed petitions for Inter Partes Review before the Patent Trial and Appeals Board (PTAB) challenging all three patents-in-suit. The PTAB upheld the ‘304 and ‘506 Patents and invalidated the ‘997 Patent; the Federal Circuit affirmed. On March 16, 2020, Plaintiff (now Vidstream LLC, which allegedly acquired the patents from Youtoo Technologies in a bankruptcy proceeding), moved the Court to reconsider its earlier ruling invalidating the ‘304 and ‘506 patents. On April 1, 2022, the Court reversed its original ruling on the ‘304 and ‘506 patents. On September 27, 2024, Vidstream filed a motion for partial summary judgment, which the Court granted in part. The case went to a jury trial, and on April 16, 2025, the jury rendered a verdict finding (i) that Twitter did not infringe any claim of the ‘506 patent and two out of three claims of the ‘304 patent and that each of those patent claims was invalid, but (ii) that Twitter willfully infringed one claim of the ‘304 patent. The jury awarded Plaintiff $105 million in damages. In November 2025, the district court affirmed the jury’s award and awarded an additional $67 million in prejudgment interest. Twitter has appealed and Vidstream has cross-appealed. Both appeals remain pending before the Federal Circuit.
paras.zh: 2016 年 3 月，非执业实体 Youtoo Technologies 在美国德克萨斯州北区联邦地区法院对 Twitter, Inc. 提起诉讼，指控其 Vine 和 Periscope 产品侵犯 Youtoo 的视频共享专利（‘304、‘506 和 ‘997 专利）。经 Twitter 动议，地区法院以无效为由驳回 ‘304 和 ‘506 专利。Twitter 向专利审判与上诉委员会（PTAB）提交多方复审请求，对全部三项涉案专利提出异议。PTAB 维持 ‘304 和 ‘506 专利有效，并宣告 ‘997 专利无效；联邦巡回法院予以维持。2020 年 3 月 16 日，原告（现为 Vidstream LLC，据称其在破产程序中从 Youtoo Technologies 处取得上述专利）向法院提出动议，请求重新考虑其此前宣告 ‘304 和 ‘506 专利无效的裁定。2022 年 4 月 1 日，法院推翻其关于 ‘304 和 ‘506 专利的原裁定。2024 年 9 月 27 日，Vidstream 提交部分简易判决动议，法院部分准许。该案进入陪审团审理，2025 年 4 月 16 日，陪审团作出裁决，认定 (i) Twitter 未侵犯 ‘506 专利的任何权利要求以及 ‘304 专利三项权利要求中的两项，且上述各项专利权利要求均无效，但 (ii) Twitter 故意侵犯了 ‘304 专利的一项权利要求。陪审团判给原告 $105 million 损害赔偿。2025 年 11 月，地区法院维持陪审团裁决，并另行判给 $67 million 判决前利息。Twitter 已提起上诉，Vidstream 已提起交叉上诉。两起上诉目前均在联邦巡回法院审理中。

paras.en: In June 2023, music publishing companies that are members of the National Music Publishers’ Association (the “NMPA”) filed a complaint against X in the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Tennessee, claiming direct, contributory, and vicarious copyright infringement based on Twitter’s alleged failure to expeditiously take down infringing music posted by users after the music publishers allegedly gave Twitter notice of those infringements. The music publishers also allege that Twitter did not suspend the accounts of “repeat infringers,” so that Twitter is not entitled to a “safe harbor” from liability under the DMCA. X filed a motion to dismiss the complaint on August 14, 2023. On March 5, 2024, the Court dismissed plaintiffs’ direct infringement and vicarious infringement claims, and part of plaintiffs’ claim for contributory infringement. X answered the complaint on April 9, 2024. Litigation was stayed from June 11, 2025 to September 9, 2025 for settlement discussions that were not successful. Accordingly, discovery is ongoing. On April 1, 2026, the Court granted the parties’ joint motion for a stay to allow X to file a renewed motion to dismiss the suit based on the Supreme Court’s decision in Cox Comm’s, Inc. v. Sony Music Entm’t. Fact discovery is now closed. In light of this Supreme Court ruling, the parties have stipulated to a May 11, 2026 deadline for the music publishers to amend their complaint with respect to their remaining claims for contributory infringement, and a June 11, 2026 deadline for X to file a renewed motion to dismiss.
paras.zh: 2023 年 6 月，作为美国国家音乐出版商协会（“NMPA”）成员的几家音乐出版公司在美国田纳西州中区联邦地区法院对 X 提起诉讼，主张直接侵权、帮助侵权及替代侵权著作权责任，理由是据称音乐出版商已就相关侵权行为向 Twitter 发出通知后，Twitter 未能迅速下架用户发布的侵权音乐。音乐出版商还主张，Twitter 未暂停“重复侵权者”的账户，因此 Twitter 无权依据 DMCA 享有责任“避风港”。X 于 2023 年 8 月 14 日提出驳回起诉的动议。2024 年 3 月 5 日，法院驳回了原告的直接侵权和替代侵权主张，以及原告帮助侵权主张的一部分。X 于 2024 年 4 月 9 日对起诉状作出答辩。诉讼自 2025 年 6 月 11 日起中止至 2025 年 9 月 9 日，以便进行和解磋商，但磋商未能成功。因此，证据开示仍在进行中。2026 年 4 月 1 日，法院批准了双方共同提出的中止申请，以便 X 基于最高法院在 Cox Comm’s, Inc. v. Sony Music Entm’t 一案中的判决重新提出驳回诉讼的动议。事实证据开示现已结束。鉴于最高法院的该项裁决，双方已约定：音乐出版商须于 2026 年 5 月 11 日前就其剩余的帮助侵权主张修改起诉状，X 须于 2026 年 6 月 11 日前重新提出驳回动议。

paras.en: In September 2023, Dutch foundation Stichting Data Bescherming Nederland (“SDBN”) filed a putative class action lawsuit in the District Court of Amsterdam in the Netherlands against TIUC, Twitter, Inc., X Corp., and Twitter Netherlands b.v. related to Twitter’s operation of the MoPub platform. SDBN primarily claims that MoPub’s real-time bidding ad exchange violated the GDPR. SDBN claims to represent 11 million Dutch internet users who downloaded and used third-party mobile apps containing the MoPub software development kit during the period 2013-2022 and it seeks a monetary award in the range of € 250 to € 2,500 per person. On February 4, 2026, the Court declined to allow the case to proceed as a class action and indicated that it is considering staying the proceedings until the Court of Justice of the European Union has ruled in a separate case concerning the applicability of Dutch class action requirements to GDPR claims. The Twitter parties filed a brief in support of the proposed stay, which the plaintiffs opposed, on March 4, 2026.
paras.zh: 2023 年 9 月，荷兰基金会 Stichting Data Bescherming Nederland（“SDBN”）在荷兰阿姆斯特丹地区法院对 TIUC、Twitter, Inc.、X Corp.和 Twitter Netherlands b.v.提起一项拟议集体诉讼，涉及 Twitter 对 MoPub 平台的运营。SDBN 主要主张 MoPub 的实时竞价广告交易平台违反了 GDPR。SDBN 声称其代表 11 百万名荷兰互联网用户，这些用户在 2013-2022 年期间下载并使用了包含 MoPub 软件开发工具包的第三方移动应用，并寻求按每人€ 250 至€ 2,500 的金额判给赔偿。2026 年 2 月 4 日，法院未允许本案作为集体诉讼继续进行，并表示正在考虑中止诉讼程序，直至欧盟法院就另一案件中荷兰集体诉讼要求对 GDPR 主张的适用性作出裁决。Twitter 各方于 2026 年 3 月 4 日提交了支持拟议中止的书面意见，原告对此表示反对。

paras.en: In August 2024, Dutch foundation Stichting Onderzoek Marktinformatie (SOMI) initiated a collective action in the District Court of Amsterdam in the Netherlands on behalf of approximately 7.8 million Dutch X users. Among other things, SOMI seeks damages against TIUC, X Corp. and Twitter Netherlands B.V. (collectively, the “X entities”) for: (1) alleged data breaches and insufficient security measures; (2) alleged unauthorized microtargeting and lack of transparency; and (3) the alleged failure to moderate hate speech and the obstruction of research, all in violation of the GDPR and/or DSA. The alleged data breaches relate to a Twitter API bug that came to light in 2022 and that had allowed persons who knew the email address or phone number of a user to determine the user’s Twitter ID. SOMI has requested compensation (to be assessed at a later stage) for each member of the class, including symbolic damages of EUR 1 for each member of the class that is allegedly affected by hate speech on the X platform. The X entities filed a procedural defense on March 12, 2025. The court held a hearing on April 2, 2026, and indicated that it would hand down its decision on May 27, 2026.
paras.zh: 2024 年 8 月，荷兰基金会 Stichting Onderzoek Marktinformatie（SOMI）代表约 7.8 million 荷兰 X 用户，在荷兰阿姆斯特丹地区法院提起集体诉讼。SOMI 请求判令 TIUC、X Corp. 和 Twitter Netherlands B.V.（合称“X 实体”）就以下事项承担损害赔偿等责任：(1) 涉嫌数据泄露及安全措施不足；(2) 涉嫌未经授权的微定向投放及缺乏透明度；(3) 涉嫌未能对仇恨言论进行审核以及妨碍研究，上述行为均违反 GDPR 和/或 DSA。所称数据泄露涉及 2022 年曝光的一个 Twitter API 漏洞，该漏洞曾使知晓用户电子邮件地址或电话号码的人能够确定该用户的 Twitter ID。SOMI 已请求为每一位集体成员提供赔偿（具体金额留待后续阶段评估），其中包括向每一位据称在 X 平台上受到仇恨言论影响的集体成员支付 1 欧元的象征性损害赔偿。X 实体于 2025 年 3 月 12 日提交了程序性抗辩。法院于 2026 年 4 月 2 日举行听证，并表示将于 2026 年 5 月 27 日作出裁决。

paras.en: In September 2025, non-practicing entity Search and Share Technologies, LLC (“SaS”) filed a patent complaint against X Corp. in the Federal District Court for the Western District of Texas. SaS alleges that X Corp. infringed on U.S. Patent Nos. 10,180,952 and 11,106,744, through features in its mobile app and website enabling users to interact with content through dedicated interfaces that directly share what other users see in ranked feeds and search results. SaS filed an Amended Complaint on January 5, 2026. On January 20, 2026, X Corp. moved to dismiss SaS’s willful infringement and induced infringement claims. On February 3, 2026, SAS responded to, but did not oppose, X Corp.’s partial motion to dismiss. On February 10, 2026, X Corp. filed its reply. On February 4, 2026, X Corp. filed an IPR petition challenging the ‘744 Patent and on February 18, 2026, filed an IPR petition challenging the '952 Patent.
paras.zh: 2025 年 9 月，非执业实体 Search and Share Technologies, LLC（“SaS”）在德克萨斯州西区联邦地区法院对 X Corp. 提起专利诉讼。SaS 指控 X Corp. 通过其移动应用和网站中的功能侵犯了美国专利第 10,180,952 号和第 11,106,744 号，这些功能使用户能够通过专用界面与内容互动，直接分享其他用户在排序信息流和搜索结果中看到的内容。SaS 于 2026 年 1 月 5 日提交了修订起诉状。2026 年 1 月 20 日，X Corp. 提出动议，请求驳回 SaS 的故意侵权和诱导侵权主张。2026 年 2 月 3 日，SAS 对 X Corp. 的部分驳回动议作出回应，但未提出异议。2026 年 2 月 10 日，X Corp. 提交了答辩状。2026 年 2 月 4 日，X Corp. 提交 IPR 申请，对 '744 专利提出质疑；2026 年 2 月 18 日，又提交 IPR 申请，对 '952 专利提出质疑。

paras.en: Beginning in January 2026, the Company and certain subsidiaries have been named as defendants in multiple lawsuits arising from Grok’s image-generation and editing features. The complaints generally allege that Grok’s image-generation and editing features enabled the creation and dissemination of nonconsensual explicit images and/ or content representing women and/or children in sexualized contexts. The actions include Jane Doe v. X.AI Corp. and X.AI LLC, instituted in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California on January 23, 2026, and Jane Doe 1 et al. v. X.AI Corp. and X.AI LLC (the “Jane Doe 1 Case”) instituted in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California on March 16, 2026. These cases are putative class actions, asserting claims including, among other things, claims of strict liability, negligence, nuisance, rights of privacy or publicity, and, in the Jane Doe 1 Case, certain federal statutory claims. Plaintiffs in these two cases seek, among other things, compensatory, statutory and punitive damages, restitution, disgorgement and injunctive relief. In addition, a case, Mayor and City Council of Baltimore ex rel. Ebony M. Thompson v. X Corp., X.AI Corp., X.AI LLC, and Space Exploration Technologies Corp, was instituted in the Baltimore City Circuit Court on March 24, 2026 (the “Baltimore Case”). The plaintiff in the Baltimore Case, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore, asserts similar claims to those in the two cases discussed above under Baltimore’s Consumer Protection Ordinances. The plaintiff in the Baltimore Case seeks statutory penalties and/or injunctive relief. The Company intends to defend itself vigorously in these actions.
paras.zh: 自 2026 年 1 月起，公司及若干子公司已在多起因 Grok 的图像生成和编辑功能而提起的诉讼中被列为被告。起诉状普遍指控 Grok 的图像生成和编辑功能使得未经同意制作和传播露骨图像及/或在性化语境中描绘女性和/或儿童的内容成为可能。相关诉讼包括于 2026 年 1 月 23 日在美国加利福尼亚州北区联邦地区法院提起的 Jane Doe 诉 X.AI Corp. 及 X.AI LLC 案，以及于 2026 年 3 月 16 日在美国加利福尼亚州北区联邦地区法院提起的 Jane Doe 1 等诉 X.AI Corp. 及 X.AI LLC 案（“Jane Doe 1 案”）。上述案件为推定集体诉讼，主张的请求包括（除其他事项外）严格责任、过失、妨害、隐私权或公开权等请求，且 Jane Doe 1 案中还包含某些联邦法定请求。上述两案原告寻求（除其他事项外）补偿性、法定及惩罚性损害赔偿、返还、交出违法所得及禁令救济。此外，Mayor and City Council of Baltimore ex rel. Ebony M. Thompson 诉 X Corp.、X.AI Corp.、X.AI LLC 及 Space Exploration Technologies Corp 一案已于 2026 年 3 月 24 日在巴尔的摩市巡回法院提起（“巴尔的摩案”）。巴尔的摩案的原告巴尔的摩市长和市议会依据巴尔的摩《消费者保护条例》主张与上述两案类似的请求。巴尔的摩案原告寻求法定罚款和/或禁令救济。公司拟在上述诉讼中积极抗辩。

paras.en: On April 14, 2026, the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People and the NAACP Mississippi State Conference (together, the “NAACP”) filed suit against X.AI Corp. and MZX Tech, LLC alleging that the mobile gas turbines powering the COLOSSUS II data center with the permission of the Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality are in violation of the Clean Air Act because they allegedly constitute stationary sources without the proper permits. On May 6, 2026, the NAACP filed a preliminary injunction motion seeking to enjoin the operation of the turbines. The Company intends to defend itself vigorously in these actions.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 14 日，全国有色人种协进会及 NAACP 密西西比州分会（合称“NAACP”）对 X.AI Corp. 及 MZX Tech, LLC 提起诉讼，指控经密西西比州环境质量部许可为 COLOSSUS II 数据中心供电的移动式燃气轮机违反了《清洁空气法》，理由是该等燃气轮机据称构成未取得适当许可的固定污染源。2026 年 5 月 6 日，NAACP 提交初步禁令动议，寻求禁止该等燃气轮机的运行。公司拟在上述诉讼中积极抗辩。

paras.en: The Company has recorded an accrual of $399 million for litigation losses that are probable and reasonably estimable in Accrued expenses and other current liabilities and Other liabilities on the consolidated balance sheet as of March 31, 2026. For other matters, the Company is not currently able to estimate the reasonably possible loss or range of loss.
paras.zh: 公司已在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日合并资产负债表中的应计费用及其他流动负债和其他负债项下，就很可能发生且能够合理估计的诉讼损失计提 $399 million。对于其他事项，公司目前无法估计合理可能的损失或损失区间。

paras.zh: 公司不时与其首席执行官和董事有关联的某些实体开展业务。

paras.en: During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the Company purchased $34 million of Megapack products from Tesla, Inc. (“Tesla”) recorded in Property, plant, and equipment, net in the consolidated balance sheets. In April 2026, the Company purchased $269 million of Megapack products from Tesla. As of December 31, 2025, the Company purchased $506 million of Megapack products and $131 million of Cybertrucks at manufacturer’s suggested retail price from Tesla, recorded in Property, plant, and equipment, net in the consolidated balance sheets.
paras.zh: 在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，公司从 Tesla, Inc.（“Tesla”）购买了 $34 million 的 Megapack 产品，并计入合并资产负债表中的物业、厂房及设备净额。2026 年 4 月，公司从 Tesla 购买了 $269 million 的 Megapack 产品。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，公司按制造商建议零售价从 Tesla 购买了 $506 million 的 Megapack 产品和 $131 million 的 Cybertrucks，并计入合并资产负债表中的物业、厂房及设备净额。

paras.en: In January 2026, and as further amended on February 18, 2026, CTC entered into an equipment lease agreement with Valor Equity Partners (“Valor”) for certain AI infrastructure hardware (“Valor transaction II”). The founder, CEO and Chief Investment Officer of Valor, Antonio Gracias, serves as one of the directors of the Company. The Valor transaction II was deemed to be a failed sale-leaseback transaction. The Company has previously entered into a similar agreement with Valor for other AI infrastructure hardware. As of March 31, 2026, the Company recorded debt of $1,121 million and $7,920 million within Debt and finance leases, current and Debt and finance leases, net of current, respectively, in the Company’s consolidated balance sheet, and $186 million in Interest expense for the three months ended March 31, 2026 in the Company’s consolidated statement of operations related to equipment lease agreements with Valor. As of December 31, 2025, the Company recorded debt of $455 million and $4,052 million within Debt and finance leases, current and Debt and finance leases, net of current, respectively, in the Company’s consolidated balance sheet related to equipment lease agreements with Valor. Refer to Note 9, Debt for additional details. The related asset is recorded within Property, plant, and equipment, net in the Company’s consolidated balance sheets.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，并经 2026 年 2 月 18 日进一步修订，CTC 与 Valor Equity Partners（“Valor”）就某些 AI 基础设施硬件订立了一份设备租赁协议（“Valor 交易 II”）。Valor 的创始人、首席执行官兼首席投资官 Antonio Gracias 担任公司董事之一。Valor 交易 II 被视为失败的售后回租交易。公司此前已就其他 AI 基础设施硬件与 Valor 订立过类似协议。截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，公司在其合并资产负债表中分别于“债务及融资租赁，流动”和“债务及融资租赁，扣除流动部分”中记录了 $1,121 million 和 $7,920 million 的债务，并在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，在其合并利润表中就与 Valor 的设备租赁协议记录了 $186 million 的利息费用。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，公司在其合并资产负债表中分别于“债务及融资租赁，流动”和“债务及融资租赁，扣除流动部分”中记录了与 Valor 的设备租赁协议相关的 $455 million 和 $4,052 million 的债务。更多详情请参见附注 9“债务”。相关资产计入公司合并资产负债表中的物业、厂房及设备净额。

paras.en: Other transactions with Tesla and other related parties during the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025 were immaterial.
paras.zh: 在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日和 2025 年 3 月 31 日的三个月内，与 Tesla 及其他关联方的其他交易均不重大。

paras.en: Following the Mergers, the Company evaluated how to view and measure performance of the combined company and potential realignment of individual entity’s historical segment structure. Following this evaluation, the Company determined that as a combined company, effective in Q1 2026, the Company’s Chief Executive Officer, as the Chief Operating Decision Maker (“CODM”), organizes the Company, manages resource allocations, and measures performance among three operating and reportable segments: (i) Space, (ii) Connectivity, and (iii) AI. Prior period presentations for segments conform to the current segment reporting structure.
paras.zh: 合并完成后，公司评估了如何审视和衡量合并后公司的业绩，以及各实体历史分部结构可能进行的重新调整。经此评估，公司确定作为合并后公司，自 2026 年第一季度起生效，公司首席执行官作为首席经营决策者（“CODM”），按三个经营及报告分部来组织公司、管理资源配置并衡量业绩：(i) 太空、(ii) 连接和 (iii) AI。分部的以往期间列报已与当前分部报告结构保持一致。

paras.en: The Company’s CODM assesses performance and allocates resources to operating segments based on segment income (loss) from operations by comparing actual income (loss) from operations to historical results and previously forecasted financial information. The Company’s CODM does not evaluate operating and reportable segments using asset or liability information.
paras.zh: 公司 CODM 根据分部经营利润（亏损），通过将实际经营利润（亏损）与历史业绩及先前预测的财务信息进行比较，来评估业绩并向经营分部分配资源。公司 CODM 不使用资产或负债信息来评估经营及可报告分部。

paras.en: #### Collaboration Agreement
paras.zh: #### 合作协议

paras.en: On April 19, 2026, the Company entered into a compute agreement with Anysphere, Inc., doing business as Cursor, a San Francisco-based private software company (“Cursor”). Pursuant to the compute agreement, the Company will collaborate with Cursor to improve the Company’s existing models, including Grok, and potentially to jointly develop AI models and related model-specific deliverables.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 19 日，本公司与 Anysphere, Inc.（以 Cursor 为商号经营，一家总部位于旧金山的私营软件公司，简称“Cursor”）签订了一份算力协议。根据该算力协议，本公司将与 Cursor 合作改进本公司现有模型（包括 Grok），并可能共同开发 AI 模型及相关模型专属交付成果。

paras.en: Concurrent with the compute agreement, the Company also entered into an option agreement for the right, but not the obligation, to acquire Cursor. The option agreement generally provides that the Company may exercise the call option at any time during the 30-day period following the earlier of (i) seven trading days following the completion of the Company’s IPO and (ii) September 30, 2026. Exercise of the call option is in the Company’s sole discretion and subject to further approval by the board of directors. Cursor is also subject to certain exclusivity obligations under the option agreement. The consideration for the acquisition of Cursor would consist of shares of Class A common stock based on an implied equity value of Cursor of $60.0 billion, and the price of Class A common stock that equals, if the acquisition closed prior to the completion of this offering, the most recent quarterly valuation, or, if the acquisition closed after the completion of the Company’s IPO, the volume-weighted average closing price thereof over the seven consecutive trading days immediately preceding the closing of the acquisition. If either (i) the Company decides to terminate the option agreement or (ii) Cursor is eligible to and decides to terminate due to the Company’s material breach of the option agreement, Cursor is entitled to a $1.5 billion termination fee under the option agreement and an $8.5 billion deferred services fee under the compute agreement. These fees are payable in cash (or Class A common stock, if the Company’s IPO has not been consummated at the time the fees become payable).
paras.zh: 与算力协议同时，公司还签订了一份选择权协议，获得收购 Cursor 的权利（但无义务）。该选择权协议一般规定，公司可在以下两者中较早发生者之后的 30 天期间内随时行使认购期权：(i) 公司 IPO 完成后七个交易日，及 (ii) 2026 年 9 月 30 日。行使认购期权由公司自行决定，并须经董事会进一步批准。Cursor 亦须遵守选择权协议项下的若干排他性义务。收购 Cursor 的对价将包括基于 Cursor 隐含股权价值 $60.0 billion 的 A 类普通股股份，以及 A 类普通股的价格，该价格等于：若收购在本发售完成前交割，则为最近一次季度估值；若收购在公司 IPO 完成后交割，则为紧接收购交割前七个连续交易日的成交量加权平均收盘价。若 (i) 公司决定终止选择权协议，或 (ii) Cursor 因公司重大违反选择权协议而有资格并决定终止，则 Cursor 有权根据选择权协议获得 $1.5 billion 的终止费，并根据算力协议获得 $8.5 billion 的递延服务费。该等费用应以现金支付（或若费用到期应付时公司 IPO 尚未完成，则以 A 类普通股支付）。

paras.en: The Company has conducted preliminary due diligence on Cursor’s business, technology and operations, and expect to continue such diligence in connection with any decision to exercise the call option. The Company cannot predict whether the Company will elect to exercise the call option or, if exercised, whether the acquisition will close on the anticipated terms or at all.
paras.zh: 公司已对 Cursor 的业务、技术和运营进行了初步尽职调查，并预计在就任何行使认购期权的决定进行相关工作时将继续进行该等尽职调查。公司无法预测公司是否会选择行使认购期权，或若行使，收购是否会按预期条款完成或根本无法完成。

paras.zh: #### 售后回租交易

paras.en: On April 24, 2026, CTC entered into a five-year equipment lease agreement with Valor, a related party, for certain AI infrastructure hardware (“Valor transaction III”) for total undiscounted lease payments of $6,587 million.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 24 日，CTC 与关联方 Valor 就某些 AI 基础设施硬件（“Valor 交易 III”）签订了一份五年期设备租赁协议，未折现租赁付款总额为 $6,587 million。

paras.en: #### Asset Acquisition
paras.zh: #### 资产收购

paras.en: On April 30, 2026, the Company entered into an asset purchase agreement with an unaffiliated third party to purchase certain mobile gas turbines and related packages for approximately $2,000 million (the “Turbine Acquisition”). The closing of the Turbine Acquisition is expected to occur in May 2026 and is subject to customary closing conditions. The seller has also agreed to enter into a post-closing services agreement to support the Company's turbine operations. The Turbine Acquisition will help provide power to the Company's data centers.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 30 日，公司与一家非关联第三方签订了一份资产购买协议，以约 $2,000 million 购买某些移动燃气轮机及相关配套设备（“燃气轮机收购”）。燃气轮机收购预计于 2026 年 5 月交割，并须满足惯常交割条件。卖方亦已同意签订交割后服务协议，以支持公司的燃气轮机运营。燃气轮机收购将有助于为公司数据中心提供电力。

paras.en: #### Cloud Services Agreement
paras.zh: #### 云服务协议

paras.en: On May 3, 2026, the Company entered into a cloud services agreement with Anthropic PBC, an AI research and development public benefit corporation, with respect to access to compute capacity. Pursuant to this agreement, the customer has agreed to pay a monthly fee through May 2029, with capacity ramping in May 2026 at a reduced fee. The agreement may be terminated by either party upon 90 days’ notice. The customer will retain ownership and intellectual property rights in its content, AI models, and related data.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月 3 日，公司与 Anthropic PBC（一家 AI 研发公益公司）就获取算力容量签订了一份云服务协议。根据该协议，客户已同意在 2029 年 5 月之前按月支付费用，其中 2026 年 5 月的容量将以较低费用逐步提升。该协议可由任何一方提前 90 天通知终止。客户将保留对其内容、AI 模型及相关数据的所有权和知识产权。
